job.name: Staff Software Engineer- BE
job.description:
Strength in Trust OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead technical direction across a major feature area or set of related systems at OneTrust. Staff Engineers determine their own approach on complex, often ambiguous assignments, and their technical judgment is trusted well beyond their immediate team.

Your Mission Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Lead design and architecture for major features or components, ensuring alignment with the broader system architecture.
  • Determine approach and methods independently on complex, ambiguous assignments without an established playbook.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Partner with other engineering teams, Product, and UX to shape solutions before implementation begins.
  • Build working relationships and technical credibility beyond your immediate team.

Quality & Standards

  • Establish and champion engineering best practices adopted by your team and beyond.

Mentorship

  • Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers, helping them grow their technical judgment and scope of ownership.

You Are Someone who determines methods and approach independently on new, complex assignments, and who is sought out by other engineers for technical guidance beyond your own team. You think in terms of systems and tradeoffs, not just individual tickets.

Your Experience Includes

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Demonstrated track record leading technical initiatives that span multiple engineers or systems
  • Deep expertise in frontend and/or backend technologies relevant to OneTrust's platform, including cloud architecture experience
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Windsurf, or similar) in a professional setting, with genuine enthusiasm for applying AI to accelerate and elevate day-to-day engineering work.

Where we Work

Automation Engineer
job.description:
Automation Engineer | Control Systems | Embedded Systems

Employment: Full-time, on-site

Experience: 2–5 years

CHILTIER develops personal cooling and heating systems. Our ThermoPod circulates temperature-controlled water through a wearable vest, using a compact system that integrates thermoelectric modules, a pump, fans and sensors.

We’re hiring a hands-on engineer to develop the ThermoPod’s control logic and validate it on real hardware. You’ll work with our team to take the system from prototype testing through production validation.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and tune closed-loop temperature control. Use sensor feedback while balancing thermal performance, power consumption and noise.
  • Define and implement system behaviour for startup, shutdown, operating modes and transitions between vehicle and battery power.
  • Develop protective behaviour for conditions such as overheating, low supply voltage, loss of water flow and sensor faults. Verify how the system detects faults, shuts down and recovers.
  • Implement or integrate control logic in embedded firmware. Bring up and debug sensors, actuators and controller boards alongside the electronics and firmware teams.
  • Instrument prototypes to measure temperature, flow, voltage and current. Analyse test data to diagnose issues across firmware, electronics and the thermal system.
  • Build repeatable bench tests and automate data logging where useful. Validate performance under different ambient temperatures, thermal loads and power conditions.
  • Document control logic, calibration settings and test results for design reviews and production handover.

What you’ll bring

  • A degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Controls or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 2–5 years of experience in embedded systems, control systems or product automation, with at least one project involving real hardware.
  • Experience implementing or tuning feedback control, such as PID or hysteresis, and using measured data to verify system behaviour.
  • Practical experience with embedded C or C++, microcontrollers, and interfaces such as ADC, PWM, I²C, SPI or UART.
  • Experience integrating sensors and actuators and troubleshooting with tools such as a multimeter, oscilloscope, bench power supply or data logger.
  • Ability to design a test, interpret the results and explain what you would change based on the evidence.

Good to have

  • Experience with thermoelectric modules, refrigeration, liquid cooling, motor control or battery-powered products.
  • Experience with STM32, ESP32 or similar microcontrollers, or with an RTOS.
  • Python or MATLAB skills for test automation, data logging or analysis.
  • Experience taking a physical product through prototype validation, pilot production or manufacturing handover.

job.name: Functional Validation
job.description:
OUR STORY At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. YOUR ROLE Lab validation and characterization

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications.

As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time.

In this context, you will be responsible for developing the validation environment (definition of the tests suite, of the test bench in the laboratory, of the hardware, development of stimuli, automation, documentation). To do this, you will benefit from the different areas of technical expertise of our employees in testing, optics, electronics, mechanics, and software development.

Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration.

To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs.

You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team.

Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements.

Your Skills & Experiences

  • Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
  • Version management tools (git, svn)
  • Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities.
  • Knowledge:
  • Embedded electronics / computing (real time)

Exp: 7 to 12yrs

job.name: Director of Engineering
job.description:
**Meritto is the operating system for enrollment and embedded finance for education institutions. More than 1,100 institutions across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East rely on Meritto to run mission-critical operations across the student enrollment journey, from the first inquiry through admissions, fee collection, and payment reconciliation.

The platform supports billions of student interactions and millions of leads. It handles high-volume workflows, complex payment flows, and institution-specific processes on shared infrastructure. A deep ecosystem of integrations, APIs, and a developer portal connects Meritto to the systems institutions already depend on. During peak admission cycles, these workflows need to perform reliably at scale.

About the role

We’re hiring a Director of Engineering to lead multiple engineering teams across a core area of the Meritto platform. You’ll own engineering delivery from commitment through production, with responsibility for team capacity, technical decisions, and production outcomes.

Your mandate is to make delivery faster and more predictable while improving platform reliability. You’ll put the engineering practices in place to make that possible, embed AI into how teams build and test software, and help bring AI-native capabilities into production.

What you’ll own

\* Delivery and commitments. Partner with Product and QA to translate priorities into realistic delivery plans with clear owners, dates, and dependencies. Make capacity and scope decisions early, surface delivery risks, and stay accountable through release and stabilization.

\* Engineering practices and customer issues. Establish how teams plan work, review designs and code, test changes, and release software. Work with Customer Success and Operations to give customer issues a clear path from triage to engineering ownership, resolution, and closure.

\* AI-assisted engineering and AI-native products. Embed AI into codebase exploration, prototyping, implementation, review, debugging, and test automation. Set standards for validating AI-generated changes and protecting code and customer data. Partner with Product to define how AI features are evaluated and monitored in production.

\* Architecture, quality, and reliability. Lead technical decisions for your area and stay close to critical designs and releases. Strengthen automated coverage for critical workflows, improve release safeguards and observability, and own the engineering response to incidents and recurring defects.

\* People and performance. Lead and develop engineering managers, technical leads, and engineers. Track delivery against commitments, lead time to production, defects that reach customers, and incident recovery time. Use those measures to identify bottlenecks and verify that changes are improving outcomes.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for an AI Engineer to work on an enterprise AI platform that is transforming how public-sector organizations evaluate tenders and procurement documents.

Our platform uses Generative AI, Agentic AI, document intelligence and open-source foundation models to automate complex document-heavy workflows involved in tender evaluation. Role Description We are seeking a highly experienced Automation Architect to define and drive the organization’s enterprise test automation strategy, with Playwright as the primary framework for modern web automation.

The ideal candidate will architect, govern, and implement scalable automation solutions across web applications, APIs, databases, batch processes, and end-to-end business workflows. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role responsible for defining automation roadmaps, establishing enterprise frameworks and engineering standards, identifying high-value automation opportunities, integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines, and building sustainable automation capabilities that improve software quality, accelerate releases, and reduce manual testing effort.

Key Responsibilities

Automation Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and execute the enterprise test automation vision, roadmap, and target-state architecture.
  • Establish Playwright as a strategic automation framework for modern web applications.

Playwright Automation

  • Architect and develop enterprise-grade Playwright frameworks using TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • Implement framework patterns including Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable components, utilities, configuration management, and data-driven testing.

job.name: IoT Developer (Automotive Telematics)
job.description:
Position : IoT Developer (Automotive Telematics)

Job Summary

We are seeking an IoT Developer with 5 to 6 years of experience to join our team in a full-time, On-Site capacity. In this role, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of our connected vehicle platform, managing vehicle modeling, certificate-based security architecture, automated device provisioning, and serverless backend services. You will build, scale, and maintain critical data pipelines and automation tools that connect our physical hardware to the cloud.

Core Responsibilities

● Secure Device Connectivity & Protocol Management:

○ Design and maintain edge-to-cloud messaging pipelines utilizing MQTT for lightweight, real-time vehicle telemetry and HTTP/REST APIs for bulk data or command payloads.

○ Implement, debug, and enforce mTLS (Mutual TLS) authentication across all hardware endpoints (TCUs) to guarantee secure, encrypted communication with AWS IoT Core.

● AWS IoT FleetWise Vehicle Modeling & Data Configuration:

○ Design and maintain Signal Catalogs, Model Manifests, and Decoder Manifests for vehicle data ingestion.

○ Manage data campaigns and establish workflows for Last Known State (LKS) updates.

○ Translate automotive network files (e.g., DBC files) into cloud-compatible telemetry decoder schemas.

● Vehicle Lifecycle & Provisioning Management:

○ Own the technical workflows for TCU (Telematics Control Unit) and vehicle provisioning.

○ Develop and manage secure link/delink data flows, device quarantine/de-quarantine processes, and vehicle decommissioning.

● IoT Security & Certificate Architecture:

○ Manage Root CA certificate lifecycles, Intermediate Certificate Authority (ICA) rotations, and self-signed certificate strategies.

○ Utilize AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) Private Certificate Authority (PCA) to orchestrate automated vehicle and ICA certificate rotations

● Backend & Serverless Development:

○ Develop, optimize, and maintain AWS Lambda functions handling real-time events, including notification partition handlers.

○ Manage Azure repositories, ensuring clean branching strategies, deployment guidelines, and optimized CI/CD pipelines.

● Automation & Scripting:

○ Develop and maintain automated scripts using Python and Bash to orchestrate cron jobs, manage CI/CD pipelines.

○ Develop secure backend scripts for cross-environment validation, including cross-env secret key validation.

Required Skills & Experience

● Experience: 5 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, with a heavy focus on IoT engineering, connected vehicle platforms, or automotive telematics.

● IoT Networking Protocols: Deep understanding and production experience configuring MQTT brokers/topics and HTTP/HTTPS web services.

● Edge Security & Authentication: Practical expertise deploying mTLS (Mutual TLS) for hardware client-side authentication, along with TLS handshake

troubleshooting.

This role serves as the operational bridge between media activation, partner reporting, Business Intelligence, and client analytics. Key Responsibilities

Reporting Intake and Operational Management

  • Maintain a centralized inventory of required campaign, retailer, media partner, and measurement reporting.
  • Track expected reporting dates, delivery status, missing inputs, and data-processing progress.
  • Download or collect reporting from partner portals, shared locations, email deliveries, APIs, and other approved sources.
  • Organize source files using established folder structures, file-naming standards, version controls, and retention requirements.
  • Maintain reporting calendars and communicate potential delays before they affect recap and wrap-report timelines. Data Preparation and Standardization
  • Consolidate partner reports delivered through spreadsheets, flat files, PDFs, presentations, and self-service reporting platforms.
  • Transform source data into standardized reporting templates and analysis-ready datasets.
  • Normalize campaign, retailer, brand, product, audience, placement, creative, tactic, and business-unit naming conventions.
  • Map partner-specific metrics to approved enterprise metric definitions.
  • Reconcile retailer, product, UPC, campaign, placement, and organizational hierarchies.
  • Document transformations, assumptions, exclusions, and calculations so outputs can be consistently reproduced. Data Quality and Validation
  • Perform completeness, accuracy, reasonableness, duplication, and reconciliation checks before datasets are released for analysis.
  • Validate reported spend, impressions, clicks, sales, units, ROAS, audience results, and other applicable metrics against source totals and campaign plans.
  • Identify anomalies, missing reporting dimensions, inconsistent metric definitions, and unsupported comparisons.
  • Maintain a data-quality and exception log that documents issues, owners, status, resolution, and downstream impact.
  • Escalate material data-quality risks to BI and Retail Media leadership.
  • Ensure that corrected or restated partner data is versioned and reflected in downstream datasets. Automation Readiness
  • Develop reusable templates, mapping tables, validation routines, checklists, and standard operating procedures.

  • Translate operational processes into documen

job.name: AI QE
job.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many products we use every day are conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 5+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence.

In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence.

You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing.

The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages for Teamcenter.
  • Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases.
  • Apply AI-assisted techniques to accelerate test-case generation, script development, test-data preparation, defect analysis, log analysis, troubleshooting, and regression optimization.
  • Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery.
  • Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable.
  • Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution.
  • Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage.
  • Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies.

job.name: Software Development Engineer, Returns and Recommerce
job.description:
Description Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.

WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.

Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.

We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.

Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

job.name: Compiler Performance Engineer
job.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

  • Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler
  • Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime
  • Improve code generation for x86\_64 and AArch64
  • Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions
  • Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

  • 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering
  • Strong C++ design and coding skills
  • Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations
  • Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

  • Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8
  • Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler
  • Knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
  • Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals
  • MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. job.name: Senior Frontend Engineer - Design Systems
job.description:
"We may say most aptly that the Analytical Engine weaves algebraic patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves."

— Ada Lovelace, 1843

What Lovelace saw in the loom was the pattern — flowers and leaves, repeated faithfully, each one begun by a hand that chose it. Mercury is built from patterns too. Every component, every interaction our customers come to trust, starts with someone deciding how it should go, and making it good enough to be used again and again. Tending those patterns, and giving everyone at Mercury the means to weave with them, is the work of our Design System team, and the north star of this role.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Design Systems team, you will build and care for those patterns: the components and foundations that everything else at Mercury is built on. Done well, a single decision here makes every product team faster.

The ground under that work is shifting, though. Software is being built in new ways, and AI is increasingly part of how design systems are made and used. We are looking for someone who is fluent at that intersection: deeply versed in design systems, and equally as serious about what it takes to build a system that holds up at the leading edge of AI.

As part of this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain the components, patterns, and foundations (tokens, type, color, layout) that Mercury's product is woven from, holding a high bar for accessibility, performance, and pixel-level craft.
  • Lead projects that ship new UI patterns to solve real pain points for product teams, helping them build better experiences faster.
  • Develop a design system that's as ready for AI as it is for people, applying the technology to create leveraged outcomes.
  • Invest in the design system's prototyping experience, shaping the next iteration of how our design function rapidly prototypes, iterates on the product, and explores new concepts.
  • Raise the craft and AI fluency of the people around you, through mentorship and clear best practices.

The ideal candidate for the role: We're looking for someone who cares about the foundational work that lets other people do their best work, and who's eager to help define what a design system means in a world where agents build alongside us. A successful candidate will likely have:

Role Overview The Technology Solution Engineer works with business and technology stakeholders to shape technical solutions, then builds them. This is a deliberately broad, hands-on role that combines consultative solution design with real delivery across the enterprise technology platforms.

At this level, the Technology Solution Engineer owns solutions end to end. The role runs requirement workshops directly with business stakeholders, authors the design, makes independent technical decisions, and leads the build through to operational handover. Work spans the full platform estate rather than a single technology, and includes reviewing the work of others and mentoring less experienced engineers.

The platforms in scope include cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services, integration, automation, APIs, containers, and web hosting. Platforms are run both as internal products and as managed services, so the role carries accountability for how solutions run as well as how they are built.

Key Responsibilities Solution Consulting and Design

Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, TuneLab
job.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Organization Overview Lilly Catalyze360 is a comprehensive approach to enabling the early-stage biotech ecosystem by democratizing access to infrastructure, expertise, and resources. Through its interconnected pillars–Lilly Ventures, Lilly Gateway Labs, Lilly ExploR&D, and Lilly TuneLab–Catalyze360 strategically removes barriers that traditionally block bold science from becoming life-changing medicines, providing biotechs with flexible combinations of capital, physical lab space, R&D capabilities, AI/ML tools, and decades of enterprise learning.

Lilly TuneLab is an artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) platform that provides biotech companies access to drug discovery models trained on years of Lilly’s research data. Lilly estimates that this first release of AI models includes proprietary data obtained at a cost of over $1 billion, representing one of the industry’s most valuable datasets used to train an AI system available to biotechnology companies. By integrating advanced in silico modelling and federated learning, we connect pioneering machine learning algorithms, substantial computational power, exclusive datasets, and Lilly’s domain-specific knowledge to drive innovation in drug discovery and facilitate access to optimal therapies for patients.

Job Summary TuneLab has powerful underlying AI models and point solutions. The job now is to turn them into something a biotech startup can actually use: a coherent workflow, a clean product experience, and a SaaS offering that scales.

You won’t start from zero. There are working point solutions, trained models, and internal infrastructure to build on. Federated learning is a meaningful part of the work – letting biotech customers use & train Lilly’s models without their data leaving their environment. Plenty else is yours to create from scratch.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to be one of the early engineers on this team. You’ll own meaningful product surfaces end-to-end, ship features that customers depend on, and raise the bar on what we build.

You’ll partner closely with a Staff Software Engineer and the Engineering Manager. You’ll have real influence on architecture and the engineering bar.

Read the full description

job.name: Lead Design Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About this Role:

As a Lead Design Engineer at Samsara, you'll build the systems that power our product and scale our impact as a design team. You'll define the components, patterns, tokens, and guidelines for both people and agents to build with. You'll work in design and in code, shipping highly interactive UI across web and mobile. You’ll codify our principles, heuristics, and taste for high quality ai generation. Your work will shape how quickly teams can build, how reliably our products behave, and how confidently customers use them.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US.

job.name: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Defense Autonomy
job.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions About The Role The Mission Control team at Applied Intuition builds a tailored suite of UIs that enable our defense customers to interact with our autonomy stack, also known as a C2 (Command and Control). Our users (warfighters, program managers, test engineers) need a strong user interface through which to test, understand, and operate our autonomy in simulation and in the field. This collection of UIs will provide multi-agent workflows around mission planning, monitoring, and debrief.

This role is a "startup within a startup” moving with day-long iteration cycles, and supplying much-needed autonomy tooling to the Defense industry.

Each engineer on Mission Control works on building a highly configurable, stable, and intuitive frontend platform. This will include:

  • Data-oriented design to support user interaction with live and simulated data
  • Principled architecture with clear roles and responsibilities, including strong test fixtures

Frontend UI/UX (including 2D/3D rendering and selection tools) for Defense applications including mission planning/debrief, command and control, and simulation tools

At Applied Intuition, You Will

  • Design and implement a data-oriented frontend UI/UX platform, including 2D/3D graphics & visualizations of live agents in the world.
  • Work closely with the Design team to understand user workflows, developing a vision for the Defense Tooling UI/UX

job.name: Full Stack Engineer
job.description:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer (NYC – Hybrid)

Location: New York City, NY

Our hiring partner is a pioneering cybersecurity startup that recently secured Series A funding, and are on a mission is to eliminate systemic risks in critical infrastructure—from energy grids to space systems—by transforming how software is hardened at scale. Today’s software supply chains produce uniform binaries, creating a single point of failure for entire fleets. We break this vulnerability by engineering intelligent variability directly into the compilation process. Our technology disrupts attacker economics and massively increases exploitation costs, ensuring resilience for large-scale deployments.

To achieve this, we orchestrate thousands of parallel compiler runs across distributed systems. We’re now building our greenfield backend platform from scratch—scaling build orchestration, secure artifact distribution, and performance analytics. Join us at ground zero to architect the future of resilient software.

Your Impact

As a Founding Full-Stack Engineer, you’ll shape our customer-facing portal, internal tools, and backend services. You’ll collaborate with infrastructure and security teams to turn complex workflows into intuitive, secure experiences. Your code will empower enterprises to manage diversified builds, analyze security metrics, and safeguard critical systems worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Build responsive web apps (React, Next.js, TypeScript) for developers and enterprise users.
  • Design & optimize APIs and backend services (Node.js, PostgreSQL).
  • Expose infrastructure pipelines (build orchestration, artifact distribution) via UI/APIs.
  • Ship end-to-end features across the stack, from dashboards to access controls.
  • Embed security and usability into customer tools and internal platforms.
  • Co-define architecture and drive technical decisions in early-stage development.

Required Expertise

  • 3+ years as a full-stack engineer shipping production systems.
  • Frontend mastery: React, Next.js, TypeScript.
  • Backend fluency: Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL API design.
  • Core understanding: Web architecture, auth (OAuth/SAML), CI/CD, and testing.
  • Startup mindset: Thrives in ambiguity, owns outcomes, and iterates rapidly.

Nice-to-Haves

  • AWS, Docker, Terraform, or Kubernetes experience.
  • Exposure to compilers (LLVM), embedded systems, or low-level toolchains.
  • Background in security engineering, multi-tenant SaaS, or B2B developer tools.
  • Passion for securing critical infrastructure (robotics, energy, transportation, edge).

The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

job.name: VIS Software Engineer
job.description:
Job#: 3055871 Job Description: Software Engineer – Vehicle Integration System (VIS) Position Description As a Software Engineer – Vehicle Integration System (VIS) , you will play a key role in the architecture, development, and evolution of Ford's Vehicle Integration System (VIS), a critical platform enabling vehicle upfitters, fleet customers, and internal engineering teams to configure and integrate aftermarket equipment with production vehicles.

You will work at the intersection of cloud software, embedded vehicle systems, AI-powered engineering tools, and vehicle communications networks. The role requires strong software engineering expertise combined with automotive systems knowledge to enable seamless integration of CAN/J1939 signals, vehicle switches, telematics data, proprietary vehicle modules, and future software-defined vehicle capabilities.

The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineer who can translate feature requirements from vehicle engineering teams into scalable software solutions while collaborating across software, hardware, telematics, validation, and supplier organizations.

Key Responsibilities Software Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Google cloud-native and desktop-based applications supporting VIS configuration workflows, with a solid understanding of vehicle architecture.
  • Architect and implement microservices and APIs using:

+ Java
+ Spring Boot
+ Node.js
+ React
+ PostgreSQL

  • Develop reusable frameworks and services that support vehicle feature configuration, signal management, and integration workflows.
  • Ensure performance, scalability, reliability, and cybersecurity requirements are met across all VIS components.

Vehicle Integration & Systems Engineering

  • Collaborate closely with vehicle feature engineers, module owners, telematics teams, and external suppliers to integrate new vehicle capabilities into VIS.
  • Support integration of:

+ CAN and CAN-FD signals
+ J1939 communications
+ LIN-based devices
+ Vehicle Ethernet technologies
+ Hard switches and soft switches
+ Telematics and connected vehicle services

  • Analyze vehicle architecture changes and determine impacts to VIS configuration models and workflows.
  • Participate in system-level design reviews and technical feasibility assessments.
  • Design and integrate AI-powered capabilities that improve configuration authoring, validation, and diagnostics.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies applicable to vehicle integration and software-defined vehicles.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead observability initiatives using SLOs, SLIs, dashboards, monitoring, and alerting frameworks.
  • Drive performance engineering, API governance, and software quality practices.
  • Champion secure software development lifecycle practices and compliance requirements.
  • Mentor engineers and promote engineering best practices across the team.

Cross-Functional Leadership

job.name: Staff Android Engineer (Founding)
job.description:
About Us Grow was born to tackle a critical challenge: making mental health care more effective and accessible for everyone. Since launching in 2020, 15 million sessions have started on Grow, and we've barely scratched the surface. We do it through a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. Every solution we build reveals ten more waiting to be delivered, and that's just what gets us going. We've backed that ambition with more than $328M in funding, including our Series D at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others.

Your Impact At Grow At Grow, the work you do can literally change someone's life. Your work here doesn't stay on a screen; it impacts whether someone can find, afford, and access quality care. That ambition sets us apart, and offers you an endless runway to impact one of the world's most urgent issues. We don’t have passenger seats here. Everyone is driving something that matters.

This work deserves real commitment. So if you thrive on meeting problems head on, untangling serious complexity, and working at pace with the sharpest yet kindest people around, you've come to the right place.

The Opportunity We’re looking for our founding Staff Android Engineer to build Android at Grow. Our iOS app launched earlier this year, and mobile is now a core part of how clients find care, connect with their providers, and stay engaged between sessions. You’ll have end-to-end ownership and set the technical direction for Android from day one: the architecture, the developer experience, the first production release, and the systems every future Android engineer will build on. You won’t start from zero, with a shipped iOS app, a shared backend, and an established design system to build from.

You’ll report to our Director of Engineering for the Momentum pillar and work alongside the iOS, product, and design partners who built the first app. This is a hands-on role in an AI-forward engineering organization, and we expect you to make deliberate architectural calls with incomplete information, ship the first release, and set the standards a growing Android team inherits.

job.name: Senior Product Builder
job.description:
About Clutch Clutch is Canada’s largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car buying and selling experience. Customers can sell their car instantly online using our ML-driven pricing model, or browse thousands of cars to buy, all from the comfort of their home.

Named three years in a row to the Globe & Mail’s list of the Top Growing Companies in Canada and awarded spots on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50™ and Fast 500™ lists, we’re looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017 and is backed by world-class investors including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90.

About The Team Product & Design is Clutch’s creative engine.

We solve some of the hardest problems in the business: improving the customer experience, building internal tools that power our operations, running growth experiments, connecting systems and data, and finding better ways to buy, sell, and move cars.

The way we build products has changed significantly.

Using Ignition, our platform for agentic engineering, individuals can now work across parts of the product-development process that traditionally required several specialized roles. A project that once involved a large team for months can increasingly be owned by one or two people and shipped in days.

We call those people builders .

A builder can move from understanding a business problem to shaping a solution, designing the experience, building it, testing it against realistic data, putting it in front of users, and iterating based on what they learn.

This role is for someone excited by the fact that the boundaries between product, design, and engineering are becoming increasingly blurry.

What you’ll do

job.name: Salesforce Service Cloud & Field Service Lightning Architect
Mobile Lead – AI-Native Care Delivery Applications
job.description:
Role: Mobile Lead – AI-Native Care Delivery Applications

Location: Pune / Remote (with overlap)

Mode: Full-time

About Azodha

Healthcare is no longer confined to hospitals—it’s happening in homes, in transit, and in real time. The systems supporting this shift haven’t kept up.Azodha is addressing that gap.

We coordinate workflows, logistics, and care delivery across fragmented systems into a single, real-time layer. Mobile is where a lot of this actually comes to life—especially for clinicians in the field and patients outside traditional care settings.

What this role is really about

  • You’ll be shaping mobile systems that people rely on while delivering or receiving care—not in ideal conditions, but in the real world.

That means:

  • Unreliable networks.
  • Time-sensitive workflows.
  • Interfaces that need to work quickly and clearly, every time.

This isn’t about building consumer apps or pixel-perfect screens.

It’s about making sure:

  • A clinician can do their job without friction.
  • A patient can engage with care without confusion.
  • The system holds up when it actually matters.
  • You’ll also define how mobile engineering is done here—architecture, quality, and how the team approaches problems.

What you’ll work on

Mobile systems that work in the real world .

  • Build and evolve applications using Flutter (Dart).
  • Work across iOS and Android fundamentals where needed.
  • Design mobile architecture that scales and remains maintainable over time.

Performance and reliability where it matters

  • Optimize for responsiveness across devices, OS versions, and network conditions
  • Ensure stability in environments where failure isn’t acceptable
  • Handle edge cases that don’t show up in ideal testing conditions

AI as part of the mobile experience

  • Integrate AI-driven capabilities into mobile workflows
  • Enable context-aware interactions and decision support at the point of care
  • Think through how intelligence shows up on small screens—clearly and usefully

Connected systems, not isolated apps

  • Integrate deeply with backend APIs and distributed systems
  • Ensure reliable data flow between mobile, backend, and web platforms
  • Handle sync, offline scenarios, and real-time updates thoughtfully

Quality that survives production

  • Implement testing strategies across unit, widget, and integration layers
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines for reliable builds and releases
  • Maintain consistency and reliability across environments=

Leadership & Ownership

  • Set direction for mobile architecture and engineering practices
  • Define standards for performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Mentor engineers and help them grow in both technical depth and ownership
  • Drive clarity in ambiguous problem spaces
  • Collaborate closely with backend, frontend, product, and design teams
  • Take ownership of outcomes—not just delivery

What you’ll influence

job.name: BI and ETL Tester
job.description:
We are seeking a skilled BI & ETL Tester to validate, analyze, and ensure the accuracy, performance, and reliability of data pipelines, BI reports, dashboards, and analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in data validation, SQL, ETL process testing , and working with modern data platforms.

Key Responsibilities

1. ETL / Data Pipeline Testing

  • Validate end-to-end ETL workflows including data extraction, transformation, and loading .
  • Perform source-to-target data validation , record counts, reconciliation, schema checks, and transformation logic checks.
  • Test data ingestion from multiple sources (databases, files, SAP, cloud platforms).
  • Verify scheduling, dependencies, and error-handling processes in ETL jobs.
  • Conduct regression, functional, and sanity testing for data loads.

2. BI / Reporting Testing

  • Validate BI reports and dashboards for accuracy, formatting, filters, drill-downs, KPIs, and aggregations .
  • Compare visual outputs with backend data using SQL queries.
  • Test performance, data refresh cycles, row-level security, and report-level access.

3. SQL & Data Quality Validation

  • Write complex SQL queries to validate business rules, calculations, and data transformations.
  • Identify data issues, anomalies, and integrity gaps.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers, BI Developers, and Data Analyst to resolve defects.

4. Test Planning & Execution

  • Create detailed test plans, test cases, test scenarios , and acceptance criteria.
  • Perform manual testing and assist in setting up automated testing frameworks (e.g., Python, PyTest, dbt tests).
  • Document defects in tools like JIRA and follow through to closure.
  • Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and Agile ceremonies.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5–10+ years of BI/ETL testing or QA experience.
* Strong SQL skills (joins, window functions, aggregations, CTEs).
* Experience testing ETL tools such as: Airflow
* Experience with BI tools:

job.name: Data Engineer Sr (Databricks)
job.description:
Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop Databricks notebooks, jobs, and workflows to replicate and enhance DB2/Guidewire-based pipelines and transformations.
  • Implement Delta Lake tables and patterns (bronze/silver/gold, ACID, time travel, schema evolution) for migrated data.
  • Integrate Databricks with AWS/S3 or Azure ADLS, ADF/Synapse, Key Vault, and Snowflake as required.
  • Optimize Databricks clusters, jobs, and queries for performance and cost.
  • Implement incremental loads, CDC patterns, and batch schedules for large datasets.
  • Collaborate with Snowflake and dbt teams to ensure consistent data models and data contracts.
  • Participate in data validation and reconciliation between DB2 400 / Guiderwire and Databricks outputs.
  • Follow coding standards, version control, and CI/CD practices using Git/Azure DevOps.
  • Provide defect fixes and support during SIT/UAT and post go-live stabilization.

Experience : Legacy Demystification & Ingestion (DB2/400 & Guidewire)

8+ years of experience in databricks with understanding complex legacy data models and getting that data into the cloud:

  • Extracting DB2/AS400: Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC) or scheduled batch extractions from DB2 into cloud storage. Involves working through JDBC connections, mapping table dependencies, and re-platforming legacy SQL to distributed computing standards.
  • Handling Guidewire Data: Integrating with Guidewire Cloud Data Access (CDA) or InsuranceSuite to replicate complex P&C (Property & Casualty) insurance schemas. Senior engineers parse these highly normalized operational databases and transform them into analytical-friendly schemas in the cloud.
  • Architecture & Pipeline Development

The core of the experience involves transitioning these legacy, row-based stores into a scalable Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers):

  • Delta Lake Optimization: Using Databricks and Apache Spark to build ETL/ELT data pipelines with ACID transactions. Senior engineers handle schema evolution, upserts, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 2).
  • Business Logic Refactoring: Translating rigid legacy procedural code (e.g., RPG/COBOL background logic, stored procedures) into scalable distributed patterns (PySpark, Spark SQL, and Scala).
  • Data Governance & Observability

A senior engineer is expected to govern vast amounts of incoming and generated data across the enterprise:

  • Unity Catalog: Implementing strict data governance, lineage tracing, and table-level security.
  • Data Quality: Automating data validation frameworks to ensure a seamless transition from legacy to modern systems without data loss or corruption.
  • Integration with the Databricks Platform Ecosystem

Moving beyond basic storage to utilizing the full power of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform:

Founding Fullstack Engineer | Robotics | NYC | Up to $350k + Equity

Tesla. SpaceX. Anduril. Google. Want to build alongside that calibre of engineer while owning a substantial part of the product?

We’re hiring a Founding Fullstack Engineer for a Series A robotics startup with autonomous machines already operating on customer sites 24/7 .

Your job is to build the software people use to put those machines to work: launch a job, monitor a fleet, investigate a failure, & get operations moving.

Up to $350k base + founding equity. NYC. 3-8 years’ experience.

Must be based in NYC & this role requires US Citizenship due to regulatory constraints. No sponsorship/visas/Green Card. Relocation support offered.

What you’ll own:

  • Fleet dashboards: Give operators a clear picture of what each machine is doing, what needs attention, and what happens next.
  • Job planning and control: Build interfaces that let customers configure tasks, deploy machines, and manage their work.
  • Tools for investigating failures: Turn telemetry, logs, and error states into information people can act on.
  • The backend behind it: Design the APIs, data flows, and services that keep the product responsive and reliable.

You’ll own features from the first product decision through to production, working directly with robotics engineers and the people operating the machines.

Why join at this stage?

The ambition is to build a major robotics company. You’re joining while individual engineers can still shape its architecture, customer experience, and engineering standards.

For someone drawn to the early Anduril or Tesla story, that’s the opportunity: substantial responsibility, technically demanding work, and equity in the company you help build.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3-8 years of fullstack experience , with strong React and TypeScript and solid backend fundamentals.
  • A product or substantial feature you personally took into production.
  • Good judgment about interfaces, architecture, and what to ship first.
  • Evidence that you take responsibility when requirements are unclear or production breaks.

Experience with robotics, live data, industrial software, or complex technical products would be useful. Strong product engineers from other backgrounds are welcome.

Package & process:

Up to $350k base + founding equity + benefits, relocation pacakge offered.

Interviews:

3 rounds. Target: 2 week. No take-homes.

1. Technical conversation: A system you built, your contribution, and the decisions you made.

job.name: Infrastructure & Security Engineer
job.description:
About Engram Today’s AI is a brilliant stranger: it can solve the world’s hardest math problems, but it knows next to nothing about you and your work. It rereads your files to answer even basic questions, burns an enormous amount of tokens when sifting through large corpuses, and between sessions, it retains scraps at best.

We train models to study your world and anticipate your questions in advance, forming engrams: compact memories that capture your knowledge and history. Our approach opens a new axis of scaling. The more we study your context at training time, the better we become at inference time.

We're already working with leaders in AI like Microsoft, Notion, and Harvey, and just raised $98M from General Catalyst, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Factory, Modern, Amplify, Neo and others. Our investors and advisors include Assaf Rappaport, Andrej Karpathy, and Pieter Abbeel.

AI has spent years learning everything about the world. Now it should learn something about yours.

About The Role Every Engram customer gets models trained on their own context, such as their documents, messages, code, and knowledge bases, and retrained continuously as that context changes. That means isolation can't stop at where data is stored: it has to follow the data into training runs and into the models themselves.

We're looking for an infrastructure engineer to own and evolve the systems that make that true, from ingestion through training to inference, as we add customers and providers. You'll work closely with our researchers so the secure path is also the fast one.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate the cloud infrastructure responsible for training and serving Engram customer models.
  • Design and enable the boundaries that keep each customer's data, training runs, and models separate; both on the cloud and on Engram-managed baremetal compute.
  • Partner with researchers and engineers on paved roads that improve our isolation and security posture.
  • Evaluate and secure the providers and tools we build on, including Modal, Baseten, and Fireworks as well as compute on baremetal or Kubernetes.
  • Take the lead on security operations and customer trust: maintain the logging and monitoring we rely on, respond to incidents, and bring clarity to security reviews and compliance work.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

At Samsara, interns can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, an intern may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, an intern could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.

job.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Job Overview We are looking for a Software Engineer in Test who is passionate about quality and about mobile playback to join the Android Player team. This team owns everything about playback in the Netflix Android app outside of the UI, from streaming and offline downloads to the foundations that live events and ad-supported viewing are built on. You will own how we prove that playback works, across thousands of Android devices, on a client that ships every week. Right now that means deepening automation coverage for live and advertising, keeping a shared device lab fast and honest, and making test results a signal the team trusts enough to block a merge or a release on.

About The Role

  • Own the Android Player test strategy, deciding what gets verified at the unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and which tests earn the right to block a pull request or a release.
  • Build the automation frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure that make that coverage possible, not just the tests that run on top of them.
  • Grow automated coverage for live events and ad-supported playback, where defects in the field carry the most risk and where test infrastructure is still maturing.
  • Treat the device lab as the finite, shared resource it is, making deliberate choices about device coverage so suites stay fast and lab time goes where it buys the most signal.
  • Drive down flakiness and runtime, and retire tests that no longer change a decision.
  • Support release readiness and live event readiness for a client that ships every week, including participation in the on-call rotation behind live gating.
  • Raise the quality bar across the whole team through code review, mentorship, and influence, so that testability is designed in rather than added later.
  • Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values.

What Sets You Apart

job.name: Senior Virtual Cloud Engineer (MUST HAVE Android Cuttlefish and QEMU); automotive experience
job.description:
Worldwide, the Volkswagen Group has a long tradition of dramatic innovations. The Volkswagen Group with its headquarters in Wolfsburg, Germany is one of the world’s leading automobile manufacturers and the largest carmaker in Europe. The Group comprises twelve brands from seven European countries: Volkswagen Passenger Cars, Audi, SEAT, ŠKODA, Bentley, Bugatti, Lamborghini, Porsche, Ducati, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, Scania and MAN.

*Brief Role Description This is a HYBRID position in Belmont, CA. If you are not local to the Belmont area, you must be open to relocation to be considered.* The Senior Virtual Cloud Engineer leads the creation and cloud deployment of a virtual Android Automotive (AAOS) infotainment ECU. The role entails designing a high-fidelity virtual representation of the head-unit software stack and hosting it in the cloud, enabling engineering teams across Volkswagen Group brands and regions to develop against it on demand, without the need for physical hardware. Virtualization and cloud delivery are central to the position: the engineer transforms a physical infotainment ECU into a scalable, globally accessible service and coordinates the brands, suppliers, platform providers, and partners — including the RV Tech (Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies) joint venture — required to deliver this capability.

The position forms part of the worldwide connectivity technical team and interfaces with multiple stakeholders across the Volkswagen Group technical organization. The engineer investigates and contributes to the development of new architectures for connected systems targeted to the US market.

*Role Responsibilities Virtual ECU Architecture — Android Automotive – (35%)*

  • Lead the virtualization strategy for the AAOS infotainment ECU, building configurable virtual devices on Android Cuttlefish and QEMU — together with the supporting stack of crosvm, KVM, virtio, and AVD/Android Emulator — that reproduce the production head-unit software stack and boot sequence.
  • Define hardware and HAL abstraction, virtio-backed virtual peripherals (display, audio, touch, GNSS, modem), and the timing and determinism controls required to maintain fidelity with physical hardware.
  • Model the in-vehicle environment on which the infotainment ECU depends — Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, and CAN — such that the virtual ECU behaves as it would within the vehicle.

Cloud Platform & Global Access – (30%)

  • Lead the cloud platform that hosts virtual ECUs at scale — containerized and orchestrated with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS or Google Cloud — providing on-demand instances and remote access for distributed teams.
  • Integrate CI/CD pipelines such that software builds deploy onto cloud-hosted virtual ECUs automatically, and establish observability, artifact management, and capacity planning for the virtual-device fleet.

Coordination & Technical Leadership – (20%)

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

The Experience Slack is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own Android accessibility across the app — from Slack Kit component-level fixes to platform-wide screen reader, testing, and compliance strategy. You’ll be the primary technical owner of Android a11y, working closely with the iOS/mobile accessibility team, design systems, and feature teams to make Slack usable for everyone.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Drive accessibility for Slack Kit Compose components — audit and fix issues, and build/maintain snapshot and automated a11y testing.
  • Diagnose and fix TalkBack/framework issues and generalize fixes into shared utilities other teams can adopt.
  • Own and evolve Android a11y test suites and infrastructure, including custom tooling and third-party integrations for automated UI-test coverage.
  • Provide accessibility guidance to feature teams on complex UI work — labeling, focus order, state announcements, and audible feedback for interactive actions.
  • Lead VPAT compliance efforts: triage and resolve related tickets, group recurring issues into epics, and clearly document Slack’s compliance posture.
  • Plan and run accessibility testing across major features and partner with QA vendors on regression testing.
  • Represent Android in cross-platform mobile accessibility planning, coordinating with iOS counterparts, design systems, and feature teams
  • Mentor Android engineers on accessibility best practices, run onboarding sessions, and share knowledge broadly (docs, newsletters, external talks).

You're Our Person If...

  • 5+ years Android engineering experience, including Kotlin and Jetpack Compose in a team environment
  • Hands-on expertise with Android accessibility APIs and TalkBack behavior.
  • Experience building or maintaining accessibility testing infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with accessibility compliance frameworks (e.g. WCAG, VPAT) and experience driving compliance work end-to-end.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — you’ll work with design systems, iOS and feature teams regularly.

job.name: Software Engineering Internship - San Francisco
job.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

At Samsara, interns can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, an intern may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, an intern could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.

job.name: Product Engineer
job.description:
About Us Imbue is a radically different AI company.

We believe that data should belong to you, humans should come before technology, and everyone deserves to own a personal team of AI agents. We believe in a future of open agents that you can modify to do exactly what you want.

We’re building a suite of tools to make tech serve humans, and making it open source.

Some first projects include

  • Studio: A custom digital HQ for building personalized software, apps, and tools
  • Bouncer: A social media feed filter that removes what you don't want to see and retrains your algorithm
  • Sculptor: An interface for programmers to run coding agents in parallel and stay in flow
  • mngr: A command-line tool for managing agents
  • Vet: A standalone tool that catches AI coding mistakes and reviews full PRs
  • Offload: A tool that automatically distributes your tests to run in isolated sandboxes
  • Latchkey: A command-line tool to integrate local agents with third-party APIs
  • Darwinian Evolver: A near-universal optimizer for code and agents

And we’re just getting started. If you’re excited about building a future with open agents, say hi!

We're supported by investors like Nvidia, Simon Last (co-founder of Notion), and Eric Schmidt (former CEO of Google), with $200M raised at over $1B valuation.

Summary In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to shape our product and help build 0-1 — not just the technologies that we use, but the overall direction of our product as it evolves. You will be responsible for building across our entire stack, understanding customer needs, and contributing to our product roadmap.

This role is a particularly good fit for anyone who either has previously been, or would like to be, a founder of a software product company. We are looking primarily for good product intuition and judgment — someone who understands what actually matters and then makes that happen.

Example Projects

  • Conduct user interviews and ask insightful questions while shadowing current or potential users
  • Implement rough prototypes for potential product ideas or iterations
  • Collect, parse, and ideate on feedback generated from both internal and external users
  • Quickly assemble code abstractions to enable fast iteration, and exercise judgment to delete code that doesn’t contribute as strongly to product fit
  • Ship backend and frontend code against various interfaces (web, CLI, IDE, etc.)
  • Collaborate with our product design team to transform promising ideas into new product features

You Are

  • A builder at heart
  • Motivated by solving real problems for real customers
  • Energized by understanding and talking to users
  • Someone that loves to sweat the details
  • Able to navigate ambiguity and work independently without explicit directions
  • Either experienced or interested in being a founder of a software product company
  • Very experienced programming in Typescript/Javascript and Python

About Glean Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.
