At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.

Our Team The Netflix Ads org builds the sophisticated advertising systems and integrations that power our rapidly growing ad-supported tier. We leverage Netflix's unique innovations to connect advertisers with our deeply engaged global audience, ensuring an ad experience that complements our members' premium entertainment.

The Creative Studio team owns the end-to-end experience advertisers use to build, preview, and approve their creative assets. We own the Creative Builder and Asset Library user experiences, along with the Compositing Service that powers high-fidelity previews and the Creative Studio Service that powers the broader creation workflow. We are driving significant bets to raise the quality and speed of creative moving through our platform, including GenAI-powered format, instant previews, auto-assembly, and intelligent, automated workflows that drastically reduce advertiser friction and time-to-market. Our tooling directly fuels a virtuous flywheel of engagement: by removing friction from the creative process and empowering advertisers to elevate their creative quality, we unlock superior ad performance, higher ROI, and a more premium experience for our members.

As Netflix rapidly expands its advertising tier, a critical new growth engine closely watched by both our C-suite and the broader media industry, the tools our advertisers use must be best-in-class. This role is about defining and building the highly available, scalable backend services and APIs that power those tools. You will be at the cutting edge of our GenAI format innovation, building the data pipelines and service architecture that enable the massive scale, speed, and sophistication required to make Netflix a dominant player in the digital advertising space.

We are looking for a backend engineer who can move quickly to set architectural direction across our services, raise the technical bar in design and execution, navigate highly ambiguous problems, and mentor the engineers around them.

job.name: Inference Intern
job.description:
About Etched Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference . Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary We are seeking talented Spring '27, and Summer '27 Inference Architecture interns to join our team and contribute to the design of next-generation AI accelerators. This role focuses on developing and optimizing compute architectures that deliver exceptional performance and efficiency for inference workloads. You will work on cutting-edge architectural problems and performance modeling over the course of your internship.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support porting state-of-the-art models to our architecture. Help build programming abstractions and testing capabilities to rapidly iterate on model porting.
  • Assist in building, enhancing, and scaling our runtime, including multi-node inference, intra-node execution, state management, and robust error handling.
  • Contribute to optimizing routing and communication layers using our collectives.
  • Utilize performance profiling and debugging tools to identify bottlenecks and correctness issues.
  • Develop and leverage a deep understanding of our architecture to co-design both HW instructions and model architecture operations to maximize model performance
  • Implement high-performance software components for the Model Toolkit

You may be a good fit if you have

  • Progress towards a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in computer science, computer engineering, applied mathematics, or a related field
  • Proficiency in Python, C++
  • Understanding of performance-sensitive or complex distributed software systems, e.g. Linux internals, accelerator architectures (e.g. GPUs, TPUs), Compilers, or high-speed interconnects (e.g. NVLink, InfiniBand).
  • Ported applications to non-standard accelerator hardware or hardware platforms.
  • Deep knowledge of transformer model architectures and/or inference serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, etc.)

Strong Candidates May Have Some Experience With

  • Proficiency in Rust
  • Low-latency, high-performance applications using both kernel-level and user-space networking stacks.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, algorithms, and challenges, including consensus protocols, consistency models, and communication patterns.
  • Solid grasp of Transformer architectures, particularly Mixture-of-Experts (MoE).
  • Built applications with extensive SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) optimizations for performance-critical paths.
  • Familiarity with PyTorch or JAX.
  • Math competitions (AIME, AMC, etc)

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification.

  • Automate recommendations and remediations — routing actionable findings to engineering teams via Microsoft Teams, email, and ServiceNow; building approval-gated automated remediation for low-risk waste

job.description:
Sr. Consultant Machine Learning & Knowledge Graph Engineer Data Science is all about breaking new ground to enable businesses to answer their most urgent questions. Pioneering massively parallel data-intensive analytic processing, our mission is to develop a whole new approach to generating meaning and value from petabyte-scale data sets and shape brand new methodologies, tools, statistical methods and models. What's more, we are in collaboration with leading academics, industry experts and highly skilled engineers to equip our customers to generate sophisticated new insights from the biggest of big data.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound impact as Sr. Consultant Machine Learning & Knowledge Graph Engineer on our growing and dynamic team in Round Rock, Texas. What you'll achieve Lead the architecture, development, and deployment of enterprise scale ML solutions across Dell's global ecosystem. Drive MLOps standards, build production grade ML services, and collaborate across engineering, product, and platform teams to enable AI at scale. Scale ML solutions across Dell's global ecosystem. As a Sr . Consultant Machine Learning & Knowledge Graph Engineer , you will play a pivotal role in advancing our AI and ML capabilities and creating Enterprise wide KG marketplace and Ontology layouts. This is a high-impact, enterprise-level technical leadership position responsible for defining and executing Dell's graph data strategy. You will architect production-grade Knowledge Graph platforms, design semantic data layers that power Agentic AI, and drive the convergence of graph technologies with large-scale data engineering ecosystems. This role demands a rare combination of deep graph expertise, distributed systems mastery, and strategic business influence.

You will

  • Knowledge Graph Architecture and Delivery: Design, build, and scale enterprise Knowledge Graph platforms using Neo4j and/or Stardog, establishing graph-native data models that enable entity resolution, relationship discovery, and semantic reasoning across business domains. Ontology and Semantic Layer Engineering: Define and govern enterprise ontologies (OWL 2), taxonomies, and semantic schemas that provide a unified, machine-interpretable view of Dell's data assets, ensuring consistency, reusability, and inferencing capability
  • Graph-Powered Agentic AI Infrastructure: Architect graph-backed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, tool-calling interfaces, and dynamic prompt-to-graph query pipelines that fuel autonomous AI agent decision-making with deterministic, explainable knowledge. Data Virtualization and Federation: Lead the design of virtualized graph layers using Stardog Virtual Graphs or equivalent federation patterns, enabling real-time querying across SQL, NoSQL, and streaming data sources without mass ETL

About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Search has become the default way consumers discover where to shop, compare options, and decide what to buy across platforms like Google, TikTok, and even Klarna. As we build a new Ads business and evolve Marketplace into a best in class shopping experience, improving search is one of our highest leverage investments to create an experience users choose and merchants want to invest in.

What You'll Do

  • With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals.

What We Look For

  • You have previous work or internship experience working with Javascript/Typescript.
  • You have previous work or internship experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale and are experienced using Python or Kotlin.

  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

Base Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 5

job.name: IT Systems Engineer
job.description:
Austin, TX (Onsite 4 days per week) Note: This is a full-time role, and we do not offer C2C or C2H employment and are not able to sponsor visas for this position. *About Acrisure* Acrisure Enterprise Technology Group is where human expertise meets advanced technology.

A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, it connects clients with personalized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, real estate services – and beyond. Since 2013, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to ~$5 billion and employs ~20,000 colleagues in 19 countries. And this is just the beginning. To learn more, visit Acrisure.com.

The Role: Our Engineering teams depend on a wide range of cloud and SaaS platforms to do their work. Someone has to decide who gets into each of them, with what permissions, and make sure that is still the right answer six months later. That is the core of this job.

Much of your time goes to account, access, and identity work: provisioning and deprovisioning across our SaaS and cloud platforms, designing and maintaining the groups and roles that grant access rather than handing out permissions one at a time, running onboarding and offboarding end to end, managing software licensing and vendor relationships, and supporting the access audits our compliance obligations depend on.

Other responsibilities include hands-on and onsite: hardware and workstation support, new hire equipment setup, conference room A/V, printers, inventory, and technical support for town halls and leadership meetings. A smaller share of the week than the access work, and the part that keeps people unblocked day to day.

There is also room for some Cloud and DevOps work alongside our Cloud Engineering team — up to 50% of your time. It is uneven: some weeks there is a real project to sink your teeth into, other weeks none at all. The natural starting point is automating your own work, since provisioning, deprovisioning, and access reporting are all problems best solved with code. To be clear about what this role is: it is primarily IT, and we expect it to stay that way.

You will work on a small, senior team with a degree of latitude to improve how all of this works.

Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Amazon Corporate Network Engineering team owns the design, planning, and delivery of all Amazon corporate office network infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the keep all the Amazon offices connected. job.name: Staff Data Scientist
job.description:
The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. job.name: Quant Model Risk Vice President
job.description:
Job Description We are looking for a new member to join our Interest Rates team in the Model Risk Governance and Review Group which is responsible for end-to-end model risk management across the firm.

As a Quant Model Risk Vice President you will assess and help mitigate the model risk of complex models used in the context of valuation and risk measurement for Interest Rate derivatives. Additionally, you will have an opportunity for exposure to a variety of business and functional area as well as will work closely with model developers and users.

You will also have managerial responsibility to oversee, train and mentor junior members of the team.

Job Responsibilities

  • Carries out model reviews: analyze conceptual soundness of complex pricing models, engines, and reserve methodologies; assess model behavior and suitability of pricing models/engines to particular products/structures
  • Provides guidance on model usage and act as first point of contact for the business on all new models and changes to existing models
  • Develop and implement alternative model benchmarks and compare the outcome of various models; Design model performance metrics
  • Liaises with model developers, Risk and Valuation Control Groups and provide guidance on model risk
  • Evaluates model performance on a regular basis
  • Manage and develop junior members of the team.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • 7 years of experience in a FO or model risk quantitative role.
  • Excellence in probability theory, stochastic processes, statistics, partial differential equations, and numerical analysis
  • MSc, PhD or equivalent in a quantitative discipline
  • Inquisitive nature, ability to ask right questions and escalate issues
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Good understanding of option pricing theory (i.e. quantitative models for pricing and hedging derivatives)
  • Good coding skills, for example in C/C++ or Python

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience with interest rates derivatives

job.name: Quantitative Researcher
job.description:
IMC is looking for an experienced Quantitative Researcher to develop trading signals and predictive models for our Options business. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with large datasets, and building models that drive trading performance, this role could be a great fit.

You will focus on researching and developing statistically robust signals and models to better understand and predict options market behaviour. Your work will directly inform trading strategies and have a measurable impact on performance. You will also help shape the research direction by exploring new approaches and improving existing methodologies.

IMC has strong advantages across market access, technology, and execution, and you will work in a collaborative environment alongside traders and engineers to translate research into production.

Your Core Responsibilities

  • Develop and test alpha signals and predictive models for Indian options markets
  • Perform large-scale data analysis to uncover patterns and trading opportunities
  • Apply rigorous statistical methods to ensure robustness and reliability of results
  • Build a deep understanding of market behaviour, pricing dynamics, and structural inefficiencies
  • Collaborate with traders and engineers to translate research into production strategies
  • Continuously improve models and identify new areas of research

Your Skills And Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in quantitative research in NSE/BSE, ideally within derivatives or options
  • Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and quantitative modelling
  • Proven track record of developing impactful trading signals or models
  • Experience working with large datasets and time-series data
  • Strong programming skills in at least one language (Python preferred)
  • Curious, analytical mindset with a focus on problem-solving and innovation

About Us IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is hiring a Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer to join the Next Gen Network Observability team. Help build cloud-scale intelligence systems that enable OCI networks to detect, diagnose, and respond to failures automatically—advancing the vision of self-healing networks through automated network control.

Description In this high-impact role, you will design and build distributed systems and algorithms that measure, analyze, and explain network behavior across OCI’s data centers and WAN. You will combine active measurements, network topology, routing state, flow signals, and switch telemetry to identify where latency, congestion, packet loss, and failures originate.

The broader vision is to make observability an active part of the network control loop. The platform will transform trusted, confidence-scored insights into signals that automated controllers can use to steer traffic, mitigate congestion, isolate faults, and restore network health safely. These capabilities will provide the intelligence foundation for increasingly autonomous, self-healing cloud networks while maintaining explainability, policy controls, and operational safeguards.

This position requires deep systems expertise and hands-on experience with networking, algorithms, telemetry, and distributed computing. You will develop topology-aware observability capabilities, congestion-triangulation and queue-wait reconstruction algorithms, confidence-scored fault localization, and production services that operate reliably at cloud scale.

About Docker Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. The Role Docker is shipping a wave of new products this year, with R&D initiatives likely to lead to more, and we're investing heavily in the platform underneath all of it. That platform supports hundreds of engineers across many development teams and carries high-scale production traffic and data transfer every day. It has grown faster than its foundations, and this year is about closing that gap.

Today, much of that work still leans on a handful of experts unblocking the same provisioning and operational workflows by hand. The top priority for this role is moving that work from expert-driven support to paved roads : self-service systems with clear ownership, safe defaults, strong guardrails, and adoption we can measure. The goal is a platform teams trust enough to stop thinking about it, one that just works, so they can focus on their own products instead of ours.

The concrete version sits on this year's roadmap: spinning up a new global region or application environment should take hours, not days. Right now it takes days. Getting there means building the foundations underneath it. We need a real multi-region, cross-account network architecture and a testing and continuous-deployment flow teams can trust, then a self-service layer on top.

We're the container company building our own internal platform, so the bar for "the easy path is also the safe path" is high. You'd be joining a team of four, growing to seven this year (this is one of those hires), and we're looking for a Staff engineer to set technical direction and lead it through real production adoption.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
job.description:
About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; New York City; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington D.C.; Toronto, Canada

About The Role Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. These Kubernetes platforms are purpose-built from the ground up and run on bare metal Linux in different regions around the world. The scale we work at involves tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of network traffic. The team takes pride in knowing this platform helps run parts of the global Internet.

As an engineer on the Kubernetes platform team, you'll be building the tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities.

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Search Control Plane
job.description:
Our vision We are building the next-generation search platform, with a vision to democratize knowledge construction and consumption at Thomson Reuters. The platform consolidates search systems across Thomson Reuters products and services, serving millions of end users, internal agents, and internal search teams, into a fully managed, customizable, sovereign, and self-serve search platform. Job Description The AI Enabled Software Engineering (AIESE) team is seeking a Staff Software Engineer for a highly impactful role at the foundation of the search platform. You will design and deliver a fully managed, highly scalable, and reliable control plane that brings a search system to life and manages its full lifecycle at the click of a button. That means automating the provisioning of Kubernetes, Kafka, ingestion pipelines, and the data plane for query and ingest, with sovereignty and observability built in from the start, and owning the infrastructure that runs every search index.

Every search system that moves onto the platform depends on what you build, so your work sets how quickly and safely teams across Thomson Reuters can create, change, and operate search on their own. Staff Engineers here define, build, deploy, and operate what they ship. We ship to production constantly, treat delivery friction as a standing engineering priority, and use AI-assisted development as the norm.

Key Responsibilities Control plane and lifecycle

  • Design, build, and own the control plane that creates, configures, upgrades, promotes, and retires search systems on demand, with full lifecycle management at the click of a button.
  • Own automated provisioning of everything a search system needs: Kubernetes workloads, Kafka messaging, ingestion pipelines, and the data plane for query and ingest.
  • Provide the lifecycle workflows for schema changes, reingest, index switch, and rollback, with status that tells callers when an index is ready.
  • Build sovereignty into the platform: tenant data isolation, enterprise identity and role-based access, and the controls that keep each customer's data within the boundaries it requires.
  • Design the configuration data model and persistence layer for system definitions, component registries, index lifecycle state, and audit history, built to scale across tenants and regions.
  • Set the platform's interface standards, including versioned, backward-compatible contracts and clear documentation, and expose what evaluation and experimentation workflows need.

job.name: Member of Technical Staff (Migrations)
job.description:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.

At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

The Role The Migrations team owns the full suite of MOLT (Migrate Off Legacy Technology) tooling: Convert, Fetch, Replicator, and Verify. We also recently launched the Migration Assistant, which brings the individual MOLT tools together into a single migration workflow which guides customers through moving their databases to CockroachDB and Cockroach Continuum. We're looking for a staff software engineer to help build out the Migration Assistant, expand the capabilities of the MOLT toolkit, and to drive innovation around how AI can be leveraged to further reduce friction during the migration process..

You'll report to Eric Alton, who leads the Migrations and Observability teams, and work closely with other engineers, SREs, and our product and design teams.

This role follows Cockroach Labs' hybrid model: Roachers local to an office come in Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, and work flexibly the rest of the week.

You Will

  • Build and extend CockroachDB's migration tooling, including the Migration Assistant, to make migrating to CockroachDB effortless.
  • Apply AI to real migration problems in a way that ensures security of customer data and correctness of the migration workflow.
  • Help expand the capabilities of MOLT's Convert, Fetch, Replicator, and Verify tools into a single, cohesive migration experience.
  • Develop primarily in Go (we'll teach you if you don't know it) alongside engineers and PMs across the cloud and database teams.
  • Take part in a collaborative, technically rigorous culture, and help shape engineering practices on a growing team.

The Expectations In the first month, you'll join the team and get familiar with our production systems, the MOLT tooling suite, the Migration Assistant's architecture, and how customers actually migrate to CockroachDB. Take the time to learn the technology, the team, and how we work before diving into big projects.

job.name: Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
job.description:
Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role? The Data Infrastructure team at Cohere is responsible for the storage and data movement layer underlying every model training run. We're building the unified storage layer that feeds our training workloads. It needs to serve petabytes of training data and model checkpoints fast enough to keep thousands of GPUs busy across several training clusters. In this role, you’d have an opportunity to build this system from the ground up. You’d be a key contributor, working on a problem few teams have had to solve at this scale.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and operate the distributed storage system that feeds model training and evaluation.
  • Run this system multiple on Kubernetes clusters at petabyte scale.
  • Work with researchers and training-infra teams on how jobs actually read and write data, and turn that into throughput, latency, and durability requirements
  • Work through the networking, I/O, and consistency problems of moving large datasets and checkpoints across regions and backends, with GPU idle time and time-to-insight as the measures of success

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • Strong storage fundamentals, including replication, consistency, caching, and data lifecycle management.
  • Strong coding ability. We work in Python and Go; experience in either is enough, but you should be willing to pick up the other
  • Experience running stateful systems on Kubernetes, including Persistent Volumes, CSI drivers, and StatefulSets.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud object storage such as S3 as well as POSIX-style filesystems.

It’s a Bonus If You Have

  • Experience with parallel or HPC filesystems such as Weka, VAST, or Lustre.
  • Familiarity with the data-loading and checkpointing patterns used in large-scale model training.
  • An interest in how large models are trained and evaluated, including the trajectory and eval data those runs generate, and a desire to understand the workloads the platform is serving.

Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. About The Role Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. These Kubernetes platforms are purpose-built from the ground up and run on bare metal Linux in different regions around the world. The scale we work at involves tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of network traffic. The team takes pride in knowing this platform helps run parts of the global Internet.

As an engineer on the Kubernetes platform team, you'll be building the tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. job.name: Sr. Backend Software Engineer (Video Engineering)
job.description:
At Philo, we’re a group of technology and product people who set out to build the future of television, marrying the best in modern technology with the most compelling medium ever invented — in short, we’re building the TV experience that we’ve always wanted for ourselves. In practice this means leveraging cloud delivery, modern tech stacks, machine learning, and hand-crafted native app experiences on all of our platforms. We aim to deliver a rock solid experience on the streaming basics, while cooking up next generation multi-screen and multi-user playback experiences.

Senior Backend Software Engineer (Video Engineering) Video is at the core of Philo and what customers engage with the most: watching their favorite shows. The Video Infrastructure team is crucial for delivering on this high expectation, and — together with the Ads team — for generating significant revenue through advertising. We own the systems that get every frame of Philo to every screen: live and video on demand transcoding, DRM and license servers, manifest generation that holds up under peak live events, and Server-Side Ad Insertion (SSAI). We support playback across all major streaming platforms, and partner closely with the Ads, Client, and Data teams to build out the end-to-end video player and ad experience. We increasingly apply machine learning to inspect both content and ads — surfacing quality issues, optimizing encodes, and improving the viewing experience in ways that weren't possible a few years ago.

Philo's video streaming infrastructure is highly distributed, horizontally scalable, and harnesses the power of cloud computing to deliver video at exabyte scale. Our video pipeline, developed in-house, uses industry-leading commercial and open source components to transcode, package in real-time, and generate HLS and DASH manifests on a per-user, per-session basis. The team also builds and maintains highly available RESTful web services that dynamically scale to meet the ever-increasing demands of simultaneous video streams across our platform.

We are seeking an enthusiastic Senior Software Engineer to help us build and optimize the next generation of our video ingest, transcode and delivery platform. This is a high impact role that influences every video stream that Philo serves. If you endeavor to see how your work directly impacts end-users this is the role for you.

job.name: MIS EXECUTIVE
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – MIS EXECUTIVE

Department: Finance & Accounts / MIS

Designation: MIS Executive

Industry: Battery Manufacturing / Automobile / Electrical / Manufacturing

Location: Manufacturing Plant / Head Office

Experience: 2–5 Years

Salary Budget: ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month

Qualification: Graduate (B.Com preferred)

1. Job Purpose

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented MIS Executive with practical experience in manufacturing MIS, Tally ERP/Tally Prime and Advanced MS Excel.

The candidate will be responsible for independently preparing, maintaining and analysing daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports covering Production, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, BOM, Finished Goods, Dispatch and Cost Centre-wise performance.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of manufacturing operations, accounting principles, inventory management and cost analysis.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Production MIS

  • Prepare daily, weekly and monthly production MIS reports.
  • Monitor planned vs. actual production.
  • Track product-wise and model-wise production, efficiency, rejection and wastage.
  • Analyse production performance, productivity and material consumption.
  • Highlight production variances and operational deviations.

B. Sales & Dispatch MIS

  • Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales reports.
  • Analyse product-wise, customer-wise and region-wise sales.
  • Monitor sales targets vs. actual achievements.
  • Track sales orders, billing, dispatches and outstanding amounts.
  • Prepare sales realisation and dispatch performance reports.

C. Purchase & Inventory MIS

  • Prepare purchase and material consumption reports.
  • Monitor vendor-wise and material-wise purchases.
  • Track Raw Material (RM), Work-in-Progress (WIP) and Finished Goods (FG) inventory.
  • Prepare stock ageing, slow-moving and non-moving inventory reports.
  • Reconcile physical stock with Tally records.

D. BOM & Manufacturing Costing

  • Maintain product-wise and model-wise Bill of Materials (BOM).
  • Monitor standard vs. actual material consumption.
  • Identify material consumption variances, wastage and rejection.
  • Prepare product-wise manufacturing cost reports.
  • Analyse material yield and production cost deviations.

E. Finished Goods (FG) MIS

  • Prepare daily Finished Goods production and stock reports.
  • Track opening stock, production, dispatch and closing stock.
  • Prepare FG stock reconciliation reports.
  • Monitor product-wise and model-wise stock movement.
  • Identify discrepancies between physical stock and Tally.

F. Cost Centre-wise MIS

  • Prepare department-wise and cost centre-wise MIS reports.
  • Monitor expenses against respective cost centres.
  • Prepare budget vs. actual expense reports.
  • Analyse cost variations and identify areas for cost control.
  • Assist management in cost analysis and profitability reporting.

G. Accounts & Tally ERP

job.name: Technical Project Manager
job.description:
Technical Project Manager — SecNinjaz Technologies LLP

New Delhi · Fully on-site · Full-time · 6+ years · B.Tech / MCA or equivalent

About us

SecNinjaz is a cybersecurity and AI solutions company serving enterprise, BFSI and government clients across India. We build and deliver AI products, security platforms and compliance programmes, often for on-premise and air-gapped environments. We are becoming an AI-native company, where AI agents are part of how work gets done every day.

The role

You'll own delivery across several parallel product and client projects, from requirements to production acceptance. You'll lead a small delivery team and report directly to the Founder & CTO. This is not a coordination role — you own the plan, the risks and the outcome.

What you'll do

  • Turn requirements and RFPs into baselined plans: scope, WBS, milestones, Gantt charts and dependencies.
  • Support RFP and tender responses with effort estimates and delivery plans.
  • Run delivery cadences and keep GitLab as the single source of truth for status.
  • Manage risks, issues and change control with written impact on time, cost and quality.
  • Track budget, utilisation and SLAs alongside scope and dates.
  • Produce audit-ready delivery evidence aligned to CMMI, ISO standards and CERT-In requirements.
  • Coordinate QA, testing and client acceptance cycles, including STQC.
  • Run security engagements (VAPT, audits, red-team) from scoping to report walkthrough, as assigned.
  • Act as the delivery point of contact for government and enterprise clients.
  • Lead and coach your delivery team, and help hire as the team grows.
  • Use AI tools daily, and help design agent workflows that automate routine project management work.

What you bring

  • 6+ years in software delivery, including 3+ years managing technical projects end to end.
  • Delivery experience on at least one Indian government or PSU project.
  • Experience leading a delivery team.
  • At least 3 delivered projects you can walk through in detail, including what went wrong.
  • Enough engineering depth to challenge an estimate: architecture, APIs, CI/CD, containers, on-prem deployment.
  • Hands-on with Agile/Scrum and plan-driven delivery.
  • Experience producing evidence for CMMI, ISO or similar audits.
  • Clear written English and confidence with senior stakeholders.
  • Discretion with confidential client information.

Good to have

  • GeM procurement and STQC testing experience.
  • AI/ML or cybersecurity project delivery (VAPT, audits, SOC).
  • BFSI client experience.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum or similar certification; CEH or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
  • Diagrams-as-code (Mermaid, PlantUML).
  • Hindi.

Why SecNinjaz

  • Real ownership, working directly with the founder.
  • Work on AI, video analytics and security systems used by government and enterprise clients.
  • Shape how an AI-native company runs delivery.
  • Certification support and a clear growth path into senior delivery leadership.

job.name: Senior Mobile Application Developer (iOS & Apple TV)
job.description:
Hiring for BRAHMA AI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Brahma AI builds enterprise technology for content creation, management and distribution. This role focuses on native Apple applications, bringing reliable mobile and television experiences to complex media and enterprise workflows.

About the Role

As a Senior Mobile Application Developer, you will design, develop and maintain production applications for iOS, iPadOS and Apple TV (tvOS). This is a full-time, hands-on engineering role for someone with 5+ years of mobile development experience who has delivered both native iOS and native tvOS applications. You will independently own features, work with existing complex codebases and troubleshoot production issues.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain native iOS and tvOS applications using Swift, UIKit and SwiftUI, with reusable components and maintainable MVC/MVVM architectures.
  • Implement Apple TV navigation, Focus Engine behaviour, Siri Remote interactions and TV-specific application lifecycle handling.
  • Develop media playback using AVPlayer, AVKit and AVFoundation, including playback controls, subtitles and multiple audio tracks.
  • Integrate REST APIs, JSON, third-party SDKs, local storage, caching, push notifications and deep links.
  • Work on streaming reliability, secure media delivery and device communication, including authentication, pairing and real-time integrations.
  • Diagnose crashes, memory leaks, concurrency issues, buffering and playback failures using Xcode, Instruments, logs and profiling tools.
  • Own testing, TestFlight distribution, provisioning and App Store releases for the modules you deliver.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, UI/UX and Backend teams, review code and contribute to architecture and release planning.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of mobile application development experience, with strong professional native iOS development using Swift.
  • Actual hands-on native Apple TV/tvOS development experience; theoretical familiarity or cross-platform-only experience is not sufficient.
  • Practical experience using AVPlayer, AVKit or AVFoundation to deliver production media playback.
  • Strong UIKit/SwiftUI knowledge, REST API integration experience and working knowledge of Objective-C.
  • Sound understanding of memory management, multithreading, concurrency, application lifecycle, local persistence and caching.
  • Experience maintaining released applications, debugging complex production issues and improving performance and stability.
  • Ability to independently translate requirements into maintainable code, own modules and work effectively in existing codebases.
  • Experience with Xcode, Instruments, TestFlight, provisioning profiles and App Store deployment.

Nice to have

Posit Team is the trusted on-premises platform at the center: a place where data scientists and the organizations that rely on them can explore data, deploy applications and agents, expose and consume MCP servers, and do all of it with the visibility, accountability, and reproducibility that serious analytical work demands.

We are seeking a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will bring a builder’s instinct to a team working at the intersection of data science, infrastructure, and AI. You will help us build new capabilities and features in our product suite, including things we haven’t yet imagined possible, and you will drive those changes forward into our customers’ hands.

About You You are an enthusiastic generalist who thrives in the face of ambiguous requirements—an engineer who is just as good at starting things as you are at finishing them. Some qualities we value most:

High agency You are driven. When something important feels daunting or underspecified, your first instinct is to prototype to clarify the value you can deliver, rather than wait for someone to give you the answers.

Boldness in learning You are genuinely unafraid to tackle unfamiliar subjects. You know that nobody is an expert in everything, and you don't let unfamiliarity be a reason for not trying. job.name: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - TS/SCI (CI Poly)
job.description:
About The Company America is under sustained cyber attack. Our adversaries infiltrate our networks, steal our IP, and degrade the digital infrastructure that modern life runs on. They’ve learned—correctly—that those attacks rarely produce consequences.

Twenty was founded to change that, by making our adversaries think twice before they attack us. Our vision is American and allied primacy in cyberspace—a future where they cannot contest us, deterrence is assured, and the free world remains secure.

Founded in 2024, Twenty Technologies (www.twenty.io) industrializes offensive cyber operations for the U.S. and its allies. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Twenty has raised $168M from Khosla Ventures, Accel, Caffeinated Capital, Friends & Family Capital, Point72 Ventures, General Catalyst, and In-Q-Tel.

Mission | On Site | Full Time | Active TS/SCI with CI Polygraph Role Summary

You'll be on the ground at a government customer site, serving as a generalist engineering presence for Twenty's mission-critical platform in a restricted, air-gapped environment. Twenty builds software for cyber operations, and the applications you'll extend and operate are used by operators and analysts working against hard national security problems.

This is the broadest engineering role at Twenty. In a given month you might build a customer-specific feature, integrate a new data source, get an extension through the customer's deployment process, chase down a production failure, tune the monitoring that would have caught it sooner, and prototype an AI-backed capability with support from Arlington. You won't be an expert in all of it, and the role isn't designed to require that. For specialist work like data engineering and AI engineering, you'll deliver with guidance from the Arlington engineers who specialize in it. What the role does require is range: the ability to pick up an unfamiliar part of the system, get productive quickly, and produce work that holds up in production.

The office-based team can't access this environment, so you are the engineering presence where the software actually runs. Problems reach you first, and the judgment calls are yours: what's wrong, what's urgent, and what Arlington needs to know. When customer work is quiet, you'll build features for Twenty's core product applications, carrying what you learned in the field directly into the product.

You'll report directly to the VP of Engineering. You'll be part of a small forward deployed team, working closely with other on-site colleagues, the Arlington-based product engineering and DevSecOps teams, and the customer's own technical staff.

If you're a strong generalist who wants your work in the hands of operators the same day you build it, and you'd rather own a production system end to end than ship features into a backlog, this role is for you.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Secure Build
job.description:
About Docker Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

The Role The Secure Build team builds and operates the infrastructure behind Docker's container builds. The team owns Docker Build Cloud and Auto Builds while developing the next generation of trusted build and CI capabilities.

Software is being changed faster than ever, but CI remains a bottleneck and a major trust boundary. Developers and software agents need to run build and test work quickly without exposing secrets, losing local-to-cloud parity or accepting an unverifiable result. Our direction is to make Docker the trusted place CI runs and turn that constraint into an accelerator.

The technical work spans Go services, container and build technology, cloud infrastructure, isolated execution and software supply-chain security. It also requires disciplined operation of the production systems customers rely on today. Docker Build Cloud and Auto Builds will need targeted reliability and operational improvements while useful capabilities evolve towards a coherent Secure Build platform.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will turn these problems into practical product and technical outcomes. You will own substantial work from discovery and design through production, make sound security and reliability trade-offs, and stay close to the experience of developers and the agents they delegate work to.

We make extensive use of AI-assisted engineering tools. We expect engineers to use them thoughtfully, validate their output and remain accountable for the quality and security of what ships.

Success in This Role Looks Like You will succeed by becoming an end-to-end owner for secure, reliable build infrastructure. Within your first year, you should have delivered a material secure-build or CI capability, reduced operational risk in Docker Build Cloud or Auto Builds, and become a trusted partner to the teams and customers that consume the platform.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer II - Streaming and Durability
job.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

About the Role

Every transaction, every listing view, every agent interaction at Compass touches a streaming pipeline, a database, or a cache owned by the Streaming & Durability team. This team is responsible for the foundational data layer: the systems that have to be fast, correct, and isolated across thousands of tenants, every single time.

We don't just keep the lights on. We're solving hard problems: how do you run Kafka as a true platform, with clear authentication, managed schemas, and standard tooling, when it has run for years without a dedicated owner? How do you make Kafka upgrades, schema changes, and connector rollouts routine instead of risky? How do you enforce tenant-level data isolation across shared PostgreSQL clusters and Redis/Valkey caches without sacrificing latency? How do you build SDKs that make the safe path the easy path for hundreds of engineers who never think about infrastructure?

As a Senior Engineer, you'll own answers to those questions. You'll design systems that quietly protect millions of records, ship tooling that engineers across the company reach for by default, and operate infrastructure where the cost of getting it wrong is measured in trust, not just latency.

Responsibilities

  • Own Kafka at Compass end to end, across our MSK and Confluent clusters: platform health, upgrades, capacity, and cost. Set the technical direction for how the rest of engineering uses streaming.
  • Run the Kafka operational program: client authentication and access standards, Schema Registry ownership with PR-driven schema registration, Kafka Connect upgrades and standard management, producer compression defaults, and the runbooks and drills that let application teams recover quickly.
  • Build and scale Kafka/MSK streaming infrastructure, the connective tissue between Compass services, including topic architecture, consumer patterns, partition rebalancing, upgrades, and dead-letter-queue and redrive guidance.
  • Build multi-tenant data isolation into Compass's data layer, shipping SDKs in Go, Java, and Python that enforce tenant-safe access patterns so product engineers can move fast without risking cross-tenant data exposure.
  • Support the database and caching fleet (RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Redis/ValKey, DynamoDB) alongside our database platform partners, including replication, failover, and capacity decisions.
  • Drive production database upgrades at fleet scale, moving toward automation, with Terraform state changes across hundreds of clusters and zero customer-facing impact.

Read the full description

job.name: Backend Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

Auric AI is building a battlefield AI vision platform that converts satellite imagery into actionable intelligence. We need backend engineers who think from first principles, move fast, and can design systems that elegantly handle both complexity and scale.

This role is for someone who enjoys solving hard problems at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time image processing, and AI deployment — regardless of years of experience.

What You’ll Build

  • High-throughput image ingestion pipelines (10,000+ images/day)
  • Automated tiling, preprocessing, and transformation systems
  • Model inference services connected to our CV research stack
  • Quality control and validation workflows
  • Scalable data stores for imagery, detections, and metadata
  • Secure access-controlled dissemination to thousands of users
  • Edge-friendly intelligence delivery over low-bandwidth networks

What Matters Most

  • Ability to break down complex system problems into simple, logical components
  • Strong reasoning and clarity of thought
  • Pragmatic engineering instincts — knowing what to build now vs later
  • Comfort working with ambiguity and 0→1 product building
  • Curiosity and willingness to dive deep into unfamiliar areas

Skills & Qualities

  • 1+ years of hands-on engineering experience, with good exposure to building or working with ML or AI systems in production.
  • Strong in at least one backend language (Python, Go, Node, Java)
  • Ability to design and implement distributed services
  • Good understanding of data storage, queues, caching, API design
  • Ability to optimize systems for throughput, reliability, and latency
  • Experience building things outside of work (projects, systems, tools)
  • Comfort with cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure) and containers (Docker/K8s)

Years of experience are irrelevant to us — depth of thinking and engineering ability matter far more.

job.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy autonomous multi-agent workflows using orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, or similar, including complex state machines with conditional routing, parallel execution, and error recovery patterns.
  • Architect graph-based agent workflows with 10+ nodes involving agent collaboration, task decomposition, and sequential/parallel execution across multiple business domains.
  • Develop and maintain reusable agent node libraries, extensible platform patterns, versioning strategies, and testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end) for agent workflows.
  • Build production-grade FastAPI applications with async I/O patterns, integrating PostgreSQL, Redis, and external enterprise services.
  • Implement real-time agent streaming using Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSocket protocols, alongside RESTful and event-driven API architectures for agent orchestration.
  • Integrate cloud-based LLM providers (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4) and design prompt management systems with versioning, templating, and dynamic compilation.
  • Implement conversation state persistence using Redis checkpointing and build tool-calling protocols (Model Context Protocol, function calling) for external data sources and APIs.
  • Develop hybrid intelligence patterns combining LLM reasoning with rule-based logic and statistical analysis, and build response transformation pipelines for structured analytical outputs.
  • Integrate observability platforms (Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar) to enable end-to-end agent tracing, telemetry, performance monitoring, and cost optimization across production workflows.
  • Implement evaluation frameworks measuring agent success rates, reasoning quality, and output accuracy, while continuously optimizing token usage and LLM costs.
  • Ensure enterprise security integration (LDAP, SSO, access control), robust error handling, and compliance with data governance and Responsible AI standards.
  • Partner with data engineers, business analysts, and UX teams to translate requirements into scalable agent workflows and streaming interfaces.
  • Mentor junior engineers on async Python patterns, agent design, and LLMOps best practices; participate in architecture reviews and contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing.

job.name: Quick Commerce Growth Lead
job.description:
Company: DataFuel (DataFuel.tech)

Location: Mumbai , Lower Parel

Experience: 3 to 4+ years in Quick Commerce

About us

DataFuel is an AI-powered marketplace analytics and ads automation platform. We work with 130+ brands across Amazon, Flipkart and quick commerce platforms (Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart). Until now, DataFuel has been primarily a tools-only business. We are now launching a new managed services arm, where our own team runs and scales brands end to end, powered by DataFuel's platform. This role is one of the first hires for that arm.

The role

We are looking for a Quick Commerce Growth Lead to help build our new managed services arm: someone who knows how to run and scale a brand on quick commerce end to end. You will own growth for a portfolio of enterprise and FMCG brands across Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart, covering end to end . You have done this before for large brands , and you can show the numbers. This is an individual contributor (IC) role to start, focused fully on hands-on execution. Once we onboard a few brands, you will hire and lead your own team.

What you will do

  • Own end-to-end growth for a portfolio of brands on Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart: assortment, listings, pricing, offers, availability and ads.
  • Drive availability and supply chain: plan city and dark store level stock, work with brands and platform teams on replenishment, track fill rates and run root cause analysis on out-of-stocks.
  • Run advertising: plan, launch and optimize keyword, visibility and banner campaigns on each platform, manage budgets and hit ROAS and growth targets.
  • Grow market share: track share of voice, keyword ranks and category share, benchmark competitors and act on the gaps.
  • Plan and execute events: build the sale and festive calendar, and run platform sale days, launches and category events end to end, from stock readiness to offers and ad bursts.
  • Manage relationships with platform category managers and brand stakeholders, and lead monthly business reviews.
  • Grow into a team lead: you start as an IC. As the arm signs brands, you will hire and lead a team of account and ads executives.
  • Turn wins into case studies and help the sales team pitch quick commerce services to new brands.
  • Shape our product: work with the DataFuel product team to improve our quick commerce dashboards and tools.

Must have

  • 2 to 3+ years of hands-on quick commerce & Ecommerce experience.
  • Direct experience across all three platforms: Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart (brand side, agency side or platform side).
  • A proven, documented case study of scaling an enterprise brand on quick commerce from ₹30 to 40 lakh per month to ₹1 crore+ per month, ideally across multiple brands.
  • Strong understanding of quick commerce operations: supply chain and replenishment, advertising, and market share end to end
  • Strong sale event planning and execution skills.

job.name: Associate, Supply Excellence
job.description:
Associate, Supply Excellence

Location: Gurgaon | Experience: 2-4 years | Type: Full-time | Reports to: Business Heads

The role in brief

30 Sundays is an AI-first travel company. We design international holidays for couples. Every trip

depends on local partners: DMCs deliver hotels, transfers and activities. You will help choose the right

hotels and DMCs, then keep our rates competitive, our data accurate and our trips well delivered.

What you will do

  • Choose the right suppliers: research hotels and DMCs, compare value, price tiers and quality,

and recommend whom to onboard.

and policies. Support in-market hotel contracting.

  • Keep pricing competitive: benchmark supply costs against OTA rates. Flag gaps and suggest

fixes.

  • Keep data right: keep rates, contract dates, hotel classes and activity details accurate.
  • Fix quality issues: use NPS and escalations to spot weak suppliers. Drive corrective action or

replacement.

  • Support sales: answer rate and availability queries fast. Publish a monthly supply report.

Improvement projects

Top performers also take on extra improvement projects. Examples: finding where a destination loses

margin, building a hotel-rate benchmark, or cutting manual supply checks with AI tools.

How we measure success

Price competitiveness versus OTAs on priority hotels. Accuracy of rates and product information. NPS for our hotels and activities. Turnaround on sales queries. Contracts and rates renewed on time.

Who we are looking for

  • 2-4 years in consulting, strategy, vendor management, procurement, partnerships or account management.
  • Experience negotiating with vendors, suppliers or clients. Strong English.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets. Comfortable using AI tools. Attention to detail.
  • Can manage many partners and priorities. Learns a new industry quickly.
  • Travel experience helps, not required. Structured onboarding and industry training provided.

Why this role

Work directly with Business Heads and international partners. Your negotiations affect both margins andtraveller experience. Join a fast-paced, AI-first travel company.

About the role

We are looking for a sourcing specialist who can find profitable products from US retail websites and resell them on Amazon US, Walmart US and other marketplaces. You will own the full lead process: finding products, checking demand and competition, calculating profit, and flagging risks before we buy. Your work directly drives our inventory decisions and profit, so accuracy matters more than volume.

Key responsibilities

  • Source profitable products daily from US retailers (Walmart.com, Target, Kohl's, Walgreens, CVS, Home Depot, Zoro, Best Buy and others) for resale on Amazon US and Walmart US
  • Analyze each lead with Keepa: sales rank history, price stability, number of sellers, Buy Box rotation and whether Amazon sells on the listing
  • Calculate buy cost, FBA/WFS fees, referral fees, prep and inbound shipping, net profit and ROI using SellerAmp SAS or similar tools
  • Estimate monthly sales and recommend a safe buy quantity for each lead
  • Check every lead for risk: gated brands and categories, IP and brand complaints, hazmat, private label, variation and listing-match issues, restricted products
  • Stack savings with coupons, cashback portals (e.g. Rakuten), discounted gift cards and retailer promotions
  • Track retailer sales, clearance events and seasonal trends (Q4, back-to-school, Prime Day) to plan buys ahead
  • Maintain a clear lead sheet with source link, ASIN, cost, sell price, fees, profit, ROI, estimated sales and notes
  • Monitor replenishable winners and rebuy them when prices and margins stay healthy
  • Coordinate with the purchasing team and prep center on orders, shipments and inventory (if assigned)
  • Report weekly on leads found, leads approved, sell-through and actual vs. expected profit

Requirements (must-have)

1+ year of proven online arbitrage or product sourcing experience for Amazon US and/or Walmart US

Strong command of Keepa and SellerAmp SAS (or BuyBotPro / Tactical Arbitrage)

Clear understanding of Amazon FBA fees, referral fees, Buy Box behaviour and sales rank

Knowledge of Amazon and Walmart policies: gating, ungating, IP complaints, restricted and hazmat products, invoice and authenticity requirements

Good spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets or Excel): formulas, filters, lead tracking

Good written English for working with US suppliers, prep centers and managers

Detail-oriented, honest about mistakes, and comfortable working with targets

Good to have

Team: Aveva Lab India

Experience: 5-10 years

About the Role

As the 3D Data Migration Expert at our newly established Aveva Lab in India, your primary goal will be to guide the seamless transition of vital engineering data from legacy systems, such as Hexagon S3D and SPPID, into the Aveva Unified Engineering suite, particularly E3D and NextGenPID. You will act as the crucial bridge between historical project data and future digital platforms.

We are looking for a dedicated professional from the EPC industry who knows the immense value of accurate data and can lead a team to ensure zero loss of information during these critical transitions. If you have been working with enterprise reporting or data management in a competitor organization and are looking for a significant leadership challenge, this is your opportunity to shape the core of our digital transformation.

Context

  • The EPC sector is evolving rapidly. Industry statistics generally indicate that smooth and accurate data migration can reduce overall project delays by up to 25% and significantly lower operational costs.
  • To stay at the forefront of this digital shift, we are establishing a state-of-the-art Aveva Lab in India, which will serve as the heart of our global digital project execution.
  • A key part of our strategy is consolidating engineering platforms, moving away from fragmented systems like Hexagon towards a unified Aveva ecosystem.
  • We need a seasoned expert who intuitively understands the nuances of engineering data to lead this complex migration.
  • Your work will directly ensure that global project teams have reliable, uninterrupted access to their 3D models and engineering diagrams, allowing them to build the future without skipping a beat.

Key Responsibilities

  • Migration Strategy Implementation: Support the Data Migration lead in implementing the migration strategy proposed by the System Integrator for moving engineering models and schematics from Hexagon systems to the Aveva Unified Engineering suite.
  • Data Mapping & Translation: Understand the implemented data mapping between target and source systems and the data transformations performed to feed the target system (e.g. ISO15926 to DEXPI and to post-processor, S3D schema to E3D schema). Ensure technical documentation provides clear, sequential instructions so the workflow is reproducible.
  • Quality Assurance: Test and validate processes to confirm that the migrated data is entirely accurate, secure, and ready for immediate use by engineering teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product and IT teams to align the migration schedule with broader business goals, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum visibility.

ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. job.name: Assistant Manager – ITGC / IT Audit
job.description:
Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.

7–8 years of relevant experience in IT Audit, ITGC, Technology Risk, Risk & Compliance in Top 10 Big firm (PWC, Deloitte, KPMG, EY etc)

Prior experience in leading engagements or reviewing the work of junior team members is preferred.

Certifications such as CISA, CIA, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor will be an advantage.

Job Summary

The Assistant Manager – ITGC will be responsible for managing and reviewing IT General Controls (ITGC) assessments, supporting audit and compliance engagements, and ensuring effective risk and control management across IT environments. The role requires hands-on ITGC expertise along with responsibility for reviewing team deliverables, managing stakeholders, identifying control gaps, and driving remediation.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and review ITGC testing and documentation for internal and external audit engagements.

Lead assessments of User Access Management, Change Management, IT Operations, and IT Security controls.

Review user provisioning, de-provisioning, privileged access, and Segregation of Duties (SoD) controls.

Evaluate change management processes, including approvals, testing, migration, and emergency changes.

Review IT operations controls covering backups, recovery, batch processing, and job scheduling.

Assess logical and physical security controls across applications, databases, and IT infrastructure.

Identify control deficiencies, assess associated risks, and provide practical remediation recommendations.

Review audit workpapers, control testing evidence, findings, and management responses.

Coordinate with clients/stakeholders, IT teams, Internal Audit, Risk, Compliance, and external auditors.

Support compliance engagements relating to SOX, ISO 27001, SOC, and other relevant frameworks.

Guide and review the work of junior team members and ensure timely completion of assigned engagements.

Assist senior management with engagement planning, status reporting, risk discussions, and final deliverables.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of ITGC, IT Audit, SOX Compliance, Risk Management, and Control Testing.

Strong understanding of Access Management, Change Management, IT Operations, and Information Security controls.

Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Workday.

Ability to independently identify and assess IT risks and control deficiencies.

Good experience in audit documentation, workpaper review, and report preparation.

Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication, and team-management skills.

Ability to manage multiple engagements and deadlines effectively.
