job.name: Senior Full Stack Engineer, People Products
job.description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes. Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About The Business Applications Team The Business Applications org builds and operates the internal systems that keep Thumbtack running at scale: Salesforce-centered workflows, admin tooling, and the integrations that connect teams across the company. We're now expanding that foundation into a broader internal platform for AI-enabled work — shared APIs, reusable integration patterns, and safe, auditable capabilities for business-critical actions. We work directly with the business teams who depend on these systems, turning complex operational needs into software that's easier to run, extend, and automate responsibly.

The challenge Thumbtack’s People team is reimagining how employees and leaders experience People programs—and how the People team operates. Employees get support tailored to their circumstances, managers bring relevant evidence into feedback and team decisions, and People specialists spend less time coordinating processes across systems. We have promising starting points: a People Q&A assistant, personalized insights that help leaders understand their teams, and automations across HR and recruiting systems. You’ll help build what comes next: advisors that bring People expertise and personal context together, experiences that anticipate needs and help people act on insights, and connected workflows that complete work on someone’s behalf.

Making this possible means working with some of the company’s most sensitive information—performance, feedback, org structure, and hiring. Every product must know who the user is, what they’re allowed to see and do, what an AI model may receive, and what gets retained. You’ll own that engineering problem end to end, building on our identity-aware infrastructure as it matures and extending its capabilities to meet the specific needs of People products. You’ll work day to day with People Products & Data, who set product direction and priorities, alongside TPMs, HR systems analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and other partners—while building on and contributing to the Business Applications platform.

What You’ll Do

Headquartered in Winnipeg, Wawanesa is the parent company of WSI™, a specialty insurer delivering tailored solutions built around unique needs; Wawanesa Life, a provider of life insurance products; and Western Financial Group, a leading national distributor of personal and commercial insurance.

Wawanesa is committed to helping communities thrive in a changing world. The company invests more than $4 million annually in charitable initiatives, including $2.5 million each year to support people and communities on the front lines of climate change. Learn more at wawanesa.com.

Direct to Member (D2M) is a new initiative at Wawanesa focused on finding better, simpler ways for members to access insurance. We're looking for people excited to collaborate, test new ideas and explore new ways of working. By learning what works and using technology to make things easier, we're helping shape the future of how we serve our members.

job.description:
Infotech delivers impartial, highly pertinent IT research, enabling CIOs and IT leaders to make well-informed, strategic decisions. We are currently serving over 30,000 professionals and collaborate closely with IT teams, equipping them with actionable tools and expert guidance to drive measurable results and enhance technology initiatives and organizational processes.

Why join us?

  • We pride ourselves on consistent year-on-year growth, with double-digit growth even during a global pandemic.
  • We are in the Top 3 on LinkedIn's Top Companies List in Canada.
  • Info-Tech fosters a growth-focused, entrepreneurial culture with unlimited opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • We provide financial support for professional development and training.

About The Role We’re looking for seasoned Senior Software Developers, especially people who really care about the quality and impact of the products they’re building. Our stack is mostly built with Ruby on Rails, MySQL, and JavaScript.

Your Responsibilities As a Senior Software Developer

  • Build, test, and support the development of web software applications and internal tools
  • Analyze requirements and decide the best ways to meet or even rework them; unique and innovative ideas are welcome
  • Be proactive by finding and addressing areas of technical concern
  • Mentor your peers and contribute to code reviews, and be mentored if something is new to you
  • Collaborate across teams to continually improve our processes
  • Promote the use of design patterns and best practices
  • Contribute to Agile ceremonies for prioritizing, understanding, and estimating
  • Support the growth of our Agile practices through Retrospectives

Why you should join us

  • Work with like-minded individuals in a work-hard/play-hard culture
  • Continued learning is a major part of our best-practice-driven environment. We support our teams with a substantial budget for training and career development
  • Work-life balance is important to us: after-hours and weekend work are rare to non-existent
  • You will work in a highly collaborative team that functions efficiently even in a remote work setting. You will have flexibility to work from home, at one of our unique offices in London (Ontario) or Toronto, or in a hybrid mode
  • We offer great competitive salaries, benefits plan, and RRSP matching plans

Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma from an accredited institution
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in a professional software development role
  • Experience supporting and mentoring junior to intermediate developers
  • Comfortable developing in an Agile product development framework

Must Have Skills

job.description:

Nous recherchons un(e) développeur(euse) web front-end senior pour rejoindre l'équipe de développement UX et contribuer à définir les fondements de l'expérience utilisateur pour l'ensemble des produits Genetec.

À ce poste, vous contribuerez à l'évolution de Gelato, le système de conception de Genetec, de notre plateforme de micro-front-ends, ainsi que des outils permettant aux concepteurs et aux développeurs de créer à grande échelle des expériences utilisateur cohérentes et de haute qualité. Votre travail influencera directement la manière dont les équipes produit conçoivent, développent et déploient les interfaces au sein de notre écosystème.

Au sein d'une équipe très collaborative, vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des concepteurs UX, des développeurs et des équipes produit afin de créer des solutions d'interface utilisateur réutilisables qui améliorent la cohérence, l'accessibilité, les performances et la productivité des développeurs. Vous contribuerez à garantir que les concepts de conception se traduisent par des implémentations robustes et évolutives, tout en favorisant les meilleures pratiques en matière d'architecture front-end et d'expérience utilisateur.

Ce poste allie l'ingénierie front-end, le développement de systèmes de conception, une approche axée sur la plateforme et l'innovation en matière de flux de travail, y compris l'exploration de fonctionnalités basées sur l'IA qui accélèrent la livraison des produits et améliorent la qualité de l'expérience utilisateur.

Votre journée en un coup d'oeil :

Développement de la bibliothèque de composants et du système de conception

  • Créer, faire évoluer et maintenir des composants d'interface utilisateur réutilisables de niveau entreprise, utilisés dans plusieurs produits
  • Mettre en œuvre les API, les états, les modèles, les jetons et les normes d'accessibilité des composants
  • Collaborer avec les designers lors des revues de maquettes et de Figma afin d'évaluer la faisabilité, de suggérer des améliorations et de garantir la conformité aux directives de Gelato
  • Contribuer à la modernisation du thème visuel, en veillant à la cohérence entre les produits.

Ingénierie de la plateforme de micro-frontends

  • Contribuer à la conception, à la mise en œuvre et à l'optimisation de notre plateforme de micro-frontends
  • Développer des outils, des structures de base et des utilitaires d'exécution partagés permettant aux équipes produit d'assembler des modules de manière efficace et sécurisée
  • Garantir de bonnes performances, la sécurité, la gestion du cycle de vie et une bonne expérience développeur (DX) pour les micro-frontends

Outils d'IA et automatisation des workflows

Ce poste est en mode hybride.

Agissant à titre de conseiller / consultant de Chrome Technologies, le candidat interviendra auprès de nos clients dans la réalisation des projets qu'ils nous ont confiés.

Tâches

Animé(e) par la curiosité et un désir de livrer de la valeur, vous joindrez l'équipe de développement chevronnée derrière la plateforme agricole ayant connu la plus forte croissance au Canada ces dernières années. Vos compétences Azure serviront à faire grandir cette plateforme de façon sécuritaire pour les producteurs de demain.

  • Définir et porter la vision technique de la plateforme en collaboration avec l'architecte et le responsable de produit (PO);

job.name: Senior Full Stack Developer
job.description:
A career as a senior full stack developer within the Wealth Management IT Delivery team at National Bank means acting as a specialist in end-to-end development of modern applications. This role allows you to make a tangible impact on our organization by leveraging your expertise in software development, application architecture, and DevOps practices, while contributing to technology solutions that directly support our internal teams and clients.

Your role

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full stack applications in a cloud environment, applying best practices in security, quality, and architecture (microservices and micro-frontends).
  • Ensure the quality, performance, and resilience of delivered solutions through automated testing strategies and a continuous focus on reducing technical debt.
  • Contribute to the evolution of DevOps practices and continuous integration and deployment pipelines to improve delivery efficiency and reliability.
  • Influence technology directions by collaborating closely with architecture, development, and operations teams.
  • Support and guide team members as well as technology partners in resolving complex, cross-functional technical issues.
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of team practices, technical standards, and software engineering approaches.

Your team

The Information Technology and Operations Vice-Presidency bring together more than 5,500 specialists who work in an agile, proactive, and collaborative way to seize opportunities, stay at the forefront of technology, and continuously improve processes.

Within the Wealth Management sector, you are part of a team recognized for the quality of its deliveries, its close collaboration with stakeholders, and its ability to deliver high-value solutions. You report to the senior director and evolve in an environment where autonomy, collaboration, and continuous improvement are valued. job.description:
Opentext - The Information Company OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered. At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

The Content Services business unit provides content platforms used by thousands of organizations to manage business content on-premise, in public cloud and private cloud, across a diverse portfolio of mature and emerging products.

We are looking for a Senior Software Developer to design and build the integration layer between OpenText Content Management and the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 productivity services. You will develop SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solutions, Office add-ins, and Microsoft Graph and REST API integrations that enable thousands of enterprise users to seamlessly access, manage, and govern content directly within the applications they use every day.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role on a small, high-impact team with significant visibility across the organization. You will own features end-to-end, from architecture and design through implementation, testing, release, and post-production support. Working closely with Product Management, QA, Support, and Cloud Operations teams across multiple geographies, you will help deliver reliable, scalable, and intuitive integrations that are critical to our clients' daily workflows.

Your Impact The integrations you build are often the first experience clients have with our platform. When a records manager can securely file an email to a governed repository without leaving Outlook, or a project team can access controlled content directly within a Microsoft Teams channel, that experience is the result of your work.

You will solve complex challenges that span two large enterprise ecosystems: OpenText and Microsoft. Success often requires going beyond the documentation, analyzing protocol traces, understanding authentication and token flows, and collaborating directly with clients to diagnose and reproduce issues. This is a role for a developer who enjoys tackling difficult integration problems, navigating ambiguity, and delivering solutions that have a direct impact on client productivity and adoption.

job.name: Sr. Software Engineer - Product
job.description:
Authentic is a tech-enabled MGA (managing general agent). We design and run insurance programs for specific kinds of businesses, like restaurants, gyms, and power producers. Brokers bring us the businesses that need coverage, and carriers back our policies. Every program runs on a platform we built ourselves, and we own every line of code behind it. Engineers and insurance experts build it side by side in New York and Dayton, Ohio. Since our founding in 2022, we’ve grown to 80+ people and been named to the 2026 CB Insights Insurtech 50.

Why this role is interesting

Our users are underwriters, brokers and operations teams. They make high-stakes decisions on complex, messy data all day, and the tools they use either slow them down or give them a real edge. You'll build the tools that give them that edge.

The hard parts:

  • *Dense workflows for experts.* An underwriter might review dozens of data points, apply rules that vary by state and program, and price a policy in one session. Making that fast and clear is a serious UX and architecture problem.
  • *Correctness matters.* A wrong rate or a missed form has real financial and regulatory consequences, so you'll design systems that are both fast to change and safe to trust.
  • *New programs keep launching.* Each one adds new coverages, rules and data. The platform has to stay flexible without turning into a mess.
  • *Your users sit near you.* You can watch an underwriter use what you shipped and fix the friction the same week.

What you'll do

  • Own major product areas end to end: work with underwriters and product to define the problem, then design, build, ship and measure it.
  • Build polished, responsive interfaces in React and TypeScript that turn complex insurance workflows into tools people enjoy using.
  • Work across the stack. You'll shape APIs and contribute to backend services when the best solution calls for it.
  • Find the bottlenecks that slow our users or our team down, and fix them.
  • Raise the bar for the team through code review, mentoring and how you approach problems.

In your first 90 days you might

  • Design, architect, and build a Claims product so we can administrate claims and feed its data into our underwriting processes.
  • Ship the broker-facing flow for a new program launch
  • Lead a frontend architecture improvement, such as forms, state or a design system

Our stack

React, TypeScript, Python, AWS. The team has 8 engineers and you'll report to the Head of Engineering.

We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Explore our Engineering Blog & Emerging Talent Blog to learn more about how we build at Ramp and what it’s like to start your career here.

About The Role Ramp is, at its core, an engineering company. We’re looking for frontend and full-stack engineering interns who are excited to build intuitive, high-quality products that solve complex problems for our customers.

Our ideal candidate has strong JavaScript fundamentals, an eye for great user experiences, and enjoys turning customer needs into thoughtful engineering solutions. Our frontend stack includes TypeScript, React, Vite, and Ryu, our in-house design system.

What You’ll Do

  • Own meaningful projects and ship products alongside cross-functional teams

  • Experience with one or more programming languages

The company sources groundnuts directly from farmers, ensuring traceability, freshness, and fair value across the supply chain. Its operations are guided by strong values of pride, honesty, professional ethics, and fair business practices. With locations in Jetpur, Saurashtra, and Ahmedabad, Shree Gopal Agri benefits from access to one of India’s best groundnut-growing regions and a robust distribution network for efficient market reach.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad, focused on ECommerce and Modern Trade for SHREGO. The role involves managing online marketplaces and eCommerce platforms, including product listings, pricing, promotions, and inventory coordination. The individual will build and maintain relationships with modern trade partners, negotiate listings and visibility, and ensure timely execution of promotions and planograms. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring sales performance, analyzing channel data, tracking competitor activity, and coordinating with supply chain and marketing teams to support growth. The role also requires regular reporting on key metrics, implementing channel-specific strategies, and ensuring a consistent brand presence across all modern trade and eCommerce channels.

job.name: Threat Hunter
job.description:
Job title: Threat Hunting - 8/5 Support

Workplace type: On-site

Location: Karle Tech Park, Bangalore, India

Job type: Full-time (Long term)

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Threat Hunter to proactively identify, investigate, and mitigate advanced cyber threats that evade traditional, alert-driven security controls. You will run hypothesis-driven and intelligence-led hunts across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud environments to reduce dwell time and improve detection maturity.

Must-Have: Hands-On Microsoft Sentinel Experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct hypothesis-based and IOC-driven threat hunts across:
  • Endpoint (EDR/XDR)
  • SIEM / log management platforms (Microsoft Sentinel preferred)
  • Network telemetry (NDR)
  • Identity logs (AD / Entra ID)
  • Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, M365)
  • Identify stealthy and advanced threats, including:
  • Living-off-the-Land (LotL) techniques
  • Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs)
  • Lateral movement and privilege escalation
  • Insider threat indicators
  • Develop and execute MITRE ATT&CK-aligned hunting hypotheses
  • Convert hunting findings into:
  • Security incidents
  • New detection rules (Sentinel / SIEM / EDR / XDR)
  • Change or service requests (misconfigurations, logging gaps)
  • Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, and Threat Intelligence teams
  • Produce hunting reports and KPIs (dwell time reduction, hunts-to-detections, incidents generated)

Technical Skills

  • Microsoft Sentinel (hands-on, mandatory)
  • Strong expertise in SIEM/SOAR platforms (Splunk, Chronicle, Palo Alto XSIAM are a plus)
  • Hands-on experience with EDR/XDR tools (Microsoft XDR, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Palo Alto Cortex)
  • Proficiency in KQL / SPL / advanced hunting queries
  • Deep understanding of MITRE ATT&CK techniques and TTPs
  • Strong OS knowledge: Windows, Linux, macOS
  • Basic scripting skills (PowerShell / Python preferred)
  • Cloud security exposure (Azure, AWS, M365 Defender)

Experience & Soft Skills

  • 6+ years in SOC / threat detection, with 2+ years in threat hunting
  • Strong analytical and investigative mindset
  • Client-facing reporting and presentation skills
  • Comfortable working on-site at Karle Tech Park, Bangalore

How to Apply

Fill the Form - https://forms.gle/jU9Qn5Pm34bBn14k7

Click Apply or send your resume to jyotsna.mahajan@arborvitae.in

job.name: Embedded Security
job.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Embedded Firmware Engineer – Embedded Security

📍 Location: Bengaluru

💼 Experience: 4+ Years

🏢 Company: LeadSOC Technologies

About LeadSOC Technologies

LeadSOC is a multinational engineering company specializing in end-to-end VLSI and semiconductor engineering solutions. We work across the semiconductor product lifecycle, from SoC design and verification to embedded software, firmware, automation engineering, and post-silicon engineering.

Our Software Engineering team focuses on embedded software, firmware, Linux, device drivers, system software, and other low-level technologies supporting next-generation semiconductor platforms.

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Embedded Firmware Engineer with strong expertise in Embedded C, ARM Cortex-M architecture, MCU programming, bootloader development, and embedded security.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in secure boot, firmware updates, cryptography, device identity, and trusted execution environments.

Must-Have Skills

1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
2. 4+ years of hands-on experience in embedded software development.
3. Strong C programming skills for embedded systems; Python experience is an added advantage.
4. Solid understanding of ARM Cortex-M architecture.
5. Hands-on MCU programming experience in bare-metal and RTOS environments.
6. Experience in bootloader development and firmware updates, preferably with MCUboot or vendor-specific security frameworks.
7. Strong debugging skills using J-Link/SWD; experience with logic analyzers and oscilloscopes is an advantage.
8. Understanding of cryptography fundamentals, including hashing, digital signatures, and key management.
9. Knowledge of Secure Boot, Root of Trust, provisioning, and device identity concepts such as PKI and certificates.
10. Experience with ARM TrustZone-M, MPU configuration, and trusted execution features.
11. Experience with embedded software development, testing, and validation practices.

Additional Expectation

Demonstrated ownership, with the ability to independently drive technical tasks from development through debugging, integration, and validation.

job.name: Threat Hunter
job.description:
• Role: Threat Hunter (8/5 support; note that the JD also mentions willingness to work in 24×7 SOC environments)
  • Openings: 1 position (not a backfill; long-term)
  • Start Date: Immediate
  • Location: Karle Tech Park, Bangalore, India

Role And Responsibilities:

Instead of just waiting for security alerts to pop up, you form educated guesses ("hypotheses") about how attackers might sneak in and check the data to see if it's happening. Your day-to-day work involves:

  • Digging through system data: Checking endpoints (laptops/servers), network traffic, login/identity logs (like Active Directory or Entra ID), and cloud setups (Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365).
  • Spotting stealthy attacks: Looking for advanced persistent threats (APTs), lateral movement (attackers jumping from one machine to another), privilege escalation (gaining higher access), insider risks, and "living-off-the-land" tactics (using built-in system tools maliciously).
  • Turning clues into defenses: Escalating real threats as incidents, writing new detection rules so tools catch similar activity automatically next time, flagging logging gaps, and sharing clear reports and metrics (like reducing dwell time—how long an attacker goes unnoticed).

What we are Looking for:

  • Experience: 6+ years overall in SOC or threat detection, including at least 2 years specifically doing threat hunting.
  • Tools & Platforms:
  • SIEM / SOAR: Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Chronicle, or Palo Alto XSIAM
  • EDR / XDR: Microsoft XDR, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or Palo Alto Cortex
  • Cloud & OS: Windows, Linux, and macOS, plus cloud security (Azure, AWS, M365 Defender)
  • Querying & Scripting: Writing hunting queries (like KQL or SPL) and basic scripting (PowerShell or Python).
  • Mindset: Strong investigative instincts, clear reporting/communication with stakeholders, and comfort working in fast-paced security operations.

job.description:
About the Role

Leidos is seeking an experienced UI/UX Web Developer to support a federal government project. The role involves leading the design, development, and deployment of a modern web application prototype that brings together fragmented information, digital PDF resources, and workflows currently distributed across multiple legacy Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) portals.

You will help create a unified web interface that provides centralized access to information and resources. Working closely with stakeholders through an iterative review process, you will deliver responsive user experiences, reliable API integrations, and interfaces that meet federal Section 508 accessibility requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and refine a functional, scalable web application prototype that aggregates information from multiple databases, web services, and document repositories.
  • Translate complex information architecture into intuitive, modern, mobile-compatible user interfaces.
  • Develop robust search, filtering, and document retrieval workflows.
  • Ensure digital interfaces, navigation structures, and rendered document content comply with Section 508 standards and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines.
  • Implement mechanisms to organize, parse, index, and streamline access to digital PDF resources and unstructured content.
  • Participate in five formal review gates: Discovery, Architecture/UI Design, Demonstration, Refinement, and Recommendation.
  • Prepare user flow and interaction specifications.
  • Document visual, functional, and system rules that connect design requirements with front-end and back-end development.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of professional web development experience using modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js, along with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Demonstrated expertise in responsive web design (RWD), including cross-browser compatibility and mobile and tablet viewport support.
  • Experience building intuitive user interfaces, user journey flows, and structured content hierarchies for complex, data-heavy systems.
  • Experience integrating or consuming RESTful APIs and working with JSON/XML data payloads.
  • In-depth practical knowledge of Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act and WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Experience with ARIA roles, semantic HTML, and automated and manual accessibility testing.
  • Familiarity with accessibility tools such as axe, WAVE, and screen readers including JAWS and NVDA.
  • Experience implementing search, faceted filtering, and indexing tools for digital Document management, particularly multi-page PDF files and digital repositories.

Preferred Qualifications

job.name: Sr. Software Engineer (Core Policy)
job.description:
Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data.

The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity.

Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control.

For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production.

Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide.

  • Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments.
  • Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies.
  • Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures.
  • We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Immuta’s Core Policy Team builds the technologies that power Immuta’s platform, enabling customers to author, manage, and enforce complex data access policies across modern data ecosystems.

We develop systems that automate governance and privacy enforcement across leading cloud data platforms, including Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, and Starburst. We work across engineering, product, design, and other partner teams to solve complex technical problems, improve scalability and performance, and deliver maintainable software that creates meaningful value for customers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Core Policy Team, you’ll design, build, and evolve scalable, high-performance features that power Immuta’s policy abstraction and enforcement capabilities. You’ll work across front-end and back-end systems to turn complex product and technical challenges into clear, maintainable solutions.

Description There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact.

You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. What’s in it for you?

With teams across the Amazon universe, you don’t have to choose one path too early. You’ll take ownership, build new skills, and shape a career that evolves as you do.

Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
job.description:
Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role? The Data Infrastructure team at Cohere is responsible for the storage and data movement layer underlying every model training run. We're building the unified storage layer that feeds our training workloads at petabyte scale. In this role, you would have the opportunity to architect and lead the design of this system from the ground up, serving petabytes of training data and model checkpoints fast enough to keep thousands of GPUs busy across several training clusters. You'd be a key contributor, leading the effort to solve a problem few teams have tackled at this scale.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, architect, and operate the distributed storage system that feeds model training and evaluation, driving the technical vision from concept through production.
  • Lead and own the deployment of this system across multiple Kubernetes clusters at petabyte scale, setting standards and best practices for the organization.
  • Collaborate with researchers and training-infra teams to define how jobs read and write data, translating those patterns into throughput, latency, and durability requirements that shape the platform's roadmap.
  • Navigate the networking, I/O, and consistency challenges of moving large datasets and checkpoints across regions and backends, with GPU idle time and time-to-insight as the key metrics of success — and drive the solutions that improve them.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • Strong storage fundamentals, including replication, consistency, caching, and data lifecycle management, with demonstrated architecture and design experience.
  • Strong coding ability in Python and Go, with the ability to lead implementations and mentor others in either language, and the willingness to contribute to the other.
  • Proven experience running stateful systems on Kubernetes, including Persistent Volumes, CSI drivers, and StatefulSets, with the capacity to design and execute operational strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud object storage such as S3 as well as POSIX-style filesystems.

It’s a Bonus If You Have

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

Why this role? This role is for a highly experienced Back-End Software Engineer who wants to work on core systems that shape how the platform (Model Vault) operates. You will help define the architecture of the platform where reliability, security, performance, and simplicity all matter, and where many of the problems do not have off-the-shelf solutions.

Model Vault is Cohere’s inference platform for deploying and operating models securely at enterprise scale. The team owns the systems between a customer and the underlying AI infrastructure, including identity, deployments, metering, billing, security, privacy, and confidential computing. We are strengthening these systems as Model Vault grows, with the goal of scaling to millions of users and supporting some of the world’s most demanding enterprise workloads.

As a Senior/Staff Software Engineer, You Will

  • Evolve and scale the backend systems that power Model Vault, including authentication and authorization, deployment management, billing, metering, and customer lifecycle.
  • Lead major architectural initiatives across identity, payments, usage systems, platform scalability, and other core product foundations.
  • Build highly reliable control-plane services for provisioning, configuring, scaling, and operating model deployments across clouds and hardware platforms.
  • Design APIs and distributed systems with strong guarantees around correctness, consistency, isolation, failure recovery, idempotency, and observability.
  • Build security and privacy into the platform architecture, including tenant isolation, least-privilege access, auditability, secrets management, encryption, and confidential computing boundaries.
  • Solve complex problems that span backend systems, cloud infrastructure, security, and AI inference, where conventional SaaS patterns are often not enough.
  • Drive projects end-to-end, from architecture and threat modeling through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration based on real customer workloads.

A hands-on automation and platform engineer who combines strong programming with deep Azure knowledge. The role will build reusable cloud capabilities, Infrastructure-as-Code, Policy-as-Code, CI/CD automation, container integrations, and developer self-service experiences.

job.name: Management Information System Executive
job.description:
Associate – MIS Executive

Zolo | Coliving

Own the data. Create visibility. Enable better decisions.

Why this role exists

Zolo's coliving operations are built on accurate information, operational visibility, and disciplined execution. While property teams manage residents and day-to-day operations, the business depends on reliable data to make decisions.

Every property generates information every day:

  • Residents move in and move out
  • Beds get occupied and vacated
  • Collections get updated
  • Transfers happen across properties
  • Operational activities are tracked

Every business needs a single accountable owner who ensures this information remains accurate, organized, and available when needed.

This role exists to ensure that occupancy records, resident databases, operational trackers, and business reports remain reliable — enabling teams to execute effectively and management to make better decisions.

If the MIS Executive is strong, teams trust the data and operations run smoothly.

If the MIS Executive is weak, reporting becomes unreliable, visibility reduces, and decisions get delayed.

Your mandate is clear:

  • Maintain accurate resident, occupancy, and operational records
  • Ensure reports are shared on time and without errors
  • Keep databases, trackers, and dashboards updated at all times
  • Support operations teams with reliable information
  • Identify discrepancies and drive data accuracy
  • Ensure management has complete visibility into business performance

This is not a reporting role.

It is ownership of operational visibility and data discipline.

About Zolo

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

What you will be responsible for

1. Own Resident & Occupancy Records

  • Maintain accurate resident and occupancy information across properties
  • Track move-ins, move-outs, transfers, vacancies, and occupancy changes
  • Ensure all records remain updated and reliable
  • Maintain complete visibility of resident data

2. Manage Reports & Dashboards

  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports
  • Maintain operational dashboards and trackers
  • Generate occupancy, collections, and operational reports
  • Ensure reports are available on time and without errors

3. Ensure Data Accuracy & Validation

job.name: Senior Developer

Title: Zoho Automation Lead

Location: Whitefield, Bengaluru (on-site)

Experience: 3–5 years, with at least 2 years hands-on in Zoho

Type: Full-time

Joining: Immediate to 30 days preferred

About Chattels Design LLP,

Chattels Design LLP is a premium home interiors and modular furniture company, founded in 2019 and headquartered in Bengaluru. We have delivered 5,000+ homes, employ 100+ people, run our own modular furniture factory, and have four experience centres: Whitefield, JP Nagar and Jakkur in Bengaluru, and Gachibowli in Hyderabad. The whole company runs on Zoho. We are growing fast and want automation, not extra headcount, to carry that growth.

We are hiring one Zoho Automation Lead to automate the day-to-day work of every Chattels Design team across Zoho, using Zoho's own tools (Deluge, Zia, Flow) and AI tools such as Claude.

The role:

You will be the single owner of how Chattels runs on Zoho. You will find the manual, repetitive work in each team, automate it, and keep those automations running as the company grows.

You will work with sales, design, project management, production, accounts and HR. You will use Zoho's built-in tools first, and AI tools such as Claude and Zia where they do the job better.

Key responsibilities:

Automate across Zoho. Example work, by app:

CRM: Lead assignment, follow-up reminders, deal-stage alerts, Closed Won handover

Projects : Auto-create projects and task lists from won deals; flag delayed or not-updated projects

Books : Payment reminders, collection tracking, checks for duplicate or unusual payments

People : Onboarding and exit checklists, attendance and leave rules, policy workflows

Creator: Custom internal apps where standard Zoho apps fall short

Cliq, Mail, WorkDrive: Team alerts, scheduled reports, automatic file filing

Own and run it

  • Map each team's process first, agree the change with the team head, then build.
  • Build with Deluge, workflow rules, Blueprints, Zoho Flow and APIs; use Zia and Claude for AI steps such as reading documents or drafting messages.
  • Set up scheduled reports and dashboards for management.
  • Act as Zoho One admin: user accounts, roles, permissions and data clean-up.
  • Fix automations when they break, and document every one so others can follow it.
  • Train staff on each change and track the hours it saves.

Skills

Must have

  • 2+ years hands-on with Zoho CRM and Zoho Creator, including Deluge scripting.
  • Has built workflow rules, Blueprints and custom functions that are live in a company today.
  • Has connected Zoho apps to each other, or to outside tools, using APIs or webhooks.
  • Comfortable with reports and dashboards.
  • Uses AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) in daily work.
  • Talks to non-technical teams in plain English and turns their problems into working solutions.
  • Works independently and follows through without being chased.

Good to have

job.name: AI Inference Core - Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer
job.description:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.

This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.

Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.

About The Team The Core Infrastructure team builds the software systems that power engineering workflows across Cerebras.

Our infrastructure coordinates complex work across machines, clusters, development environments, and hardware systems. We build orchestration frameworks, execution engines, scheduling systems, test infrastructure, developer tools, and reusable software platforms that allow engineers to build, test, qualify, and deliver software reliably at scale.

These systems are primarily built in Python, but the work goes far beyond scripting or automation. Our frameworks act as the control plane for distributed workflows, managing resources, execution state, concurrency, failures, retries, dependencies, and observability across large and complex environments.

About The Role We are hiring a Software Engineer to design and build the core software behind Cerebras engineering infrastructure.

You will work on Python frameworks, orchestration systems, distributed execution, scheduling, test infrastructure, and developer tooling. You will help define the architecture and APIs that other engineering teams depend on every day.

This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys reading unfamiliar code, understanding how systems fit together, debugging difficult problems, and improving the underlying design rather than applying one-off fixes.

We value strong software-engineering fundamentals, independent problem solving, and sound systems thinking more than familiarity with any particular infrastructure product.

The Client Financing Strats team focuses on three areas: developing pricing and risk models and systems to support client financing trading in products such as repo, bills, total return swaps, and bond forwards; implementing electronic trading algorithms for repo and bills and driving system development; and building data analytics that improve business operation efficiency.

Client Financing is seeking a Front Desk Quant/Strat in Montreal to contribute to the research and development of client financing strats, with a focus on data analytics and the improvement of live risk and P&L (profit and loss) systems.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley has been known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

job.name: Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
job.description:
Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role? The Data Infrastructure team at Cohere is responsible for the storage and data movement layer underlying every model training run. We're building the unified storage layer that feeds our training workloads. It needs to serve petabytes of training data and model checkpoints fast enough to keep thousands of GPUs busy across several training clusters. In this role, you’d have an opportunity to build this system from the ground up. You’d be a key contributor, working on a problem few teams have had to solve at this scale.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and operate the distributed storage system that feeds model training and evaluation.
  • Run this system multiple on Kubernetes clusters at petabyte scale.
  • Work with researchers and training-infra teams on how jobs actually read and write data, and turn that into throughput, latency, and durability requirements
  • Work through the networking, I/O, and consistency problems of moving large datasets and checkpoints across regions and backends, with GPU idle time and time-to-insight as the measures of success

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • Strong storage fundamentals, including replication, consistency, caching, and data lifecycle management.
  • Strong coding ability. We work in Python and Go; experience in either is enough, but you should be willing to pick up the other
  • Experience running stateful systems on Kubernetes, including Persistent Volumes, CSI drivers, and StatefulSets.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud object storage such as S3 as well as POSIX-style filesystems.

It’s a Bonus If You Have

  • Experience with parallel or HPC filesystems such as Weka, VAST, or Lustre.
  • Familiarity with the data-loading and checkpointing patterns used in large-scale model training.
  • An interest in how large models are trained and evaluated, including the trajectory and eval data those runs generate, and a desire to understand the workloads the platform is serving.

Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks

At Finnable we like to keep things uncomplicated, exciting, and fast – well, that’s our brand promise to our customers also. We want to give them loans in under 3 minutes -UNCOMPLICATED AND FAST!

job.description:
1166772\_RR00124794 Job ID: 1166772\_RR00124794

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.

For more information, go to med.nyu.edu , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X and Instagram .

Position Summary The Petljak Lab is seeking a highly motivated and creative Senior Bioinformatics Programmer to join our multidisciplinary team within the newly established Cancer Genomics & Genetics Program at NYU Grossman School of Medicine. This is a highly collaborative, fast-paced, and scientifically engaged position suited to someone who thrives in an ambitious research environment, takes strong ownership of their work, and is motivated to drive projects forward. The position offers exposure to leading experts and collaborations across cancer biology, genomics, computational biology, and related disciplines.

The Petljak Labs research sits at the intersection of computational and experimental biology, cancer genomics, mutagenesis, and tumor evolution, with the goal of understanding how mutational processes arise and shape cancer development and therapeutic responseand using these insights to identify new opportunities for cancer prevention and treatment. Our work builds on recent studies deconvoluting mutational signatures from cancer genomes and using them as molecular readouts to identify the sources, mechanisms, and functional consequences of individual mutational processes (Cell, 2019; Nature, 2023; Nature Genetics, 2023; Cell Trends In Cancer, 2026).

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Ontology & Reasoning Systems (819)
job.description:
At Protegrity, we lead innovation by using AI and quantum-resistant cryptography to transform data protection across cloud-native, hybrid, on-premises, and open source environments. We leverage advanced cryptographic methods such as tokenization, format-preserving encryption, and quantum-resilient techniques to protect sensitive data.

As a global leader in data security, our mission is to ensure that data isn’t just valuable but also usable, trusted, and safe.

Protegrity offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of innovation and collaboration, with the ability to make a meaningful impact on the industry while working alongside some of the brightest minds. Together, we are redefining how the world safeguards data, enabling organizations to thrive in a GenAI era where data is the ultimate currency. If you're ready to shape the future of data security, Protegrity is the place for you.

Role Overview

Protegrity is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Ontology & Reasoning Systems to design and build the ontology and reasoning layer that connects structured sources, semi-structured metadata, and unstructured documents into a model that supports deterministic machine reasoning.

In this role, you will formalize complex domains into entities, relationships, constraints, and rules that allow the system to derive conclusions from underlying facts. A key focus will be making those conclusions explainable and traceable, with clear derivation paths back to the source data and logic that produced them.

LLMs play an important role at the ingestion boundary, supporting extraction, normalization, and categorization of information from unstructured or ambiguous inputs. The reasoning layer itself must remain deterministic, auditable, and explainable, with appropriate checks on model-generated outputs before they are used as trusted facts.

You will work closely with product and research teams to define formal models, improve reasoning quality, and build systems that support accurate, reviewable outputs. This role is well suited for someone with a strong foundation in logic, graph-based systems, formal modeling, and production-grade software engineering.

What You’ll Do

Senior Software Engineer, Search Platform Our vision We are building the next-generation search platform, with a vision to democratize knowledge construction and consumption at Thomson Reuters. The platform consolidates search systems across Thomson Reuters products and services, serving millions of end users, internal agents, and internal search teams, into a fully managed, customizable, sovereign, and self-serve search platform. Your work is what lets internal teams create, configure, and run search on their own, without waiting on a central team.

This is a full-ownership role. You design, build, test, deploy, and operate production systems at scale. Senior Engineers here hold design authority within their scope, share expertise across the team, and mentor more junior engineers.

Key Responsibilities Build the platform

  • Build reliable pipeline components that move documents through parsing, chunking, enrichment, and indexing, using proven patterns for retries, dead-letter queues, and idempotent processing.
  • Build self-service platform APIs that let client teams configure search systems, manage index lifecycles, and monitor ingestion health.
  • Design retrieval interfaces for products and AI agents with predictable contracts, explicit latency budgets, and result payloads sized for LLM context windows.
  • Contribute to the move from OpenSearch to Vespa, including schema migrations and zero-downtime index promotion.
  • Instrument retrieval components so offline evaluation and LLM-as-judge grading can compare pipeline versions and measure search quality.

Operate What You Build

  • Take part in the on-call rotation and own incidents in your scope, from triage and root cause to post-mortem and systemic fixes.
  • Add logging, metrics, and distributed tracing to your components, including trace-level visibility into agentic retrieval paths, and help define SLOs.

Lead and collaborate

job.name: Software Engineer, AI Automation
job.description:
About Fluidstack We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Decision Team Examples of key problems the team is working on

  • Automate the delivery of gigawatts. Every process that takes AI infrastructure from land to live compute becomes software: schedules, decisions, and todos generated from a live knowledge graph instead of chased by hand.
  • Forward-deploy beside the experts. Product teams sit with quality managers, sourcing leads, and deployment engineers on factory floors and sites, and turn their judgment into systems that reach every unit.
  • Deliver every supercomputer faster than the last. Dozens of concurrent projects feed one graph, so every lesson learned at one site becomes a preventive check at all of them.

Role Scope

job.name: Sr Analyst, Cyber Security Threat Management
job.description:
About Northern Trust As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

As part of Northern Trust’s security operations center, a Senior Analyst will conduct security monitoring, security incident identification, incident prioritization, incident escalation and directed response support functions. Tier one analyst will play a crucial role in executing Northern Trust’s 24x7 security monitoring model, creating a resilient and unified team that improves NT’s ability to protect and defend its networks and information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR/XDR, email, identity, network, and cloud security tools.
  • Analyze security events to determine incident scope, severity, and business impact.
  • Coordinate containment, remediation, escalation, and incident tracking through closure.
  • Conduct threat hunting and identify opportunities to improve detections, runbooks, and playbooks.
  • Maintain accurate investigation records and provide effective handovers across global SOC teams.
  • Support major incidents, post-incident reviews, and operational reporting.
  • Provide technical guidance and investigation support to junior analysts.
  • Collaborate with regional and global cybersecurity, infrastructure, identity, cloud, and technology teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Practical knowledge of incident response processes, MITRE ATT&CK, networking, and common cyberattack techniques.
  • Experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, email security, identity security, and ServiceNow.
  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, KQL, threat intelligence, or security automation is preferred.
  • Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently within a shift-based, 24x7, or follow-the-sun operating model.

job.name: Advanced Product Security Senior Tester
job.description:
Join us as a Advanced Product Security Senior Tester at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

To be successful as an Advanced Product Security Senior Tester, you should have experience with:

  • Strong software development and secure code review skills, with the ability to analyse codebases, trace data and control flows, and identify complex design, implementation and business-logic vulnerabilities.
  • Architecture review and threat modelling, including identifying trust boundaries, abuse cases and attack paths, and translating them into targeted security test cases.
  • Advanced penetration testing of web applications, APIs and modern platforms, combining white-box and dynamic techniques to validate exploitability and create controlled proof-of-concept exploits.
  • Correlating source-code analysis with runtime testing to identify root causes, control bypasses and vulnerabilities that automated tools or conventional testing may miss.
  • Assessing cloud-native, containerised, distributed or AI-enabled applications and their supporting security controls.
  • Producing clear, reproducible technical findings, risk assessments and practical remediation guidance for engineering and senior stakeholders.
  • AI-assisted AppSec and penetration-testing techniques with appropriate human validation, evidence checking and protection of sensitive information.
  • Leading complex technical assessments, performing peer review and collaborating across Product, Engineering, Architecture, AppSec and Penetration Testing teams.

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field.
  • Experience in financial services or other regulated environments.
  • Professional experience combining software engineering with product security, secure code review or penetration testing.
  • Vulnerability research, reverse engineering, exploit development, custom security tooling or test automation.
  • Knowledge of OWASP ASVS, SAMM and testing guidance, together with relevant NIST and MITRE frameworks.
  • Relevant certifications such as CREST, OSCP, OSEP, OSWE, GIAC/SANS or CSSLP, or equivalent demonstrable practical expertise.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The role is based out of Pune.

Purpose of the role To identify potential vulnerabilities within the banks IT systems using penetration testing tools and techniques to ensure security of computer systems, applications, servers, and networks.

job.name: HMI S/W Lead (VC++, MFC, WIN32)
job.description:
HMI Software Lead Developer– UAV Ground Control Systems (VC++, MFC, Win32)

Location: Hyderabad, India (On-site)

About the Role

We are seeking a highly technical and hands-on Software Lead to take ownership of our core Ground Control Station (GCS) and mission planning applications. In the mission-critical UAV sector, our ground control software acts as the central nervous system for flight operations, telemetry monitoring, and payload management. You will lead a dedicated engineering pod to architect, modernize, and scale our Windows-based applications, ensuring rock-solid reliability for complex flight profiles.

What You Will Do

Technical Leadership: Lead the architecture, design, and development of high-performance desktop applications used for UAV mission planning, live telemetry tracking, and payload control.

  • Core Development: Write, review, and optimize complex multithreaded code using VC++, MFC, and Win32 APIs for Windows environments.
  • Team Mentorship: Guide a team of software engineers, enforcing rigorous code quality, memory management practices, and peer review standards.
  • Systems Integration: Interface ground software with UAV flight controllers and communication links using protocols like MAVLink, UDP/TCP, and custom serial interfaces.
  • Safety & Compliance: Champion aerospace software standards (such as DO-178C guidelines where applicable) to ensure mission-critical reliability and fault tolerance.
  • Legacy Modernization: Strategically decouple and refactor legacy MFC codebases into modular architectures to support future cross-platform or UI/UX scaling.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 6+ years of hands-on software development with a minimum of 2+ years in a technical leadership or team lead capacity.
  • Core Stack: Deep, uncompromising expertise in C++, VC++, Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC), and Win32 API.
  • Concurrency: Strong command of multithreading, asynchronous I/O, IPC, and memory leak profiling in a Windows environment.
  • Networking: Proven experience with network socket programming (TCP/UDP) for real-time, low-latency data streaming.
  • Problem Solving: Exceptional debugging skills using Visual Studio tools, WinDbg, and performance profilers.
  • Standout Qualifications (Nice to Have)Prior experience in the aerospace, defense, or UAV industry developing GCS or avionics software.
  • Familiarity with geographic information systems (GIS), map rendering (GDAL, QtLocation), or 3D rendering (OpenGL/DirectX).
  • Knowledge of aerospace safety-critical verification processes (DO-178C, DO-330).

Why Join Us?

You will be directly influencing the software that commands next-generation unmanned aerial systems. We offer a culture of high engineering rigor, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to build products that solve real-world logistical and defense challenges.

How to Apply

Apply job here on LinkedIN. OR

Please send your resume to communications@qubistsolutions.com.

job.name: Software Engineer - 2 (Billing)
job.description:
About Exotel:

Exotel is the emerging market’s leading full-stack customer engagement platform and business-focused virtual telecom operator. Incorporated in 2011, Exotel’s cloud-based product suite powers 50 million daily engagements across voice, video, and messaging channels. Exotel serves over 6000 companies across 60+ countries, including India, SE Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.

Tech @ Exotel

  • Exotel Engineering builds fault-tolerant, scalable, and real-time distributed systems.
  • Our tech stack includes Golang, Java, PHP, MySQL, Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, Beanstalkd, and Elasticsearch.
  • We follow best practices in clean abstractions, loosely coupled services, and DevOps-driven operations.
  • We strongly believe in "you build it, you own it."

Team IPO Readiness:

The IPO Readiness pod owns Exotel’s billing and revenue platform — real-time call/SMS billing, balance deduction, invoicing, payment processing, and credit control. The platform handles approximately 200k transactions per minute across Voice, Messaging, and other Exotel solutions.

Role: Member of Technical Staff II

As an MTS-II on IPO Readiness, you will design, build, and integrate components across the billing platform and support IPO-readiness initiatives (controls, monitoring, automation). You will work on feature delivery, production support, and cross-system integrations with ERP (Business Central), payment gateways, and the Zuora migration path.

Key Responsibilities:

Platform Development & Integration:

  • Develop and maintain microservices and batch jobs in Golang, Java, or PHP
  • Build and extend REST APIs and Kafka consumers/producers for billing events, sync flows, and fallback pipelines.

Must-Have Skills:

  • Strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms).
  • Proficiency in at least one of: Golang (preferred), Java, or PHP.
  • Experience building scalable distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
  • Hands-on MySQL — schema design, query tuning, replication awareness.
  • Experience with Apache Kafka and asynchronous processing (consumers, lag, fallback/retry patterns).
  • Kubernetes basics — pods, deployments, namespaces, ArgoCD or equivalent GitOps.
  • DevOps mindset — you build it, you own it; comfortable with logs, metrics, and incident triage.

job.description:
Contract Job for 1 year | Product Implementation Consultant for a Consent Management Product | 3+ years’ experience candidates only | Bangalore

Selection Process & Instructions

1. Candidates with less than 3 years of relevant experience, including freshers, are requested not to apply. Candidates who have previously applied for this role and were not shortlisted/rejected are also requested not to reapply.

2. This position is open only to candidates currently based in Bangalore.

3. BDO will screen the candidates based on the information submitted through this job posting response (experience, current location, immediate availability, current CTC, expected CTC, etc. would be the key points for filtration). Please note that this is a relatively early-career implementation role, and so the salary expectations cannot go beyond 7 to 8 lakhs per annum .

4. For filtered candidates, there will be a short conversation from BDO's side to validate the data submitted. The candidates will be asked to share their CV in a one-slide PPT format, which will be used by BDO for client submissions.

5. The PPT version of the CVs will be submitted to the client, who will then set up a MS Teams call with multiple candidates together simultaneously, where the candidates will give an introduction of themselves and their work experience. The client will assess the communication skills and smartness of the candidates in this short chat.

6. The client will then revert to BDO, confirming a list of candidates who may be considered for the Product training on their SaaS-based Consent Management solution. This is a free training session where training content will be shared online, and the candidate has to complete the self-paced training at their convenience. There will be an evaluation at the end (minimum 75% to clear the exam). There will be daily Q&A sessions for 1 hour to clarify doubts, if any, on the training material. No payment, salary, or stipend will be provided by BDO or the Client during this training session period. On average, if you spend 3 hours a day, then the training and certification should be completed within 2 weeks.

7. The client will then inform BDO of the list of candidates who have cleared the exam and training and are ready to be onboarded or deployed.

8. Accordingly, BDO will onboard the client-confirmed candidates as BDO employees, but they will be deployed at the client location. There will be a BDO induction in the first week of onboarding.

9. After the first deployment or first assignment gets over, the employee may get deployed on another project of the client.

job.name: Senior Developer Advocate, AWS Security Customer Outcomes
job.description:
Description Are you a developer who loves making security approachable and building bridges between deep technical concepts and the people who build on AWS? Do you get excited about helping external developers ship more securely without slowing them down, including the new generation building AI-powered applications? Are you passionate about growing developer communities and turning hard security problems into clear, usable guidance? If you are a natural teacher with strong technical depth and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Developer Advocate to join our AWS Security Customer Outcomes team. In this role, you will lead developer engagement focused on security, driving adoption of AWS security services and secure-by-design practices while fostering a thriving community of developers who build securely on AWS.

Your mission is to improve the security experience for external developers on AWS. You will meet developers where they are, understand the friction they hit when securing their applications and workloads, and turn that insight into content, tools, and product feedback that makes building securely the easy path. A core part of that mission is helping developers secure the AI development life cycle (AI-DLC), from how they source and handle training data to how they deploy, monitor, and guard agentic and generative AI workloads. You will also show developers how to use AI itself to accelerate security, bringing security review, threat modeling, and remediation earlier and faster into the way they build. Alongside this, you will champion open source security, contributing to and uplifting the open-source projects and tooling that developers rely on, and helping the broader community build and ship secure software supply chains. Estimated 25% travel required for the role.

Key job responsibilities

You will create engaging technical content, including tutorials, blog posts, reference architectures, and sample applications, that helps external developers secure their workloads on AWS. This includes guidance for securing AI-powered and agentic applications across the AI development life cycle, and practical examples of using AI-assisted tooling to speed up secure coding, threat modeling, and vulnerability remediation.

You will represent AWS Security at conferences, meetups, and online events, delivering technical talks and workshops that educate and inspire developers to adopt secure-by-design practices. You will gather developer feedback on security pain points, including the emerging challenges of building and securing AI systems, and feed it directly into the AWS Security product roadmap, working closely with service teams to ensure our security services and the broader platform meet real developer needs.

About The Role Data governance is one of the most critical challenges for Mixpanel's enterprise customers, and the AI era turns it into a foundational problem. Analytics and agents are only as trustworthy as the data beneath them. Poor data quality compounds: incorrect analyses spread as it becomes easier for anyone — or any agent — to query data, and the problem multiplies as customers scale into projects with high-cardinality events and fast-growing user bases. A data foundation that stays clean, consistent, and trusted is what sets Mixpanel apart.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Data Foundation team, you'll work across the stack to build high-impact features with extreme customer focus. You'll partner closely with engineers across the company, and with Design, Product, and GTM, to solve one of the hardest problems in analytics: keeping data clean, consistent, and trustworthy at scale.

The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness.
