job.description:
Numéro d’emploi : 10535

Type d’emploi : Nouveau poste

Environnement de travail : Nous offrons un environnement de travail hybride qui donne la flexibilité à nos employés d’établir un équilibre entre le travail au bureau (2 jours par semaine OU 15 heures par semaine dans un bureau de Wawanesa) et le travail à distance. Vous pouvez travailler à partir de l’un des endroits suivants : Winnipeg, MB; Wawanesa, MB; Vancouver, BC; Calgary, AB; Edmonton, AB; Lethbridge, AB; Toronto (North York), ON; Kitchener, ON; Ottawa, ON; Montréal, QC; Ville de Québec, QC; Moncton, NB; Dartmouth; NS.

Langue de travail : anglais. Ce rôle sera nécessaire pour communiquer avec les parties prenantes internes et externes partout au Canada, où la principale langue des affaires pour ce rôle est l'anglais.

Salaire : À Wawanesa, le salaire est l’un des éléments de la rémunération globale, complète et concurrentielle que nous offrons à nos employés. En plus du salaire, nos employés permanents à temps plein et à temps partiel sont admissibles à un programme incitatif annuel, à des programmes de régime complémentaire de congés et bénéficient de journées de vacances généreuses, des jours personnels, des avantages sociaux sans primes et d’un régime de retraite.

Le salaire offert est déterminé en tenant compte de divers facteurs, notamment : votre lieu de travail, les conditions du marché du travail local, les données salariales du marché externe, l’équité salariale interne, ainsi que les connaissances, les compétences, l’expérience et la maîtrise attendue du poste. Le salaire offert devrait se situer dans la fourchette suivante : 90 000 $ - 125 000 $. Les candidats ayant des attentes salariales en dehors de cette fourchette sont quand même encouragés à postuler.

À propos de la Compagnie mutuelle d’assurance Wawanesa Fondée en 1896, La Compagnie mutuelle d’assurance Wawanesa est l’une des plus importantes compagnies du genre au Canada. Elle est détenue entièrement par ses plus de 1,8 million de membres. Ayant son siège social à Winnipeg, Wawanesa est la société mère de WSIMC, une compagnie d’assurance spécialisée qui offre des solutions sur mesure et fondées sur des besoins particuliers; de Wawanesa Vie, qui fournit des solutions en matière d’assurance vie partout au Canada; et de Western Financial Group, un fournisseur de premier plan à l’échelle nationale en assurance des particuliers et des entreprises.

Wawanesa s’engage à aider les communautés à prospérer dans un monde en constante évolution. La Compagnie soutient activement des organismes qui renforcent les communautés, en faisant don de plus de 4 millions de dollars par an à des organismes caritatifs, dont 2,5 millions de dollars chaque année pour soutenir les personnes en première ligne de la lutte contre le changement climatique. Pour en savoir plus, consultez wawanesa.com.

job.name: Senior Software Developer
job.description:
Founded in 2017, TripArc is a $750 million privately held company powers the top Travel Agencies and Tour Operators in North America. Our expansive and growing network empowers seamless access to a comprehensive range of travel options and services globally with over $750 million transactions annually - all at the industry’s best rates.

As an industry leader in technology, purchasing, finance, HR and marketing, we know how to deliver solutions to travel professionals in the most effective way possible. With deep experience in partnering with two leading brands in the luxury travel space – Kensington Tours and Travel Edge – TripArc has real insight into the needs of tour operators and travel agencies today.

TripArc’s goals are simple. To make our network of over 1400 travel entities more profitable, efficient and help them create truly unique travel for their clients.

This is a hybrid position, currently requiring a minimum of two days per week onsite at our office located at 2 Queen St. E in Toronto, ON. The Role TripArc's travel booking platforms are used every day by thousands of travel professionals to plan, price, book, and manage trips for their clients. We're re-envisioning them as a single AI-powered platform.

We're hiring a Sr. Software Developer for Trip Management, which covers everything after a client says yes. You'll help build our new payments, booking, invoicing, and accounting systems, along with the advisor-facing trip dashboard and trip detail experiences on top of them. Because these systems are new, we don't have to copy how travel payments have always worked. The work spans greenfield and existing platform in equal measure: new VESA microservices and Angular MFEs, plus extending and integrating with the mature ADX booking platform while trips and travel professionals move off the legacy system. You'll know payments well enough to tell where the numbers have to be exact, and you'll help decide where AI belongs in the product. We need people who can hold both contexts without losing altitude.

You own your work end to end: design through deployment, in close collaboration with Product, QA, UX, and your pod.

How We Build We expect every developer on this team to use AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, whatever fits your flow) as a standard part of how you develop. Not as an experiment, and not as a replacement for engineering judgment. We move faster because of these tools, and we ship with confidence because of the quality gates, code review culture, and testing discipline that sit alongside them. In a money flow, that discipline matters even more. If you've figured out how to get real leverage from AI-assisted development without cutting corners on quality, you'll fit right in here.

What You'll Work On

job.name: Principal Full-Stack Developer - Platform & Infrastructure
job.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers , including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. About The Team Platform & Infrastructure keeps everything else fast, reliable and easy to build on. We own the shared services every product team builds on top of (identity, search, communication and our Pantry design system), the tooling that makes our engineers productive, and the release and runtime foundations that let us ship with confidence. Build it once, and every team benefits.

Teams You Might Join

  • Product Foundation: Identity, communication, search and Pantry, including the Integrations Marketplace, Global Search and the Pantry Design System.
  • Developer Productivity: Internal tooling and IDE plugins that make every engineer faster.
  • Release + Runtime and Testing: CI/CD, SRE, FedRAMP compliance and QA. This team leans more toward infrastructure and reliability.

What You'll Work On

  • Set the technical direction for the shared services and components that other teams depend on.
  • Design APIs, tools and design system components that other engineers want to use, and drive adoption across teams.
  • Improve the speed, safety and reliability of how we build, test and ship software.
  • Treat internal engineers as your customers: gather feedback, measure adoption and iterate.

The Role

  • Lead the design and delivery of large, ambiguous projects end to end, from planning through production.
  • Partner directly with Product Managers, Designers, Engineering leadership, and the engineers who build on your work to shape your team’s roadmap and influence the roadmaps of adjacent teams.
  • Own the long-term technical health of a platform domain: reliability, performance, and the parts of the codebase nobody notices until they break.
  • Drive architecture decisions and write the technical proposals others build against.
  • Mentor senior and staff engineers, and set the standard for code review on your team.
  • Raise the bar on tooling, testing, and delivery practices across teams, not just your own.

Read the full description

job.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role AspenTech recherche un Développeur principal talentueux et dynamique pour rejoindre notre organisation Enterprise Operations Platform (EOP). Dans ce rôle, vous ferez partie d’une équipe de développement Agile responsable de la livraison de logiciels industriels de nouvelle génération.

Cette solution fournira une plateforme flexible, définie par logiciel et centrée sur les données, permettant l’automatisation pour la clientèle diversifiée d’AspenTech.

En tant que membre de l’équipe de développement EOP, vous travaillerez sur des projets de connectivité industrielle avancée et d’informatique distribuée, permettant de faire remonter les données depuis les équipements industriels jusqu’au cloud. L’équipe se concentre sur la création de services de données hautement performants, capables de déplacer et gérer en toute sécurité d’importants volumes d’informations. Vous contribuerez à créer des solutions permettant de configurer, contextualiser, analyser et visualiser les données, afin de les rendre facilement accessibles à un large éventail d’applications. La plateforme EOP prend en charge plusieurs systèmes d’exploitation et des technologies nuagique sans serveur, offrant ainsi des opportunités de travailler avec un ensemble varié de technologies modernes.

Ce rôle aura un impact très visible sur le succès et la capacité de construire nos offres logicielles pour nos clients. Notre organisation et notre produit sont positionnés pour une croissance rapide au cours de la prochaine décennie, offrant de nombreuses opportunités d’évolution professionnelle.

Your Impact

  • Participer activement avec les membres de l’équipe au sein d’une organisation Agile à grande échelle.
  • Recevoir des directives stratégiques pour ensuitre travailler avec l’équipe pour affiner des exigences à haut niveau en user stories exploitables avec des critères d’acceptation détaillés.

Senior Full Stack Developer MaintainX is part of Autodesk and a key component of Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization bringing together Autodesk’s capabilities across the full asset lifecycle. Its mobile-first work execution platform helps industrial and frontline teams manage maintenance, assets, and day-to-day operations. Together, these solutions advance Autodesk’s strategy to connect design, make, and operate in one continuous lifecycle.

It is also where some of our newest investment is happening, including two newly formed teams building a Work Execution Platform and a rebuilt Technician Experience from scratch. If you want to work close to what customers use daily, and have a chance at green-field ownership, this is the place.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and improve the workflows customers use every day, from scheduling and parts management to reporting.
  • Solve hard product problems: dense, data-heavy interfaces, large datasets, offline behaviour and multi-site scale.
  • On our newly formed teams, shape architecture and engineering practices from the ground up.

The Role

  • Ship features end to end, from planning through production.
  • Partner directly with Product Managers and Designers to shape your team's roadmap, not just execute against it.

Our core stack is TypeScript, React, Node.js, and MySQL. Some teams use C# or Python. You don't need to already know every piece of it to apply. At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

As we build a new Ads business and evolve Marketplace into a best in class shopping experience, improving search is one of our highest leverage investments to create an experience users choose and merchants want to invest in.

job.name: Senior Software Developer
job.description:
At Range Group we believe in the power of the professional travel advisor. We represent over $4.5 billion in annual travel sales. All our investments stem from a common thesis, that travel advisors add real value to a trip. Travel advisors when equipped with technology and 24/7 support are irreplaceable. Equally important is our philanthropy. Range Foundation channels 10% of group profits to social impact. From exploration grants, improved access to education, new discoveries on sea and land, cultural infrastructure, and helping our global neighbors in times of need — we are investing to build a better future.

This is a hybrid position, currently requiring a minimum of two days per week onsite at our office located at 2 Queen St. E in Toronto, ON. The Role TripArc's travel booking platforms are used every day by thousands of travel professionals to plan, price, book, and manage trips for their clients. We're re-envisioning them as a single AI-powered platform.

We're hiring a Sr. Software Developer for Trip Management, which covers everything after a client says yes. You'll help build our new payments, booking, invoicing, and accounting systems, along with the advisor-facing trip dashboard and trip detail experiences on top of them. Because these systems are new, we don't have to copy how travel payments have always worked. The work spans greenfield and existing platform in equal measure: new VESA microservices and Angular MFEs, plus extending and integrating with the mature ADX booking platform while trips and travel professionals move off the legacy system. You'll know payments well enough to tell where the numbers have to be exact, and you'll help decide where AI belongs in the product. We need people who can hold both contexts without losing altitude.

You own your work end to end: design through deployment, in close collaboration with Product, QA, UX, and your pod.

How We Build We expect every developer on this team to use AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, whatever fits your flow) as a standard part of how you develop. Not as an experiment, and not as a replacement for engineering judgment. We move faster because of these tools, and we ship with confidence because of the quality gates, code review culture, and testing discipline that sit alongside them. In a money flow, that discipline matters even more. If you've figured out how to get real leverage from AI-assisted development without cutting corners on quality, you'll fit right in here.

What You'll Work On

job.name: AI Process Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About The Role ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.

You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale. What You’ll Be Doing

  • Deploy and prove: own the end-to-end journey from first process file to a running, measurably improving production workflow.

+ At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see.
+ At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

job.name: Lead Engineer
job.description:
The Opportunity

As a Lead Engineer you will guide the design, build, testing, and modernization of custom applications across cloud-native and on-premise environments, using modern engineering approaches, low-code platforms, and a range of programming languages. As a Manager you will lead teams, coach junior staff, manage workstreams, and use autonomous decision-making to analyze complex issues, set direction, and deliver work that aligns with client expectations and quality standards within our Advisory practice. In this role at PwC, you will support custom application development and testing efforts across the software development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through build and test, while contributing to digital products that help clients move ideas into usable technology.

Responsibilities

  • Managing project planning, budgeting, timelines, and delivery for client-facing software initiatives
  • Guiding teams through requirements analysis, solution design, coding, testing, and deployment activities
  • Reviewing application architecture, code quality, and technical documentation across multiple programming languages and low-code platforms
  • Coordinating use of CI/CD pipelines, application lifecycle management tools, and digital delivery methods to support efficient release cycles

What Sets You Apart

  • Building cloud-native, secure applications across modern stacks

  • Managing client accounts and guiding project planning
  • Mentoring junior engineers through code reviews and feedback

job.name: Software Engineer, Fullstack
job.description:
The Role

We’re looking for Software Engineers to help architect, build, and productize our AI/ML infrastructure. You'll be the bridge between research, product, customers, and engineering, driving AI adoption from strategy through production at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys owning things end to end, and wants their work to have a measurable impact on an industry that desperately needs modern infrastructure.

What You’ll Do System Architecture & Design

  • Design and evolve a modular, service-oriented architecture to power configurable healthcare workflows at scale.
  • Build a workflow orchestration engine capable of handling thousands of concurrent stateful tasks (credentialing, verification, enrollment).
  • Define and optimize integration frameworks to connect with thousands of external systems — web portals, APIs, PDFs, spreadsheets.
  • Drive reliability, auditability, and performance through observability, self-healing, and clear fault-domain boundaries.

Applied AI and Automation

  • Lead the design and deployment of AI-powered digital workers — LLM- and rules-driven agents that perform operational workflows end-to-end.
  • Evaluate AI tools, frameworks, and third-party APIs, ensuring alignment with platform goals and data protection requirements.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to discover use cases, build features, and deliver value
  • Engage with customers to understand operational challenges, validate assumptions, and iterate solutions quickly

Must-Have What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years experience building and scaling complex, distributed systems or workflow-heavy SaaS platforms.
  • Proven ability to own architecture and make high-stakes technical decisions in ambiguous, high-growth environments.
  • Deep understanding of modern cloud architecture and full software stacks.
  • Excellent communication — able to clearly explain technical trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

Preferred

  • Experience with workflow orchestration frameworks or event-driven architectures.
  • Contributions to open-source projects, publications, or active technical presence.
  • Open-source contributions, publications, or technical blog presence

You’ll Love This Role If You

  • Want to lead AI projects from idea to deployment
  • Want to own architecture, projects, and culture — not inherit them.
  • Thrive in a 0→1 environment, building from scratch and scaling from concept to production.
  • Care deeply about impact — accelerating patient access by fixing the infrastructure of healthcare.
  • Believe great products emerge from tight collaboration between product, engineering, and operations.
  • Want your work to outlast you — building systems that become part of healthcare’s invisible infrastructure.

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
About the Role: Wolters Kluwer Health has a strong foundation in trusted clinical decision support. We are extending that foundation into outcome-focused solutions that connect clinical content, data, AI, and workflow to help customers improve clinical, operational, financial, and experience outcomes.

The Forward Deployed Engineer is a product-minded, hands-on engineer who works with strategic customers and WK teams to discover high-value problems, build working solutions, validate impact, and turn repeatable patterns into scalable WK Health capabilities. The role reports into Technology and partners closely with Product. This is not a professional services, implementation delivery, or sales engineering role. It is a product-embedded engineering role that learns from real customer environments, accelerates adoption of WK Health platforms, and shapes reusable product direction across the Health division, including AI-enabled capabilities building on the momentum of our Expert AI propositions.

Job Description: The FDE owns the path from customer problem to technical proof, measured outcome, and product feedback. They build fast, practical solutions while protecting safety, security, quality, and long-term maintainability. No direct reports are expected initially; the role may lead cross-functional virtual squads or technical workstreams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Discover and Frame Outcomes

  • Work with customer executives, clinical leaders, informaticists, pharmacists, IT/data teams, and end users to understand workflows, constraints, decision points, and adoption barriers.
  • Translate ambiguous needs into outcome hypotheses, use cases, success metrics, acceptance criteria, prototypes, and implementation options anchored in measurable customer value.

Build, Integrate, and Validate

  • Design, code, integrate, test, and deploy prototypes and product extensions using WK Health assets, APIs, data, AI capabilities, and platform services.
  • Apply healthcare integration patterns where appropriate, including HL7 FHIR, SMART on FHIR, CDS Hooks, secure APIs, and cloud-native approaches.
  • Use modern engineering practices, including Spec Driven Development, automated testing, observability, secure SDLC, and AI-assisted or agentic development with human accountability.

Make Field Learning Reusable

  • Design with reuse as the default; convert field-built patterns into APIs, connectors, reference architectures, templates, evaluation harnesses, playbooks, and product backlog input.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to determine what should become a platform capability, packaged solution, roadmap priority, or retired one-off pattern.

Navigate Responsibly

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
A high-growth AI-native startup is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer in New York to work alongside their earliest enterprise customers and ship real production value in days, not quarters.

This is a role for engineers who want to be close to the customer. You’ll embed with design partners, understand their workflows in detail, and build the integrations, prototypes and production code that turn the product into something they can’t live without. Expect wide scope across the stack and direct influence over the product roadmap based on what you learn in the field.

Role: Forward Deployed Engineer

Salary: $180,000 - $300,000 plus equity

Location: New York, 5 days per week in office

What you’ll be doing:

  • Embed with enterprise customers to understand workflows, pain points and real-world constraints
  • Build custom integrations, prototypes and production features that turn pilots into committed usage
  • Ship end to end across Python, TypeScript, React and Next.js
  • Feed field insight back into product and engineering to shape the broader roadmap
  • Own problems end to end, from first customer conversation through to deployed, instrumented code
  • Use AI tooling (Claude, Cursor and similar) throughout your workflow to move fast without compromising quality
  • Partner closely with founders, product and GTM to turn customer conversations into shipped features

What you’ll need:

  • Strong commercial software engineering experience with Python, TypeScript, React and Next.js
  • Track record shipping production code end to end, ideally in a startup or early-growth environment
  • Comfortable in front of enterprise customers, able to translate business problems into technical solutions
  • Fluent in modern AI tooling (Claude, Cursor, Copilot and similar) and able to use it to materially raise your output
  • High autonomy, high ownership and the pragmatism to know what good enough looks like
  • Happy working 5 days a week in-person with a small, high-intensity team

Nice to have:

  • Prior Forward Deployed, Solutions or Applied Engineering experience
  • Exposure to AI/LLM product work or agentic systems
  • Background shipping to large enterprise users with real integration complexity

This role would suit an engineer who wants to sit at the sharp end, build with real users in the room and see their code land in production the same week.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, AI Products & Agents
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

Overview The Data Products Team within the Data Insights Group (DIG) at Paramount Global builds the internal platforms that power how the business understands streaming performance, audience behavior, and content strategy. We own the applications, APIs, and automation systems that analysts and stakeholders rely on daily.

You'll join a small team with outsized impact, working across NextJS applications, FastAPI services, and AI-powered workflows. We build and ship quickly, and the tools we create are used immediately across the organization. If you want to own products end-to-end and see your work drive decisions at scale, this is that type of role.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and build internal web applications using NextJS and FastAPI
  • Design and own backend services and REST APIs that power automation tools and AI-driven features
  • Partner with data engineers to integrate BigQuery pipelines and metadata systems into user-facing products
  • Drive features from concept through production, owning technical design, implementation, and reliability
  • Solve ambiguous problems across the stack, balancing delivery speed with maintainability
  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance
  • Define and champion engineering standards around code quality, testing, and system design
  • Shape the technical roadmap and architectural decisions as the team scales

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software development experience building internal tools or data-driven applications
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Experience architecting production web applications with React or NextJS
  • Experience designing and scaling REST APIs (FastAPI, or similar)
  • Deep knowledge with SQL and cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake), including performance optimization
  • Proven ability to own systems end-to-end: design, deployment, monitoring, and iteration
  • Experience mentoring engineers and spearheading engineering standards
  • Strong communication skills with non-technical stakeholders

job.name: Software Engineer
job.description:
A growth-stage commercial insurance business, backed by well-known VCs, rebuilding underwriting and pricing from the ground up with software and AI.

This is a full-stack engineering role building the internal platform that runs the business end to end, covering underwriting, pricing and policy workflows. You’ll work directly with actuaries and underwriters, turning messy real-world logic into clean, durable, production-grade systems. The platform is moving towards an agentic, AI-driven model, so you’ll be building at the point where insurance expertise meets software.

Role: Full-stack Software Engineer

Salary: $250,000 to $400,000 base plus competitive equity and relocation support, depending on experience

Location: New York, on-site

What you’ll be doing:

  • Build core internal infrastructure for underwriting, pricing and policy workflows
  • Work closely with actuaries and underwriters to turn complex business logic into reliable production systems
  • Help build an in-house agentic platform that automates document parsing, data extraction, pricing and terms
  • Build tools that underwriters can steer, with autonomous underwriting as the longer-term goal
  • Work across the stack, from backend services and data through to the front-end interfaces your internal users rely on
  • Choose which engineering team you join, from Pricing, Underwriting, CX and AI
  • Work alongside a PM embedded in your team
  • Learn a complex industry quickly and leave systems better than you found them
  • Take ownership of your work and act with urgency

Requirements:

  • 4 to 8 years’ experience as a full-stack or backend software engineer
  • Experience at a Pre-Seed to Series E startup
  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js
  • Python experience
  • Experience with Postgres and Redis
  • Experience with GraphQL, Apollo, React and Next.js
  • The ability to translate complex, ambiguous business logic into clean, durable systems
  • Curiosity and a real willingness to learn a complicated domain
  • Comfort working in person and in close collaboration with non-engineers

Nice to have:

  • Experience in insurance, fintech or another regulated industry
  • Experience building internal tools or workflow platforms
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs or AI agents

This role would suit a full-stack engineer with a few years of startup experience behind them who wants to build serious internal systems alongside underwriters and actuaries, and who is curious enough to get properly stuck into a complex industry.

job.name: Software Engineer, Detection
job.description:
Why Join Doppel Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. job.name: Fintech Futures - Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
Overview Money is being rewritten to run on AI agents - systems that initiate, authorize, and settle transactions with no human in the loop. The protocols that will govern that shift are being authored right now, by a small number of companies, in real time. Fintech Futures is where Intuit shows up to that table: an engineering team defining and validating the next generation of fintech integration protocols - spanning agentic payment settlement, edge AI and on-device financial intelligence, and verifiable financial trust.

This is not a proof-of-concept shop. Every solution is built against production-grade architecture, run on real Intuit data and real rails, and judged on the qualities that separate a real system from a demo: scalability under real transaction volume, security and compliance posture that can survive external review, reliability and observability once it's live, and maintainability so what graduates doesn't collapse the moment someone other than its author has to extend it. Velocity matters, because the window to shape these standards is measured in weeks and months, not years, but speed here means proving things fast and well, not proving them fast and forgettably.

Intuit holds a verified, cross-asset financial graph no payments company in the world can replicate. The capabilities this team builds - agent-initiated settlement, edge AI-driven financial agents running locally on-device, and portable verifiable trust - are how that asset becomes something agents can actually call on.

Responsibilities What You'll Do

  • Own the technical vision for a major capability area - whether that's agent-initiated settlement, edge AI-driven on-device financial agents, or portable verifiable trust - architected to hold up as the underlying standards continue to converge.
  • Lead technical design that positions Intuit's engineering work as a credible input to the industry conversation, not just an internal build.
  • Anticipate cross-system risk that spans dependencies across the portfolio, where one capability becomes the foundation others are built on.
  • Act as the connective tissue between engineering and domain/compliance stakeholders, turning technical proof points into the case for what should scale into a real product.
  • Champion strategic investment in a specific frontier technology, shaping how the broader team and Intuit's standing in the industry evolve.

Qualifications Must Haves

job.name: Full Stack Engineer - Agentic AI
job.description:
Staff Full-Stack Engineer - Agentic AI

East Bay, San Francisco Bay Area | Hybrid, 3 days a week in the office

$240K - $275K base + competitive equity | 2 openings

This role needs two things in equal measure: deep full-stack product engineering AND hands-on experience building agentic AI that real users rely on. If you have one without the other, this probably isn't the right fit - but if you have both, it's one of the most interesting briefs I've seen this year.

THE COMPANY

I'm working with a venture-backed AI company of around 200 people, fresh from a $55M Series B. They've built an AI operating system for chemical and materials R&D, used by scientists in more than 40 countries at some of the world's best-known chemical, materials and consumer brands.

The platform has two halves. The first is a system of record that holds decades of lab data, experiments, formulations and workflows that would otherwise sit in spreadsheets, notebooks and people's heads. The second is an agentic AI assistant that works on top of it: scientists ask in plain language and it plans and runs multi-step work, from finding past tested materials and checking inventory to running regressions, generating candidate formulations, comparing patents and drafting summaries straight into notebook pages. Every answer comes with a reasoning audit trail showing which tools were called and why, with permissions-aware access and versioned, governed automated actions.

It's working. In the last year, project creation grew more than 20x, the number of scientists on the platform grew 6x and workflow creation grew 4x. At one of their largest customers, over half of the formulations the AI surfaced came from projects outside the scientist's own team, and nearly 80% of recommended raw materials were new to the scientist. More than 90% of chemists there say they plan to use it regularly.

THE ROLE

They're hiring two Staff Full-Stack Engineers to merge the system of record and the agentic layer into one AI-native application, where scientists and agents work side by side in the same interface. You'll own it end to end, from the data model to the last pixel.

  • Rebuild the core application across the data model, TypeScript/NestJS backend and React frontend so that agents and people are equal users of it
  • Make every part of the UI agent-operable: views that agents can compose, fill in, add recommendations to and walk scientists through, only asking for input when it's needed
  • Design how agents act on regulated (GxP) data safely - tool calling, permissions, audit trails, versioning and human-in-the-loop approval
  • Build agentic UI generation, where interfaces are composed dynamically by agents rather than hard-coded
  • Design enterprise-grade systems: permission-based access, zero-downtime scaling and migrations with no data loss across DynamoDB, Databricks and Python services

job.name: Software Engineer I, Fullstack (Search)
job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Search has become the default way consumers discover where to shop, compare options, and decide what to buy across platforms like Google, TikTok, and even Klarna. As we build a new Ads business and evolve Marketplace into a best in class shopping experience, improving search is one of our highest leverage investments to create an experience users choose and merchants want to invest in.

What You'll Do

  • With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals.
  • You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade-offs related to your work.
  • You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime.
  • You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities.

What We Look For

  • You have previous work or internship experience working with Javascript/Typescript.
  • You have previous work or internship experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale and are experienced using Python or Kotlin.
  • You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
  • You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $130,000 - $180,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
A high-growth AI-native startup is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer in San Francisco to work alongside their earliest enterprise customers and ship real production value in days, not quarters.

This is a role for engineers who want to be close to the customer. You’ll embed with design partners, understand their workflows in detail, and build the integrations, prototypes and production code that turn the product into something they can’t live without. Expect wide scope across the stack and direct influence over the product roadmap based on what you learn in the field.

Role: Forward Deployed Engineer

Salary: $180,000 - $300,000 plus equity

Location: San Francisco, 5 days per week in office

What you’ll be doing:

  • Embed with enterprise customers to understand workflows, pain points and real-world constraints
  • Build custom integrations, prototypes and production features that turn pilots into committed usage
  • Ship end to end across Python, TypeScript, React and Next.js
  • Feed field insight back into product and engineering to shape the broader roadmap
  • Own problems end to end, from first customer conversation through to deployed, instrumented code
  • Use AI tooling (Claude, Cursor and similar) throughout your workflow to move fast without compromising quality
  • Partner closely with founders, product and GTM to turn customer conversations into shipped features

What you’ll need:

  • Strong commercial software engineering experience with Python, TypeScript, React and Next.js
  • Track record shipping production code end to end, ideally in a startup or early-growth environment
  • Comfortable in front of enterprise customers, able to translate business problems into technical solutions
  • Fluent in modern AI tooling (Claude, Cursor, Copilot and similar) and able to use it to materially raise your output
  • High autonomy, high ownership and the pragmatism to know what good enough looks like
  • Happy working 5 days a week in-person with a small, high-intensity team

Nice to have:

  • Prior Forward Deployed, Solutions or Applied Engineering experience
  • Exposure to AI/LLM product work or agentic systems
  • Background shipping to large enterprise users with real integration complexity

This role would suit an engineer who wants to sit at the sharp end, build with real users in the room and see their code land in production the same week.

job.name: Senior Backend Engineer
job.description:
About The Company Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

About The Role Industrious's Growth Engineering team owns every customer-facing surface we build: the member portal, the mobile app, the public site, for a member base growing alongside 100+ new locations this year. This Senior Backend Engineer seat is backend-leaning, genuinely full-stack, and comes with early access to the decisions that shape what gets built, not just how. You'll own production systems real members rely on every day, and design real AI agentic systems, agents, MCP servers, and the guardrails that keep them safe in production, not just use AI coding tools day to day.

You'll join a team of five to six, reporting to our Growth Engineering Manager. Code ships often here, you'll see the result of your work in the product within days, not quarters, at a company that's profitable, CBRE-backed, and still scaling fast.

What Might Your Day Look Like It's Wednesday, Hub Day, so you're in our New York HQ with the rest of the local team. Standup surfaces a reservation-access bug: a member's on-demand booking isn't unlocking their room. You trace it through a Kafka event that never fired, patch the service, and ship the fix before lunch.

In the afternoon you sit down with Product and Design to look at the next iteration of the credit-expansion feature, the one that lets members book new locations with their existing credits. You flag a data-modeling tradeoff nobody had considered, sketch two approaches, and the three of you land on one together, before a single ticket gets written.

Later, you pick up a small frontend fix on the member portal. It's not glamorous, but it's yours to own like everything else here.

What You Will Own

job.name: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

Job summary

This position is for the SSL Store, powered by DigiCert

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, TLS and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. The platform is a TypeScript monorepo: Fastify and Express services, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL and Redis, queues and workers on AWS, deployed to Kubernetes through Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps pipelines. It also carries a legacy .NET estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of AI-assisted features and internal tooling.

You will own features end to end, from schema and API through UI, pipeline, and production. We work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before

What you will do

  • Design, build, and ship features across the full stack: Fastify or Express APIs, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL schemas and migrations, SQS-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them.
  • Own services in production: observability with Sentry and Grafana, on-call participation, incident root-causing, and the follow-through fixes.
  • Build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter.
  • Maintain and incrementally retire legacy .NET and Python components, moving behavior into the TypeScript platform with parity verified rather than assumed.
  • Extend CI/CD and infrastructure: Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker images, Helm charts, and Terraform for EKS, RDS, SQS, and related AWS services.
  • Integrate third-party and partner APIs (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build AI-backed features where they genuinely improve the product.
  • Review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and AI-generated code alike.
  • Mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room.

What you will have

job.name: Senior Backend Engineer
job.description:
About Edia Edia is the leading AI technology company in K-12 education, helping 1M+ students across the U.S. have an exceptional experience in school.

About The Role We're seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to join our team and help scale our Node.js applications on AWS. This role is different from a traditional engineering position: we've fully embraced AI-assisted development, and we expect most code to be written by AI tools. Your job is to direct that process effectively.

You'll work across our entire product suite and internal tools, building robust systems that serve educators and students while also using AI to automate our business operations.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and oversee backend systems across our product lineup and internal tooling
  • Guide AI coding assistants to implement large-scale changes and new features
  • Review, debug, and refine AI-generated code to production standards
  • Use AI internally to automate business operations
  • Ship full-stack features end-to-end

What We're Looking For Essential skills:

  • Fast at reading code, human or AI generated
  • Strong debugging skills and an eye for bugs
  • Capacity to envision large architectural changes and break them into steps an AI can execute
  • Ability to context switch and juggle multiple in flight tasks
  • Experience with Node.js and cloud infrastructure (AWS, containers, managed databases)

What sets you apart:

  • You think at systems scale
  • You're effective at communicating intent to AI tools and iterating on their output
  • You have good judgment about when to accept AI suggestions and when to push back
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can take ownership of loosely-defined problems

Nice to have:

Why This Role Is Different We're not looking for someone who wants to write every line of code themselves. We're looking for someone who can leverage AI to move faster than traditional development allows, while maintaining the quality and reliability our school district partners depend on. If you're excited about working at the frontier of how software gets built, we'd love to hear from you.

Work Authorization: We are currently unable to sponsor or transfer work authorization for all jobs. If things change in the future, we'll be sure to update this section.

We appreciate your interest in Edia. Feel free to follow us on LinkedIn to learn more about what we're doing to improve education outcomes in the US.

Compensation Range: $180K - $250K

About the Company

Bonterra

About the Role

Bonterra is looking for an AI-first Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and ship software by orchestrating AI coding agents across the full development lifecycle. This role is intentionally language and stack agnostic: rather than being defined by expertise in a single programming language, the ideal candidate uses AI tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) to work productively across whatever languages, frameworks, and systems a given team needs, from backend services and APIs to front-end applications, data pipelines, and infrastructure automation. You will take ownership of complex technical problems end to end, using AI as a force multiplier for planning, implementation, testing, and review, while retaining full engineering accountability for the quality, security, and reliability of everything you and your agents ship.

Responsibilities

AI-ORCHESTRATED SOFTWARE DELIVERY (45%)

  • Designs, builds, tests, and ships production-quality features and services end to end, using AI coding agents to plan, scaffold, implement, and validate work throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Selects the language, framework, and architecture best suited to each problem, using AI assisted tooling enables productive work across many stacks (for example, TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#, Go, Ruby, PHP, or SQL/PL-SQL).

TECHNICAL DESIGN & SYSTEM OWNERSHIP (20%)

  • Owns complex technical challenges from design through delivery, authoring technical design documents and proposing architecture that other engineers, and AI agents, can build against.
  • Evaluates tradeoffs between build speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability, and makes sound engineering decisions under ambiguity.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION (15%)

job.name: Senior Product Manager
job.description:
On-site | Vancouver Office – 675 W Hastings St.

Our Mission

Our mission is to amplify human success with AI automation.

In a dental lab, that means technicians spend less time on repetitive casework and more on the complex cases that need real skill, and labs take on volume they used to turn away. We automate the parts of the job nobody wants. We don't pretend that's the whole job.

Our vision is to become the operating system of the dental industry. Not a tool a lab logs into. The system a lab runs on.

The Problem We're Solving

A dental lab loses hours every week to a question that shouldn't need asking: where is that case? Orders arrive from a dozen different manufacturer portals, and chasing them down has always been somebody's job.

The Command Center ends that. It gives a lab full visibility of every case — what arrived, what stage it's at, what's stuck and why — updating continuously, in one place. Your job is to build the next generation of it around the way a lab actually works.

Why EviSmart

  • 300 people. Two hubs: Vancouver HQ and Manila operations.
  • 145% year-over-year SaaS growth.
  • 28 countries. One platform. The dental industry's operating system.
  • An in-house AI model research and development team building proprietary intelligence.

Why This Role Exists

A lab isn't one job. It's designers, technicians, quality control, case managers, shipping, the owner — each with a different week and a different definition of what matters today. Full visibility means something different to each of them. The next generation of Command Centers has to be built around how those roles actually work. No written definition exists yet of what the next version of the Command Center must contain, what's optional, or what disqualifies one from shipping.

You write that definition, and you write it from inside dental labs. Then you hold it, while everything else gets built against it.

What You'll Own

job.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

NVIDIA's world-leading hardware relies on design exploration beyond the limits of conventional tools. Our team develops highly optimized internal EDA technology by combining novel algorithms, parallel computing, machine learning, and high-performance C++.

We are seeking a Senior Software R&D Engineer to invent the next generation of detailed physical design algorithms, with a focus on ECO routing and physical optimization. These algorithms sit at the core of applications spanning extreme timing and power optimization, incremental logic synthesis, metal ECOs, precision clock-tree tuning, and high-speed interconnect.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop incremental physical-design technology that can rapidly implement high-performance logic changes with DRC and parasitic awareness, including for both all-layer and metal-only ECOs.
  • Invent improved detailed-routing algorithms for the intricate mix of discrete and continuous optimization problems arising from DRC constraints in the latest manufacturing processes.
  • Help craft cross-domain optimization tools that simultaneously consider logic, timing, clocks, testability, power distribution, placement, along with routing and DRCs to push the frontier of computing performance.
  • Own problems end-to-end—from algorithm invention through implementation, validation, and production deployment.

What We Need To See

  • MS, PhD, or equivalent experience, with 5+ years of relevant experience.
  • Strong expertise in C++, high-performance software architecture and algorithm development, including complexity, data structures, and memory efficiency.
  • Deep understanding of detailed routing, including advanced design rules, pin access, route optimization, and DRC-aware implementation.
  • Understanding of areas often impacted and co-optimized with ECOs, including clock distribution, DFT, and power delivery.
  • Authorization to work on export controlled data arising in CPUs, GPUs, LPUs, and communication networks.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Familiarity with logic and physical co-optimization principles, including logic restructuring, technology mapping, and using SAT solvers.
  • Experience with related physical-design areas such as placement, legalization, and IR drop reduction.
  • Experience applying LLMs, reinforcement learning, GNNs, or other machine-learning techniques to physical design, combinatorial optimization, or algorithm-performance tuning.

Are you passionate about tackling innovative algorithms that enable the fastest, most efficient AI hardware? We have the scale, compute resources, and direct collaboration with hardware teams that make that possible!

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Compiler Engineer
job.description:
NVIDIA is dedicated to reinvent accelerated computing. Reinvention requires great technology and amazing people. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is hiring a Senior Compiler Engineer to join our team driving the next generation of GPU systems programming. We are redefining how developers write high-performance GPU software by bringing the safety, expressiveness, and modern tooling of Rust to native GPU and CUDA development. On this team, you will build cutting-edge compiler pipelines, custom intermediate representation (IR) frameworks, and JIT compilation systems that bridge host and device execution—allowing developers to write memory-safe, high-performance GPU kernels in idiomatic Rust.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop Rust-to-GPU Compiler Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain custom compiler backends (such as rustc codegen backends and proc-macros) and Rust-native intermediate representation (IR) frameworks to compile standard Rust directly to high-performance CUDA PTX and machine code.
  • Build compiler IRs and Optimizers: Work with modern compiler architectures to lower Rust AST and MIR into IRs including MLIR, PTX, and LLVM, including GPU-specific optimizations.
  • Support complex ahead-of-time, just-in-time, and link time optimization workflows: Build state-of-the-art tooling to support users targeting a broad family of NVIDIA GPUs, host platforms, and feature sets.
  • Define Safe Parallel Abstractions: Architect innovative compiler-enforced safety models that extend Rust's ownership, borrowing, and lifetime disciplines across the GPU launch boundary—preventing data races and enforcing memory safety during asynchronous GPU execution.
  • Expose Next-Gen Hardware Features: Implement type-safe, ergonomic device-side abstractions in Rust for low-level GPU hardware primitives, including shared memory, barriers, scoped atomics, Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), and warp/cluster-level operations.
  • Build the future: Supporting today’s accelerated computing applications is not sufficient. We have to build composable building blocks for others around us to build the applications of tomorrow.

What We Need To See

job.name: Sr. Engineering Manager, AI on Sensor (Hybrid)
job.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

*About The Role:* CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

job.name: Senior Design Verification Engineer - Neuromorphic Computing
job.description:
Job Details Job Description:

The Opportunity For nearly a decade, Intel's Neuromorphic Computing Lab-together with a global ecosystem of 250+ research groups-has explored architectures, algorithms, and software inspired by the brain's extraordinary efficiency, scalability, and adaptability. Our Loihi series of research chips pioneered event-driven, sparse, and massively parallel neuro-inspired processing, fueling over 100 peer-reviewed publications that validate the promise of this novel approach.

Now, we're entering an exciting new chapter: transforming these breakthroughs into real-world products that will power the coming era of physical AI systems-beyond the reach of GPUs and mainstream AI accelerators.

If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of computing, from transistor-level innovation to software abstractions, join us. Help define the next wave of AI technology that harnesses the proven advantages of Intel's neuromorphic computing technology with the versatility demanded by modern AI workloads.

Position Overview We are seeking experienced pre-silicon verification engineers who are passionate about driving innovation at the intersection of advanced semiconductor technologies, physical AI and next-generation computing architectures. As a member of Intel's neuromorphic silicon team, you will develop and scale verification methodologies spanning software, RTL, and emulation platforms to validate these novel architectures.

This role requires a full-stack verification mindset. You will create application-driven workloads using high-level software APIs while also developing robust HDL-based verification environments that ensure correctness at the lowest levels of hardware implementation. Working closely with architecture, design, and software teams, you will help drive verification strategies that enable first-pass silicon success.

An openness to learning new technologies and methodologies, such as asynchronous design techniques and AI-driven verification automation, is essential.

Responsibilities

  • Mapping application-level requirements to unit- and system-level test plans.
  • Write Python-based directed and random tests for design partitions and chip-level.
  • Running regressions, debugging test failures, tracking coverage and working with designers to fix failures and improve coverage.
  • Maintaining assertions, scoreboards and any tools/flows that are developed.
  • Integrating VIPs and coordinating with IP teams to ensure protocol requirements are met.

job.name: ASIC Developer
job.description:
Grow with us About this opportunity: Design Verification Engineer – AI & Agentic Workflows Austin, Texas Design Verification Engineer ASIC, SoC & FPGA Verification

Build the Verification Foundation for Next-Generation Custom Silicon

Ericsson Silicon is looking for an innovative, results-driven Design Verification Engineer to architect, verify, and scale the custom IPs, ASICs, SoCs, and FPGA-based platforms powering next-generation communications infrastructure and Layer 1 accelerators.

In this role, you won't just build traditional testbenches—you will pioneer and leverage AI-driven verification methodologies and agentic workflows to supercharge test generation, automate complex debug loops, and accelerate coverage closure. You will work closely with architects, RTL designers, emulation teams, and system engineers to identify issues early, reduce tapeout cycles, and deliver exceptionally high-quality custom silicon.

This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on complex designs spanning OSI Layer 1 Accelerators, custom baseband DSPs, AI/ML inference blocks, RISC-V/ARM cores, and high-speed multi-gigabit interfaces.

What You’ll Do Define Verification Strategies: Spearhead verification plans, environments, and schedules for complex Layer 1 accelerator ASICs, SoCs, and FPGA platforms.

Architect Reusable UVM Environments: Build advanced, highly reusable UVM-based verification environments using SystemVerilog, integrated with LLM-assisted test generation and intelligent stimulus models.

Deploy Agentic Workflows: Utilize and help develop AI agentic frameworks (e.g., LLM agents integrated into CI/CD pipelines) to autonomously triage regression failures, draft test sequences, and parse complex log files.

Drive Coverage Closure with ML: Drive functional, code, and assertion coverage closure utilizing machine learning-guided constrained-random and formal verification techniques.

Automate & Optimize CI/CD Pipelines: Build and maintain intelligent verification infrastructure using Python, Tcl, shell scripting, Jenkins, Git, and AI-augmented CI/CD automation pipelines.

Multi-Environment Validation: Verify RTL and gate-level designs seamlessly across software simulation, hardware emulation, FPGA prototyping, and post-silicon environments.

Advanced Debug & Root Cause Analysis: Leverage AI-assisted log analysis and pattern recognition tools to debug intricate issues across RTL, gate-level netlists, and hardware-software co-simulation platforms.

Interface & Protocol Verification: Validate performance and functionality across custom Ericsson-Proprietary Interfaces, AMBA, PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and high-speed SerDes.

Methodology Innovation: Actively contribute to Ericsson Silicon’s verification methodology evolution, embedding generative AI and automation tools into daily workflows to optimize KPIs.

job.name: Sr Applied Scientist, Embedded Battery Algorithms, Energy Storage
job.description:
Description Do you want to write the algorithms that control next-generation batteries, and shape the future of energy storage? This role sits where electrochemistry, data/ML, and control theory meet. You will develop the physics-informed and data-driven methods that estimate state of charge, health, power capability, and remaining life, and validate them against lab and fleet data until they are ready to ship. Your algorithms will decide how hard a battery can be pushed, when it needs attention, and how long it will last, so they shape the safety, warranty, and economics of the whole product. You will work side by side with cell, systems, and software engineers, and as an early hire you will help define how we develop and validate battery algorithms.

This role can be based in Boston, Irvine, Sunnyvale, or Seattle, and involves occasional domestic and international travel, up to 10% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

  • Develop and own algorithms for state of charge, state of health, power capability, and remaining useful life, combining physics-based models with data-driven and estimation methods.
  • Deliver validated reference implementations, test vectors, and accuracy targets that define what production code must achieve.
  • Design the test plans and data needed to develop and validate algorithms, working with the cell and testing teams to turn lab and field data into model improvements.
  • Analyze algorithm performance across the deployed fleet, find where models drift or fail, and drive improvements.
  • Own the accuracy and robustness of battery algorithms, and sign off that production implementations match the validated reference. Provide algorithm evidence for safety certification.

A day in the life

Your week moves between data, models, and experiments. One day you might be working out why a health estimate drifts on cells that have aged in the field, and the next deciding which model structure holds accuracy at cold temperatures. You could be designing a test with the cell team to expose a behavior your model misses, or reviewing an implementation with an applied scientist to confirm that what ships matches what you validated. You will regularly share results with software, systems, and cell leaders, and your findings will shape decisions well beyond the algorithm itself.

About The Team We are building Amazon's energy storage capability, providing power for advanced technologies while contributing to a stable grid. Our product is highly connected, yet secure and resilient by design. We own it end to end, from software, ML, and controls through system design to cell selection and supply, and on to a safety-certified product in the field. The organization operates like a startup inside Amazon: small, fast-moving, and accountable for our decisions. We work across hardware, software, and science, with suppliers and partners worldwide, and with Amazon infrastructure, procurement, legal, and finance.

*👋 You* Curious about who thrives at Whatnot? We’ve found that low ego, a growth mindset, and leaning into action and high impact goes a long way here.

job.name: Principal AI Model Security Researcher
job.description:
Overview Microsoft Security is seeking a Principal AI Model Security Researcher to join a new red team spanning adversarial machine learning, model integrity, offensive security, automation and privacy. You will conduct hands-on red teaming of advanced AI models and the training and evaluation systems around them; design attacks that expose exploitable model behavior; and turn critical findings into durable improvements such as regression evaluations, adversarial environments, stronger controls and safety training data.

These are roles for researchers who can move between scientific investigation and operational security work. Success requires depth in adversarial machine learning or offensive security, fluency across the broader AI system, and the judgment to produce reproducible evidence that research, engineering, product and independent review teams can act on.

Work Location: Redmond, WA (preferred). Remote work within the United States will be considered for highly qualified candidates.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Responsibilities

  • Design and execute white-box attacks against advanced AI models, checkpoints, post-training systems, reward functions, data pipelines and evaluation environments.
  • Investigate adversarial behavior including jailbreaks, harmful permissiveness, reward hacking, deceptive behavior, capability elicitation, privacy leakage, data poisoning and model supply-chain compromise.
  • Build high-fidelity experiments and automated attack suites that reproduce realistic threats and run continuously against new checkpoints and system configurations.
  • Develop rigorous threat models, attack hypotheses and reproducible evidence; assess severity, exploitability and customer or governance impact.
  • Partner with model scientists, engineers and product security teams to identify root causes and drive findings to verified remediation.
  • Convert confirmed weaknesses into regression evaluations, adversarial training or RL environments, safety training data and stronger technical controls.
  • Communicate findings and residual risk clearly to technical teams, leadership and independent reviewers.

Qualifications Required Qualifications:

  • Doctorate in relevant field AND 3+ years related research experience

+ OR Master's Degree in relevant field AND 4+ years related research experience

  • OR Bachelor's Degree in relevant field AND 6+ years related research experience

The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services.   • Execute the top-connector backlog, including connectors such as M365, ServiceNow, and Salesforce, and offer them to Directories as distributed, governed assets without duplicate builds.
  • Partner with data platform and engineering teams to deliver secure, governed access to structured, unstructured, analytical, and real-time data in line with firm data policy.

job.name: Sr. Software Engineer II, AI on Sensor – Mac, Linux, or Windows (Hybrid)
job.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

*About The Role:* CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

This is a Sr. Software Development Engineer II (SDE) role in the CTIO team that is bringing multiple AI-based strategies together into an integrated capability on our next-generation sensor (lightweight agent) across macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms. The Sr. SDEs in the team own the design and development of the features that put AI on the endpoint: operationalizing machine learning models inside the sensor, building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on-device inference, and integrating those capabilities with the core sensor features. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking, and many are built with shared components across platforms. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently.
