job.name: AI Engineering
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

AI Engineering

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows.

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development.

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis’s product-platform strategy.

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities.

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives.

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations.

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks.

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return.

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions.

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration.

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns.

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management.

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability.

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows.

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities.

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance.

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools.

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes.

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience.

job.description:
Job Description Are you a software engineer who is excited by the challenge of building both embedded firmware and user-facing applications that power industrial automation systems? Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you.

We are looking for curious, motivated engineers who enjoy working across the full software stack, from real-time controller firmware running on Linux and VxWorks RTOS to workstation applications used by engineers to configure, program, visualize, and manage industrial automation systems. Based in Austin, Texas, you will join a diverse community and work as a contributing member of a cross-functional Agile team focused on the development of Emerson's PACSystems technologies.

PACSystems is trusted by leading companies across discrete and hybrid manufacturing industries to safely and reliably control critical processes. In this role, you will contribute to both the embedded controller platform and the engineering software tools that interact with PACSystems controllers. You will contribute to the design and development of next-generation PACSystems software capabilities across embedded and workstation layers. Our work includes C and C++ software development, real-time distributed computing, Linux and VxWorks RTOS environments, workstation application development, and systems where timing, reliability, usability, and predictable behavior are critical. Our team also embraces modern development practices, including automated testing, AI-assisted development, and spec-driven methods that improve quality and reduce ambiguity.

You will be part of an organization led by leaders who are deeply committed to technical excellence, Agile principles, mentorship, and building an environment where engineers do their best work. job.name: Principal Engineer, AI Acceleration
job.description:
Job Description About Us Core IT is responsible for delivering and maintaining the technology, platforms, and services that help teams across GM do their best work. We support product, design, engineering, manufacturing, operations, and corporate functions by improving the tools, workflows, and technology experiences they rely on every day. Our goal is to provide secure, reliable, and seamless technology that helps employees spend less time navigating friction and more time solving the problems that matter most in their domains.

The Role At General Motors, we are using AI to simplify how work gets done—reducing manual effort, removing friction, and helping engineers and business teams focus on higher-value outcomes.

As a Principal Engineer, AI Acceleration, you will identify high-leverage opportunities, then design, build, and scale AI-powered tools that measurably improve how people work. You will operate at the intersection of software engineering, AI/LLM capabilities, product thinking, and organizational change. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. This isn’t a research or advisory role. You’ll ship tools people use every day and aim for step changes of 10x to 100x, not incremental gains.

For example, our design team’s brand guidelines live in Figma. Instead of maintaining static templates, we built an AI skill that reads the guidelines directly, drafts on-brand presentations, and runs a linter that catches off-brand choices. Work that took days now takes minutes, and the guidelines stay the single source of truth. You’d find and build the next dozen of these.

You will work directly with product, design, engineering, manufacturing, operations, and corporate-function teams to understand the problems behind the requests. You will move quickly from discovery and prototyping to production-quality solutions, while maintaining appropriate standards for security, privacy, reliability, responsible AI, and supportability.

The right person is comfortable creating clarity where there is no specification, switching between executive-level strategy and technical implementation, and measuring success by outcomes.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
job.description:
About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; New York City; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington D.C.; Toronto, Canada

About The Role Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. These Kubernetes platforms are purpose-built from the ground up and run on bare metal Linux in different regions around the world. The scale we work at involves tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of network traffic. The team takes pride in knowing this platform helps run parts of the global Internet.

As an engineer on the Kubernetes platform team, you'll be building the tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. Our mission is to provide a reliable and flexible platform to help product teams release new software efficiently and safely. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities.

Responsibilities

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

This role will define and deliver production-oriented solutions that connect AMD CPUs, GPUs, DPUs, networking, memory, and software platforms with the operating systems, databases, runtimes, APIs, developer frameworks, and cloud-native services customers use to build and operate modern infrastructure.

The role will bridge AMD architecture and the broader open ecosystem by creating reference architectures, upstream integrations, reusable software components, validated deployment patterns, and early customer proof-of-concepts. Primary focus areas include Linux and other operating-system kernels, runtime and system services, database and data-platform enablement, API layers, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, container and orchestration environments, observability, security, and performance engineering.

Working across AMD + AMD (A+A) and AMD + NVIDIA (A+N) environments and leveraging ROCm™, AMD Zen Software Studio, AMD Enterprise AI, open-source projects, industry standards, and upstream communities, this leader will make AMD platforms easier to adopt, integrate, operate, and optimize. AI is one supported workload domain—particularly inference, retrieval, developer tooling, and data-intensive services—but the role is fundamentally centered on open systems integration and solution engineering.

As a recognized technical authority, this individual will collaborate with silicon architecture, product engineering, software organizations, customers, hyperscalers, ISVs, standards bodies, and open-source communities. The role will influence AMD hardware and software roadmaps through implementation evidence, workload analysis, ecosystem gaps, customer requirements, and measurable improvements in compatibility, performance, scalability, security, manageability, and developer experience.

This is a highly technical, hands-on individual contributor role focused on architecture, integration, implementation, performance engineering, and ecosystem leadership. It is not a people management, program management, or alliance management position.

job.name: Remote Backend Engineer (Python/FastAPI)
job.description:
About Us:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Ideal Background:

This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree.

Project Overview:

As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

  • Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go.
  • Evaluate and refine AI-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance AI-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks.
  • Build agents and automated verification tools in Python that can verify the quality of code and identify error patterns.
  • Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them.
  • Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task.

job.name: Remote Python/Typescript Full Stack Engineer
job.description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world's leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

About the Role:

We're looking for a high-taste engineer with a strong eye for quality — someone who's worked hands-on with preference data and rubric creation, and knows what separates a good example from a great one. You communicate clearly and can synthesize complex technical work the way a strong MAI dev would: concise, structured, and easy for others to act on. You're comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and default to shipping over deliberating.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • Design, refine, and iterate on rubrics and evaluation criteria for preference data
  • Review and label data with a high bar for quality, catching subtle issues others might miss
  • Build and maintain pipelines/infra that support data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows
  • Synthesize findings from data work into clear write-ups, updates, or recommendations for the team
  • Collaborate closely with researchers/engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes

Required Skills:

  • Proficiency in Python (especially building/maintaining pipelines and infra) or Typescript (experience contributing to or navigating large codebases like VSCode a plus)
  • Hands-on experience with preference data collection and/or rubric creation
  • Strong written and verbal communication — able to distill technical work into clear, actionable summaries
  • Demonstrated high-taste judgment — able to articulate why something is good, not just that it is.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

Engagement Details:

  • Compensation: Market rate. Please share a specific rate expectation (rather than a range) so we can quickly assess mutual fit
  • Availability: 40 hours/week preferred, with a minimum 6-hour overlap with Pacific Time. If you're unable to commit to 40 hours, please share your available hours and overlap window
  • Employment Type: Independent contractor (does not include medical or paid leave benefits
  • Duration: 3 months, with an expected start date as soon as possible

Evaluation Process (approximately 30 mins):

  • One round of interview (30 mins of technical & cultural discussion)

job.name: Senior Developer Advocate, AWS Security Customer Outcomes
job.description:
Description Are you a developer who loves making security approachable and building bridges between deep technical concepts and the people who build on AWS? Do you get excited about helping external developers ship more securely without slowing them down, including the new generation building AI-powered applications? Are you passionate about growing developer communities and turning hard security problems into clear, usable guidance? If you are a natural teacher with strong technical depth and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Developer Advocate to join our AWS Security Customer Outcomes team. In this role, you will lead developer engagement focused on security, driving adoption of AWS security services and secure-by-design practices while fostering a thriving community of developers who build securely on AWS.

Your mission is to improve the security experience for external developers on AWS. You will meet developers where they are, understand the friction they hit when securing their applications and workloads, and turn that insight into content, tools, and product feedback that makes building securely the easy path. A core part of that mission is helping developers secure the AI development life cycle (AI-DLC), from how they source and handle training data to how they deploy, monitor, and guard agentic and generative AI workloads. You will also show developers how to use AI itself to accelerate security, bringing security review, threat modeling, and remediation earlier and faster into the way they build. Alongside this, you will champion open source security, contributing to and uplifting the open-source projects and tooling that developers rely on, and helping the broader community build and ship secure software supply chains. Estimated 25% travel required for the role.

Key job responsibilities

You will create engaging technical content, including tutorials, blog posts, reference architectures, and sample applications, that helps external developers secure their workloads on AWS. This includes guidance for securing AI-powered and agentic applications across the AI development life cycle, and practical examples of using AI-assisted tooling to speed up secure coding, threat modeling, and vulnerability remediation.

You will represent AWS Security at conferences, meetups, and online events, delivering technical talks and workshops that educate and inspire developers to adopt secure-by-design practices. You will gather developer feedback on security pain points, including the emerging challenges of building and securing AI systems, and feed it directly into the AWS Security product roadmap, working closely with service teams to ensure our security services and the broader platform meet real developer needs.

Read the full description

job.name: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer, ServiceNow
job.description:
At Deloitte, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) don't just build AI solutions, they help clients turn AI ambition into enterprise-scale impact, pairing leading class engineering with pod-based delivery and vertical expertise. If you thrive at the intersection of product, engineering, problem-solving, and client impact, this role puts you at the forefront of AI transformations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do As a Lead ServiceNow FDE, you will serve as the senior practitioner-leader embedded directly with our most strategic clients, leading forward-deployed engineering pods that develop and deploy GenAI solutions into production for Deloitte's most strategic clients. You'll set technical direction, remove delivery blockers, and stay hands-on; designing, reviewing, and debugging systems with the team. You'll translate engineering trade-offs into clear decisions for client leaders when needed. Your ability to influence decisions at the C-suite level, while maintaining hands-on technical credibility, is what sets you apart. Pods under your leadership may be deployed onshore with clients or in hybrid onshore/offshore configurations, leveraging Deloitte's global delivery capability to maximize speed and scale.

Client Engagement

  • Serve as the senior client-facing presence, building trusted advisor relationships as the senior engineering partner for client product, data, and platform leaders
  • Lead executive-level discovery, define success metrics (quality, latency, cost, adoption, risk) and a phased plan from prototype to production and scaling
  • Navigate organizational complexity and influence to align executive sponsors, IT leadership, and business owners around a shared vision
  • Represent Deloitte's FDE capability in client pursuits, executive briefings, and platform partner engagements-contributing to pipeline development and deal shaping.

Cross-Functional Pod Leadership & Program Governance

  • Lead FDE pods of 2-5 onshore anchored and offshore supported engineers, owning execution, resource management, escalations and overall delivery health
  • Enforce delivery standards across the pod: sprint cadences, stakeholder communication plans, risk management, and quality gates
  • Coordinate multi-pod or multi-workstream engagements, ensuring reliable architecture and consistent client experience.
  • Mentor and develop junior FDEs

As the Principal Salesforce Architect, you will own the architecture, strategic direction, and long-term evolution of an enterprise-wide Salesforce ecosystem supporting patient services, commercial operations, and marketing. You will design an integrated, scalable platform that connects multiple Salesforce clouds with external data sources and business systems.   • Design enterprise data models, Salesforce organization strategies, sharing and security frameworks, and master data approaches that support scalability, performance, and reporting.
  • Establish and maintain platform governance, including architecture reviews, design standards, environment management, release processes, and change control.
  • Ensure that technical solutions meet healthcare and life sciences compliance requirements, collaborating with Compliance, Quality, and IT Security teams.
  • Work with Patient Hub, Commercial, Marketing, Medical, Market Access, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into technical requirements, solution designs, and delivery plans.
  • Develop and maintain multi-year architecture roadmaps aligned with business objectives, product launches, and patient needs.
  • Evaluate the feasibility, cost, and risks of new initiatives, Salesforce capabilities, third-party applications, and AppExchange solutions.

Do you have strong opinions about what great agentic tooling looks like, formed from real experience shipping with it? We're a growing team looking for a passionate and experienced Software Engineer. In this role, you'll help define and build the next generation of our agentic platform, orchestrating the latest AI models and harnesses in service of company-wide developer productivity. You'll lead through excellent contributions to the ESAI codebase, advocate best practices for agentic development, and forge technical and mission-based partnerships with other teams across Microsoft working on related problems.

If you are excited about AI's potential and want to be on the front lines of AI-Powered developer efficiency at Microsoft, we want you in ES365 AI.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building some of the world's most extensive data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a world-class data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a strong focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. P-1630 About The Role Every product Databricks ships has to be priced, contracted, rated and billed before it can earn a dollar. The Money organization builds the systems that make this happen, at hyperscaler scale and across every major cloud. We built the world's only cross-cloud integrated rating engine in-house, and it now rates billions of dollars in revenue. Our next goal is bigger: a fully automated, zero-touch order-to-cash flow where the platform is the source of truth for accounts, contracts and subscriptions, and Month End Close needs little or no human intervention.

As Director of Engineering, you will lead the engineering organization that owns this commercial engine from start to finish. You will set the product and technology strategy for how Databricks makes money. You will be the engineering voice Finance, Product and GTM leaders turn to for strategic decisions. You will also build the leadership bench that lets the organization keep scaling.

Speed is critical. Databricks keeps inventing new ways to sell: commit and pay-as-you-go, marketplaces, conditional benefits, strategic partnerships and new clouds and regions. The commerce engine either makes each of these fast and safe to launch, or it becomes the bottleneck. You will make sure it is the former.

What You'll Own The org covers six commercial domains:

  • Pricing configuration: SKUs, multipliers, price-change processes, deal desk and discounting
  • Orders and contracts: from negotiated quote to order to signed customer contract
  • Subscriptions: commit, pay-as-you-go and proof-of-concept subscriptions, plus how contracts are tied to payment methods
  • Rating: applying each customer's negotiated price, discounts and conditional benefits to ingested usage to compute the bill
  • Billing: commit drawdown, invoicing, Month End Close and related financial processes
  • Marketplace: third-party data and solutions, available seamlessly to Databricks customers

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
job.description:
About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; New York City; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington D.C.; Toronto, Canada

About The Role Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. These Kubernetes platforms are purpose-built from the ground up and run on bare metal Linux in different regions around the world. The scale we work at involves tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of network traffic. The team takes pride in knowing this platform helps run parts of the global Internet.

As an engineer on the Kubernetes platform team, you'll be building the tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. Our mission is to provide a reliable and flexible platform to help product teams release new software efficiently and safely. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. job.name: Software Development Engineer III, Machine Learning Annapurna - System Integration
job.description:
Description Do you want to build AI-powered tooling that keeps custom silicon running reliably at scale? In Annapurna Labs at Amazon Web Services (AWS), we sit at the intersection of software and hardware, designing the systems that detect failures, generate repair instructions, and automate qualification for Trainium products. As a Software Development Engineer III, you will lead the technical design and delivery of this tooling platform — combining generative AI techniques with deep hardware knowledge to solve problems that few teams in the industry encounter. With hardware complexity and scope expanding rapidly, this is a rare opportunity to shape how we bring the next generation of custom chips to operational stability.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and deliver generative AI-based tools that identify complex hardware failures, dynamically create repair instructions from hardware system designs, and automate the qualification framework for post-new-product-introduction hardware changes on Trainium systems.
  • Own system design decisions across the tooling software stack, evaluating tradeoffs in scalability, maintainability, and performance while partnering with silicon design and operations teams on cross-functional technical discussions.
  • Collaborate with hardware design and sustaining teams to align tooling updates with upcoming silicon changes, creating the right integration checkpoints to ensure successful delivery.
  • Drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team through code reviews, design reviews, and mentorship — raising the quality bar and helping fellow engineers grow.
  • Evaluate and refine generative AI model outputs used in the tooling platform, applying responsible AI practices to ensure accuracy and reliability at production scale.

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing system health metrics for the tooling platform, then join a design review where a teammate walks through a new generative AI model for automated failure diagnosis on Trainium hardware. You ask probing questions that sharpen the approach. After lunch, you pair with an engineer to work through a tricky data-modeling problem, then shift to a cross-team sync with hardware design engineers to align on upcoming silicon changes that will require updates to your qualification automation. Later, you write a technical document outlining how the tooling will scale to support the next generation of Trainium products.

job.name: Senior Performance Engineer, Efficiency Red Team
job.description:
Description Are you the kind of engineer who obsesses over performance? Does the idea of hunting for hidden waste across the world's largest infrastructure and turning those findings into hundreds of millions of dollars in freed capacity sound like the most exciting job you can imagine? If so, keep reading.

This role offers something rare. Deep technical research freedom, immediate access to the largest compute infrastructure in the world, and direct line of sight to impact that reshapes how Amazon builds and operates its infrastructure. The Efficiency Red Team has already driven billions in cumulative capacity savings, reclaimed petabytes of DRAM through automated profiling, and built GPU efficiency frameworks adopted across Amazon. And we are just getting started. The surface area of opportunity grows with every new workload, every new chip generation, and every new AI model Amazon deploys. You would be joining a team with a proven foundation and an expanding frontier.

Compute demand is rising with no sign of slowing down. The explosive growth of Generative AI has created unprecedented demand for GPUs, and the shock-waves are now constraining DRAM availability for traditional compute across the entire industry. Silicon, power, and physical space are not infinite. When capacity is constrained, efficiency becomes the new capacity. At Amazon's scale, a single efficiency pattern discovered and applied can unlock resources equivalent to building entirely new data centers. A modest reduction in memory footprint across a widely deployed library translates into millions of dollars in freed capacity. An optimization that improves response latency by milliseconds across billions of requests directly improves the experience of hundreds of millions of customers and drives business growth.

We are looking for experienced performance engineers to join a focused group whose mission is discovering and eliminating waste across every layer of the compute stack. You will work at the intersection of hardware and software, from GPU memory management in generative AI inference pipelines to DRAM allocation patterns deep inside language runtime, from storage subsystem inefficiencies to CPU scheduling behaviors at hyper-scale.

job.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

LSI (Lean SuperIntelligence) is a security AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity LLMs. LSI-Offense-1 finds, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to attacks. The two train against each other inside LSI Cyber World Models, realistic instrumented enterprise environments where every outcome is verified, and they run on-prem or air-gapped inside the enterprise that owns them.

LSI is founded by the team behind India's first sovereign LLM and AI labs at Alexa, Uber AI and Salesforce Research, with elite security researchers, and is backed by Accel, Fusion Fund, SVQ, Inventus Capital and Dreamit Ventures, plus angels who led AI and security at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne and Zscaler.

About the Role

You will architect LSI's agentic security system: a team of AI agents that attack, defend and harden a customer's estate continuously. Offense agents probe like an attacker, defense agents detect, investigate and respond like the best responder, and remediation agents turn findings into fixes. You own how they reason, act, hand off to each other and stay under human control.

You are fluent on both sides: you have run adversary simulations and led investigations, and you have built agents that do both. You will turn that into system architecture, training signal and evaluations, working with ML researchers, offense and defense engineers and design partners.

What you'll do

  • Architect the multi-agent system: offense, defense and remediation agents, the orchestrator that routes work between them, and the shared context that carries a finding from attack path to detection to fix.
  • Design the harness and actuators agents use across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, code and CI/CD, and SIEM/XDR/SOAR, with every action scoped, traceable and replayable.
  • Build the security context graph that unifies endpoint, identity, cloud, app and agent signals with threat intel, past incidents and policy.
  • Own routing between LSI's specialised cyber models and frontier models, trading accuracy, latency and cost per task.
  • Define agent identity, least privilege, autonomy levels, human sign-off for high-impact actions, audit trails and rollback.
  • Own one evaluation scorecard across find, exploit, detect, investigate, triage and fix, and lead staff engineers and design-partner pilots.

job.name: Software Development Engineer III, Amazon Java Runtime
job.description:
Description The Java Runtimes Team (JRT) owns and advances the Java runtime that powers a large share of Amazon's production services. We work at the intersection of language runtimes, compilers, and hardware — tuning the JVM and its ecosystem so that thousands of services run faster, use less memory, and scale more efficiently across x86 and Graviton (AArch64) fleets. We contribute directly to OpenJDK and our Corretto JDK, and we build the tooling that turns deep runtime expertise into automated, fleet-wide performance gains.

We are hiring a Runtime Engineer to work across three closely-linked areas: the JIT compiler, garbage collection, and systems-level software optimization. You will profile real production workloads, identify runtime bottlenecks, prototype and land improvements in the JVM, and help encode that expertise into tools that scale beyond one-to-one consultation.

Key job responsibilities

  • Analyze production JVM workloads to identify compiler, GC, and runtime bottlenecks, and translate findings into concrete optimizations.
  • Design, implement, and benchmark improvements to JIT compilation, garbage collection, and core runtime subsystems.
  • Contribute changes upstream to OpenJDK and to Amazon Corretto, working through code review and community processes.
  • Tune runtime behavior for performance and efficiency across x86 and Graviton (AArch64) architectures.
  • Build and improve profiling, observability, and auto-tuning tooling so runtime expertise scales across the fleet rather than through manual, per-service consultation.
  • Validate performance and reliability of changes against real workloads before broad rollout.
  • Partner with service teams to drive adoption of runtime improvements and newer JDK versions.

About The Team Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), started in 2022, is working to make Amazon the best place to build software. Every day, hundreds of thousands of Amazon software builders rely on us for the tools they build with, and for the technology, training, and community behind them. One of our most important responsibilities is shaping the language ecosystem, both inside Amazon and across the open-source community, to improve the experience for every software builder.

  • 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

job.name: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Leo Autopilot
job.description:
Description Are you ready to write code that operates real spacecraft in orbit? We're building the autonomous system that decides what every satellite in our constellation does, when it does it, and how it recovers when something goes wrong — all without a human in the loop for routine operations. This isn't about building another web service; it's about creating software that continuously manages an entire fleet of satellites at scale, making critical decisions under real physical constraints.

This Senior role offers a rare combination: the depth of hard systems problems — planning and scheduling under physical constraints, coordinating across a large fleet, designing safeguards you have to trust with spacecraft — alongside the ownership that comes with a small team and an expanding charter. Because the constellation and its software are both still growing, the architecture decisions you make now will run for the life of the fleet, and your work connects directly to delivering reliable broadband to people who don't have it today.

Export Control Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

  • Work with our peer teams and customers to design suitable software systems to fulfill the mission needs.
  • Develop cloud native software systems in Java and Python.
  • Utilize AWS and other Amazon technologies to build highly-available software services.
  • Design and develop performant software systems that meet the mission criteria and requirements.
  • Help on-board and mentor new team members.
  • Lead technical roadmap definition efforts and decide which features and performance improvements to build.

A day in the life

You start the day with your team, aligning on what's shipping and where you can unblock each other. Most of your time goes to building: designing services, writing and reviewing code, and hardening systems that operate real spacecraft. You work closely with operators and mission teams, watching how they handle tricky situations, spotting patterns, and turning them into automation. Some weeks you go deep on a single system; others you're connecting several so they work as one. You'll also take turns supporting the systems you build, which keeps you close to how they behave in the real world.

About The Team Our mission is to operate a satellite constellation autonomously. We're building software that changes how satellites are managed: the ground sets the intent and guardrails, and the system schedules work, coordinates across the fleet, and recovers from faults on its own — with people supervising outcomes instead of issuing commands one at a time.

More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

job.name: Senior Application Security Developer
job.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary: This role is available to candidates across Canada, excluding Quebec. If you are local to one of our hubs (Burnaby, Calgary, or Toronto) you will be expected to be in office two days per week for our Anchor Days.

Clio is looking for a Senior Application Security Developer to join the Vulnerability Management Program within the Application Security Team. Vulnerability Management is established as a standing program at Clio, with a clear mission: Vuln0 is the goal, and automation is the path. As a Senior Developer, you will bring solid software development experience combined with deep domain expertise in application security and vulnerability management to architect and build tools that reduce toil, automate vulnerability discovery, drive automated remediation, and partner with product teams across Clio.

In this role, you will help own, operate, and extend the tooling and automation pipeline (including our custom internal security tooling) that powers our vulnerability management lifecycle - covering dependency CVEs, SAST, secret scanning, pentest findings, bug bounty, and infrastructure-as-code. You will work directly with development teams to provide guidance, solve root causes, and remediate vulnerabilities in core codebases.

You will collaborate closely with other subteams across Security and Engineering, helping integrate vulnerability sources, refine triage quality, prove reachability, and enable development teams to drive open vulnerabilities to zero past SLA.

Program Philosophy & Mission

  • Vuln0 is the goal: Vuln0 means zero vulnerabilities open past SLA
  • Automation is the path: We cannot scale the team by adding humans to manually triage and patch. We reach Vuln0 generating fixes automatically, and reserving human effort for complex edge cases. The “Vuln-pocalypse” is here and we need people that can apply tooling to ride this wave. Be excited about solving hard problems the right way
  • Risk-based prioritization: Risk and exploitability determine sequencing so development teams focus on what is reachable and actionable
  • Enforceable SLAs & clear ownership: VM owns the process, tooling, systems, and automation; development teams own resolving their own vulnerabilities with our guidance and assistance

A Day in the Life

job.name: Senior SDE, VPC Lattice
job.description:
Description AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS's services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you'll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS.

EC2 Networking is one of the foundational services that enabled customers to move to the cloud. We manage the traffic flowing through one of the largest networks in the industry, handling billions of requests. VPC Lattice is how we are re-inventing application networking — giving customers a fully managed way to connect, secure, and observe services across accounts and VPCs without the undifferentiated heavy lifting of building their own networking layer.

We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to help scale the next generation of our networking architecture and control plane. As Lattice adoption accelerates, the hard problems are increasingly about scale, elasticity, and reliability: how the control plane provisions and propagates configuration across tens of thousands of endpoints, how it stays consistent and fast as the fleet grows by orders of magnitude, and how we evolve the data path without disrupting live customer traffic. This is a senior role for an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, large-scale technical problems end to end and raise the bar for the engineers and teams around them.

A successful candidate is a technical leader who can decompose a hard, loosely-defined problem into a sequence of deliverable milestones, drive the design across team and service boundaries, and bring other engineers along. You are comfortable going deep on distributed-systems fundamentals — consistency, throughput, failure modes, operational safety — and equally comfortable zooming out to influence multi-year architecture. You raise the operational and quality bar for the whole team, not just your own code.

Key job responsibilities

Own the architecture and implementation of control-plane-scaling systems that keep VPC Lattice fast, consistent, and reliable as the fleet grows by orders of magnitude.

Lead the design of ambiguous, large-scale technical problems end to end — from a loosely-defined goal to a sequence of shippable milestones with clear tradeoffs documented.

Drive technical decisions that span team and service boundaries, building alignment with partner teams across EC2 Networking, PrivateLink, and the broader UC organization.

Set and enforce the bar for operational excellence — observability, failure isolation, safe deployment, and the ability to evolve the data path without disrupting live customer traffic.

job.name: Lead Engineer - Acc Core
job.description:
Team: Accounting Core

Location / work arrangement: San Francisco, San Mateo, Seattle & Vancouver (Canada)

Employment type: Full Time

About The Role Xero’s ledger is the source of truth for millions of businesses, and every product we ship is built on top of it. We are rebuilding this integrity layer for the next 20 years, and we are standing up the Vancouver engineering hub around it from day one. As Lead Engineer, you will make the architectural decisions that set the course for the platform and the team, and you will see those decisions reach every customer who depends on Xero to get their numbers right.

The Technical Challenges

  • Correctness at scale. Accounting data has to be consistent, auditable, and immutable. There is no “close enough,” and every change to the ledger has to preserve that guarantee across regions and regulations.
  • Evolving a mature system. We are adding real-time expectations to a platform that millions of businesses depend on daily. That means strengthening service boundaries and clarifying data contracts without compromising reliability.
  • Durable, high-throughput services. We use durable execution (for example, Temporal) to keep long-running financial workflows accurate and recoverable under load.
  • AI-ready data. We are structuring accounting data so it can power AI-native experiences while maintaining trust in the numbers.

Impact

  • First six months: You understand the ledger and its consumers, align the team on service boundaries and data contracts, and ship a first modernization increment with no loss of data integrity.
  • First twelve months:

+ You have set the architecture for the core accounting capabilities (general ledger, journals, chart of accounts, multi-currency).
+ The Vancouver engineering team has clear ownership and quality standards, thanks in part to your leadership and role modeling.
+ Your work reaches customers through every product built on the ledger, and the decisions made now will shape Xero for years.

Ownership You will own the technical direction for your area of the accounting platform, from design through production and on-call. You will make architectural decisions on service boundaries, data contracts, and technology choices without needing sign-off, and you will be accountable for reliability and data integrity end to end. You will also help set hiring, quality, and ownership practices for an early and growing team, which will compound over time.

Who You’ll Work With Bernardo Farah is the Director of Engineering for Accounting Core. He has over 10 years of SaaS software experience, including six years building platforms and growing teams at Samsara.

job.name: Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.

Know the Why : We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.

Innovate & Iterate : We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We're building a new SRE team and looking for founding members to help shape how we operate. You'll be responsible for the reliability, performance, and availability of Develocity instances serving paying customers, open-source projects, and public-facing services, plus supporting infrastructure like artifact registries.

job.name: Sr. Software Engineer- Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps
job.description:
The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

To enable this, the systems behind NG-SIEM are growing to accommodate >100 PB of event and action data ingested every day, up to 10 years of retention, and dozens of millions of queries per hour across large sections of the data stored.

Ideal candidate for this Senior Engineer II has deep expertise in large-scale distributed/control systems (intelligent placement, auto balancing, autoscaling) and the ability to go deep into the underlying data platform (LogScale) — ingestion, storage, and query internals — to connect scaling decisions to real system behavior in a large multi-tenant environment. The core challenge is a two-sided optimization: deliver the best performance for every customer while achieving the best overall resource utilization (minimal wasted capacity, maximum density).

About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon, London, Austin About The Team The Zero Trust Connectivity team builds the hub that connects Cloudflare One and Zero Trust products such as Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare One Client, Cloudflare Tunnels, Gateway and Workers VPC. Powering this hub is a set of Rust-based services operating on every one of the data-centers that Cloudflare runs. These services route all of Cloudflare One traffic end to end. By leveraging Cloudflare's incredible infrastructure and programming languages such as Rust, this critical service is safe, performant and secure.

As Cloudflare Zero Trust set of features evolves, this team is responsible for evolving these hub services to deliver those new capabilities while guaranteeing scalability and reliability as top priority.

We are a team of engineers who obsess over building reliable services which leverage Cloudflare's unique architecture and global network footprint.

About Docker Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. It’s a powerful, intelligent, and secure control point that eliminates the toil of model orchestration, tool management, observability, and governance - so developers can focus on building incredible AI agents, not gluing together infrastructure.

We’re just getting started and we need exceptional engineers to help us build the backbone of the future of agent-based development.

LiveRamp is shaping the future of responsible data collaboration between the world’s leading brands, retailers, financial services providers, and healthcare innovators. As consumers embrace new AI-driven experiences, the LiveRamp data collaboration network exponentially expands the breadth and accuracy of the data on which marketing AI capabilities operate, powering deeper customer insight and measurable performance on a global scale. LiveRamp is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with offices worldwide. Learn more at LiveRamp.com.

The Activations Backend team is responsible for the bulk of big data processing that powers LiveRamp’s primary activation product, which delivers hundreds of millions in annual recurring revenue. Our systems process over one hundred thousand batch jobs per day, ranging in size from gigabytes to over 100 terabytes, and power distributions to hundreds of downstream destinations. Cumulatively, our systems process multiple exabytes per year. We provide detailed monitoring, statistics, error recovery, and resiliency to keep this core product reliable for our largest customers.

At LiveRamp, big data processing is not just for back-office analytics. Our product is a big data product: we transform, deduplicate, and transport massive datasets across clouds and regions, while respecting complex rate limits and SLAs, and enabling many of the most successful companies on the planet to activate their data safely and efficiently.

Your Team Will

  • Re‑architect Activations Back End to be cloud‑forward and multi‑regional, taking advantage of SingleStore and other modern data warehouses to replace legacy Spark‑heavy flows where it makes sense.
  • Deliver high‑throughput, low‑latency activation by combining: SingleStore‑backed state and delta computation, Spark/Dataproc for the heaviest batch workloads, and Streaming infrastructure (e.g., Redpanda/Pub/Sub) for event‑driven and incremental deliveries.

job.description:
Description We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join our AI acceleration team. You will embed directly with internal teams across Luna Engineering, Marketing Technology and Business teams, working with their real workflows and constraints to ship AI powered productivity solutions into production. This is a builder role where you own the outcome end to end, from discovery through a live, adopted deployment, and you feed what you learn in the field back into our shared platform and tooling so every other team benefits.

You are a hands on builder who designs, develops, and operates the systems and agents that bring proprietary and third party models into the daily work of internal teams. You translate a team's ambiguous, real world problem into a working technical solution, writing production code in whatever stack the work requires. Between engagements, you turn one off solutions into reusable platform capabilities, agents, SDKs, and patterns that scale from one internal team to the next.

We are looking for a highly collaborative engineer with a customer obsessed mindset with strong business acumen. Ambiguity motivates you to invent and solve problems. You are comfortable being the technical owner in front of business teams you serve, including pushing back on request with data backed alternatives. You thrive in fast paced, entrepreneurial environments and are comfortable owning and executing delivery from start to finish. This is an exciting opportunity to fundamentally shift how teams work using AI.

Key job responsibilities

  • Embed with internal teams: you work inside a team's real workflow and constraints to scope, design, and ship AI powered productivity solutions into production.
  • Own the outcome: you define success with each team up front and stay accountable until the solution is live, adopted, and delivering the agreed productivity result.
  • Reach production fast and make it stick: you get to a working production deployment quickly, then enable the team to operate and build on the solution over time.
  • Close the loop to product: when applicable, you turn what you learn in each engagement into reusable platform capabilities, agents, SDKs, and patterns, so a one-off solution for one team becomes the default for the next.
  • Launch cross-functional agents: you identify high value productivity use cases and partner with domain experts to build transformative agentic workflows and systems.
  • Stay ahead and pioneer: you track the latest AI methodologies and tooling, bring the best of them into Amazon Games, and act as an evangelist and change agent who shifts how teams work.
  • You build and operate high scale API infrastructure: you design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable and cost-efficient AI solutions using native AWS.
  • Ensure enterprise grade security, compliance, and responsible AI underpin every solution.

The SPLAT team delivers foundational platform services for secure API routing, service registration, traffic management, distributed throttling, private connectivity, authentication, and safe-change enforcement. SPLAT sits in the request path for more than 300 OCI control planes and processes hundreds of billions of API requests each month.

You will write and review production code, guide architectural decisions, solve complex operational problems, and mentor engineers. Success requires sound technical judgment, clear communication, and the ability to drive progress when requirements, ownership, or failure boundaries are unclear.

  • Lead complex incident investigations and turn recurring failures and manual processes into automation and preventive engineering improvements.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for issues spanning applications, infrastructure, networking, and organizational boundaries.

job.name: AI Process Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About The Role ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.

You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale. What You’ll Be Doing

  • Deploy and prove: own the end-to-end journey from first process file to a running, measurably improving production workflow.

+ At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see.
+ At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

Read the full description

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Your role will involve utilizing your expertise in full stack development, including technologies like React, Python, FastAPI, AWS, Spring Boot, and Node.js, to develop and maintain complex software solutions. You will contribute to software development and optimization efforts, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure optimal quality and performance of our systems.

We continuously innovate in automating and accelerating product delivery using cutting-edge software and hardware technologies. By utilizing the latest AWS and GenAI platforms, we build distributed, highly available systems to achieve our objectives.

job.name: QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: QA Automation Engineer

Company: Terralogic

Experience: 3-5 years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Bangalore

About Terralogic

Terralogic is a technology solutions and engineering services company delivering innovative solutions across software, cloud, infrastructure, and digital engineering. We are looking for a skilled QA Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Python programming, Selenium WebDriver, and the PyTest framework, along with a solid understanding of manual testing, software quality assurance, and test automation.

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled QA Automation Engineer with 3–5 years of experience in automation and manual testing. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Python programming, Selenium WebDriver, and the PyTest framework, along with a good understanding of software testing concepts, Linux commands, debugging, and virtualization technologies.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing automation test scripts, identifying defects, and ensuring the quality and reliability of software applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Python.
  • Perform web application automation testing using Selenium WebDriver.
  • Develop and execute automated test cases using the PyTest framework.
  • Perform manual testing to validate application functionality and identify defects.
  • Analyze test results, troubleshoot issues, and perform debugging.
  • Execute Linux commands for testing, troubleshooting, and debugging purposes.
  • Identify, document, track, and report software defects.
  • Collaborate with development and QA teams to improve product quality.
  • Understand and work with basic VMware/Nutanix virtualization concepts.

Required Skills

  • 3–5 years of experience in QA Automation Testing.
  • Strong programming knowledge in Python.
  • Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver.
  • Experience working with the PyTest framework.
  • Good understanding of manual testing concepts and methodologies.
  • Knowledge of Linux commands and debugging techniques.
  • Basic understanding of VMware/Nutanix virtualization concepts.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Candidates with practical experience in both manual and automation testing.
  • Ability to develop, execute, and maintain automation test scripts.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a QA team.

Interested candidates with relevant QA Automation experience are encouraged to apply.

job.name: Test Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Test Engineer with 6+ years of software testing experience in the automotive domain, specializing in ECU testing, CAN/UDS protocols, test automation, and Vector toolchain. The candidate should be capable of independently handling unit, integration, and software testing activities, developing automation frameworks using CAPL and Python, and working within ASPICE and ISO 26262 environments.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases for complex automotive ECUs.
  • Independently handle Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and Software Testing requirements.
  • Develop and maintain scalable test automation frameworks using CAPL and Python.
  • Perform UDS diagnostic testing, including diagnostic functions, fault memory verification, and ECU flashing validation.
  • Work extensively with CAN, LIN, and SPI communication protocols.
  • Use Vector CANoe, CANalyzer, and CAN Disturbance Tools for testing and debugging.
  • Perform testing in SIL and HIL environments and troubleshoot hardware/software issues.
  • Analyze test results, capture logs, identify defects, and prepare detailed defect reports.
  • Collaborate with Test Leads, System Engineers, and development teams to debug and resolve issues.
  • Ensure testing activities comply with ASPICE (SWE.4, SWE.5 & SWE.6) and ISO 26262 requirements.

Mandatory Requirements

  • 6+ years of software testing experience, specifically in the Automotive/Embedded domain.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Unit Testing and Integration Testing.
  • Expert-level knowledge of CAN and UDS – Mandatory.
  • Strong practical experience with Vector CANoe and CANalyzer.
  • Hands-on expertise in CAPL and Python scripting for test automation.
  • Experience with SIL/HIL testing environments.
  • Ability to independently handle automotive communication protocols from day one.
  • Experience with debugging tools such as oscilloscopes and multimeters.
  • Strong understanding of software testing processes and defect management.

job.name: Senior Consultant- Smart Cities Expert
job.description:
Overview The Smart Cities Expert – Senior Consultant will support the delivery of smart-city advisory and consulting engagements for government, giga-project, real estate, infrastructure and destination-development clients in Middle East with the primary focus in Saudi Arabia. The role will help clients translate city and district ambitions into practical smart-city strategies, priority services and use cases, value cases, governance arrangements and phased implementation roadmaps.

The successful candidate will combine strategic consulting capability with practical knowledge of urban technology and city operations. The role requires the ability to assess opportunities across mobility, utilities, public realm, safety, sustainability, citizen experience, urban operations, IoT, data and AI, while connecting strategic objectives to operating models, technology concepts and implementation planning.

Your role

  • Support Saudi smart-city advisory engagements for government, giga-project, real estate, infrastructure, and destination-development clients.
  • Translate city or district ambitions into smart-city strategies, service portfolios, priority use cases, value cases, and phased implementation roadmaps.
  • Assess capabilities across mobility, utilities, public realm, safety, sustainability, citizen experience, urban operations, IoT, data, and AI.
  • Shape governance and operating models for multi-stakeholder delivery, covering service ownership, decision rights, funding logic, and performance management.
  • Define concepts for urban platforms, command centers, digital twins, sensor ecosystems, interoperability, dashboards, and data-driven city operations.
  • Contribute to workshops, proposals, RFP inputs, vendor assessments, executive presentations, and thought leadership tailored to the Saudi market.

Requirements About you

  • 5-8+ years in smart cities, urban technology, digital consulting, infrastructure advisory, or technology-enabled city operations.
  • Practical understanding of Saudi smart-city priorities, Vision 2030 transformation programs, giga-project environments, and public-sector stakeholder dynamics.
  • Exposure to at least three smart-city domains, such as mobility, smart infrastructure, IoT, public safety, sustainability, city platforms, or citizen services.
  • Ability to connect strategy with implementation planning across use-case design, operating model, technology architecture, and roadmap delivery.
  • Familiarity with data governance, AI-enabled services, cybersecurity-by-design, and responsible use of urban data in public-sector environments.
  • TOGAF-certified, with proven regional program delivery experience.
  • Strong consulting skills: structured problem solving, stakeholder interviews, workshop facilitation, concise writing, executive storytelling, and English communication.

Behavioural Competencies

Bangalore,IND
