About SysAid

SysAid builds service management software used by 4,000+ organizations in 140 countries and more than 9 million people every day. We're recognized in Gartner's ITSM Magic Quadrant and by AWS as a Rising ISV Star, and generative AI sits at the centre of our product roadmap.

The Role

This is a hands-on technical role. You will design, build, and run the AI systems our revenue team uses: agents, MCP integrations, data pipelines, and the evals that keep them accurate.

Our go-to-market stack is already connected to Claude through MCP, and we use it every day for forecasting, pipeline tracking, and account research. What we don't have yet is an engineer-minded owner who turns a set of useful connections into a production system the whole revenue org relies on.

You need revenue judgment and technical depth. You should know why a forecast is wrong, not only how to query it. But most of your week is spent building, in code and in Claude, not writing requirements for someone else to implement.

The AI Guild

You'll be one of three founding members of SysAid's AI Guild, alongside Marketing's data scientist and our Data Tech Lead.

The guild sets how AI gets built and used across go-to-market: shared data definitions, shared tooling, evaluation standards, and what is ready for production. You lead the revenue side.

Guild members review each other's work. You'll need to hold your own in a conversation about model evaluation, data modelling and system design, and to give useful feedback on work that isn't yours.

What You Will Build and Own

1. Agents and revenue workflows

  • Agents for pipeline generation, enrichment, outreach, deal inspection, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Decide what agents run and what people run. Build it, monitor it, and replace it when something better ships.

2. Integrations and MCP

  • Build and maintain the MCP servers and API integrations that connect Claude to Salesforce, Gong, Snowflake,e and the rest of the stack.
  • Own authentication, permissions, rate limits, TSs,s and cost for everything agents can reach.

3. The data foundation

  • Model revenue data in Snowflake so that agents and people query the same definitions and get the same numbers.
  • Write the data quality checks that catch a broken pipeline before it reaches a dashboard or a forecast.

4. Evals and guardrails

  • Test sets, graders, and regression checks for every workflow that matters, so a forecast an agent produced holds up in a board meeting.
  • Monitoring that tells you a workflow is drifting before a rep does.

5. Revenue intelligence

  • One view of performance from first touch through renewal and expansion.

job.name: Senior Performance Engineer, Efficiency Red Team
job.description:
Description Are you the kind of engineer who obsesses over performance? Does the idea of hunting for hidden waste across the world's largest infrastructure and turning those findings into hundreds of millions of dollars in freed capacity sound like the most exciting job you can imagine? If so, keep reading.

This role offers something rare. Deep technical research freedom, immediate access to the largest compute infrastructure in the world, and direct line of sight to impact that reshapes how Amazon builds and operates its infrastructure. The Efficiency Red Team has already driven billions in cumulative capacity savings, reclaimed petabytes of DRAM through automated profiling, and built GPU efficiency frameworks adopted across Amazon. And we are just getting started. The surface area of opportunity grows with every new workload, every new chip generation, and every new AI model Amazon deploys. You would be joining a team with a proven foundation and an expanding frontier.

Compute demand is rising with no sign of slowing down. The explosive growth of Generative AI has created unprecedented demand for GPUs, and the shock-waves are now constraining DRAM availability for traditional compute across the entire industry. Silicon, power, and physical space are not infinite. When capacity is constrained, efficiency becomes the new capacity. At Amazon's scale, a single efficiency pattern discovered and applied can unlock resources equivalent to building entirely new data centers. A modest reduction in memory footprint across a widely deployed library translates into millions of dollars in freed capacity. An optimization that improves response latency by milliseconds across billions of requests directly improves the experience of hundreds of millions of customers and drives business growth.

We are looking for experienced performance engineers to join a focused group whose mission is discovering and eliminating waste across every layer of the compute stack. You will work at the intersection of hardware and software, from GPU memory management in generative AI inference pipelines to DRAM allocation patterns deep inside language runtime, from storage subsystem inefficiencies to CPU scheduling behaviors at hyper-scale.

job.description:
Description Every time an advertiser runs a campaign on Amazon, they want to know: did it drive sales at Target, Walmart, Costco, and hundreds of other retailers? Omnichannel Metrics (OCM) answers that question — and we're just getting started. We build the ML-powered attribution systems that connect billions of ad impressions to real-world purchases across the entire retail landscape, processing massive-scale panel data to give advertisers measurement insights no competitor can match. OCM is one of Amazon Ads' highest-growth products, directly responsible for unlocking advertiser investment by proving the full omnichannel value of Amazon media.

Right now, we're shipping some of the most ambitious projects in MADS: Fine-Grained OCM that breaks attribution down to category and retailer level for the first time, OCM for Autos bringing omnichannel measurement to the automotive vertical, OCM Local building location-based foot traffic measurement for restaurants and retail, a Combined Methodology that unifies our Panel and Circana measurement into a single omnichannel view, and international expansion of the Unified Panel to 8 new marketplaces. Looking ahead to 2027, we're building real-time streaming attribution, integrating LLMs for agentic report generation and automated campaign optimization, expanding into healthcare and home services verticals, and launching causal incrementality measurement. The problems are genuinely hard — privacy-safe identity resolution at scale, calibrating ML models across sparse panel data, building streaming systems that produce daily estimates from weekly ground truth — and the ambiguity is high. You won't be handed a spec; you'll be defining what to build and how.

As an SDE II, you will own the architecture and delivery of major system components end-to-end. You'll make technology choices that shape how OCM scales from thousands to tens of thousands of active studies, design distributed data pipelines processing billions of events in Spark/EMR, and build the AI-powered features that transform OCM from a reporting tool into an autonomous measurement platform. You'll work across Scala, Java, and Python, with deep expertise in big data technologies (Apache Spark, Kestrel, EMR), AWS infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, Step Functions, CDK), and data modeling for both relational and non-relational systems.

You will lead technical design reviews, mentor engineers, and raise the engineering bar across the team. You'll partner directly with applied scientists on ML model productionization and with product managers to translate ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. This is a team where an L5 engineer has outsized impact — we're small enough that your architectural decisions become the system, and high-visibility enough (S-team and VP-level goals) that leadership sees the results.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, ML API – AI Inference
job.description:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.

This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.

Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.

About The Role Cerebras is building a new generation of disaggregated AI inference systems that combine GPU-accelerated prefill with ultra-fast decode on the Cerebras Wafer-Scale Engine.

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and evolve the ML API layer that makes this heterogeneous serving system accessible, reliable, and easy to use. You will own significant features and components across our inference APIs, model integration layer, and request-routing services, delivering a consistent experience across models and accelerator backends.

This role sits at the intersection of machine learning systems, API design, model serving, and distributed systems. You will translate evolving model capabilities and customer requirements into clear designs, lead implementation across multiple components, and carry features through validation, rollout, and production operation. Your work will help ensure that streaming, sampling, tool use, structured outputs, multimodal inputs, and model configuration behave correctly and consistently.

You will work closely with model enablement, compiler, runtime, cloud infrastructure, product, and customer-facing teams, as well as customers directly. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with opportunities to lead small project teams, mentor engineers, and improve the quality and reliability of production inference software.

job.description:

This role will co-own MLOps practices at Fluent Media and establish standards for model deployment, serving, scaling and infrastructure efficiency. Working with ML scientists, Data Engineering and Product, this engineer will ensure models support accurate ad selection through reliable production systems at an optimal cost to serve.

  • Build, monitor and optimize automated pipelines for training, testing and deployment.

  • Ability to independently resolve production challenges and collaborate with ML scientists, engineers and Product.

job.name: Staff Engineer - AI Security
job.description:
Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Staff Engineer. About the team: AnShi Lab is dedicated to pioneering the next generation of firewall and gateway software architectures. Our mission centers on deep technical innovation in file security, advanced threat prevention, and AI-driven security operations. Moving beyond traditional boundaries, we are actively integrating AI Research into our core roadmap—focusing on AI Runtime Security and the protection of large language model (LLM) ecosystems. By conducting high-impact, long-term research, we generate strategic patents that define the future of datacom gateways. Our goal is to establish new industry benchmarks through cloud-native, AI-augmented software engineering. Leveraging a global talent pool, we are building a high-performance team of experts committed to driving organizational excellence and securing the intelligent edge.

About the job:

  • Research, develop, and optimize small language models (SLMs) for AI security detection and analysis.
  • Fine-tune and evaluate language models for security-specific tasks, focusing on detection accuracy, false positive rates, and inference efficiency.
  • Design algorithms to detect abnormal AI agent behaviors, suspicious tool calls, unauthorized operations, and potential security threats.
  • Develop intelligent detection capabilities for sensitive information leakage, prompt injection attacks, and malicious or unintended AI agent actions.
  • Research techniques for analyzing AI agent intentions, behavioral patterns, and interactions with external tools and APIs.
  • Build and maintain security datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and automated testing pipelines.
  • Implement and integrate AI-based detection algorithms into real-world AI security products.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and research teams to improve the effectiveness and performance of AI security solutions.

The total target annual compensation ranges from $127,000 to $225,000 depending on education, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Job requirements

About the ideal candidate:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing fundamentals.
  • Good programming skills, preferably in Python, with experience in algorithm implementation, data processing, and debugging.
  • Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical problems.
  • Interest in AI security, LLM technologies, and emerging threats associated with AI agents.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with engineering and research teams.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. As AI Engineer, you will design and build production-grade AI and agentic AI solutions that solve real business problems for EY's clients. You are the core builder on the delivery team, responsible for AI/ML pipelines, agentic workflows, multi-agent coordination, evaluation frameworks, observability and governance that ensure AI solutions work in production.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, AI Architect, AI Platform Engineers, and Data Scientists to translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and responsible AI solutions through maintainable architectural. job.description:
Job Title: AI/ML Software Engineer - Localization Engineering

Work Mode: Hybrid (Wednesday in Office, Rest of the Week Remote)

Job Location: British Columbia, Canada

Experience: 4+ Years

Contract: T4 Contract

Pay Rate: CAD 65 to 75 per hour

Contract Duration: 12 Months

Role Summary

We are hiring for an AI/ML Software Engineer - Localization Engineering to work on a project focused on intelligent localization systems and AI-powered translation technologies. The selected candidate will build scalable backend solutions, develop and fine-tune transformer-based models, and improve end-to-end localization workflows using modern AI/ML technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop AI-powered localization workflows integrating Neural Machine Translation (NMT) and Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Build and improve translation quality estimation systems using COMET, BLEURT, and custom LLM-based evaluators.
  • Develop and fine-tune Automated Post-Editing (APE) solutions to improve translation quality, terminology accuracy, and consistency.
  • Fine-tune transformer-based models using Hugging Face and domain-specific translation memory and glossary data.
  • Build scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices to support automated localization workflows.
  • Integrate product systems, Translation Management Systems (TMS), content repositories, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop automation frameworks for content extraction, file processing, translation handoff, validation, and linguistic quality assurance.
  • Optimize model performance, inference latency, and cloud deployment using AWS services such as SageMaker and Bedrock.
  • Build Python pipelines for multilingual data processing, sentence alignment, tokenization, and fuzzy matching.
  • Benchmark translation performance using BLEU, chrF++, TER, COMET, and other NLP evaluation metrics.
  • Collaborate with localization program teams, product engineering teams, and external suppliers to improve localization processes.
  • Contribute to localization engineering standards, shared tools, frameworks, and AI-enabled translation practices.

Must-Have Skills

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience, with significant backend or AI/ML experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Python.
  • Experience working with transformer-based models, including Hugging Face or similar frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying machine learning models.
  • Experience with AWS services such as SageMaker and Bedrock.
  • Strong experience building APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end localization workflows, including extraction, translation, review, quality assurance, and release.
  • Experience working with Translation Management Systems such as Phrase, Passolo, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases and cloud-native architectures.

job.description:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.

This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.

Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.

About The Role As an Applied Machine Learning Research Scientist at Cerebras, you will play a key role in turning modern machine learning techniques into scalable, high-performance systems. This role sits at the intersection of modeling and systems focused not on publishing new algorithms, but on understanding how they work and making them run effectively at scale. Your work will directly impact how large language models (LLMs) are trained, optimized, and deployed on one of the most advanced AI platforms in the world.

You will work closely with researchers and senior engineers to implement and improve workflows for LLM pretraining, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning-based post-training. This includes building training pipelines, debugging complex system behaviors, improving model quality, and iterating on data and evaluation strategies. Your contributions will help translate cutting-edge ML ideas into reliable, production-ready systems that solve real-world problems.

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy hands-on engineering, want to build deep intuition for ML systems, and are excited about working on LLMs and reinforcement learning in practice, not just in theory.

Responsibilities

  • Apply post-training techniques (e.g. RLVR, RLHF, GRPO etc.) techniques to improve model performance.
  • Build and maintain evaluation pipelines to measure model performance across tasks and domains.
  • Debug issues across the ML stack, including data pipelines, training jobs, model outputs and mixed or lower precision computation.
  • Collaborate with researchers to translate ML ideas into efficient, scalable implementation.
  • Design, implement, and scale ML pipelines across all stages of LLM development (pretraining, fine-tuning, alignment).
  • Work with large datasets, including dataset generation, filtering, and synthetic data approaches.
  • Optimize training and inference workflows for performance, efficiency, and reliability.
  • Contribute high-quality, maintainable code to shared ML infrastructure.

job.description:
As a Member of Technical Staff (Research) at Quadrillion Labs, you'll help train our next-generation model for research creativity. This is genuinely hard: very few people have post-trained models at the scale of several hundred billion parameters, and we're doing it with a lean team and a set of ingenious ideas — accumulating research data and training on it in an unusually data-efficient way. If you're excited about turning every arXiv paper on the internet into an RL environment, or building fast RL loops between user data and model training, this role may be for you.

What You'll Do

  • Build infrastructure for model training. You'll build our ultra-efficient infrastructure for scraping and accumulating data, turning it into RL environments, and post-training our frontier model — especially on extremely long-horizon tasks.
  • Develop RL techniques. No one has figured out how to train a model that's truly good at research yet. You can help us change that with mysterious RL techniques.
  • Construct and run evaluations and benchmarks. Build evaluations for complex, long-horizon tasks and measure both frontier models and our own against them — so we know what's working and where to push next.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience training or benchmarking large, modern models
  • Ability to move quickly in a zero-to-one environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience training hundreds-of-billions-of-parameters frontier models

About This Role We work in-person 5 days a week out of our office in Midtown Manhattan. We cover generous benefits for employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, lunch and dinner covered, and other varied stipends.

We pride ourselves on a company culture that values a diversity of thoughts and opinions.

About Quadrillion Quadrillion Labs builds Qualia, an agentic research intelligence platform that does real computational research — running experiments, analyzing data, and surfacing insight for the people who do this work at the highest level.

We're a team out of Stanford NLP, HRT, Citadel, Jane Street, Google Research, and Harvard Med, building for an audience that looks a lot like us. We've raised ~$18M from Conviction, Audacious, Bloomberg Beta, ex/ante, and angels including Wes McKinney, the creator of pandas.

We think this is the Industrial Revolution moment for research, and we're building the team to define what comes next.

job.name: Machine Learning Engineer – Distributed Training & Research Infrastructure
job.description:
We’re partnering with a leading global trading firm to hire a Machine Learning Engineer to build the systems their researchers use to train models at scale. What you’ll do

  • Build and scale distributed training pipelines for large models and complex, high-volume datasets
  • Design the parallelism strategy, data loading and checkpointing for multi-node GPU training
  • Automate the research loop with quantitative researchers: experiment orchestration, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining
  • Work with HPC specialists to raise training throughput and GPU utilization, and to cut compute cost
  • Extend the internals of PyTorch and other open-source ML tools when off-the-shelf isn’t fast enough
  • Evaluate third-party tools and decide when to build versus buy

What you’ll bring

  • 3+ years in machine learning, focused on training systems
  • Hands-on experience scaling training across many GPUs and nodes with PyTorch, JAX or TensorFlow (e.g. FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron, DDP)
  • A strong grasp of ML fundamentals, including transformer and attention internals, beyond high-level APIs
  • Production-quality Python, with testing discipline and ownership of the systems you ship
  • A habit of measuring before optimizing: profiling, benchmarking and finding the real bottleneck
  • Clear communication, so you can explain your technical decisions to researchers and adapt when the evidence says to

Nice to have

  • Experience with HPC schedulers (Slurm) and cloud or orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, Ray)
  • Contributions to open-source ML or distributed-systems projects
  • Familiarity with NCCL, collective communication or interconnect tuning

No trading experience is required. What matters is depth in large-scale training systems and the ability to move fast among very smart people.

job.name: Machine Learning Engineer – GPU Performance & Low-Latency Inference
job.description:
We’re partnering with a leading global trading firm to hire a Machine Learning Engineer to make ML models run as fast as possible. You’ll work close to the hardware, squeezing latency out of real-time inference and speeding up training, in an environment where microseconds matter.

What you’ll do

  • Build and optimize low-latency inference pipelines that deliver real-time predictions in production
  • Profile and optimize ML workloads at the device level: memory, compute, kernels and compilers
  • Write and tune custom GPU code (CUDA, Triton or equivalent) where libraries fall short
  • Apply and validate low-precision techniques (FP8/INT8, quantization), knowing which optimizations stay bit-exact,
  • Optimize batching, KV caching and serving paths for latency-critical workloads.
  • Extend the internals of PyTorch and inference frameworks to raise performance on specific workloads

What you’ll bring

  • 3+ years in machine learning, focused on inference or GPU performance
  • Hands-on experience optimizing ML at the GPU level: CUDA, Triton, C++, TensorRT or similar
  • Experience with profiling tools (Nsight, torch.profiler) and reasoning about memory bandwidth, latency and throughput
  • A strong grasp of modern ML architectures, attention in particular, and how they map onto hardware
  • Production-quality Python (C++ a strong plus), with testing discipline and ownership of the systems you ship
  • A habit of measuring before optimizing, and the judgment to know when to build versus buy

Nice to have

  • Experience building real-time, low-latency prediction systems in high-performance environments
  • Experience with numerics: mixed precision, quantization and correctness at scale
  • Contributions to open-source projects such as PyTorch, vLLM, Triton or FlashAttention

No trading experience is required. What matters is deep, hands-on performance engineering and a drive to make things faster.

job.name: Staff ML Engineer - Embodied AI Scaling Foundations
job.description:
Job Description At General Motors, we're turning today's impossible into tomorrow's standard. Our vehicles already move millions of people every day, and we're building the autonomy that will drive them - L2 through L4, on real roads, at real scale. Making self-driving safe at that scale is one of the hardest AI problems there is.

The Data Scaling team owns the data flywheel for AV foundation model pre-training and SFT. We determine what data the AV needs in order to learn driving behaviors at scale, and we define what data quality means across the loop. The team delivers ML models that move the product up the data scaling curves, turning better data composition into measurably better driving behavior. We work with the very large datasets GM already has and we define the next generation of highest-value datasets GM collects. With each major release we aim to 10x the effective data behind our models: more scale, more diversity, and more value extracted from every example.

Why Join Us?

  • Train on driving data almost nobody else has - real-world miles from GM's fleets, plus synthetic sim data - scaling into billions of examples. Then decide which ones are worth it: ten thousand near-identical highway miles teach the model less than one unprotected left turn in the rain. Mixture design, curation, mining, and evaluation are how you find out which is which, working alongside other MLEs and research scientists.
  • Work on questions with no textbook answers yet. Scaling laws for language are well mapped by now; for embodied driving data - heavy-tailed, safety-constrained, closed-loop - they aren't. You'd be helping write them, and we support publishing what you find.
  • See your results in the world rather than on a leaderboard. The models this team ships change how the vehicle behaves on real roads, and that behavior comes back as the evidence for your next iteration.

As a Staff AI/ML Engineer in the Embodied AI Data Foundations organization, you will be an individual contributor developing data-centric AI solutions that directly improve autonomous driving performance. You will design and run the data curation and model training recipes that produce models capable of safe, reliable behavior across diverse real-world scenarios, drawing on both real and synthetic data.

What You'll Do

With more ocean miles and real-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365.

THE POSITION Saildrone's vessels use multiple sensors to detect and track objects in the maritime environment. The challenge is turning imperfect observations from different sensors into reliable tracks and useful information for autonomous systems and mission operators.

As a Perception & Sensor Fusion Engineer, you will develop the algorithms and software that combine sensor observations into detections, tracks, and higher-level representations of the environment. Your work may span machine learning, computer vision, tracking, sensor fusion, and active sensing—for example, using information from one sensor to direct a PTZ camera toward an object of interest.

The Responsibilities

  • Develop perception and sensor-fusion algorithms that combine observations from multiple sensor modalities.
  • Develop and evaluate algorithms for object detection, classification, tracking, and estimation.
  • Train, evaluate, and deploy machine-learning models where ML is the right approach to the problem.
  • Develop algorithms that use information from one sensor to guide or cue another sensor, including PTZ cameras.
  • Analyze real-world sensor data to identify failures, edge cases, and opportunities to improve performance.
  • Integrate perception outputs with production software and cloud applications used by mission operators.
  • Validate and continuously improve perception capabilities using real operational data.

Who You Are

Two technical co-founders with deep AI, robotics and mechanical engineering backgrounds, plus exceptional early hires.

The role

This is a founding AI engineer role with full ownership of the multimodal AI stack from day one: production VLM pipelines, eval frameworks, edge inference and real-time voice-video AI running on real hardware in the field. You should be a scrappy, high-ownership builder who has shipped agentic or multimodal systems to real users, not just demos.

What you will do

  • Ship a production agentic-VLM pipeline on smart glasses: multi-step, tool-using visual-reasoning loops running against real industrial workflows (SOPs, inspections)
  • Build and own the eval and data flywheel: eval harnesses, failure-mode capture, and customer-data to fine-tune loops that measurably improve model quality each release
  • Ship field connectivity adaptation and edge inference: model orchestration, runtime optimization, and graceful fallback across varying connectivity and latency budgets
  • Build real-time voice-video AI interfaces for the glasses: video-heavy, conversational speech and proactive alert modes
  • Drive multimodal model training, including open-source model fine-tuning (SFT, RLHF, quantization) for on-premise enterprise deployments

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years of experience
  • End-to-end ownership of vision-language models: has taken a VLM from data and evals through to production, not one piece of a larger team's stack
  • Has shipped multimodal AI systems to real users in production (text-only LLM or RAG work is usually not enough)
  • Stack: Python, PyTorch, vLLM, Triton, Ray Serve, ONNX, TensorRT, Hugging Face Transformers, quantization (GPTQ, AWQ), edge AI

Details

  • On-site 5 days a week in San Francisco, CA
  • Base salary $200,000 to $260,000, plus 0.25% to 0.75% equity
  • Open to visa transfers (e.g. OPT, H-1B transfers)
  • Full-time

Fresh off our $50M Series B and backed by Notable Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, TQ Ventures, Susa/Kivu Ventures, and other leading investors, we’re building the category-defining AI automation platform that healthcare teams rely on to operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Built by healthcare operators for healthcare operators, Plenful is driven by a deep understanding of the challenges facing today’s care teams. We’re passionate about equipping healthcare workers with world-class tools that deliver real, measurable impact, and we’re proud to serve 100+ leading health systems, pharmacies, and healthcare organizations across the country. If you’re excited to help shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to meet you. Apply now to join our growing team.

About The Role Healthcare's back office still runs on faxes, PDFs and phone calls. AI can take that work off people's plates, but only if it is accurate enough to trust with patient and financial data.

At Plenful, we build agents and models that do that work in production, with people in the loop wherever judgment matters. As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you set the technical direction for how we build, train and measure AI across the company, and you stay hands-on while you do it. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports and broad influence.

What you'll do

You set the direction for how our agents are built

  • Define the architecture for production agents: tool use, retrieval, state and context management, routing, orchestration, tracing and failure recovery.
  • Turn what works into patterns other engineers reuse.
  • Make the calls on build versus buy for models and platform pieces.

You own our post-training strategy

  • Decide where supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, distillation and reinforcement learning pay off, and where they do not.
  • Train and ship LLMs and vision-language models for healthcare tasks, and build the in-house capability to keep doing it.
  • Prove every gain with evaluation that holds up in production.

You define what good looks like

  • Set the AI quality strategy: automated graders, calibrated LLM judges, regression suites, human review, failure taxonomies and offline-to-online validation.
  • Make eval results the basis for release decisions.

You build loops that improve themselves

  • Design the systems that turn production failures and user feedback into better datasets, evals and models.
  • Set the standard for dataset versioning, observability and MLOps so every team's work is reproducible and measurable.

Archer is collaborating with Oracle to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role. Description Implements machine learning (ML) models for production with minimal guidance. Contributes to the readiness of machine learning models for deployment in production. Contributes to the automation of machine learning workflows. Participates in the creation of infrastructure and frameworks to monitor the performance of machine learning models in deployment. Identifies potential data quality, security, and/or privacy issues and their impacts on modeling. Provides troubleshooting and debugging support. Contributes to addressing issues in machine learning infrastructure and workflows. Collaborates with stakeholders to integrate machine learning models into new or extant systems. Contributes to the development and maintenance of tools, platforms, and services for internal use. Develops low-complexity, efficient, bug-free code from scratch. Develops familiarity with current developments in the machine learning field and integrates knowledge into model development.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities *Machine Learning And Data Modeling – Model Productionization:* – Utilizes machine learning (ML) and software development knowledge to implement ML models for production with minimal guidance.

– Contributes to transforming machine learning prototypes into production-ready models.

– Supports collaboration with multiple stakeholders such as Development Leads, Product Management, Operations, and Release Management to make, adopt, and communicate technical decisions, and shape the development and delivery of software.

*Model Development And Deployment – Model Deployment:* – Contributes to ML model readiness for deployment by scaling models, cleaning model code, and ensuring production quality standards are met.

– Contributes to the automation of machine learning workflows, from data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) to model deployment and monitoring, to establish the continuous integration and continuous delivery of machine learning solutions.

*Model Development And Deployment – Model Performance:* – Utilizes infrastructure and frameworks to monitor the performance and alignment with design criteria of trained models and/or systems.

– Monitors the performance of deployed models and troubleshoots independently or in collaboration with Data Science.

– Interprets novel metrics that provide analytical insights to non-technical stakeholders on how well machine learning models are operating.

*Model Development And Deployment – Data Quality:* – Identifies potential issues related to data quality (e.g., bias, fairness), data security, and data privacy, and contributes to minimizing their impacts on data analyses and modeling.

– Contributes to tasks such as data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature identification to prepare for and enable model training.

job.name: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
job.description:
Staff AI Engineer – LLM Systems, RAG & Production ML

Location: Greater Salt Lake City, Utah

Working pattern: Hybrid – 1–2 days onsite per week

Employment: Full-time, permanent

Seniority: Staff Engineer | Senior Individual Contributor

Industry: Healthcare AI / Digital Health

Compensation: Competitive Staff-level base salary + equity (range to be confirmed)

Build AI that will directly influence the future of healthcare.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, venture-backed healthcare technology company building an intelligent platform designed to transform how patients receive personalised, continuous care.

The business already operates an established healthcare service with meaningful commercial traction. Now it's building the next generation of its technology: an AI-powered clinical companion capable of understanding patient context, intelligently orchestrating multiple AI models and supporting personalised care at scale.

This is an opportunity for an exceptional Staff AI Engineer to take technical ownership of some of the most important AI systems within the business.

You'll be joining a small, highly capable engineering team where your work will move directly into production and have a measurable impact.

This is a hands-on engineering position, not a management or architecture-only appointment.

What you'll be building

You'll design, code, deploy and continuously improve production AI systems, including:

  • LLM orchestration: Build intelligent routing and orchestration across frontier and open-weight models, balancing accuracy, latency, cost and reliability.
  • Retrieval-augmented generation: Develop RAG pipelines grounded in patient records, clinical context and longitudinal healthcare information.
  • AI evaluation and safety: Implement automated evaluation frameworks, regression testing, guardrails, hallucination detection and safety mechanisms suitable for healthcare applications.
  • Classical machine learning: Develop, train, validate and deploy predictive ML models using statistical analysis and modern ML frameworks.
  • Production AI infrastructure: Build reliable model-serving systems, inference pipelines, observability, monitoring and scalable AI services.
  • Agentic workflows: Develop context-aware AI workflows with structured tool use, state management, memory and robust failure handling.

You'll be expected to write substantial production code, make architectural decisions and own your systems beyond initial deployment.

job.name: Machine Learning Engineer 4 - Manager IC
job.description:
Do you love building and pioneering in the AI and technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Machine Learning Engineers who are passionate about leveraging cutting-edge open source frameworks, advanced algorithms, and emerging technologies to join our team. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major AI transformations and scaling production models across Capital One.

As part of the Enterprise ML Platform team, you will build and evolve the high-throughput, multi-tenant training platform that powers model workflows across Capital One—ranging from classical ML to GenAI fine-tuning and distributed computing with Ray, Spark, and Dask. Owning the Kubeflow Pipelines v2 application layer on Amazon EKS, the team develops internal Python and Go SDKs, custom Kubernetes operators, and developer tooling that abstract complex infrastructure for critical, regulated workloads. In this role, you will integrate agentic AI into modern engineering lifecycles and contribute directly to upstream open-source Kubeflow, balancing fast-paced feature delivery with enterprise-grade platform stability and security.

What You’ll Do:

  • The MLE role overlaps with many disciplines, such as Ops, Modeling, and Data Engineering. In this role, you'll be expected to perform many ML engineering activities, including one or more of the following:
  • Design, build, and/or deliver ML models and components that solve real-world business problems, while working in collaboration with the Product and Data Science teams
  • Inform your ML infrastructure decisions using your understanding of ML modeling techniques and issues, including choice of model, data, and feature selection, model training, hyperparameter tuning, dimensionality, bias/variance, and validation)
  • Solve complex problems by writing and testing application code, developing and validating ML models, and automating tests and deployment
  • Collaborate as part of a cross-functional Agile team to create and enhance software that enables state-of-the-art big data and ML applications
  • Retrain, maintain, and monitor models in production
  • Leverage or build cloud-based architectures, technologies, and/or platforms to deliver optimized ML models at scale
  • Construct optimized data pipelines to feed ML models
  • Leverage continuous integration and continuous deployment best practices, including test automation and monitoring, to ensure successful deployment of ML models and application code
  • Ensure all code is well-managed to reduce vulnerabilities, models are well-governed from a risk perspective, and the ML follows best practices in Responsible and Explainable AI
  • Use programming languages like Python

job.name: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role As a member of the Product and Engineering team at PitchBook, you will be part of a team of big thinkers, innovators, and problem solvers who strive to deepen the positive impact we have on our customers and our company every day. We value curiosity and the drive to find better ways of doing things. We thrive on customer empathy, which remains our focus when creating excellent customer experiences through product innovation.

We know that greatness is achieved through collaboration and diverse points of view, so we work closely with partners around the globe. As a team, we assume positive intent in each other’s words and actions, value constructive discussions, and foster a respectful working environment built on integrity, growth, and business value. We invest heavily in our people, who are eager to learn and constantly improve. Join our team and grow with us!

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) on the AI & ML (Insights) team, you will play a critical role in delivering AI-powered features that extract meaningful insights from PitchBook’s wealth of structured and unstructured data, including reports, news, and other textual content. This role requires deep technical expertise in advanced data analytics and machine learning, as well as a hands-on approach to designing, building, and optimizing ML solutions that power user-facing features on the PitchBook Platform.

You will be deeply involved in the end-to-end development and operationalization of ML models, including their architecture, training, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Your focus will span across natural language processing (NLP), generative AI (GenAI), large language models (LLMs), and scalable data systems. You will be expected to tackle complex technical challenges, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate closely with other engineers, data scientists, and product managers to ensure that your work aligns with business goals and AI/ML strategy.

About Strava Strava is the app for active people. With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today.

Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward.

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join the growing AI and Machine Learning team at Strava. This team is responsible for sophisticated machine learning models and systems which provide value to Strava athletes including personalization, recommendations, search, and trust and safety. The team also maintains the ML platform and infrastructure that enables our team to iterate on models quickly and deploy them reliably at scale.

This is an important role in the ML team and across Product teams designing, roadmapping, and implementing innovative machine learning algorithms. We value full stack ML engineers who are able to work on all parts of an ML pipeline from model building, evaluation, optimizing performance, and ensuring the scalability and reliability of these production models. We also seek those who can improve the systems and tools behind the ML pipeline to further empower the team.

job.name: Staff AI/ML Engineer
job.description:
About The Role Chime's Data Science & Machine Learning team builds the models, services, and platforms behind how millions of members manage and grow their financial lives. We're hiring a Staff AI/ML Engineer on our Lending and Cashflow team to lead the modeling behind cash flow underwriting and surface member insight: using members' transaction and deposit data to make fair, accurate credit decisions for people that traditional credit scores often miss.

In this role, you'll build and deploy machine learning systems on some of the richest transactional and behavioral data in fintech, turning it into the credit decisions behind products like MyPay, Instant Loans, and SpotMe. This is a highly applied role: you'll own problems end to end, from framing the question through to a model running in production and moving a metric that matters, and you'll set the technical direction for how Chime underwrites with cash flow data.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Lead the design, training, and deployment of deep learning and classical ML underwriting models that turn members' transaction and cash flow data into credit decisions, from approval and line assignment to loss forecasting
  • Take models from problem framing through to production — training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration — and stay accountable for how they behave once they're live
  • Design and improve the systems around the model: feature pipelines, batch and real-time inference, monitoring, and retraining
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Risk to turn ambiguous business problems into ML solutions, and to make sure the solution is the right one
  • Connect model performance to member outcomes and business metrics, and use experimentation to prove impact
  • Set the technical roadmap for Lending ML and raise the bar across the team through design reviews, mentorship, and shared standards for model development, validation, and governance
  • Help identify where AI/ML creates measurable impact for members — and where a simpler answer is the better one

job.description:
About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About The Role We’re seeking someone to lead the future of fraud machine learning at Ramp. In this role, you will help build core machine learning models, design data architectures, and set strategic roadmaps to help Ramp mitigate fraud-related threats while minimizing the friction experience by legitimate users. You will partner closely with product and engineering counterparts across model design, implementation, execution, and analysis.

What You’ll Do

  • Employ statistical and machine learning techniques on large datasets to discover patterns of fraud, platform abuse, and identity theft
  • Prototype and productionize machine learning models and rules-based systems to protect Ramp and its users from fraud
  • Partner closely with Fraud Engineering and Data Platform teams to augment and leverage data across first and third party sources, ensuring we’ve added as much context as possible to every decision we make
  • Contribute to the culture of Ramp’s machine learning team by influencing processes, tools, and systems that will allow us to make better decisions in a scalable way

What You Need

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Math, Economics, Physics, Computer Science, or other quantitative fields
  • A minimum of 5 years of industry experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Applied Scientist or Data Scientist
  • Strong python experience (numpy, pandas, sklearn, pytorch etc.) across ML techniques and backend engineering
  • Prior experience deploying Machine Learning models to production and making meaningful contribution to backend systems
  • Strong knowledge of SQL (Snowflake, Postgres, etc.)
  • Fluency with agentic (AI) tools for software development and data analysis
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly improving, start-up environment that focuses on solving problems with iterative technical solutions

job.description:
Lead Machine Learning Engineer (Remote first or hybrid NYC)

Our hiring partner is offering a rare opportunity to architect the future of AI and machine learning for a trusted platform at the heart of the American economy. We are the leading online marketplace connecting professional buyers and sellers of privately held companies ($5M-$100M). Trusted by thousands of the world's top acquirers and M&A advisors, our platform has facilitated millions of connections and hundreds of millions in closed transactions.

In 2024, our platform saw over 10,000 companies pursue an exit. Now, we're searching for you to lead the technical charge in leveraging our unique, proprietary dataset to build a next-generation, AI-powered experience that radically transforms how these businesses find their perfect match.

What You’ll Take On

You will be the pioneering force for ML and advanced technologies within our senior, tight-knit engineering team. Your work will directly upgrade our core matching and recommendation systems, delivering immense value to our users.

  • You will design, develop, and deploy ML/AI-driven models to enhance our matching engines, industry classification systems, and core product features.
  • You will help establish ML and MLOps best practices, laying the technical groundwork for sustained AI/ML development for years to come.
  • You will collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to define and execute AI strategies that are directly aligned with our core business objectives.
  • You will optimize AI and machine learning models for performance, accuracy, and scalability, ensuring they integrate reliably into our production platform.
  • You will develop and refine our recommendation systems, applying techniques in NLP, deep learning, and predictive analytics to fundamentally improve buyer-seller matchmaking.
  • You will create clear documentation and visualizations to communicate complex insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Who You Are

You are a technically excellent leader who thrives on ownership and building from the ground up.

  • You have 5+ years of experience using AI/ML and related technologies to materially improve consumer or B2B software experiences.
  • You possess strong production expertise specifically in building, modifying, and scaling machine learning recommendation systems and engines.
  • You are familiar with SQL and data warehouses (e.g., AWS Redshift) for powering AI-driven analytics.
  • You have outstanding problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and drive initiatives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

job.name: Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
A self-funded AI startup with $100M committed is hiring a Senior or Lead Engineer, Machine Learning to lead the production ML stack behind their AI-first consumer products.

You’ll be the person turning model research into real systems: training, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference and the infrastructure underneath it all. The product is aimed at billions of everyday users, so performance, cost and reliability aren’t afterthoughts. No VCs, no fundraising calendar, no outside board. Just a senior, fully remote team shipping.

Role: Senior or Lead Engineer, Machine Learning

Compensation: $200K - $400K base, OKR-based discretionary bonus, plus equity

Location: Remote, US based

What the role covers:

  • Lead the production ML stack end to end: data, training, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference and deployment
  • Design and run training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models
  • Build evaluation systems that capture capability, robustness, safety and how the product actually performs in the wild
  • Architect inference at scale, with sharp focus on latency, GPU utilisation, memory footprint, cost per request and reliability
  • Build real-world and synthetic data pipelines that feed training
  • Stand up the production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring and improving models continuously
  • Collaborate with research and application engineering to translate model progress into shipped product gains
  • Debug production issues quickly and keep user impact minimal
  • Support a small, senior ML team and keep the operating cadence sharp

Background we’re looking for:

  • 7+ years shipping production ML models and systems in industry
  • Strong Python, with deep PyTorch or JAX
  • Proven ownership across the full ML lifecycle, not just one slice of it
  • Hands-on with GPU-based training and inference, and instincts for the trade-offs that matter
  • Real experience operating high-performance inference stacks, such as vLLM or TensorRT-LLM
  • Fine-tuning, eval design and reliability engineering for large models
  • Pragmatic, iterative builder who prefers shipping over polishing
  • Thrives in a fully remote team with no set time zone requirements
  • Must already hold US work authorisation (no sponsorship available)

Bonus signals:

  • Prior work at an AI-native consumer product company or a foundation model lab
  • Synthetic data pipeline work at scale
  • Experience with mobile ML, on-device inference or latency-critical consumer AI
  • Technical lead experience inside a small, senior engineering team

This role would suit a senior ML engineer who wants real ownership of the production layer, a fully remote setup, and the stability of a company that doesn’t have to answer to a funding cycle.

job.name: Data Platform Engineer
job.description:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

Shift4 is seeking a Data Platform Engineer to join our Data Platform team and build, maintain, and optimize the pipelines that move data from our production systems into our analytics warehouse. Today, our infrastructure uses Amazon ECS services and SQS queues to replicate data from Aurora MySQL into Snowflake, with plans to expand to additional data sources and consumers as our platform evolves.

This is a hands-on infrastructure engineering role focused on pipeline performance, reliability, scalability, resource optimization, cost efficiency, and observability. You will help ensure data is delivered accurately, reliably, and on time as our data platform grows. Data modeling, warehouse cost management, and business transformation logic are managed by partner teams, allowing you to focus on the infrastructure and systems that power our data ecosystem—all while embracing the Shift4 way.

Responsibilities

  • Operate, tune, and scale the ECS/SQS-based ingestion pipelines from Aurora MySQL into Snowflake: task sizing, autoscaling, consumer concurrency, batching, retries, and dead-letter handling
  • Own pipeline reliability: define SLOs for freshness and lag, build alerting and dashboards, lead incident response and root-cause analysis for pipeline failures
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and CI/CD for pipeline services
  • Continuously benchmark and tune throughput versus cost across ECS, SQS, and Snowflake ingestion (Snowpipe/COPY, stages)
  • Onboard new sources and consumers to the platform in partnership with application, data, and analytics teams
  • Apply data-quality and security controls appropriate for PCI-compliant or payment-handling environments: encryption, secrets handling, least-privilege access, audit trails
  • Proactively explore and apply AI tools to improve efficiency across the pipeline lifecycle (development, testing, runbooks, and documentation)

job.name: Staff Data Engineer
job.description:
Camis is a recognized industry leader in reservation and park management technology. We connect people to a world of memorable experiences through our robust, user-friendly reservation software and best-in-class call center services. Trusted by over 1,300 government-operated parks, campgrounds, harbors, and marinas across North America, Camis is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions that make it easier for visitors to discover, book, and enjoy the most beautiful landscapes.

We believe work should be fun, fulfilling, and flexible—and we're looking for friendly, motivated people to join us!

Visit www.camis.com for more information on our products, services, and clients.

The Opportunity

We are committed to building software that stands the test of time, and we're looking for a Staff Data Engineer to own how data is stored, moved, modelled, and governed across our Parks & Recreation platform.

This is a hands-on, staff-level engineering role reporting to the CTO. You will own two connected parts of the Camis business: the performance and health of our Azure SQL production databases (Core), and the Snowflake data platform built on top of them. When the two compete for attention, Core comes first, because Core is production.

You will be the senior escalation point for Azure SQL production issues, the owner of our multi-tenant ELT platform (Meltano to Snowflake via dbt, orchestrated by Dagster on Azure Container Apps), and the steward of sensitive data, including PII classification, masking, right-to-erasure, and the scrubbing of non-production database copies.

You will also be the formal technical leader of our Data Work Group, a cross-functional team of analysts, DevOps engineers, and co-op students. You'll set the engineering standards for SQL, dbt, and pipeline work, and partner with product, finance, and leadership to turn questions into trusted metrics.

AI-assisted development is part of how we work at Camis. You will use AI coding tools in your day-to-day SQL, dbt, Python, and Terraform work, and apply rigorous guardrails so that changes involving personal data or production databases never rely on unreviewed AI output.

Our platform processes millions of reservations and transactions annually for agencies including Parks Canada, Ontario Parks, BC Parks, and Mississippi State Parks. The data systems you own will serve more than 30 production clients across our Canadian and US environments, and underpin real experiences for millions of visitors exploring some of North America's most treasured outdoor destinations.

• Role Title: Staff Data Engineer (Remote)
  • Role Type: Full-time
  • Location : Remote

The Role

This is a Staff-level, hands-on engineering role for someone who has built data infrastructure from zero to production and knows how to turn fragmented operational data into reliable, accessible, and actionable systems.

You'll own the architecture and implementation of our data warehouse, ingestion pipelines, transformations, and product analytics foundations.

We're building an AI-native organization where both humans and autonomous agents need access to trustworthy, well-structured data. You'll design the systems that make this possible, enabling self-service analytics, automated decision-making, and increasingly intelligent workflows across the company.

What You'll Do

1. Build our data platform from zero: Architect and implement our internal data warehouse, ingestion infrastructure, ETL/ELT pipelines, and core data models.

2. Create agent-ready data foundations: Design reliable, well-documented datasets and interfaces that AI agents can safely discover, query, and use.

3. Turn messy data into trusted systems: Transform fragmented operational and product data into consistent, high-quality sources of truth.

4. Enable self-service analytics: Build the infrastructure that allows engineering, product, and business teams to answer questions independently without relying on manual data requests.

5. Own product analytics infrastructure: Establish the event tracking, instrumentation, data models, and reporting foundations needed to understand product usage and performance.

6. Automate data operations: Leverage AI coding agents and intelligent automation to accelerate pipeline development, data validation, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

7. Build for reliability and scale: Establish data quality standards, observability, governance, and scalable architectural patterns from the beginning.

8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish strong data engineering practices, and lead architectural decisions through hands-on execution.

What We're Looking For

1. Staff-level engineering expertise with extensive hands-on experience building and operating production data platforms.

2. Proven greenfield experience: You've personally led the design and implementation of a data platform from scratch, rather than exclusively maintaining or extending existing infrastructure.

3. Deep understanding of data warehouses, ETL/ELT architectures, data modeling, orchestration, and distributed data processing.

4. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with the software engineering fundamentals needed to build reliable data infrastructure.

5. Experience with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or equivalent tools.

Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role? We’re building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most driven, and most curious people to help us do it. As the head of the Data Foundation pillar of our Analytics and Data Insights team, you’ll lead the team that makes Cohere’s data trustworthy, governed, and available: the warehouse every analytics surface runs on, the pipelines that keep it fresh, the access model that keeps it secure, and the agentic analytics layer that lets anyone at Cohere (and their agents) ask questions of governed data directly.

Your team owns the full data lifecycle. You’ll run ingestion into BigQuery from internal and external data sources, orchestrate it in Airflow and Cloud Run, model the data warehouse in dbt, and serve the results through Looker, export APIs, and customer-facing analytics surfaces. Everything is provisioned as code in Terraform, and governance is part of the design: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, and documented access paths that let people and agents move fast without putting data at risk.

This role is both highly visible and highly impactful, and you’ll inherit a solid structure on which to build the rest of the stack: a Terraform-provisioned warehouse framework, dbt modeling conventions, an alerting and incident-response practice, and documentation patterns to keep everything discoverable. The roadmap is set with big bets in flight: scaling that framework across the company, standing up an internal analytics agent with a real eval harness, and consolidating institutional knowledge into a self-correcting and self-maintaining system that keeps context centralized, current, and documented, rather than dispersed and in people’s heads.

Stack

New York City, in person, full time.

Overview We are seeking a versatile quantitative researcher with strong data engineering skills to join a newly formed systematic equities pod focused on intraday mean reversion and market microstructure strategies.

You will be responsible for building and maintaining the research data infrastructure, and for developing and testing trading signals using statistical and machine learning methods. This role combines data engineering rigor with quantitative research creativity.

You will work directly with the Portfolio Manager to turn raw market data into actionable trading signals.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or a related quantitative field
  • 3+ years of experience in a quantitative research or data-intensive role in a buy-side or sell-side financial firm
  • Strong programming skills in Python with deep proficiency in Polars, Pandas, NumPy, and SciPy
  • Solid understanding of statistical methods: regression, time-series analysis, hypothesis testing, cross-validation
  • Familiarity with equity markets, market microstructure, and intraday trading dynamics
  • Strong data engineering instincts: schema design, data quality, pipeline reliability
  • Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills and intellectual curiosity
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work In a small, fast-paced team

Preferred Skills / Experience

The Role You will build and operate components of our data platform: the pipelines that move healthcare data from customer EHR systems into Snowflake, and the models that turn that raw data into trusted core entities. You will work within workstreams scoped and architected with senior engineers on the team, and own your components end to end - building them, testing them, running them in production, and fixing them when they break.

This is a growth role. You will get direct exposure to enterprise-scale healthcare data problems, a modern stack (Snowflake, SQLMesh, Temporal, Python, AWS, Datadog), and senior engineers invested in ramping you. The expectation is a steep trajectory: components today, workstreams as you grow.

What You Will Do

  • Write production Python and SQL: extract logic, transformations, and data quality checks.
  • Contribute to our core entity models and learn the RCM domain that drives them.
  • Debug data quality and pipeline issues through to root cause, not just symptom.
  • Run what you build. You join the on-call rotation with support from senior engineers.
  • Develop AI-natively. AI coding tools (Claude Code and similar) are part of how this team designs, builds, and reviews.

What You Will Bring

  • 2+ years of software or data engineering experience with production code you can walk through in detail.

  • Exposure to at least one part of the modern data stack: a cloud warehouse, an orchestration tool, or a transformation framework.
  • Strong debugging instincts and honesty about what you know versus what you are guessing.
  • You respond well to feedback and probing - depth may still be developing, but the fundamentals and the trajectory are visible.
  • Interest in healthcare data. You do not need domain experience, but you need the appetite for a messy, regulated domain.

The base salary range for this position is $165,000 to $190,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we offer an annual bonus program, company equity, and a competitive benefits package.

Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

Why this role? The Data Infrastructure team at Cohere is responsible for the storage and data movement layer underlying every model training run. We're building the unified storage layer that feeds our training workloads at petabyte scale. In this role, you would have the opportunity to architect and lead the design of this system from the ground up, serving petabytes of training data and model checkpoints fast enough to keep thousands of GPUs busy across several training clusters. You'd be a key contributor, leading the effort to solve a problem few teams have tackled at this scale.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, architect, and operate the distributed storage system that feeds model training and evaluation, driving the technical vision from concept through production.

  • Collaborate with researchers and training-infra teams to define how jobs read and write data, translating those patterns into throughput, latency, and durability requirements that shape the platform's roadmap.
  • Navigate the networking, I/O, and consistency challenges of moving large datasets and checkpoints across regions and backends, with GPU idle time and time-to-insight as the key metrics of success — and drive the solutions that improve them.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • Strong storage fundamentals, including replication, consistency, caching, and data lifecycle management, with demonstrated architecture and design experience.
  • Strong coding ability in Python and Go, with the ability to lead implementations and mentor others in either language, and the willingness to contribute to the other.
  • Proven experience running stateful systems on Kubernetes, including Persistent Volumes, CSI drivers, and StatefulSets, with the capacity to design and execute operational strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud object storage such as S3 as well as POSIX-style filesystems.

The Activations Backend team is responsible for the bulk of big data processing that powers LiveRamp’s primary activation product, which delivers hundreds of millions in annual recurring revenue. Cumulatively, our systems process multiple exabytes per year. We provide detailed monitoring, statistics, error recovery, and resiliency to keep this core product reliable for our largest customers.

At LiveRamp, big data processing is not just for back-office analytics. Our product is a big data product: we transform, deduplicate, and transport massive datasets across clouds and regions, while respecting complex rate limits and SLAs, and enabling many of the most successful companies on the planet to activate their data safely and efficiently.

Your Team Will

  • Re‑architect Activations Back End to be cloud‑forward and multi‑regional, taking advantage of SingleStore and other modern data warehouses to replace legacy Spark‑heavy flows where it makes sense.
  • Deliver high‑throughput, low‑latency activation by combining: SingleStore‑backed state and delta computation, Spark/Dataproc for the heaviest batch workloads, and Streaming infrastructure (e.g., Redpanda/Pub/Sub) for event‑driven and incremental deliveries.
  • Build smarter orchestration and scheduling using Temporal/Cadence and queueing services to: Classify jobs (latency‑critical vs. throughput‑heavy vs. background), Route them through multi‑queue schedulers and capacity pools, respect destination‑specific rate limits and SLAs, and eliminate duplicated work through config canonicalization and caching so identical or similar jobs across customers share heavy computation.
  • Collaborate closely with partner teams (Identity, Data Foundation, Activations Fullstack, Integrations/OPI) to deliver end‑to‑end improvements in activation reliability, speed, and observability, and continuously raise the bar on operational excellence.

job.name: Quantitative Trader
job.description:
Company Description Quantizer Research, founded in 2019, is focused on becoming India’s leading quantitative trading and high-frequency trading (HFT) firm. The company builds ultra-low latency trading platforms and tools for real-time trade support, market access, and trading simulations. With a strong emphasis on scale, technology, algorithms, speed, and advanced mathematics, Quantizer’s tech team specializes in identifying profitable opportunities and optimizing performance metrics. Over the years, Quantizer has developed a state-of-the-art HFT infrastructure with some of the industry’s lowest latencies. Its product portfolio includes arbitrage trading platforms, an ultra-low latency C++ API for automated trading, and an advanced options trading platform with cutting-edge features and performance.

Role Description The Quantitative Trader role at Quantizer Research is a full-time, on-site position based in New Delhi. The role involves designing, developing, and executing quantitative trading strategies across various asset classes and markets. Day-to-day responsibilities include analyzing market microstructure, building and refining models for market making and arbitrage, and monitoring live trading performance. The Quantitative Trader will collaborate closely with developers and researchers to implement strategies on ultra-low latency systems, optimize execution, and manage risk. The role also includes backtesting strategies, reviewing performance reports, and continuously improving models based on changing market conditions.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess skills in Trading and Trading Strategies, including experience executing systematic or algorithmic strategies in live markets.
  • Candidates should possess skills in Market Making and Quantitative Investing, with a strong understanding of liquidity provision, risk management, and portfolio construction.
  • Candidates should possess skills in Quantitative Analytics, including statistical modeling, time-series analysis, and performance evaluation.
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages commonly used in quantitative finance (such as C++, Python, or Java) and familiarity with ultra-low latency trading environments.
  • Solid foundation in mathematics, statistics, and probability, ideally supported by a degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or related field).
  • Ability to work with large datasets, conduct rigorous backtesting, and interpret results to refine trading models.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively under time-sensitive market conditions.
  • Prior experience in HFT, options trading, or arbitrage strategies is an advantage but not mandatory.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!
