As Tech Lead for our API & Integration team, you’ll drive the technical direction of a critical integration landscape built on the Azure integration stack. You’ll shape integration architectures, set engineering standards, and lead by example in code—balancing new integration development with the stabilization and evolution of existing interfaces to ensure reliability, scalability, and security.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys designing clean APIs, building resilient event and message-driven integrations, and guiding teams through complex system landscapes—turning connectivity challenges into robust, well-governed Azure solutions.

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Project Role : Data Engineer

Project Role Description : Design, develop and maintain data solutions for data generation, collection, and processing. Create data pipelines, ensure data quality, and implement ETL (extract, transform and load) processes to migrate and deploy data across systems.

Must have skills : Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

As a Data Engineer, a typical day involves designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive data solutions that support data generation, collection, and processing activities. The role requires creating efficient data pipelines to facilitate smooth data flow and ensuring the integrity and quality of data throughout its lifecycle. Additionally, the position involves implementing processes to extract, transform, and load data, enabling seamless migration and deployment across various systems. Collaboration with different teams to optimize data handling and support organizational data needs is an integral part of daily responsibilities.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
  • Responsible for team decisions.
  • Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
  • Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
  • Lead efforts to optimize data workflows and improve system performance.
  • Mentor junior team members to enhance their technical skills and project contributions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives to align data engineering efforts with business objectives.

Professional & Technical Skills:

  • Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Experience in designing and implementing scalable data pipelines and ETL processes.
  • Strong knowledge of data architecture principles and best practices for data quality assurance.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and distributed computing environments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and optimize data processing workflows.
  • Experience working with diverse data formats and integrating data from multiple sources.

Additional Information:

  • The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • This position is based at our Chennai office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.

job.name: Consulting Senior Associate- Low Carbon Solutions – Electricity Networks & Energy Systems
job.description:
ERM is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.

Our Consulting Delivery Hub (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.

As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.

Why this role matters? As a Consulting Senior Associate within ERM's Low Carbon Solutions team, you will support global client projects by providing technical analysis, market insight, and strategic advice to help organizations navigate the transition to low-carbon energy systems. Working closely with regional consulting teams and energy sector stakeholders, you will contribute to the development of innovative solutions that enable decarbonisation, strengthen energy networks, and accelerate progress towards Net Zero.

What your impact is?

  • Deliver data-driven research and analysis to support low-carbon energy, electricity network, and energy systems projects.
  • Develop techno-economic models and analytical insights that inform client strategies and investment decisions.
  • Leverage Python and other analytical tools to produce efficient, reproducible, and high-quality project outputs.
  • Translate complex technical findings into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Produce high-quality reports, presentations, and client deliverables that support successful project outcomes.
  • Collaborate effectively with global project teams and clients to advance decarbonisation and sustainability goals.

What will you bring?

  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent qualification in physical science, engineering, economics, or another relevant discipline.
  • 2-3 years of relevant experience.
  • Good experience in Python and modelling.
  • Demonstrated interest in sustainability and the low-carbon energy transition.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and draw meaningful conclusions.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and time-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications, Skills & Competencies

  • Experience in low carbon energy and/or consultancy
  • Experience of software development
  • Fluency in European language
  • First class undergraduate degree

Key Responsibilities

job.name: Data Scientist
job.description:
Company Description Criclive.in is a fast-growing digital platform built to deliver the quickest live, ball-by-ball cricket commentary on the internet, matching the pace of live telecasts for fans worldwide. Over time, it has evolved into a comprehensive cricket destination, offering detailed features, in-depth articles, and breaking news from across the cricketing world. The platform also hosts an active fan discussion page, where cricket enthusiasts from around the globe share opinions, celebrate key moments, and debate trending topics. Criclive.in is driven by a passion for cricket and a commitment to creating an engaging, community-focused experience where fans can truly live the game together.
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Data Scientist role based in Janakpuri. The Data Scientist will work with large volumes of match, player, and user interaction data to derive insights that enhance live commentary, content recommendations, and fan engagement. Day-to-day responsibilities include collecting and cleaning data, building statistical and machine learning models, and generating dashboards and visualizations for product and editorial teams. The role involves collaborating closely with engineers, designers, and content specialists to translate analytical findings into practical features and improvements. The Data Scientist will also design experiments, monitor performance metrics, and continuously refine algorithms to improve user experience and platform performance.
Qualifications

  • Strong foundation in Data Science and Data Analytics, with experience applying these skills to real-world problems.
  • Solid understanding of Statistics and Data Analysis for hypothesis testing, forecasting, and performance measurement.
  • Proficiency in Data Visualization, using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Python/R visualization libraries.
  • Hands-on experience with programming languages commonly used in data work (e.g., Python, R, SQL) and related libraries.
  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques and frameworks, and experience deploying models into production is an advantage.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate in a cross-functional team.
  • Interest in cricket, sports analytics, or digital media platforms is highly beneficial.

job.name: Python Developer - Agentic AI & Enterprise Automation
job.description:
JD of Python Developer – Agentic AI & Enterprise Automation.

1 . Job Purpose

To design, develop, deploy, and maintain Python-based Agentic AI solutions that automate business processes, improve operational efficiency, support decision-making, and enable intelligent workflows across Kilburn Engineering Limited. The role will focus on developing secure, reliable, and scalable AI agents that can understand business requirements, retrieve relevant information, interact with approved enterprise applications, execute authorized tasks, and escalate exceptions to human users when required.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

· Design and develop AI agents using Python, Large Language Models (LLMs), and appropriate agentic AI frameworks.

· Develop single-agent and multi-agent solutions where justified by business requirements.

· Evaluate whether a problem requires an autonomous agent, a simpler LLM workflow, or conventional automation, choosing the most appropriate solution.

· Build AI solutions to assist with ERP-related queries, transaction analysis, exception identification, and operational reporting.

· Establish baseline measurements and track the business value delivered by deployed AI solutions.

· Follow coding standards, version-control practices, peer reviews, and secure software development principles.

· Integrate approved LLMs through secure APIs or enterprise-approved deployment methods.

· Apply appropriate access controls so that users retrieve only information they are authorized to access.

· Develop integrations between AI agents and approved enterprise applications, including Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Zoho CRM, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Power BI, as applicable.

· Establish evaluation datasets and test cases for AI agents and LLM-powered applications.

· Deploy Python and AI applications using approved cloud or on-premises infrastructure, depending on business requirements.

· Ensure that source code, technical documentation, credentials, and deployment assets remain under Kilburn's approved ownership and control.

3. Technical and Functional Skills

· Strong hands-on programming experience in Python.

· Knowledge of Python libraries, object-oriented programming, data structures, error handling, and asynchronous programming concepts.

· Practical experience building AI-powered applications or automation workflows.

· Knowledge of tables, pages, code units, reports, events, and extension-based customization

· Experience integrating applications through REST APIs, webhooks, and approved connectors.

4. Preferred Technical Skills

· Experience building AI solutions for manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, finance, or industrial operations.

· Relevant Python, cloud, or AI certifications are an advantage.

· Understanding of AI observability, tracing, evaluation frameworks, and LLM performance monitoring.

5. Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies

  • Work closely with clients to understand their infra constraints and tailor deployment accordingly

Pi-labs provides cutting-edge cybersecurity and intelligence solutions to governments and enterprises, helping them stay ahead of emerging cyber threats driven by the rapid adoption of AI. We specialize in developing advanced tools that safeguard digital ecosystems and ensure trust, safety, and authenticity. At pi-labs, you’ll work with a team of passionate experts at the forefront of AI-powered security technologies. Join us to build impactful solutions, solve complex challenges, and contribute to protecting the digital world as it evolves.

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Project Role : Data Engineer

Project Role Description : Design, develop and maintain data solutions for data generation, collection, and processing. Create data pipelines, ensure data quality, and implement ETL (extract, transform and load) processes to migrate and deploy data across systems.

Must have skills : Apache Spark

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

As a Data Engineer, your typical day involves designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive data solutions that support the generation, collection, and processing of data. You will be responsible for creating efficient data pipelines that facilitate smooth data flow across various systems. Ensuring the accuracy and quality of data is a key part of your role, along with implementing processes to extract, transform, and load data effectively. Your work enables seamless data migration and deployment, supporting the broader data infrastructure and analytics needs of the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
  • Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
  • Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver scalable data solutions.
  • Monitor and optimize data workflows to improve performance and reliability.
  • Document data processes and maintain clear communication with stakeholders.
  • Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support in their tasks.

Professional & Technical Skills:

  • Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Apache Spark.
  • Experience in building and managing data pipelines and workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of data processing frameworks and distributed computing.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and optimize large-scale data processing jobs.
  • Familiarity with data storage solutions and data integration techniques.
  • Understanding of data quality assurance and validation methods.

Additional Information:

  • The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Apache Spark.
  • This position is based at our Hyderabad office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.

Job Title: Store Infrastructure Analyst

Location: Mumbai Office

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Store Infrastructure Specialist to own and manage IT operations across our existing and upcoming international retail store network (Europe, UK, Australia, New Zealand, and Dubai). Sitting at the intersection of frontline store teams, central IT, and external vendors, you will oversee store IT setups, broadband and Wi-Fi connectivity, Mac/Windows endpoints, barcode scanner systems, asset lifecycles, and hardware procurement. You will ensure high store uptime, enforce foundational security controls, and act as the primary point of coordination for ISPs, hardware vendors, and internal stakeholders to keep daily retail operations running smoothly.

Scope

  • Store Networking & Connectivity: Own the setup, reliability, and ongoing coordination with store broadband and wireless infrastructure providers across international locations.
  • Store Endpoints & POS Peripherals: Oversee the deployment and maintenance of store endpoints and peripherals, coordinating closely with POS vendors to resolve day-to-day device health issues.
  • Store Asset Management & Hardware Procurement: Maintain end-to-end visibility and control over all store IT assets—from initial vendor sourcing and purchase order coordination through deployment, transfers, spare stock management, and warranty/RMA or end-of-life handling.

Key Responsibilities

1. Store IT Setup & Multi-Site Operations:
2. Manage end-to-end IT readiness for new store launches and ongoing operations across Europe, the UK, Australia, New Zealand, and Dubai.
3. Broadband, Wi-Fi & ISP Coordination:
4. Coordinate with regional broadband and wireless infrastructure providers to manage ISP connections, internet failover, and Wi-Fi Access Points. Basic knowledge of LAN/VLAN/DHCP fundamentals.
5. Endpoint, Scanner & POS Vendor Management:
6. Oversee the deployment and health of store Windows and macOS endpoints alongside handheld, counter/fixed, and wireless/Bluetooth barcode scanners (USB/HID/serial).
7. Store Asset Lifecycle Management:
8. Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all store hardware inventories, serial numbers, spare/backup stock, deployments, inter-store transfers, and RMA or end-of-life movements using Freshworks Asset Management (or similar ITAM/ITSM tools like ServiceNow, Jira, or Snipe-IT).
9. IT Procurement & Vendor SLAs:
10. Manage end-to-end store hardware procurement workflows—collecting vendor quotes, comparing technical specifications and pricing, and coordinating purchase orders and deliveries. Hold hardware vendors and ISPs accountable to SLAs and oversee warranty/RMA claims.
11. Cross-Functional Coordination:
12. Collaborate smoothly with Legal, HR, and central IT for vendor contracts and compliance, store staffing updates, and technical escalations.

Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

job.name: Agentic AI Engineer
job.description:
Agentic AI Engineer

About the Role

We are seeking an Agentic AI Engineer to design and build production AI agents that

can reason over enterprise data, retrieve supporting evidence, use tools safely, and

complete multi-step workflows with clear audit trails. You will work with Data Science,

Backend Engineering, Product, and client stakeholders to turn complex operational

decisions into reliable agent systems. You will also support the cloud deployments and

operational infrastructure setup in AWS.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agent architecture and orchestration: Design agentic workflows with explicit state, structured outputs, tool routing etc and support deployment and maintenance in cloud environment.
  • MCP and tool integration: Develop secure MCP servers, function tools, APIs, and SDKs that connect agents to databases, document stores, billing platforms, and workflow systems. Define typed contracts, authorization boundaries, validation, idempotency, and actionable error handling.
  • Retrieval and knowledge systems: Create RAG pipelines for payer policies, coding rules, prior-authorization requirements, historical resolutions, and internal procedures.
  • Human review and controlled autonomy: Implement confidence- and risk-based routing, approval checkpoints, reviewer feedback, reversible actions, and clear escalation paths.
  • Agent evaluation and testing: Build representative datasets and replay tests from historical cases. Measure tool-selection accuracy, groundedness, decision and action correctness, policy adherence, latency, and cost; add regression gates for prompts, models, tools, and workflow changes.
  • Security and governance: Protect sensitive data through least-privilege tool access, scoped credentials, prompt-injection defenses, input and output validation, PHI and PII controls, traceable decisions, and secure handling of untrusted documents.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Set up comprehensive logging, metrics, and alerting using systems like CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, or Elasticsearch to track query accuracy, latency, data drift, and system reliability.
  • Production application engineering: Build reliable Python and TypeScript services, asynchronous jobs, event-driven integrations, and model-provider abstractions. Package and deploy services with practical logging, tracing, versioning, and rollback support.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Experience: Five or more years in software, backend, or AI engineering, including hands-on experience building production LLM or agentic applications.
  • Languages & Core Tech: Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and REST/gRPC service

architectures.

  • Agent frameworks: Experience with n8n, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK or a comparable orchestration framework.

Primary Skill Strong TOSCA Test Automation with Oracle Fusion/Finance/HCM Modules.

Senior Automation Developer P3

  • Establish TOSCA ExecutionLists for smoke, targeted regression, and quarterly release regression.
  • Review TOSCA Modules, TestCases, and reusable components; enforce automation standards and mentor engineers.
  • Define TOSCA approaches for dynamic UI identification, synchronization, recovery, long-running processes, and test-data dependencies.
  • Support TOSCA CI/CD integration and distributed execution where applicable, improve suite stability, and prepare technical runbooks and knowledge-transfer materials.

How To Apply Please include your total/relevant TOSCA experience, Oracle Fusion modules automated, TOSCA certifications, current CTC, expected rate, notice period, and current location in your application.

job.name: TECHNICAL LEAD L1
job.description:
Job description:

Job Description Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to facilitate application solutions by developing and reviewing module-level codes, creating replication patterns, performing root cause analysis to identify recurring issues and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure stable, well-documented deliverables that meet business objectives.

͏

Areas of responsibility

Gathering of requirements-Participate in gathering requirements for specific modules and ensure clear, structured documentation. Work across multiple business processes to capture linkages, dependencies, and required changes.

͏

Solution Design-Facilitate creation of application solution designs for a specific module under the guidance of the Project Manager, ensuring alignment with business requirements and technical standards.

͏

Coding and Configuration-"Review the developed codes, resolve technical queries of the team for the assigned module and create consistent replication patterns, to ensure that the developed code aligns with the project standards.Collaborate with project managers through all phases of software development life cycle."

͏

Perform root-cause analysis to identify and troubleshoot recurring technical issues. Modify software codes to resolve errors, adapt to new hardware and software, enhance performance, and upgrade interfaces."

Implementation-"Collaborate with technical teams to validate configurations, facilitate integration of new applications, and address dependencies during deployment. Prepare user training documents and related frameworks to ensure smooth adoption new applications and minimize transition risks."

Mandatory Skills: SDET
.

Experience: 5-8 Years
.

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Avant de postuler à un emploi, sélectionnez votre langue de préférence parmi les options disponibles en haut à droite de cette page. Découvrez votre prochaine opportunité au sein d'une organisation qui compte parmi les 500 plus importantes entreprises mondiales. Envisagez des opportunités innovantes, découvrez notre culture enrichissante et travaillez avec des équipes talentueuses qui vous poussent à vous développer chaque jour. Nous savons ce qu’il faut faire pour diriger UPS vers l'avenir : des personnes passionnées dotées d’une combinaison unique de compétences. Si vous avez les qualités, de la motivation, de l'autonomie ou le leadership pour diriger des équipes, il existe des postes adaptés à vos aspirations et à vos compétences d'aujourd'hui et de demain.

Fiche De Poste Applies the principles of software engineering to design, develop, maintain, test, and evaluate computer software that provide business capabilities, solutions, and/or product suites. Provides systems life cycle management (e.g., analyses, technical requirements, design, coding, testing, implementation of systems and applications software, etc.) to ensure delivery of technical solutions is on time and within budget. Researches and supports the integration of emerging technologies. Provides knowledge and support for applications’ development, integration, and maintenance. Develops program logic for new applications or analyzes and modifies logic in existing applications. Analyzes requirements, tests, and integrates application components. Ensures that system improvements are successfully implemented. May focus on web/internet applications specifically, using a variety of languages and platforms. Defines application complexity drivers, estimates development efforts, creates milestones and/or timelines, and tracks progress towards completion.

Provides specific functional expertise that is theoretical and conceptual in nature. This expertise is typically acquired through a combination of university education and experience within a field. May have responsibility for supervising others in the capacity of a “player coach” but primary focus is individual expertise. Particularly at higher levels, sophisticated subject matter expertise is a requirement for success.

Applies in-depth conceptual and practical knowledge in own job discipline and basic knowledge of related job disciplines. Solves complex problems related to own job discipline by taking a new perspective on existing solutions. Builds consensus. Regularly acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. Works independently, receives minimal guidance.

Agile Engineering Best Practices

job.description:
Job Description Summary To administer the Online Gaming platform and monitor and report as part of a “shift-based operations” team on a 24x7 basis, ensuring optimum performance and availability of such platform, provide second-level troubleshooting support, and liaise with all applicable service providers and third parties. Achieve the goals established internally and follow SLAs and OLAs concerning service delivery to our customers (both external and internal).

Job Requirements

  • 4-6 years’ experience in a technical support / operational role
  • All-round, with broad scope technology knowledge, both windows and Linux.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of gathering and delivering information to both technical and non-technical collaborators.
  • A working knowledge of monitoring tools, both event management and metrics. For example – Grafana, Datadog.
  • Good problem-solving method and approach
  • Evidence of accountability and ownership when managing incidents.
  • Ability to analyse logs and solve issues.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
  • Docker/Kubernetes experience
  • Cloud Platform experience – Google GK, Amazon EKS
  • Experience with code repositories GitHub/GitLab
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases. For example MSSQL/MongoDB
  • Experience with DNS/HTTPS certificates.
  • Experience with orchestration tools Ansible and Ansible Tower.
  • Experience with event workflow ticketing systems, for example Freshdesk / Jira

Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality artwork that meets project briefs, exploring creative concepts and offering multiple executions.
  • 24x7 proactive monitoring and support of the live and staging infrastructure
  • Investigate and react to any live issues that occur.
  • Prepare and implement periodic releases for both infrastructure and software.
  • Act as a point of contact for a partner concern raised through customer channels.
  • Partake in the design and improvement of processes and activities related to the role.
  • Handle service requests, incident problems and change requests in line with ITIL v4 standard methodology.

Members of our NOC team are standout colleagues. They are passionate about technology and their jobs. They have a proactive and flexible attitude. They can handle daily tasks and projects while constantly learning new skills.

Sound fault-finding skills and an ability to react to problematic situations in a focused manner are essential in this role. It is essential that the person applying for this position is comfortable with shift work – The NOC offers 24x7 coverage.

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Project Role : Data Engineer

Project Role Description : Design, develop and maintain data solutions for data generation, collection, and processing. Create data pipelines, ensure data quality, and implement ETL (extract, transform and load) processes to migrate and deploy data across systems.

Must have skills : Machine Learning (ML)

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

As a Data Engineer, a typical day involves designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive data solutions that support the generation, collection, and processing of data. This role requires creating efficient data pipelines and ensuring the integrity and quality of data throughout its lifecycle. The position also involves implementing processes to extract, transform, and load data, facilitating seamless migration and deployment across various systems. Collaboration with different teams to optimize data workflows and troubleshoot any issues that arise is a key part of daily activities, ensuring that data infrastructure remains robust and scalable.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
  • Responsible for team decisions.
  • Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
  • Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable data architectures to support business needs.
  • Mentor junior team members to enhance their technical skills and project contributions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts to align data engineering initiatives with organizational goals.

Professional & Technical Skills:

  • Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Machine Learning (ML).
  • Strong experience in building and optimizing data pipelines and ETL processes.
  • Knowledge of data storage solutions and database management systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing frameworks.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve data quality and integration issues.
  • Experience with programming languages commonly used in data engineering such as Python or Scala.

Additional Information:

  • The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Machine Learning (ML).
  • This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.

job.description:
www.enchargeai.com

AI Compiler Engineer-Staff/Principal

Locations: Bangalore (Hybrid) Staff AI Compiler Engineer (Hybrid-2 days office/3 days -home)/Remote

The 10 Hottest Semiconductor Startups Of 2025 (So Far)

https://www.enchargeai.com/blog/the-efficiency-imperative-energy-will-define-ais-next-chapter

About EnCharge AI:

AI Compiler Engineer

EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. EnCharge’s robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today’s best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems.

About the Role

EnCharge AI is seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Compiler Engineer to spearhead the efforts in developing and optimizing graph compilers tailored to cutting-edge AI and ML workloads. You will collaborate with hardware architects, and AI researchers to enhance performance, optimize computation graphs, and enable efficient model deployment on EnCharge’s Inference Accelerators.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and implement optimizations for AI model execution on graph compilers to improve performance, reduce latency, and maximize hardware utilization.
  • Work closely with ML researchers, hardware engineers, and software developers to design and deploy AI models, understanding and addressing hardware-specific challenges.
  • Work on performance optimizations for neural network models, such as layer fusion, operator fusion, and graph-level transformations.
  • Develop compiler optimizations and passes that convert high-level AI models (e.g., from TensorFlow, PyTorch) into intermediate representations (IR).
  • Implement parsing, semantic analysis, and IR generation for deep learning frameworks.
  • Research and integrate the latest advancements in compiler design, ML model optimizations, and hardware acceleration into graph compilers.
  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to a team of engineers focused on graph compiler optimizations.

Qualifications

job.name: UI/UX Design Engineer – SaaSNova
job.description:
Role: UI/UX Design Engineer – SaaSNova

Job ID: DES-ENG-2026-IN

Design the experience behind SaaSNova's AI agents. As we build and scale agentic products for SaaS companies worldwide, we're hiring a UI/UX Design Engineer who can design, prototype and ship interfaces where people and AI agents work together, with precision, autonomy and founder-grade clarity.

  • Location: Chennai
  • Experience: 4+ years of hands-on UI/UX design, with front-end build experience
  • Compensation: Competitive, based on experience

About SaaSNova

SaaSNova accelerates Go-To-Market (GTM) success for SaaS companies worldwide. We help ISVs grow through hyperscaler ecosystems, partner-led strategies and Marketplace GTM programs, and we are now building AI agents that run these workflows at scale.

As UI/UX Design Engineer, you will own the experience layer of our agent products: how users brief an agent, follow its work, review its output and stay in control. This is a high-impact role working directly with the Founder.

Learn more about us:

  • 🌐 www.saasnova.ai
  • 🔗 Founder on LinkedIn: Jenepher Dawson
  • 📌 Follow our SaaSNova LinkedIn page for updates and opportunities

What You Will Own

1. Agent Experience Design

  • Design end-to-end flows for AI agents: briefing a task, watching progress, reviewing results and approving actions.
  • Create clear human-in-the-loop patterns for approvals, handoffs, corrections and error recovery.
  • Make agent behaviour transparent: show what the agent is doing, why, and what it needs from the user.
  • Design for trust and control, including undo, audit trails, confidence signals and safe defaults.

2. UI Design and Design Systems

  • Own the visual language of SaaSNova's agent products and internal tools.
  • Build and maintain a scalable design system: components, tokens, typography, spacing and states.
  • Produce wireframes, high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes in Figma.
  • Ensure every screen is accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA), responsive and consistent.

3. Front-End Build and Prototyping

  • Turn designs into production-ready UI using React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS (or similar).
  • Build fast prototypes to test agent interactions with real users before full development.
  • Work with engineers on streaming responses, loading and long-running task states, and real-time updates.
  • Keep design and code in sync so the design system ships as reusable components.

4. Research and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Run user interviews, usability tests and feedback loops with SaaS founders and partner teams.
  • Translate GTM and product requirements into flows, specs and design tasks with the Founder.
  • Collaborate with engineering, content and GTM teams to keep experiences accurate and on-brand.
  • Provide proactive communication and clear status updates.

Who You Are

job.name: Salesforce Developer
job.description:
Hiring for PULS Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of DIN-rail power supplies for industrial automation, with plants in Germany, the Czech Republic, China and Chennai. Its global IT team, spread across the same four countries, runs Salesforce as a core business platform connected to sales, service and SAP S/4HANA. PULS is hiring a hands-on developer in Chennai to build and extend that platform for business units worldwide.

Job Roles & Responsibilities

  • Build and enhance Salesforce solutions in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and Flow for global PULS business units.
  • Deliver Salesforce change requests on time and within budget: requirements analysis, technical design, build, testing, documentation and deployment.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA through SAP CPI, using REST/SOAP APIs and Platform Events.
  • Support releases, data migrations and cross-system projects with solution architects, administrators and integration developers.
  • Resolve incidents and problems raised by business stakeholders across countries.
  • Follow the team's development standards, code reviews, Git workflows and CI/CD deployments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development, writing Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and Flow.
  • Has built Sales Cloud features end to end, including configuration, security, data models, validation rules and automation.
  • Has designed and shipped at least one integration between Salesforce and an external system using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events or middleware.
  • Has deployed through Git-based version control and a CI/CD pipeline with Salesforce DX or similar deployment tools.
  • Has turned business-user requirements into maintainable solutions and troubleshot complex production issues.
  • Communicates clearly in English with stakeholders in several countries.
  • A plus: Platform Developer I/II certification, full-cycle implementations, SAP integration, Service Cloud, manufacturing or electronics industry experience, and work with implementation partners.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of a global Salesforce platform that is central to PULS's business.
  • A place in an international IT team across Germany, the Czech Republic, China and India.
  • Full-time, on-site role at PULS's Chennai office.

We are looking for a Performance Marketer (D2C & Marketplaces) to drive customer acquisition, revenue growth in ecommerce marketplaces.

This role will own paid marketing and organic growth across channels including Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, while also managing marketplace advertising on platforms like Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Blinkit and Instamart.

  • Highly analytical and comfortable working with marketing data

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to build and scale a high-growth ecommerce brand
  • Work closely with leadership on marketing strategy and growth initiatives
  • Own the full funnel from customer acquisition to retention

job.name: Technical Product Manager & Scrum Master
job.description:
Company Description Mirador Technologies is an information technology company focused on delivering end-to-end IT solutions and services that meet high standards of quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction. The organization is committed to keeping clients at the cutting edge of technology while optimizing cost and resource investments. Sentinel emphasizes strong customer partnerships and tailored solutions that align with evolving business and technology needs. With a vision to become a leading name in the IT industry, the company fosters a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth for its team members.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai for a Technical Product Manager & Scrum Master. The role involves leading product discovery and delivery, defining product requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and collaborating with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to build and enhance technology solutions. The Technical Product Manager & Scrum Master will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments for the team, and ensure alignment with product strategy and roadmap. Daily responsibilities include monitoring product performance, analyzing customer feedback and data, coordinating cross-functional programs, and ensuring timely and quality releases. The role also requires clear communication of progress, risks, and dependencies, while promoting best practices in Agile and product management.

Key roles and responsibilities

A. Product management

  • Define and maintain product vision, strategy and development roadmaps.
  • Translate business and customer requirements into functional and technical requirements.
  • Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRD), Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and functional specifications.
  • Define epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain and prioritize product backlogs.
  • Establish product development milestones and release schedules.
  • Evaluate competing products and identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Coordinate with management, sales, engineering and customer stakeholders.
  • Ensure product development aligns with business objectives and customer commitments.

B. Scrum and Agile management

  • Implement and manage Agile and Scrum methodologies across engineering teams.
  • Conduct daily stand-up meetings, sprint planning, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
  • Manage two-week development sprints or other agreed sprint cycles.
  • Ensure all development activities are properly documented and tracked.

job.name: Research - Intern
job.description:
RESEARCH INTERN

Company: Focus Realm

Mode: Remote

Duration: 3 Months (Extendable up to 6 Months)

Commitment: 1–2 Hours Daily | 5 Days a Week

Compensation: Unpaid Internship

ABOUT FOCUS REALM

Most hotels in India don't fail on strategy. They fail on the fourth floor at 11 PM — when the housekeeping attendant forgets the amenity list, when the F&B intern skips the temperature log, or when the night desk closes out a checkout without the deposit note.

Focus Realm is the operating standards platform for Indian hospitality. SOPs, training and compliance — running on the phones your team already carries, in the languages they actually speak.

WHY WE EXIST

Standards protect the guest, the brand, the star rating and the FSSAI license. Yet, in most Indian hotels, they exist as PDFs shared on WhatsApp, classroom training sessions that fade within a week, and audit files that nobody wants to open.

With 40–60% of frontline employees rotating annually, maintaining consistent operational standards remains a major challenge.

We're building the operating layer that keeps standards alive between audits — for the housekeeper on shift, the GM managing multiple properties and the corporate trainer trying to maintain consistency across hundreds of rooms.

WHAT FOCUS REALM DOES

One system, three portals — each designed for the people using it.

  • Employee Portal: Mobile-first, multilingual SOPs and training, helping employees access the right procedures for their daily tasks.
  • Manager Portal: Property-level visibility into operational performance, identifying gaps, training requirements and compliance issues.
  • Author Portal: Corporate-level content management to create standards, publish them across properties, manage versions and monitor implementation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Focus Realm is looking for research-oriented individuals interested in exploring real-world industry challenges, market trends, business practices and emerging opportunities.

This internship primarily focuses on SECONDARY RESEARCH.

Interns will collect, review, analyse and interpret information from existing sources such as:

  • Industry reports and market studies • Company websites and business reports • Published articles and industry publications • Government reports and publicly available data • Competitor websites and existing business solutions • Other credible online sources

The research findings will be used to develop descriptive research papers, informative articles and business-oriented content for publication as part of Focus Realm's proprietary research portfolio.

IMPORTANT: This is a practical industry research internship, NOT an academic or scholarly research programme.

Interns are not expected to conduct university-level research, write academic theses, develop complex research methodologies or undertake primary data collection.

Job Summary We are seeking an experienced SAP Fiori Senior Consultant to design, develop, and implement SAP Fiori/UI5 applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP UI5, Fiori design principles, OData services, and integration with SAP backend systems. This role involves working closely with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver user-friendly and scalable SAP solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop SAP Fiori/UI5 applications aligned with business requirements.
  • Implement Fiori Launchpad configuration, catalogues, groups, and roles.
  • Develop and consume OData services (Gateway) for SAP applications.
  • Extend standard SAP applications using SAPUI5 and Fiori elements.
  • Customize and enhance SAP standard Fiori apps.
  • Collaborate with ABAP teams for backend development and performance optimization.
  • Ensure adherence to SAP Fiori design guidelines and UX standards.
  • Perform troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning of Fiori applications.
  • Participate in end-to-end implementations, upgrades, and support activities.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members.
  • Work in Agile/Scrum environments and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 development.
  • Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery.
  • Experience with SAP Gateway and OData services.
  • Knowledge of Fiori Launchpad configuration and administration.
  • Experience with Fiori Elements and Smart Controls.
  • Integration experience with S/4HANA or ECC backend systems.
  • Familiarity with ABAP (debugging, enhancements, CDS views).
  • Experience in SAP Web IDE / BAS (Business Application Studio).
  • Knowledge of UI/UX best practices and responsive design.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and in team-oriented environments.
  • Leadership and mentoring capabilities.

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

Certifications (Good To Have)

  • SAP Certified Development Associate - SAP Fiori Application Developer.
  • SAP UI5/Fiori certifications or related SAP certifications.

job.name: Senior MS Network engineer(L2)
job.description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).

Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go-to person for second-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.

You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.

As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.

You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.

job.name: Embedded Bootloader Engineer - UFS/ZeBu
job.description:
Job Requirements Role Embedded Bootloader Engineer - UFS / ZeBu

Experience 3-6 years

Primary Skills Embedded C, BootROM/Bootloader, UFS, Synopsys ZeBu, SoC bring-up and validation

Work Focus UFS boot development and pre-silicon validation on RTL/emulation platforms

Role Summary

We are looking for an Embedded Bootloader Engineer with 3-6 years of experience in low-level embedded software, bootloader development and SoC validation. The engineer will bring up and validate UFS boot functionality on an existing ROM bootloader using RTL/emulation platforms such as Synopsys ZeBu.

The role covers BootROM execution against the SoC RTL/emulation environment, UFS link and protocol bring-up using Synopsys UFS VIP/transactors, boot partition access, SBL integration, error handling, regression testing and technical documentation.

Key Responsibilities And Mandatory Skills

  • 3-6 years of hands-on embedded software or firmware development experience, with strong programming skills in Embedded C.
  • Set up and validate the incoming ROM bootloader, CPU and Synopsys ZeBu emulation environment, including the required transactors.
  • Load and execute ROM images; perform CPU reset, BootROM entry, memory and basic platform sanity checks.
  • Understand the existing boot flow and develop or extend the UFS boot path in the ROM bootloader.
  • Integrate and configure UFS transactor-based Synopsys VIP and validate UFS device initialization and link establishment.
  • Debug UFS initialization, link, command, transaction, timeout and protocol issues across BootROM, controller, RTL and verification environments.
  • Possess working knowledge of UFS, including Boot LUN or boot partition access, data transfer, error handling, and general UniPro/M-PHY concepts.
  • Perform register-level and transaction-level analysis using software logs, waveforms, register dumps and protocol traces.
  • Implement and validate access to the UFS boot partition or Boot LUN, boot-image read, memory loading and BootROM-to-SBL handoff.
  • Implement and validate the complete UFS boot flow, including positive, negative, recovery, and error scenarios.
  • Develop the UFS boot validation test plan, test cases, expected results and acceptance criteria.
  • Execute bootloader and system-level tests and regressions on ZeBu/RTL environments and verify non-regression of existing boot flows.
  • Triage failures and determine whether the issue originates in BootROM/software, RTL integration, the UFS subsystem, VIP/transactor, or the test environment.
  • Maintain requirement-to-test traceability and prepare test execution, defect analysis and regression reports.
  • Prepare and maintain the environment setup/user guide, bootloader design documentation, UFS boot-flow documentation, test plan, test procedures, test cases, validation reports and known-issue notes.
  • Demonstrate a good understanding of processor reset/startup, memory-mapped I/O, register-level programming, interrupts, clocks, resets, me

job.description:
As a Senior Full Stack Java Automation Engineer at Citi, you will build and scale the test automation and generative AI-driven quality platforms used across global technology teams. You will own core modules of Citi's proprietary FAST automation framework, orchestrate enterprise test telemetry through tools such as Zephyr and AWS ECS, and advance how generative AI is applied to automated test creation. This is an opportunity to bring deep software engineering and quality assurance expertise to shape testing strategy across multiple lines of business.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain full stack Java components across Citi's FAST automation framework modules, including fast-cd-zephyr, fast-playwright-js, fast-zephyr-uploader, and fast-tdm.
  • Orchestrate AWS ECS cron jobs across multiple FAST Dashboard instances to capture real-time test execution data and synchronize results into Zephyr ALM.
  • Develop reusable Playwright and Selenium automation utilities, including page object model components, to modernize end-to-end testing across distributed web applications.
  • Guide cross-functional teams across multiple lines of business toward shared automated regression coverage and reporting benchmarks.
  • Build executive reporting tools that summarize test execution status across applications using automated color-coded indicators.
  • Architect generative AI test-generation capabilities within Friday.ai, integrating Playwright code generation into LLM prompt-to-code pipelines that produce validated BDD feature files and executable scripts.
  • Design agentic workflows and synthetic test data generation utilities that convert business requirements into test plans, test scenarios, and enterprise-aligned test data.
  • Build Streamlit-based QA copilot tools that help engineering teams debug and triage automation issues faster.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 4+ years of software engineering and quality assurance experience, delivering enterprise-scale test automation within Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, or JavaScript, with a solid foundation in object-oriented design and data structures.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, REST Assured, and Cucumber/Gherkin BDD practices.
  • Experience integrating test automation pipelines with test management and reporting tools such as Zephyr, ALM, and Jira.
  • Experience deploying and scheduling automated workloads in cloud environments such as AWS ECS, supported by CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Git-based version control.
  • Experience applying generative AI techniques, such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic workflows, to software testing use cases.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across multiple teams and lines of business.

job.name: Acuver Consulting - Senior Consultant - IBM Sterling OMS
job.description:
Role Overview Acuver Consulting is seeking a highly energetic IBM Sterling OMS Senior Consultant with 5 to 8 years of relevant experience. In this pivotal role, you will lead the engineering of Sterling Commerce platforms for global retailers. You are expected to move beyond execution, taking ownership of technical strategy, architectural direction, and the design of highly scalable, performance-intensive omnichannel solutions.

Core Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Define and drive the technical strategy and architectural direction for large-scale E-Commerce platforms.
  • Complex Solution Design: Translate intricate business requirements into specialized technical designs, ensuring the solution is flexible for future business expansion.
  • Hybrid Engineering: Lead the development of "Sidecar" microservices using Spring Boot to extend Sterling's core capabilities without bloating the base product.
  • Full-Lifecycle Ownership: Drive all project phases: from conceptualization and fit-gap analysis to high-stakes production implementation and performance tuning.
  • Client Advisory: Interact directly with client-side stakeholders and architects to recommend architectural best practices and demonstrate the team's engineering excellence.

Technical Skills

  • IBM Sterling OMS Mastery: In-depth knowledge of version 10.0+ or OMOC, including the Configuration Deployment Toolkit (CDT), IV, SIP, Global Inventory Visibility (GIV), and complex Order Flows.
  • Advanced Backend Engineering: Mastery of Java and Spring Boot for building high-performance, resilient microservices and RESTful APIs.
  • Data Expertise: Expert-level knowledge of Oracle/DB2 SQL and Sterling DB schemas; ability to identify and resolve complex transaction locking and indexing issues.
  • Performance Architecture: Proven ability to write efficient, structured code and tune system agents/services for maximum throughput.

Highly Desirable

  • Cloud & Modern Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (OpenShift), and building CI/CD pipelines for OMS deployments.
  • Frontend & UX: Proficiency in Angular, React, or Node.js to customize IBM Web Store and Call Center interfaces.
  • Event-Driven Patterns: Experience with message brokers like Kafka or RabbitMQ for real-time system integrations.
  • Modern Data: Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra) for high-speed data caching and retrieval.
  • Intelligence & Reporting: Exposure to AI-driven modules like Intelligent Promising and advanced reporting via Jasper Reports.

Professional Attributes

  • Agility & Adaptability: Proven ability to react quickly and adapt to changing priorities in high-pressure retail environments.
  • Mentorship: Experience in coordinating work with intra-company team members and mentoring junior consultants on best practices.
  • Metric-Driven: Ability to generate and communicate meaningful development metrics to both technical teams and business stakeholders.

job.name: CX - Oracle Fusion Field Service Cloud Software Engineer with 5+ years’ experience
job.description:
Job Description As a member of the the software engineering division, your focus is to deliver post-sales support and solutions to the Oracle customer base while serving as an advocate for customer needs. This involves resolving post-sales non-technical customer inquiries via phone and electronic means, as well as, technical questions regarding the use of and troubleshooting for our Electronic Support Services. A primary point of contact for customers, you are responsible for facilitating customer relationships with Support and providing advice and assistance to internal Oracle employees on diverse customer situations and escalated issues.

As a Software Engineer, you will be the technical interface to customers, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Value-Added Resellers (VARs) for resolution of problems related to the installation, recommended maintenance and use of Oracle products. Your primary task will be to provide support to customers who contact the Oracle Solution Center and maintain high level of customer satisfaction while meeting guidelines (mostly through electronic means). Able to work with general guidance from senior support engineers and management and, in some areas, may work independently. Solutions often take time to develop through research, collaboration or problem replication.Provide technical leadership to other software developers. Specify, design and implement modest changes to existing software architecture to meet changing needs.

Duties and tasks are standard with some variation. Completes own role largely independently within defined policies and procedures. One year prior working experience with Oracle products (or at least two years related experience without Oracle products) and technical degree i.e., BS Computer Science/Management Information Systems/Science/ Engineering/Math/Physics/Chemistry with a 3.0 GPA OR functional degree + technical higher degree or in lieu of degree may substitute 4 years professional experience & professional certification (i.e., CNE, MCSE, CPA, Oracle, etc.).

Responsibilities Position is for a Techno/Functional Support Professional, preferably with implementation background in Field Service Cloud Applications.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to providing excellence in customer service support, diagnosis, replication, resolving Functional issues of complex and critical service requests. The focus of this position is to provide Customer Service on a Functional level and to ultimately drive complete and total resolution of each issue reported by customer.

Job Responsibilities:

The main role of a Support engineer is to troubleshoot and resolve highly complex Functional problems. The key skills put to use on a daily basis are - high level of Functional skills, Oracle products knowledge, problem solving skills, and customer interaction/service expertise.

job.name: Data Analyst (SAP MDM / Databricks)
job.description:
Hiring for TAO The Automation Office — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

TAO The Automation Office is an enterprise intelligent automation consulting and solutions company.

About the Role

We are hiring two Data Analysts with at least 8 years of relevant experience (target 8–10 years; candidates above 10 years remain eligible), to migrate data-quality rules from SAP data sources into Databricks. This is a hands-on development and validation role requiring practical MDM development and SQL-based extraction, not theoretical exposure.

What you'll do

  • Identify SAP tables and fields used by existing data-quality rules and reports, and map them to corresponding data in Databricks.
  • Validate data completeness, structure and required-field availability across bronze, silver and other Databricks layers.
  • Build a proof of concept by implementing selected existing data-quality rules in Databricks.
  • Execute migrated rules, reconcile outputs against existing results, investigate differences and resolve defects.
  • Migrate agreed as-is rules end to end, including SQL logic, data mappings, outputs and transformations.
  • Validate source data, rules, results and defects to ensure expected outcomes.
  • Support data-quality KPIs, outputs and dashboards, including report-result validation.

What you bring

  • At least 8 years of relevant experience.
  • Hands-on MDM development experience and practical experience reading and extracting data from MDM tables.
  • Strong SQL coding and database-querying skills.
  • SAP MDM experience and a good understanding of SAP tables and fields.
  • Practical ETL or ELT, Databricks and Python or PySpark experience.
  • Experience in data quality, data validation and reconciliation across different sources.
  • Ability to translate data-quality requirements into technical SQL or Python logic.
  • Experience testing data-quality rules, investigating defects and troubleshooting discrepancies.
  • Degree-level education.

Nice to have

  • Depth in SAP master-data domains.
  • Experience validating data-quality KPIs and dashboard outputs.

job.name: WeRize - Senior Software Engineer - Backend
job.description:
About The Job About WeRize: Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India's largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India.

WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks.

PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property, health and life insurance and investment products.

WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.

While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves.

So, a pure digital model doesn't work for this segment.

WeRize has innovated on this front through its 'Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)', a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support.

These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on-the-ground financial services providers.

Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn't work for this segment.

While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city.

That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies.

WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own.

This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com

job.name: Specialist, Financial Operations
job.description:
Job Title: Specialist, Financial Operations

Description: In this role, You'll Drive transformation across Rights & Royalties operations by leveraging business analysis, data analytics, and workflow automation to improve accuracy, efficiency, controls, and decision-making. Partner with Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to deliver actionable insights, scalable processes, and measurable business outcomes. This role aligns with industry titles such as Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst or Business Analyst – Rights & Royalties Transformation

The Role

We are seeking a high-impact Business Analyst / Data Analyst (3–4 years’ experience) to join the Rights & Royalties Transformation Group. This role blends business analysis, analytics, and workflow automation to improve royalty accuracy, cycle times, controls, and decision visibility. The ideal candidate is fast, agile, and execution-focused, able to grasp business fundamentals quickly, translate them into data and process requirements, and deliver measurable operational outcomes through dashboards, automation, and standardisation. Royalties domain experience is a strong advantage (rights, licensing, royalty calculations, statements, author/vendor payments, deductions, reserves, contractual terms).

What You'll Own

  • Build trusted operational and financial visibility for Rights & Royalties via dashboards and KPIs.
  • Drive automation and simplification of recurring operational activities (exceptions, validations, reconciliations, reporting packs).
  • Reduce rework, disputes, and leakage risks through improved data quality and process controls.
  • Enable faster decision-making through standardised reporting and self-serve insights.
  • Conduct rapid discovery of current processes (as-is), pain points, and root causes across rights, royalties, and related finance operations.
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes (cycle time, error reduction, SLA improvement).
  • Partner with Operations, Finance, Product/Tech and stakeholders to design to-be processes using the lens: Standardise Automate Optimise Scale.
  • Drive execution: prioritise backlog, manage dependencies, support UAT, and ensure adoption with crisp documentation and training aids.
  • Define and maintain KPI frameworks for Rights & Royalties and convert them into operational dashboards.
  • Build and maintain dashboards using Tableau and/or Looker, ensuring performance, data integrity, and stakeholder usability.
  • Perform deep-dive analytics to identify trends and anomalies.
  • Develop actionable insights and recommendations; present them in executive-ready formats.
  • Identify high-volume manual activities suitable for automation.
  • Build workflow automations and lightweight tools using Power Automate.
  • Support integration patterns and data pipelines in collaboration with engineering/BI teams.

job.name: Palo Alto Firewall Engineer, Level 1
job.description:
Hiring for Zurich Insurance — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Zurich Insurance Group is one of the world's largest multi-line insurers, serving customers in more than 200 countries and territories. In 2026 Zurich opened its Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad as a zero-legacy, AI-first technology hub. Its Security Platform Services team is building an in-house network security engineering capability there, taking over firewall operations for Zurich's global estate.

About the Role

As a Level 1 Palo Alto Firewall Engineer you're the first line of Zurich's global firewall service. You keep the Palo Alto estate healthy, diagnose incidents, and carry out approved changes under strict change control. Along the way you learn automation and AI-assisted operations, so you can grow into a broader engineering role.

This is a hybrid role from Hyderabad. Candidates who can join immediately or within 15 days are preferred.

What you'll do

  • Monitor the health, availability, capacity and alerts of Palo Alto firewalls, Panorama and VPN services
  • Do structured first-line diagnosis of firewall, NAT, DNS, VPN and connectivity incidents using logs and telemetry
  • Make approved standard changes, including security rules, network objects and NAT, within change controls
  • Work through service requests and tickets with clear updates, implementation evidence and validation results
  • Escalate complex or high-risk issues to Level 2 engineers with diagnostics and business impact
  • Support health checks, configuration compliance, rule recertification and audit evidence
  • Keep runbooks and the knowledge base current, and spot repeat work that could be automated

What you bring

  • 1–3 years in network operations, network security or infrastructure support
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls
  • A solid grasp of TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, NAT, segmentation and VPN
  • You have made firewall rule or NAT changes in production and troubleshot traffic from firewall logs
  • You have worked tickets under ITIL incident, change and request processes (e.g. ServiceNow)
  • Clear written communication and careful documentation

Nice to have

  • PCNSA, CCNA or a similar certification
  • Some Python, REST APIs, Ansible or Terraform
  • Exposure to cloud network security on Azure or AWS
  • Using AI tools in day-to-day troubleshooting and documentation

Originally posted on: 5 Nov 2026

General Information

Ref # 238610

Location: India-Ahmedabad CDC

Job family: Not Specified

Closing Date: 2026-12-11

Description We are recruiting for the role of Corporate Services Coordinator in the Corporate Services Department , based at our Combined Delivery Center (CDC) in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

The position is primarily responsible for providing administrative and records support for the Qatar Airways Group property portfolio. Maintain accurate property data and systems, reconcile records, produce and validate operational reports, support inspections and audit checks, and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve data and invoicing queries.

Accountabilities- Property Data and Reporting

  • Conduct regular reconciliation of system data, ensuring accuracy in reporting and database management.
  • Produce and validate operational reports such as occupancy, allocation and aging reports, and assist the Line Manager in creating ad-hoc reports as required by Management.
  • Update and maintain operational systems and customer master databases to ensure accountability and avoid data duplication or discrepancies, troubleshooting system errors in collaboration with the IT department.
  • Generate invoices, update Oracle reference numbers and manage accounts receivable; track utility invoices and ensure timely processing and payments.

Inspections and Compliance

  • Carry out regular building inspections of vacant premises in coordination with the maintenance team.
  • Ensure compliance and conduct spot audit checks, raising queries with the concerned stakeholders.
  • Submit inspection reports where assets need to be repaired or replaced, highlighting any misuse with the cost to be recovered.
  • Report safety, security, hygiene or any other issues related to Company property to the Maintenance Manager.

Stakeholder Coordination and Improvement

  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders for data verification, invoice validation and resolving queries.
  • Identify and suggest improvements to streamline operations and enhance efficiency.
  • Perform other department duties related to the position as directed by the Line Manager or Head of Department.

We’re hiring an MBA Intern | Project Management, Operations & Finance

Anytime Fitness Gujarat | Ahmedabad, on-site | 3 months | ₹15,000–₹20,000/month

job.name: Industrial Engineer - Apparel Manufacturing (work Ex 5-7 Years)
job.description:
Company Description BBS GLOBAL PVT. LTD. is a manufacturer and exporter of protective workwear, flame-resistant (FR) and high-visibility garments, and other professional clothing for diverse industries.

Fill the below form link to Apply

https://automateforms.ai/form/14ccd241-e90b-40c5-81ed-fa51f90c7cca

Role Description: This is a full-time on-site Industrial Engineer position located in Kolkata. The Industrial Engineer will focus on optimizing manufacturing processes. Responsibilities include analyzing workflows, developing process improvements, implementing efficiency strategies, and ensuring the production meets quality standards. Effective communication and collaboration with cross-functional teams will be essential to achieve organisational goals.

﻿ Key responsibilities

SAM and operation bulletins

  • Prepare operation breakdowns and SAMs for every enquiry and confirmed order, from tech packs, samples or photos
  • Use GSD or another PMTS method, verified by stopwatch time studies (rating and allowances)
  • Build and maintain a SAM database by product type and operation (trousers, coveralls, jackets, bib-trousers, parka, etc)
  • Give SAM and labour-content inputs to merchandising for CMT and cost-per-minute quotations and Production team for target setting.

Line planning and balancing

  • Calculate takt time, manpower and machine requirements for each style
  • Prepare line layouts and balance operators to remove bottlenecks before production starts
  • Plan style changeovers to cut learning-curve losses and lost output
  • Support PPC with capacity in minutes and line-days for order booking and delivery dates

Methods and productivity

  • Run method studies and set the best method for each critical operation
  • Specify folders, guides, attachments and work aids to cut SAM and improve quality
  • Train operators and supervisors on new methods; maintain the operator skill matrix
  • Run lean initiatives: 5S, SMED, kaizen, waste reduction and value stream mapping

Monitoring and reporting

  • Track hourly output, line and operator efficiency, WIP and lost time with reasons
  • Publish daily and weekly efficiency reports with root causes and actions
  • Keep production data accurate in our ERP and target-tracking systems
