job.name: CX - Oracle Fusion Field Service Cloud Software Engineer with 5+ years’ experience
job.description:
Job Description As a member of the the software engineering division, your focus is to deliver post-sales support and solutions to the Oracle customer base while serving as an advocate for customer needs. This involves resolving post-sales non-technical customer inquiries via phone and electronic means, as well as, technical questions regarding the use of and troubleshooting for our Electronic Support Services. A primary point of contact for customers, you are responsible for facilitating customer relationships with Support and providing advice and assistance to internal Oracle employees on diverse customer situations and escalated issues.

As a Software Engineer, you will be the technical interface to customers, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Value-Added Resellers (VARs) for resolution of problems related to the installation, recommended maintenance and use of Oracle products. Your primary task will be to provide support to customers who contact the Oracle Solution Center and maintain high level of customer satisfaction while meeting guidelines (mostly through electronic means). Able to work with general guidance from senior support engineers and management and, in some areas, may work independently. Solutions often take time to develop through research, collaboration or problem replication.Provide technical leadership to other software developers. Specify, design and implement modest changes to existing software architecture to meet changing needs.

Duties and tasks are standard with some variation. Completes own role largely independently within defined policies and procedures. One year prior working experience with Oracle products (or at least two years related experience without Oracle products) and technical degree i.e., BS Computer Science/Management Information Systems/Science/ Engineering/Math/Physics/Chemistry with a 3.0 GPA OR functional degree + technical higher degree or in lieu of degree may substitute 4 years professional experience & professional certification (i.e., CNE, MCSE, CPA, Oracle, etc.).

Responsibilities Position is for a Techno/Functional Support Professional, preferably with implementation background in Field Service Cloud Applications.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to providing excellence in customer service support, diagnosis, replication, resolving Functional issues of complex and critical service requests. The focus of this position is to provide Customer Service on a Functional level and to ultimately drive complete and total resolution of each issue reported by customer.

Job Responsibilities:

The main role of a Support engineer is to troubleshoot and resolve highly complex Functional problems. The key skills put to use on a daily basis are - high level of Functional skills, Oracle products knowledge, problem solving skills, and customer interaction/service expertise.

Education & Experience:

job.name: : Senior Test Automation Engineer -Assistant Vice President
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Test Automation Engineer with 12+ years of experience to lead and execute test automation across our web, API, and backend systems. This is a hands-on technical role focused on building robust automation scripts, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring high software quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Automation Development: Build, maintain, and enhance automated test suites for Web UI, REST APIs, and Databases.
  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into build pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) for continuous feedback.
  • Test Planning & Execution: Design test scenarios from user stories, execute functional/regression tests, and analyze failures.
  • Defect Management: Identify, log, and track bugs in Jira with clear root-cause details.
  • Code Reviews & Mentoring: Review automation PRs, enforce coding standards, and guide junior/mid-level QA team members.

Technical Skills Required

  • Programming Languages: Java, TypeScript / JavaScript
  • UI Automation: Selenium WebDriver
  • API Testing: REST Assured, Postman / Soap UI
  • Test Frameworks: TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber (BDD)
  • CI/CD & DevOps: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Docker
  • Database: Strong No SQL querying - Mongo DB
  • Tools: Git, Jira, Zephyr

Qualifications & Experience

  • Total Experience: 12+ years in Software Testing / Quality Assurance.
  • Automation Experience: 8+ years of hands-on test automation and framework development.

job.name: Risk Operations and Issues Management Officer
job.description:
About Us As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com

Job Description Reporting to the Head of Risk Operations and Insights you will join a dedicated team within the Group’s Risk & Compliance (R&C) Non-Financial Risk function. In this role you will have responsibility for supporting the end-to-end Issues Management process, critical to identifying and resolving risks materialising throughout the business. In doing so you will leverage a solid understanding of risk within financial services and the Group’s GRC tool (Archer). Your proactivity, critical thinking, adaptability, stakeholder management and diligence will be instrumental to your success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for ensuring issues logged in the Group’s GRC tool are complete and well-articulated through communication with key stakeholders across the business;
  • Use analytical skills to look beyond the numbers, analyzing issues data to spot trends, recurring root causes and emerging themes, and help explain what they mean for the business;
  • Use a sound understanding of risk and the importance of issues in managing that risk to continuously improve the effectiveness of the issues management process;
  • Assist in running the team’s governance forums by preparing pre-reads, keeping the action log up to date and following up on agreed actions;
  • Use in depth knowledge of the Archer tool and Issues Management module to be the go-to person for issue owners using Archer: share guidance and support users use of the system;
  • Help with the preparation of reports and dashboards for senior leaders and committees;
  • Work with internal teams and Archer on improvements to the tool and its reports;
  • Support ad hoc requests, such as audit or regulatory information requests;

job.name: Zonal MIS Analytics Executive - South
job.description:
Job Purpose To work as an important link between Marketing Function (for all domestic markets and some international markets like Nepal & Bangladesh) and Logistics Department so as to facilitate movement of goods in the most cost effective manner and on OTIF (On-time, In-Full) principle.

Job Context & Major Challenges

  • With the launch of multiple products, the movement of goods has become a challenging task in the Unit, more-so in the context of higher no. of SKUs. The challenge gets multiplied with the dynamics and uncertainties of competitive market conditions wherein, the logistics & dispatch plans are not static in a given period.
  • The uncertainties arising out of external factors (like change in fuel prices, local logistical advantages of competitors in specific markets, troughs & crests in monthly off-take of Stockists linked to ongoing market-demand, road transporters strike, impact of seasonality on availability of adequate means of transportation etc.) lead to daily fine-tuning of dispatch plan and coordination with various internal customers/ external agencies so that the Monthly/ Quarterly/ Yearly Sales target are met.
  • Also, the coordination task with relevant All-India offices of CONCOR (tasks like rake-planning & transhipment planning, control of financial liabilities arising out of damages/ ground-rents/ penalties/ demurrages, maintaining cordial relations with key-decision-makers and staff in CONCOR & Indian Railways etc.), demands dedicated focus and highly effective coordination & interpersonal skills.Key Challenges
  • Uncertain market conditions impacting the variables of transportation/ movement of goods.
  • To coordinate with All-India marketing team and ensure maintenance of Optimum Stock Level in all the Depots, to avoid a stock-out position, even in the most uncertain situations.
  • Manage On-Time, In-Full delivery of all the SKU (Stock-keeping Units) with a constant review & control of - dispatch plan, transit-time in shipment of goods, damages, withheld material at Container Yards etc.
  • Effective coordination with all the internal/ external touch-points so as to maintain high level of customer satisfaction, especially on the parameter of OTIF Delivery.
  • To streamline daily dispatch plan in a manner that it doesnt affect the monthly/ quarterly/ yearly sales target of Marketing-function.
  • To assist Marketing Head in preparing near-accurate monthly sales budget of the entire product-mix so that the production-planning & logistics-planning are well aligned and deviations are minimized.

Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Accountability: ASSISTANCE IN SALES PLANNING 1. Study the historic trends of Sales (Month-wise, Product-wise, Sales Area-wise, State-wise, Zone-wise & All-India for BW as well as competitors).

  • Design formats to obtain the Sales Figure from Regional

teams, during Planning & Budgeting exercise.

job.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.

You will analyze expense trends and develop financial and non-financial dashboards, forecasts, and simulation models to address evolving business requirements. You will produce outputs that go beyond reporting results to highlight forward- looking insights, emerging risks and opportunities, and actionable recommendations that support leadership decision-making. You will engage stakeholders to understand operational drivers and translate open-ended business questions into structured analysis and practical solutions. Additionally, you will drive improvements to FP&A processes and reporting, leveraging AI and automation to streamline recurring activities, reduce manual effort, and create capacity for higher-value analysis. job.description:

Frazier & Deeter (FD) is an award-winning accounting & advisory firm. FD and our family of brands serve clients worldwide, from the Fortune Global 500 companies to growing small businesses. This Java Technical Lead role is a senior-level software engineering leadership role embedded within Citi's Exchange-Traded Derivatives (ETD) Clearing technology organization, responsible for driving platform modernization and delivering strategic, business-critical capabilities across a global clearing infrastructure. The position sits at the intersection of hands-on Java development, cloud-native architecture, and engineering leadership supporting real-time message flows from global futures markets while leading the replacement of legacy product processors. The ideal candidate will bring deep enterprise engineering expertise, a track record of leading distributed teams, and a demonstrated commitment to AI-assisted software development practices. In this capacity, you will serve as the principal designer, systems architect, and hands-on lead engineer for mission-critical, low latency, and high-throughput platform. This platforms powers real-time controls, intraday position aggregation, P&L, commissions, anomaly detection, and live risk enforcement across global trading desks.

As an engineering leader, you will collaborate extensively with other global teams and stakeholders across Asia, Europe, and Americas. Senior Java Software Engineer - Vice President
job.description:
Job Specification: We are seeking a Senior Java Engineer to fill the role of ‘Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst’ on the XiNG large scale distributed calculation platform (XiP).

In this role you will design, build, and maintain the software that manages and controls the XiP platform. This engine is responsible for 1.5 billion risk & suitability calculations at Citi every day. The calculation engine at the core of XiP is both highly performant and rapidly changing to support new scenarios, technologies, and infrastructure.

As an engineer working on XiP, you will work on a platform which daily; coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute cores, utilizes hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations.

You will work closely with software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable operations of the platform.

Responsibilities: Take part of the shared responsibility for the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in undesirable manner, small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines.

Collaborate and innovate within the team: Work as a key member of the development team responsible for the next generation of XiP. Participate actively in the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, contribute to technical discussions, and share your knowledge with peers to solve complex challenges and drive the project forward.

Implement changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine, including analyzing and designing improvements to the distribution mechanisms of the engine which regularly parallelizes 250,000 hours of compute into a single 90-minute execution: Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput.

Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone: Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs.

This team manages Citi's exposure to financial institutions, governments, and corporates that trade with Citi. job.name: Senior Java Developer - Assistant Vice President
Software Engineer II
job.description:
Hiring for Lapmaster Wolters — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Lapmaster Wolters is a global leader in high-precision machine tools and surface processing systems, with a heritage of over 200 years. Its machines lap, polish and fine-grind surfaces for manufacturers in more than 20 industries. The company has 600+ employees, 40,000+ m² of production space and revenue above €250 million.

Lapmaster Wolters is now expanding into advanced semiconductor packaging, one of the fastest-growing segments in chips, driven by chiplet architectures, heterogeneous integration and next-generation compute. The Bengaluru software team builds the software behind this new equipment line.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer II in Software Engineering – Semiconductor Equipment, you'll write the software that drives high-precision semiconductor machines. You'll work where software meets hardware, building control interfaces, operator GUIs and automated system controls that meet semiconductor-industry standards. The role is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru.

What you'll do

  • Design, develop, test and integrate software for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
  • Build C#/C++ DLL interfaces that let customers control the equipment programmatically.
  • Build operator interfaces for the equipment in C# (WinForms/WPF) and C++.
  • Implement hardware control modules over serial interfaces and TCP/IP.
  • Develop and maintain automated system controls for equipment operations.
  • Run system testing, debugging and performance optimisation.
  • Support customers and field teams after deployment, debugging issues on live equipment.

What you bring

  • 3–6 years of professional software development in C# / .NET.
  • Hands-on C# and C++, with strong OOP, design patterns, data structures and algorithms.
  • GUI development with C# .NET (WinForms and WPF).
  • Has built software that talks to hardware (instruments, machines, PLCs or embedded devices) over serial or TCP/IP.
  • Solid multithreading and concurrent programming.
  • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis on complex systems.
  • Familiarity with PLC programming concepts and industrial automation.
  • Version control with GitHub or Azure DevOps.
  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field, and clear written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of SEMI software standards (SECS/GEM, GEM300) and equipment cybersecurity.
  • Experience in regulated or high-precision domains such as semiconductor, healthcare/medical devices or aerospace.

job.name: Quality & Customer Experience Supervisor
job.description:
Job Summary The Quality & Customer Experience Supervisor will be responsible for driving service quality and customer experience across the Technical Support & Customer Service operation through structured quality audits, data and trend analysis, process improvement, and targeted capability-building initiatives. The role will work closely with Operations and Training to identify performance gaps, improve customer interactions, and ensure consistent adherence to defined quality and service standards.

Key Responsibilities Quality Assurance & Audits:

  • Conduct regular audits of customer interactions across voice and case/email channels against defined quality standards
  • Evaluate call handling, communication, troubleshooting approach, case documentation, customer experience, and process adherence
  • Ensure quality evaluations are consistent, objective, and supported by clear observations and actionable feedback
  • Participate in calibration sessions with Operations and other stakeholders to maintain consistency in quality standards
  • Identify critical quality concerns requiring immediate intervention and escalate appropriately

Quality Analysis & Insights

  • Analyze audit results to identify recurring errors, performance trends, knowledge gaps, and customer experience opportunities.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis on quality issues, escalations, repeat contacts, and other identified service gaps .
  • Develop periodic quality insights highlighting key trends, risks, improvement opportunities, and recommended actions .
  • Go beyond reporting quality scores by translating findings into specific improvement actions

Process & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, knowledge articles, communication standards, and customer handling practices.
  • Partner with Operations, Technical SMEs, and other stakeholders to implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Track improvement initiatives to determine whether identified quality gaps have reduced following intervention
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving service delivery and overall customer experience.

Training & Capability Development :-

  • Design and facilitate targeted training and refresher sessions based on quality findings and operational requirements.
  • Conduct sessions covering areas such as phone etiquette, call handling, probing and questioning techniques, active listening, customer communication, email etiquette, difficult customer handling, and overall customer experience
  • Provide focused coaching or learning interventions for teams where recurring quality gaps are identified
  • Work with Operations and Training to ensure quality findings are incorporated into ongoing learning and development plans.

job.name: Oracle Fusion HCM - Consulting Technical Manager
job.description:
Job Description As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Manager, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL), VBS (Visual Basic Studio) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a Manager with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
  • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
  • Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
  • Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
  • Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
  • Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
  • Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.
  • Review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to support delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

  • Monitor adherence to the Enterprise Risk Management Framework and applicable compliance policies, escalating issues where established standards are not met.

What we'll need from you:

  • Ability to produce clear, concise, and well-structured reports, documentation, and procedural materials related to risk and controls.

Education:

job.name: AI Engineer
job.description:
Yrs of Exp -- 2 to 7 Yrs

AI Engineer / Lead AI Engineer

Location -- Pune

Roles & Responsibilities

1. Build agentic workflows: Design and develop multi-step agent workflows using LangGraph or a similar framework - covering planning, picking the right tools, breaking down tasks, handling memory, and adding human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
2. Design and build agent tools: Figure out what tools the agent actually needs to do its job, and build them - including setting up MCP servers to safely connect agents to SQL databases and other data sources.
3. Connect apps and services: Integrate third-party apps and services using SDKs, function calling, and REST or GraphQL APIs.
4. Handle data and memory: Set up context and memory management, including RAG, session state, and user personalization.
5. Tune and optimize: Keep refining prompts, system instructions, and tool schemas so the agents run reliably, stay fast, and don't burn through tokens unnecessarily.
6. Test and track performance: Set up evaluations and monitoring to see how agents behave in the wild - tracking success rates, figuring out why things fail, and keeping an eye on latency and token costs.
7. Keep things secure: Manage authentication and permissions for connected apps (OAuth 2.0, API keys, scoped access) while keeping user data safe and private.
8. Work with the team: Partner with product and design folks to turn user ideas into working agent features, build quick prototypes, and bring in useful updates from new AI lab releases.

job.name: Associate Manager, Software Engineering (P4 Integrations)
job.description:
Perforce is a community of collaborative experts, problem solvers, and possibility seekers who believe work should be both challenging and fun. We are proud to inspire creativity, foster belonging, support collaboration, and encourage wellness. At Perforce, you’ll work with and learn from some of the best and brightest in business. Before you know it, you’ll be in the middle of a rewarding career at a company headed in one direction: upward.

With a global footprint spanning more than 80 countries and including over 75% of the Fortune 100, Perforce Software, Inc. is trusted by the world’s leading brands to deliver solutions for the toughest challenges. The best run DevOps teams in the world choose Perforce.

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the Integrations team. The Integrations team owns APIs written in multiple languages (like C++, Java, Python, PHP, Perl, C#, Ruby). The team is also responsible for integrating P4 capabilities within IDEs and applications in the form of plugins (IDEs like Eclipse, Visual Studio, Jenkins, Photoshop, etc.). In addition to these, there are a couple of exciting, brand-new tools (both at version 1.0) that this manager will also be responsible for.

P4 is the best version control software (VCS) for world-class development at scale. It securely versions all digital content, even large files, in a single repository. It scales for large teams, handles thousands of daily transactions, and delivers files quickly to remote users (even if they’re using Git).

job.name: Senior Telecom Software Developer (5G RAN / CNF)
job.description:
Description About the Role We are seeking a hands-on Senio r Developer to lead the design and implementation of high-throughput, low-latency 5G gNB (Next-Generation NodeB) software. You will bridge the gap between high-level architectural vision and low-level system execution, driving the evolution of our 5G RAN stack into resilient, cloud-native microservices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Design: Architect end-to-end 5G gNB Distributed Unit (DU) and Centralized Unit (CU) components as scalable, cloud-native network functions (CNFs).
  • Hands-On C++ Development: Write clean, maintainable, and ultra-low-latency modern C++ (C++17/C++20) code for Layer 2 (MAC, RLC, PDCP) and Layer 3 (RRC, NGAP, F1AP) protocol stacks.
  • Data Plane Optimization: Design and optimize high-speed packet processing pipelines using DPDK (Data Plane Development Kit), bypassing the kernel to maximize throughput and minimize jitter.
  • System-Level Engineering: Architect multi-threaded, lock-free applications on Linux, optimizing CPU pinning, NUMA awareness, memory management, and hardware acceleration (e.g., SmartNICs, SR-IOV).
  • Cloud-Native Transformation: Lead the containerization and orchestration of 5G workloads on Kubernetes, ensuring seamless lifecycle management, high availability, and observability.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, conduct rigorous architecture and code reviews, and establish best practices for performance profiling and benchmarking.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5 to 8 years of proven experience in telecom software engineering, with at least 3+ years in a technical leadership or architectural capacity.
  • 5G & RAN Expertise: Deep understanding of 3GPP 5G NR specifications, specifically around gNB architecture (CU/DU split), Layer 2 (MAC scheduling, RLC, PDCP, SDAP), and Layer 3 signaling protocols.
  • Programming Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in modern C++ and Linux system programming (IPC, shared memory, POSIX threads, socket programming, profiling tools like perf and gdb).
  • Packet Processing & Networking: Strong hands-on experience with DPDK, SR-IOV, and core computer networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, SCTP, GTP-U, VLAN, QoS).
  • Cloud-Native Stack: Practical experience deploying and debugging CNFs on Kubernetes/OpenShift, utilizing Helm, Docker, and cloud-native networking plugins (Multus, Calico, Cilium).

Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)

  • Experience with O-RAN (Open RAN) architectures, interfaces (Open Fronthaul, E2, A1, O1), and RIC integration.
  • Familiarity with hardware offloading technologies (e.g., Intel FlexRAN, NVIDIA Aerial, or FPGA/ASIC-based lookaside/inline acceleration).
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for telco workloads and automated performance testing frameworks.

job.description:
The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities.

Job Specification: We are seeking a Java Engineer to fill the role of ‘Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst’ on the XiNG large scale distributed calculation platform (XiP).

In this role you will design, build, and maintain the software that manages and controls the XiP platform. This engine is responsible for 1.5 billion risk & suitability calculations at Citi every day. The calculation engine at the core of XiP is both highly performant and rapidly changing to support new scenarios, technologies, and infrastructure.

As an engineer working on XiP, you will work on a platform which daily; coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute cores, utilizes hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations.

You will work closely with software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable operations of the platform.

Responsibilities: Take part of the shared responsibility for the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in undesirable manner, small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines.

Collaborate and innovate within the team: Work as a key member of the development team responsible for the next generation of XiP. Participate actively in the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, contribute to technical discussions, and share your knowledge with peers to solve complex challenges and drive the project forward.

Implement changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine, including analyzing and designing improvements to the distribution mechanisms of the engine which regularly parallelizes 250,000 hours of compute into a single 90-minute execution: Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput.

job.name: Senior Solutions Engineer, Contracts
job.description:
This is a fully remote role in the United States. As a Senior Solutions Engineer, Contracts, you will play a pivotal role as a domain expert in how we continue to build out our contract modeling products. Turquoise is looking for a talented, product-minded, analytical individual with a deep fluency in the mechanics and implications of managed care contracts, payer policies, claims, and remits data, who can translate that background into clear, impactful outcomes in close partnership with our product team.

In this role, you will work alongside our product team to support and inform key product decisions through your domain experience. This requires a thorough understanding of contract mechanisms, including provision hierarchy, bundling, qualifier logic, and government fee schedules, to support our ability to accurately model a wide range of contract structures. In addition, you will be able to apply your SQL skills to investigate and explore claims and remits data to inform product decisions through clear and easy to understand documented findings. Your expertise will also be leveraged through supporting claims validation variance exercises, assessing the impact of payer policies, tracing denials back to contract terms or policies, and improving our claims mapping process.

We encourage you to bring your innovative, analytical, and resourceful mindset to this role. You'll have the chance to solve unique product-oriented problems, expand on your subject matter expertise, and build strong relationships at Turquoise. We measure success by your thoughtful and efficient collaboration with product and engineering to ensure sustainable, long-term solutions for our customers.

What You’ll Do

  • Investigate and analyze managed care contracts, claims and remit data, and payer policies to answer key product questions
  • Provide high-quality written documentation that highlights product needs, feasibility, and customer impact
  • Inventory contract calculation methodologies to define an accurate and scalable modeling approach
  • Use SQL to investigate claims and remit data and translate findings into clear next steps
  • Support claims validation variance exercises by classifying pricing variances across 835s by root cause to enable a clear target for AI-assisted validation
  • Assess the impact of payer policies, including which policy attributes recur and which can be computed against claims versus which require human judgment
  • Trace denials back to contract terms and policies to be able to classify Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (CARCs) as attributable to the contract, to policy, or to neither
  • Improve our claims mapping process by identifying gaps in automated mapping, finding patterns, and determining the best path forward: better rules, better reference data, or human review by design

job.name: TECHNICAL LEAD L1
job.description:
Job description:

Job Description

Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to facilitate application solutions by developing and reviewing module-level codes, creating replication patterns, performing root cause analysis to identify recurring issues and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure stable, well-documented deliverables that meet business objectives

͏

Areas of responsibility

Gathering of requirements :

Participate in gathering requirements for specific modules and ensure clear, structured documentation. Work across multiple business processes to capture linkages, dependencies, and required changes.

Solution Design :

Facilitate creation of application solution designs for a specific module under the guidance of the Project Manager, ensuring alignment with business requirements and technical standards.

Coding and Configuration :

Review the developed codes, resolve technical queries of the team for the assigned module and create consistent replication patterns, to ensure that the developed code aligns with the project standards.

Collaborate with project managers through all phases of software development life cycle.

͏

Testing and Trial Runs

Monitor and implement testing activities for assigned modules and conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

Perform root-cause analysis to identify and troubleshoot recurring technical issues. Modify software codes to resolve errors, adapt to new hardware and software, enhance performance, and upgrade interfaces.

Implementation

Collaborate with technical teams to validate configurations, facilitate integration of new applications, and address dependencies during deployment. Prepare user training documents and related frameworks to ensure smooth adoption new applications and minimize transition risks.

͏

Maintain Documentation

Ensure that all technical documents, flowcharts, layouts, and diagrams align with project objectives.

Collate and submit project specification, project progress, resource requirements and status reports for the review of Project Manager.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Engage with project managers, client stakeholders, and technical team to gather and refine requirements and define technical expectations.

Work with internal and external stakeholders to gather feedback, align deliverables, evaluate software–hardware interactions, and define specifications to meet performance requirements.

Innovation

Develop improved testing and programming practices using innovative methods to enhance automation and ensure the delivery of error free codes.

͏

Mandatory Skills: Python for Insights
.

Experience: 5-8 Years
.

job.name: Lead Analytics Product & Delivery Manager - Senior Vice President
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced SVP, Lead Analytics Product & Delivery Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of People Insights and Organizational Effectiveness products and platforms.

This leader will oversee a portfolio of analytics, reporting, decision-support, and AI-enabled products that support workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee experience, and executive decision-making.

The role requires a combination of product leadership, strategic thinking, analytical problem solving, stakeholder management, and AI product expertise. The successful candidate will lead a team of product managers while partnering across Data Science, Data Engineering, Technology, HR, and Control Functions to bring innovative and governed solutions from concept through enterprise adoption.

The ideal candidate can connect long-term product strategy with day-to-day execution, ensuring solutions deliver measurable business value while operating within Citi's governance, privacy, and control frameworks.

Key Responsibilities Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

  • Define and own the product strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for People Insights and Organizational Effectiveness products.
  • Develop and maintain a prioritized portfolio of analytics, reporting, workforce intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Identify opportunities where data, analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI can improve workforce decisions and organizational effectiveness.
  • Evaluate initiatives based on business value, feasibility, regulatory requirements, adoption potential, and strategic alignment.
  • Establish product investment priorities and recommend resource allocation across initiatives.
  • Drive alignment between business priorities, product strategy, technology investments, and delivery roadmaps.

Product Delivery and Execution

  • Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of analytics and AI products, from opportunity assessment and discovery through deployment and adoption.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Technology teams to ensure solutions meet scalability, reliability, security, and usability requirements.
  • Establish product delivery standards, governance processes, and success measures across the portfolio.
  • Ensure that products are supported by clear business requirements, use cases, KPIs, and adoption plans.
  • Monitor product performance and business outcomes, making data-driven decisions regarding future enhancements and investments.
  • Drive continuous improvement across product development and delivery practices.

AI and Analytics Product Innovation

job.name: Industry Consultant-Insurance
job.description:
Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities As an Industry Consultant for Insurance, you will guide insurance organizations through modernization journeys by aligning business strategy with digital capabilities. This role involves leveraging industry acumen to drive business outcomes, with a focus on improving customer engagement and implementing data-driven risk assessment models.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Aligning Business Strategies: Align business strategy with digital capabilities across underwriting, claims, and policy administration to drive modernization journeys.
  • Driving Automation: Leverage industry acumen to drive automation and improve customer engagement.
  • Implementing Risk Models: Implement data-driven risk assessment models that foster resilience and competitive advantage.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Digital Capabilities Alignment: Exposure to aligning business strategy with digital capabilities across underwriting, claims, and policy administration to drive modernization journeys. This includes understanding of digital technologies and their application in insurance industry.
  • Industry Acumen Application: Exposure to leveraging industry acumen to drive automation and improve customer engagement, with a focus on business outcomes.
  • Data-Driven Risk Assessment: Exposure to implementing data-driven risk assessment models that foster resilience and competitive advantage, including understanding of data analysis and modeling techniques.
  • Automation Implementation: Exposure to driving automation in insurance organizations, including process automation and workflow optimization.
  • Business Strategy Development: Exposure to developing business strategies that align with digital capabilities and industry trends, with a focus on improving customer engagement and driving business outcomes.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

MACH creates transformative communications solutions for today, tomorrow, and beyond, bridging wholesale and inter-carrier connectivity with roaming and clearing.

job.name: GenAI Senior Integrated Designer
job.description:
Brandtech+ (formerly known as OLIVER+) is a global team of creative thinkers, tech-savvy trendsetters, and production pros specialising in film, CGI, automation, AI, motion design, and digital/print content. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting . Our focus is to connect clients with high-quality solutions , talent and ambitious opportunities worldwide.

As a part of The Brandtech Group , we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

Role: GenAI Senior Integrated Designer

Location: Remote working until further notice

A little bit about the role:

GenAI technology is reshaping creative production, offering creatives new tools to ideate, adapt, and deliver content faster and smarter. We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented GenAI Integrated Designer with m otion skills to join our growing team. The ideal candidate has an expert grasp of digital, social, and motion design, is eager to embrace GenAI workflows, and enjoys hands-on creation across all phases of a project.

You’ll be trained on our proprietary AI platform, Pencil, and use this alongside other GenAI tools to produce creative solutions that stand out in the market. You’ll work collaboratively from brief to delivery on a range of assets - adapting, optimizing , and evolving content for digital marketing, social media, e-commerce, and brand campaigns. You’ll blend classic design and motion skills with GenAI-powered techniques, helping us produce scalable, standout content for high-profile brands .

What you'll be doing:

  • Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team to ideate, create, and deliver integrated design assets across digital and social.
  • Design, layout, animate and refine digital marketing assets (static, animated, and video formats), e-commerce content, and social-first visuals - directly leveraging GenAI tools to accelerate, enhance, or transform ideation and production processes.
  • Develop assets for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Google Display using the Pencil platform in response to client briefs.
  • Take client briefs through all steps including insight, concept, copy, image & video generation and final creative assembly using different GenAI models and techniques.
  • Optimize and adapt assets for multi-channel rollouts, ensuring best practices for web, mobile, and social distribution.
  • Implement brand guidelines, ensuring visual quality and cohesion throughout every project.
  • Respond constructively to feedback, using GenAI capabilities to rapidly iterate and improve designs as needed.
  • Present your work to internal teams, confidently explaining how GenAI has contributed to ideation or execution.

As a part of The Brandtech Group , we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

Beauty is where craft, technology, and emotion converge. job.name: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
job.description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

About Bain Applied Technology & AI

Bain’s Applied Technology & AI works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

The Impact You’ll Have

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

As an AI Engineering leader in Applied Technology & AI team, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

The Role

The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

Read the full description

job.name: GPU Infrastructure Engineer / HPC Engineer
job.description:
Build and operate large?scale GPU compute pods to deliver predictable, high?throughput, low?latency training and inference services across 10K GPU cluster.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Implementation

Stand up multi?pod GPU clusters (rack/power/cooling layouts; TOR/leaf connectivity; IB/Ethernet host configs).

Implement GPU partitioning (MIG/vGPU profiles) and quota policies for multi?tenant environments.

Integrate cluster schedulers (Slurm/Kubernetes) with GPU device plugins, node feature discovery, and accounting/quotas.

  • Operations

Own day?2 operations across firmware/driver/DCGM/NVML lifecycles; execute change windows with zero/low downtime.

Capacity planning (GPU/CPU/Memory/NIC) and bin?packing strategies for heterogeneous GPU SKUs.

  • Performance & Optimization

Tune NCCL/UCX, GPU clocks/persistence, GPU Direct Storage, NUMA/locality, and CUDA runtime parameters.

Drive benchmarking and acceptance (HPL, HPL?AI, MLPerf?like internal suites); track perf regressions with SLOs.

  • Reliability & Incident

Lead P0/P1 incident response for GPU, CUDA, or scheduler issues; perform root?cause and preventative actions.

Act as the primary technical lead during production outages, coordinating cross-functional teams across Networking, GPU Operations, Platform Engineering, Storage, and Application teams to restore services within SLA targets.

Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for network, GPU, CUDA, NCCL, RDMA, and scheduler-related failures, identifying underlying causes and implementing preventive and corrective actions.

Collaborate with platform and GPU engineering teams to resolve issues impacting CUDA jobs, Kubernetes scheduling, Slurm workload management, GPU resource allocation, and large-scale AI training environments.

Define golden images; implement node remediation (cordon/drain/reimage) and auto?healing workflows.

  • Security & Compliance

Enforce GPU tenancy isolation (MIG, cgroup/device cgroup, mpsd), secure drivers/containers, SBOM and image scanning.

  • Documentation & Enablement

Publish runbooks , performance baselines, and application tuning guides for LLM training and inference.

Experience & Educational Requirement BE/B-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics & Communication

NVIDIA Certified Professional (AI Infrastructure); Linux (RHCE/LPIC) preferred.

Relevant Experience

  • 7–12 years building/operating HPC/AI GPU clusters at scale; deep CUDA/MIG/vGPU expertise.
  • Proven with H100/B?series class GPUs, Slurm and/or Kubernetes device scheduling; NCCL/UCX performance tuning.

Tools / Tech

  • CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN, TensorRT; 2. DCGM/NVML, nvidia-smi; 3. Slurm, K8s (device plugin, DaemonSets, NFD); 4. Helm/ArgoCD; 6. GPUDirect Storage; 7. Prometheus/Grafana; 8. ELK/Splunk.

job.name: Research Engineer — Agent Architectures (Coding & Autonomous Systems)
job.description:
Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building *aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems* . While that is the vision, the mission to build safety aware autonomous system in the extreme near term. Our research work spans around areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI, Eurips etc. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai & remote), Paris, & London.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

The Role

Most of the variance in agent performance comes from the system around the model, not the model itself. This role researches that system. The coding agent is the primary testbed: it takes an objective, works on a repository, verifies its own changes, and produces a record of what it did. It runs inside a customer's network, usually with no internet egress, against codebases that are large, old, thinly tested and load-bearing. Small models under real latency and cost budgets are a target, not a fallback.

Three areas:

*Harness.* Action space and tool surface design, context construction policy, where deterministic program analysis should replace model inference, control topology (single loop versus decomposition), verification design, and allocation of inference-time compute.

*Memory.* Schemas for execution state held outside the context window, compaction policy and what it destroys, retrieval under closed-world constraints, and whether an agent measurably improves on a repository over time.

*Evals.* Task construction from real repository history with executable verification, scoring partially-checkable long-horizon work, variance and contamination control, and failure taxonomies that attribute a failure to a component.

The work is controlled experiments on architecture, not prompt tuning: isolate a failure from eval traces, form a hypothesis about the responsible component, change it, ablate it, and establish whether the gain holds across repositories and model sizes. Outputs are papers, benchmarks and released tooling where we can publish, and shipped architecture where we cannot.

You will work directly with our alignment and interpretability researchers on post-training, behavioral evaluation, and reading what an agent actually did rather than what its trace claims.

What We Are Looking For

Research judgment with systems depth. You should be able to isolate a failure, design the experiment that tests your explanation of it, build what the experiment needs, and tell the difference between a real gain and an artifact of your setup.

Max Experience: 17

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead AI Evaluation Engineer (Science, Engineering Simulation & Design) with proven technical leadership skills to spearhead the authoring, review, and validation of "model-breaking," simulation-based engineering design problems. Operating across major disciplines—including Physics, Electrical, Mechanical, Control Systems, Aerospace, Systems, and Robotics—you will lead a team of subject-matter experts to create complex, multi-constraint tasks where AI agents must interpret requirements, navigate trade-offs, configure open-source simulation tools, diagnose failures, and iterate toward valid solutions. You will oversee benchmark quality standards, analyze agent execution logs, expose systemic reasoning gaps, and guide the development of automated, objective graders to elevate frontier model performance.

Job Requirements

  • Education & Expertise: PhD in Physics, Electrical, Mechanical, or Aerospace Engineering (or a closely related discipline), with 5+ years of hands-on engineering design experience.
  • Proven Leadership Experience: Prior experience leading engineering teams, technical pods, or peer-review workflows, with a strong track record of mentoring contributors, calibrating quality standards, and driving deadline-oriented execution.
  • Simulation Tooling: Proficiency with at least one domain-relevant open-source simulation package (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, CalculiX, python-control, CadQuery, build123d, OpenModelica, Cantera, Gmsh) combined with strong Python scripting skills.
  • AI Evaluation & Failure Diagnostics: Hands-on experience with modern LLMs/coding agents and evaluation concepts (pass@k, failure-mode analysis, nondeterministic behavior), with the ability to audit trajectory logs and isolate core reasoning or tool-use failures.
  • Evaluation & QA Background: Prior experience in AI evaluation, technical content review, quality assurance, or a related analytical leadership role.
  • Domain Rigor & Precision: Uncompromising attention to physical plausibility, unit consistency, boundary conditions, convergence criteria, and technical documentation.
  • Availability & Commitment: Must have weekend on-call availability (part-time engagement is acceptable for weekend coverage) alongside core weekday overlap.
  • Technical Infrastructure: Personal desktop/laptop equipped with a stable, high-speed internet connection in a remote setup.

Job Responsibilities

job.name: AI Migration Lead
job.description:
Job Title: AI Migration Lead If you’re looking to take an exciting new direction with your HSBC career, an internal move can open the door to many opportunities, allowing you to take on a new challenge, and develop your skills. Bring your knowledge of our brand to a new role and grow yourself further.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of ‘AI Migration Lead’ - this role may be based in Bangalore, Gurgaon, Hyderabad or Kolkata. This is a pivotal leadership role at the heart of the R&C AI agenda, turning strategy into action and accelerating the delivery of AI-driven outcomes across the organisation. As AI Enablement Lead, you’ll lead the central AI Migration team, connecting deep business expertise with agentic AI delivery and enabling Value Streams to move from ambition to impact at pace.

A move across the business allows you to continue to access tailored professional development opportunities, and our fantastic benefits packages.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the R&C AI portfolio strategy and prioritisation, working closely with the R&C CAIO to translate top-down strategy and target outcomes into an executable, portfolio-level roadmap. Aggregate value and delivery progress from across Value Streams to portfolio level, and instrument the relevant benefit metrics (efficiency & capacity, adoption & maturity) feeding the R&C CAIO's overall benefit-tracking framework.
  • Own the prioritisation and escalation mechanism across Value Streams: chair a regular portfolio prioritisation forum with Value Stream Product Owners and Value Stream AI Leads, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the R&C CAIO. Lead the AI Migration team: a central, flexible technical pool deployed into Value Streams on a solid-line basis to this role, with a dotted-line working relationship into the Value Stream while deployed.
  • Ensure the AI Migration team operates as the bridge between business SMEs and agentic architecture translating and migrating manual or semi-manual tasks into governed, agentic and automated workflows. Partner with Group Technology and the Group AI Platform function, including the Architecture Lead capability, to ensure portfolio delivery aligns to Group tooling, platform and architecture standards.
  • Partner with the Re-engineering team and the Knowledge Management Enablement Lead as shared capabilities supporting the migration agenda. Enable, R&C Value Streams Product Owners and Leads to deliver against set targets.

To Be Successful You Will

job.name: Application Development Lead - Senior Vice President
job.description:
The Applications Development Technology Senior Lead Analyst is a senior level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology Team. The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis and programming activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Technology Roadmap & Architecture
  • Define and Execute Vision: Establish and drive the strategic technology architecture roadmap for the Client Financials portfolio, ensuring alignment with long-term business outcomes.
  • Technical Direction: Provide strategic direction and critical input into key technology decisions to ensure a scalable, robust, and future-proof buildout.
  • Solution Design: Demonstrate deep technical acumen to collaborate with and direct a strong engineering team in making critical architectural and design decisions.
  • Cloud Transformation & Data Engineering
  • Cloud-Native Engineering: Lead the design, development, and scaling of enterprise-grade, cloud-native data services on AWS.
  • Databricks & Spark Migration: Drive the migration of legacy data platforms to Databricks, delivering high-performance Spark and PySpark solutions.
  • Platform Optimization: Optimize system performance, capacity, and infrastructure efficiency to support data-heavy, high-throughput applications.
  • AI-Enabled Analytics: Deliver AI-enabled operational and analytics platforms to unlock advanced insights and predictive capabilities.
  • Stakeholder Management & Business Alignment
  • Methodology Representation: Present and represent the firm's client returns methodology to senior stakeholders across diverse business and technology teams, including Markets, Finance, Risk, Banking, Performance Management, and ICM.
  • Impact Analysis: Clearly articulate and present the technology platform's impacts on revenue, expense, GSIB (Global Systemically Important Banks), and tax calculations.
  • Relationship Building: Foster strong, collaborative partnerships with senior business and technology leaders to align engineering delivery with business priorities.
  • Engineering Leadership & Agile Delivery
  • End-to-End Accountability: Take full and direct accountability for the solution delivery lifecycle of the Client Financials portfolio.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of expert data and software engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, quality, and velocity.
  • Agile Execution: Drive agile execution across multiple complex data engines, calculation engines, and multi-dimensional analytics platforms.

job.description:
REMOTE AND PUNE OPTION IS AVAILABLE

NO FRESHER WILL BE PREFERRED

We are looking for Principal AI Solutions Architect (Enterprises Architecture)as a Full Time for our IT Company.

Location- Pune
Experience- 10+ years

Principal Architect, AI Solutions

Role Summary

We are seeking a Principal Architect to help lead the next generation of AI-enabled product, platform, and engineering capabilities across our organization. This is a senior individual contributor role operating at the highest levels of technical leadership. The ideal candidate will combine deep AI architecture expertise with strong enterprise architecture judgment, practical delivery experience, and the ability to influence teams across business units.
This role will partner closely with business and technology leaders to shape product and platform architectures, define and uphold enterprise standards, and help our engineering organization adopt modern AI and AI-powered software delivery practices responsibly and effectively.

Lead architecture for strategic AI initiatives across products, platforms, and shared enterprise capabilities

Mentor technical leads and senior engineers and contribute to raising the technical bar across the organization

job.name: Senior Platform Engineer (Python/AI) - Assistant Vice President
job.description:
Role Overview Join a pioneering team at the forefront of financial technology innovation. We are building a cutting-edge, agentic AI platform designed to revolutionize the end-to-end credit risk model development lifecycle. By leveraging the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) and intelligent workflows, we aim to augment our quantitative modelers, dramatically increasing their productivity, enhancing model governance, and accelerating the delivery of critical risk models.

We are seeking a hands-on senior engineer to be a key contributor to this transformation. In this role, you will work closely with quantitative analysts and key stakeholders to understand and shape high-impact use cases and collaborate within a talented engineering team to design, build, and deploy the generative AI platform that brings this vision to life.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of discrete platform modules and drive them to completion, exercising sound judgement and initiative to navigate ambiguity and drive progress independently, with minimal supervision.
  • Build proofs-of-concept and working prototypes to validate technical approaches early, iterating quickly based on stakeholder feedback in a fast-moving, discovery-driven environment.
  • Design, develop, and ship production-grade Python components for the agentic AI platform — orchestration pipelines, RAG systems, LLM integrations, and MCP-based tool interfaces.
  • Champion engineering best practices — clean code, automated testing, CI/CD, logging, and monitoring
  • Build and maintain secure integrations with internal data sources, external APIs, and LLM providers in compliance with Citi's data governance and security standards
  • Actively invest in self-learning to keep pace with the rapidly evolving GenAI and LLM landscape, bringing emerging tools and techniques to the team.

Qualifications : Graduate

The organization operates at the intersection of public policy, government advisory, political campaigns, governance initiatives, media communications, data-tech solutions, and investment promotion. It specializes in strategy building through policy dialogue, operational assistance, resilient design, intelligence, and evidence-based decision-making. Clients include state governments and leadership, national political parties, district administrations, educational institutions, law firms, research organizations, impact investors, professors, non-profits, voluntary groups, influencers, and change-makers.
Role Description This full-time hybrid Consulting Advisory Intern role is based in Hyderabad, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. The intern will support projects in political economies, data, AI and public policy, and dashboard development, contributing to research, analysis, and advisory outputs. Day-to-day responsibilities include collecting and managing data from diverse public and private sources, conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis, and assisting in the design and maintenance of analytical dashboards and visualizations. The role also involves preparing briefings, policy notes, and presentations for internal and client stakeholders, and coordinating with cross-functional teams working on public policy, governance, and impact evaluation initiatives. The intern will be expected to document workflows, ensure data quality, and contribute to insights that inform evidence-based decisions.

job.name: Business Intelligence Engineer, II, Amazon FinAuto - GREF Tech, Data and Analytics
job.description:
Description Amazon runs offices and workplaces for hundreds of thousands of employees in dozens of countries, and every building produces data on space, safety, energy, maintenance and employee feedback. In this role, you'll turn that data into the trusted metrics, dashboards and AI-ready datasets that decide how those buildings are run.

You'll own the data models and the metric layer that our operations, finance, engineering and product partners use as their single source of truth. That covers whether buildings are safe, clean and sustainable, whether people have the right space at the right time, and how employees rate their workplace experience. You'll build interactive dashboards in Amazon QuickSight. You'll also make it easier for teams to answer their own questions without waiting on a report, and you'll prepare well-governed data for GenAI tools, apps and automated workflows.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll take projects from the first conversation with a business partner all the way to production, often with several running at once. You'll work alongside data engineers and fellow BI engineers. If you enjoy trying new AI tools and working out where they fit into everyday work, you'll have room to do that here.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and build large-scale analytical data models for one of Amazon's most complex real estate data ecosystems
  • Own the semantic and metric layer that serves as the single source of truth for GREF KPIs: Customer Feedback; Safe, Clean and Sustainable Buildings; Right People, Place and Time; and Right Customer Experience
  • Partner with Operations, Finance, Engineering and Product teams to turn business needs into analytics solutions with measurable outcomes, and improve GREF self-serve analytics
  • Build interactive dashboards and reports in Amazon QuickSight that give GREF customers actionable insights
  • Make GREF data AI-ready: governed, high-quality and discoverable datasets that power apps, workflows and GenAI applications
  • Lead projects end to end, from requirements and design to production, across multiple concurrent projects
  • Work with technology teams on data engineering, platform capabilities, tooling, data governance and data quality, and keep learning new AI tools to find where they fit in current workflows

A day in the life

Your main focus is building trusted, well-defined data for our real estate and workplace domains, and making sure it stays reliable in production.

A typical morning might start with a data issue in your domain that our on-call engineer has flagged and needs your help fixing. Once the production issue is resolved, you'll get back to learning the business and functional side of your domain so you can refine the design of a core dataset that teams will use as their single source of truth. You'll run tests in Redshift to check that your proposal holds up, then write up your findings for review with the team and leadership.

Read the full description

job.name: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
job.description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

About Bain Applied Technology & AI

Bain’s Applied Technology & AI works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

The Impact You’ll Have

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

As an AI Engineering leader in Applied Technology & AI team, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

The Role

The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

job.name: Product Manager
job.description:
JD: Product Manager – Agentic AI

Joining within 45 days | Experience: 5 to 8 years | Location: Bangalore or Mumbai | On-site | Hands-on role

Cogniflix Artificial Intelligence Pvt Ltd (Mindflix AI) is building the next generation of AI-powered personalisation and engagement systems across voice, conversational interfaces and real-time intelligence. We are persona-driven: we build live AI personas, avatars that talk, listen and respond like people. We are building for EdTech first, with healthcare to explore next.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the vision, strategy and roadmap for our agentic AI products, starting with EdTech and then exploring healthcare.

Mindflix AI works from Bangalore and Mumbai and is being built with a global outlook, including a Singapore company structure to support international expansion, enterprise partnerships and future growth.

Role

This is a hands-on role. You will lead the product and execute it yourself.

You will set the direction and also do the detailed work: writing the requirements, testing the product, working through the data and driving delivery with engineering. There is no team under you to hand work to at the start, and there is the opportunity to build one as we grow.

You will work with the founders, the engineering team and our interns.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product strategy and roadmap: define and prioritise what we build, aligned with business goals and customer needs.
  • Discovery: understand customers and users first-hand, and turn their problems into clear, buildable requirements.
  • AI product quality: work with AI engineers to define how our agents should behave, how quality is evaluated, and what is safe to ship.
  • Analytics and experimentation: define success metrics, track adoption and conversion, and use data to decide what to do next.
  • Cross-functional execution: drive delivery with engineering and design, and support launches and client rollouts.
  • New verticals: build for EdTech first, then explore healthcare with us.
  • Ownership: take the product from idea through launch, adoption and continuous improvement.

Must Have

  • 5 to 8 years of professional experience, with at least 3 years in product management.
  • End-to-end ownership of a live B2B or SaaS product, from discovery through launch and improvement.
  • Practical experience building products with generative AI or agentic AI.
  • Comfortable leading and executing at the same time: setting direction and doing the detailed work yourself.
  • Technical fluency: APIs, data, and how LLM-based products are built and evaluated.
  • Strong analytical skills, and the habit of deciding with data.
  • Clear written and spoken communication, including requirements engineers can build from.
  • Comfortable working directly with clients.
  • Able to join within 45 days.

Good to Have
