job.name: AI/ML Engineer
job.description:
Hiring for BRAHMA AI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

BRAHMA AI is an enterprise AI content creation platform. Its products help media, sports and enterprise brands create, edit and distribute video and multimodal content at scale using generative AI. The team is growing its AI engineering group in Bengaluru to build the agentic systems behind its next generation of content workflows.

About the Role

You'll design, build and scale AI agents and GenAI applications in production: agentic systems powered by LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation and multimodal models that turn text, images and video into finished content. You'll take recent research and make it into reliable, observable production systems.

What you'll do

  • Architect and deploy agentic AI systems with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Autogen, Semantic Kernel or Google ADK
  • Design RAG pipelines on vector databases such as OpenSearch, Pinecone, FAISS or Weaviate
  • Build modular agent architectures for reasoning and tool orchestration
  • Integrate and fine-tune foundation models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral) for domain tasks
  • Build multimodal generation workflows: text to image, image to video, text to video and text to speech
  • Set up observability, performance tracking and continuous evaluation of models and agents
  • Work with platform, data and product teams to ship and run these systems reliably

What you bring

  • 3+ years in AI/ML engineering, with hands-on work on LLMs or generative AI
  • Have shipped an ML, computer vision or LLM feature that runs in a real product
  • Strong Python, plus experience with microservices or API-based systems
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, vector search and RAG architectures
  • A good grasp of prompt engineering, model evaluation and context optimisation
  • Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP and containerised deployments
  • Exposure to fine-tuning, LoRA or custom embeddings

Nice to have

  • Experience with video, sports or media AI products (highlights, clipping, video analytics)
  • Multimodal AI across text, image, audio and video
  • Built or contributed to agent SDKs or AI developer platforms
  • Optimising inference latency and cost for production models
  • Familiarity with hallucination control and AI safety practices

Originally posted on: 21 Oct 2026

Job Description As an Applied AI & ML Lead in the Market Operations team, you will drive the design and delivery of AI agents and ML solutions that enhance and transform Market Operations. You will lead a team of scientists and engineers, partner with business stakeholders and technology leaders, and ensure the successful implementation and scaling of AI-driven tools. + Lead the end-to-end design, development, and delivery of LLM-based agents and advanced ML models for Market Operations.
+ Design and own the agent harness: orchestration loop, tool and API interfaces, context and memory management, multi-agent coordination, human-in-the-loop escalation, and guardrails.

The consultants will work closely with functional, technical, business, and source-system teams to ensure that data is extracted, transformed, validated, loaded, reconciled, and signed off successfully Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute end-to-end data migration activities for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement.

+ General Ledger balances and journals
+ Fixed Assets and Cash Management data, where applicable

  • Analyse and resolve load errors, rejected records, reference-data issues, and data-quality exceptions.

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.

With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. The Knowledge & Data Architect defines the architecture, standards and readiness requirements governing how knowledge and data are sourced, structured, accessed, grounded, secured, evaluated and maintained throughout the AI solution lifecycle.

Working as part of the AIP Factory Core, the role supports Delivery Squads in assessing customer information environments, defining fit-for-purpose grounding approaches, identifying information-quality constraints and specifying the remediation required to enable reliable AI outcomes.

The Knowledge & Data Architect does not necessarily own all data or knowledge remediation. The role owns the architecture, standards, assessment and assurance required to determine whether the information foundation is suitable for the proposed AI agent.

job.description:
Description and Requirements "At BMC trust is not just a word - it's a way of life!" Description And Requirements CareerArc Code

CA-SB

Hybrid BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.

We are hiring a Senior Digital Analytics Manager to own how web and digital behavior connects to our broader data infrastructure and revenue motion. This is a strategic and hands-on role where you will provide direction and governance over our Adobe Analytics platform as assessment and implementation work progresses, architect the web-to-warehouse data pipeline, define how we measure performance in an era of AI-driven search, and serve as the connective tissue between digital strategy, Marketing Ops/GTM, demand marketing, and the Core Data team.

Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success: Adobe Analytics Platform Ownership Own the strategy, standards, and governance for our Adobe Analytics implementation. Assessment and implementation work is already underway with an external partner — your role is to direct that work, shape decisions, and ensure what gets built reflects our measurement architecture and long-term needs. Establish and maintain standards for event taxonomy, naming conventions, data layer design, and documentation. Own ongoing platform health and QA.

Web-to-Warehouse Data Architecture Design and maintain the pipeline from web data capture through to our data warehouse. Identify integration gaps, redundancies, and points of failure across web → core → downstream systems. Partner with data engineering to build clean, durable pipelines — using tools like Snowflake, dbt, or equivalent — so web data is trusted, documented, and joinable with CRM and campaign data.

Attribution and Revenue-Linked Measurement Build and maintain the KPIs and dashboards that connect web performance to pipeline and revenue — not vanity metrics. Define and implement multi-touch attribution logic that works across the marketing stack. Partner with Sales Ops and the Core Data team to align on a single source of truth.

Web Traffic Analysis and Optimization Analyze traffic, behavior, and conversion paths to surface where we're winning, leaking, and underinvesting. Translate findings into prioritized, testable recommendations. Raise the analytics fluency of digital and demand partners — bring people along rather than operating as a black box.

job.description:
Job Description As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Consultant, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a consultant with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
  • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
  • Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
  • Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
  • Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
  • Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
  • Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.
  • Review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to support delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1,700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure.

About the Role

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code.

What you'll do

  • Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
  • Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
  • Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
  • Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
  • Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
  • Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
  • Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

What you bring

job.name: Data Engineer - EDO
job.description:
Description Role purpose

The Senior Data Engineer will migrate and validate batch data workloads from AWS Databricks to Azure Databricks. The role focuses on notebook and job conversion, Databricks Asset Bundles, data movement, Unity Catalog integration and automated deployment across environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Assess source notebooks, jobs, libraries, SQL scripts, schedules, parameters, cluster configurations and upstream or downstream dependencies.
  • Refactor Python, PySpark and SQL workloads for Azure Databricks while preserving business logic, data contracts and operational behavior.
  • Convert deployment assets to Databricks Asset Bundles and implement environment specific configuration for development, test and production.
  • Migrate data and metadata from S3 based patterns to ADLS Gen2 and Unity Catalog aligned structures using approved migration methods.
  • Update secrets, service connections, file paths, storage access, libraries and integrations to use Azure platform services and managed identities.
  • Implement or migrate scheduled batch workflows, job dependencies, retries, notifications and operational logging.
  • Support Unity Catalog object creation, ownership, grants, external locations, storage credentials and workspace bindings under architect guidance.
  • Build unit checks and reconciliation utilities for schema, row counts, aggregates, checksums and business rules.
  • Resolve defects found during system integration testing and user acceptance testing. Provide evidence for release and cutover decisions.
  • Document migrated components, operating instructions, known constraints and support procedures.

Required Experience And Skills

  • 5+ or more years in data engineering with strong hands on delivery experience in Databricks and Spark based platforms.
  • Experience designing and implementing Genie Spaces in Databricks, including semantic modeling, governance, and optimization of natural language query responses.

Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to leverage Databricks Genie for AI-driven reporting, data discovery, and decision-making across large-scale data platforms.

  • Advanced Python, PySpark and SQL skills, including debugging and optimization of batch workloads.
  • Experience with Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Delta Lake, Azure Key Vault and Entra based access patterns.
  • Working knowledge of AWS Databricks, S3, IAM roles and cross cloud migration considerations.
  • Practical experience with Databricks Asset Bundles, Git based development and CI CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Unity Catalog objects, privileges, external locations and governed data access.
  • Experience with automated data validation and source to target reconciliation.

Preferred Experience

job.name: HCM Cloud Functional Solution Architect
job.description:
Job Description About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.

Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.

Why join CSS?

  • Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.
  • Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.
  • Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio.
  • Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.
  • Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

Fusion Apps Studios Fusion Apps Studios help customers realize greater value from Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications by improving business processes, adopting new capabilities, and making better use of embedded AI. The team assesses existing environments, identifies adoption and process gaps, and develops practical improvement roadmaps. Solutions prioritize standard functionality, supported by integration and extensions where needed. Depending on the role, work may include Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX. Join Fusion Apps Studios to deepen your functional or technical expertise while broadening your contribution to customer advisory, connected processes, and business transformation.

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Solution Architect, you will own end-to-end solution design across two designated HCM services, translating complex business requirements into integrated, secure and effective solutions. You will combine deep hands-on expertise in your primary service with sufficient functional depth in the secondary service to evaluate, challenge and approve solution designs.

job.name: Customer Relationship Management Analyst
job.description:
Job Description: Advisory Coordinator – Sales Pipeline Data Analyst

Position Overview

  • Job Title: Advisory Coordinator – Sales Pipeline Data Analyst
  • Company: EisnerAmper
  • Department: Growth Team
  • Business Groups: Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group
  • Experience: 2+ years
  • Primary Focus: CRM Data Management, Sales Pipeline Data Quality, and Reporting
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Work Schedule: Must maintain 3–4 hours of regular overlap with U.S. business hours.
  • Work Arrangement: Hybrid.
  • Location : Mumbai

Role Overview

EisnerAmper is seeking a detail-oriented Sales Pipeline Data Analyst to support CRM data quality and pipeline management across its Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group.

The candidate will be responsible for auditing, cleaning, maintaining, and validating sales pipeline data within NetSuite CRM and other approved CRM platforms.

The role involves identifying duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, stale, and misclassified opportunity records, coordinating with business development professionals and practice leadership to resolve discrepancies, and ensuring reliable pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI tracking.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on CRM experience, strong Excel skills, excellent attention to detail, and an understanding of sales pipeline management and data quality processes.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Data Management & Data Quality

  • Conduct regular audits of CRM and sales pipeline records.
  • Identify and resolve duplicate, stale, incomplete, inaccurate, and non-compliant records.
  • Maintain CRM data quality through daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly hygiene activities.
  • Validate opportunity fields, stages, ownership, close dates, service line coding, and originator attribution.
  • Update and correct CRM records while ensuring compliance with established data standards.
  • Investigate data discrepancies and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.

Sales Pipeline Management

  • Monitor aging, stalled, dormant, duplicate, and misclassified opportunities.
  • Coordinate with opportunity owners and stakeholders to obtain missing information.
  • Ensure accurate opportunity classifications and timely updates.
  • Support pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI accuracy.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare and distribute pipeline hygiene reports, scorecards, and exception reports.
  • Support pipeline review meetings through data preparation and follow-up activities.
  • Assist in creating and maintaining CRM reports, dashboards, and data quality monitoring tools.
  • Identify recurring data quality trends and recommend improvements.

Process Improvement & Documentation

job.name: Assistant Consultant- Ecology
job.description:
Job Description WSP is seeking Assistant Consultants to join our large and growing technical support team in India (Noida/Bengaluru/Mumbai), working closely with our UK-wide national Ecology team.

The successful candidate will support data delivery and GIS-based outputs that underpin ecological assessments and reporting. You will play a key role in ensuring high-quality, efficient, and client-focused project delivery by handling, analysing, and visualising ecological data collected across UK projects.

The role is primarily focused on data handling, GIS analysis, and technical support , contributing to a wide range of environmental and multidisciplinary projects across commercial and scientific sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Data Management & Analysis
  • Handling, sorting, validation, and preparation of ecological datasets
  • Managing, interpreting, and manipulating large and complex data sets
  • Ensuring data quality control, validation, and adherence to QA/QC processes
  • Supporting structured data storage, metadata standards, and version control
  • GIS & Spatial Deliverables
  • Preparation of ecological cartography (e.g., habitat maps, species distribution plans) to recognised standards
  • Performing spatial analysis, including calculation of habitat losses and gains
  • Supporting Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) analysis and preparation of associated digital inputs
  • Developing GIS templates and data capture tools for use in field data collection platforms
  • Generating high-quality figures and mapping outputs for reports, publications, and consultations
  • Technical Support to Ecology Projects
  • Preparing supporting information for European Protected Species licensing and assessments
  • Assisting in preparation of habitat mitigation and compensation design plans
  • Supporting HRA/EIA deliverables through data and mapping inputs
  • Interpreting ecological survey data and translating it into usable outputs
  • Data & Systems Management
  • Purchasing and maintaining datasets (e.g., OS Mapping and third-party datasets) in compliance with licensing agreements
  • Ensuring adherence to data security, licensing, and compliance requirements
  • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
  • Working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams across ecology, planning, and EIA
  • Actively promoting knowledge sharing and development of best practices
  • Supporting internal stakeholders and building strong working relationships across WSP
  • Contributing to process improvements and efficiency enhancements

Qualifications

  • Degree in Ecology, Environmental Science, or related discipline

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on large, multidisciplinary global projects
  • Exposure to UK ecology standards and international best practices
  • Strong focus on learning, development, and career progression
  • Collaborative and inclusive team environment

job.name: Sensory Scientist
job.description:
Position Title: Sensory Scientist

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 45150

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy. About The Role. The Sensory Scientist reports to the Sensory UX Innovation Manager, Asia Pacific and South African (APACSA) and is based in Delhi, India.

This role applies sensory and consumer/customer research best practices and methodologies, to provide guidance and insights to McCain’s regional and local Product Development teams throughout the stage gate process.

This position is a key member of a Asia Pacific and South African (APACSA) regional Sensory UX team and provides direction and training to various stakeholders on all sensory aspects of McCain’s products. Sensory Scientist partners with cross-functional teams to integrate sensory practices and testing, where appropriate, throughout the product development process.

The role is responsible for using and creating sensory Consumer/customer and analytical methods to guide product development, enable successful innovation launches and guide renovation efforts. The Sensory Scientist designs and leads testing plans with scientific rigor, issues reports and creates actionable recommendations to stakeholders.

The Sensory Scientist collaborates with R&D, Marketing, Consumer Insights, Operations, and other internal and external partners on new products, processes, quality improvements and cost savings to drive McCain’s profitable growth.

As part of the Global Sensory and User Experience team, the Sensory Scientist also works with internal team members to expand McCain’s global sensory capabilities. This includes the optimization and standardization of sensory tools and the development of new or hybrid methods. It also includes developing new training materials, assessing and onboarding new vendors, identifying and closing gaps the company has in regard to its sensory needs, and contributing to investigations regarding the linkage between sensory methods or attribute intensities to instrumental test methods.

The position executes and reports sensory and consumer/customer research studies. As such, the Sensory Scientist builds and maintains strong relationships with core vendors, supervises the application of best scientific practices by such vendors and manages test costs and timelines.

This position is based in the McCain HO. Ad hoc travel to regional plants and research venues (including Research Agency sites, Universities etc) may be required (eg for product tastings/review and other R&D focused activities as required). McCain will reimburse travel costs for such work-related travel

What You’ll Be Doing.

job.name: Senior Analyst- BCG Vantage
job.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Analyst (SA) with the ValueScience® Center (VSC), Client-Focused track, you will provide hands-on corporate finance and valuation expertise to consulting teams – developing Total Shareholder Return (TSR) and financial diagnostics, building from scratch and stress-testing 3-statement financial models, and running scenario and sensitivity modelling to support client decision-making. You will translate your analysis into clear client insights, and guide case teams on core CFS concepts, acting as a thought partner in brainstorming and problem-solving discussions.

You will work as part of a growing global team across Singapore, India, North America, Europe and Middle East, deployed on case and proposal work for more than 55% of your time. Regular travel to client sites should be expected during staffing assignments, as you work onsite – alongside consulting team members, as well as client stakeholders directly – to understand requirements and help design and deliver solutions.

Beyond casework, you are also comfortable with GenAI and agentic ways of working – for example, building skills using Claude Code to accelerate analysis and modelling, and contributing to reusable tools and client assets.

The Profile

We are looking for someone who combines technical rigor with genuine curiosity about the “so what” – someone who does not just execute a model correctly, but pushes to understand what it means for the client's decision, and says so clearly.

You are comfortable being in the room with clients early – not just supporting from behind the scenes, but building the confidence to walk stakeholders through your own analysis, take questions, and hold your own when challenged on the numbers.

You manage your own workload with minimal hand-holding: you flag issues before they become problems, keep people informed without being asked, and know when to escalate versus when to solve it yourself.

Read the full description

job.name: Consultant - Forensics - National - ASU - Forensics - Discovery - New Delhi
Credit Risk Strategy & Analytics - Vice President
job.description:
The Credit Risk Strategy & Analytics role will support the development, implementation, and management of credit risk and/or collection strategies and policies for consumer and/or commercial lending portfolios. This includes directing credit analytics team in assessing various internal and external data sources for inclusion into policies and lending platform to optimize commercial risk assessment and straight through application processing in a digital environment. This role requires a deep level of understanding of statistics, data, modeling, and analytical tools to creatively support the responsible growth and risk management of assigned portfolios.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in developing origination, portfolio, and collection strategies internally and with strategic partners by leveraging data analytics inclusive of score-based models, on-us/off-us data, and business rules
  • Support Portfolio Risk Manager to optimize risk-return dynamics by overseeing credit risk and/or collection strategies and developing recommendations for policy optimization throughout the loan lifecycle
  • Develop framework for portfolio risk assessment including evaluation of credit, financial and collections performance across varied lending products and industry segments
  • Understand applicable credit policies, industry regulations and the requisite impact of those governance items to new initiatives
  • Utilize Statistical Analysis System (SAS) in a UNIX environment to perform risk, financial and data analyses including profiling, sampling, forecasting and new program due diligence
  • Prepare risk management presentations for senior management that include analytics on expected portfolio performance and areas of potential risk and/or opportunity
  • Stay abreast of emerging industry trends in data analytics and perform proactive analytics to assess and support portfolio and origination strategies
  • Proactively identify emerging risks within the portfolio and gaps that might compromise Credit Policy strategies and increase losses.
  • Liaise with key stakeholders to advance and support initiatives.
  • Direct analytics team effectively to impart knowledge and rationale for tasks and ensure ownership for assigned responsibilities, lead to successful completion of goals, as an incubator for innovation
  • Knowledge of Citibank credit policies and practices and regulatory policies, to assist unit in achieving compliance with the above and satisfactory ratings from internal and external auditors.

job.description:
Job Description The Marine Environmental Modeler will support marine and coastal projects through numerical modelling of sediment transport, hydrodynamics, water quality and environmental impacts associated with infrastructure, dredging, ports, offshore energy and coastal developments.

The role will work closely with WSP Italia and international marine specialists delivering feasibility studies, environmental impact assessments, permitting studies and detailed engineering support.

+ Sediment transport

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Hiring for PULS Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About PULS Group

PULS Group is a global leader in DIN rail power supplies, Field Power Supplies, and industrial power technology. The India team is scaling local capability for manufacturing, analytics, supply-chain visibility, and cross-functional business support while staying connected to PULS global operating standards. The role is based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

Job Roles & Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines from SAP S/4HANA into Snowflake, ensuring clean, consistent, business-ready data for the global controlling and analytics team.
  • Model, transform, and optimize data in Snowflake using strong SQL, structured layers, semantic models, and performance-aware data-engineering practices.
  • Partner with business controllers and global stakeholders to convert requirements into MVPs, functional testing, UAT, rollout, and ongoing enhancements across 2–3 month project cycles.
  • Support Power BI as the reporting and visualization front-end, including datasets, dashboards, calculations, and validation of outputs against source systems.
  • Work through Jira/ticket-based delivery while communicating clearly with teams across India, Germany, Czech Republic, China, and external partners.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 3–5 years of data engineering, analytics engineering, or BI engineering experience; no freshers/newcomers for this role.
  • Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is the top priority, including data modeling, transformations, warehouse concepts, and performance optimization.
  • Advanced SQL and practical ETL/ELT or data-pipeline experience, ideally around business, finance, controlling, operations, or manufacturing data.
  • SAP S/4HANA exposure is a strong advantage but trainable; candidates with strong Snowflake/data-engineering fundamentals should still be considered if SAP depth is emerging.
  • Power BI experience is helpful for front-end visualization, but should not outweigh Snowflake/data-engineering strength.
  • Computer Science or Information Systems background preferred; Snowflake Cortex, AI/ML on Snowflake, or chatbot-over-business-data exposure is a bonus signal.

Role Impact

This role will help PULS replace and localize data-engineering capability that previously sat in Munich. The hire will turn SAP and business data into trusted Snowflake data products and Power BI outputs, enabling controllers and global business teams to make faster, more confident decisions.

What We Offer

  • Work with a global industrial technology leader building India capabilities across analytics, manufacturing, sourcing, and operations.
  • Collaborate with international stakeholders on practical, business-critical data products rather than isolated dashboard work.
  • Gain exposure to emerging Snowflake AI/Cortex use cases, including chatbot-style interaction with SAP/business data.

Description Department/Project Description We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).

You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.

Requirements Job Responsibilities Domain-Specific AI Integration Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).

Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.

Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.

Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.

Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).

Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.

Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.

Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.

job.name: Gasoline Engine Calibration Engineer
job.description:
The Gasoline Engine Calibration Engineer is responsible for developing, testing, and validating vehicle-based calibrations that achieve world-class fuel economy and drivability meeting current and future emission standards.

The Engineer will plan, generate, and verify feature calibrations in hot climate, cold climate, and high altitude in accordance with powertrain system functional objectives along with generating reports to communicate the status of the program to the larger team. The candidate will manipulate and utilize large and complex sets of engine mapping data to analyze and solve complex system problems as they relate to engine performance, fuel consumption, emissions, OBD, and base engine calibration development. The candidate will work cross functionally with engine development, powertrain controls and vehicle teams to identify and implement calibration solutions that achieve program drivability and emissions requirements.

The engineer will evaluate new engine and after treatment hardware and technology for future applications and analyze, plan, and solve complex system problems as they relate to calibration development. He/She will manipulate and utilize large and complex sets of data and actively participate in the development of standard hardware and calibration development processes and procedures. The engineer will participate in meetings with management, product design, and systems teams and present summaries and detailed reports on specific assignments, including timing projections. This position combines multiple engineering disciplines to develop hardware and calibrate the engine management system of engines produced by the company. The candidate should expect to travel 4-6 weeks throughout the year for system validation/verification.

*Basic Qualifications:*

  • Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or equivalent Engineering degree
  • 5+ years of prior vehicle engine calibration experience
  • Fundamental knowledge of internal combustion engines and powertrain calibration
  • Working knowledge of calibration tools (INCA /ATI), emissions regulations, and powertrain technologies
  • Outstanding problem solving and analytical skills
  • Self-motivated and proactive
  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including PowerPoint presentations to upper management

*Preferred Qualifications:*

  • Master of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering from an ABET accredited university
  • 6+ years of experience in engine development, powertrain systems development /engine calibration /control systems development / diagnostics within the automotive industry
  • Calibration process knowledge using design of experiments and advanced optimization techniques
  • Proficient in advanced simulation tools
  • Proficient in Matlab / Simulink

job.description:
Description Department/Project Description We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).

You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.

Requirements Job Responsibilities Domain-Specific AI Integration Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).

Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.

Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.

Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.

Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).

Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.

Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.

Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.

job.name: Data Engineer II, Alexa AI - ML Engineering
job.description:
Description Join Alexa AI - ML Engineering and help power personalized, proactive experiences for hundreds of millions of Alexa customers worldwide. As a Data Engineer II, you will design and own the large-scale data pipelines that turn raw customer-interaction signals into the context and features our personalization and proactive-agent models depend on, working side-by-side with SDEs to shape our data strategy and architecture.

  • You will build and operate ETL/ELT pipelines processing billions of records a day, using AWS big-data services (Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Redshift, DynamoDB) and distributed compute.
  • You will partner with SDEs and applied scientists to define data strategy, contracts, and feature pipelines, and to decide architecture direction together.
  • You will own operational health: data migrations, schema/platform updates, and triage of pipeline tickets, directly supporting the SDE team's work.
  • This is a high-visibility role: the data you deliver, and keep running, directly shapes what Alexa proactively tells customers, and when.

Key job responsibilities

  • Partner closely with SDEs to help define data strategy, architecture direction, and the long-term roadmap for the team's data platform.
  • Design, build, and own ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and load customer-interaction and context data at a scale of billions of records per day.
  • Own operational items end-to-end: data migrations, schema and platform updates, and triage/resolution of data-pipeline tickets, providing day-to-day support to the SDE team.
  • Partner with applied scientists and ML engineers to define data contracts, feature pipelines, and data-quality checks feeding personalization and proactive-agent models.
  • Operate and continuously improve production pipelines: optimize data delivery, redesign for scalability, manage deployments, and drive root-cause fixes for pipeline incidents.
  • Establish and document best practices for data modeling, warehousing, and pipeline design across the team.

A day in the life

You'll join SDEs in a design discussion to shape data strategy and architecture, then pick up a migration or platform-update ticket and see it through to resolution. You'll trace a data-quality issue in a personalization feature pipeline, support SDEs with any operational asks on your pipelines, and monitor the health of systems processing billions of daily customer-interaction events. You'll partner with applied scientists to onboard new signal sources and triage pipeline alerts.

job.name: Senior Data Engineer, FBA Growth Segments Intelligence
job.description:
Description WW FBA Growth Segments has a multi-year charter to accelerate Fulfillment by Amazon's growth into its largest untapped product segments. We focus on categories where FBA has a large addressable opportunity but low penetration. Four structural barriers hold that penetration back: cost economics, fulfillment complexity, catalog limitations and seller trust gaps. Our portfolio spans heavy and bulky goods, premium electronics and appliances, multi-component products, and Amazon Business supply chain.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build and own the data foundation for the full portfolio. The mission areas are non-sort economics, high-ASP seller trust, multi-box fulfillment, seller growth and B2B supply chain. You will turn ambiguous business questions into clear data architecture. You will deliver datasets that depend on source systems owned by other organizations. Because the team supports the whole portfolio, you will build shared data assets that more than one mission can reuse, instead of one-off pipelines.

The role sits at the intersection of data engineering and AI. You will own the data layer that decides whether GenAI-powered insights are accurate, fast and trusted. You will work on an executive-level initiative to deliver proactive, AI-generated insights on Growth Segments metrics to FBA leadership worldwide.

The role needs strength in two areas. First, you will set a high bar for data architecture, data quality and operational excellence. Second, you will drive delivery across organizational boundaries. That means aligning partner teams in catalog, fulfillment, pricing, seller experience and transportation on data contracts, dependencies and launch dates. You will work closely with Product, Program Management, Business Intelligence, Science and Software Engineering partners to decide what data we build, in what order, and how we measure success.

Key job responsibilities

Data foundation and architecture

  • Architect a scalable, cost-optimized S3-based data lakehouse. It will unify Growth Segments data across selection, inventory, fees, cost-to-serve, seller and customer domains.
  • Lead the migration from a Redshift-centric architecture to a lakehouse model, with defined targets for query performance and cost.
  • Design flat, denormalized datasets that embed ASIN, seller and segment attributes. These make queries simple for analysts and GenAI agents.

Data quality and operations

  • Design standard ingestion patterns with built-in quality checks, staging-first policies and automated validation gates.
  • Set up metadata management with automated data classification and lineage tracking.
  • Define data quality SLAs, runbooks and schema change management processes for every production dataset.
  • Build orchestration for metrics workflows with full audit trails and alerting on late or incomplete upstream data.

job.name: Agent Engineer - Evals and Harness
job.description:
Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems. While that is the vision, the mission is to build safety aware autonomous systems in the extreme near term. Our research work spans areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris, and London.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

The Role

Our current sprint on building autonomous systems for complex problems, across software engineering, data science, and AI research, involves building the harness, execution substrate and evaluation system, and each is designed to run inside a customer's environment rather than ours.

This role sits underneath all three agents. The coding agent, the data science agent and the AI engineering agent look different from the outside, but they are the same system underneath: a loop that plans, acts, observes, recovers, and knows when to stop. You will build that shared layer, and the evaluation system that tells us whether any change to it made things better. Both halves matter equally. A harness we cannot measure is a harness we cannot improve.

*What you'll work on:*

Harness

  • The core agent loop and its execution model, covering orchestration, concurrency, sub-agent coordination, cancellation, timeouts, checkpointing and resume.
  • Context and state management for long-running tasks, including retention, compaction, and how an agent reasons over what it has already done.
  • The shared tool protocol, its schemas, versioning, and the internal libraries every agent team builds against.
  • The execution substrate. Sandboxed environments that are reproducible, snapshot-able and resource-bounded, and that behave identically for a repository task, a training run and a data analysis.
  • Failure semantics. Retry policy, partial failure, idempotency, and the distinction between a recoverable error and a task that should stop and hand back.
  • The trace schema every agent emits, which serves at once as our debugging surface, our training signal, and the audit record our customers keep.

Evals

job.name: Senior AI Platform Engineer
job.description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab building aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems. Our work spans alignment methods, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across LLMs, agents, and tabular / structured-data models.

A core part of our work is turning advanced AI research into production systems. That means taking internally developed libraries and model workflows, such as *AlignTune , TabTune , and DLBacktrace* , and integrating them into scalable platform infrastructure that supports training, inference, evaluation, observability, and enterprise deployment.

The Role

We are hiring a *Senior AI Platform Engineer* to build the platform layer that operationalizes Lexsi’s core AI systems.

This role is centered on *R&D-to-platform rollout* : taking technically sophisticated model systems and making them usable, reliable, and scalable inside the product stack. You will work across model pipelines, training systems, inference infrastructure, distributed execution, and backend platform architecture.

This is not a thin integration role. It requires strong engineering depth and enough model understanding to work effectively with systems involving *fine-tuning, RL, alignment, interpretability, agent execution, and inference optimization across LLMs, agents, and tabular foundation models* .

Responsibilities

  • Own the platformization of Lexsi’s internal AI libraries, turning research-heavy systems into robust platform capabilities with stable APIs, execution layers, observability, and deployment paths.
  • Build and scale training and post-training infrastructure for workflows including *SFT, RL, evaluation, model adaptation, and agent optimization* .
  • Design the integration layer between research systems and product infrastructure, including job orchestration, artifact management, dataset versioning, experiment lineage, and runtime control surfaces.
  • Build inference systems that can support complex model behaviors under production constraints, including latency, throughput, cost efficiency, debuggability, and safety.
  • Design for *multi-cluster and distributed execution* , including scheduling, fault tolerance, checkpointing, retries, workload isolation, and heterogeneous compute environments.
  • Operationalize systems such as *AlignTune for fine-tuning and RL pipelines, TabTune for tabular foundation model workflows, and DLBacktrace* for interpretability, tracing, and behavioral inspection.
  • Build common platform primitives for model lifecycle management across training, evaluation, serving, rollback, and monitoring.
  • Partner closely with research teams to translate model-science complexity into production architecture without flattening away the core technical value.
  • Improve platform reliability for long-running and failure-prone AI workloads, especially where model behavior, system behavior, and i

You will guide complex engagements from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization. Your work will connect planned schedules, recorded time, absence transactions, and downstream Payroll processing to support consistent business outcomes and production readiness. Working with geographically distributed clients and functional, technical, integration, security, data, and Payroll teams, you will resolve cross-service dependencies and explain design options and trade-offs. You will govern rules, formulas, approvals, testing, performance, and solution quality while addressing relevant security, Redwood, AI, and Workforce Health and Safety implications. The role suits an experienced architect or domain lead who can demonstrate personal implementation ownership, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks and decisions to project leadership.

The role supports clients across all geographies. Hiring location, official grade, final experience range, employment model, hybrid attendance, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Own integrated Workforce Management architecture from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization to support successful delivery.
  • Lead requirements and architecture workshops; evaluate design options against business fit, maintainability, performance, security, user experience, and delivery complexity.
  • Resolve dependencies across Workforce Scheduling, time capture and calculation, absence processing, and Payroll, including processing sequence, retrospective corrections, reconciliation, and exception ownership.
  • Govern business rules, Fast Formulas, validations, approvals, and exception handling to deliver consistent outcomes across services.
  • Lead cross-stream design reviews with functional, technical, integration, security, data, and Payroll teams; address relevant Workforce Health and Safety, security, Redwood, and AI implications.
  • Define and govern integration, regression, exception, performance, and user acceptance testing across services to validate end-to-end business outcomes.
  • Establish solution quality criteria, review delivery evidence, and drive resolution of functional issues and design defects to meet agreed quality expectations.
  • Review migration and integration designs, data ownership, error handling, recovery, reconciliation, and cutover dependencies to establish production readiness.
  • Maintain design decisions, dependency maps, documentation, and configuration or development standards; demonstrate the integ

job.name: Senior .NET Developer / .NET Lead
job.description:
Job Title: Senior .NET Developer / .NET Lead

Experience: 6–8 Years

Location: Chennai

Employment Type: Full-Time

About SANeForce SANeForce is a technology-driven organization specializing in innovative software solutions for the Pharma, Healthcare, Hospital, Diagnostics, FMCG, and other industries. Our solutions include Sales Force Automation (SFA), Distribution Management Systems (DMS), and Payroll Management, helping businesses streamline their operations through technology.

Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Senior .NET Developer / .NET Lead with 6–8 years of hands-on experience in developing, designing, and maintaining scalable web applications using .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, PostgreSQL, and MS SQL Server.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise, problem-solving capabilities, and the ability to take ownership of development activities, mentor team members, and deliver high-quality software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

+ Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using .NET Core and ASP.NET MVC.
+ Develop and implement RESTful APIs and backend services.
+ Work extensively with PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server for database design, development, and optimization.
+ Write efficient SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and database scripts.
+ Analyze technical requirements and translate them into effective software solutions.
+ Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application performance issues and technical challenges.
+ Ensure application performance, scalability, security, and maintainability.
+ Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UI/UX designers, QA engineers, and project managers.
+ Review code, maintain coding standards, and ensure adherence to development best practices.
+ Guide and mentor junior developers and support technical decision-making.
+ Participate in requirement analysis, technical discussions, testing, deployment, and production support.

Required Technical Skills

+ Strong hands-on experience in .NET Core.
+ Good experience in ASP.NET MVC.
+ Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL.
+ Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server (MS SQL).
+ Proficiency in C# and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
+ Experience in REST API development and integration.
+ Strong knowledge of database design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
+ Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and coding best practices.
+ Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

job.name: Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll Architect
job.description:
Job Description About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.

Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.

Why join CSS?

  • Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.
  • Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.
  • Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio.
  • Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.
  • Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

Fusion Apps Studios Fusion Apps Studios help customers realize greater value from Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications by improving business processes, adopting new capabilities, and making better use of embedded AI. The team assesses existing environments, identifies adoption and process gaps, and develops practical improvement roadmaps. Solutions prioritize standard functionality, supported by integration and extensions where needed. Depending on the role, work may include Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX. Join Fusion Apps Studios to deepen your functional or technical expertise while broadening your contribution to customer advisory, connected processes, and business transformation.

Read the full description

job.name: Mainframe UA Developer
job.description:
Req ID: 398828

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Mainframe UA Developer to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN-TN), India (IN).

Mainframe (UA) Developer

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Coordinate with clients and other I.T. personnel in analyzing system requests, developing specifications for new system development projects or for maintenance to existing mainframe-based applications.
  • Adhere to System Development Life Cycle standards, including preparation of project-related documents as requested by the Project Manager.
  • Make design changes to programs, either alone or in concert with other programmers.
  • Prepare unit and integration test plans for program changes, and in cooperation with clients and other I.T. personnel, perform the testing.
  • Conduct thorough problem analysis in regard to technical system and application programs; documents findings and proposes problem resolution alternatives.
  • Some on-call responsibilities to support production as needed.
  • Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Communicate project progress and issues as needed.
  • Prepare user and operational documentation for programming work performed.
  • Serve as a Project Lead for smaller or less complex projects
  • Serve as a mentor for less experienced programmer/analysts as needed.
  • Serve as a ‘go-to’ resource for complex questions.

Be a participatory team member, share knowledge, assist with projects as needed and suggest improvements for the system development process.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • 8+ years experience performing system development and support for mainframe-based applications.
  • Proven experience in meeting deadlines and managing multiple priorities.
  • Proven ability to work with clients in developing system solutions to business needs
  • Mastery of mainframe development tools: COBOL, Easytrieve, CICS, VSAM, VSE/DOS. Some Assembler knowledge also a plus.
  • Master of VSE tools such as: SyncSort, IDCAMS, CECI, CEDF, FTP, or any other third party toolset.
  • Client/Server technology skills a plus. Working with .TXT, .XLS files and SQL is also a plus, but not required.
  • Working skills for MS Office suite of products also preferred (Word, Excel, Visio)
  • Working knowledge of systems development life cycle and use of structured methodologies and techniques (Waterfall, Agile).
  • Experience working in a team environment.
  • Strong technical, analytical and communication skills.

Job Description Title: Dynamics AX Developer-Microsoft Dynamics AX / Enterprise Applications- Husky(India) Guindy, Chennai

Id: 20962

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Core Java & Apache Spark
job.description:
We are hiring an elite Senior Software Engineer to build and scale our core data processing and application infrastructure. This role demands deep, hands-on expertise in the Java ecosystem and distributed computing with Apache Spark. You will be responsible for the architecture, design, and implementation of mission-critical systems that process massive datasets, requiring a mastery of concurrency, JVM internals, and modern cloud-native patterns.

Core Tech Stack:

  • Languages & Runtimes: Java (8+), SQL, JVM
  • Frameworks & Libraries: Spring (Boot, Data, Security, Batch, Integration), Apache Spark (RDD, Spark SQL, DataFrames/DataSets)
  • Big Data Ecosystem: Hadoop, Hive, Impala, Spark Tuning & Optimization
  • Databases: Relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, Oracle), NoSQL (MongoDB, Graph DB)
  • Messaging & Middleware: JMS, Solace
  • Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift
  • Build & CI/CD: Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, Git
  • Code Quality & Security: SonarQube, TDD (JUnit/Mockito), Secure Coding Practices

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect & Build: Design and construct high-throughput, low-latency data processing pipelines using Apache Spark and the Spring ecosystem.
  • Performance Engineering: Dive deep into JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, and Spark job optimization to maximize performance and resource efficiency.
  • Distributed Systems Design: Implement scalable, resilient, and transactional architectures leveraging container orchestration (Kubernetes/OpenShift) and distributed data stores.
  • Code & Design Excellence: Champion and enforce best practices in software engineering, including SOLID principles, advanced design patterns, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • Database Mastery: Engineer and optimize data models for both relational and NoSQL databases, ensuring data integrity, performance, and scalability.
  • CI/CD Automation: Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment of Java applications and Spark jobs in a containerized environment.
  • Technical Leadership: Lead design and code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and drive the adoption of new technologies and architectural patterns across the team.

Required Technical Qualifications:

job.name: Applications Developer Salesforce and ETL
job.description:
Citi is looking for an Applications Development Analyst to join its Banking Operations Technology team in Chennai, contributing to the design, development, and continuous improvement of Salesforce and ETL-based application systems. In this role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to build and refine solutions that directly support banking operations and enhance how technology serves internal business functions. This is an opportunity to grow your technical foundation within a global financial institution that operates at real scale and complexity.

Responsibilities

  • Build and enhance application features by applying knowledge of development procedures, system concepts, and industry standards to identify and implement required improvements.
  • Develop Salesforce and ETL solutions that address complex business and systems challenges within the Banking Operations environment.
  • Analyze application issues, assess potential approaches, and implement well-reasoned solutions that align with system and business requirements.
  • Write, test, and debug code to meet design specifications, using appropriate scripting tools and programming techniques.
  • Evaluate information and apply judgement to recommend improvements that increase system effectiveness and operational reliability.
  • Build working knowledge of Citi's application landscape, including client-server development, database administration, network operations, and enterprise systems.
  • Support risk-aware development practices by identifying and escalating control issues and ensuring solutions meet applicable compliance and policy standards.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 2-5 years of experience in application development, programming, or software debugging in a business context.
  • Working knowledge of at least one programming language used in application or systems development.
  • Familiarity with industry development standards and practices as applied to business application environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both in writing and verbally, across technical and non-technical audiences.

job.description:
Job Description Title: IoT Software Developer - Device Engineering Team-Husky(India) Guindy, Chennai

Id: 20963

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

IoT Software Developer Do you want to work on software applications that connect industrial machines, edge devices, and cloud platforms?

As an IoT Edge Software Developer within the Device Engineering Team (DET), you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and support of software running on edge devices that collect machine data, communicate securely with cloud platforms, and enable remote management at scale. You will work with Windows-based edge devices, cloud-connected applications, and device lifecycle management processes that support customers worldwide.

This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys hands-on software development, troubleshooting complex device and connectivity issues, and working at the intersection of industrial systems, edge computing, and cloud technologies.

job.name: Senior Java Microservices Engineer - Assistant Vice President
job.description:
Citi is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Banking Operations team within the Consumer Operations Technology organization, where you will design and deliver Java microservices solutions that directly support critical banking operations at scale. In this role, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle — from feasibility and planning through to implementation and ongoing support — acting as a subject matter expert for both your team and senior stakeholders. This is an opportunity to build meaningful technology in a global financial institution where your engineering decisions have real business impact.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement Java microservices applications that address specific business needs within the Banking Operations team, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable, and fit for purpose.
  • Lead all phases of the software development lifecycle, including analysis, design, construction, testing, and deployment, maintaining quality and delivery standards throughout.
  • Analyse complex technical and business problems, evaluate system processes against industry standards, and engineer effective solutions that improve operational outcomes.
  • Define and enforce security measures and operating standards as part of post-implementation reviews, ensuring systems perform reliably and securely in production.
  • Collaborate with business users, clients, and cross-functional technology teams to gather requirements, recommend advanced engineering solutions, and resolve technical issues.
  • Conduct feasibility studies, support IT planning, and contribute to time and cost estimation activities to inform sound technical decision-making.
  • Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers, sharing technical knowledge and supporting their professional development within the team.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 8 to 13 years of experience in software application development, with a focus on systems analysis, design, and programming.
  • Hands-on experience building and delivering Java-based applications, with practical knowledge of microservices architecture in an enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver software projects end to end, navigating shifting requirements and competing priorities under pressure.
  • Working knowledge of project management and consulting methodologies, with the ability to coordinate effectively across technology and business teams.
  • Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, exercising sound technical judgement and taking ownership of outcomes with minimal supervision.
  • Commitment to risk awareness and compliance, including the ability to identify and escalate control issues and apply ethical judgement in day-to-day engineering decisions.
