Job Description: ServiceNow TNI Architect Experience 10+ years of experience in ServiceNow architecture, development and telecom modules

Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled ServiceNow TNI (Telecom Network Inventory) Architect to design, architect, and implement telecom and network infrastructure solutions on the ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in ServiceNow modules [Telecom Network Inventory (TNI)), Telecom Service Management (TSM), Service Order Management for Telecom (SOMT], and along with strong understanding of network inventory, service modeling, and telecom operations. You will drive architecture decisions, ensure scalable implementations, and align ServiceNow capabilities with evolving telecom business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define end-to-end ServiceNow architecture for telecom/network inventory (TNI)
  • Design scalable solutions using CMDB & CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, and TSOM/TNI
  • Lead implementation of ITSM, ITOM, and telecom modules
  • Model telecom/network services (L1/L2/L3, circuits, devices)
  • Architect integrations with NMS, EMS, OSS/BSS systems
  • Ensure CMDB data quality, governance, and reconciliation
  • Mentor teams and drive best practices
  • Optimize platform performance and scalability

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, CMDB
  • Experience with ServiceNow TNI, Service Mapping, Discovery
  • Knowledge of network infrastructure and telecom lifecycle
  • Integration expertise (REST, SOAP, MID Server)
  • JavaScript, Glide APIs, Flow Designer
  • Data modeling & CSDM

Certifications

  • ServiceNow CSA
  • CIS – Minimum 2 CIS certification
  • Telecom certifications (Good to have)
  • CTA (preferred)

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management
  • Leadership and mentoring ability

EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

job.name: HCM Cloud Functional Solution Architect
job.description:
Job Description About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.

Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.

Why join CSS?

  • Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.
  • Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.
  • Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio.
  • Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.
  • Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

Fusion Apps Studios Fusion Apps Studios help customers realize greater value from Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications by improving business processes, adopting new capabilities, and making better use of embedded AI. The team assesses existing environments, identifies adoption and process gaps, and develops practical improvement roadmaps. Solutions prioritize standard functionality, supported by integration and extensions where needed. Depending on the role, work may include Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX. Join Fusion Apps Studios to deepen your functional or technical expertise while broadening your contribution to customer advisory, connected processes, and business transformation.

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Solution Architect, you will own end-to-end solution design across two designated HCM services, translating complex business requirements into integrated, secure and effective solutions. You will combine deep hands-on expertise in your primary service with sufficient functional depth in the secondary service to evaluate, challenge and approve solution designs.

job.name: Oracle Fusion HCM - Principal Consultant
job.description:
Job Description As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Consultant, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a consultant with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
  • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
  • Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
  • Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
  • Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
  • Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
  • Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.
  • Review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to support delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

Skills - Mandatory Experience

job.name: Staff Data Engineer
job.description:
Camis is a recognized industry leader in reservation and park management technology. We connect people to a world of memorable experiences through our robust, user-friendly reservation software and best-in-class call center services. Trusted by over 1,300 government-operated parks, campgrounds, harbors, and marinas across North America, Camis is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions that make it easier for visitors to discover, book, and enjoy the most beautiful landscapes.

We believe work should be fun, fulfilling, and flexible—and we're looking for friendly, motivated people to join us!

Visit www.camis.com for more information on our products, services, and clients.

The Opportunity

We are committed to building software that stands the test of time, and we're looking for a Staff Data Engineer to own how data is stored, moved, modelled, and governed across our Parks & Recreation platform.

This is a hands-on, staff-level engineering role reporting to the CTO. You will own two connected parts of the Camis business: the performance and health of our Azure SQL production databases (Core), and the Snowflake data platform built on top of them. When the two compete for attention, Core comes first, because Core is production.

You will be the senior escalation point for Azure SQL production issues, the owner of our multi-tenant ELT platform (Meltano to Snowflake via dbt, orchestrated by Dagster on Azure Container Apps), and the steward of sensitive data, including PII classification, masking, right-to-erasure, and the scrubbing of non-production database copies.

You will also be the formal technical leader of our Data Work Group, a cross-functional team of analysts, DevOps engineers, and co-op students. You'll set the engineering standards for SQL, dbt, and pipeline work, and partner with product, finance, and leadership to turn questions into trusted metrics.

AI-assisted development is part of how we work at Camis. You will use AI coding tools in your day-to-day SQL, dbt, Python, and Terraform work, and apply rigorous guardrails so that changes involving personal data or production databases never rely on unreviewed AI output.

Our platform processes millions of reservations and transactions annually for agencies including Parks Canada, Ontario Parks, BC Parks, and Mississippi State Parks. The data systems you own will serve more than 30 production clients across our Canadian and US environments, and underpin real experiences for millions of visitors exploring some of North America's most treasured outdoor destinations.

What you'll be doing

job.name: Sr Business Systems Analyst – Laboratory System
job.description:
Sr Business Systems Analyst – Laboratory System, Lansing, MI, US

System Analyst The position is responsible for taking a lead role in the implementation of two new Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) for the Bureau of Laboratories and for providing ongoing maintenance and support of several Bureau of Laboratories applications supported within our department. These applications are critical for tracking resources and producing reports for Public Health. The resource is integral to supporting and improving MDHHS automated processes, streamlining critical business processes, data integrity, SEM/SUITE compliance, and securing the applications. As a lead, the resource participates in a variety of assignments that provides for the enhancement, integration, maintenance, and implementation of projects. The resource also provides application oversight to business analysts in the team that support other applications. Not having a resource on staff will lead to delays and errors on the reports that MDHSS will have to manually process and delay support of applications and projects. This would significantly reduce the quality of Public Health services provided by the State of Michigan

Job Responsibilities

  • Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements from lab stakeholders (scientists, technicians, QA/QC, management)
  • Translate laboratory workflows into system requirements and user stories
  • Conduct gap analysis between current processes and system capabilities
  • Support implementation, configuration, and enhancement of LIMS and related systems
  • Collaborate with vendors and IT teams on system upgrades, integrations, and issue resolution
  • Assist in validation activities (IQ/OQ/PQ) where applicable
  • Analyze lab workflows (sample tracking, testing, reporting) to identify inefficiencies
  • Recommend automation and digital solutions
  • Standardized processes across labs or departments
  • Maintain SOPs, user guides, and system documentation
  • Act as the bridge between technical teams and non-technical lab users
  • Facilitate workshops, training sessions, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
  • Provide ongoing user support and training
  • Understanding of laboratory workflows:
  • Sample lifecycle (login, testing, reporting)
  • Instrument integration
  • Quality control processes

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related laboratory science (such as Biology or Chemistry)
  • 8+ years of experience in requirements elicitation and documentation (BRDs, FRDs, user stories)
  • 8+ years of Process mapping (BPMN, flowcharts)
  • 8+ years of Stakeholder management and communication
  • 8+ years of experience with data migration and system implementation projects
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or similar
  • Understanding of:
  • System integrations (APIs, HL7, ETL processes)
  • SQL and basic database concepts
  • Data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)

Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.

job.name: Technical Lead
job.description:
Company Description Criclive.in is a dedicated cricket platform built to deliver the fastest live, ball-by-ball commentary on the internet, matching the pace of live telecasts. Over time, it has evolved into a comprehensive cricket destination, offering sharp features, in-depth analyses, and breaking news from across the cricketing world. The platform also hosts an active fan discussion page where cricket enthusiasts from around the globe share opinions, celebrate key moments, and debate trending topics. Criclive.in is focused on helping fans not just follow the game, but experience and live it together as a community.
Role Description The Technical Lead will oversee the design, development, and maintenance of Criclive.in’s core platforms and services, ensuring fast, reliable, and scalable delivery of live cricket content. This full-time, on-site role based in Janakpuri involves leading a small engineering team, reviewing code, setting technical standards, and guiding architectural decisions for web and backend systems. The Technical Lead will collaborate closely with product, content, and operations teams to translate business needs into robust technical solutions and optimize performance for high-traffic, real-time updates. Day-to-day responsibilities include hands-on development, troubleshooting production issues, managing deployments, and mentoring team members to uphold best practices in security, quality, and maintainability.
Qualifications

  • Strong experience in web application development (e.g., modern JavaScript frameworks, responsive UI development, RESTful APIs).
  • Solid backend engineering skills (e.g., server-side languages, relational and/or NoSQL databases, caching, message queues).
  • Proficiency in system architecture and scalability (e.g., high-availability systems, load balancing, performance optimization for real-time data).
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps practices (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, containerization, cloud infrastructure management, monitoring and logging).
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities (e.g., team mentoring, code review, technical decision-making, cross-functional collaboration).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to clean, maintainable, and secure code.
  • Ability to work on-site in Janakpuri and thrive in a fast-paced, content-driven environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience; passion for cricket and sports technology is a plus.

job.name: Avaloq Engineer
job.description:
Join us as an Avaloq Engineer

  • This is an opportunity for a driven Software Engineer to take on an exciting new career challenge
  • Day-to-day, you'll build a wide network of stakeholders of varying levels of seniority
  • It’s a chance to hone your existing technical skills and advance your career
  • We're offering this role at associate level

What you'll do

In your new role, you’ll engineer and maintain innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust solutions. You’ll be working within a feature team and using your extensive experience to engineer software, scripts and tools that are often complex, as well as liaising with other engineers, architects and business analysts across the platform.

You’ll also be:

  • Producing complex and critical software rapidly and of high quality which adds value to the business
  • Working in permanent teams who are responsible for the full life cycle, from initial development, through enhancement and maintenance to replacement or decommissioning
  • Collaborating to optimise our software engineering capability
  • Designing, producing, testing and implementing our working code
  • Working across the life cycle, from requirements analysis and design, through coding to testing, deployment and operations

The skills you'll need

You’ll need a background in software engineering, software design, architecture, and an understanding of how your area of expertise supports our customers. You'll need at least three years of strong experience in PL/SQL with a good understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle or SDLC and hands-on experience in Avaloq scripting and parameterisation, including Report Writer, Workflows, Order Validations, Migration Scripts, Interface Definitions, and related modules.

You'll also need experience in the Core Banking or Wealth Management domain, with the ability to analyse requirements and issues, design and deliver high-quality solutions, develop changes in line with strong coding standards, coordinate delivery with testers, business users and other stakeholders and provide post-go-live support.

You’ll also need:

  • Experience of working with development and testing tools, bug tracking tools and wikis
  • Experience in multiple programming languages or low code toolsets
  • Experience of DevOps, testing and Agile methodology and associated toolsets
  • A background in solving highly complex, analytical and numerical problems
  • Experience of implementing programming best practice, especially around scalability, automation, virtualisation, optimisation, availability and performance

job.name: Vermilion Developer
job.description:

With key outsourcing clients and a growing book of Middle Office services, we now require an experienced Vermilion Developer to support our expanding team.

We are looking for a candidate to join the newly formed Client Reporting Team. The ideal candidate will have a background in Vermilion development and prior exposure to client reporting within the financial services industry.

The role involves working as part of a growing local team while also collaborating with an extended offshore team. Strong client ownership is essential, with the expectation to deliver high-quality service and contribute to strategic initiatives and change projects.

The successful candidate will take ownership of the development and delivery of Vermilion-based client reports. This will involve close interaction with Product, Global IT, Operations, and third-party vendors to ensure reports are delivered to a high standard and within agreed service levels.

The role requires a proactive and independent professional with strong technical expertise and a “go-getter” attitude. Previous experience in financial services (preferably investment banking) and the ability to lead medium-to-large projects in a fast-paced environment are highly desirable.

Citi is undergoing a period of significant growth, and this role offers the opportunity to help shape the business. Experience in process improvement and working through periods of change will be viewed favourably.

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
job.description:
Description Department/Project Description We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).

You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.

Requirements Job Responsibilities Domain-Specific AI Integration Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).

Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.

Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.

Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.

Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).

Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.

Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.

Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.

job.description:
Technical Analyst – Post-Merger Integration (Hybrid: Business + Technical)

About The Role We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Technical Analyst to support Post-Merger

Integration (PMI) initiatives. This hybrid role combines strong domain understanding with

hands-on technical skills to independently discover and validate requirements, design

clear frameworks, and develop execution plans. A core focus is to analyze the acquired

company’s technology and process stack, map it to our ecosystem, and recommend the

best integration approach. They will ensure outcomes are well-defined, feasible,

measurable, and delivered on time.

Key Responsibilities

  • PMI Discovery & Assessment: Rapidly inventory and assess the acquired

company’s product, data, and process stack (applications, data models, APIs,

integrations, workflows, SLAs), documenting current-state capabilities and

constraints.

  • Stack Mapping & Alignment: Create detailed mappings from acquired systems to

our platforms and processes, including data entities/attributes, interface

touchpoints, roles/permissions, and operational handoffs; identify overlaps, gaps,

and deprecation candidates.

  • Integration Options & Recommendations: Propose integration patterns (e.g.,

consolidate, federate, phase-and-bridge), articulate trade-offs, and recommend

best-path actions aligned to business outcomes, risk, cost, and timeline.

  • Technical Decomposition: Translate target-state outcomes into epics, user

stories, data contracts, and interface specifications; outline system interactions,

dependencies, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability,

compliance).

  • Requirement Gathering & Analysis: Lead structured discovery with stakeholders

to elicit, clarify, and document business needs and success metrics; convert

ambiguity into clear, testable, and technically feasible requirements.

  • Frameworks & Documentation: Produce PMI-specific artifacts (current/target

state diagrams, sequencing/transition plans, cutover runbooks, decision logs,

RACI/DACI, prioritization matrices) to drive shared understanding and decisions.

  • Execution Planning: Build and maintain integration plans with scope, milestones,

dependency maps, risks/assumptions, and mitigation strategies; define and track

measurable outcomes and KPIs.

  • Data Quality & Reconciliation: Partner with data teams to define reconciliation

strategies, data quality checks, and migration validation plans; ensure lineage and

auditability across systems during transitions.

  • Stakeholder Management: Manage stakeholder communication independently

across both organizations; facilitate workshops, align on scope and phasing, handle

trade-offs, and maintain a consistent communication cadence.

job.name: Oracle Fusion HCM - Principal Consultant
job.description:
Job Description As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Consultant, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a consultant with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
  • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
  • Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
  • Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
  • Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
  • Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
  • Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.
  • Review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to support delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

Skills - Mandatory Experience

Job Description About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.

Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.

Why join CSS?

  • Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.

  • Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.
  • Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

Fusion Apps Studios Fusion Apps Studios help customers realize greater value from Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications by improving business processes, adopting new capabilities, and making better use of embedded AI. The team assesses existing environments, identifies adoption and process gaps, and develops practical improvement roadmaps. Solutions prioritize standard functionality, supported by integration and extensions where needed. Depending on the role, work may include Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX. Join Fusion Apps Studios to deepen your functional or technical expertise while broadening your contribution to customer advisory, connected processes, and business transformation.

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Solution Architect, you will own end-to-end solution design across two designated HCM services, translating complex business requirements into integrated, secure and effective solutions. You will combine deep hands-on expertise in your primary service with sufficient functional depth in the secondary service to evaluate, challenge and approve solution designs.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Design and develop scalable full stack applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.

job.name: Oracle Fusion HCM Technical - Sr. Principal Consultant
job.description:
Job Description As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Consultant, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a consultant with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
  • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
  • Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
  • Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
  • Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
  • Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
  • Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
THE ROLE: Data Engineer for Insight Globals AI Product & Services Division out of our Hyderabad location

We are looking for a Data Engineer to build the data foundation that IG Labs' agentic systems run on. Every agent we deploy into a client is only as good as the data and structure beneath it, and you are the engineer who builds that foundation: the pipelines, the models and ontologies, and the retrieval layer that feeds the agents the right context. This is backbone engineering, core to everything we deliver, not a service on the side.

You take on the hardest data problems in our client work: the source no one can cleanly extract, the ontology that has to capture how a business really works, the retrieval that has to surface the right context every time. You own the data foundation from a raw, messy starting point to a governed, reliable system in production, and you are accountable for whether the agents built on it can be trusted.

Everything you build, you build to last beyond one client. The pipelines, connectors, and ontology fragments you create become Factory IP that compounds across every engagement, so each project starts ahead of the last. You are a senior engineer in our delivery organization, based in India, working within the POD model alongside the Technical Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and the UI/UX and Technical/Field engineers who build the rest of the system.

Key Responsibilities

1- Solving the Hardest Data Problems

  • Take on the toughest data problems in our client work: the messy, incomplete, undocumented client data that stands between an idea and a working agent.
  • Design the data models and ontologies the agentic system operates on: entities, relationships, states, and the business rules that govern them.
  • Build the retrieval substrate that agentic systems depend on: chunking, embeddings, indexing, and retrieval pipelines tuned for accuracy.
  • Take an open-ended data problem with no clean source and engineer a reliable, governed path to usable data.
  • Shape genuinely architectural decisions with the Technical Architect, contributing the patterns that become standard.

2- Data Engineering

  • Build production-grade ingestion, ETL and ELT, and transformation pipelines across batch and streaming.
  • Design warehousing and lakehouse structures, schemas, and ontologies that hold up as engagements grow.
  • Stand up and tune vector stores and retrieval pipelines that feed RAG and agentic workflows.
  • Own data quality, governance, and lineage, the difference between an agent you can trust and one you cannot.
  • Engineer for performance and cost, so the foundation scales with the client without surprises.

3- Delivering in Client Engagements

job.name: Senior Engineer- Dot Net
job.description:
About Us We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Energy Systems We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

About The Role The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital & Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.

This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification & Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.

This is not a project-based delivery or staff-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.

Working in close partnership with Frontend Engineers, Product leadership, Data & AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security & Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.

The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft-oriented full-stack environment. The primary stack includes C# and .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Docker, .NET Aspire, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams.

This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform.

job.name: Senior Security Engineer I - Confluent
job.description:
Introduction At Confluent, we’re creating a category that transforms how every company manages and streams data. Have you ever found a new favorite series on Netflix, picked up groceries curbside at Walmart, or paid for something using Square? That’s Confluent in action—giving our customers instant access to massive amounts of real-time data, enabling them to thrive in an ever-changing digital world. As one of the fastest-growing enterprise companies in history, and with Fortune 100 customers across major industries, we have a tremendous opportunity in front of us. We also have experience on our side. Our leaders have taken companies of our size to major success before and include some of the original creators of Apache Kafka®.

We’re looking for self-motivated team members who crave a challenge and feel energized to roll up their sleeves and help realize Confluent’s unlimited potential. Chart your own path and take healthy risks with the backing and support of our #OneTeam culture. Be part of inclusive initiatives like Employee Resource Groups and development programs, and take advantage of benefits that support our diverse global teams. Grow as we grow—whether you’re just starting out or managing a large team, you’ll be amazed at the magnitude of your impact.

Your Role And Responsibilities Build and maintain scalable cloud-based security monitoring solutions, treating detections as code across logging pipelines, ETL jobs, and SIEM ingestion.

  • Translate modern adversary tradecraft (TTPs) and threat models into high-signal detection strategies to ensure our critical infrastructure operates safely.
  • Build processes and workflows to triage security alerts and drive incidents to closure, including participating in a shared on-call rotation for incident response.
  • Research new threat attack vectors and ensure that our detection and response program is in line with the current threat landscape.
  • Proactively improve the quality of our detection rules, working directly with engineering teams to eliminate classes of issues.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams in building logging pipelines needed to gather relevant security telemetry.
  • Contribute to risk management and prioritization efforts around detection and response.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

job.name: Manager – Data Governance & Protection Engineering

Cyber, Data, and Resilience Practice Kroll is seeking a Manager, Data Governance & Protection Engineering to help build and scale a high-performing global delivery capability focused on Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Privacy Operations, and enterprise data governance technologies. This role combines technical leadership, implementation oversight, and offshore team development across enterprise cybersecurity, privacy, and data protection programs.

This is a client-facing consulting role responsible for leading technical delivery initiatives while helping establish and mature a scalable India-based delivery and engineering capability supporting global client engagements. The ideal candidate will possess strong hands-on experience across multiple governance, privacy, and data protection technology stacks while also demonstrating leadership capabilities in team development, operational scaling, and delivery management.

RESPONSIBILITIES – Leadership & Global Delivery Development

  • Assist with hiring, mentoring, onboarding, and developing technical practitioners across governance and data protection disciplines.

RESPONSIBILITIES – Privacy Operations & Governance Technology

job.name: Security Specialist,AVP
job.description:
Join us as a Security Specialist

  • We’re looking for someone to actively support a domain and our wider organisation as a subject matter expert in a security-related field
  • Day-to-day, you’ll be making sure that the security implications of the backlog are understood in the right way to build security early into the design
  • This is your chance to bring a competitive edge to your career profile by solving new problems and creating smarter solutions and enjoying professional development opportunities
  • We're offering this role at associate vice president level

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll make sure that decisions are based on robust data, return on investment and value measures that demonstrate thoughtful and intelligent cost management. You’ll also encourage the identification of ideas and drive the delivery of initiatives that will reduce cost and simplify our Group.

Additionally, you’ll work at a domain level to understand and make sure that robust security is continuously considered and incorporated at every stage, programme increment and Feature team delivery throughout the development lifecycle and through to support.

You’ll Also Be Responsible For

  • Using your SME knowledge to support the wider organisation in building and operating secure services that protect both our colleagues and customers
  • Collaborating with Feature teams and participating in store refinement, sprint planning and retrospective sessions
  • Establishing a culture of innovation and strategic thinking that provides our Group with knowledge of the latest developments in your area of specialism
  • Making sure any developments in your area of specialism are assessed and the impact on our wider organisation is appropriately communicated

Your Profile

  • 8+ years of experience in System/Software Architecture, Design, and Integration.
  • Strong knowledge of Git/GitHub, Visual Studio Code (or equivalent IDEs), YAML, JSON, and PlantUML.
  • Experience with API design, REST services, HTTP methods, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD).
  • Knowledge of Model-Based Design (MBD) and Component-Based Systems Engineering (CBSE).
  • Experience defining software interfaces and integration architectures.
  • Strong understanding of architectural principles including SOLID and SOA.
  • Experience developing YAML-based workflows, automation frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines.

Architecture & Design: End-to-end architectural design of intelligent rApps focused on RAN optimization, automation, and management (e.g., energy saving, traffic steering, beamforming optimization).

SMO & RIC Integration: Define and implement robust integration patterns between rApps and the Non-RT RIC / SMO platform using standard O-RAN R1, O1, and A1 interfaces.

Development & Coding: Lead by example by writing clean, scalable, and secure microservices-based code (Python, Go, or Java) and mentoring junior developers.

On-Site Deployment & Delivery: Drive the hands-on deployment, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting of rApps directly within live customer network environments or trial labs.

Standardization Compliance: Ensure all software architectures strictly align with the latest O-RAN Alliance specifications (specifically Working Group 2 and Working Group 10).

Customer Consultation: Act as the primary technical point of contact for customer engineering teams, translating complex operator requirements into software architectures.

Required Technical Skills & Experience

  • Deep understanding of O-RAN Architecture, specifically Non-RT RIC, SMO, Near-RT RIC, and the O1, A1, and R1 interfaces.
  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or Java with a strong background in developing cloud-native microservices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, Helm charts, and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Experience with Kafka, MQTT, or gRPC for high-throughput data ingestion and messaging between SMO and rApps.
  • Familiarity with NETCONF/YANG, RESTconf, and SNMP protocols used in O1 interface management.

Qualifications & Experience Experience: 8+ years in telecom software development, with at least 2+ years of dedicated experience designing and deploying O-RAN rApps.

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience in successfully delivering and deploying rApps at a customer site (lab trials or commercial rollouts).

Soft Skills: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain complex architectural concepts to both internal developers and executive-level customers.

job.name: Senior Telecom Software Developer (5G RAN / CNF)
job.description:
Description About the Role We are seeking a hands-on Senio r Developer to lead the design and implementation of high-throughput, low-latency 5G gNB (Next-Generation NodeB) software. You will bridge the gap between high-level architectural vision and low-level system execution, driving the evolution of our 5G RAN stack into resilient, cloud-native microservices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Design: Architect end-to-end 5G gNB Distributed Unit (DU) and Centralized Unit (CU) components as scalable, cloud-native network functions (CNFs).
  • Hands-On C++ Development: Write clean, maintainable, and ultra-low-latency modern C++ (C++17/C++20) code for Layer 2 (MAC, RLC, PDCP) and Layer 3 (RRC, NGAP, F1AP) protocol stacks.
  • Data Plane Optimization: Design and optimize high-speed packet processing pipelines using DPDK (Data Plane Development Kit), bypassing the kernel to maximize throughput and minimize jitter.
  • System-Level Engineering: Architect multi-threaded, lock-free applications on Linux, optimizing CPU pinning, NUMA awareness, memory management, and hardware acceleration (e.g., SmartNICs, SR-IOV).
  • Cloud-Native Transformation: Lead the containerization and orchestration of 5G workloads on Kubernetes, ensuring seamless lifecycle management, high availability, and observability.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, conduct rigorous architecture and code reviews, and establish best practices for performance profiling and benchmarking.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5 to 8 years of proven experience in telecom software engineering, with at least 3+ years in a technical leadership or architectural capacity.
  • 5G & RAN Expertise: Deep understanding of 3GPP 5G NR specifications, specifically around gNB architecture (CU/DU split), Layer 2 (MAC scheduling, RLC, PDCP, SDAP), and Layer 3 signaling protocols.
  • Programming Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in modern C++ and Linux system programming (IPC, shared memory, POSIX threads, socket programming, profiling tools like perf and gdb).
  • Packet Processing & Networking: Strong hands-on experience with DPDK, SR-IOV, and core computer networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, SCTP, GTP-U, VLAN, QoS).
  • Cloud-Native Stack: Practical experience deploying and debugging CNFs on Kubernetes/OpenShift, utilizing Helm, Docker, and cloud-native networking plugins (Multus, Calico, Cilium).

Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)

  • Experience with O-RAN (Open RAN) architectures, interfaces (Open Fronthaul, E2, A1, O1), and RIC integration.
  • Familiarity with hardware offloading technologies (e.g., Intel FlexRAN, NVIDIA Aerial, or FPGA/ASIC-based lookaside/inline acceleration).
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for telco workloads and automated performance testing frameworks.

Area(s) of responsibility

Role Summary

As Observability Engineer / SME, you will be the technical authority for designing, implementing, and operating enterprise monitoring and observability solutions across hybrid IT environments. Working hands-on with platforms such as HPE OpsRamp and SolarWinds (and similar ITOM/observability tools), you will deliver end-to-end monitoring — onboarding, discovery, service mapping, alert correlation, and ITSM-integrated event management — to improve reliability, reduce noise, and accelerate MTTD/MTTR for our clients. Design & Implementation

Required Skills & Experience Monitoring & Observability (mandatory)

job.name: Revenue Manager
job.description:
Spacez runs 70+ private luxury villas for group stays and celebrations across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Goa and Rajasthan. We are hiring a Revenue Manager to build our revenue function: how we price and sell them.

You own the price of every villa-night, the channels it is sold on, and the forecast it is judged against. You take our in-house pricing engine live and run it the way revenue will be run from here on: AI does the heavy lifting, you make the calls, and your decisions go live in days. Very few revenue managers get to design the system they run. Here you do.

You report to the founder, and part of your pay is linked to the revenue you grow. This is the role for you if you would rather build a revenue system than inherit one.

What will you be doing at Spacez

  • Channel manager and listings: you own the channel manager. Automations keep every listing mapped and in sync, growth on each channel is driven by what the tracking shows, and you keep a clear read on what each channel earns us after commission.
  • Calendar sync: every listing's calendar closing on its own when the villa sells anywhere.
  • Rate parity: a parity policy per channel, and a weekly check that it holds.
  • Listing health: our listing performance tracker, turned into weekly fixes with the listings owner.
  • Price setting: setting the prices yourself, through AI and our in-house pricing engine, with guardrails and a read on what each change earned.
  • Price shape: the day-of-week, season and festival calendar for each city. Mumbai and Bengaluru have near-opposite seasons, and Diwali is a dip for us, not a peak.
  • Discounts: one discount ladder, a floor on every villa, and a read on what each code actually earns.
  • Peak dates: villa-level peak pricing, set from how each villa picked up last year and how it is pacing now.
  • Forecast: the monthly forecast by city and villa, and its published track record.
  • Targets: proposing the monthly revenue and occupancy targets for each villa from the forecast, for the founder to approve.
  • Pace to target: a weekly pace review that ends in named price and channel decisions.
  • Future months: the forward book. Bookings for the months ahead and the advance revenue they bring, through early-booking offers, long-lead pricing and a target for how much of each month is sold before it starts.
  • Measurement: clean definitions, and a test-and-read habit on every pricing change.
  • Direct growth and OTA commission: growing direct bookings and cutting what we pay OTAs in commission, through a channel mix plan with the true cost of each channel in it.

What are your job requirements at Spacez

Introduction Retail Media Data Operations Analyst: The Retail Media Data Operations Analyst is responsible for transforming fragmented reporting from retail media networks, third-party media partners, retailers, and measurement providers into standardized, validated, analysis-ready datasets.

This role serves as the operational bridge between media activation, partner reporting, Business Intelligence, and client analytics. The analyst will manage the data preparation lifecycle from reporting intake and completeness checks through normalization, quality assurance, documentation, and delivery so the media teams can dedicate more time to performance analysis, strategic recommendations, and executive storytelling.

Your Role And Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Reporting Intake and Operational Management

  • Download or collect reporting from partner portals, shared locations, email deliveries, APIs, and other approved sources.

Data Preparation and Standardization

  • Reconcile retailer, product, UPC, campaign, placement, and organizational hierarchies.
  • Document transformations, assumptions, exclusions, and calculations so outputs can be consistently reproduced.

Data Quality and Validation

  • Perform completeness, accuracy, reasonableness, duplication, and reconciliation checks before datasets are released for analysis.

job.name: Senior Business Intelligence Engineer, FBA Growth Segments Intelligence
job.description:
Description WW FBA Growth Segments has a multi-year charter to accelerate Fulfillment by Amazon's growth into its largest untapped product segments. We focus on categories where FBA has a large addressable opportunity but low penetration. Four structural barriers hold that penetration back: cost economics, fulfillment complexity, catalog limitations and seller trust gaps. Our portfolio spans heavy and bulky goods, premium electronics and appliances, multi-component products, and Amazon Business supply chain.

We are looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to set the analytics strategy for the full portfolio. The mission areas are non-sort economics, high-ASP seller trust, multi-box fulfillment, seller growth and B2B supply chain. You will own the metrics framework that FBA leadership uses to track segment growth and to make investment decisions. You will turn ambiguous business problems into measurement plans, reporting roadmaps and insights that change decisions. Because the team supports the whole portfolio, you will decide where analytics effort goes as priorities change. You will also build shared reporting assets that more than one mission can reuse.

The role sits at the intersection of business intelligence, metrics governance and AI-powered analytics. You will own the governed metrics layer behind WBR, MBR and QBR reviews. You will also make sure AI-generated insights match those governed metrics, so leaders can trust them.

The role needs strength in two areas. First, you will set a high bar for metric definitions, analytical rigor and reporting quality. Second, you will drive alignment across organizational boundaries. That means getting partner teams in catalog, fulfillment, pricing, seller experience and transportation to agree on shared definitions, data contracts and timelines. You will work closely with Product, Program Management, Data Engineering, Science and Finance partners to decide what we measure, how we measure it, and how we act on it.

Key job responsibilities

Metrics strategy and governance

  • Define the metrics framework for Growth Segments, covering input and output metrics for each mission area.
  • Own the metric registry as the single source of truth. Each metric includes formula, source mapping, owner, data quality rules and interpretation guidance.
  • Lead the change control process for metric definitions across Growth Segments and partner teams.
  • Reconcile metrics across dashboards, WBR/MBR decks and source systems. Close definition gaps at the root.
  • Hand governed definitions to Data Engineering as build specs, with clear acceptance criteria.

Reporting and self-service

  • Design the reporting architecture for WBR, MBR and QBR cadences. Remove manual data pulls.
  • Own production-grade QuickSight dashboards and self-service tools for leadership and stakeholders across regions.
  • Set standards for dashboard design, refresh SLAs, query performance and documentation.

The role is weighted toward AI/GenAI architecture and core system architecture: distributed systems, microservices, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, security, and operations. The AI Architect translates product goals, customer commitments, and engineering constraints into architecture that works end to end, from user experience and service boundaries through data pipelines, model and retrieval layers, integrations, deployment, and runtime monitoring.

This is not a prompt-engineering or agent-building role in isolation. Prompts, models, and agents are components of a larger system, and this role is accountable for everything around them: service decomposition, contracts, data flow, state management, latency and cost budgets, failure handling, security and PHI protection, observability, evaluation, and long-term maintainability. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect who has shipped GenAI to production and can defend the full system design, not only the model layer.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture of GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI solutions, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategy, tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration, memory and state management, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Design and evolve a shared enterprise AI platform: LLM gateway and model abstraction, prompt and configuration management, embedding and vector search services, agent orchestration (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), guardrails, and evaluation services.
  • Define RAG and knowledge architectures end to end: ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid search, re-ranking, access control on retrieved content, data freshness, and grounding/citation strategy.
  • Establish AI evaluation and LLMOps practices, including offline and online evaluation, golden datasets, regression testing of prompts and models, hallucination and quality metrics, A/B testing, and controlled model/version rollout and rollback.
  • Drive AI governance, safety, and security: prompt-injection and data-exfiltration defenses, PII/PHI redaction, content filtering, auditability, model risk assessment, and alignment with Responsible AI and healthcare regulatory requirements such as HIPAA.
  • Make and document build-vs-buy and model trade-off decisions (managed services such as AWS Bedrock vs. open-weight or self-hosted models) based on quality, latency, cost, data residency, and vendor risk.

job.name: Principal Engineer (backend)
job.description:
About the Role

As a Principal Backend Engineer at Sage, you will provide technical leadership in designing, developing, and delivering a high-quality SaaS solution that exceeds customer and business partner expectations. We are looking for someone with 10+ years of professional experience in backend engineering, who can bring technical depth, architectural vision, and leadership maturity to the team. Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required.

We value humility and collaboration. We are looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code, including tests, documentation, and long-term code quality.

Location: Bangalore, India. This is a hybrid role, three days per week in the office.

Required Skills

Core languages & runtime

  • Strong TypeScript (strict mode) and Node.js (v24+) for production services.
  • Solid computer-science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, async I/O.

Backend frameworks & APIs

  • REST API design with Fastify (or Express/NestJS/Koa with willingness to learn Fastify).
  • JSON Schema contract design and validation (AJV or equivalent); OpenAPI/Swagger.
  • Understanding of API versioning, idempotency, pagination, and error-handling patterns.

Data & persistence

  • Relational databases MySQL and/or PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, query tuning.
  • Comfort with JSON-document modeling in a relational store and query compilation to SQL.
  • SQL query builders (Knex or similar); parameterized queries and SQL-injection prevention.
  • Caching with Redis.

Distributed systems & messaging

  • Event-driven / message-queue systems (AWS SQS, or Kafka/RabbitMQ/SNS equivalents): producer/consumer patterns, dead-letter queues, retries/backoff, and idempotency.
  • Designing for at-least-once delivery and eventual consistency.

Cloud & platform

  • AWS services (SQS, EFS, S3, IAM, ECR) in a production context.
  • Containerization with Docker; familiarity with Kubernetes deployments.

Security

  • OAuth2 / OIDC / JWT validation (RS256, JWKS), token propagation, and multi-issuer auth.
  • Secure coding against the OWASP Top 10; multi-tenant isolation and row-level security.

Testing & quality

  • Unit, integration, and contract testing (Vitest/Jest or equivalent); test-driven mindset.
  • Linters/formatters (Biome, ESLint/Prettier) and CI discipline.

Tooling & workflow

  • Git and pull-request workflows; monorepo experience (Nx) a plus.
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar).

AI Tooling

  • Productive use of AI-assisted developer tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate day-to-day backend development.
  • Integrating LLM / generative-AI capabilities into backend services (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock) via SDKs, streaming responses, and prompt/response validation.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): embeddings, vector stores/search, and context assembly pipelines.

Nice to Have

job.name: Software Development Engineer II, Prime Video Sports
job.description:
Description Prime Video is reimagining the live streaming experience, combining high-quality video delivery with interactive features across some of the world's most popular sports properties. We're looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our web engineering team and help build the next generation of live events and sports experiences on Prime Video.

In this role, you will design and deliver customer-facing web features using Java, Scala, GraphQL, TypeScript, and React, all running on AWS infrastructure. You will tackle complex problems at massive scale, write clean and maintainable code, and contribute to the full software development lifecycle from design through deployment and operations. Beyond your own deliverables, you will serve as a multiplier for the team by mentoring and coaching junior engineers, participating actively in code reviews, and collaborating closely with Senior Software Development Engineers and Principal Engineers to ensure architectural alignment and engineering quality.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and build web features for live sports, live events, and detail page experiences using Java, Scala, GraphQL, TypeScript, and React, delivering reliable software through the full development lifecycle.
  • Identify and resolve operational issues at their root cause, contribute to on-call support, and continuously improve system reliability, scalability, and performance for services that must be available during high-profile live events.
  • Mentor and coach junior engineers through hands-on guidance and meaningful code reviews, raising the overall quality bar and helping teammates grow their technical skills.
  • Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools and approaches where they can improve productivity, code quality, or operational efficiency, and recommend adoption strategies to the team.
  • Collaborate with Senior Software Development Engineers and Principal Engineers to align your designs with the team's long-term architectural strategy, and work with cross-functional partners to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

A day in the life

Your day starts with a team standup where you align on priorities for the sprint. From there, you move into focused engineering time — writing and reviewing code, designing solutions for upcoming features, or debugging issues in the presentation and client layers. You proactively drive your work from the roadmap rather than reacting to incoming requests. Throughout the week you pair with junior engineers on tricky problems, participate in design reviews, and coordinate with Senior and Principal Engineers on architectural decisions. You also contribute to deployment and monitoring of your features, ensuring they perform reliably when millions of viewers tune in for a live event.

job.name: Senior Performance Test Automation Engineer - Assistant Vice President
job.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Performance Test Engineer with strong hands-on automation skills. The role is a blend of performance engineering (about 60%) and test automation (about 40%).

You will own the performance testing lifecycle for business-critical applications. This covers workload modelling, test execution, bottleneck analysis and reporting. You will also build and maintain automation frameworks and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines. You will work with developers, architects and DevOps teams to make sure applications meet performance, scalability and resilience targets.

Key Responsibilities

Performance Testing

  • Define the performance test strategy, plan and approach for applications and releases.
  • Derive workload models from production data and business volumes, and define NFRs/SLAs (response time percentiles, throughput, error rate, resource utilization).
  • Design, script and execute load, stress, soak, spike, scalability and breakpoint tests.
  • Monitor applications and infrastructure with APM and observability tools. Identify bottlenecks across the application, database, middleware and infrastructure layers.
  • Analyze thread dumps, heap dumps, GC logs and slow queries, and recommend tuning.
  • Prepare clear performance test reports with findings, trends, risks and go/no-go recommendations.
  • Review and baseline results across releases and track performance regressions.
  • Provide guidance on capacity, scalability and resilience (autoscaling, failover and caching).

Test Automation

  • Design, build and maintain scalable automation frameworks for API and, where needed, UI testing.
  • Develop automated regression suites and reusable test components with good coding practices.
  • Integrate automated functional and performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with pass/fail quality gates.
  • Enable shift-left performance testing (component-level and API-level checks in the pipeline).
  • Manage test code in Git with branching, pull requests and peer reviews.
  • Build dashboards and automated reports for test results and trends.
  • Contribute to test data automation and environment readiness checks.

Leadership and Collaboration

  • Act as the technical lead for performance and automation in the team. Mentor junior engineers and review scripts and frameworks.
  • Work in Agile/Scrum teams, estimate effort and track work in Jira.
  • Present results and risks to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Define and promote testing standards and best practices.

Mandatory Skills

Performance Testing (Primary)

job.name: Pyspark Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven PySpark / Big Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex raw data into actionable analytical data models, optimizing distributed computing workloads, and ensuring data integrity, scalability, and security across enterprise data platforms.

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Apache Spark architecture, advanced Python programming, distributed systems optimization, modern cloud platforms, and data warehousing/lakehouse paradigms.

Key Responsibilities Data Pipeline Design & Development

  • Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark and Python to ingest data from diverse batch and streaming sources (Kafka, relational databases, REST APIs, Object Storage).
  • Design and implement Lakehouse architectures using formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi.
  • Build reusable frameworks and data ingestion libraries to standardize enterprise data processing.

Spark Performance Tuning & Optimization

  • Diagnose and tune Spark application performance, managing memory allocation, partitions, execution plans, broadcast joins, data skews, and garbage collection.
  • Optimize query execution plans using Catalyst Optimizer and Tungsten execution engine.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot production Spark jobs across cluster management environments (YARN, Kubernetes, or Databricks).

Data Modeling & Architecture

  • Collaborate with Data Architects to design dimensional (Star/Snowflake), normalized, and Data Vault schemas optimized for analytical workloads.
  • Ensure efficient data storage, partitioning strategies, and file format selection (Parquet, ORC, Avro).

Orchestration, CI/CD & DevOps

  • Schedule and orchestrate complex workflow DAGs using workflow orchestrators such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) for automated testing, packaging, and deployment of data pipelines.
  • Write unit tests, integration tests, and data validation routines (e.g., Great Expectations, PyTest).

Governance, Security & Quality

  • Implement enterprise data governance, lineage tracking, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
  • Ensure strict compliance with data security, masking, tokenization, RBAC, and regulatory privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

Required Technical Qualifications & Skills

job.name: AI Research Scientist
job.description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI research lab focused on building *safe, interpretable, and aligned AI systems* as capabilities scale toward advanced autonomous intelligence.

Our research operates at the intersection of *agent learning, alignment, and interpretability* , with the goal of developing the scientific foundations required for trustworthy AI systems.

Key research areas include:

  • *Multi-agent reinforcement learning and agent learning systems* for scalable coordination, exploration, and long-horizon learning.
  • *Continual learning and adaptive agents* that can evolve safely over time without catastrophic forgetting.
  • *Alignment strategies and behavioral control methods* including reward modeling, safety fine-tuning, pruning, and unlearning.
  • *Mechanistic interpretability and model transparency* to understand internal representations and reasoning behavior in large models.
  • *Information-theoretic approaches* including mutual information and causal analysis to study how knowledge and decisions form inside deep networks.
  • *Foundation models for structured and tabular domains* aimed at high-stakes real-world applications.
  • *Open research infrastructure and tooling* for alignment experimentation, RL training, and model evaluation.
  • *Open science and global collaboration* , with research hubs in Mumbai and Paris and publications in leading venues such as ICML, ACL, IJCNN, and WWW.

Our goal is to advance the science required to ensure that future AI systems remain *transparent, controllable, and aligned with human intent* .

The Role

As an *AI Research Scientist , you will work on fundamental research problems at the frontier of agent learning, reinforcement learning, interpretability, and alignment* .

Your work will involve designing new algorithms, studying the internal behavior of large models, building research systems for experimentation, and contributing to open research that advances the understanding and safety of AI systems.

This role offers the opportunity to pursue ambitious research ideas while collaborating with a team building the next generation of *alignment methods and agent learning systems* .

The Lead Test Engineer owns end-to-end quality for the team's deliveries. Non-functional testing

  • Plan and run load, stress, soak and performance testing using realistic production volumes.

Job Description: DevSecOps Engineer Job Summary The DevSecOps Senior Engineer is an intermediate-level position responsible for designing, implementing, and securing application delivery pipelines in coordination with development and technology teams. The overall objective of this role is to champion and embed security principles and automated practices throughout the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Responsibilities:

  • Promote a DevSecOps culture of collaboration, open communication, and shared responsibility across development, security, and operations teams.
  • Design, architect, and optimize resilient and secure automated build, test, and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure fast, reliable feedback loops.
  • Integrate automated security testing (e.g., SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container scanning) directly into CI/CD pipelines to identify vulnerabilities early.
  • Lead and execute the migration of legacy CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, UrbanCode uDeploy) to modern, containerized, and cloud-native platforms.
  • Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision, configure, and scale secure and consistent application environments.

  • Participate in scheduled weekend release windows and provide deployment support to ensure smooth and secure production rollouts.
  • Establish and manage comprehensive observability platforms with monitoring, logging, and alerting to provide real-time visibility into application health, performance, and security posture.
  • Build platforms, templates, and documentation that empower developers with self-service capabilities to provision resources and deploy code safely within established guardrails.

Skills Required:

  • Strong engineering mindset and a deep understanding of DevSecOps fundamentals: automation, security, reliability, continuous feedback, and ownership.
  • Hands-on experience with modern CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Tekton) and strategic pipeline design.
  • Proficiency in scripting and programming for building custom automation and integrations, with strong knowledge of Python and Bash.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Strong conceptual and practical knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Hands-on experience with Helm for packaging and managing Kubernetes applications.
  • Familiarity with integrating various security scanning tools (SAST, DAST, SCA) into automated pipelines.
  • Strong analytical, systems-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication, empathy, and collaboration skills, with an ability to mentor and work with diverse technical stakeholders.

Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.
