job.description:
Job Title: QA Engineer

Req ID: 65078

Job Function: Software Engineering

Posting Start Date: 27/11/2026

Posting End Date: 03/12/2026

Division: BT International

Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-Pritech

Advertised Salary: Competitive

Job Req ID: Posting Date: Function: Location: Salary: About The Role We are looking for a Security QA Engineer who combines strong cybersecurity expertise with software quality assurance and offensive security skills.

The role will be responsible for validating that applications, APIs, infrastructure, and DevSecOps pipelines are not only functionally correct but also secure and resilient against real-world attacks.

The engineer will perform security testing across the development lifecycle, conduct penetration testing and attack/breach simulations, validate vulnerabilities and security controls, and work with engineering teams to ensure security issues are identified and addressed before production.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Application Security Testing

Perform security testing of web applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-hosted applications. Conduct SAST, DAST, SCA, API security testing, and manual penetration testing. Identify vulnerabilities including Injection vulnerabilities; Broken authentication and authorization; IDOR/BOLA; XSS; SSRF; insecure deserialization; business-logic vulnerabilities; secrets exposure; insecure APIs. Validate vulnerabilities against the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10. Reproduce reported vulnerabilities and verify remediation through retesting.

  • Penetration Testing

Perform authorized penetration testing against applications, APIs, infrastructure, and cloud environments. Develop realistic attack scenarios to evaluate security controls. Use tools such as: Burp Suite; OWASP ZAP; Nmap; Metasploit; Kali Linux; Postman; Nuclei. Clearly document attack paths, evidence, impact, severity, reproduction steps, and remediation recommendations.

  • Attack & Breach Simulation

Design and execute controlled attack and breach simulations to validate defensive capabilities. Simulate attacker techniques such as: Initial access; Credential attacks; Privilege escalation; Lateral movement; Persistence; Command and control; Data-access scenarios. Map exercises against MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Validate whether preventive and detective controls successfully identify or block simulated attacks. Work with SOC/security teams to identify gaps in detection and response.

  • DevSecOps Security Assurance

Embed security validation throughout the CI/CD lifecycle rather than relying purely on end-stage penetration testing.

Responsibilities include Code → Build → Test → Deploy → Production

The engineer should validate security controls including SAST; SCA/dependency scanning; Secrets scanning; Container scanning; IaC security scanning; DAST; API security testing; Security quality gates.

job.name: Application Developer
job.description:
Job Purpose and Impact

We are building CRR (Corporate Risk Reporting) , an enterprise platform delivering critical commodity risk insights. As a QA Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of data pipelines and risk reporting outputs. You will work closely with data engineers, SQL developers, and Application Developers to validate data flows and ensure alignment with business requirements.

Data & Functional Validation

Pipeline & Ingestion Testing

Performance & EOD Validation

Defect Management & Collaboration

Qualifications

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Required Skills: Mandatory:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data validation and analysis.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes and data pipeline testing.
  • Understanding of data quality concepts and validation techniques.
  • Familiarity with test automation using Python or similar tools.

Good to Have:

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. job.name: Risk Reporting 2LOD Sr. Analyst, Assistant Vice President
job.description:
As a Senior Market Risk Reporting Analyst, you will shape how market risk is measured, monitored, and reported across Citi's key European and UK legal entities. You will join the EMEA Legal Entity Market Risk Reporting team at a pivotal time, combining regulatory-grade production reporting with the opportunity to build advanced portfolio analytics using Python, automated data pipelines, and interactive dashboards. This role places you at the intersection of risk management, data science, and regulatory compliance, giving you direct visibility into Citi's cross-asset risk profile.

Responsibilities

  • Produce, analyze, and present comprehensive market risk profiles across Rates, FX, Credit, Equities, and Commodities.
  • Conduct deep-dive analysis on key risk measures, including Value at Risk, Expected Shortfall, Factor Sensitivities, Issuer and Concentration Risk, and Firmwide Stress Testing.
  • Ensure legal entity compliance with European and UK regulatory frameworks, including ECB, PRA, FCA, and EBA standards.
  • Deliver auditable analytics for regulatory examinations, ICAAP exercises, and periodic regulatory filings.
  • Maintain a strong control environment across the data lifecycle and identify data quality issues at the source.
  • Drive remediation of data issues in partnership with first-line and technology teams.
  • Apply Python, machine learning, and statistical modeling to detect anomalies in risk movements and automate risk commentary.
  • Partner with Market Risk Managers, Traders, Structurers, and Legal Entity Risk Officers to explain P&L and risk fluctuations.
  • Design and deploy interactive dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, and Python to transform static risk reporting into real-time analytics tools.
  • Oversee the governance, calibration, and monitoring of market risk limits and early warning triggers.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in a Markets-focused function at a large financial institution, ideally within a risk discipline.
  • You hold a solid understanding of financial markets and risk management practices across asset classes and financial products.
  • You work effectively both independently and as part of a team to deliver on project objectives.
  • You apply strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills to complex risk questions.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

  • You have experience running projects successfully from initiation through completion.
  • You combine Tableau or Power BI expertise with Python coding skills.
  • You bring a data-driven mindset, with experience in SQL, Tableau, Python, and workflow automation tools such as Alteryx.
  • You hold a bachelor's degree in a related scientific discipline, along with a master's degree.
  • You hold or are working toward a financial qualification such as FRM or CFA.

What We Offer

Candidate Profile

job.description:

With roots dating to 1828, Willis Towers Watson has 45,000 employees serving more than 140 countries and markets.

job.name: Project Controls Assistant - ENS (Contract)
job.description:
Description We are seeking a driven, analytical, and detail-oriented Project Controls Analyst to join our dedicated Project Controls team. This role is integral to our project delivery success, where you will help drive financial integrity across our project portfolio. You will be responsible for maintaining, updating, and managing project financial data, structures, and reporting within our central project portfolio management platform, EcoSys.

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional with a strong foundation in project cost concepts to master an enterprise-grade platform and support our global project teams in delivering critical infrastructure projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data and Project Management in EcoSys: Create and maintain project records, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS), and internal cost codes. Ensure Work Authorization Forms (WAFs) are accurately reflected in the system.
  • Budgeting and Cost Control: Facilitate budget modifications, track actual expenditures, monitor commitments, and perform periodic variance analyses to provide early warnings on potential overruns and inform corrective actions.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Generate standard cost reports and ad-hoc analyses for project managers and clients. Translate complex financial data into actionable insights for decision-making.
  • Change Management: Monitor and record internal project change requests, mapping approved changes directly to active project budgets and contingency funds within EcoSys to ensure financial traceability.
  • System and Configuration Support: Assist senior system administrators in EcoSys setup, testing, system upgrades, and minor configuration updates to enhance system functionality and user experience.

Technical & Soft Skills

  • Foundational Cost Knowledge: A firm grasp of fundamental project cost control concepts (e.g., budgets, forecasts, actuals, commitments, WBS, and Earned Value Metrics).
  • Software Familiarity: Prior hands-on exposure to EcoSys is highly preferred.
  • Familiarity with other Project Portfolio Management (PPM) or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) tools (such as Primavera P6, Oracle Unifier, or SAP Cost Management) is beneficial.
  • Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data analysis) are required.
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong logical reasoning with the ability to identify anomalies, patterns, and trends in financial datasets.
  • Detail-Oriented: A keen eye for data integrity, ensuring database naming conventions and budget configurations are precise and consistently applied.
  • Proactive Communicator: Comfortable collaborating with multi-disciplinary stakeholders, including project managers, engineers, and financial analysts, to resolve issues and provide support.

Qualifications

job.name: Technology Director - Digital Platform Engineering (Production Support)
job.description:
About This Role At Wells Fargo, a Technology Director directs engineering organizations that deliver secure, resilient, and scalable technology solutions aligned with enterprise priorities. You will translate strategy into actionable roadmaps, oversee engineering practices and risk management, and align people and financial resources with delivery commitments.

The Technology Director within the Digital Technology & Innovation (DT&I) Platform Engineering organization is responsible for defining and executing the strategic vision for mission-critical enterprise platforms that support external and internal customers. This role provides executive leadership across RunOps, DevOps, Shared Services, Cloud Efficiency Engineering functions through Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, AIOps practices ensuring platform stability, reliability, security, scalability, and operational excellence across production and non-production environments for the Digital Platform capabilities including online banking, mobile banking, authentication, authorization, payments, messaging, digital account opening, content and customer engagement platforms, fraud and operational support capabilities, and enterprise machine learning and artificial intelligence platforms.

The role leads to multidisciplinary engineering teams through engineering managers, senior managers, and technical leads to delivering technology outcomes aligned with enterprise priorities. The role directs organizational priorities rather than personally performing routine engineering or operational tasks and is responsible for ensuring that subordinate leaders and their teams execute daily delivery, support, monitoring, deployment, remediation, and operational activities effectively to improve operational resilience, service availability, performance, efficiency and customer experience.

The Technology Director serves as a senior command center leader during major incidents, releases, and business-critical events, translating complex technical challenges into business impact assessments and actionable recommendations for executive stakeholders, ensuring informed decision-making, operational continuity, and successful delivery of enterprise objectives.

The Technology Director partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to define platform roadmaps, establish execution plans, and drive adoption of strategic technology capabilities across the enterprise and accountable for the strategy and execution of data center, infrastructure, cloud, and application modernization programs, ensuring enterprise platforms evolve to meet current and future business demands.

Description Are you a Software Development Manager who thrives on turning complex financial data into reliable, scalable systems? The Amazon Finance Automation Technology team is looking for a thoughtful and collaborative engineering leader to help build the next generation of distributed financial systems that serve Amazon's global operations. In this role, you will lead a team of software engineers as you design and deliver solutions that automate and streamline financial processes across the organization. You will partner closely with stakeholders in Finance Operations, Product, and Tax compliance to define requirements and translate them into well-architected software. If you enjoy working at the intersection of technology and finance, and you are energized by ambiguity and real-time problem-solving, this is a role where your contributions will be felt across the business.

job.name: Control Assurance Lead
job.description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: Control Assurance Lead

Location: Cambridge or London, UK / Hyderabad, India / San Leandro, USA Employment Type: Full-time, hybrid

The job The Control Assurance Lead is responsible for providing independent assurance that AVEVA's security controls are designed and operating effectively. Acting as a second-line assurance function, the role delivers objective, evidence-based assessments that support leadership decision-making, internal audit activities, certification requirements, and external compliance obligations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines technical assurance expertise, security testing oversight, compliance support, and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assurance Methodology and Standards

Develop and maintain AVEVA's control assurance methodology, including testing procedures, evidence requirements, sampling approaches, and control rating criteria. Ensure alignment with GRC risk governance and maintain the common assurance framework in partnership with Assurance Engineering.

  • Control Testing and Assurance Delivery

Plan, perform, and oversee testing of the design and operating effectiveness of key controls across the organisation. Ensure all conclusions are supported by appropriate evidence and controls are assessed consistently. Evolve assurance activities from periodic testing towards continuous monitoring, focusing on exception management, control drift detection, and proactive identification of potential control failures.

  • Baseline Assessments and Coverage

Deliver and maintain baseline assessments of key controls across critical systems and processes. Increase assurance coverage through current and reliable evidence, while identifying and reporting areas where sufficient assurance cannot yet be demonstrated.

  • Compliance and External Assurance Support

Support compliance with external requirements and assurance programmes by maximising the reuse of control testing activities. Provide tested and current evidence to support ISO 27001 internal audit requirements, SOC 2 reporting, and other assurance obligations. Identify, assess, and report any control exceptions that may impact compliance or certification outcomes.

  • Findings Management and Remediation Validation

Document clear, risk-ranked findings and validate them with control owners. Independently assess remediation activities, conduct retesting, and determine whether findings can be formally closed. Partner with Security Assurance Business Partners to support effective remediation tracking and resolution.

  • Security Testing and Control Validation

Coordinate risk-based penetration testing, attack simulations, and validation of critical attack paths with Cyber Defence teams and external providers. Define testing scope, independently assess outcomes, and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions.

job.name: Applied Scientist, Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI)
job.description:
Description Alexa+ is Amazon’s next-generation, AI-powered virtual assistant. Building on the original Alexa, it uses generative AI to deliver a more conversational, personalised, and effective experience. Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI) team is developing responsible AI (RAI) solutions for Alexa+, empowering it to provide useful information responsibly.

The Mission

Build AI safety systems that protect millions of Alexa customers every day. As conversational AI evolves, you'll solve challenging problems in Responsible AI by ensuring LLMs provide safe, trustworthy responses, building AI systems that understand nuanced human values across cultures, and maintaining customer trust at scale.

What You'll Build

You'll pioneer breakthrough solutions in Responsible AI at Amazon's scale. Imagine training models that set new safety standards, designing automated testing systems that hunt for vulnerabilities before they surface, and certifying the systems that power millions of daily conversations. You'll create intelligent evaluation systems that judge responses with human-level insight, build models that truly understand what makes interactions safe and delightful, and craft feedback mechanisms that help Alexa+ grasp the nuances of complex customer conversations. Here's where it gets even more exciting: you'll build AI agents that act as your team's safety net—automatically detecting and fixing production issues in real-time, often before anyone notices there was a problem. Your innovations won't just improve Alexa+; they'll fundamentally shape how it learns, evolves, and earns customer trust. As Alexa+ continues to delight customers, your work ensures it becomes more trustworthy, safer, and deeply aligned with customer needs and expectations.

Your work directly protects customer trust at Amazon's scale. Every innovation you create—from novel safety mechanisms to sophisticated evaluation techniques—shapes how millions of people interact with AI confidently. You're not just building products; you're defining industry standards for responsible AI.

This is frontier research with immediate real-world impact. You'll tackle problems that require innovative solutions: training models that remain truthful and grounded across diverse contexts, building reward models that capture the nuanced spectrum of human values across cultures and languages, and creating automated systems that continuously discover and address potential issues before customers encounter them. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform state-of-the-art ideas into production systems serving millions.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep expertise in state-of-the-art NLP, Large Language Models
  • Track record of building scalable ML systems
  • Passion for impactful research—where frontier science meets real-world responsibility at scale
  • Excitement about solving problems that will shape the future of AI

Description Amazon’s operations in Australia is at a unique phase of rapid expansion. As our selection and local fulfilment network grows, the complexity of managing supply chain increases. To systemically address these complexities, we are establishing a team of subject matter experts by expanding Supply Chain Optimisation Technology (SCOT) team's engagement with Australia. We are looking for an exceptional Data Scientist to join this specialised team and help build the analytical foundations that allow us to automate and optimise our local supply chain at scale.

Key job responsibilities

  • Build Predictive Models: Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models (e.g., time-series forecasting, regression, classification) to predict inbound volumes, leveraging signals from demand forecasts, vendor behaviour, and upstream planning systems unique to the Australian supply chain.
  • Drive Root-Cause Analysis: Apply statistical methods and causal inference techniques to quantify defect attributions across plan-over-plan changes, actuals-over-plan variances, and forecast accuracy degradation, translating complex analytical findings into actionable insights for stakeholders.
  • Enable Automated Intelligence: Leverage agentic workflows and LLM-based pipelines to build self-improving prediction systems for inbound volumes, automating feature engineering, model retraining, and anomaly detection to replace manual heuristics.
  • Advance Experimentation: Design and execute A/B tests and counterfactual analyses to measure the impact of supply chain interventions (e.g., buying policy changes, capacity adjustments) on inbound volume outcomes, providing rigorous evidence for decision-making.
  • Influence Strategy: Synthesise insights across product demand forecasting accuracy, inventory efficiency, and capacity planning to build data-driven narratives that influence inbound volume projections and supply chain strategy at the leadership level.

About The Team Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and wondered how it got to you so fast? Wondered where it came from and how much it cost? At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

In This Role, You Will

  • Apply actuarial science, statistical analysis, and quantitative modeling to evaluate business risks, identify opportunities, and support sound decisions across relevant domains.
  • Develop, validate, and maintain actuarial models, assumptions, forecasts, and analytical frameworks that produce reliable, actionable insights.
  • Analyze complex datasets, trends, and performance indicators to explain business outcomes and recommend improvements.
  • Partner with technical, product, finance, and business stakeholders to translate actuarial findings into clear recommendations and measurable outcomes.
  • Contribute to scalable analytical solutions by applying strong data practices, reproducible methodologies, and sound judgment across multiple use cases.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve analytical outcomes, while applying familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and AI/ML concepts to real-world products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, data science, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience applying actuarial methods, statistical analysis, quantitative modeling, or risk analysis in a business or technical environment.
  • Experience owning analytical workstreams or models within a defined service, product area, or business domain, from problem definition through delivery and ongoing refinement.
  • Proficiency with data analysis, statistical techniques, model development, validation, and communicating quantitative results to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of system design, low-level design, API design, and data modeling as they relate to analytical or actuarial solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

job.name: AI Migration Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: AI Migration Engineer If you’re looking to take an exciting new direction with your HSBC career, an internal move can open the door to many opportunities, allowing you to take on a new challenge, and develop your skills. Bring your knowledge of our brand to a new role and grow yourself further.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AI Migration Engineer - this role may be based in Bangalore, Gurgaon, Hyderabad or Kolkata. AI is reshaping how regulated organisations run and evidence controls and Risk and Compliance is no exception. This role focuses on simplifying and re-engineering Risk & Compliance processes end to end then rebuilding them as governed agentic AI workflows running in production. You’ll work closely with process owners to map current-state journeys and design target-state workflows that make clear where humans stay in the loop. Success means safer faster processes with measurable improvements in cycle time error rate and cost and with documentation that stands up to audit and regulatory scrutiny. You’ll also contribute reusable patterns and shared components across the Chief AI Officer function in Risk & Compliance.

A move across the business allows you to continue to access tailored professional development opportunities, and our fantastic benefits packages.

In This Role, You Will

  • Map Risk & Compliance processes end to end with process owners including inputs hand-offs data lineage controls and exceptions. Simplify processes before automation by removing redundant steps duplicate controls manual reconciliations and rework loops
  • Re-engineer target processes around agentic patterns with explicit human-in-the-loop decisions and control points. Build and integrate agentic workflows using LLMs tool calling and MCP connecting to Risk & Compliance systems data platforms and document stores. Implement retrieval patterns including RAG GraphRAG and hybrid search grounded in Risk & Compliance policy regulatory and risk data
  • Replace or wrap legacy components such as spreadsheets macros scripts and EUCs with maintainable version-controlled code
  • Build evaluation harnesses for accuracy faithfulness robustness and regression using golden datasets agreed with the business. Embed controls and deploy via LLMOps pipelines with monitoring for drift quality cost and latency plus parallel runs cutover and rollback plans

To Be Successful You Will

job.name: SAP authorization Engineer
job.description:
1. Key Purpose of the Role

The SAP Authorization Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing and maintaining SAP authorization and security solutions across the global SAP landscape.

The role focuses on ensuring secure user access, role management, segregation of duties (SoD), and GRC compliance while supporting SAP projects, system enhancements and operational requirements. The engineer will work closely with functional teams, architects, security teams and external partners to deliver compliant, high-quality SAP authorization solutions.

2. Roles & Responsibilities

1. SAP Authorization Design & Implementation

  • Design, develop and implement SAP authorization concepts, roles and access models based on business requirements.
  • Ensure role designs follow the least-privilege principle and segregation of duties (SoD) requirements.
  • Work on SAP authorization across ERP, SAP BI, SAP HANA and Central Finance (CFIN) environments.
  • Ensure compliance with global IT security policies and best practices.

2. SAP GRC & Security

  • Work on SAP GRC Access Control, including access risk analysis, access requests and emergency access management.
  • Identify, analyse and resolve SoD conflicts and access-related risks.
  • Support GRC implementation, configuration and enhancements.
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

3. Incident Management & Troubleshooting

  • Handle SAP authorization and GRC-related incidents and service requests.
  • Investigate and resolve user access, role assignment and authorization issues.
  • Support user lifecycle management, including access provisioning, modification and removal.
  • Provide technical support and ensure timely incident resolution.

4. Project Implementation & Delivery

  • Act as the SAP Authorization and GRC subject matter expert throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into authorization designs.
  • Coordinate with architects, functional consultants, project teams and external partners.
  • Support testing, UAT, cutover and go-live activities.
  • Monitor project progress and ensure timely, quality delivery.

5. Documentation & Stakeholder Management

  • Maintain documentation of authorization concepts, role assignments and security configurations.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing and training sessions for internal stakeholders.
  • Work with global teams across different time zones.

6. Process Improvement & Innovation

  • Identify opportunities to automate authorization processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement in SAP security and GRC processes.
  • Stay updated on SAP security developments, tools and industry best practices.

job.name: Product and Platform Security Specialist
job.description:
Do you enjoy working out how code, pipelines and cloud platforms connect, and closing the gaps between them? Would you like your work to protect every product at once? Join our team Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward, making it safer, cleaner, and more efficient for people and the planet.

We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to secure the systems our software is built, shipped and run on. The role finds and reduces security risk along the path from a code commit to a running workload. That path covers source control, build and deployment pipelines, artifact registries, container platforms and cloud accounts.

You will work with platform, cloud security and product security teams on controls that every product inherits. You will also shape how AI agents are used safely inside the delivery pipeline.

You will suit this role if you have built or run pipelines, clusters or cloud environments yourself and can think like an attacker about how they connect. Hands-on experience across identity, CI/CD, containers and cloud infrastructure matters more than depth in any one tool.

Partner with the best as a Product and Platform Security Specialist you will be responsible for:

Source control and pipeline security

  • Assess how source control organizations, repositories and build pipelines are configured, and find the paths an attacker could take to production.
  • Review access, tokens, apps and integrations, and reduce standing privileges.
  • Define and enforce baseline rules for protected branches, code review and pipeline permissions.
  • Harden runners and build environments against untrusted code.

Deployment and container platform security

  • Review deployment systems and GitOps controllers: who can deploy what, where, and with which credentials.
  • Assess cluster access, workload isolation, admission policy, secrets handling and network segmentation.
  • Make sure only trusted, traceable artifacts reach production.
  • Work with platform teams to fix findings and track them to closure.

Cloud foundations and identity

  • Review how pipelines and workloads obtain cloud access, and replace stored keys with short-lived, federated identity.
  • Assess account structure, organization-level guardrails and infrastructure as code for gaps.
  • Keep an inventory of machine identities and what each one can do.
  • Agree with the cloud security team who owns each finding on cloud resources.

Automation, policy as code and monitoring

  • Write scripts that collect configuration evidence from platform APIs, so assessments can be repeated.
  • Express controls as code, so they are versioned, reviewed and tested.
  • Define the audit logs each platform must send to central monitoring and build detections for risky changes.
  • Support the response to software supply chain and platform incidents.

AI agent and developer platform security

Position Overview Job Title: Analyst Information Security, NCT Location: Pune, India Role Description As an IAM Engineer you will act as the technical expert for identity lifecycle management. Your primary task is to securely onboard enterprise applications into central request/approval, recertification platforms, automate provisioning tasks, and orchestrate continuous compliance through recertification tools.

About Team The ISPS onboarding team performs security IAM tasks. The activities mainly include assessment of applications, onboarding of application to central tool, validating SoD breaches.

What We’ll Offer You As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

  • Best in class leave policy
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Application Assessment & Onboarding
  • Assess business applications for onboarding to centralized IAM solutions, including:
  • Authorization platforms
  • Request & approval systems
  • User recertification solutions
  • Segregation of Duties (SoD) controls
  • Authentication frameworks
  • Execute onboarding activities based on assessment outcomes, adhering to defined processes and governance standards.
  • Requirements, Design, Documentation & Implementation

+ Gather and define access requirements (roles/entitlements) and prepare request input sheets for request & approval workflows.
+ Design and document provisioning models (automated/manual; centralized/decentralized) and develop Key Operating Procedures (KOPs).
+ Coordinate with technical teams for form designing, SIT, and deployment of application to onboarding solutions.
+ Support and validate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure compliance with business and security requirements.
+ Drive smooth implementation and release of solutions in alignment with IAM governance standards.

  • Stakeholder Management, Risk, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

+ Engage and manage key stakeholders (Information Security, Application Owners, Engineering, Operations) to ensure seamless onboarding and governance alignment.
+ Facilitate training and transition activities for applications moving to centralized ID administration teams.
+ Identify, assess, and escalate risks while ensuring adherence to security policies, governance standards, and regulatory requirements.
+ Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process gaps and implementing efficiency and control enhancements.
+ Support development and maintenance of operational procedures, ensuring compliance with defined policies and standards.

job.name: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Freight
job.description:
Description Amazon Freight is building an innovative transportation network with the vision of redefining shipping for its customers. As our Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) and Truckload (TL) business continues to grow, booking and execution efficiency is a critical capability that enables us to deliver competitive service offering while optimizing network utilization, carrier performance, and long-term profitability.

You will be working on a range of challenging tech opportunities that includes (1) building a new quotation architecture (2) Building shipper identities and profile (3) Improving shipper communication architecture (4) core network challenges like network design and demand mismatch (5) Scheduling reliability and service quality (6) A new operator tooling application.

This position requires strong business judgment, exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, is comfortable making data-driven decisions in ambiguous environments, and has experience translating complex transportation economics into scalable network execution strategies. If you are passionate about solving complex transportation problems, influencing cross-functional partners, and building innovative supply chain capabilities that create value for customers while driving sustainable business growth, we'd love to speak with you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and develop highly secure, scalable, and fault-tolerant distributed systems for compliance and verification solutions using cloud computing technologies
  • Drive the overall development lifecycle of solutions and manage complex projects from inception to delivery
  • Collaborate with security engineers and product managers to develop strategy and roadmaps for secure, customer-facing solutions
  • Partner with engineering peers to develop technical designs and approaches for new product development
  • Establish and promote best practices for software development, documentation, and code quality
  • Ensure designs meet requirements and deliver high-quality work within defined timelines
  • Manage project prioritization, planning of features, stakeholder communication, and tracking of commitments
  • Drive operational excellence through monitoring and operation of production services

A day in the life

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, your day typically involves designing or researching technical solutions and alternatives for your team's most critical and complex features and projects. As a team leader, you will review your peers' code and dive deep into their design documents to provide feedback on software architecture, scalability, and security. You will code the critical code path on your projects and coordinate with peers on tasks you delegate to them. You advise your manager on trade-offs and product direction.

Basic Qualifications

job.name: Principal Consultant
job.description:
Job Description We are seeking experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Data Migration Consultants to support the migration of master, reference, and transactional data into Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement(Optional). The consultants will work closely with functional, technical, business, and source-system teams to ensure that data is extracted, transformed, validated, loaded, reconciled, and signed off successfully Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute end-to-end data migration activities for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement.
  • Work with business and functional teams to identify source data, transformation rules, dependencies, and target-system requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain data-migration strategies, object lists, mapping documents, conversion specifications, and reconciliation reports.
  • Perform data profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, and duplicate analysis.
  • Develop and validate Oracle data-load files using tools and methods such as FBDI, ADFdi, spreadsheet loaders, REST APIs, SOAP services, and scheduled processes.
  • Support the migration of relevant data objects, including:

+ Chart of Accounts and other financial reference data
+ Suppliers, supplier sites, contacts, addresses, and bank details
+ Procurement business units, agents, categories, and approved supplier information
+ Purchase agreements, purchase orders, requisitions, and related open transactions
+ Customers, customer accounts, sites, contacts, and profiles
+ Payables and Receivables open transactions
+ General Ledger balances and journals
+ Fixed Assets and Cash Management data, where applicable

  • Analyse and resolve load errors, rejected records, reference-data issues, and data-quality exceptions.

job.name: Senior Analyst- FP&A
job.description:
About the Role:

Qualicentric embeds senior finance capability inside US mid-market companies and deal teams, delivering the analytical depth of a Big-4 or specialist advisory practice at the economics of an outsourced model. The Senior Analyst sits at the core of this delivery - translating raw client data into the financial models, reports, and diligence workpapers that drive CFO decisions and deal outcomes.

Unlike a traditional in-house analyst role, you will work across two complementary mandates. On the ongoing advisory side, you support FP&A and management reporting for clients where Qualicentric acts as an embedded finance function. On the transaction side, you build the analytical workpapers underpinning Quality of Earnings and working capital analyses for live US deal mandates. The skillset is the same; the context shifts by engagement.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in the quality of their own work product - who notices when a number does not reconcile, who formats a model so it can be audited, and who asks the right question before building in the wrong direction.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. FP&A & Management Reporting

  • Build and maintain driver-based financial models: monthly actuals vs. budget variance analysis, rolling forecasts, and scenario analyses under the direction of the Manager
  • Prepare management reporting deliverables - monthly P&L packs, KPI dashboards, and variance commentary decks - ensuring numbers tie end-to-end across all schedules
  • Populate and maintain integrated three-statement models (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) with operating KPI bridges; flag model integrity issues proactively
  • Maintain 13-week cash flow trackers and covenant compliance schedules with weekly updates coordinated against client accounting data
  • Support CFO presentation preparation: build charts, tables, and bridge analyses in Excel and PowerPoint to a client-ready standard
  • Perform ad hoc financial analyses - pricing and margin analyses, department-level cost deep-dives, customer profitability reviews - as directed by the engagement lead

2. Financial Due Diligence & Transaction Support

  • Build and maintain the QoE workbook - populating normalising adjustment schedules, sourcing supporting documents from the data room, and maintaining a clean audit trail for each adjustment
  • Construct revenue disaggregation analyses: customer-level waterfall schedules, cohort trends, channel mix, and concentration summaries across the trailing analysis period
  • Build working capital analyses: monthly NWC calculation schedules, seasonality overlays, and peg determination support under the direction of the engagement Manager
  • Populate net debt schedules - debt instruments, capital lease obligations, deferred revenue, unfunded liabilities - with values sourced directly from client balance sheets and supporting documents

job.name: Commercial & FP&A Analyst
job.description:
ABOUT CARGO PLAYERS

Cargo Players is a fast-growing, electric-first urban logistics and last-mile delivery partner powering India’s leading e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms. As we rapidly expand dark-store deployments and EV fleet operations across major metros, we are strengthening our Head Office finance team in Connaught Place to drive rigorous financial planning, commercial control, and unit-level profitability.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a sharp, commercially minded Commercial & FP&A Analyst to sit at our Head Office and serve as the financial anchor for our ground operations.

Your mandate is not to run field operations—it is to build budgets, scrutinize site-level P&Ls, validate commercial rate cards, and challenge operational leaders with hard numbers. You will bridge the gap between ground execution and corporate finance, ensuring forecasts stay realistic, client contracts remain profitable, and cost variances are caught early.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

· Own Operational Budgeting & Variance Analysis: Build annual and monthly hub-level budgets, track actuals vs. forecast week over week, and publish variance bridges explaining margin shifts across dark stores and cities.

· Drive Commercial & Rate-Card Governance: Evaluate client contracts, Minimum Guarantee (MG) structures, supervisor gearing norms, and SLA penalties—ensuring ground deployments adhere strictly to agreed commercial terms.

· Challenge Ground Performance with Data: Partner with (and constructively question) City Heads and Fleet Managers during weekly business reviews to pinpoint root causes behind cost overruns, low rider productivity, and fleet underutilization.

· Ensure Billing & Reimbursement Accuracy: Reconcile third-party control tower logs and client portals against internal payouts, client invoices, and pass-through claims (assets, raincoats, bags, hub expenses) to prevent revenue leakage.

· Model New Bids & Expansion: Build bottom-up commercial P&L models, working capital forecasts, and sensitivity analyses for new client RFPs, pricing negotiations, and city launches.

· Deliver Executive FP&A Scorecards & Automate Workflows: Prepare crisp weekly and monthly financial packs for HO leadership highlighting unit economics, cash burn, receivables, and hub-wise ROI, while leveraging modern automation and AI tools to streamline recurring reconciliations and reporting.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

· Education: Qualified/Inter CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), CFA (Level 2+), or a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce/Economics/Finance from a premier institution.

· Experience (Industry Preference): 2–5 years in FP&A, Commercial Finance, Business Finance, or Financial Consulting / Transaction Advisory (Big 4 or high-growth startups). Candidates from the same industry—specifically 3PL logistics, quick commerce, e-commerce delivery, or EV/mobility fleets—are strongly preferred.

job.name: Oracle Fusion HCM - Consulting Technical Manager
job.description:
Job Description As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Manager, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL), VBS (Visual Basic Studio) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a Manager with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
  • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
  • Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
  • Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
  • Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
  • Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
  • Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.
  • Review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to support delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

The AI Infrastructure organization at OCI is leading this effort by creating a GPU focused cloud with the latest hardware providing the best performance, efficiency, reliability, and scalability. This is your chance to be part of the AI revolution by creating systems that allow customers to scale from tens to thousands of GPUs without compromising performance. job.name: Applications Support Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary The Applications Support Analyst (C10) is an intermediate-level individual contributor responsible for managing production and continuity of business (COB) deployments, release execution, day-to-day technical support, and operational maintenance across enterprise application suites. Applies standard technical and operational procedures to execute automated and manual releases (via tools such as Harness and uDeploy/IBM UrbanCode Deploy), validate Change Tasks (CTASKs), and troubleshoot production issues in a timely manner. Works collaboratively within a 24x7 operational support model, executing routine health checks, participating in Release on Demand (ROD) cycles, conducting incident triage, and escalating complex issues appropriately. Strong release management fundamentals, analytical capabilities, and communication skills are required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Release Management & CTASK Execution: Executes and owns production and COB release implementations against scheduled Change Tasks (CTASKs), ensuring strict adherence to enterprise Change Management governance, approval gates, and deployment windows.
  • Deployment Automation & Tooling: Drives both Release on Demand (ROD) and planned/manual deployments utilizing continuous delivery and orchestration tools such as Harness, uDeploy (IBM UrbanCode Deploy), Bitbucket/Git, and associated CI/CD pipeline frameworks.
  • Environment & Post-Deployment Validation: Coordinates and executes comprehensive pre-deployment health verifications, rollback procedures when necessary, and post-implementation checkouts across Production (PROD) and Continuity of Business (COB) disaster recovery environments.
  • Operational Shift Support: Operates as a technical support practitioner within a 24x7 rotational shift environment, ensuring continuous system availability and structured shift handovers.
  • Incident & Problem Resolution: Triages, investigates, and troubleshoots incoming application incidents and user queries, adhering to established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and escalating severe issues promptly.
  • Monitoring & Health Checks: Executes start-of-day checks, intra-day health monitoring, and system checkout procedures to proactively identify performance degradations, data discrepancies, or infrastructure failures.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Serves as a primary liaison between business users, Release Management, Application Development (AD), and Infrastructure teams during deployment windows and incident resolution.
  • Runbook & SOP Maintenance: Maintains, updates, and executes standard operating procedures (SOPs), deployment runbooks, and batch schedule configurations to ensure consistent operational execution.
  • Problem Management & RCA: Participates in root cause analysis (RCA) investigations following production incidents or release failures to identify preventative controls and improve deployment reliability.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to streamline release

Overview We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled .NET Developer. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, coupled with knowledge of Markets domain in Kazakhstan. This role requires development of the following in-country applications:

  • The in-country applications maintain several critical business functions for Markets Operations, including:

+ Downloading market data, FX, and repo deals from the Kazakhstan stock exchange and their further submission to downstream applications.
+ Downloading swap, spot, and forward deals from upstream applications and their further submission to the Kazakhstan central depository.
+ Downloading exchange rates from the National Bank.
+ Regulatory reporting to the National Bank.
+ Risk reporting to downstream applications.
+ Downloading broker deals from the Kazakhstan stock exchange and their further submission to downstream applications.
+ Downloading exchange rates from the National Bank.
+ Regulatory reporting to the National Bank.

IBM Power Systems Engineer

IBM Power / AIX Architect

We are looking for an experienced IBM Power / AIX Architect to lead the end-to-end architecture and technical design of an IBM Power/AIX implementation project.

job.name: Security Specialist,AVP
job.description:
Join us as a Security Specialist

  • We’re looking for someone to actively support a domain and our wider organisation as a subject matter expert in a security-related field
  • Day-to-day, you’ll be making sure that the security implications of the backlog are understood in the right way to build security early into the design
  • This is your chance to bring a competitive edge to your career profile by solving new problems and creating smarter solutions and enjoying professional development opportunities
  • We're offering this role at associate vice president level

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll make sure that decisions are based on robust data, return on investment and value measures that demonstrate thoughtful and intelligent cost management. You’ll also encourage the identification of ideas and drive the delivery of initiatives that will reduce cost and simplify our Group.

Additionally, you’ll work at a domain level to understand and make sure that robust security is continuously considered and incorporated at every stage, programme increment and Feature team delivery throughout the development lifecycle and through to support.

You’ll Also Be Responsible For

  • Using your SME knowledge to support the wider organisation in building and operating secure services that protect both our colleagues and customers
  • Collaborating with Feature teams and participating in store refinement, sprint planning and retrospective sessions
  • Establishing a culture of innovation and strategic thinking that provides our Group with knowledge of the latest developments in your area of specialism
  • Making sure any developments in your area of specialism are assessed and the impact on our wider organisation is appropriately communicated
  • Building relationships with colleagues across our group and third-parties to make sure decisions are commercially-focused and create long-term value for our organisation

The skills you’ll need

To be successful in this role, you’ll have experience of, or a willingness to learn, risk management frameworks. You’ll also have experience of setting risk appetites and a background in defining risk policy controls. Knowledge of one, or more, security subject areas would also be advantageous.

job.name: Associate Reliability Engineer
job.description:
About Chargebee

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.

Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

About the Role

We are hiring an entry-level Associate Reliability Engineer (Contractor) to support the reliability and availability of Chargebee’s cloud infrastructure. This role involves working on live production systems, monitoring applications, and troubleshooting issues across both application and database layers.

This is a hands-on opportunity to gain real-world experience in cloud operations, DevOps practices, and large-scale system reliability.

Note: This is a contract role that requires working in a 24/7 rotational shift environment .

Why Join Us

  • Hands-on exposure to production systems at scale
  • Opportunity to learn cloud, DevOps, and reliability engineering
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and infrastructure teams accustomed to operating in high-performance, large-scale environments.

Key Responsibilities

Monitoring & Reliability

  • Monitor production systems hosted in AWS cloud using tools like Splunk, Datadog, and AWS CloudWatch
  • Ensure high availability by proactively identifying and resolving issues
  • Respond to alerts and participate in incident management

Troubleshooting (Application & Database)

  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the Java-based application stack
  • Analyze and troubleshoot database issues in MySQL and PostgreSQL
  • Identify slow queries and assist in basic performance tuning
  • Work with engineering teams to perform root cause analysis and implement fixes

Automation & DevOps

  • Develop scripts (Python, Bash) to automate repetitive tasks
  • Improve operational workflows and monitoring through automation

Required Skills & Qualifications

Problem Solving & Collaboration

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset
  • Ability to collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams

Database Knowledge

  • Basic knowledge or exposure to MySQL or PostgreSQL
  • Ability to write SQL queries and understand basic database performance concepts

Scripting / Programming

  • Basic proficiency in Python or Bash

Cloud Fundamentals

  • Basic knowledge or exposure to AWS

Nice to Have

  • Internship or academic project experience in cloud/DevOps/backend systems
  • Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix systems
  • Exposure to tools like Splunk, Datadog, or CloudWatch is a plus

job.name: Software Test Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Senior Test Engineer - Dotnet testing, Chennai/Pune India

We are seeking a Senior Test Engineer (T6) to join our SA&I Engineering team. The team is responsible for survey platforms and panel management software, supporting critical business processes and ensuring high-quality data collection and analysis. Our technology stack includes .NET / C# / SQL Server, and we are actively modernizing our infrastructure toward .NET Core and cloud-native solutions.

This role is ideal for an experienced test engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment, enjoys mentoring others, and is passionate about building scalable and maintainable testing frameworks.

This role includes not only implementing automated testing but also manual testing.

Who We Are Looking For

You are a seasoned test engineer who:

  • Has deep experience in software testing methodologies and automation frameworks
  • Understands and applies software quality assurance principles
  • Is comfortable leading testing initiatives and collaborating with cross-functional teams
  • Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentors junior testers and contributes to team growth
  • Takes ownership of complex testing challenges and drives them to resolution
  • Is adaptable and continuously learning new technologies

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for web and backend applications
  • Lead testing efforts for migration of legacy systems to modern platforms
  • Collaborate with developers and product owners to define test strategies and acceptance criteria
  • Perform functional, regression, performance, and security testing
  • Conduct thorough manual testing, especially smoke testing after releases, to ensure system stability
  • Continue to expand and improve automated testing coverage
  • Ensure high test coverage and maintain test documentation
  • Conduct code reviews and enforce testing best practices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex testing issues
  • Mentor and support junior and mid-level test engineers

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing and quality assurance
  • Strong experience with automated testing tools (e.g., Selenium, Postman, JMeter)
  • Important: Familiarity with .NET and .net core applications and SQL Server
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., Azure)
  • Solid understanding of test design techniques and defect tracking
  • Preferred knowledge in:
  • Survey and panel management systems
  • Bulk email systems and high-volume messaging infrastructure
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience

Additional Information

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Team members collaborate across functions to ensure that software is thoroughly tested, secure, and user-friendly. This role involves collaborating with developers, business analysts, and product teams to understand requirements, identify defects, and ensure issues are resolved before release.   • Candidates should possess good understanding of SDLC and STLC, including regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.
  • Candidates should possess clear written and verbal communication skills for documenting results and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Relevant experience in manual and/or automated testing, preferably in a product or enterprise software environment.
  • Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

job.name: Senior Automation Engineer - Assistant Vice President
job.description:

You will be instrumental in ensuring the highest software quality by leveraging test automation, TDD, BDD, trunk-based development, security testing, and modern ways of working.

This role requires deep technical expertise in automation frameworks, system design for testing, and vulnerability assessment to build reliable, scalable, and secure applications.

  • Design and implement automated test strategies for functional, integration, performance, and security testing.

  • Deep understanding of system design for scalable test automation.

job.name: Oracle Fusion HCM - Consulting Technical Manager
job.description:
Job Description As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Manager, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL), VBS (Visual Basic Studio) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a Manager with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
  • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
  • Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
  • Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
  • Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
  • Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
  • Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.
  • Review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to support delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

Skills - Mandatory Experience

job.name: Product and Platform Security Specialist
job.description:
Do you enjoy working out how code, pipelines and cloud platforms connect, and closing the gaps between them? Would you like your work to protect every product at once? Join our team Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward, making it safer, cleaner, and more efficient for people and the planet.

We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to secure the systems our software is built, shipped and run on. The role finds and reduces security risk along the path from a code commit to a running workload. That path covers source control, build and deployment pipelines, artifact registries, container platforms and cloud accounts.

You will work with platform, cloud security and product security teams on controls that every product inherits. You will also shape how AI agents are used safely inside the delivery pipeline.

You will suit this role if you have built or run pipelines, clusters or cloud environments yourself and can think like an attacker about how they connect. Hands-on experience across identity, CI/CD, containers and cloud infrastructure matters more than depth in any one tool.

Partner with the best as a Product and Platform Security Specialist you will be responsible for:

Source control and pipeline security

  • Assess how source control organizations, repositories and build pipelines are configured, and find the paths an attacker could take to production.
  • Review access, tokens, apps and integrations, and reduce standing privileges.
  • Define and enforce baseline rules for protected branches, code review and pipeline permissions.
  • Harden runners and build environments against untrusted code.

Deployment and container platform security

  • Review deployment systems and GitOps controllers: who can deploy what, where, and with which credentials.
  • Assess cluster access, workload isolation, admission policy, secrets handling and network segmentation.
  • Make sure only trusted, traceable artifacts reach production.
  • Work with platform teams to fix findings and track them to closure.

Cloud foundations and identity

  • Review how pipelines and workloads obtain cloud access, and replace stored keys with short-lived, federated identity.
  • Assess account structure, organization-level guardrails and infrastructure as code for gaps.
  • Keep an inventory of machine identities and what each one can do.
  • Agree with the cloud security team who owns each finding on cloud resources.

Automation, policy as code and monitoring

  • Write scripts that collect configuration evidence from platform APIs, so assessments can be repeated.
  • Express controls as code, so they are versioned, reviewed and tested.
  • Define the audit logs each platform must send to central monitoring and build detections for risky changes.
  • Support the response to software supply chain and platform incidents.

AI agent and developer platform security

You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a consultant with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
  • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
  • Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
  • Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
  • Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
  • Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
  • Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.
  • Review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to support delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

Skills - Mandatory Experience

job.name: WFM Manager, LMAQ
job.description:
Description Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate’s route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions.

job.name: Product and Platform Security Specialist
job.description:
Do you enjoy working out how code, pipelines and cloud platforms connect, and closing the gaps between them? Would you like your work to protect every product at once? Join our team Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward, making it safer, cleaner, and more efficient for people and the planet.

We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to secure the systems our software is built, shipped and run on. The role finds and reduces security risk along the path from a code commit to a running workload. That path covers source control, build and deployment pipelines, artifact registries, container platforms and cloud accounts.

You will work with platform, cloud security and product security teams on controls that every product inherits. You will also shape how AI agents are used safely inside the delivery pipeline.

You will suit this role if you have built or run pipelines, clusters or cloud environments yourself and can think like an attacker about how they connect. Hands-on experience across identity, CI/CD, containers and cloud infrastructure matters more than depth in any one tool.

Partner with the best as a Product and Platform Security Specialist you will be responsible for:

Source control and pipeline security

  • Assess how source control organizations, repositories and build pipelines are configured, and find the paths an attacker could take to production.
  • Review access, tokens, apps and integrations, and reduce standing privileges.
  • Define and enforce baseline rules for protected branches, code review and pipeline permissions.
  • Harden runners and build environments against untrusted code.

Deployment and container platform security

  • Review deployment systems and GitOps controllers: who can deploy what, where, and with which credentials.
  • Assess cluster access, workload isolation, admission policy, secrets handling and network segmentation.
  • Make sure only trusted, traceable artifacts reach production.
  • Work with platform teams to fix findings and track them to closure.

Cloud foundations and identity

  • Review how pipelines and workloads obtain cloud access, and replace stored keys with short-lived, federated identity.
  • Assess account structure, organization-level guardrails and infrastructure as code for gaps.
  • Keep an inventory of machine identities and what each one can do.
  • Agree with the cloud security team who owns each finding on cloud resources.

Automation, policy as code and monitoring

  • Write scripts that collect configuration evidence from platform APIs, so assessments can be repeated.
  • Express controls as code, so they are versioned, reviewed and tested.
  • Define the audit logs each platform must send to central monitoring and build detections for risky changes.
  • Support the response to software supply chain and platform incidents.

job.description:
Develop, construct, test and maintain architectures such as databases and large-scale processing systems

Job Summary We're looking for a Database Developer to own and evolve the data layer of a cloud-hosted healthcare SaaS platform. You'll design and optimize stored procedures, build reporting pipelines, tune performance in a high-concurrency environment, and collaborate with application developers on data access patterns — while also helping migrate legacy T-SQL logic into modern .NET services.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and optimize stored procedures, functions, views, and triggers in SQL Server

Must-Have

  • Entity Framework 6 or EF Core — understanding ORM-generated SQL, N+1 detection, migrations
  • Git-based workflow — pull requests, code review for SQL, branching strategies

Good-to-Have

  • Data warehousing — star/snowflake schemas, reporting aggregation
