job.name: Staff Software Engineer (Salesforce)
job.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Position Summary The Staff Software Engineer is the builder-orchestrator; the person who turns solution designs into working, production-quality software, increasingly by specifying, directing, and rigorously verifying AI-generated code, not only by hand-writing every line. You will write Apex, build Lightning Web Components, design Flows, implement integrations, and deliver the features and enhancements that power Illumina’s Commercial and Services organizations on the Salesforce platform, working fluently with AI coding assistants while remaining fully accountable for the correctness, security, and quality of everything you ship.

You are responsible for the majority of hands-on delivery on the team, increasingly by directing and verifying AI-generated code, not only writing it by hand. You will work from solution designs provided by Solution Architects, under technical direction set by the Technical Architect, and in close collaboration with Test Automation Engineers who validate your work. You will produce clean, well-tested, secure code that meets Illumina’s engineering standards and scales to support a global organization, whether you typed it or an AI agent produced it, you own it.

This role operates within an Agile Scrum delivery model. You will participate in sprint planning and grooming alongside Product Owners, Solution Architects, Technical Architects, and TAEs. You will collaborate with TAEs to define test strategy for your features; quality is a shared responsibility, built into every sprint, not a handoff at the end. As the Salesforce platform evolves with AI capabilities like Agentforce and Data Cloud (Data 360), you will build and implement these solutions alongside the rest of the engineering team. As AI takes on more first-pass implementation, your leverage shifts upstream, to clear specifications, strong tests, and disciplined review, and your judgment about what “good” looks like becomes the most valuable thing you bring.

job.description:

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. In this role at PwC, you will help execute outsourced processes, respond to client and customer questions, monitor quality controls, resolve escalations, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of Salesforce solutions and service delivery.

  • Troubleshooting Salesforce application issues and supporting configuration, integration, and release activities
  • Analyzing process performance data to identify trends, recommend improvements, and refine service outcomes
  • Managing assigned workstreams and coordinating deliverables within complex client service engagements

  • At least a Bachelor's degree
  • At least 4 years of experience
  • Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

  • Building Salesforce customization and integration solutions

  • Interpreting client needs across changing business contexts
  • Using critical thinking to break down complex concepts
  • Translating data into insights and recommendations

job.name: Senior Full Stack Engineer – Ruby on Rails, React.js & Python
job.description:
Meet the Team At Cisco Meraki , our mission is to simplify technology so passionate people can focus on their mission. Our intuitive cloud platform empowers organizations of all sizes—from local schools and hospitals to global enterprises—to deliver outstanding customer and employee experiences on a scale.

We have built an unrivaled company culture centered on collaboration, flexibility, psychological safety, and technical autonomy. Our Dashboard Engineering teams build and maintain web applications that manage millions of network devices globally from the cloud. Every single day, tens of millions of people rely on infrastructure configured, secured, and monitored through the Meraki Dashboard.

Your Impact

  • Partner across firmware, backend, SRE, and product teams to design systems managing millions of global network devices.
  • Develop high-performance backend services using Ruby on Rails, Python, and TypeScript, alongside adaptable and intuitive React.js frontends.
  • Build efficient PostgreSQL models and fine-tune queries for low-latency, high-throughput operations.
  • Author automated test suites, participate in architecture reviews, and uphold high coding standards.
  • Work with UX and Product to convert complex network data into intuitive, accessible user workflows.
  • Inclusive teamwork, knowledge sharing, and constructive peer code reviews.

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have Skills) We are seeking 7+ years of professional experience writing clean, maintainable, and test-driven production code for medium to large-scale distributed web applications.

  • Proven hands-on experience across the stack, using Ruby on Rails on the backend with ReactJS, JavaScript / TypeScript on the frontend
  • Demonstrated expertise in database schema build, indexing, and SQL query optimization using PostgreSQL or relational databases.
  • Consistent record of owning features from initial conception and architectural build through implementation, testing, and production deployment.
  • A strong curiosity for understanding user workflows and turning customer needs into elegant technical solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs clearly across multi-functional engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)

  • Experience architecture and operating cloud-based infrastructure and large-scale microservices.
  • Background or strong curiosity about enterprise networking, network security, or device management.
  • Experience with containerized environments and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with modern observability tools, distributed tracing, and CI/CD automation pipelines.

job.description:
At Warner Music Group, We’re a Global Collective Of Music Makers And Music Lovers, Tech Innovators And Inspired Entrepreneurs, Game-changing Creatives And Passionate Team Members. Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog !

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

About The Job We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help maintain, modernize, and innovate the core engineering applications that powers our entire music publishing business lifecycle—from rights management and contract administration to complex royalty processing and global licensing management.

If you love music, thrive on solving complex business issues and scale challenges, and are passionate about building mission-critical systems that songwriters and rightsholders rely on, this role is for you.

job.name: Senior Engineer (frontend)
job.description:
About the Role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer at Sage, you will contribute and lead in the design, development, and delivery of features for a high-quality SaaS solution that exceeds customer and business partner expectations. You will work closely with product managers and designers and proactively share your own knowledge of frontend technologies and practices with the wider team. We are looking for someone with 7+ years of professional experience in frontend engineering. Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required.

We value humility and collaboration. We are looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code, including tests, documentation, and long-term code quality.

Location: Bangalore, India. This is a hybrid role, three days per week in the office.

Required Skills

  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development for scalable, web-based applications.
  • Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required.

Core languages & frameworks

  • Strong TypeScript (strict) and modern JavaScript (ES Modules, async).
  • Deep React experience (hooks, composition, performance); React 19 / React Compiler a plus.
  • Solid HTML5, CSS3, and responsive/accessible UI fundamentals.

Build & tooling

  • Modern build tooling Vite (or Webpack/Rollup); code splitting and bundle optimization.
  • Git and pull-request workflows; monorepo experience (Nx) a plus.
  • Linters/formatters (Biome, ESLint/Prettier) and CI discipline.

State & data

  • State management with Redux Toolkit, XState (state machines), and/or TanStack Query.
  • RxJS / reactive streams.
  • Consuming REST APIs; JWT/OAuth2 bearer auth on the client; robust error handling.

Styling & design systems

  • Tailwind CSS, MUI (Material UI), styled-components/Emotion.
  • Working with a design-token system for brand consistency.

Data grids & performance

  • Complex data grids (ag-Grid Enterprise preferred, or TanStack Table/Handsontable): virtualization, server-side row model, custom renderers/editors.
  • Frontend performance profiling and optimization (rendering, memoization, main-thread work).
  • Web Workers for off-main-thread compute.

Accessibility & i18n

  • WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA accessibility practices; ARIA, keyboard, focus management.
  • Internationalization (i18next or similar), including locale-aware date/number formatting.

Testing & quality

  • Unit/component testing (Vitest/Jest + Testing Library), API mocking (MSW), and Playwright E2E.
  • Secure client-side coding against the OWASP Top 10 (XSS, token handling, safe storage).

AI Tooling

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Principal UI Engineer - Frontend/Fullstack (React, TypeScript)

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

Access Essentials - Core Product

The Access Essentials organization at Okta builds the platform features for authentication and authorization across Okta-protected resources. Our mission is to enable customers to access these resources seamlessly & securely. We develop Okta cloud services and client software that allow users to seamlessly login to devices and use Okta authenticators to access applications securely. The Access Management team is part of Okta R&D Engineering. Learn more about Okta’s Engineering on our blog.

The First Party Apps Platform team

First Party Apps Platform team is part of the larger Access Essential - Core Product organization. We develop Okta’s secure web experiences for end-user authentication and access. Our products and features are high-impact and high-visibility. Our team develops the Okta Sign-in Widget, End User SSO Dashboard, and the Okta Browser Plugin.

The Engineer Opportunity

We seek an experienced web front-end engineer to join our First Party Apps Platform team. The ideal candidate has extensive experience in web development, building well-tested and maintainable software. The opportunity is an excellent chance to build software with high impact and usage. If you’re excited to work on something that millions of users will use on a daily basis, this is the opportunity for you.

job.name: AI Tools Administrator
job.description:
Position Title: AI Tools Administrator

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 43620

Overview Our Digital Technology team helps employees leverage technology to work more effectively, collaborate better, and deliver greater business value. As McCain continues to expand the use of Microsoft Copilot, Claude and other AI productivity tools, the quality of their configuration, integrations and access controls determines whether those tools deliver real value.

The AI Tools Administrator is the hands-on technical owner of day-to-day configuration and operations for McCain's enterprise AI productivity tools, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and Claude Enterprise. You will turn approved designs into working, secure, supportable capabilities: connectors, MCP servers, plugins, skills, policies and managed client settings.

You work within the AI Deployment & Enablement team, taking direction from the AI Enablement Lead and Manager, who own governance, communications and program strategy. This role is distinct from McCain's horizontal AI Platform, which is owned by the engineering teams.

The successful candidate is a methodical, technically curious professional who enjoys getting systems to work, documents what they build, and helps employees use new tools with confidence.

Job Purpose Configure, operate, troubleshoot and continuously improve McCain's enterprise AI productivity tools so employees get tools that work, are secure, and integrate with the systems they need.

This is a technical, execution-focused role: roughly 80% hands-on configuration, integration and support work, and 20% governance, documentation and coordination.

Key Responsibilities AI Tools Administration & Configuration (~40%)

  • Administer Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and Claude Enterprise, including tenant and admin console settings, workspaces, roles, SSO and SCIM provisioning, and license assignment
  • Configure and maintain managed client settings and deployment of AI client tools (e.g., Claude desktop and Claude Code) through Intune
  • Manage groups, access policies and data-boundary controls in line with security and data classification standards
  • Apply approved configuration changes through McCain's change control process

Connectors, MCP, Plugins & Skills (~25%)

  • Set up, test and maintain MCP servers, connectors, plugins and skills for approved use cases, including authentication, scopes and permissions
  • Build and maintain simple agents and workflows in Copilot Studio
  • Validate integrations before release, manage versioning and rollback, and retire connectors and plugins that are no longer used
  • Maintain a catalog of approved connectors and plugins, with configuration details

Support, Troubleshooting & Monitoring (~15%)

job.name: Lead Data Architect
job.description:
Overview WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Team We are a global integration and delivery team. We implement, integrate and support border management and passenger data solutions for government customers around the world. We deploy and configure applications, integrate them with government and airline systems, ship regular releases, and support them in production. Our solutions run in secure on-premises, customer-hosted and cloud environments, and our teams are spread across several regions and time zones.

PURPOSE

The Lead Technical Architect owns the technical design of the team's solutions, from early estimation through to production. You'll define solution and integration architectures for high-availability, message-driven systems built on Java microservices and Kubernetes. You'll set the technical direction for environments, CI/CD and platform standards, and act as the senior technical authority for engineering teams, customers and partners.

Key Responsibilities Solution and integration architecture

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for new implementations, enhancements and modernisation programmes. This includes high-level and low-level designs, interface specifications and architecture decision records.
  • Design integration patterns across synchronous REST/SOAP APIs, enterprise messaging (IBM MQ) and event streaming (Kafka). Keep external interface contracts stable while internal components are modernised.
  • Lead legacy-to-modern re-platforming: break down monolithic applications into microservices, move embedded business logic into configurable rules, and plan data migration.
  • Make technology decisions, for example choosing between relational and NoSQL data stores, based on functional need, non-functional requirements and licence cost.

job.name: Oracle Fusion HCM Technical - Principal Consultant
job.description:
Job Description As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Consultant, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a consultant with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
  • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
  • Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
  • Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
  • Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
  • Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
  • Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.
  • Review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to support delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

Skills - Mandatory Experience

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking a highly experienced Hands‑On Technical Manager to lead our engineering team both technically and organizationally. This role requires deep, hands‑on expertise across the full technology stack, combined with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and technical strategy.

You will remain actively involved in system design, critical code paths, architectural decisions, and complex problem‑solving while also managing, mentoring, and growing a team of engineers and Tech Leads. You will serve as a key bridge between Engineering, Product, Design, and Leadership, ensuring scalable, secure, and high‑quality solutions are delivered consistently to production.

Duties and Responsibilities of the Manager, Software Engineering:

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership (Hands On)

  • Define and own system architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy across products and platforms.
  • Design, architect, and review complex full-stack solutions using Angular, .NET, Node.js, GraphQL, and REST-based microservices.
  • Contribute to critical technical initiatives through architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts, technical spikes, and complex refactoring efforts.
  • Guide teams in secure coding practices, scalability, performance optimization, maintainability, and operational excellence.
  • Review and approve high-impact design decisions, code changes, and release strategies.
  • Drive engineering quality through code reviews, automated testing, quality scans, and development best practices.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for adoption.

Delivery & Execution

  • Own end-to-end delivery of technical initiatives and ensure successful deployment into production environments.
  • Partner with Product, Design, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Balance immediate delivery commitments with long-term architectural sustainability.
  • Collaborate with Agile teams throughout the software development lifecycle including design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Ensure application reliability, maintenance, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive timely execution and resolution of complex technical challenges.

People Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop engineers and technical leads.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Drive technical excellence through coaching, knowledge sharing, and best practices.
  • Support team growth through performance management, career development, and succession planning.

Required Qualifications

job.name: Lead Software Developer
job.description:
Overview WELCOME TO SITA At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward - we’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Role & Team We are looking for an experienced Lead Developer to provide technical leadership across the design, development, delivery and support of enterprise digital solutions.

The role requires someone who can think beyond individual applications , understand the end-to-end solution, and work across development, architecture, QA, DevOps, infrastructure and support teams.

We are looking for a Lead Developer who thinks beyond the code — someone who considers the complete journey from:

User → Application → API → Integration → Database → Infrastructure → Production → Support and takes ownership of delivering solutions that are reliable, secure, maintainable and production-ready. What You’ll Do

  • Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentoring to development teams.
  • Design and develop scalable, secure and maintainable enterprise solutions.
  • Understand and troubleshoot systems end-to-end, from application and APIs through to databases, infrastructure and production.
  • Lead technical design, code reviews and engineering best practices.
  • Support production incidents, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams on deployment, monitoring and operational readiness.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies and performance/reliability considerations early.
  • Ensure solutions provide a good overall user and customer experience.
  • Communicate technical solutions and issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Promote effective use of AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, testing, troubleshooting and documentation.

Qualifications ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

Company Overview Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

Docusign is looking for a highly motivated full stack Senior Software Engineer to join our commerce platform team. This person will work in a close knitted development Pod of 4-6 engineers to develop, test, and support features and experimentation on ecom.docusign.com and adjacent experiences. The Commerce engineering team offers unique learning opportunities where you will be directly involved in end-to-end customer experience ownership across a large surface area of product and engineering collaboration. We look for candidates with love for computer science and engineering, and we truly believe you will enjoy and find success in this team.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Engineering Manager, Commerce Platform.

Responsibility

  • Be open minded, forward thinking and passionate about great software
  • Think about how to solve problems in scale and build fault tolerant systems
  • Develop testable, high-quality, and ship-ready code with ample test coverage
  • Work with Product Management and other stakeholders to understand and translate commerce and growth teams, and build end to end architecture and system designs
  • Lead the end to end architecture and systems designs by partnering with cross functional teams for the PLG org
  • Mentor and address other senior and lead engineers and architects within the organization
  • Represent PLG engineering org in all discussions with the stakeholders
  • Identify and build POCs to solve technical challenges within the organization and recommend a scalable solution
  • Experience presenting software architecture to the executives
  • Work as part of a cross-site development team to drive the design, implementation, testing, and release of products

Job Designation

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

job.name: FileNet & DOJO Developer
job.description:
Position Description

Job Title

FileNet & DOJO Developer

Experience 8 10 Years

Location

Bangalore

Job Summary We are looking for an experienced FileNet & DOJO Developer to develop, enhance, and support Enterprise Content Management (ECM) applications built on IBM FileNet and DOJO Toolkit. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in IBM FileNet P8, DOJO, Java/J2EE, and enterprise web application development. job.name: Software Developer 3
job.description:
Job Description Here at OCI we’re building the world’s largest AI clusters and we’re the fastest at bringing them to the market. The AI Infrastructure organization at OCI is leading this effort by creating a GPU focused cloud with the latest hardware providing the best performance, efficiency, reliability, and scalability. This is your chance to be part of the AI revolution by creating systems that allow customers to scale from tens to thousands of GPUs without compromising performance. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and make a significant impact on our organization's success.

We are looking for a highly skilled distributed systems engineer to scale and optimize AI infrastructure components like GPU control plane and GPU data plane that provide computing resources to customer AI workloads. You will provide technical leadership to the team and bring clarity to ambiguous problems and come up with innovative solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance our AI infrastructure to deliver exceptional customer experience and peak performance.

Responsibilities RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and develop solutions to scale and optimize AI compute infrastructure components like GPU control plane and GPU data plane with the goal to optimize customer experience and customer workload performance on our AI infrastructure.
  • Develop “best-in-class” AI compute infrastructure for our customers by ensuring that the services and the components are well-defined and modularized, secure, reliable, diagnosable, actively monitored, compliant and reusable.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development, operations, and product management, to understand their requirements and design innovative orchestration solutions.
  • Mentor junior developers and drive modern software engineering practices like leveraging data/telemetry to make decisions, well-defined interfaces across components, design reviews, coding standards, code reviews, and comprehensive coverage from unit test, integration test and active production monitoring.
  • Develop benchmark metrics and automation to drive and track performance and reliability across customer workload and lower infrastructure stack. ­

Qualifications & Skills

  • BS (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software development with programming languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, Go, Rust.
  • 3 years of experience designing and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and services.
  • 1 year of experience providing technical leadership and clarity to cross-functional teams and projects while collaborating across stake holders.
  • Systematic problem-solving approach, strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and drive.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

job.name: Custom Software Engineering Lead
job.description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineering Lead

Project Role Description : Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.

Must have skills : Microsoft Agentic AI Architecture

Good to have skills : Python (Programming Language), Agentic Orchestration, Agentic Design

Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

Lead the end-to-end enterprise AI and Agentic AI architecture, translating the existing application and integration landscape into a scalable, production-grade AI architecture and driving it from design through approval and engineering execution. This builds on the existing client requirement. This role needs the Architect to be cloud agnostic and not just on Azure rather should be able to pick up across cloud and lead the Enterprise AI and Agentic AI Architecture.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Strong Enterprise AI / Agentic AI architecture experience, with ability to define target architecture, reusable patterns, standards and guardrails across enterprise platforms. Required active participation and contribution in team discussions.
  • Deep expertise in Context Engineering, including how enterprise/domain knowledge, architecture, code, APIs, standards and delivery context are curated and dynamically supplied to agents - Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into effective application configurations.
  • Internal AI-native engineering guidance explicitly positions context engineering as managing context, rules, memory, skills and architectural constraints around the model.
  • Strong understanding of Agent Memory Management, including short/long-term memory, state, persistence, context-window optimization, knowledge retrieval and appropriate separation of context versus persistent memory.
  • Architect AI Harness patterns around agents, covering context, tools/APIs, execution loops, state, guardrails, recovery, observability, security and human approval. Accenture's internal harness material positions the harness as the operating layer governing how agents execute reliably at enterprise scale.

Professional & Technical Skills:

Must Have Skills: Enterprise AI Architecture.

Good to Have Skills: Agentic AI, Context Engineering, memory Management, AI Harness, Multi-Agent Orchestration, MCP/A2A, Enterprise Integration, AI Governance, LLMOps/AgentOps,Cloud Agnostic

Title And Summary Senior Site Reliability Engineer

oVERVIEW-

Who is Mastercard? We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

About The Role The Mastercard Authorization Platform is an international message processing system that serves all Mastercard principals, affiliates, and associations: large and small, automated and non-automated. The Authorization Platform transmits authorization validation data among issuers, acquirers, and points of interaction.

The Authorization Platform refers to both hardware (the physical communications lines of the Mastercard Network and Mastercard interface processors [MIPs]) and software (the Mastercard Network authorization application).

As a Senior Engineer in BizOps, you will play a pivotal role in advancing Mastercard’s authorization observability and operational intelligence. This role focuses on engineering solutions that enhance platform instrumentation, cross-team integration, and real-time alerting across multi-platform environments.

Your responsibilities include building and maintaining impact and blast-radius reporting in partnership with Incident Manager teams to enable rapid delivery of metrics for incidents affecting Transaction Switching Authorization. You’ll also engineer internal SLA/SLO monitoring, dashboarding, reporting systems, and support customer-facing data enablement for latency and decline inquiries.

You’ll collaborate with BizOps Squad Leads to define and deliver release observability requirements, ensuring robust logging and monitoring for new and enhanced components. You’ll also support SLA/SLO documentation and cross-team reviews to identify and implement improvements.

job.description:
Agentic AI Engineer – LLM Agents, Tool Calling & Orchestration | 2–3 Years Experience

Company: MXC Ignite LLP

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana (On-site)

Experience: 2–3 years of relevant professional experience

Salary: ₹7.5–12 LPA, based on technical expertise and interview performance

Openings: 4–5

Joining: Immediate

About the Role

MXC Ignite is hiring experienced Agentic AI Engineers to develop and implement production-oriented AI agent systems for real-world technology projects.

We are specifically looking for engineers who have hands-on experience building LLM-powered agents that interact with external tools, execute multi-step workflows, make routing decisions, handle failures and integrate with existing applications.

This is a specialized AI engineering role requiring practical experience in agent development, LLM API integration, tool calling and workflow orchestration.

Please note: General software development experience alone is not sufficient for this position.

We are looking for engineers who have already built functional AI agents and can demonstrate their technical work.

Core Technical Responsibilities1. Agentic AI Development

  • Design, develop and implement LLM-powered AI agents using Python.
  • Build multi-step agent workflows involving tool/function calling, routing and task execution.
  • Implement agent-to-agent handoffs and agent-to-human escalation workflows.
  • Configure agent roles, tools, routing permissions and token budgets using YAML.
  • Develop integrations between AI agents, REST APIs, backend systems and external tools.
  • Implement exception handling, retries, timeouts and fallback mechanisms.
  • Maintain defined data-access boundaries and controlled agent execution.

2. LLM Integration and Orchestration

  • Integrate LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini or comparable models.
  • Implement tool/function calling to enable agents to perform structured tasks.
  • Build agent orchestration workflows connecting LLMs with external applications.
  • Handle structured responses, tool execution results and unexpected model behaviour.
  • Optimize prompts and improve agent reliability.
  • Understand and manage token usage, execution latency and LLM costs.

3. Testing, Evaluation and Debugging

  • Develop test cases and evaluation datasets to validate agent behaviour.
  • Debug agent failures using logs and execution traces.
  • Investigate incorrect routing, failed tool calls and unexpected outputs.
  • Write regression tests before releasing changes.
  • Monitor agent performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Document implementation decisions, technical issues and fixes.

4. Human-in-the-Loop and Enterprise AI Workflows

job.description:
A Data Engineer on the BW SOON Data Team analyzes data from multiple source systems and designs/models data marts based on business requirements. job.name: Urban Development Expert
job.description:
Company: Atharva Planning and Research Centre Pvt. Ltd. (APARC)

Project: State Institute of Transformation (SIT)

Department: Department of Planning & Statistics, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

Location: Daman (State Headquarters)

Employment Type: Contractual / Project-Based

Number of Positions: 1

About APARC

Atharva Planning and Research Centre Pvt. Ltd. (APARC) is a multidisciplinary planning and research consultancy working across urban and rural development, infrastructure planning, environmental management, policy advisory, and socio-economic research.

APARC is seeking an experienced Urban Development Expert for the State Institute of Transformation (SIT), a strategic initiative of the Department of Planning & Statistics, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and evaluate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to Urban Development and Urban Planning.
  • Provide strategic insights and technical guidance on urban development policies and programmes.
  • Lead analytical studies related to urban spatial planning, transportation, traffic analysis, housing, real estate, infrastructure assessment, urban governance, and land-use planning.
  • Design and conduct field surveys, research studies, and sectoral assessments.
  • Develop state-level indices and performance indicators aligned with frameworks of NITI Aayog and UN organisations.
  • Prepare urban development strategies, sectoral targets, socio-economic goals, and the State Vision 2047 roadmap.
  • Conduct market research and evaluate existing policies, strategies, and development programmes.
  • Coordinate with government departments, development partners, technical agencies, and reputed institutions such as NIUA, CEPT, and UN-Habitat.
  • Prepare policy briefs, technical reports, presentations, and project proposals.
  • Support the State Government in strengthening its monitoring and evaluation systems.
  • Facilitate stakeholder consultations, workshops, and cross-learning platforms.
  • Maintain coordination with the State Planning Department, LKI, and NITI Aayog.

Essential:

  • Master's degree in any discipline OR a Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology, including B.Architecture or B.Planning, from a recognised university.
  • Alternatively, a two-year PGDM in the relevant sector.
  • Relevant post-qualification field experience.

Desirable:

  • Advanced diploma or degree in the relevant sector.
  • Research publications or demonstrated contributions to urban development and planning.

Required Experience

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience in urban development, urban planning, and programme implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience in project management, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience working with government departments, development agencies, or international organisations will be an advantage.

job.description:
Job Description Analyst I, Procurement Intelligence (based in Ahmedabad) Position Summary As an Analyst I for Procurement Intelligence function, you contribute to Kraft Heinz's strategic ambition in shaping procurement-wide cost modelling strategy, providing critical insights to support executive decision-making on productivity, and driving financial efficiency. You will provide structure, support, and guidance to the Procurement team to ensure a comprehensive approach is used when there is a need to build our understanding of the market, competitors, and the importance of trends for all categories. You’ll understand our business objectives and strategically research relevant data to help us improve category strategies & approaches to competitive sourcing. You will design summary extract reports and analytics in collaboration with our procurement teams to embed this external knowledge which will help our business partners make informed decisions. This is a data-intensive, insight-driven role that bridges procurement strategy, finance, and external market intelligence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform quantitative and qualitative research into consumers, competitors, and the marketplace
  • Data mine the world wide web leveraging search engines and web analytics to gain insights from articles, publications etc.
  • Conduct in-depth research on industry trends, supplier markets, commodity pricing, and geopolitical factors to understand supply and demand dynamics and cost drivers
  • Analyze data from numerous sources to identify market trends and relevant demographics
  • Evaluate market data using software and statistical techniques
  • Provide analytical support to help develop sourcing strategies, support supplier identification and selection processes
  • Deliver supplier intel for strategic sourcing as required on an ongoing basis based on financial performance metrics (KPIs)
  • Apply the end-to-end procurement knowledge to conduct internal and external price benchmarking, identify areas of cost improvement and areas of automation
  • Thoroughly understanding the specifications of the products procured at the company and identify the productivity opportunities using the value engineering, design to value, specs change, supplier normalization etc.
  • Collect and analyze data from various procurement tools like SAP, SNOWFLAKE to ensure accuracy and consistency in data
  • Conduct spend analysis, total cost breakdown and should cost analysis to compare supplier prices and identify savings opportunities
  • Collect, analyze data from various databases including sec filings, Refinitiv, Capital IQ, EMIS, Factiva to ensure accuracy and consistency in data
  • Review and interpret large data sets and organize them into spreadsheets, charts, and graphs
  • Create insightful reports, presentations, and action items based on collected data

job.name: Azure Integration Developer
job.description:
What You Will Do:

  • Build Azure Functions, Blob storage for incoming files, and Service Bus queues that move a file from received to saved in Dataverse.
  • Make a repeated file safe, so sending it twice does not create a second certificate or a second bill.
  • Keep a link from each file row to the certificate it created and to the billing line.
  • Let one bad row fail without stopping the rest of the file.
  • Build one adapter shape: a provider file comes in, a standard completion record comes out. Seertech is the first provider. The adapter must not contain business checks.
  • Support three ways a file can arrive: SFTP or a folder drop, a scheduled API call, and an ABS Excel or file template uploaded by a user.
  • Build the monthly billing job. If a rate is missing, stop the close. Write lines that are never edited. Lock the month. Write a spreadsheet whose cells cannot run as formulas.
  • Write a unit test for every file check and for the billing calculation.

Education & Experience:

  • 5 to 8 years of software development, with hands-on C# on Azure.
  • BE/BTech degree in a technical field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Certifications:

  • AZ-204, Azure Developer Associate.

Good to Have:

  • AZ-400, DevOps Engineer Expert.
  • AZ-700, Azure Network Engineer, or proven VNet delivery without the certificate.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Must Have:

  • C# and .NET.
  • Azure Functions, including VNet integration and managed identity.
  • Azure Logic Apps for file and API integration.
  • Azure Service Bus.
  • Azure Blob Storage, including immutable storage for files that must not be changed.
  • Azure Key Vault for secrets, keys, and connection strings. No secrets in code.
  • Azure Virtual Network, subnets, private endpoints, and VNet peering.
  • Azure API Management (APIM): APIs, policies, products, and subscriptions.
  • REST API design and integration patterns: SFTP, storage drop, and scheduled API pull.
  • Application integration with Dataverse Web API or SDK: batched writes, throttling, and alternate-key updates.
  • Pipelines that can be run again without creating duplicate rows.

Good to Have:

  • Azure App Service, where a component is better as a web app than a Function.
  • LMS or training-system integrations.
  • Creating Excel files from code.
  • Ledger or billing work where a closed month is not rewritten.
  • Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions pipelines.

Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days

job.description:
Data Scientist – Predictive Intelligence Engine (PIE)

About Codvo.ai

Codvo.ai is an AI-native technology services company that helps global enterprises build and scale data, cloud and AI solutions. Our teams deliver for Fortune 500 clients across Oil & Gas, Energy, MedTech and other regulated industries.

Role overview

We are hiring a Data Scientist with hands-on Predictive Intelligence Engine (PIE) experience to turn enterprise and industrial data into models that forecast outcomes and prevent failures. You will own problems end to end: framing the question, building and validating models, and putting them into production with engineering teams. The role works directly with client stakeholders and suits someone who enjoys both technical depth and business impact.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build and enhance models and pipelines within the Predictive Intelligence Engine (PIE), partnering with stakeholders to translate problems into measurable predictive use cases.
  • Build, validate and tune predictive models for forecasting, failure prediction, risk scoring, churn and demand.
  • Develop predictive maintenance and anomaly detection solutions using sensor, IoT and time-series data from industrial assets.
  • Engineer features from large structured and unstructured datasets, including historian and operational data.
  • Apply statistical methods, survival analysis and experiment design to measure model impact.
  • Build and evaluate GenAI / LLM solutions such as RAG pipelines where they strengthen predictive workflows.
  • Work with data and ML engineers to deploy models into production and monitor accuracy, drift and retraining (MLOps).
  • Present predictions and their business value to technical and non-technical audiences through dashboards and clear recommendations.
  • Document models, assumptions and results, following data governance and compliance standards.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to reusable predictive assets and best practices.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering or a related field.
  • 10+ years of hands-on data science experience, with at least 3 years building predictive models.
  • Hands-on experience building or working on a Predictive Intelligence Engine (PIE) in production, such as predictive maintenance, demand forecasting or failure / risk prediction.
  • Strong time-series forecasting skills (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM or gradient-boosted models such as XGBoost / LightGBM).
  • Strong Python skills, including pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn and TensorFlow or PyTorch.
  • Advanced SQL and experience working with large datasets.
  • Solid grounding in statistics, probability, model validation and performance metrics.
  • Working knowledge of a cloud platform: Azure, AWS or GCP.
  • Clear communication skills and comfort working with client stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.

The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.

We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.

Our digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. The Manufacturing Intelligence and Technology Transformation (MITT) team within Pfizer’s Global Technology, Engineering and Launch organisation develops and deploys advanced manufacturing capabilities across Pfizer Global Supply. job.name: Senior Cloud Engineer
job.description:
Req ID: 142868

Remote Position: Hybrid

Region: Asia

Country: India

State/Province: Chennai

City: Guindy, Chennai

Summary We are seeking a strategic, deeply hands-on Senior Cloud & Platform Architect to lead both the architectural design and end-to-end operational lifecycle of our enterprise multi-cloud and container ecosystem. Reporting to the Head of Cloud Platform Services, you will bridge architecture and execution—defining target-state blueprints and governance standards across AWS, Azure, and GCP while actively deploying, managing, and maintaining mission-critical platforms.

In this role, you will architect, build, and operate resilient multi-cluster Kubernetes platforms (native Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, GKE, and AKS), design and manage enterprise API integration patterns and service meshes, and engineer scalable infrastructure for high-throughput AI/ML inference and agentic workflows. You will serve as both a technical authority and a lead practitioner—mentoring Band 8 engineers, driving architectural reviews, and taking hands-on ownership of complex deployments, cluster lifecycle management, and high-severity incident resolution

Detailed Description

  • Multi-Cloud Architecture, Deployment & Management: Design, provision, and manage end-to-end multi-cloud reference architectures, landing zones, and hybrid connectivity patterns across AWS, Azure, and GCP, balancing workload portability, resilience, and FinOps cost optimization.
  • Kubernetes Platform Design & Lifecycle Operations: Architect, deploy, and maintain multi-tenant, multi-cluster Kubernetes environments (OpenShift, GKE, AKS, native K8s), overseeing cluster topology, GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), zero-downtime cluster upgrades, node pool patching, and resource auto-scaling (HPA, KEDA, Cluster Autoscaler).
  • API Integration & Service Mesh Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise API integration patterns, API gateways, ingress controllers, and zero-trust service meshes (Istio) to secure and manage north-south and east-west service traffic.
  • AI & Agentic Infrastructure Engineering & Support: Architect, deploy, and maintain low-latency infrastructure for LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and autonomous agentic runtimes—configuring GPU node pools, GPU slicing/scheduling, persistent storage, vector database integrations, and model-serving endpoints.
  • Enterprise IaC & Automation: Establish organizational standards for Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu,) while actively writing, testing, and maintaining reusable Terraform modules, Helm charts, Kustomize overlays, and custom operators.
  • Security, Compliance & Vulnerability Management: Architect zero-trust security frameworks (IAM federation, workload identity, Vault) and oversee ongoing vulnerability management—driving remediation of container CVEs (Trivy, Grype) and enforcing security patches across cloud and cluster fleets.
  • Backup, Disaster Recovery & Resilience: Define e

job.name: Product and Platform Security Specialist
job.description:
Do you enjoy working out how code, pipelines and cloud platforms connect, and closing the gaps between them? Would you like your work to protect every product at once? Join our team Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward, making it safer, cleaner, and more efficient for people and the planet.

We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to secure the systems our software is built, shipped and run on. The role finds and reduces security risk along the path from a code commit to a running workload. That path covers source control, build and deployment pipelines, artifact registries, container platforms and cloud accounts.

You will work with platform, cloud security and product security teams on controls that every product inherits. You will also shape how AI agents are used safely inside the delivery pipeline.

You will suit this role if you have built or run pipelines, clusters or cloud environments yourself and can think like an attacker about how they connect. Hands-on experience across identity, CI/CD, containers and cloud infrastructure matters more than depth in any one tool.

Partner with the best as a Product and Platform Security Specialist you will be responsible for:

Source control and pipeline security

  • Assess how source control organizations, repositories and build pipelines are configured, and find the paths an attacker could take to production.
  • Review access, tokens, apps and integrations, and reduce standing privileges.
  • Define and enforce baseline rules for protected branches, code review and pipeline permissions.
  • Harden runners and build environments against untrusted code.

Deployment and container platform security

  • Review deployment systems and GitOps controllers: who can deploy what, where, and with which credentials.
  • Assess cluster access, workload isolation, admission policy, secrets handling and network segmentation.
  • Make sure only trusted, traceable artifacts reach production.
  • Work with platform teams to fix findings and track them to closure.

Cloud foundations and identity

  • Review how pipelines and workloads obtain cloud access, and replace stored keys with short-lived, federated identity.
  • Assess account structure, organization-level guardrails and infrastructure as code for gaps.
  • Keep an inventory of machine identities and what each one can do.
  • Agree with the cloud security team who owns each finding on cloud resources.

Automation, policy as code and monitoring

  • Write scripts that collect configuration evidence from platform APIs, so assessments can be repeated.
  • Express controls as code, so they are versioned, reviewed and tested.
  • Define the audit logs each platform must send to central monitoring and build detections for risky changes.
  • Support the response to software supply chain and platform incidents.

AI agent and developer platform security

job.name: Agentic AI Engineer
job.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

What You Can Expect

Zimmer Biomet is moving from AI that reads enterprise data to AI that acts inside the systems that run the business. The Agentic AI Engineer owns that last mile: designing, building and operating the secure, governed integrations that let AI agents read from and write back to SAP and other core IT systems – so that agent recommendations become executed transactions, not spreadsheets or dashboards.

This role sits at the boundary between the AI delivery teams and Core IT. It is equal parts software/integration engineering and agent development, and it succeeds only if Core IT and SAP platform owners trust the engineer’s judgment on security, change control and data integrity. The first priority is to establish that trust and use it to stand up a standard, reusable pattern (including MCP-based tool access) for agent integration into enterprise systems.

Value This Role Creates

  • Closes the gap between AI insight and action – enables agent pipelines to write approved outputs (e.g., planning parameters, master data corrections, orders, exceptions) back to SAP and other source systems.
  • Unlocks end-to-end supply chain automation by providing the integration layer that agentic use cases (supply planning, inventory optimization/MEIO, transportation optimization) depend on.
  • Gives Core IT a governed, auditable, reusable integration pattern instead of one-off point solutions – reducing risk and accelerating every subsequent agent deployment.
  • Builds the enterprise MCP/tool layer so agents across functions can safely discover and use system capabilities.

Work Location: Bangalore

Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)

Shift Timing - 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM

The Applied Research Scientist – Voice of the Customer (VOC) - will participate in applied research necessary for the success of Five9’s Voice of the Customer (VOC) AI Agent software platform. Our AI agent platform provides customers with fully autonomous self-service agents for customer support, sales, and services use cases in the contact center. Our Voice of the Customer (VOC) component of this platform analyzes conversations with human agents, and uses them to generate insights, analytics and instructions and operating procedures for AI Agents. In other words – we use our human agent data to train AI agents. This is one of the hottest areas of application for AI Agent technology!

The Applied Research Scientist is responsible for conceiving of algorithms, prompts, clustering and aggregation technologies, agentic systems, and so on, and then running experiments to validate correctness. The applied research scientist will participate in experiment design, execution, results evaluation, documentation, and iteration. They will work on metric definitions and measurement techniques. They will participate in data collection and creation of golden data sets for experiments. They will also run experiments evaluating the performance of different LLMs, including small language models and open weight models. The applied research scientist will also perform fine tuning of models (typically small language models) and evaluate their performance.

The work of the applied research scientist is directly aligned to the needs of the product itself. Work done by the applied research scientist is meant to quickly make its way into production to improve the product. The applied research scientist is not expected to produce the actual production code, though this can happen in some cases.

As one of the fastest-growing segments of Amazon, we operate at unprecedented scale across desktop, mobile, connected TV, and emerging surfaces.

Within Amazon Ads, Traffic Quality is a critical pillar of advertiser trust and marketplace integrity. Our mission is to build advanced capabilities that work at petabyte scale to detect sophisticated invalid traffic (IVT) which includes sophisticated non-human traffic, bot networks, and fraudulent engagement patterns across programmatic advertising. We are on a journey to establish Amazon Ads as an industry leader in traffic quality standards and transparency. Our research agenda focuses on staying ahead of adversarial actors through continuous innovation in detection methodologies, leveraging state-of-the-art techniques in deep learning and generative modeling, user behavior and multi-modal representation learning, anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and sparse labeling methods. We process billions of ad events daily, developing novel algorithms that balance precision and recall while operating under strict latency constraints. Our work directly protects hundreds of millions of dollars in advertiser spend annually while maintaining a seamless user experience.

Key job responsibilities

As a Data Scientist II in Traffic Quality, you will solve inherently hard problems in advertising fraud detection by applying advanced statistical techniques and machine learning. You'll work on systems that process billions of ad impressions and clicks per day, using Amazon's cloud services including EC2, S3, EMR, Sagemaker, and RedShift.

  • Define and frame new research problems in fraud detection where neither problem nor solution is well-defined.
  • Apply new machine learning approaches, models, and algorithms to detect sophisticated invalid traffic.

job.name: Agentic AI Engineer - Enterprise Systems Integration (SAP & Core Systems)
job.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

What You Can Expect

Zimmer Biomet is moving from AI that reads enterprise data to AI that acts inside the systems that run the business. The Agentic AI Engineer owns that last mile: designing, building and operating the secure, governed integrations that let AI agents read from and write back to SAP and other core IT systems – so that agent recommendations become executed transactions, not spreadsheets or dashboards.

This role sits at the boundary between the AI delivery teams and Core IT. It is equal parts software/integration engineering and agent development, and it succeeds only if Core IT and SAP platform owners trust the engineer’s judgment on security, change control and data integrity. The first priority is to establish that trust and use it to stand up a standard, reusable pattern (including MCP-based tool access) for agent integration into enterprise systems.

Value This Role Creates

  • Closes the gap between AI insight and action – enables agent pipelines to write approved outputs (e.g., planning parameters, master data corrections, orders, exceptions) back to SAP and other source systems.
  • Unlocks end-to-end supply chain automation by providing the integration layer that agentic use cases (supply planning, inventory optimization/MEIO, transportation optimization) depend on.
  • Gives Core IT a governed, auditable, reusable integration pattern instead of one-off point solutions – reducing risk and accelerating every subsequent agent deployment.
  • Builds the enterprise MCP/tool layer so agents across functions can safely discover and use system capabilities.

Work Location: Bangalore

Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)

Shift Timing - 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM

Its BRAHMA AI Core (BAIC) platform grew out of the CLEAR media asset management system and helps organisations ingest, manage, search and localise large libraries of video and media, while BRAHMA AI Studio adds generative AI for content creation. What you bring

  • Hands-on React experience, ideally with microservices and micro-frontend architectures.

Nice to have

You will mentor P2/P3 AI engineers, review designs, create reusable patterns, and help the broader team explain AI design choices clearly across Guidewire, SI partners, and customers.

Job Description Key Responsibilities

  • AI Feature Blueprinting: Create technical blueprints for AI features, including architecture, data needs, model strategy, evaluation approach, and delivery risks.
  • Model Selection: Define patterns for identifying which LLM model should be used for each call, and when to use NLP/NLU instead.
  • Harness Architecture: Shape reusable patterns for agent loops, tool/function calling, context construction, memory, structured outputs, retries, and failure handling.
  • Prompt Engineering: Set standards for prompt design, versioning, review, experimentation, and regression testing as first-class engineering assets.
  • Evaluation: Design eval frameworks, golden datasets, regression suites, error analysis, and LLM-as-judge patterns to measure quality and guide decisions.
  • RAG & Knowledge Patterns: Guide document parsing, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, prompt assembly, and grounded response patterns.
  • Mentorship & Enablement: Coach P2/P3 AI engineers, review technical designs, create examples, and help junior engineers present architecture findings clearly.
  • Cross-Guidewire Collaboration: Partner with Product, AI CoE, PS, customer teams, and SI partners.

KPIs & Success Metrics

  • AI feature blueprints are clear, reusable, and actionable for Strike Teams.
  • Model and architecture choices are backed by evals, analysis, and documented trade-offs.
  • Prompt, harness, RAG, and evaluation patterns are adopted consistently by P2/P3 engineers.
  • Delivered AI features meet project bars for accuracy, groundedness, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Junior and mid-level engineers can implement patterns and explain the results confidently.

job.name: ADAS Algorithms - Driving Functions (FSF)
job.description:
ADAS Architect – Front Safety Functions

Department

ADAS Algorithms – Driving Functions

Location

Bengaluru

Employment type

Full-time, permanent

Experience 7–15 years

About The Team You will join a focused team of domain experts building a greenfield, in-house L2+ ADAS software stack for Indian road conditions, covering four-wheelers and two-wheelers. The team designs and owns the complete architecture, algorithms, and tooling, from first principles through to deployment on automotive-grade ECUs. Engineers here shape foundational technical decisions, work directly with experts across perception, fusion, driving functions, motion control, and simulation, and see their work carried from concept to vehicle.

Role purpose

The Front Safety Architect leads the concept, architecture, and algorithm development of forward-facing safety functions: Autonomous Emergency Braking (AEB), Forward Collision Warning (FCW), Lane Departure Warning (LDW), and Front Cross-Traffic Alert (FCTA). The role spans the full development lifecycle, from requirements and algorithm design through simulation-based validation, embedded implementation, and in-vehicle tuning.

Key responsibilities

  • Define the functional architecture for the Front Safety function family, including a shared critical-object-selection core and arbitration of warning and braking requests.
  • Design and implement algorithms for critical object selection, threat assessment, and multi-stage intervention (warning, brake prefill, partial and full braking).
  • Develop lane departure warning logic that is robust to degraded , missing, and non-standard lane markings.
  • Develop cross-traffic alert logic for junction and turning scenarios.
  • Derive stakeholder, system, and software requirements with measurable acceptance criteria, and ensure full traceability to verification.
  • Define scenario catalogues for validation, covering NCAP protocols and India-specific traffic situations.
  • Validate functions in closed-loop simulation and through resimulation of recorded vehicle data.
  • Implement production-grade algorithms in C++ and support integration on target ECUs.
  • Scale functions across four-wheeler and two-wheeler variants from a common architecture.
  • Define and track KPIs: detection rate, false-activation rate, warning time, and speed reduction.
  • Contribute to safety analysis in line with ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF).
  • Author technical proposals and roadmaps for Front Safety functions.
  • Provide technical guidance, design reviews, and mentoring.

Required Qualifications

Experience or exposure to technical data analysis, scientific data workflows or complex datasets.

Strong mathematical, analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to interpret technical datasets and identify inconsistencies or anomalies.

Must be willing to travel across India, including monthly travel with the technical team, based on project requirements.

Preferred Experience & Technical Exposure Candidates with exposure to any of the following areas will be preferred:

SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) and radar systems.

RF systems and signal processing.

Imaging systems and sensor data processing.

job.name: DataOps Engineer
job.description:
Job Details We are seeking a hands-on DataOps Engineer who combines strong engineering skills, an automation-first mindset and a genuine sense of ownership for production data. You will be responsible for keeping the Group's data platform reliable, tested and performant, making sure that the pipelines feeding our reporting, analytics, data products and AI use cases run on time and deliver data the business can trust. Working closely with Data & AI team members and the wider Technology organisation, you will further develop the DevOps and software engineering practices behind our data workflows on Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Kubernetes. You will fix issues when they arise, but your real focus is preventing them: building the monitoring, testing, data contracts and CI/CD that catch problems before our stakeholders do.

Core Mandate: Make sure trusted data arrives on time, every time, and that issues are detected, understood and prevented before they reach the business.

Your Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Own the day-to-day reliability of the Group's data pipelines, ensuring ingestion, transformation and delivery jobs across Airflow, dbt and Snowflake run on time and to agreed service levels.
  • Shift the team from reactive firefighting to proactive operations by building monitoring, alerting, freshness checks and anomaly detection that surface issues before stakeholders are affected.
  • Investigate, resolve and document pipeline failures and data incidents, driving root-cause analysis and permanent fixes rather than one-off patches.
  • Design and maintain CI/CD for data, including automated testing, code review gates, environment promotion and safe, repeatable deployments of dbt models, Airflow DAGs and platform components.
  • Establish and enforce data contracts and schema validation with source system owners, so that upstream changes are detected and managed rather than silently breaking downstream models.
  • Implement and scale data quality controls, including dbt tests, validation rules and reconciliation checks across ingestion sources, cleaning and transformation layers.
