Description Do you want to be part of the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?

DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will contribute to three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces; and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents that provide actionable safety insights.

This is a rare opportunity to join a team building a platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy software components for a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems
  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed
  • Develop frontend components for a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
  • Implement compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well tested code following software engineering best practices
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence activities
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to integrate data pipelines and model outputs into production services
  • Contribute to automated evidence preservation mechanisms to address short video retention windows
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, participating in on call rotations to ensure system reliability

job.name: Product Engineer
job.description:
About Codvo

Codvo is operationalizing AI for the world’s most important industries.

We build production AI systems for healthcare organizations where accuracy, governance, privacy, security, and measurable clinical and operational outcomes matter. Powered by NeIO, our sovereign AI execution platform, we deliver trusted AI across cloud, private cloud, on-premises, edge, and air-gapped environments.

⸻

The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on engineering leader to build AI products that transform healthcare operations.

This is not a traditional engineering management or AI research role.

You’ll lead the full lifecycle—from customer problem discovery through architecture, engineering, production deployment, and productization—turning successful customer solutions into reusable NeIO capabilities.

⸻

What You’ll Do

Lead development of production AI products for healthcare and MedTech customers. Build AI-native systems using LLMs, agents, retrieval, multimodal AI, workflow orchestration, and enterprise integrations. Partner with healthcare providers, MedTech companies, and clinical operations teams to solve high-value challenges across clinical documentation, surgical workflows, revenue cycle, medical device intelligence, patient operations, and healthcare document workflows. Drive architecture, engineering quality, evaluation, governance, security, and operational reliability. Build and mentor high-performing AI engineering teams. Convert customer implementations into reusable NeIO platform capabilities and healthcare accelerators. Partner with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to define the Healthcare AI roadmap.

⸻

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year you will:

Launch multiple production AI solutions. Build reusable Healthcare AI capabilities within NeIO. Reduce implementation time through reusable engineering assets. Establish engineering standards for trusted production AI. Become a trusted technical advisor to strategic healthcare customers.

⸻

What We’re Looking For

15+ years building enterprise software products. 5+ years leading engineering teams. Experience delivering production AI systems—not prototypes. Strong architecture experience across cloud-native distributed systems. Experience applying LLMs, AI agents, retrieval, and enterprise integrations to real business problems. Customer-facing leadership and strong communication skills. Industry experience in one or more of: Healthcare Providers MedTech Life Sciences Digital Health Clinical Operations Revenue Cycle Management Medical Devices

⸻

Nice to Have

Experience with healthcare standards and technologies such as HL7, FHIR, DICOM, EHR/EMR integrations, HIPAA, clinical documentation, medical imaging, or medical device platforms.

Experience with Azure, AWS, Databricks, Kubernetes, OpenShift, NVIDIA AI, multimodal AI, enterprise integrations, and secure private AI deployments.

job.name: Azure Public Tier Developer
job.description:
What You Will Do:

  • Build the publish job. Normal changes go out once an hour. A revoke, a suspension, or a lapsed approval goes out within 5 minutes.
  • Copy only the fields the public is allowed to see. Stop the copy if an unknown field appears. Hide part of the first name before the row is saved. Never write back to Dataverse.
  • Design the Azure SQL tables and indexes for a last-name search and for browsing by course and country.
  • Build the API in API Management. The ABS website calls it with no key. Other companies get a free key that ABS can switch off.
  • Build these calls: verify a certificate, list courses, list providers for a course, and list providers.
  • Clean last names the same way on save and on search, then match them exactly. Return three different answers, and use the same failure text when the name is wrong or the number is unknown.
  • Build the public website for the check and the course-first directory, including a maintenance page and a switch that can hide the public data without a new release.
  • Work with security so names with apostrophes, hyphens, and accents are not blocked by the firewall.

Education & Experience:

  • 5 to 8 years of software development, with hands-on Azure and a JavaScript front end.
  • BE/BTech degree in a technical field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Certifications:

  • AZ-204, Azure Developer Associate.

Good to Have:

  • AZ-700, Azure Network Engineer.
  • AZ-500, Azure Security Engineer.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Must Have:

  • Azure Functions, including a private network path back only to the services this API is allowed to call.
  • Azure API Management (APIM): products, keys, quotas, policies, and OpenAPI.
  • REST API design. The public API must not return a list of people.
  • Azure SQL: table design, T-SQL, and indexes.
  • Azure Key Vault and managed identity. No secrets in config files.
  • Azure Virtual Network, private endpoints, and VNet peering.
  • A JavaScript front end on Azure Static Web Apps or Azure App Service.
  • Application integration between the public API and the read-only SQL database.
  • Azure Logic Apps where a publish or notification step is a workflow rather than code.

Good to Have:

  • Azure Front Door, WAF, and bot protection.
  • Rate limiting.
  • Unicode and international name handling, including accents and double-barrel surnames.
  • WCAG accessibility.
  • Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days

job.name: Power Platform Developer
job.description:
What You Will Do:

  • Build the Dataverse tables for company, training site, contact, learner, course, certificate, rate card, billing line, training provider, and file batch.
  • Set the rules so one person can have only one active certificate of the same type for the same course, and so sending the same certificate number again updates the record.
  • Set security roles, hide rate and price columns from people who should not see them, and turn on audit.
  • Build the model-driven app screens for certificate changes, failed file rows, monthly billing review, and upcoming renewals.
  • Build Power Automate flows for company and training-site renewal reminders, and for alerts to the service owner. These flows must not calculate a fee and must not check a provider file.
  • Build the Power BI reports for file intake, billing close, and day-to-day operations.
  • Package the work as managed solutions and move it through the project pipeline.

Education & Experience:

  • 4 to 7 years with Dataverse, model-driven Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
  • BE/BTech degree in a technical field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Certifications:

  • PL-400, Power Platform Developer Associate.

Good to Have:

  • PL-200, Power Platform Functional Consultant.
  • PL-600, Power Platform Solution Architect.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Must Have:

  • Microsoft Dataverse: tables, relationships, alternate keys, duplicate detection, and plug-ins or custom APIs.
  • Model-driven Power Apps: forms, views, business rules, and security-trimmed screens.
  • Power Automate cloud flows, including connectors and error handling.
  • Power BI reports on Dataverse data.
  • Dataverse security: security roles, teams, column security, business units, and auditing.
  • Power Platform ALM: solutions, environment variables, connection references, and pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
  • Dataverse Web API, including batch calls.
  • Integration from Power Platform to Azure: custom connectors, HTTP actions, and calling Azure Functions or an API.
  • Microsoft Entra ID sign-in for the internal app.

Good to Have:

  • Azure API Management, Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Key Vault, enough to connect a flow or a connector to them.
  • Azure Virtual Network concepts, enough to know when a connector must use a gateway or a private path.
  • Canvas apps and Power Pages.
  • Billing, rate card, or other finance screens.
  • Training, certification, or accreditation work.

Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days

job.description:
As a Vice President in Credit Risk Research at Citi, you will conduct high-impact analysis across wholesale and retail portfolios that directly shapes how the firm identifies, measures, and manages credit exposure. This individual contributor role gives you the platform to inform senior leadership, influence governance frameworks, and apply deep credit risk expertise to decisions with firm-wide consequences. If you can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insight, this position offers the scope and visibility to make a lasting impact.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct in-depth credit risk research across wholesale and retail portfolios, producing assessments that equip senior leadership with well-informed risk decisions.
  • Develop and refine credit risk measurement methodologies, keeping Citi's approach to credit risk rigorous and aligned with evolving market conditions.
  • Analyze credit portfolios to identify emerging risk concentrations, trends, and vulnerabilities, translating findings into clear risk mitigation recommendations.
  • Monitor counterparty and sector-level credit risk trends to maintain an accurate, current view of Citi's credit exposures.
  • Produce high-quality risk assessment reports and research outputs that communicate complex findings clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Present research conclusions to senior business and risk leaders, informing strategic credit risk decisions.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of credit risk governance frameworks, embedding research outputs into risk oversight processes.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Hold a bachelor's degree in economics, finance, statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Bring 8+ years of experience in financial services and analytics, with deep expertise in wholesale or retail credit risk research or a closely related discipline.
  • Apply strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills to develop and enhance credit risk measurement methodologies.
  • Interpret complex credit data to identify material risk themes and draw well-reasoned conclusions.
  • Communicate nuanced credit risk findings clearly and confidently to senior and executive-level audiences, in writing and in person.
  • Maintain familiarity with credit risk governance frameworks and the regulatory environment governing credit risk management in banking.
  • Manage multiple research workstreams simultaneously, delivering rigorous, high-quality outputs within defined timelines.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

  • Hold an advanced degree, such as a Master's, in economics, finance, statistics, or a related quantitative field.

What We Offer

At Citi, Credit Risk Research Vice Presidents work at the center of one of the world's most significant financial institutions, with direct access to complex, high-stakes analysis and the leadership teams who act on it.

job.description:
Job Description The Marine Environmental Modeler will support marine and coastal projects through numerical modelling of sediment transport, hydrodynamics, water quality and environmental impacts associated with infrastructure, dredging, ports, offshore energy and coastal developments.

The role will work closely with WSP Italia and international marine specialists delivering feasibility studies, environmental impact assessments, permitting studies and detailed engineering support.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute numerical models for:

+ Sediment transport
+ Coastal morphology processes
+ Wave processes and coastal dynamics
+ Hydrodynamics
+ Water quality assessments

  • Analyse marine and environmental datasets.
  • Support Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA).
  • Prepare technical reports, calculations and modelling documentation.
  • Interpret field monitoring data and calibration datasets.
  • Support feasibility studies and concept design phases.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including:

+ Marine Engineers
+ Coastal Engineers
+ Environmental Consultants
+ GIS Specialists

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in environmental engineering, coastal engineering, ocean engineering, marine sciences, hydraulics or related disciplines

Experience

  • 3 to 8 years of relevant professional experience in hydrodynamics, water quality, , coastal or sediment transport modelling.

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of marine hydrodynamics, wave processes, sediment transport, coastal morphology and environmental impact assessment.
  • Experience with numerical modelling software such as Delft3D, MIKE 21 & MIKE 3.
  • Knowledge of coastal, estuarine and offshore modelling methodologies.
  • Experience in numerical model setup, calibration, validation and interpretation of results.
  • Proficiency in GIS tools, including ArcGIS and QGIS.
  • Ability to process and interpret bathymetric, metocean, ADCP-derived current, water quality and sediment sampling datasets.
  • Familiarity with environmental permitting processes and Environmental Impact Assessments.
  • Familiarity with wave climate analysis and interpretation of wave modelling outputs for marine and coastal engineering applications.
  • Ability to prepare clear technical reports, modelling documentation and effective data visualizations.
  • Exposure to wave modelling concepts and coastal process assessments would be considered an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

job.description:
We have an exciting opportunity to join our Asset Valuations and Data Management (AVDM) within Macquarie Asset Management. Our team maintains the quality, accuracy, and integrity of valuation and reference data across our investment operations. We play a critical role in ensuring reliable data management processes that support informed decision-making and effective funds management.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

What role will you play? In this role, you will be involved in preparing time-critical custody cash, stock position, futures, forwards, and swap reconciliations, which include both manual and automated processes. Additionally, you will be responsible for conducting timely research and clearance of reconciliation discrepancies. You will be preparing daily control reports, monitoring reconciliation discrepancies, ensuring regular follow-ups and escalations, and clearing Nostro items. You will also work for AVDM team and actively contribute to the development of the internal control environment and the efficiency of our asset management business while growing your career in an empowering and inclusive culture

What You Offer

  • Tertiary qualifications in a business-related discipline. Post-qualification experience ranging 4-7 years within a financial institution, preferably in an asset reconciliation team at a global custodian or an asset manager.
  • Process knowledge of equities, fixed income, FX, derivatives, and OTC products including IRS, CDS, Cross-Currency swaps, Options and Swaptions with exposure to reconciliation and investment platforms such as Aladdin, TLM, Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, Eagle, CTM, and related systems.
  • Experience in security master/static data maintenance, portfolio setup, valuation validation, reconciliation processes, and data quality controls across multiple asset classes.
  • Strong Microsoft Office proficiency with advanced Excel skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues, solve problems, and identify process improvement opportunities.
  • Strong documentation, communication, and collaboration skills, with flexibility to support global teams and work across different time zones.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

job.name: AI Business Partner (Co-Creation) | Senior Associate
job.description:
About Interpath Interpath is an independent financial advisory business with a broad range of specialisms, operating in an agile, independent and conflict-free setting. We offer a full spectrum of restructuring services, from business performance improvement and value creation through to stress, distress and insolvency. Our advisory practice also includes corporate finance, transaction services, valuations, debt advisory, tax, pensions, forensic accounting and e-discovery. We help clients create, defend, preserve, sustain and grow value through the cycle, working with businesses and their stakeholders across the market, from regional SMEs to large, complex multinational organisations.

About The AI CoE Interpath's AI Centre of Excellence designs and builds AI solutions with practices across the firm, taking high-impact use cases from idea to production. The India team is small and hands-on: five people — an AI CoE Lead, two AI Engineers, a Data & Platform Engineer and an AI Business Partner — working as one squad with the Head of AI and practice teams across the firm.

About The Role You will spend most of your time with the practices, not in the CoE. Your job is to understand what people actually need: how work really gets done, where the hours and frustration go, and which problems are worth solving with AI. You turn that understanding into clear use-case briefs the build team can act on, and you lead co-creation with the practices: shaping use cases with fee earners and keeping them involved through build and launch, so what we deliver is theirs as much as ours.

Requirements *Key responsibilities: *Understanding the business**

  • Build working relationships with partners, directors and fee earners across deals, restructuring and other practices
  • Spend time inside teams: shadow engagements, sit in on workflows and learn where the time goes
  • Map how work actually gets done, including volumes, time spent, hand-offs and workarounds, not just the official process

Finding and shaping opportunities

  • Run discovery sessions and workshops to surface needs and pain points
  • Turn needs into clear problem statements and use-case briefs: who it's for, what good looks like, what data exists and the rough value
  • Help the CoE Lead prioritise with honest assessments of value, readiness and business appetite
  • Keep an opportunity pipeline per practice, so the build team always knows what's coming

Bridging to the build team

  • Be the voice of the user during build; bring business experts in to review prototypes and give feedback early and often
  • Work with those experts to agree real examples and what a correct answer looks like, so engineers know what they're aiming for
  • Translate the context engineers can't get themselves: terminology, regulatory constraints and the reasons behind each step

The successful candidate will serve as the scientific and technical expert supporting SPT Labtech's laboratory automation, liquid handling and sample management portfolio across India. Working closely with Sales, Marketing and customers, this role includes application development, workflow optimization, demonstrations, installations, user training and scientific collaborations across genomics, molecular biology, drug discovery and related life science applications.

About us: Based in Cambridge, UK SPT Labtech makes products that transform the way scientists work. job.name: Senior iOS SDK Engineer, Objective-C
job.description:
Who We Are Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Who You Are You are an iOS SDK engineer who builds code that runs inside other companies’ apps, not someone who mainly builds apps or integrates third-party SDKs. You’ll work on Verve’s HyBid iOS SDK, where the code has to stay lightweight, backward-compatible, and safe in host apps we don’t control. The SDK combines legacy Objective-C with modern Swift, so you’ll work in both every day. The focus is stability, Objective-C/Swift interoperability, framework packaging, and memory and thread safety.

What You Will Do

  • Develop, maintain, and improve core modules of Verve’s iOS HyBid SDK, with a focus on stability, performance, memory safety, thread safety, and backward compatibility.
  • Work hands-on with Objective-C and Swift across networking, ad rendering, mediation, tracking, and SDK integration flows.
  • Build, validate, and maintain SDK packaging and distribution through SPM, CocoaPods, .framework, and .xcframework, and lead the CocoaPods to SPM migration.

  • Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC.
  • Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies.
  • TMS & Localization Tool

job.name: Staff Software Engineer - AI
job.description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About Element34

For years, Element34 has run large-scale test execution for enterprises that can't send their testing to a public cloud. Banks, insurers, healthcare companies and other regulated organizations use our platform, SBOX, to run thousands of Selenium, Playwright and Appium sessions in parallel on their own infrastructure.

Now we're building an AI-native platform for the whole end-to-end test lifecycle: authoring, execution, failure analysis, triage and self-healing maintenance, with LLMs and agents at the core of each stage rather than added on afterward.

We're a small, senior engineering team and we plan to stay that way. We have no layers of management, no handoffs between teams and no separate infra group. Each engineer owns a problem from design through production.

The Role

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role with no direct reports. Your influence comes from the systems you design, the code you write and how you raise the engineering bar for the people around you.

About 90% of your time will be backend work in Java or Go: distributed systems, concurrency, data pipelines, AI and agent infrastructure, and performance work. The other 10% is frontend work in React.

This is not CRUD or API plumbing. You'll work on orchestration, scheduling, high-throughput ingestion, retrieval quality, agent reliability and performance problems that don't have a ready-made answer.

What You'll Do

job.name: Senior Full Stack Data Platform Engineer
job.description:
Founded in 1989, Millennium is a global alternative investment management firm. Millennium seeks to pursue a diverse array of investment strategies across industry sectors, asset classes and geographies. The firm’s primary investment areas are Fundamental Equity, Equity Arbitrage, Fixed Income, Commodities and Quantitative Strategies. We solve hard and interesting problems at the intersection of computer science, finance, and mathematics. We are focused on innovating and rapidly applying innovations to real world scenarios. This enables engineers to work on interesting problems, learn quickly and have deep impact to the firm and the business.

At Millennium, we are redefining how investment decisions are made. We don't just look at balance sheets; we harness the chaos of the real world. By analyzing vast amounts of unstructured data—from news briefings and earnings call audio to regulatory documents—we provide our Portfolio Managers (PMs) with the "informational edge" (Alpha) they need to outperform the market.

The Role We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with deep expertise in building high-throughput data platforms.

In this role, you will architect scalable data platforms using Python, Java, C++, build robust APIs, and enable processing of data using genAI techniques. You will build and optimize a config-driven, plugin-enabled data platform that will allow the construction of DAGs for data processing. You will then apply the platform to build reusable components and pipelines that will ingest gigabytes of unstructured text, audio, and video. You will enable a variety of rich data consumption use-cases by building the right abstractions and APIs for data consumers.

You will be the bridge between complex ML research and real-time trading decisions, working in a poly-language environment (Python, Java, C++) where performance is paramount.

Key Responsibilities

  • High-Performance Data Pipelines: Architect low-latency, high-throughput platform that enables rapid development of pipelines to ingest and normalize unstructured data (PDFs, news feeds, audio streams).
  • AI & ML Integration: Build the infrastructure that wraps and serves NLP and ML models. You will ensure that model inference happens in real-time within the data stream.
  • Backend Microservices: Develop robust backend services to handle metadata management, search, and retrieval of processed alternative data.
  • System Optimization: Tune the platform for speed. In financial markets, milliseconds matter; you will optimize database queries, serialization, and network calls to ensure data reaches the PMs instantly.
  • Data Strategy: Implement storage strategies for unstructured data, utilizing Vector Databases for semantic search and Distributed File Systems for raw storage.

job.name: Staff Engineer, BSS Solution Design
job.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo. Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Engineer – BSS Solution Design to lead the design and architecture of Business Support System (BSS) solutions that underpin Skylo’s commercial NTN services. You will translate complex business and product requirements into scalable, integration-ready BSS architectures — spanning product catalogue, order management, charging, mediation, partner management, and revenue assurance — working closely with MNO partners, internal engineering teams, and commercial stakeholders.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of telecom domain expertise, solution architecture, and Skylo’s mission to bring satellite connectivity to every device on earth. The role is based in Bangalore and requires being onsite at least three days a week.

Key Responsibilities BSS Solution Design & Architecture

  • Own end-to-end BSS solution design for new NTN products, services, and partner integrations — from requirements through high-level and detailed design.
  • Define solution blueprints spanning product catalogue, order management, mediation, rating, charging (OCS/OFCS), invoicing, CRM, and partner/wholesale settlement.
  • Evaluate and select BSS platforms (Amdocs, Ericsson, Nokia, Comviva, Oracle BRM, or equivalent) for fitness against Skylo’s NTN use cases.
  • Apply TM Forum frameworks (eTOM, SID, TAM, Open APIs) to ensure interoperability and standards compliance.
  • Design for scalability, high availability, and high transaction volumes typical of satellite IoT and consumer NTN services.

System Integration & API Design

job.name: Software Development Engineer, Tax Engine Services
job.description:
Description You'll work on one of the world's largest transactional distributed systems, solving complex tax calculation challenges that impact millions of customers globally. Join a team building mission-critical services that process millions of requests per minute while maintaining accuracy and compliance across constantly evolving global tax regulations.

Imagine building systems that power tax calculations for every Amazon transaction worldwide—from physical goods to digital services. In this role, you'll tackle the intricate challenge of computing correct tax amounts thousands of times per second while ensuring audit compliance across dozens of countries. You'll collaborate with peers across Amazon's business to design and operate highly scalable, reliable systems that handle hundreds of millions of records. Whether you're drawn to solving complex distributed systems problems or using technology to address real business challenges, this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a platform that touches billions of transactions annually.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable software solutions that calculate taxes accurately and efficiently across Amazon's global operations, handling millions of service requests per minute
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet tax compliance standards worldwide
  • Develop, test, and deploy high-quality distributed system software using software engineering best practices and modern development methodologies
  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, documentation, testing, and operational support of production systems
  • Contribute to system reliability and performance by monitoring production metrics, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing improvements to ensure our services meet demanding scale and accuracy requirements

A day in the life

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll engage with the full software development lifecycle—from initial design conversations through deployment and operations. You might start your day reviewing a proposal to optimize tax calculation performance, then move into code review with teammates, discussing architectural approaches to handle increased transaction volume. You'll write and test code in our Java, Linux, and Oracle-based environment, collaborate with engineers across different Amazon business units to understand their tax requirements, and participate in on-call rotations to ensure our services remain reliable. Your work directly influences how quickly and accurately customers receive tax information at checkout, and you'll see the real-world impact of your contributions through our monitoring and metrics.

Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

  • Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
  • 9 Company-Paid Holidays
  • Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • Fitness membership reimbursement
  • Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr Vultr is seeking a Data Center Operations Engineer to serve as the initial on-site operational owner for the newly launched Chennai data center location. This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the operational readiness of new data centers, acting as Vultr’s technical and operational representative during the ramp-up phase before permanent staffing and management are established.

This position focuses on operational analysis, deployment planning, coordination, and decision-making required to bring a new facility online. The role operates with significant autonomy and exercises independent judgment in determining how approved standards, deployment plans, and operational policies are applied in real-world conditions. This is a highly visible role that directly impacts infrastructure readiness, service reliability, and Vultr’s ability to scale into new markets.

job.name: Program Manager
job.description:
Job Title: Program Manager(Insurance Domain)

Experience: 15+ years

Location: Chennai,Bangalore,Mumbai,Pune

  • We are looking for an experienced Application Service Delivery Manager to oversee the delivery, performance, and operational management of enterprise insurance applications running on Microsoft Azure. The role involves managing application support functions, ensuring service quality, maintaining business continuity, and driving continuous operational improvements.
  • The ideal candidate should have strong experience in IT service delivery, application support management, Azure cloud operations, and ITIL-based service management practices.
  • Key Responsibilities
  • 1. Application Service Delivery & Management
  • Manage end-to-end application support, maintenance, and service delivery for enterprise applications.
  • Ensure compliance with defined SLAs, SLOs, operational KPIs, and business requirements.
  • Oversee application operations across insurance domains, including Policy Administration, Claims Management, Billing, Underwriting, CRM, and Customer Portals.
  • Conduct periodic service performance reviews and provide operational reports to senior management.
  • Ensure round-the-clock support coverage for business-critical applications.

2. Microsoft Azure Cloud Operations

  • Oversee the operational performance and availability of applications deployed on Microsoft Azure.
  • Track application health, infrastructure performance, and system availability using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Dynatrace, and Splunk.
  • Identify opportunities for cloud resource optimization and cost management.
  • Ensure implementation of cloud security, backup, disaster recovery, and business resiliency practices.
  • Coordinate with cloud infrastructure and engineering teams for platform enhancements and modernization initiatives.

3. Incident & Problem Management

  • Lead incident, problem, and major incident management processes.
  • Ensure timely resolution of production issues and minimize business impact.
  • Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Manage critical escalations and coordinate with technical teams to restore services within agreed timelines.
  • Identify recurring incidents and drive continuous service improvement initiatives.

4. Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish effective operational governance and service management processes.
  • Monitor service performance through defined metrics and operational dashboards.
  • Drive process standardization, service quality improvements, and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory, security, and compliance requirements.

job.description:
Description We are seeking a Splunk Consultant to manage, maintain, and optimize a high-volume enterprise Splunk environment. Embedded within a modern cloud and DevOps ecosystem, you will support large-scale telemetry ingestion while pairing platform administration with automated scripting to ensure peak reliability. Joining a collaborative team focused on continuous performance tuning, you will help cross-functional partners translate complex system data into actionable insights, driving observability, log analytics, and application performance monitoring across both operational and business domains. Eager to know more? If you are proactive, bring new ideas and suggestions, don’t waste any second and apply!

Requirements Job title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Core Compute Infrastructure Job Description Preferred qualifications & skills:

Education & experience: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, plus heavy experience in Linux systems engineering and DevOps.

OS & Automation: Mastery of Linux administration (Debian family), SaltStack configuration management, and Bash/Python scripting.

Infrastructure Knowledge: Deep understanding of systemd services, process supervision, network configurations, and system logging.

Build & Deploy: Experience managing continuous integration workflows and automated service rollouts.

Nice to have skills:

Experience with Prometheus exporters and system monitoring frameworks.

Job responsibilities

Jo.

Configure, automate, and maintain runtime environment states for orchestrator services on ARM compute hosts using SaltStack.

Troubleshoot systemd unit dependencies, deployment failures, and OS-level service degradation on new ARM hardware.

Validate infrastructure health, service metrics, and automated deployment pipelines for core compute services.

Partner with software engineering teams to resolve operational bottlenecks during ARM migration rollouts.

What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

job.description:

If you're someone who loves solving problems, is eager to learn, and wants to build a solid career in systems and infrastructure - this is a great place to start. This role will be instrumental in maintaining and enhancing our server, workstation, and cloud environments while ensuring reliability, security, and compliance across our systems.

job.name: Technical Director, Data Networks
job.description:
Maximize Your Impact with TP Welcome to TP, a global hub of innovation and empowerment, where we redefine the future. With a remarkable €10 billion annual revenue and a global team of 500,000 employees serving 170 countries in over 300 languages, we lead in intelligent, digital-first solutions.

As a Great Place to Work certified in 72 countries, our culture thrives on diversity, equity, and inclusion. We value your unique perspective and believe that your talent is the missing piece that completes our vision for a brighter, digitally driven tomorrow.

The Opportunity In this role, you will be responsible for leading an enterprise IT team of and ensure high availability, scalability, and robust security across complex LAN, WAN, Data Center, Wireless, SD-WAN, and Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) environments. The Director will drive network modernization, support digital transformation initiatives, oversee multi-OEM environments, and align technical strategy with core business objectives, offshore delivery centers (ODCs), and enterprise customer requirements.

The Responsibilities

  • Formulate and implement the long-term strategic roadmap for global network operations, aligning network architecture with business goals.
  • Drive infrastructure transformation initiatives, modernizing legacy systems to support hybrid cloud, SD-WAN, and automated NaaS frameworks.
  • Serve as a key advisor to senior leadership, providing regular updates on network performance, risks, capital projects, and operational metrics.
  • Oversee the end-to-end design, deployment, optimization, and maintenance of enterprise network infrastructure (Routing & Switching, LAN/WAN, Data Centers, Wireless, Load Balancing, and VPNs).
  • Establish and monitor stringent Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to guarantee network reliability, performance, and proactive issue mitigation.
  • Enforce robust Incident, Problem, and Change Management frameworks to ensure rapid SLA resolution and minimal business disruption.
  • Direct and support ongoing, large-scale network deployment and upgrade projects.
  • Lead, mentor, and scale an enterprise network operations organization of ~50 engineers and managers across internal IT and GCC (Global Capability Center) / ODC environments.
  • Cultivate a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture through clear goal-setting, continuous training, performance reviews, and succession planning.
  • Develop and manage the global network operational (OpEx) and capital (CapEx) budgets, driving resource efficiency and strategic cost optimization.
  • Oversee vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and SLA performance across multiple network OEMs, equipment providers, and telecom carriers.
  • Manage enterprise customer expectations and customer-facing networks, particularly within Service-Based, ODC, or multi-tenant customer environments.
  • Partner closely with Information Security leadership to define and enforce network security policies, zero-trust

job.description:
Job description:

Job Description

Do RESPONSIBILITIES Acting as a SPOC for the Customer to provide the status update whenever a major incident occurs
Driving the MI Bridge through involving all relevant Resolver Groups and continue the discussions till the Major incident is resolved

Good leadership, people management and operational skills

Ability to motivate staff
Excellent team skills with ability to listen and contribute to discussions and meetings

job.description:
*DESCRIPTION* AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. Key job responsibilities

  • Management and leadership of DCEO Engineering Team. Executes vision and goals for the team or department.
  • Responsible for the overall operation and maintenance (both routine and emergency) of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations of Data Centers. Has primary responsibility for availability zone of Data Centers.
  • Managing and developing teams of shift engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance. Is active in the training and/or development of others.
  • Liaising with internal teams & management groups. Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency
  • Participates in strategic planning projects. Helping in design, build and bring online new Data Centers. Negotiates and rolls out contracts and space.

Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes.

job.name: Web Administrator
job.description:
Job Designation: Web Administrator

Job Summary:

The Web Administrator will be responsible for the administration, hosting, security, performance tuning, and overall upkeep of the University's websites and web-based systems. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in domain name system (DNS) management, web server and hosting infrastructure (Windows/Linux, Apache/Nginx/IIS), web application security, and website performance/response-time optimization, along with working knowledge of Content Management Systems and databases. The incumbent will independently administer web systems and servers, manage DNS and hosting environments, harden and monitor systems for security, tune sites for optimal response time, troubleshoot technical issues, coordinate with vendors and hosting providers, and ensure high availability and uptime of all University web properties. This is a Web administration role, not a web development or coding role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, maintain, and manage multiple University websites and web-based systems independently, including uptime, availability, and day-to-day operations.
  • Manage DNS for all University domains and subdomains, including zone files, A/CNAME/MX/TXT records, TTL settings, domain renewals, and troubleshooting DNS propagation and resolution issues.
  • Evaluate, set up, and manage web hosting environments (on-premise, shared, VPS, dedicated, and cloud hosting), including server provisioning, SSL/TLS certificate installation and renewal, and coordination with hosting/ISP vendors on capacity, uptime SLAs, and migrations.
  • Implement and maintain web application and server security: web application firewalls (WAF), SSL/TLS configuration, vulnerability scanning, patch management, malware monitoring, and DDoS mitigation.
  • Monitor and tune website response time and server performance using caching, content delivery networks (CDN), load balancing, compression, and server/database tuning; conduct load/stress testing and capacity planning.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve website and application-related issues.
  • Administer and configure Content Management Systems (CMS) such as WordPress, Joomla, or Drupal — installation, updates, plugin/theme management, and user access — without requiring custom application development.
  • Administer databases such as MySQL and MS SQL Server (MSSQL) that support University websites, including maintenance, backups, and troubleshooting (no application/database development required).
  • Install, configure, and administer web/application server software (IIS, Apache, Nginx) supporting University web hosting.
  • Define and enforce web system access controls, user/role permissions, and security monitoring policies; conduct periodic security audits and compliance checks in line with University IT policy.
  • Perform regular backups and ensure availability and integrity of website and application data.
  • Maintain technical documentation, system configurations,

job.name: Full Stack Developer (C# / .NET / Angular / Azure)
job.description:
About Ace Rooms Ltd

Ace Rooms Ltd is a UK-based B2B travel technology company with over 16 years of experience in global hotel and transfer distribution. Our platform enables travel agents and API partners to search live inventory, book hotels and transfers, and manage payments. We are currently undergoing a full greenfield platform rebuild on Microsoft Azure, migrating from a legacy monolith to a modern, service-based architecture.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our core in-house engineering team in Kolkata and contribute to the ground-up rebuild of our hotel-distribution platform. Working across both the .NET back end and Angular front end on Microsoft Azure, you will build end-to-end features, RESTful APIs, and responsive user interfaces while collaborating closely with our backend, frontend, and QA engineers to ensure shared technical ownership across the stack.

Key Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features using C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core) on the back end and Angular (TypeScript) on the front end.

· Build, consume, and version RESTful APIs connecting our Angular single-page application (SPA) and third-party travel partner integrations.

· Develop responsive, high-performance UI components in Angular for hotel/transfer search, live pricing, and booking workflows.

· Implement and manage Azure SQL database schemas; write efficient, optimised T-SQL and Entity Framework Core queries.

· Work with Redis caching, Azure Service Bus, and Azure API Management (APIM) to support high-speed availability searches and asynchronous booking events.

· Implement server-side payment validation, booking lifecycle management, and idempotency controls.

· Manage application secrets via Azure Key Vault and follow strict secure-coding standards (parameterised queries, input validation, and OWASP best practices).

· Maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, participate in peer Pull Request (PR) code reviews across both front end and back end, and maintain clear technical documentation.

Essential Skills & Experience

· Back End: Solid commercial experience building back-end services with C#, .NET (ASP.NET Core), and Entity Framework Core.

· Front End: Strong commercial experience building modern, responsive web applications with Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS).

· Databases: Azure SQL / SQL Server schema design and T-SQL query optimisation.

· Microsoft Azure: Hands-on experience with Azure App Service, Redis Cache, Service Bus, Key Vault, and APIM.

· APIs & Data Exchange: Designing RESTful APIs and handling high-volume JSON/XML payloads for supplier and partner integrations.

· CI/CD & Git: Experience with GitHub Actions pipelines, feature-branch workflows, and Pull Request code reviews.

· Security & Quality: Awareness of secure coding standards, secrets management, and unit/integration testing.

Position Overview We are seeking a highly accomplished, hands-on Senior Lead Operations Manager to join our enterprise technology leadership team. This pivotal role blends deep technical execution with strategic leadership across four core disciplines: JD Edwards EnterpriseOne (JDE E1), IBM Integration technologies, Cloud Architecture, and emerging Artificial Intelligence practices.

The ideal candidate is not a bystander manager — they roll up their sleeves, architect solutions, and directly contribute to development, configuration, and administration while simultaneously guiding a team of engineers and analysts. You thrive in fast-paced environments, absorb new technologies at exceptional speed, and champion a culture of continuous innovation.

Key Responsibilities Operational Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a cross-functional team of developers, CNC administrators, integration engineers, and cloud architects.
  • Define operational KPIs, SLAs, and delivery roadmaps for all enterprise platform areas.
  • Drive Agile/DevOps delivery practices including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Act as escalation point for critical incidents and ensure timely resolution with root-cause analysis.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, functional analysts, and C-suite to translate business needs into technology solutions.

JD Edwards EnterpriseOne — Development, Architecture & CNC Administration

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership across the complete JDE E1 stack spanning custom development, functional configuration, CNC infrastructure, and Oracle database administration.
  • Architect and develop JDE customizations using Business Functions (BSFNs), Named Event Rules (NERs), Report Design Aid (RDA), Form Design Aid (FDA), Table Design Aid (TDA), and Data Dictionary extensions.
  • Design and deploy JDE Orchestrator Framework solutions — building orchestrations, connectors, cross-reference rules, and form requests to automate business workflows and expose JDE services as REST APIs.
  • Lead User Defined Object (UDO) governance: Composite Pages, Watchlists, Notifications, One View Reports, and EnterpriseOne Pages configuration and lifecycle management.
  • Architect and implement JDE integrations via Business Function calls, Interoperability (XML/Z-files), RESTful and SOAP web services, and third-party middleware adapters.
  • Own and lead end-to-end JDE EnterpriseOne upgrade projects — from current-release assessment and gap analysis through to production cutover — including major application releases (e.g., 9.0 to 9.2) and incremental Application Service Packs (ASPs).
  • Plan and execute JDE Tools Release upgrades (e.g., TR 9.2.x.x series): download and stage ESU/ASU bundles from Oracle Update Center, run the Tools Release installer on Enterprise and HTML Web Servers, validate planner and spec merge, and post-upgrade regression test all critical business objects.

job.name: Engineering Software Developer (VB6 / .NET)
job.description:
Description We are seeking a Software Developer to support and modernize a business-critical thermal engineering application built in Visual Basic 6 (VB6). In the near term, this role will maintain and enhance the existing VB6 application and support the engineers who rely on it. Over the longer term, the developer will play a key role in planning and carrying out the migration of the application to a modern .NET platform, preserving the accuracy of its engineering calculations throughout. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with both VB6 and .NET (C# preferred), and a track record of building or maintaining software that performs heavy engineering or scientific calculations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience maintaining and enhancing production VB6 applications, including COM/ActiveX components, OCX controls, and ADO/DAO data access.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in C# with .NET Framework and/or .NET Core
  • Experience developing or maintaining software that performs heavy engineering, scientific, or numerical calculations (e.g., iterative solvers, numerical methods, property correlations, unit conversions).
  • Solid understanding of floating-point precision and numerical accuracy, and experience validating calculation results against known reference cases.
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented programming and software design patterns.
  • Experience developing Windows desktop applications using VB6 and .NET.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, including in large legacy codebases with limited documentation.
  • Familiarity with source control systems such as Git or Azure DevOps.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating or modernizing VB6 applications to .NET, including incremental migration strategies, COM interop, and running legacy and new components side by side.
  • Familiarity with thermal and fluid engineering concepts such as heat transfer, thermodynamics, fluid flow, combustion, or steam/water properties (e.g., IAPWS-IF97).
  • Experience in power generation, boilers, heat exchangers, or similar industrial equipment domains.
  • Exposure to Fortran or other legacy scientific code.

job.name: C++ Low-Latency Developers | Leading Commodities Exchange
job.description:
Hiring: C++ Low-Latency Developers | Leading Commodities Exchange | Mumbai (Andheri)

We're partnering with India's largest commodity derivatives exchange to hire hands-on C++ engineers who love building microsecond-sensitive systems. This is a mix of new platform development and enhancement of existing systems , with real ownership and real scale.

Open roles

  • Senior Executive: 3-6 yrs
  • Assistant Manager: 6-8 yrs
  • Manager: 8-10 yrs (6+ yrs hands-on, 2+ yrs as a team lead)

What you'll work on

  • Writing and optimizing Modern C++ (C++17/20) for trading platform components: market connectivity, risk engines, order routing
  • Building zero-allocation hot paths using memory pools, arena allocation, ring buffers and placement new
  • Designing IPC frameworks using shared memory, lock-free queues and ring buffers
  • Developing deterministic multi-threaded systems with atomics, thread affinity and cache-aware design
  • Implementing exchange protocols (FIX, ITCH, OUCH, SBE) and order lifecycle logic
  • Profiling and benchmarking with perf, Valgrind and Google Benchmark
  • Code reviews and mentoring (Manager level: leading a pod of 3-4 developers)

What we're looking for

  • Strong C++ and STL, with deep command of pointers, RAII and manual memory management
  • Hands-on multithreading and concurrency (lock-free programming, avoiding races and deadlocks)
  • Solid understanding of low-latency / real-time design: CPU cache hierarchy, mmap, branch prediction, kernel-bypass networking concepts
  • Strong data structures and algorithms; MySQL schema and indexing skills
  • Template metaprogramming exposure is a plus
  • Bachelor's in CS, IT, Engineering or a quantitative discipline

Good to have

  • Background in trading, banking, investment banking, fintech or market data systems (not mandatory, but a strong plus)

Please note

  • Hands-on coding role, not a pure management position
  • Location: Andheri, Mumbai, 5 days work from office
  • Candidates must be willing to relocate to Mumbai
  • Candidates with experience only in international exchange environments and limited hands-on coding are not a fit for this role

job.name: Solutions Architect , AGS India Public Sector
job.description:
Description AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).

As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

job.name: Application Development Lead (Java) - Senior Vice President
job.description:
Job Specification: We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team — the engine room of Citi's enterprise-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1.5 billion risk calculations every day.

As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core — providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale.

Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability.

You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform.

Responsibilities Take a lead in defining the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines.

Take on the day-to-day leadership of the development team: Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards.

Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work: Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning.

Summary We are seeking a Senior Ansible Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team and serve as the subject matter expert for enterprise Ansible automation. The role involves designing scalable automation frameworks, establishing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards, mentoring engineers, and reducing manual operational effort across large-scale, multi-environment infrastructure.

Roles & Responsibilities

Automation Architecture & Development

Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade Ansible playbooks, roles, collections, and inventories across development, staging, and production environments.

Build reusable, modular Ansible roles following Galaxy standards and organizational best practices.

Develop and maintain Ansible Collections for internal distribution.

Create custom Ansible modules and plugins in Python, including action, callback, connection, and lookup plugins.

Implement reliable, idempotent, and fault-tolerant automation for OS hardening, application deployment, configuration management, and cloud provisioning.

CI/CD & Automation Platform

Integrate Ansible with Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps pipelines.

Implement automated testing using Molecule, Testinfra, and pytest.

Administer Ansible Automation Platform (AAP)/AWX, including organizations, inventories, credentials, projects, templates, and workflows.

Follow GitOps practices and manage automation code using Git.

Define Ansible coding standards, ansible-lint rules, code-review practices, and development guidelines.

Infrastructure & Cloud Automation

Automate AWS, Microsoft Azure, and GCP environments using Ansible cloud modules and dynamic inventories.

Integrate Ansible with Terraform for hybrid IaC workflows covering provisioning and configuration management.

Automate infrastructure patching, compliance enforcement, configuration management, and drift remediation at scale.

Security & Compliance

Manage secrets using Ansible Vault and integrate with enterprise secret-management platforms.

Automate CIS Benchmark and STIG-based system hardening and compliance.

Review existing automation for security risks, including hardcoded credentials, insecure configurations, and unnecessary privilege escalation.

Required Technical Skills Strong hands-on experience with Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) or AWX administration.

Expert understanding of Ansible architecture, including control/managed nodes, static and dynamic inventories, facts, SSH, WinRM, and network CLI connections.

Advanced knowledge of playbook constructs including handlers, loops, conditionals, blocks, tags, delegation, error handling, failed\_when, rescue, and related features.

Advanced Jinja2 templating, filters, tests, custom filters, and complex data transformations.

Strong Python skills for scripting and custom Ansible module development.

job.name: Senior Backend Engineer
job.description:
About Stantech AI

Stantech AI builds enterprise-grade products engineered for complete customisation: adapting precisely to organisations, while remaining scalable and cost-efficient at any size. Atop this foundation, we embed agentic automation that streamlines operations and elevates overall efficiency. Our distinction lies in resolving what most systems treat as trade-offs: deep customisation without compromising scale, sophistication without excess cost.

The Role

The role of a backend engineer has evolved, and this position reflects that. We seek an engineer who thinks structurally — who resolves problems at the level of core design rather than patching symptoms. Increasingly, our products are powered by AI agents that operate against our backend through Claude APIs, making autonomous agents a first-class consumer of our systems alongside human users and other services. The design of our APIs and tool interfaces determines how reliably and efficiently those agents operate — well-scoped, minimal, self-describing interfaces allow an agent to use them correctly without reloading context on every call. We want an engineer who designs with this setup in mind.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand the system before changing it — establish what is actually happening and where a change belongs, rather than acting on the surface symptom.
  • Evaluate every change across the dimensions that matter: scalability, multi-tenancy, and concurrency — not merely whether it works in isolation.
  • Favour reuse and consistency — extend existing code and established patterns wherever possible rather than duplicating logic.
  • Build for the future — design so that new features can be added without rework, keeping the codebase extensible rather than accumulating one-off fixes.
  • Resolve problems at their structural root, with solutions that hold up under scale and load.
  • Design internal APIs and tool surfaces as clean, minimal, well-documented contracts that AI agents can consume efficiently, reducing tool sprawl and context overhead.
  • Own backend services end to end (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka/RabbitMQ, Docker, GitLab CI/CD), using AI tools including Claude across design, implementation, review, and debugging, while remaining fully accountable for what ships.

What We’re Looking For

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) — Voice AI | Gurgaon

CallKaro AI | Onsite, Gurgaon | Six-month internship with full-time conversion

What Is a Forward Deployed Engineer at CallKaro AI?

We build Voice AI agents that handle over 5 million calls a month across 20+ languages.

Getting that technology to work in a demo is one thing. Getting it to work inside a client’s actual business — with their workflows, edge cases, systems, and customers on the other end of the line — is a completely different problem.

That second problem is the one we need you for.

A Forward Deployed Engineer sits inside the client’s world. You learn how their business actually runs, shape our platform around it, and stay close enough to the deployment to catch a broken call flow before the client does.

The role is part consultant, part engineer, and part founder.

Your work directly influences whether a client renews, expands, and trusts us with more of their business.

This is not a pure software engineering role.

You will spend significant time with clients, understanding business workflows, debugging production deployments, analyzing call data, and translating real-world requirements into working AI systems. You need to enjoy both building technology and solving problems with people.

What You Will Do

\* Own client onboarding end to end, from the first discovery call to the day the agents go live.

\* Sit with clients to understand their processes, then translate them into AI-powered call flows that hold up in production.

\* Write and refine LLM prompts that shape agent personas, conversation logic, guardrails, and escalation paths — including for Hindi, Hinglish, and regional-language calls.

\* Debug live production issues in real time by tracing call logs, reading transcripts, identifying failure points, and getting to the root cause quickly.

\* Analyze call volumes, conversion rates, drop-off points, and other performance metrics, then turn those insights into actions the client can take.

\* Build lightweight Python scripts and automations that connect our platform with client CRMs, APIs, and other systems.

\* Work closely with our product and engineering teams to communicate what clients actually need and advocate for features and fixes that can meaningfully improve their outcomes.

\* Document what you learn from each deployment so that the next implementation starts further ahead than the last one.

\* Be comfortable jumping between client conversations, debugging, data analysis, prompt engineering, and building depending on what the problem requires.

What We Look For

Must-Have

\* You know enough Python to build integrations, write scripts, work with APIs, and debug API calls.

\* You have a working understanding of LLMs and prompt engineering, and can write prompts that produce reliable behavior rather than just impressive demos.

job.name: Presales Solutions Architect
job.description:
Location : Remote (Must be flexible to travel to Pune whenever required)

Experience: 7–12 Years

We are looking for a Solutions Architect who is the technical lead in our customer

conversations: designing how AiStrike fits a given environment, running evaluations and

proof-of-value engagements, and making customer teams genuinely capable at operating an

AI SOC.

You will work directly with detection engineers, threat hunters, SOC leads and CISOs. Expect

deep technical discussions on telemetry design, analytic strategy, MITRE coverage and

prioritisation logic, and expect to be the person who turns "here is our environment and

here is what we need to prioritize" into a working architecture. This is a hands-on individual

contributor role.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery: map available telemetry, retention, existing detection coverage and blind spots across a customer's estate.
  • Design the analytic approach for each environment — which signals matter, what runs as a real-time detection, and what runs as a hypothesis-driven hunt.
  • Own technical evaluations and POVs end to end: agree success criteria, build the environment, run the scenarios, present the results.
  • Run detection coverage and telemetry-gap analysis mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and turn customer scenarios and post-incident retrospectives into concrete detection and hunt strategy.
  • Configure the environment-specific context that makes analytics precise: privileged and VIP accounts, critical assets, approved regions and service principals, sanctioned tooling.
  • Build SOAR and automation integrations that connect AiStrike findings to the customer's response tooling, and support onboarding across connectors, data paths, authentication and multi-tenant design.
  • Run workshops and technical deep dives, and maintain the demo environments, reference architectures and scenario walkthroughs behind them.
  • Bring field evidence back to Product and Engineering to shape detection content and roadmap priorities.

Requirements
