job.name: Expert Software Engineer- Workday HCM
job.description:
Veradigm is seeking a highly experienced Workday HCM Functional Consultant to join our Applications Management IT team. This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership across the Workday HCM platform — spanning day-to-day administration, system enhancements, release management, and end-user support.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on Workday expertise, a consultative mindset, and the business acumen needed to translate complex organizational requirements into scalable, maintainable Workday solutions. You will serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders and a subject-matter expert within the IT team, driving quality, stability, and continuous improvement across Workday HCM.

HCM Administration & Configuration

  • Serve as the primary Workday HCM administrator for Core HCM, Absence Management, Learning, Payroll Interfaces, Time Tracking, and Business Process Configuration.
  • Lead functional analysis, design, and hands-on configuration of Workday HCM modules to meet evolving business requirements.
  • Design, build, and optimize Workday business processes, security roles, condition rules, and reporting structures.
  • Configure and maintain calculated fields, custom reports, and dashboards to support operational and strategic decision-making.

Stakeholder Engagement & Solutioning

  • Partner with HR, Finance, Operations, and other business stakeholders to gather, document, and validate system requirements.
  • Translate business needs into clearly scoped Workday configuration solutions, articulating design trade-offs and recommendations.
  • Serve as the liaison between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams to ensure end-to-end solution integrity.
  • Provide expert guidance on Workday capabilities and constraints to inform business process design decisions.

Release Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor Workday's bi-annual release schedule; proactively assess impact of new features and configuration changes on existing implementations.
  • Coordinate release testing cycles with business stakeholders — including regression testing, UAT facilitation, and production deployment sign-off.
  • Stay current on Workday's product roadmap and recommend process improvements based on newly available functionality.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and increase user adoption through platform optimization.

Incident Management & User Support

  • Own Tier 2/3 incident resolution across supported Workday HCM modules — diagnosing root causes, implementing fixes, and communicating status to stakeholders.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve support tickets submitted via the incident management system (ServiceNow, JIRA or equivalent).
  • Provide timely, high-quality responses to user requests while managing competing priorities across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Support off-hours maintenance windows or critical incident resolution as needed to minimize system downtime.

Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world! Qualys, Inc is a pioneer and leading provider of disruptive cloud-based IT, security, and compliance solutions with over 11,000 active customers in more than 130 countries, many of which are in the Forbes Global 100 and Fortune 100. job.description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

YOUR MISSION: We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to support end-to-end architecture across PUMA’s global DTC technology landscape. In this role, you will ensure scalable, stable, and future-proof architecture decisions across digital and physical touchpoints. You will advise and enable Product and Project Teams by aligning business strategy, product roadmaps, and technology architecture, while ensuring high solution quality, strong non-functional standards, and sustainable platform evolution. Acting as an architectural authority for strategic initiatives, you will help guide the structured evolution and expansion of PUMA’s global technology ecosystem.

Role:

  • Support with end-to-end solution architecture across the global DTC technology landscape
  • Ensure scalable, stable, and future-proof architecture decisions across digital and physical touchpoints
  • Advise and enables PUMA’s Product and Project Teams
  • Alignment between business strategy, product roadmaps, and technology architecture, while governing solution quality, non-functional requirements, and long-term platform evolution.
  • Enable structured evolution and expansion of the technology stack

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and own end-to-end solution architectures for strategic initiatives across digital channels, retail systems, core platforms, integrations, and data.
  • Define architecture artifacts such as high-level architecture diagrams, design documents, data models, and system interaction maps.
  • Define integration patterns (API-first, event-driven, modular, cloud-native architectures).
  • Define and validate non-functional requirements including performance, security, scalability, compliance, resilience, and failure handling.
  • Participate in discovery workshops, architecture reviews, and impact assessments.

job.name: Lead Associate, Information Security
job.description:
This role is being created to backfill a resigning Senior Associate, Information Security with 3.5 yrs of experience at BetaNXT, and it is being redefined with a sharper mandate. The Lead Associate / Cybersecurity Engineer will own day-to-day execution of BetaNXT's Vulnerability & Exposure Management program — the single highest-priority function in this role — while also contributing to PKI/Certificate Lifecycle Management and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) / Data Classification initiatives. This is an execution and delivery role as much as a technical one: success depends on the ability to organize, prioritize, and personally drive remediation work across engineering teams that do not report to this person.

We are looking for someone with genuine passion, ambition — someone who treats this role as a launchpad to grow into broader security engineering and program leadership responsibility, not a fixed job description.

*Key Responsibilities*

  • Vulnerability & Exposure Management — Primary Focus
  • Serve as the day-to-day counterpart to DXC's Vulnerability Management lead, running a recurring, evidence-based triage cadence across findings from Qualys VMDR/TruRisk, GitLab Ultimate (SDLC/dependency findings), and CyCognito (external attack surface).
  • Segment and prioritize triaged findings by business unit (Beta, Maxit, Mediant, Delta Data), applying asset criticality, exploitability signals (EPSS/KEV), and business context rather than raw severity counts alone.
  • Build remediation plans with each BU's technology and development engineering teams, and personally drive them to closure — this requires the judgment and persistence to negotiate realistic timelines and the persuasion skills to keep remediation moving with teams that have competing priorities and no reporting relationship to this role.
  • Apply project/delivery-management discipline to the remediation portfolio: maintain trackers and burn-down views, flag at-risk items early, and escalate clearly and factually to BU and technology leadership when a commitment is slipping.

job.name: IT Manager
job.description:
About The Role Our customers expect us to meet SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA and ISO 42001. You will be our first IT hire and will own corporate IT and IT security end-to-end for ~150 people: identity, devices, SaaS, and the IT controls auditors test. This is a builder role. You will configure, script and fix things yourself.

What you will do

  • Own Google Workspace administration: org units, groups, security settings, DLP, context-aware access, email security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).
  • Run identity and access in Okta and 1Password: SSO and enforced MFA for every SaaS app (Cloudflare, Slack, GitHub, cloud consoles), role-based access, privileged access, and quarterly access reviews with evidence.
  • Automate the joiner, mover and leaver process with HR, so offboarding removes all access within 24 hours.
  • Manage the Mac-first fleet (plus some Windows/Linux) through MDM: enrollment, disk encryption, OS patching, screen lock, EDR, and remote wipe.
  • Keep a complete asset inventory and SaaS inventory; find and remove shadow IT; manage licences and IT spend.
  • Own IT vendor management and security reviews of IT tools together with the GRC Lead.
  • Keep the Google Workspace, Okta, 1Password, Slack, GitHub, Cloudflare and MDM integrations healthy; keep personnel and account mapping accurate; run Vanta access reviews; and keep every identity, device and offboarding test passing as audit evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and HIPAA.
  • Run security awareness training and phishing simulations; track completion.
  • Handle IT helpdesk and onboarding; write runbooks so it scales.
  • Own office and remote network security: Wi-Fi, firewall, VPN or zero-trust access, and guest isolation.
  • Execute IT parts of incident response, backup and business continuity tests.
  • Script repetitive work (Google Apps Script, Python, Bash, GAM, MDM APIs).

What you must have

  • 7+ years in IT operations, 3+ of them at a SaaS or tech company of 100–500 people.
  • Hands-on, expert-level Google Workspace admin.
  • Hands-on with Okta (or a similar IdP such as JumpCloud or Entra ID): SAML, OIDC, SCIM provisioning.
  • Hands-on Mac MDM (Jamf, Kandji, Mosyle or Intune for macOS), plus an EDR tool.
  • Have supported at least one SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit and produced evidence yourself, ideally through Vanta (Drata or Secureframe is acceptable if you can ramp on Vanta in the first month).
  • Working knowledge of AWS, GCP or Azure IAM, enough to manage console access and SSO into cloud accounts.
  • Scripting in at least one of Python, Bash, or Apps Script.
  • Clear writing: you document what you build.

Nice to have

  • Has used the Vanta agent, Vanta access reviews or Vanta personnel onboarding/offboarding workflows.
  • Certifications: Google Workspace Administrator, Jamf 200/300, CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer.
  • Experience with zero-trust access (Cloudflare, Tailscale, Zscaler) and SaaS security posture tools.

job.name: Principal Engineer
job.description:
About The Role Rubrik is the Security and AI Operations Company. As we move from protecting data to securing and accelerating our customers' AI transformation, we are rethinking how the whole company works and fully embracing AI in everything we do.

The Principal Engineer is a strategic, hands-on role at the same level as an Engineering Director. You will define and execute the technical strategy for Rubrik's AI software factory, the platform on which agents and people take an idea all the way to customer value.

To get there, we are moving from an AI-assisted Software Development Lifecycle to an AI Product Development Lifecycle (AI-PDLC), which covers every stage, not just code. Agents do the synthesis, drafting and execution, while people provide judgment and give accountable approval at every key decision. The platform is at an early stage, and you will lead the build of the shared foundation that every function at Rubrik, from Product, Design and Engineering to Sales and Marketing, will use it for its AI workflows.

Your primary focus is problem seeking: finding where AI can make the biggest difference, from building products to serving customers, and making the case to fund it.

What you'll do

Platform strategy

  • Define the technical vision for the AI-PDLC platform: orchestration, approval gates, model and tool gateways, agent runtimes, context, evals and cost visibility.
  • Make the platform usable by every function through clear contracts, paved paths and self-serve tooling.
  • Decide what Rubrik should own, build on and borrow.
  • Turn business opportunities and productivity gaps across Product, Design, Engineering, Support and go-to-market teams into multi-quarter roadmaps.

Technical leadership and standards

  • Set the standards for trustworthy agentic workflows: a person approves every agent output, and no workflow skips its quality or security checkpoints.
  • Champion eval-driven development, managed agent identities with native access control, and outcome metrics such as landed rate, revert rate and cost per landed change.
  • Own cross-cutting initiatives (up to about 18 engineers' effort) end to end. Stay hands-on: prototype, write code and review critical changes.

Influence and growth

  • Build consensus across Engineering, Product, Design, Support, Security and business functions.
  • Lead the organizational change that AI-native work requires, where ownership means accountability rather than gatekeeping.
  • Coach Engineers toward Principal-level impact, raise the hiring bar, and represent Rubrik externally.

About You

Job Description You will be responsible for developing, configuring, and testing complex, cloud-native master data management (MDM) applications, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance across various platforms.

Responsibilities:\\

  • Lead the development, configuration, and implementation of enterprise MDM solutions, translating complex healthcare data requirements into robust code and configuration files using the Reltio Connected Data Platform.
  • Define and enforce best practices for API Development, building seamless real-time data integration endpoints, streaming integrations, and ensuring interoperability across downstream and upstream healthcare applications.
  • Implement and optimize MDM workflows leveraging Cloud Technology, managing multi-tenant SaaS features while adhering to organizational standards for cost, security, compliance, and performance.
  • Provide expert guidance in Computer Programming and Databasing, developing optimized JSON configurations, handling crosswalk mappings, and structuring queries to interact effectively with Reltio's data store.
  • Drive the adoption of DevOps principles and practices, utilizing continuous integration, deployment pipelines, and automated tenant configuration migration across environments.
  • Support solutions incorporating Edge Computing and Embedded Systems Architecture, building data syndication logic that allows connected medical devices to consume clean master data.
  • Contribute to Full Stack Development efforts, ensuring high-quality implementation from frontend data-steward UI layouts (Reltio Console) to backend data pipelines and integration layers.

Responsible for analyzing strategic business objectives, utilizing statistical and mathematical programming techniques for machine learning and predictive analytics, developing and implementing algorithms and models, applying natural language processing, designing network simulation models, developing automated solutions, prototyping applications, managing projects, and communicating complex findings as a Data Scientist.

  • Analyze strategic business objectives and leverage advanced analytical research to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Utilize statistical and mathematical programming techniques for machine learning, predictive analytics, and other advanced data modeling tasks.
  • Develop and implement machine learning algorithms and predictive analytics models to extract insights and make future predictions.
  • Apply natural language processing techniques to extract meaningful insights from unstructured textual data.
  • Develop algorithms and methods for efficient information retrieval from large datasets.
  • Design and optimize network simulation models to improve efficiency and performance.
  • Develop automated solutions to streamline processes and increase operational efficiency.
  • Prototype and develop applications to demonstrate the feasibility and functionality of data-driven solutions.
  • Manage data science projects from inception to completion, ensuring adherence to timelines and deliverables.
  • Communicate complex analytical findings effectively through data visualization and storytelling techniques.

Education: Master’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, MIS, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar discipline.

Relevant work experience as a data scientist based on the following number of years:

Standard I: Two (2) years

Standard II: Three (3) years

Senior I: Four (4) years

Senior II: Five (5) years

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Fluency in English
  • Analytical Skills
  • Accuracy & Attention to Detail
  • Numerical Skills
  • Planning & Organizing Skills
  • Presentation Skills
  • Statistical and Mathematical Knowledge
  • Data Modeling and Visualization Skills
  • Programming Skills

job.name: AI Strategist
job.description:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in program management, strategy, or business operations.
  • Experience leading change management initiatives and managing executive stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in global operations with organizational structures and workflows.
  • Experience with no-code/low-code AI tools and a willingness to learn.
  • Experience in contributing to the development and deployment of technology solutions (including AI/ML), demonstrating the ability to identify opportunities and collaborate with technical teams.

job.name: Expert D&T Technical Data Steward
job.description:
Job Title : Expert Digital & Tech Technical Data Steward

City, Country: Hyderabad, India

As an Expert Digital & Tech (D&T) Technical Data Steward, you drive consistent, enterprise‑level execution of data governance and data management by providing hands‑on stewardship across data cataloging, data quality, metadata and lineage, issue resolution, and access control. You enhance and augment domain squads with targeted technical expertise, ensuring stewardship practices are harmonized, scalable, and fit‑for‑purpose. Through your leadership, you embed reliable governance capabilities into business domains, elevate data maturity, and enable trusted, high‑quality data for decision‑making.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Data improvements & stewardship: Execute domain-driven initiatives to consolidate, harmonize, and assess data; track progress, issues, risks, and mitigations.
  • Data Quality (DQ): Capture requirements; define metrics & rules; monitor and report DQ; design, build, and maintain data integration and transformation workflows, covering data discovery, quality rule creation/migration to IDMC, validations, data transformation, and other processing activities. Implement, maintain, and document DQ rule changes following established change control processes.
  • Catalog & Metadata: Own documentation and updates in Data Management tools (Informatica) with clear definitions, classifications, tags; align with domain ownership for transparency & findability.
  • Data Lineage: Establish and validate end-to-end lineage so upstream/downstream impacts are visible to squads.
  • Data Cleansing & issue management: Coordinate and execute technical cleansing; perform root-cause analysis; recommend solutions and prevent recurrence; define & operate domain-aligned workflows with clear SLAs.
  • Data Access & Sharing: Support enablement of data access aligned to classification and sharing policies; enforce approvals and auditability patterns.
  • Data Products & Use-cases: Provide technical guidance (profiling, fit-for-purpose assessments) during data product/use-case delivery.
  • Measurement: Demonstrate accountability and ownership for data health by actively contributing to Data Health dashboards (covering data quality,
  • discoverability, reliability, business usage, etc.), implementation of DQ metrics. Champion data trust, transparency, and compliance.
  • Collaborations & Continuous Improvement: Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing across data domains. Drive continuous improvement and innovation in data management, reusable libraries and playbooks for DQ assets.

We Offer

job.name: Data / Financial Analyst (Microsoft Dynamics GP) - Remote
job.description:
Data / Financial Analyst (Microsoft Dynamics GP) - Remote

Kake is a remote-first company and a people-first global community of senior engineers. Kake engineers are behind some of the world’s most innovative products (Brands you’ve heard!), from Fortune 500 to fast-growing companies. We believe it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. Our community spans 45,000+ engineers across 55+ countries; join a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive (and love eating kake!).

We’re looking for Data and Financial Analysts with hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) and strong SQL skills, skilled in turning ERP financial data into accurate reports and actionable insights. It's a great fit for people who enjoy working at the intersection of finance and data, owning reporting end-to-end, and collaborating closely with finance, accounting, and business teams.

What you’ll build and own

  • Write and maintain SQL queries, views, and stored procedures to extract, analyze, and report on Dynamics GP data.
  • Build and maintain financial and operational reports using tools such as SSRS, SmartList Builder, Management Reporter, and Power BI.
  • Perform financial analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting.
  • Support Dynamics GP across core modules (GL, AP, AR, Inventory, Purchasing, Sales), troubleshooting data and reporting issues.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across Dynamics GP and connected financial systems.
  • Support data integrations and migrations between Dynamics GP and other financial or reporting systems.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business questions into clear reports and data-driven recommendations.
  • Contribute to best practices and continuous improvement initiatives across projects.

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Analysis or Financial Analysis, with hands-on work in Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) .
  • Strong experience with SQL / T-SQL , including queries, views, and stored procedures on Microsoft SQL Server .
  • Working knowledge of Dynamics GP modules such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Inventory .
  • Experience with Dynamics GP reporting tools such as SmartList Builder, Management Reporter, or SSRS .
  • Solid background in financial analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis .
  • Experience with Power BI, advanced Excel , or similar data visualization and reporting tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.

job.name: Risk Manager II, Financial Fraud
job.description:
Description The Financial Fraud team's vision is to protect customers and Amazon financials from exposure to bad actors, thus disincentivizing and reducing their attempts to operate in our stores.

We are looking for a highly motivated risk manager to solve exciting business problems in large scale. This role will perform comprehensive investigations to identify business problems and root cause, use data to locate patterns of risks, and drive the implementation of large scale solutions. The risk manager will work with product and program managers, machine learning scientists, risk SMEs across areas, as well as external stakeholders.

As a Risk Manager, you will define end-to-end risk strategy, scope ambiguous problems, and design solutions in partnership with ML, engineering, and business teams. The role demands strong data analysis skills, the ability to drive prioritization and alignment across stakeholders, comfort operating in ambiguity, and the influence to move leaders across organizations and levels.

Key job responsibilities

  • Conduct complex investigations and make high--judgment enforcement decisions in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Analyze large datasets to identify abuse patterns, anomalies, and emerging risks at scale
  • Author deep-dive documents and propose scalable solutions to product, policy, and leadership stakeholders
  • Contribute to strategic vision and communicate goals, roadmaps, and policy changes through BRDs, WBRs/MBRs/QBRs
  • Influence without authority across product, tech, policy, legal, and finance teams to drive consensus and deliver results
  • Drive efficiency through automation, eliminating non-value-add processes, and building mechanisms that scale in resource-constrained environments
  • Operate independently—prioritizing multiple high-visibility initiatives, managing escalations, and making data-driven tradeoffs to maintain strategic deliverables

About The Team The Financial Fraud team manages risk vectors where bad actors seek financial gains through illegitimate activities on Amazon and cause negative impact to Amazon buyers. We monitor customer orders and financial risk throughout the seller journey, apply surgical treatments and enforcement actions to prevent bad actors from exploiting Amazon systems and processes, particularly during a customer order’s lifecycle, to protect customer experience and prevent financial loss. We strive to prevent bad actor impact to Amazon and its customers while minimizing unnecessary friction to selling partners.

job.description:

  • Support implementation and optimization of finance technologies and enterprise performance tools such as SAP, Oracle, Hyperion, Anaplan, or OneStream.
  • Deliver financial data analysis, variance reporting, KPI rationalization, and executive-ready insights for senior stakeholder decision-making.

We take a holistic approach, integrating strategy development, process design, and technology enablement to help clients overcome challenges and achieve sustained business success. Our team partners with organizations to drive profitable growth, manage costs strategically, and navigate financial risks. job.description:

You will support Securities Research by conducting or enabling quantitative and analytical research on industries, markets, companies, and changing economic conditions to assess investment risk and inform strategic direction.

  • Oversee complex research coverage and contribute directly to significant assignments

  • Identify and recommend opportunities to improve research processes, analytical methods, and risk controls

  • Collaborate with investment, risk, governance, audit, and business partners to resolve issues

  • Credit / Portfolio Management / Credit Research:

+ 7–8 years of hands‑on experience in credit analysis, underwriting, debt advisory and portfolio monitoring

Industry Exposure (Preferred) Experience in Energy and power is preferred (not mandatory)

Key skills -Technical / Functional /Behavioral Competencies

Credit Analysis & Underwriting

  • Performs in‑depth financial analysis, cash flow modelling, and credit risk assessment
  • Prepares and reviews credit appraisals, underwriting memos, and lending recommendations

Credit Portfolio Management

job.name: Senior Fraud Investigator, Fraud Investigation, Recovery and Enforcement
job.description:
Description Investigator, Retail Fraud Prevention

Summary Join Amazon's Fraud Prevention team and help protect our financial systems by investigating and preventing fraudulent payments to suppliers and vendors globally. You'll work with sophisticated transactional data to identify emerging fraud schemes, lead complex investigations, and develop detection systems that stop fraud before it impacts our business.

About The Team We are a collaborative team within Finance Operations dedicated to detecting and preventing fraudulent payments across Amazon's global operations. Our work is grounded in data—we use signals from invoices, payments, and transactional records to identify threats and emerging fraud schemes. We partner closely with colleagues in Accounts Payable, Finance, Legal, and technical support to stay ahead of risks and protect the integrity of our financial systems. Our vision is to build a fraud prevention program that evolves with emerging threats, and we're looking for someone who shares our commitment to this mission and can help us develop other investigators and strengthen our detection capabilities.

Key Job Responsibilities

Conduct thorough investigations into suspected fraudulent vendor payments, analyzing complex datasets and digital evidence to identify patterns and build comprehensive cases

Develop and implement detection systems and prototypes that identify new fraud schemes and prevent fraudulent payments from entering our financial system

Prepare detailed case summaries and evidence documentation with clear findings and recommendations for stakeholders, Legal, and law enforcement referrals

Communicate investigation results and strategic recommendations to senior leaders through periodic business reviews and updates

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline investigation processes, improve efficiency, and establish reporting systems that support investigation goals

Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent

6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience

Experience applying AI and machine learning to build detection mechanisms, automate investigation workflows, and reduce cycle time

Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets and identify patterns indicative of fraud or financial irregularities

Strong written communication skills with the ability to document complex investigations clearly and concisely

Advanced use of Excel and statistical analysis applications, experience with Microsoft office including Outlook, Word and Excel

1+ years minimum experience with SQL

Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions

Preferred Qualifications Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles/Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvement or equivalent

Masters degree or equivalent

Knowledge of intermediate SQL

job.name: ML Systems Engineer
job.description:
Location: Pune

Experience: 9–13 Years

Work Mode: Work from Office

Notice Period: Immediate to 45 Days(889)

Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced ML Systems Engineer to manage and maintain traditional Machine Learning models in production environments.

The role focuses on deploying predictive models, managing retraining cycles, monitoring model performance, identifying data and model drift, and ensuring reliable model operations. You will work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, and business teams to maintain the accuracy, stability, and performance of machine learning solutions.

This is a hands-on operational role involving production model management, deployment pipelines, performance tracking, and model lifecycle maintenance. The primary focus is on conventional predictive ML models rather than Generative AI or LLM-based applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Model Deployment & Lifecycle Management
  • Manage the deployment of trained machine learning models into production environments.
  • Execute model packaging, validation, testing, and release activities through established CI/CD pipelines.
  • Coordinate model retraining and deployment cycles based on business and operational requirements.
  • Maintain model versions, deployment records, and associated lifecycle documentation.
  • Ensure new model releases are validated before being moved into production.
  • Model Monitoring & Drift Detection
  • Monitor production models to ensure consistent accuracy and performance.
  • Identify data drift, feature drift, and concept drift that may impact model predictions.
  • Generate regular monitoring reports and highlight deviations from defined performance thresholds.
  • Investigate changes in model behaviour and coordinate corrective actions with relevant teams.
  • Track model performance over time and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Model Validation & Performance Optimization
  • Evaluate updated models against existing production models before deployment.

Hands-on experience deploying and running traditional ML models in production

job.name: GCP Network Isolation, IAM and AI Agent Security
job.description:
Senior Cloud Security Engineer: GCP Network Isolation, IAM and AI Agent Security

Role Summary

We are hiring a hands-on Cloud Security Engineer to design and harden isolated Google Cloud environments where autonomous AI agents run. The work is delivered as part of an engagement with Google Professional Services (PSO). You will build the controls that keep agent workloads from exfiltrating data, holding excess permissions or communicating with systems they should not reach, and you will encode those controls as tested infrastructure as code.

This is a build and architecture role. You will design VPC Service Controls perimeters, define least-privilege IAM models, add security checks to CI/CD pipelines, configure Security Command Center for AI workloads, and write the design documents and runbooks that other engineering teams use to adopt them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and configure VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) perimeters, including access levels, ingress and egress rules and dry-run validation, to contain data across isolated agent projects.
  • Implement Private Service Connect (PSC), network routing policies and baseline firewall rules for isolated environments.
  • Architect least-privilege IAM across the organization, folder and project hierarchy, using resource-scoped role bindings and dedicated service accounts for each agent and workload.
  • Add automated guardrails to CI/CD pipelines: code linting, static policy validation and secure authentication to registries in isolated GCP projects.
  • Configure Security Command Center (SCC) for AI security and threat protection to monitor agent activity and detect runtime anomalies.
  • Define security boundaries and isolation patterns for multi-agent architectures, including agent-to-agent (A2A) runtime communication and per-project execution.
  • Validate infrastructure with automated tests (for example Terratest) so security controls are checked on every change.
  • Remediate High and Critical severity findings in infrastructure as code by applying configuration updates.
  • Write Technical Design Documents (TDDs) and developer onboarding runbooks for the controls you build.
  • Work with Google PSO engineers, client security teams and application developers to review designs and resolve access and isolation issues.

Primary Skills (Must Have)

Skill area

Level

GCP network isolation and perimeter security

Expert

VPC Service Controls perimeters, Private Service Connect, network routing policies and baseline firewall rules across isolated environments.

GCP IAM least-privilege access architecture

Mapping enterprise IAM roles, resource hierarchy structures and resource-scoped access bindings to enforce least privilege.

CI/CD security guardrails and pipeline hardening

Advanced

Automated code linting, static policy-validation checks and secure authentication to isolated GCP project registries.

GCP Security Command Center (SCC) for AI

About the Company:

Kamakhya Analytics is a technology-driven research and consulting organisation helping leaders, parties, and institutions decode India’s political and policy landscape. We bring together survey science, data analytics, and strategic insight to answer complex questions about public opinion, governance, and performance. job.name: Senior AI Applications Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Summary We are looking for a full-stack engineer who has built production applications, and who has also helped build software that other engineers then built on top of — a shared library, an internal tool, a reusable component set or a software development kit — establishing engineering standards through automation rather than documentation.

The role combines application development with internal platform and developer-tooling engineering, and the two feed each other: building a real application end to end is how we discover which capabilities the platform should own.

On The Platform Side You Will Build GE HealthCare's Internal AI Engineering Framework — The Shared Libraries, Code Generation Tools, Standardised Interfaces And Automated Verification Our Data Scientists And Engineers Use To Take Their Own AI Solutions Into Production. It Exists To Deliver Four Outcomes For The Company

  • reduce time from working prototype to production from months to days;
  • allow data scientists to ship production-grade AI without expertise in cloud infrastructure, deployment, application security or front-end development;
  • make security, compliance and consistency automatically enforced properties of every solution, rather than outcomes dependent on scarce expert review;
  • allow underlying technologies to be replaced — model provider, agent framework, user interface approach — without rewriting the solutions built on them.

On the application side you will develop selected AI applications end to end — front end, back end and agents — for priority business use cases, and for the reference implementations that prove each platform capability before it is offered to others. Expect the balance to sit somewhat more on the platform side than the application side, and to shift as the platform matures. It is not an infrastructure operations role.

tex

Most people creating AI solutions here are data scientists and analysts rather than career software engineers. Their modelling, evaluation and domain expertise is what these programmes need; deep infrastructure and front-end expertise is not reasonable to require of them. Every solution must nonetheless reach production as a secure, reliable, supportable enterprise system. A defining characteristic of our approach is that correctness is established by automated tooling — type systems, generated code, schema validation, pipeline checks — rather than by expert human review , which does not scale to the pace required. This is a builder's role, not an audit role. You will design security into our architecture, our delivery pipeline and our AI features, and lead the team that keeps it there. Edge CDNs, WAF, bot detection agents

Tuned defences against scraping, credential stuffing and AI-driven bots

Discovery, schema enforcement, abuse and BOLA/BFLA detection

Applications Modern web front ends and backend services

Secure-by-default frameworks and paved roads for engineers

AI Extensive use of AI and LLMs in client-facing features

An LLM threat model, guardrails, evals and monitoring in production

The current list of services is based on Microservices architecture whose domain ranges from visitor tracking, User profiles, authentication, content and payments.

Platform team uses state of the art modern technologies like .Net framework, Python, Java, SQL Server, My SQL, Graph DB, SOLR, and a lot of other tools & technologies serving millions of users with hundreds of million transactions everyday through a scalable and fault tolerant architecture.

job.name: Senior Analyst, Identity Governance & Priviliged Access Management
job.description:
Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group (CCLFG), one of Canada’s leading asset managers, is seeking a Senior Analyst, Identity Governance & Privileged Access Management (IGA/PAM) to join our Center of Excellence (CoE) – Information Security in Gurugram.

The Information Security team is responsible for securing and governing access to critical systems and data across the organization. This role will lead key initiatives related to Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), user lifecycle management, access governance, and identity security modernization. If you are passionate about reducing identity-related risk, implementing scalable access controls, and driving improvements to identity security processes, this may be the right opportunity for you. The successful candidate will collaborate with teams across Canada and India and play a key role in the ongoing implementation and operation of the organization's IAM program and reporting to the Information Security Manager based in Gurugram.

What You Will Do Identity Governance and Administration

  • Lead the implementation, administration, operation, and continuous improvement of the Saviynt Identity Cloud platform, including application onboarding, connector integration, configuration, and platform health monitoring.
  • Design, implement, and maintain role-based and attribute-based access control models (RBAC and ABAC), access governance standards, and entitlement structures.
  • Develop and maintain automated Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows that provision, modify, and deprovision access based on HR, directory, and other authoritative system events.
  • Transition manual User Access Review (UAR) and certification campaigns to automated, periodic, and event-driven processes.
  • Coordinate access reviews, entitlement certifications, and remediation activities, ensuring findings are tracked to closure and supported by audit-ready evidence.
  • Build and optimize access request workflows, approval routing, and rules-based provisioning processes to reduce manual effort, prevent access creep, and improve the user experience.
  • Identify and support the remediation of excessive privileges, orphaned accounts, inappropriate entitlements, Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflicts, and other identity-related risks.
  • Integrate the IGA platform with HR systems, directories, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and adjacent identity controls, including Privileged Access Management (PAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), and multifactor authentication (MFA).
  • Troubleshoot identity workflows, provisioning processes, connector integrations, and platform configuration issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve IAM processes through automation, workflow optimization, analytics, and responsible use of AI.

Privileged Access Management

job.name: SOC Analyst L2
job.description:
Innspark is a deep-tech, product-based OEM specializing in cybersecurity products, AI, cloud solutions, and select hardware offerings such as drones, VTS, and telemedicine systems, with a diverse and evolving portfolio. To learn more, please visit our website: https://innspark.in.

We’re Hiring: Security Analyst (L2 – Triage & Investigation)

Location: Delhi

Shift Model: 24×7 Operations

Experience: Minimum 2-4 years

Expected Joining: Within 15–30 days

Note: Candidates from North India are preferred.

Role Overview

The Security Analyst (L2 – Triage & Investigation) is responsible for advanced alert triage, cross-platform correlation, structured threat hunting, and detailed incident investigations within the SOC.

This role acts as the analytical bridge between L1 monitoring and L3 threat leadership, ensuring accurate detection validation, attack narrative reconstruction, and timely remediation aligned with defined incident response requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Perform detailed triage and investigation of security events escalated by L1. Correlate alerts across SIEM, UEBA anomaly scores, NDR flow data, Deception triggers, and ASM exposure findings to identify true-positive incidents and reconstruct the full attack narrative.
2. Execute established SOAR playbooks for incident containment, enrichment, and response actions. Identify gaps in automation coverage and propose new playbook requirements to L3 leads, with documented use cases and expected efficiency gains.
3. Conduct structured threat hunting campaigns on a weekly rotation using SIEM queries, UEBA deviation analysis, NDR traffic inspection, and Deception telemetry to identify threats that bypass automated detection. Document each hunt’s hypothesis, methodology, and findings.
4. Maintain and tune detection rules, UEBA behavioural models, and NDR baseline policies within defined parameters. Track false-positive rates, alert fidelity scores, and mean time to investigate. Escalate tuning recommendations beyond defined thresholds to L3.
5. Produce detailed investigation reports for every confirmed incident, including IOCs, affected assets, timeline, impact assessment, and remediation verification, within SLA timelines defined by incident severity.
6. Actively monitor Attack Surface Management findings. Validate exposed assets, assess vulnerability context against threat intelligence, and coordinate remediation tracking with IT operations teams.

Required Qualifications

  • B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Information Security, or Cybersecurity.

Experience Requirement

  • Minimum 2-4 years of hands-on experience in a SOC environment performing alert triage, incident investigation, and threat analysis.

Technical Skill Requirements

  • Working proficiency across all six SOC platforms: SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, NDR, Deception, and ASM.

job.description:
Project Role : Technology Support Engineer

Project Role Description : Resolve incidents and problems across multiple business system components and ensure operational stability. Create and implement Requests for Change (RFC) and update knowledge base articles to support effective troubleshooting. Collaborate with vendors and help service management teams with issue analysis and resolution.

Must have skills : Workplace Technology Solutions

Good to have skills : VMware Workspace ONE

Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary As a Technology Support Engineer, a typical day involves addressing and resolving incidents and problems that affect various business system components to maintain smooth and stable operations. The role includes managing change requests and continuously updating documentation to enhance troubleshooting efficiency. Collaboration with external vendors and internal service management teams is a key part of the daily routine, ensuring timely analysis and resolution of issues that impact business continuity. This position requires a proactive approach to maintaining system reliability and supporting operational excellence across multiple teams.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Workspace ONE Technology Support Lead to own technical support operations, lead L2/L3 escalation teams, and maintain production health across a global endpoint fleet (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, and rugged hardware). This role bridges hands-on L3 technical support, OEM oversight, operational governance, and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the daily operations of the Workspace ONE engineering/support team. Oversee incident response, operational SLAs, health checks, and change management workflows for UEM and Access environments.

Serve as the final escalation point for critical incidents involving device enrollment failures, app delivery, SCEP/PKI certificates, and Identity/SSO integrations (Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID, Ping).

Direct the staging, enrollment, and provisioning strategy for frontline rugged devices manage key technical relationships with hardware, OEMConfig, and hardware-level support.

Maintain core integration components, including AirWatch Cloud Connector (ACC), Workspace ONE Tunnel, Content Gateway, and Secure Email Gateway (SEG), ensuring high availability and multi-region connectivity.

Drive operational efficiency through PowerShell, REST API, and JSON automation for bulk management, self-healing remediation, and reporting via Workspace ONE Intelligence.

Qualifications & Skills 8+ years in Unified Endpoint Management (UEM/MDM) with expertise in Omnissa Workspace ONE, including 2+ years leading technical teams or support workstreams.

job.name: Azure DevOps Engineer (Terraform + Kubernetes) – JR 1505760
job.description:
JOB TITLE

Azure DevOps Engineer (Terraform + Kubernetes) – JR 1505760

LOCATION

Hyderabad / Noida / Gurugram

WORKPLACE TYPE

On-site (client location)

EMPLOYMENT TYPE

Contract – 12 months

EXPERIENCE

5–8 years

SHIFT

1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST

JOINING

Immediate joiners only (30-day notice profiles will not be considered)

------------------------------------------------------------

ABOUT THE ROLE

Hiring Azure DevOps Engineers to own the non-production environments for a large enterprise platform. You will build and run fully automated Azure DevOps and Terraform-based pipelines for both application and infrastructure, manage Kubernetes workloads, and fix issues during development, performance testing and release preparation so that every release reaches production clean.

This is a hands-on engineering role. The interview process includes live technical exercises and scenario-based questions, such as writing Terraform modules, building Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and explaining Kubernetes networking. Candidates with only conceptual or keyword-level knowledge will not be shortlisted.

Interview process: 1 technical round followed by 2 client rounds.

------------------------------------------------------------

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Pipeline Ownership

  • Build, manage and support Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for both application and infrastructure in non-production environments
  • Keep all deployments fully automated through pipelines with designated approvers – no manual deployments
  • Write and maintain YAML pipelines, templates, stages, environments and approval gates

Infrastructure as Code

  • Create and maintain all infrastructure using Terraform – every infrastructure creation and deployment runs through Terraform
  • Write reusable Terraform modules, manage state and variables, and promote changes across environments
  • Apply platform and version upgrades when security or platform issues arise (for example, vulnerabilities in PHP or Node.js)

Kubernetes Platform

  • Manage Kubernetes workloads (AKS) in non-production environments
  • Troubleshoot pods, services, ingress, networking, resource limits and scaling
  • Fix issues found during development, performance testing and release preparation – such as unavailable services, cache problems and memory exhaustion – before they reach production

Security and Release Practices

  • Manage secrets securely across pipelines and environments (Azure Key Vault, variable groups, service connections)
  • Follow release practices and prepare a rollback plan for every change
  • Apply security patching and version upgrades on time

Environment Boundaries

  • Work only in non-production environments (no access to production services, databases or infrastructure)
  • Hand over cleanly to the production support / SRE team for production releases

------------------------------------------------------------

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

job.name: C++ | Low-Latency Trading Systems | Manager level | Mumbai
job.description:
Markets move in microseconds. We're building the systems that keep pace.

We're hiring hands-on C++ engineers to join our Technology team and build low-latency software for a high-throughput trading environment. This is an engineering-first leadership role. You'll spend most of your time designing and writing performance-critical code, and the rest mentoring developers and driving delivery.

Two levels open

  • Assistant Manager | 6-8 years | ~85-90% hands-on coding, ~10-15% mentoring. Ideal for a strong systems engineer stepping into a first leadership role.
  • Manager | 8-10 years | ~70-80% hands-on coding, ~20-30% leading a pod of 3-4 developers, reviews and sprint execution.

What you'll do

  • Write clean, ultra-fast systems code in Modern C++ (17/20) for market connectivity, market data normalization, pre-trade risk checks and execution routing
  • Apply low-latency principles: custom memory pools, object pools and placement new, with zero heap allocation on critical paths
  • Build high-speed IPC using shared memory and lock-free queues and ring buffers
  • Implement deterministic multi-threading with atomics and CPU thread affinity
  • Use template metaprogramming to build zero-overhead, compile-time abstractions
  • Build custom data structures, binary parsing and bitwise packing, and design MySQL schemas for transaction logs, reference data and audit trails
  • Implement exchange protocols (FIX, ITCH, OUCH, SBE), order lifecycles and matching-engine communication
  • Own modules end to end, run peer code reviews, and bring profiling and benchmarking (Valgrind, perf, gprof, Google Benchmark) into the workflow to catch regressions early.

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT or a quantitative discipline
  • Assistant Manager: 5-8 years of production C++ systems programming, with a track record of mentoring or feature ownership
  • Manager: 6+ years in systems-level development, including 2+ years as a team lead
  • Mastery of C++ and the STL, including pointers, manual memory management and RAII
  • Strong grasp of concurrency, lock-free design and avoiding race conditions, deadlocks and contention
  • Solid understanding of CPU cache hierarchies, mmap and branch prediction
  • Strong DSA fundamentals and MySQL indexing skills
  • Big plus: exposure to HFT infrastructure, proprietary trading, market data handlers, exchange gateways or core fintech systems.

Why join us

  • Work on microsecond-sensitive systems at the core of a leading trading platform
  • A role where you stay deeply technical while growing into leadership
  • Real ownership of modules and design decisions

Interested? Write to us at Rukmini@careerxperts.com

job.name: Sr. SRE Engineer
job.description:
Role Overview

The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. The role combines hands-on engineering with incident response, infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and continuous reliability improvement.

The ideal candidate should have experience working in production-critical environments where system availability, quick incident resolution, effective monitoring, and preventive engineering are essential.

Key Responsibilities1. Site Reliability and Production Operations

  • Monitor production systems and maintain service availability, performance, and operational stability.
  • Participate in production support and scheduled on-call rotations, including the resolution of critical incidents.
  • Investigate system failures, perform root cause analysis, document post-incident findings, and implement preventive measures.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and reduce manual intervention through automation.
  • Improve service reliability using measurable indicators, service objectives, availability targets, and error-budget practices.
  • Contribute to capacity planning, disaster recovery, high availability, redundancy, and failover strategies.
  • Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering
  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Work with cloud compute, storage, networking, access management, monitoring, and cloud-native services.
  • Support containerized applications and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure, including AKS, EKS, GKE, or equivalent platforms.
  • Troubleshoot cluster health, application workloads, resource utilization, scaling, networking, and deployment-related issues.
  • Work with Helm and other relevant deployment tools to maintain consistent application releases.
  • Infrastructure Automation and DevOps
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Support automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes.
  • Work with Git-based development workflows, including GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent platforms.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment reliability through automation.
  • Develop scripts using Python and/or Bash to simplify operational activities and eliminate repetitive tasks.
  • Monitoring, Observability and Performance
  • Build and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting solutions for production environments.
  • Work with observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Golden Signals(including Latency, errors, traffic, saturation), AWS CloudWatch, and GCP Cloud Monitoring.
  • Apply the four Golden Signals—latency, traffic, errors, and saturation—to monitor service health a

job.name: Senior C++ Developer
job.description:
Navtech is a premier IT software and services provider. Our mission is to increase public cloud adoption and build cloud-first solutions that become trendsetting platforms of the future.

We have been recognized as the Best Cloud Service Provider by GoodFirms for delivering quality services and results. We strive to innovate and push technology and service boundaries to provide best-in-class technology solutions to our clients globally.

We are a fast-growing company serving clients across the United States, UK and Europe. You will work with a team of talented developers, quality engineers and product managers who are passionate about building impactful technology solutions.

Role Overview You will join a small senior team taking over a business-critical rules engine written inVisual C++ on Windows Server with SQL Server. You will learn the system directly fromthe engineers who built it, then take ownership of features, fixes and production support.One of the three openings will also cover a related artwork management application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shadow the client's engineers, then take over development and maintenance of assigned modules.
  • Build new features and fix defects in C++ and SQL Server.
  • Write and tune stored procedures, functions and queries.
  • Investigate and resolve production incidents (L2/L3 support), including on-callrotation.
  • Document the parts of the system you learn: data flows, business rules, deploymentsteps. Pair with QA to automate regression testing of the areas you own.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional C++ development, mostly on Windows (Visual C++ / MSVC,Visual Studio).
  • Strong SQL Server: stored procedures, T-SQL, query tuning.
  • Experience maintaining and extending a large existing codebase, not only new builds.
  • Solid debugging on Windows, including multithreaded code and memory issues.
  • Version control with Git and working in Agile/Scrum teams.

Nice to have

  • MS Access or VBA (some legacy components still use it).
  • Ruby on Rails or Kafka.
  • Windows application development beyond server-side code (MFC, Win32 or similar).
  • Experience in telecom billing, trading platforms, CAD/engineering software or otherlong-lived C++ products.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. Software Engineer II, Endpoint Agent (Development & Automation Testing)

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives

3. Agent Observability & Tracing

  • Use OpenTelemetry and OpenInference for telemetry and instrumentation.
  • Work with Langfuse and LangSmith to trace agent execution, investigate failures, and analyze application behavior.
  • Monitor agent performance and troubleshoot issues across application and integration layers.

4. Azure AI Stack

  • Work with Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry for AI application and agent-related workloads.

Openings: 1

About the job

About Us

Tiger Food Ingredients Private Limited is a Chennai-based FMCG company that makes food ingredients across three manufacturing units, with high standards of quality and food safety. We have an established presence in South India across retail stores and online platforms. We are growing fast and building a team that takes pride in quality, discipline and speed.

The Role

You will own Tiger's marketplace and quick-commerce business end to end: listings, content, inventory, pricing, campaigns, orders and growth on Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and similar platforms. Every number on these channels is yours to deliver.

Key Responsibilities

1. Listings & Catalogue Ownership

● Create and maintain every SKU listing: titles, images, A+ content, keywords, pricing.

● Go live on new platforms and cities within agreed timelines; no listing stays inactive, suppressed or incorrect.

● Track and fix catalogue errors, content rejections and listing blocks the same day.

● Run weekly listing and search-rank audits; act on every gap.

● Maintain a live SKU-wise tracker of listing status, MRP, offers and content version.

2. Inventory, Orders & Fulfilment

● Plan stock for every platform and dark store with Sales Coordinator, FG Stores and Production; prevent stock-outs.

● Raise POs, appointments and shipments on time; follow up on GRN, short receipts and rejections.

● Monitor fill rate, order cancellations and OTIF daily and fix root causes without waiting to be asked.

● Reconcile orders, returns and damages with the platform and close claims within the claim window.

● Flag slow-moving and near-expiry stock early with a clear action plan.

3. Pricing, Promotions & Ads

● Own platform pricing, margins and promotions within approved limits; escalate any deviation immediately.

● Plan and run sponsored ads, deals and festival campaigns with defined budgets and ROAS targets.

● Review ad spend, ACoS/ROAS and conversion daily; pause, optimise or scale decisively.

● Track competitor prices, ranks and offers weekly and respond fast.

● Deliver monthly campaign calendars aligned with Marketing and Sales.

4. Account Management & Payments

● Be the single point of contact for category managers and account teams on every platform.

● Negotiate listing support, ad support and visibility opportunities and convert them into sales.

● Track settlements, deductions and chargebacks; raise disputes and recover dues on time.

● Resolve every platform escalation, customer complaint and rating issue within 24 hours.

  • Support strategic sourcing projects through e-sourcing, bid analysis and supplier evaluation.
  • Collaborate with procurement and cross-functional stakeholders across international manufacturing locations.
  • Contribute to the ongoing transformation of a global, centre-led procurement function.

Required Experience:

  • Experience within strategic procurement, sourcing, market intelligence or commercial analytics.
  • Exposure to chemicals, petrochemicals, raw materials or industrial manufacturing supply markets would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, with experience interpreting complex commercial, supplier and market data.
  • Ability to translate detailed analysis into meaningful strategic procurement recommendations.

job.name: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
About Backbase Backbase powers the financial experiences of many of the world's leading banks. Our engagement banking platform helps banks unify customer data, orchestrate journeys, and deliver personalized experiences across digital channels. About the role We are building the Customer Lifetime Orchestrator — an omni-channel marketing and customer engagement platform that helps banks engage end customers and influence financial behaviour.

As Senior SDET, you own quality for this domain together with the engineering team: test strategy, automation completeness, and the team's ability to execute effectively. This is a hands-on test design and automation role — not a downstream QA handoff. You will partner with Product, UX, and full-stack engineers (web, mobile, backend, AI-assisted features) to shift quality left and scale automation.

What you will do

  • Define and execute test strategy and test plans per release (scope, risks, schedule, entry/exit criteria).
  • Co-author acceptance criteria and Gherkin scenarios with Product; act as quality gatekeeper before releases.
  • Build and maintain Playwright web E2E tests for real-world customer journeys across engagement channels.
  • Govern mobile E2E strategy (Android/iOS) with engineers; use device-farm/matrix testing.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD with GitHub Actions (smoke, regression, quality gates).
  • Manage test environments with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
  • Use Grafana (or similar) to analyse test results and improve feedback loops.
  • Combine automation with exploratory and manual testing for edge cases; reduce flakiness and improve parallelization.
  • Coach engineers on TDD, BDD, contract tests, synthetic data, and shift-left practices.
  • Advocate AI-assisted testing (generation, visual regression, maintenance).

What You Bring Required

  • 5+ years as SDET or hands-on QA with an automation-first mindset.
  • Strong test planning and acceptance-criteria design with Product/UX.
  • Playwright (web), Espresso (Android), XCUITest (iOS).
  • Java and JavaScript/TypeScript; Angular SPA, mobile, microservices.
  • API testing (REST, Postman, RestAssured or equivalent).
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Jenkins), BDD/Gherkin, web and mobile E2E.
  • Cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Docker/Kubernetes.
  • Device/browser farms (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, or equivalent).
  • Git/GitHub, Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence).
  • Non-functional testing (performance, security, accessibility, localization).
  • Excellent communication in distributed teams (India, Vietnam, Europe).

Nice to have

  • Digital banking, martech, or campaign/engagement management.
  • Performance testing (k6, Gatling, JMeter).
  • SaaS or enterprise software testing experience.
  • AI/ML product testing; XRay, CucumberStudio, SonarCloud, security tooling.

Job Description You will be the cloud domain architect and and lead the design and evolution of Openshift, cloud and large-scale Kubernetes-based platforms , working at the intersection of architecture, engineering, and strategy.

This role goes beyond defining solutions — you will drive how platforms are built, scaled, and operated , partnering closely with engineering teams while influencing key technical decisions across domains.

You’ll play a central role in pushing forward a Kubernetes-first, cloud-native vision , ensuring systems meet the highest standards of resilience, scalability, and performance , while remaining pragmatic and production-ready.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

  • Own and drive the architecture of Openshift, Kubernetes-based platforms, from design to real-world production
  • Translate complex business and product needs into clear, scalable technical solutions (HLD/LLD)
  • Set direction and best practices across cloud-native, containerized environments
  • Act as a technical leader, influencing decisions and guiding engineering teams
  • Support teams on implementation, optimization, and troubleshooting in production
  • Continuously improve platform capabilities across CI/CD, observability, and security, ISTIO

Key Skills And Experience

  • Senior-level architect with strong experience designing and running cloud-native distributed systems at scale, with deep expertise in Openshift, Docker and Kubernetes in production environments
  • Combines hands-on technical depth with strategic thinking, comfortable in complex environments where performance, reliability, and scalability are critical
  • Strong expertise in Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native architectures, hands on experience in Openshift with troubleshooting knowledge, ISTIO
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices at scale
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD (ideally GitOps), Linux, networking, and security
  • Proven ability to influence technical decisions and lead through expertise
  • Exposure to telecom platforms, service mesh, observability tools, or infrastructure as code is a plus

About Us Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

Learn more about life at Nokia .

Our recruitment process We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.

job.name: Senior Solution Engineer - GCC
job.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for world-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.

The Solution Engineer will work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof-of-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation. The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.

job.name: End User Computing Engineer

The team

The Enabling Areas – Information Technology team is responsible for building & maintaining different applications for Deloitte that focuses on providing employee experience.

job.name: Solution Architect - Skills & Reusability
job.description:
Job Title: Solution Architect - Skills & Reusability Job Location: Bangalore Job Purpose We are looking for a Senior Manager, AI Solution Architecture to provide end-to-end architecture leadership for enterprise artificial intelligence and agentic solutions across technologies and platforms.

As part of the Hyper Automation Technical Design Authority, you will make sure solutions are secure, scalable, reusable, cost-efficient and future-fit. You will be accountable for agentic architecture, grounding and retrieval, integration patterns, model selection and benchmarking, evaluation, large language model operations, model drift and token and cost optimisation.

This is a technical design authority role rather than a delivery engineering role: you will decide and assure the architecture while partnering with the product and engineering teams that build, deploy and operate solutions.

You will work closely with Enterprise Architecture, security, privacy, engineering and platform teams, and with technology vendors, to turn emerging artificial intelligence capabilities into practical enterprise patterns.

Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and govern reference architectures and engineering patterns for artificial intelligence, generative artificial intelligence and agentic solutions.
  • Lead technical design reviews and provide clear design pass, hold or remediation decisions.
  • Design enterprise patterns for agent orchestration, retrieval and grounding, application programming interfaces, tools, skills and enterprise-system integration.
  • Assess artificial intelligence models for task suitability, quality, latency, security, economics and operational fit, and establish benchmarking approaches across model and workload classes.
  • Drive token optimisation and cost-per-outcome engineering, including appropriate use of smaller, lower-cost models and routing strategies.
  • Define evaluation, observability, large language model operations (LLMOps) and model-drift patterns, including criteria to hold, roll back or promote solutions.
  • Determine when model tuning is justified versus prompting, retrieval, tool and skill design or model selection.
  • Build proofs of value for emerging technologies and convert successful findings into reusable enterprise patterns.
  • Identify opportunities for reuse before new engineering is commissioned.
  • Work across platform boundaries, including cloud artificial intelligence platforms, agent frameworks and deterministic automation technologies.
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture, security, privacy and engineering teams to make sure designs meet enterprise guardrails.
  • Help mature solutions along the autonomy ladder, introducing appropriate human-in-the-loop, self-monitoring and automated remediation patterns.

Required Qualifications

Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

Summary UST is hiring for Solution/Platform Architect

  • The candidate should have 12–18+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 5 years in a Solution Architect, Platform Architect, Enterprise Architect, Principal Architect, or equivalent technical leadership role, with demonstrated responsibility for architecting and delivering complex enterprise technology solutions.
  • The candidate should have strong experience in enterprise and solution architecture, with the ability to design scalable, modular, secure and highly available solutions using microservices, API-first, event-driven and cloud-native architectural patterns. The individual should be comfortable defining architecture principles, technology choices, integration patterns, non-functional requirements and technical standards for large-scale platforms.
  • The candidate should have strong hands-on architectural experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS or equivalent hyperscale cloud platforms. Experience should include designing cloud-native and hybrid architectures using containers, Kubernetes, serverless technologies, API management, messaging, event streaming, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, resilience and enterprise security practices.
  • The candidate should have good experience with IoT, connected products or industrial technology solutions, including device connectivity, telemetry ingestion, edge computing, device and asset management, remote monitoring and control, rules and event processing. Experience with technologies and protocols such as MQTT, OPC-UA, REST APIs and industrial/automotive connectivity patterns would be highly desirable.
  • The candidate should have practical experience in Digital Twin architecture and solutions, with an understanding of how physical assets, equipment, vehicles, manufacturing systems or infrastructure can be digitally represented using asset models, relationships, telemetry, events, states and historical information.
