Sova Health | Gurugram | Full-time | On-site

About Sova Health Sova Health is India's first full-stack microbiome health company, pioneering gut health through probiotic supplements, microbiome diagnostics, and personalised nutrition programs. We combine science, technology, and personalised healthcare to improve long-term health outcomes.

Role Overview

The Program Manager will own three key program outcomes: completion, clinical efficacy, and dropout. The role involves tracking and analysing program data, maintaining accurate reporting, identifying trends, and driving actionable improvements to enhance program outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Track and improve monthly nutrition program completion rates across cohorts.
  • Consolidate and reconcile data from renewal sheets, program trackers, and other relevant systems to ensure accurate reporting.
  • Maintain consistent definitions for completed, in-progress, and dropped-out participants.
  • Track clinical efficacy and the percentage of program completers achieving clinically significant improvements.
  • Work with the clinical team to establish measurable efficacy definitions and monitor outcomes, including SovaX personalised probiotic programs.
  • Analyse dropout rates, identify stages and reasons for drop-offs, and recommend interventions to improve retention.
  • Identify at-risk participants and work towards proactive dropout prevention.
  • Maintain data integrity across program trackers and reporting systems.
  • Publish consolidated monthly reports covering completion, efficacy, and dropout trends, along with actionable insights.
  • Present monthly findings to leadership and coordinate with relevant teams to address performance gaps.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Program Completion: Improve month-on-month completion rates.
  • Clinical Efficacy: Maintain or improve the percentage of participants achieving clinically significant outcomes.
  • Program Dropout: Reduce dropout rates through root-cause analysis and corrective action.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Clinical Nutrition, Dietetics, Public Health, Medicine, Nursing, Clinical Research, or a related healthcare field.
  • 3–6+ years of experience in clinical operations, healthcare analytics, or clinical program management.
  • Experience managing metrics related to program completion, efficacy, retention, or participant outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience reconciling multiple data sources.
  • Proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets; BI/dashboarding tools are a plus.
  • Strong reporting, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in digital health, D2C healthcare, or wellness-tech.
  • Familiarity with personalised nutrition, probiotics, or microbiome-based interventions.
  • Experience with retention or dropout-reduction initiatives.

job.name: SDET Analyst
job.description:
Job Description Summary of This Role

Performs and participates in application development and testing to apply continuous quality and testability of code throughout the software development lifecycle. Builds quality within the software development process with automated testing suites providing a comprehensive view from code quality to functionality. Uses quality paradigms to provide real time quality with use of automation and frequent regression testing. Designs / develops and maintains automation frameworks and automation test suites and scripts with continuous integration, testing, deployment and delivery. Conducts performance, load, security and service virtualization testing.

What Part Will You Play?

  • Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Participates within a collaborative software development approach to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Conducts basic impact analysis, evaluates and identifies affects to regression test suites, testability of code, and application performance to reduce negative influences on continuous testing. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies and designs basic testing suites for test driven development (TDD) and behavior driven development (BDD) to allow early and frequent testing as the software is developed.
  • Writes and executes moderately complex application tests at the source code level to prevent hidden errors (i.e., white box testing) within unit and component testing. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

job.name: Enterprise Architect
job.description:
*Why you'll LOVE Sagent* You could work anywhere. We know you are talented and looking for something inspiring and impactful. A place where you will make a difference and have a great time doing it!

By choosing Sagent, you can be part of our mission to make loans and homeownership simpler and safer for all consumers.

Sagent powers servicers and consumers. You power Sagent!

About The Opportunity We are seeking an Enterprise Architect to help lead the architecture change process governed by our Architecture Review Board (ARB). In this role you will evaluate proposed solutions across the full enterprise architecture landscape — Business, Data, Application, and Technology (BDAT) — assess them against our architecture principles, standards, and target-state roadmaps, and guide project and solution teams toward designs that are sound, secure, cost-effective, and strategically aligned.

This is a breadth-first role with depth in at least one domain. You will spend less time building systems and more time shaping how systems fit together, why they should exist, and what the enterprise should stop doing. You will need to be equally credible talking about a value stream with a business VP and a network topology with an infrastructure engineer.

Our environment includes on-premises data centers, mainframe workloads deployed to cloud, and a substantial Microsoft Azure footprint, so practical hybrid-enterprise experience matters.

Your Day-to-Day At Sagent *Architecture Governance and the Review Board*

  • Co-lead the intake, triage, and review of architecture change requests entering the ARB, ensuring each submission has the artifacts, context, and analysis needed for an informed decision.
  • Assess proposals against enterprise architecture principles, reference architectures, standards, and target-state roadmaps; identify risks, gaps, dependencies, and overlaps with existing capabilities.
  • Facilitate ARB sessions: frame the decision, surface trade-offs, drive to a clear outcome, and prevent reviews from becoming design workshops.
  • Author and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), conditional approvals, and time-bound exceptions or waivers, including the remediation path attached to each exception.
  • Track accepted architecture risk and technical debt created through waivers, and report on it to governance and leadership forums.
  • Evolve the governance process itself — review criteria, submission templates, fast-track paths for low-risk changes, and the definition of what does and does not require ARB review.
  • Coach solution architects, engineers, and product teams so that proposals arrive review-ready and the standards are understood before designs are drawn.

*Business Architecture*

job.name: ML Engineer AI OPS (B6)
job.description:
*Job Summary* The AI Ops Model Monitoring professional monitors the post-deployment health, performance and reliability of AI/ML models, including traditional ML and Generative AI/LLM systems. The role builds and maintains advanced monitoring frameworks to detect drift, degradation, anomalies and GenAI-specific issues, including query-context relevance and end-user satisfaction. It leverages Databricks native capabilities (Inference Tables, Unity Catalog and Model Serving), alongside broader MLOps tools, to ensure scalable, automated observability and proactive governance.

  • Implement a GenAI evaluation framework to continuously measure output quality against trusted sources and drive model improvement and governance.
  • Design and implement continuous monitoring pipelines for ML and GenAI models, tracking core metrics (accuracy, precision/recall, latency and drift) and GenAI-specific signals (query-context relevance and end-user satisfaction) in real-time or batch modes.
  • Set up automated alerting, dashboards and incident workflows for model/endpoint health degradation.
  • Leverage Databricks Inference Tables to capture and analyse serving logs (inputs, predictions and timestamps) from Mosaic AI Model Serving endpoints; build custom processing jobs to derive profile/drift metrics, anomaly detection and performance trends.
  • Build GenAI observability: monitor query → context → relevance chains in RAG pipelines, and track embedding similarity, retrieval quality and end-to-end response metrics using logged inference data.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and AI engineers to define monitoring thresholds, baselines, drift detectors and automated retraining/rollback triggers.
  • Manage model lifecycle governance (versioning, compliance and auditability) using Databricks Unity Catalog, MLflow and related tools.
  • Contribute to enhancing the organisation’s MLOps platform with Databricks-centric monitoring features, such as scheduled jobs on inference tables, for scalability and ease of use.

*Key Responsibilities Strategy*

  • Implement continuous Model Monitoring for all use cases across CIB.

Business

Processes

Description Alexa+ is Amazon’s next-generation, AI-powered virtual assistant. Building on the original Alexa, it uses generative AI to deliver a more conversational, personalised, and effective experience. Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI) team is developing responsible AI (RAI) solutions for Alexa+, empowering it to provide useful information responsibly.

The Mission

Build AI safety systems that protect millions of Alexa customers every day. As conversational AI evolves, you'll solve challenging problems in Responsible AI by ensuring LLMs provide safe, trustworthy responses, building AI systems that understand nuanced human values across cultures, and maintaining customer trust at scale.

What You'll Build

You'll pioneer breakthrough solutions in Responsible AI at Amazon's scale. Imagine training models that set new safety standards, designing automated testing systems that hunt for vulnerabilities before they surface, and certifying the systems that power millions of daily conversations. You'll create intelligent evaluation systems that judge responses with human-level insight, build models that truly understand what makes interactions safe and delightful, and craft feedback mechanisms that help Alexa+ grasp the nuances of complex customer conversations. Here's where it gets even more exciting: you'll build AI agents that act as your team's safety net—automatically detecting and fixing production issues in real-time, often before anyone notices there was a problem. Your innovations won't just improve Alexa+; they'll fundamentally shape how it learns, evolves, and earns customer trust. As Alexa+ continues to delight customers, your work ensures it becomes more trustworthy, safer, and deeply aligned with customer needs and expectations.

Your work directly protects customer trust at Amazon's scale. Every innovation you create—from novel safety mechanisms to sophisticated evaluation techniques—shapes how millions of people interact with AI confidently. You're not just building products; you're defining industry standards for responsible AI.

This is frontier research with immediate real-world impact. You'll tackle problems that require innovative solutions: training models that remain truthful and grounded across diverse contexts, building reward models that capture the nuanced spectrum of human values across cultures and languages, and creating automated systems that continuously discover and address potential issues before customers encounter them. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform state-of-the-art ideas into production systems serving millions.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep expertise in state-of-the-art NLP, Large Language Models

Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.

This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.

About The Role We are looking for an ML Engineer who can take a model from its reference implementation to efficient execution on AI accelerator hardware. You will own model bring-up, develop MLIR-based lowering paths, validate numerical correctness, and optimize performance across the model, compiler, kernels, and runtime.

This role combines practical knowledge of model architectures with strong compiler and systems engineering skills.

We are looking for an ML Engineer who can take a model from its reference implementation to efficient execution on AI accelerator hardware. You will own model bring-up, develop MLIR-based lowering paths, validate numerical correctness, and optimize performance across the model, compiler, kernels, and runtime.

This role combines practical knowledge of model architectures with strong compiler and systems engineering skills.

Responsibilities

  • Bring up new models: Understand model architectures, load and convert weights, implement supported execution paths, and establish correctness against reference implementations.
  • Lower models to hardware using MLIR: Develop and extend dialects, graph transformations, lowering passes, and hardware-specific mappings.
  • Support model operations: Enable attention, matrix multiplication, normalization, positional embeddings, and other operators through compiler and kernel changes.
  • Optimize execution: Improve operator fusion, tensor layouts, tiling, memory allocation, data movement, and parallel execution.
  • Optimize inference: Tune prefill and decode performance, KV cache management, batching, and quantization to improve latency, throughput, and memory efficiency.
  • Validate model quality: Investigate numerical differences and measure the accuracy impact of precision changes and compiler optimizations.
  • Diagnose bottlenecks: Use profiling, execution traces, and hardware counters to identify compute, memory, communication, and runtime limitations.
  • Work closely with hardware, compiler, kernel, and runtime teams to deliver reliable model support and repeatable performance benchmarks.

Required Qualifications

job.name: Associate Consultant - NOC Job
job.description:
About The Role You are the first person to see an alert or a ticket, day or night. You check it, decide how serious it is, fix it using the runbook where you can, and pass it on with good notes where you cannot. You cover every technology in the estate at first-line level, so no incident waits because 'the right person' is not on shift. You also handle the client's Netskope remote-access requests and first-line connection issues.

What You Will Do Watch and respond

  • Watch the monitoring dashboards for servers, hypervisors, cloud instances, firewalls and WAN circuits.
  • Acknowledge every alert within the response target, check it against the runbook and set the right priority.
  • Spot duplicate or related alerts and group them into one incident.
  • Do the daily health check at the start of the day shift and raise anything abnormal.

Fix first-line problems

  • Restart failed Windows services and Linux daemons, clear disk space, end runaway processes and recover hung servers using the runbook.
  • Power on, restart or check virtual machines in vCenter and instances in the AWS, Azure and Alibaba Cloud consoles.
  • Check firewall and WAN alerts (link down, high CPU, HA state) and log carrier tickets with the internet or circuit provider, then chase them to closure.
  • Route alerts for areas the iNOC does not own (storage, backup, databases, applications, security) straight to the right client team.

Remote access (Netskope)

  • Handle remote-access requests: add or remove a user's access, or move them to the right group or policy, exactly as the approved request and the runbook say.
  • Troubleshoot first-line connection issues: client installed and enabled, user signed in, correct steering and app access, tunnel up, known outages.
  • Collect client logs and details and pass harder cases to L2 or the client's remote-access team.
  • Watch the health of the remote-access publisher and gateway nodes and escalate alerts.

Requests, records and handover

  • Complete standard operating-system requests from the request catalogue, for example planned reboots inside an approved window or agent restarts.
  • Keep every ticket updated so the next person understands what happened, and close it only after checking the service is back.
  • Write a clear handover at the end of every shift: open incidents, exceptions, planned work, pending actions.
  • Open the bridge and send the first updates when a major incident starts.
  • Tell the Technical Lead when a runbook is missing or wrong, so it gets fixed.

What You Need

star/trac builds flow, a logistics platform for yards, gates and loading docks. It handles truck check-in, self- service terminals (kiosks), slot and dock planning, and real-time monitoring for industrial customers. We are moving flow from a single-tenant setup (WildFly, Oracle, one AWS account per customer, Elastic Beanstalk) to a cloud-native, multi-tenant platform: flow6, a multi-tenant flow API (Spring Boot, JDK 21) that serves many customers from one deployment, with strict tenant isolation flow-dynamic-ui, a configuration-driven frontend where pages, queries and forms are data, not code flow-terminal-service, the backend and configurator for our check-in kiosks An analytics and real-time layer: CDC from Postgres and Oracle into Apache Doris, Kafka (MSK), and live push to the UI much of our engineering runs through AI agents in Claude Code. Each agent has a written contract, hard rules and its own tools. Our infrastructure agents are DiVa, who works inside a workload account (EKS
clusters, Dockerfiles, CI, GitOps deploys, image scans), and Otto, who works across the AWS Organization (accounts, SSO, shared networking, guardrails). They already do real work. They need a human principal who owns them.
This role is that owner. You will run our platform end to end and set up what is still missing, with the agents doing much of the hands-on work under your direction. You will also keep making the agents better: safer, more capable, and more useful to the rest of the team.

Job Summary:

This role involves end-to-end SAS programming for analysis and reporting, with a focus on regulatory compliance, data standards, and high-quality deliverables. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in efficacy analysis, SDTM and ADaM generation, and TLF programming.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform data manipulation, analysis, and reporting of clinical trial data, including both safety and efficacy datasets (ISS/ISE), using SAS .
  • Generate and validate SDTM and ADaM datasets in accordance with CDISC standards.
  • Create and validate Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for study reports and regulatory submissions.
  • Develop complex ad-hoc reports from raw clinical data.
  • Apply a strong understanding of efficacy analyses and clinical endpoints.
  • Contribute to the preparation and review of submission documents and electronic Case Report Tabulations (eCRTs) .
  • Perform production programming and quality control (QC/validation) to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Act as a team player , demonstrating commitment to quality and meeting project deadlines.
  • Stay adaptable and flexible to shifting priorities in a fast-paced clinical environment.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Statistics, Computer Science , or a related field.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in clinical trial programming using SAS .
  • Proficient in CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM), including mapping and validation.
  • Strong working knowledge of Base SAS, SAS Macros, SAS/STAT, and SAS/GRAPH .
  • Experience in generating datasets and outputs for regulatory submissions (including ISS/ISE).
  • Familiarity with eCTD standards , including Define.xml and dataset documentation.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong analytical problem-solving skills.

Working Capital Associate - Job Description

About the role

The Working Capital team is part of Financial Operations and provides working capital support to client engagements from across the UK firm, structured by line of service. The services provided by the team includes both:

  • transaction delivery - providing essential financial transaction delivery support to client engagement teams, including raising invoices, chasing outstanding debts and setting up job codes; and
  • working capital optimisation - driving improvements in working capital performance through working with engagement teams.

As a Working Capital Associate you will have responsibility for a portfolio of billing managers and/or partners within a business unit across one of our lines of service. In your role you will provide your billing managers and/or partners with both transactional delivery and working capital optimisation support, meeting with them on a regular basis to discuss their working capital performance and understand and deliver on their transactional delivery requirements. The role reports directly to the Working Capital Team Leader.

The role would suit a finance administrator or finance project coordinator, demonstrating confidence with numbers, analysis and budgeting. The candidate must also have excellent proven organisational skills, be able to multi-task and have the ability to build strong working relationships with client facing senior stakeholders (manager through partner grade), including the confidence to challenge their working capital position.

The ideal applicant will be passionate about the role they play in improving working capital performance and provide excellent client service, taking the time to learn about our clients and the services we provide. They will demonstrate drive, a customer focused approach, flexibility and agility whilst enjoying the demands that come with working in a fast paced environment and exceeding KPIs.

The suitable candidate will also demonstrate leadership qualities to manage their own time, whilst being willing to learn new tasks and taking on new responsibilities. They will also be open to sharing ideas and best practice with colleagues and peers alike.

Core Responsibilities

  • Financial administration and analysis: including creating client codes, raising invoices and credit notes, chasing debts, maintaining financial trackers, running/analysing financial reports and, in some lines of service, budget preparation.
  • Proactive active capital movement: leading meeting with Partners, Directors, Senior Managers and Managers to discuss their working capital needs on their engagements, including providing insight into their financial metrics and progress against targets, whilst making recommendations to improve metrics.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About The Role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer for our data pipeline service to build and work on data pipelines that moves data from various sources to data warehouses. The work is very diverse — all the way from patching software to building warehouse data writers, to optimizing the behavior of sync services operating on our global Kubernetes compute cluster.

You will be responsible for ensuring the technical excellence for your team and owned services, by contributing to the code, reviewing code, designing features and mentoring our junior colleagues.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer – Endpoint Security
job.description:
Senior Software Engineer – Endpoint Security (Backend / Full Stack)

Bangalore | Full-time | 6+ years | Immediate joining

Fidvia Consulting is hiring for an AI security startup that helps enterprises protect sensitive data as they adopt AI applications and agents.

In this hands-on Senior/Lead role, you’ll build the endpoint agent that detects suspicious activity and enforces security policies on enterprise devices. You’ll work with security researchers to turn behavioral signals and AI models into real-time protection. The engineering challenge is to keep that protection reliable when devices go offline while keeping CPU and memory usage low.

What you’ll build

  • Develop endpoint agents that use operating system APIs to monitor process, file, network, and application activity.
  • Detect sensitive data moving through files, browsers, and AI tools. Build local controls that prevent data leakage and continue enforcing policies during connectivity disruptions.
  • Own the agent lifecycle, including secure installation, configuration, updates, rollback, tamper protection, and communication with cloud services.
  • Build Python or Go services and REST APIs for endpoint management, telemetry ingestion, and policy distribution. Use SQL and NoSQL databases and deploy services on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Build automated tests across OS versions and application environments. Measure detection accuracy, false positives, enforcement latency, and resource usage to guide releases.

What you’ll bring

  • 6+ years in software engineering, including substantial hands-on experience building and shipping endpoint security agents, endpoint detection and response (EDR) products, or data loss prevention (DLP) products.
  • Strong systems programming skills in C, C++, or Rust , plus experience using Python or Go for services
  • or tooling.
  • Deep knowledge of Windows, macOS, or Linux internals , with hands-on experience using frameworks such as Windows minifilter drivers, macOS Endpoint Security, or Linux eBPF.
  • Experience building endpoint telemetry, behavioral detection, and real-time policy enforcement. Ability to diagnose crashes, concurrency issues, memory leaks, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Familiarity with cloud services, databases, and CI/CD. Experience leading technical design, mentoring engineers, and taking features from concept to production with research and product teams.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred experience: Applying AI or machine learning to threat detection, behavioral analysis, or data classification is strongly preferred. Experience securing AI applications or agents is a plus.

job.name: Backend Engineer
job.description:
About Alaan

Alaan is an AI-native finance platform for businesses in the Middle East. The platform combines corporate cards, expense management, cross-border payments, accounting automation, treasury, business banking\*, and more, with AI doing the work finance teams used to do by hand: coding transactions, chasing approvals and receipts, flagging policy breaches, placing treasury deposits, and closing the books.

Our mission is to simplify finance for businesses so they can save time and money.

Over 4,000 businesses use Alaan, from first-time founders to enterprises like Careem, G42, Tabby, Al Barari, and Rivoli. Since 2022, they have saved more than 2.2 million hours of manual finance work.

Alaan has raised $55Mn to date, including one of the largest Series A rounds in Middle East history, backed by Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India), Y Combinator, 468 Capital, and 885 Capital, among others. Headquartered in Dubai, Alaan has more than 250 employees across its Dubai, Riyadh, and Bangalore offices, with a team that comes from Careem, McKinsey, BCG, Goldman Sachs, Amazon, Revolut, Rippling, and the world’s leading firms.

Alaan has been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 list, UAE Future 100 list, selected as an Endeavor company, and ranked the No. 1 spend management platform in EMEA by G2.

\*Alaan is a fintech company, not a bank. Business bank accounts are issued by ruya.

About the role

As a Backend Developer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the server-side logic, database architecture, and APIs that power our products. You will collaborate closely with front-end developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-performance systems that meet the needs of our business.

What you'll do

  • Develop and maintain backend systems and services to ensure optimal performance and scalability
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices for our FinTech platform
  • Collaborate with front-end developers and product managers to define, develop, and deliver features
  • Write clean, reusable, and efficient code, following best practices
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing applications as needed
  • Ensure the security and integrity of backend systems, data, and APIs
  • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to team members
  • Monitor system performance and resolve production issues as they arise

What we're looking for

Job Description About Streamline: Here at Streamline, we strive on building lasting and trusting relationships with our clients, and our employees set the bar.

Streamline’s mission is to build innovative technological solutions that empower people who improve behavioral health and quality of life of those in need. We are a high-growth technology company that delivers web-based software for healthcare organizations to provide and coordinate all service delivery processes. Streamline has built and maintains systems for some of the premier behavioral health organizations in the United States of America, using the latest web-based technology.

Role And Responsibilities The platform is mature and handles high data volumes. Your work will span:

  • Clinical workflows that care teams use every day.
  • Government and state compliance reporting, where the data has to be exact.
  • Data integrations and reports built on SQL Server and SSRS.

You will spend real time reading existing code, understanding why it works the way it does, and improving it safely.

  • Build and enhance ASP.NET Web Forms pages, user controls, and C# business logic that are clean, testable, and fast.

  • Write and tune stored procedures, queries, and SSRS reports for large data sets, using execution plans and SQL Profiler.

Required Skills And Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years hands-on, with strong C# and object-oriented design.
  • ASP.NET Web Forms: Page lifecycle, ViewState, postbacks, user and server controls, master pages, session state, and caching.
  • SQL Server: Stored procedures, indexing, execution plans, and fixing slow queries, blocking, and deadlocks on large databases.
  • Front end: JavaScript and jQuery on Web Forms pages, with working HTML and CSS.
  • Reporting: Building and supporting SSRS reports.
  • AI-assisted development: Daily use of GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding tools.
  • Practices: Agile, CI/CD, unit testing, and secure coding.
  • Collaboration: Clear communication with product, QA, and US-based teams.

Nice to Have

  • Azure DevOps.
  • Healthcare, EHR, or compliance reporting experience.

Streamline Healthcare Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, national origin, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law.

Job Summary Analyzes trends within assigned operations, including call volumes, call patterns, staff productivity, and resource allocation. Uses analysis results to forecast call arrival and build staffing and scheduling plans to meet business unit goals and corporate objectives.

Identify potential supply chain failures as part of the planning process and mitigate associated risks Work closely with stakeholders - internal and/or external to develop short term tactical improvements. *Competencies:* Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

Part Change Control Management - Evaluates and implements engineering change request (obsolescence, supersessions, new part release, etc.) to meet customer delivery requirements while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

About the Job

Job Title - Ad Operations Specialist – Google Ad Manager (GAM)

Company: VoiseTech

Department: Ad Operations / Publisher Monetisation

Experience: 3–5+ Years

Location: Pune

Employment Type: Full-Time

About VoiseTech

VoiseTech is a global AdTech company focused on building scalable, technology-driven advertising and monetisation solutions. We work with publishers and demand partners across international markets, helping maximise advertising efficiency, inventory performance, and revenue opportunities.

As we continue to expand our publisher ecosystem, we are looking for an experienced Ad Operations Specialist with strong technical and operational expertise in Google Ad Manager (GAM), Google AdX, and Multiple Customer Management (MCM).

Job Description

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and optimising publisher-side ad operations, ensuring seamless integrations, efficient inventory management, accurate ad delivery, and maximum monetisation performance.

This is a hands-on role requiring extensive experience with Google Ad Manager, publisher ad-serving infrastructure, GAM MCM configurations, and programmatic monetisation workflows.

Key Responsibilities

1. Google Ad Manager (GAM) Operations

•⁠ ⁠Manage end-to-end publisher ad operations within Google Ad Manager.

•⁠ ⁠Configure and maintain ad units, inventory hierarchy, placements, orders, line items, creatives, and targeting.

•⁠ ⁠Manage GAM network configurations, ad-serving settings, and inventory allocation.

•⁠ ⁠Implement and troubleshoot Google Publisher Tags (GPT), including key-value targeting and ad request configurations.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor ad delivery, inventory availability, unfilled impressions, and reporting discrepancies.

2.⁠ ⁠Google AdX & Publisher Monetisation

•⁠ ⁠Manage Google AdX inventory configurations and monetisation settings.

•⁠ ⁠Implement and optimise pricing rules, inventory protections, and auction configurations.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor publisher monetisation metrics, including eCPM, fill rate, impressions, match rate, and revenue.

•⁠ ⁠Identify and resolve revenue leakage, unfilled inventory, and demand delivery issues.

•⁠ ⁠Optimise inventory performance across display, video, and other applicable ad formats.

•⁠ ⁠Support programmatic demand integrations, Open Bidding, and header bidding.

3.⁠ ⁠Publisher Onboarding & MCM Management

•⁠ ⁠Manage publisher onboarding and integration through Google Ad Manager.

•⁠ ⁠Handle GAM MCM workflows, including Manage Account (MA) and Manage Inventory (MI) arrangements.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate publisher invitations, approvals, inventory delegation, and account configurations.

•⁠ ⁠Validate publisher ad inventory, ad tags, domain authorisation, and ads.txt configurations.

•⁠ ⁠Troubleshoot MCM-related onboarding, inventory access, and monetisation issues.

4.⁠ ⁠Technical Ad Operations & Troubleshooting

job.name: Principal Architect
job.description:
About The Role As a Principal Architect, you will be responsible for the architectural design and end-to-end implementation of a high-performance OLAP query engine and semantic layer. The primary goal is to develop a custom JSON-based query language (DSL) and a translation engine that converts these requests into optimized SQL for columnar databases. This role requires a deep understanding of systems programming, compiler theory, and multi-dimensional data modeling to serve high-concurrency read loads in a microservices environment.

What You'll Do

  • Architectural Design & Query Execution

+ Compiler & DSL development: Design a custom JSON-based OLAP query language. Define eBNF grammars and build a translation layer to convert functional formulas and DSL requests into an optimized execution plan.
+ SQL generation & optimization: Implement and oversee the generation of highly optimized SQL tailored for columnar databases including ClickHouse, SingleStore, and DuckDB.
+ Semantic layer management: Architect the representation of multi-dimensional data models within columnar structures, ensuring efficient data retrieval and aggregation.
+ Custom function logic: Implement logic for custom functions, determining the optimal balance between SQL push-down and application-layer execution

  • Caching & Performance Engineering

+ Multi-dimensional caching: Envisage and implement a distributed caching strategy for multidimensional data, utilizing shared memory systems like Redis.
+ Concurrency & scaling: Build and maintain high-performance microservices using Java (Micronaut or Spring Boot) with Project Loom (Virtual Threads) to handle massive concurrent read loads.
+ Low-level optimization: Manage system-level performance including connection pooling, array pooling, and off-heap memory management.
+ JVM tuning: Apply expert knowledge of Java Garbage Collectors (including ZGC and Shenandoah) to maintain low-latency response times.

  • Engineering Excellence & AI Integration

+ AI-augmented development: Leverage AI coding agents and tools to accelerate the software development lifecycle, from prototyping to debugging.
+ Technical documentation: Maintain a disciplined approach to software development by documenting architectural decisions, design patterns, and technical specifications.
+ Technical leadership: Act as the primary technical authority on query engine internals, providing guidance on complex systems-level challenges.

What We're Looking For

job.name: GCP Security Architecture and Agentic AI Security
job.description:
Senior Cloud Security Architect: GCP Security Architecture and Agentic AI Security

Role Summary

We are hiring a hands-on Cloud Security Architect to design and harden Google Cloud platforms that run autonomous AI agents. The work is delivered as part of an engagement with Google Professional Services (PSO). You will write and review Low-Level Designs (LLDs) for platform hardening, then automate those designs with Terraform and Python.

The role covers the security of the platform and of the agents themselves: which actions an agent may take, what content passes through it, how agents authenticate to each other and to tools, and how their decisions are logged for audit. You will work with VPC Service Controls, Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK), Model Armor, Security Command Center (SCC) AI Protection and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and review Low-Level Designs for GCP platform hardening, covering VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC), CMEK and network perimeter isolation.
  • Configure Model Armor to filter agent input and output content, and build defenses against prompt injection, data exfiltration and model manipulation.
  • Design identity and access management for non-human identities (NHI), including fine-grained RBAC for agent tool authorizations and API scopes.
  • Implement secure agent-to-agent (A2A) communication using mutual TLS (mTLS) and cryptographic validation.
  • Harden agent tool connections over MCP and route them through Agent Gateways.
  • Configure SCC AI Protection and design chain-of-thought logging frameworks so that agent decision paths can be audited for compliance and forensics.
  • Write and maintain reusable Terraform modules that provision secured cloud baselines.
  • Write secure Python automation scripts, test cases and custom runtime validation tools.
  • Add security linting, static analysis (SAST) and pre-deployment policy checks to deployment pipelines.
  • Align agent platforms with data privacy controls such as Sensitive Data Protection (DLP) and data masking, and set up human-in-the-loop (HITL) override gates.
  • Remediate critical and high-risk infrastructure security findings and document the fixes in technical runbooks.
  • Work with Google PSO engineers, client security teams and application developers to review designs and resolve security issues.

Primary Skills (Must Have)

Skill area

Level

What it covers

GCP security architecture and hardening

Advanced to Expert

Hands-on creation and review of LLDs for cloud platform hardening, with deep expertise in VPC Service Controls, CMEK and network perimeter isolation.

Agentic AI security and safety guardrails

Advanced

Setting up Model Armor to govern agent input and output content filtering, and defending against prompt injection, data exfiltration and model manipulation.

IAM for non-human identities (NHI)

Advanced to Expert

job.name: Senior QA Engineer, AI Agents & Agentic Workflows
job.description:
Organization Overview Company Description QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.

We are a virtual first company and your primary work experience will be virtual / working from your home. Occasional travel to a physical office may be required to enhance working relationships, collaboration, design, strategy and alignment. Job Description QAD is seeking a Sr QA Engineer to own the continuous validation and quality of Champion Assist, a multi-

agent AI product with ~20 evolving agents. You will test the agents themselves: their reasoning, tool use,

orchestration and handoffs, and the quality of their responses. This goes beyond UI and API checks.

You will design evaluation frameworks and regression suites that catch failures unique to non-deterministic, LLM-

driven systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, run and maintain end-to-end business scenarios that exercise multi-step agentic workflows,

including agent routing, tool/function calls, and multi-turn conversations.

  • Evaluate agent outputs for correctness, relevance, groundedness, consistency, tone and

completeness, using both human review and automated methods.

  • Build and maintain eval datasets (golden sets, edge cases, adversarial prompts) and automated

regression suites that run as agents, prompts, models and tools change.

  • Identify cross-agent, orchestration and integration issues: wrong agent selection, broken handoffs,

tool-call failures, context loss, looping or runaway behavior.

  • Test for hallucination, prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage and unsafe or out-of-scope responses.
  • Detect regressions caused by model upgrades, prompt changes or retrieval/knowledge changes, and

quantify them with metrics.

  • Triage and root-cause issues with Engineering and Product, separating prompt, model, retrieval, tool

and orchestration causes.

  • Re-test fixes, validate the end-user experience, and keep evals current as the product evolves.
  • Document test strategy, eval results and quality trends clearly for global stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in software engineering, computer science or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of QA experience, with at least 1-2 years testing LLM-based applications, AI agents or

agentic workflows.

  • Hands-on experience evaluating non-deterministic outputs: defining pass/fail criteria, rubrics, and

acceptance thresholds for AI responses.

  • Experience building or maintaining AI eval or regression suites (e.g., LLM-as-judge, golden datasets,

scoring rubrics).

  • Understanding of agentic concepts: tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration, planning,

memory/context, RAG.

Position Overview:

In this role, your primary focus will be navigating complex data structures, performing deep data analysis, and leading the migration of legacy insurance data to our next-generation cloud platform.   • Stakeholder Facilitation: Act as the key interface and facilitate workshops with business SMEs, Product Owners, Actuaries, Underwriting, and Regulatory/Reporting teams to align data engineering with business goals.

Experience & Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in data analysis, data migration, or data-heavy business analysis roles within the Property & Casualty (P&C) / General Insurance domain.
  • Expert-level SQL skills with a proven track record of querying, profiling, and analyzing large, complex relational databases and modern cloud data warehouses.
  • Hands-on experience working on large enterprise modernization and cloud migration programs.

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer

Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

job.name: Principal AI Engineer - Enterprise Transformation

Organization Overview Company Description QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.

The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It sets architecture and standards, builds reusable capability, and delivers through a combination of internal engineering and external implementation partners. This is one of six foundational hires and the first dedicated engineering hire in the team.

Job Description The Senior AI Engineer is the primary builder in the CoE. You will take prioritised workflows from architecture and PRD through to working, evaluated, production-grade AI systems — and, just as importantly, factor what you build into a reusable component library so that the fifth workflow costs a fraction of the first.

This is an applied engineering role with unusually high leverage. You are not building one product; you are building the components, patterns and reference implementations that internal engineers and external partner pods will use to build many. The work spans retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, and the unglamorous production engineering — latency, cost, failure handling, observability — that separates a demo from a system the business can depend on.

Where this role sits Reports to: Head of the AI Centre of Excellence

Technical direction from: Lead AI Architect — you will work alongside them daily, and you are expected to push back when a design will not survive contact with production

Works with: The functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the workflows, PRDs and quality bar for the business functions in scope

Also partners with QAD engineering teams, Data & Platform Engineering, Security & GRC, and external system integrators

Scope: Foundational engineering hire. Expect to set the engineering standard, mentor subsequent hires, and review partner-delivered code.

Key Responsibilities Building AI and agentic workflows

  • Build production AI and agentic workflows end to end — from PRD and architecture through implementation, evaluation, release and iteration in production.
  • Design and implement agent orchestration: multi-step flows, tool and API invocation, planning and routing, state and memory, retries, fallbacks, timeouts and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
  • Make the judgement call on deterministic control flow versus model-driven control flow — and default to the former wherever it produces the same outcome more reliably and more cheaply.
  • Integrate with enterprise systems — ERP, CRM, support, services delivery, knowledge and data platforms — including systems with imperfect APIs and imperfect data.

Retrieval and context engineering

job.name: Junior AI Engineer
job.description:
About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

Role Summary:

Daignostix builds clinical AI for CT, MR, X-ray and ultrasound, with algorithms spanning neuro and stroke, pulmonary embolism, aortic pathology, urology, spine and rib fracture, solid-organ trauma and paediatric chest. Our models are used alongside radiologists (US, Indian certified), so quality is judged by clinical performance and reliability, not benchmark scores.

As a Junior AI Engineer, you will own scoped model workstreams (data, training, evaluation and error analysis) under the guidance of senior AI engineers, and support the move of validated models into production. Medical-imaging experience is welcome but not required; serious hands-on deep-learning work is.

Roles and Responsibilities:

● Model development. Train, fine-tune and evaluate CNN- and transformer-based models for classification, detection and segmentation, starting from strong baselines and running disciplined, reproducible experiments.

● Scoped ownership. Own a defined model workstream under senior review, from dataset preparation through training, validation, documentation and hand-off.

● Data pipelines. Build and maintain DICOM pipelines for ingestion, de-identification, series selection, pre-processing, augmentation, annotation handling and dataset versioning.

● Evaluation and error analysis. Report clinical metrics (sensitivity, specificity, PPV/NPV, ROC-AUC/PR-AUC, per-case and per-lesion), analyse false positives and negatives by subgroup, and explain why the model fails.

● Radiologist collaboration. Work with radiologists (US, Indian certified) to define labels, review difficult cases and turn clinical feedback into measurable model improvements.

● Production support. Contribute to packaging validated models as tested inference services (Python, Docker, FastAPI), including unit and regression tests that confirm changes do not alter clinical outputs. Senior engineers lead serving architecture, optimisation and deployment.

job.name: Software Engineer (Go/Python) - Cloud Security Products
job.description:
About ColorTokens

At ColorTokens, we keep enterprises running while they are under attack. Breaches happen — our Xshield™ platform contains them, stopping ransomware and advanced malware from spreading, so that one compromised machine never becomes a compromised business.

AI has changed the odds. Attackers now probe systems, chain weaknesses together and move across a network at machine speed — and more and more of the identities doing it are not human at all. Building the defense against that is why Forrester named ColorTokens a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Microsegmentation Solutions, Q3 2026 — one of only four Leaders, with top marks in nine categories.

Join us in transforming cybersecurity. Learn more at www.colortokens.com.

Our culture

We value customer focus, innovation, collaboration and informed decision-making — and we back it with real autonomy, so you own your initiatives and drive them. Self-starters will enjoy the reward of solving hard problems that protect organizations that matter.

Roles and Responsibility:

Build the code that protects the public cloud.

You will write backend code that reads and changes customers' live AWS, Azure and GCP accounts through their APIs, building the part of Xshield that protects the public cloud.

Instead of installing software on every workload, we connect directly to a customer's cloud environment, map everything running in it and how it all communicates, then use the cloud's own controls to allow only the traffic that should exist. When an attack is detected, we isolate the affected resources in seconds, without taking the rest of the business offline.

It is a small, senior team shipping to some of the largest cloud estates in the world, and you will own what you build from design through to production.

What You Will Work On

  • Discovering a customer’s entire cloud footprint through provider APIs alone — no agents, no installs - across AWS, Azure and GCP.
  • Turning billions of raw cloud network records into a clear, trustworthy picture of which workloads actually talk to each other.
  • Translating security policy into the cloud’s own enforcement controls and applying it safely across live production accounts.
  • One-click isolation of a compromised workload during a live incident — fast enough to matter, precise enough not to break the business.
  • Extending that protection to machine identities and their permissions, so a hijacked workload or a rogue AI agent cannot use its access to spread.

Skills & Requirements

About Us Aplyd works with governments, development partners and institutions to make rural India more prosperous and resilient. Our Sustainable Livelihoods and Prosperity practice combines grounded field research and deep engagement with public institutions with practical technology. Our technology solutions include data, digital public infrastructure, and AI to improve how rural citizens, farmers, SHG members and frontline workers access credit, entitlements, markets and advisory.

We are working on strengthening a national digital platform in the rural ecosystem that helps in the governance, bookkeeping and financial management of community-based organizations (CBO). We would be working closely with the Government and other stakeholders to develop system designs and manage implementation.

Purpose of the Role You will build, test and deploy models for the prioritised AI use cases, set up evaluation and monitoring, and handover working models over to the Government’s technical team. The work focuses on rapid proofs of concept that are validated in in pilots before national adoption, with rigorous evaluation including bias and failure-mode testing.

Key Responsibilities Model development

  • Build proofs of concept for prioritised use cases such as credit-risk assessment, vernacular data entry, business-plan advisory for CBOs and natural-language query for officials.
  • Prepare, clean and engineer features from programme and financial records, working with the data and analytics lead on data quality.
  • Select appropriate approaches, from classical machine learning to NLP, speech and language models, with a preference for practical, cost-effective and explainable solutions.
  • Build for Indian languages and for low-bandwidth, low-end and shared-device contexts.

Evaluation and responsible AI

  • Implement pre-registered evaluation approaches and run independent evaluations in the test beds.
  • Conduct bias, fairness and failure-mode testing, with particular attention to women, low-literacy users and other vulnerable groups.
  • Document models, data, limitations and risks clearly for government review.

Deployment and handover

  • Deploy models with monitoring for performance, drift and usage.
  • Iterate on findings from the first evaluation round and validate at subsequent pilots.
  • Prepare handover documentation and train the government’s technical team to operate and maintain the models.

Essential Qualifications And Experience

job.name: AI Data & Platform Engineer | Senior Associate
job.description:
About Interpath Interpath is an independent financial advisory business with a broad range of specialisms, operating in an agile, independent and conflict-free setting. We offer a full spectrum of restructuring services, from business performance improvement and value creation through to stress, distress and insolvency. Our advisory practice also includes corporate finance, transaction services, valuations, debt advisory, tax, pensions, forensic accounting and e-discovery. We help clients create, defend, preserve, sustain and grow value through the cycle, working with businesses and their stakeholders across the market, from regional SMEs to large, complex multinational organisations.

About The AI CoE Interpath's AI Centre of Excellence designs and builds AI solutions with practices across the firm, taking high-impact use cases from idea to production. The India team is small and hands-on: five people — an AI CoE Lead, two AI Engineers, a Data & Platform Engineer and an AI Business Partner — working as one squad with the Head of AI and practice teams across the firm.

About The Role In professional-services AI, much of the work is getting the right information out of documents and systems. You will own that work (ingestion, extraction, pipelines and retrieval) and the shared platform the team deploys onto, working with central IT, who own the wider cloud environment.

Requirements *Key responsibilities*

  • Ingest and extract — build pipelines that bring in documents (PDF, Word, Excel, scanned files) and data from practice systems; handle OCR, parsing, tables and metadata
  • Build the retrieval layer — chunking, embeddings, indexing and search, tuned for accuracy on our documents
  • Protect data — enforce access permissions, confidentiality boundaries between clients and engagements, retention and audit
  • Run the platform — deployment pipelines, environments, secrets, a shared model gateway, logging and monitoring
  • Manage cost and performance — track model and cloud spend; use caching, model routing and capacity planning to keep it efficient
  • Partner with central IT — network, identity and cloud landing-zone requirements
  • Keep data trustworthy — data quality checks, lineage and documentation

*Required qualifications*

  • 3+ years in data engineering, with platform or DevOps responsibilities
  • Strong Python and SQL; experience building production data pipelines
  • Document processing experience (PDF parsing, OCR, Azure AI Document Intelligence or similar)
  • Cloud infrastructure, ideally Azure: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, containers, monitoring
  • Solid understanding of data security, access control and privacy

Preferred (nice To Have)

  • Vector databases and RAG pipelines in production
  • LLMOps: model gateways, observability tooling, cost tracking
  • Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or Synapse; SharePoint / Graph API data access

job.name: Senior Director, AI Strategy & Support Innovation
job.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description About the Role

Sprinklr is seeking a visionary and results-oriented Senior Director, AI Strategy & Support Innovation to lead the transformation of our Support organization through Artificial Intelligence.

This leader will define and execute the long-term AI strategy for Support, serving as the key connection point between Support, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and business stakeholders. The role is responsible for identifying opportunities where AI can improve customer outcomes, increase operational efficiency, enhance employee productivity, and drive scalable growth across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in Support Operations, Product Strategy, AI-enabled transformation, and executive stakeholder management. They are equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy, influencing product roadmaps, building governance frameworks, and driving organizational adoption of innovative technologies.

This is a highly visible leadership role with direct accountability for the vision, roadmap, governance, adoption, and measurable business impact of AI initiatives across Support.

AI Strategy & Vision

  • Define and maintain a multi-year AI strategy and roadmap for the Support organization.
  • Identify emerging AI technologies and assess their potential impact on customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
  • Develop investment and prioritization frameworks to ensure focus on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Establish a long-term vision for AI-powered support capabilities, including intelligent automation, agent assistance, self-service,knowledge intelligence, and autonomous support solutions.

Product & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Business Operations teams to influence priorities and accelerate AI innovation.
  • Translate support challenges and opportunities into scalable AI-powered solutions.
  • Serve as an executive-level advocate for Support requirements within broader company AI initiatives.
  • Drive alignment between Support's strategic objectives and enterprise AI investments.

  • Establish integration design patterns and governance standards.

*Required Qualifications:*

  • SQL + ETL tools explicitly
  • Data modeling + transformation experience.
  • Experience with integration frameworks (REST, SSO, middleware).
  • Experience leading implementations or technical workstreams.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

  • Experience with UI-related enhancements (e.g., implementing configuration changes that affect screens, workflows, or user experiences).
  • Familiarity with common SaaS deployment practices, release cycles, and support/incident workflows.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages commonly used alongside JSON (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or C#).
  • Experience using API testing tools and log/telemetry sources to diagnose issues.

*Success In This Role:* You’ll be effective when you can consistently turn JSON-driven requirements into reliable platform updates and when you can support production operations by quickly diagnosing issues, fixing defects, and communicating resolutions.

job.name: People Science Associate
job.description:
What if you could shape the science behind how the world discovers talent?

We're looking for a People Science Associate at Unstop to build, validate, and improve the assessments behind our products. You will own your workstreams from start to finish. You will design competency-based simulations and cognitive tasks, use generative AI to speed up test development, and evaluate AI-based scoring, while holding every item and score to rigorous psychometric standards.

What you'll own:

  • Own competency modelling projects, including SME interviews, critical-incident workshops, and job-analysis surveys.
  • Design and validate competency-based simulations (e.g., caselets, situational judgement tests, in-basket exercises, role plays), cognitive tasks, and psychometric tests, including scoring rubrics and rating scales.
  • Use generative AI to draft and refine items and simulation content, then review, pilot, and analyse every generated item for quality, bias, and fit to the construct.
  • Build and evaluate AI-based scoring by preparing rubrics and rated data, comparing machine scores with expert ratings, and checking for subgroup differences.
  • Run analyses and validation studies with partner organisations, and deliver norms, validity, and fairness reports.
  • Write client reports, technical documentation, and turn assessment specs into product requirements for engineering.

Requirements:

  • Master's degree in Industrial/Organisational Psychology or a related field.
  • 1 year of work experience in assessment, people analytics, or applied research.
  • Experience creating a psychometric test or competency-based exercise (e.g., situational judgement test, caselet, in-basket exercise).
  • Experience building and validating cognitive tasks (e.g., attention, working memory, or reasoning tasks).
  • Experience with data analysis in R, Python, or SPSS, including reliability analysis and EFA/CFA.
  • Experience using generative AI tools for assessment or research work

Good to have:

  • Experience with item response theory, SEM, or cluster analysis, and tools such as mirt, Winsteps, lavaan, or Mplus.
  • Experience with AI-based scoring methods (e.g., NLP or LLM-based scoring of text, machine-learning models) and validating machine scores against human ratings.
  • Experience with Python for NLP or machine learning (e.g., scikit-learn, Hugging Face) or with LLM APIs.
  • Knowledge of cognitive psychology paradigms (e.g., n-back, Stroop, flanker, task-switching) and research methods, including study and questionnaire design.
  • Exposure to assessment or development centres, or to training development or instructional design.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise, and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent writing skills for technical and general audiences.

If this opportunity interests you, feel free to reach out to us at careers@unstop.com and share your portfolio of work.

job.name: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Python)
job.description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity.

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Our Mumbai office was launched in 2024, marking an exciting new chapter for us. We’re building the team with people who are eager to shape something from the ground up — combining the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a startup with the backing and reach of a global brand.

Job Description

We are looking for a skilled Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Python) for our Mumbai location. This role involves developing scalable, high-performing web applications for our AI-powered SaaS solutions. You will work across frontend and backend systems, building intuitive user interfaces using React and robust backend services using Python, while collaborating closely with product, design, DevOps, and engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Frontend Development: Develop and optimize responsive, user-friendly interfaces using ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs.

Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.

API Development & Integration: Build, maintain, and optimize RESTful APIs; integrate frontend applications with backend services, databases, and third-party platforms.

Database Management: Work with SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB, ensuring data integrity, performance, and scalability.

Performance Optimization: Improve frontend rendering, application responsiveness, backend performance, and API reliability.

Code Integrity: Maintain and improve code quality through unit testing, integration testing, automation, documentation, and code reviews.

Containerization & Cloud Deployment: Use Docker and Kubernetes to deploy and manage containerized applications. Work with GCP, AWS, or Azure for cloud deployment and application management.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize Terraform and Helm to manage cloud infrastructure and ensure scalable, efficient deployment environments.

CI/CD Management: Contribute to continuous integration and deployment processes, including test automation, build artifact creation, and application releases.

Qualifications

3–6 years of software development experience, with hands-on experience in full stack development using ReactJS and Python.
