job.name: Javascript Developer
job.description:
Company Description

LekhaHR is a Bengaluru-based HR and payroll software platform designed for small Indian businesses, offering attendance, leave, and payroll with PF, ESI, PT, and TDS in a single, transparent pricing model. Organizations pay only for active employees, with no base or setup fees, and HR/admin users included at no extra cost. The product is built specifically for Indian rules, clearly showing the logic and dates behind every payroll figure, leave balance, and attendance status. New customers can sign up with a work email at lekhahr.in and receive a 30-day free trial with free setup and data migration from other systems. LekhaHR currently runs in mobile browsers, with a native mobile app coming soon.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a JavaScript Developer at LekhaHR. The JavaScript Developer will build and maintain web-based features for the HR and payroll platform, focusing on clean, performant, and reliable code. Day-to-day responsibilities include implementing user interfaces, integrating front-end components with back-end APIs, troubleshooting and resolving technical issues, and collaborating with product and design teams to refine user flows. The role also involves writing unit and integration tests, optimizing performance across browsers and devices, and contributing to technical documentation and code reviews.

Qualifications

  • Strong JavaScript and Software Development skills, with experience building and maintaining production web applications.
  • Front-End Development skills, including modern JavaScript frameworks or libraries and application state management (such as Redux.js).
  • Back-End Web Development skills, including working with RESTful APIs, data handling, and basic server-side concepts.
  • Experience with HTML, CSS, and responsive design, ensuring accessibility and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, communicate clearly, and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with payroll, HR systems, or Indian compliance workflows is a plus.

job.name: Software Engineer II — Backend (Kirana Club)
job.description:
About The Team We're a small engineering team, so scope is wide and ownership is real. You'll ship to production in your first week, and every week after that.

Every engineering role here is back-end-leaning fullstack. Most of your time goes into services, data models and APIs, but you own your work all the way to the screen — and the screen should look like someone cared. If frontend hasn't been your main thing, that gap is far smaller than it used to be.

What we can't teach is taste: the sense of what a good interface feels like, and the instinct to notice when something is confusing, slow or ugly before a user has to tell you.

Everyone here writes code with LLMs — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever works, on the paid tier, and we don't count tokens. Producing code is cheap now, so what we hire for is judgment, verification, specification and taste. One hard rule: you own every line you ship, whether you typed it or not. "The model wrote it" is not an explanation in code review, in a postmortem, or in a design discussion.

About The Role Join us in building technology for the next generation of retail commerce. You will work on real-world product and platform problems, partnering closely with product, business, and operations teams.

What You'll Do

  • Own backend features and systems end-to-end, from understanding the problem to production.
  • Build reliable and scalable services, APIs, and data flows.
  • Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, simplicity, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Debug production issues and improve system reliability.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development while reviewing and validating the output.
  • Work effectively in an environment with ambiguity and changing requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 2.5 - 4.5 years of relevant backend engineering experience.
  • Strong programming fundamentals and hands-on experience with Go or JavaScript
  • Experience building production backend services, APIs, and data-intensive applications.
  • Strong understanding of databases, distributed systems, system design, and backend fundamentals.
  • Good problem-solving, debugging, and ownership skills.
  • Ability to understand product and business context, not just technical requirements.
  • Experience using AI coding tools with the ability to critically evaluate their output.

Good to Have Experience in e-commerce, retail, B2B commerce, marketplaces, fintech, logistics, or other product-led companies.

job.description:
Founded in 2014, Circles is a global technology company reimagining the telco industry with its innovative SaaS platform, empowering telco operators worldwide to effortlessly launch innovative digital brands or refresh existing ones, accelerating their transformation into techcos.

Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e&), AT&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally.

Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses:

It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.
  • Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform-as-a-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide.
  • Jetpac: Specializing in travel tech solutions, Jetpac provides seamless eSIM roaming for over 200 destinations and innovative travel lifestyle products, redefining connectivity for digital travelers. Jetpac was awarded Travel eSIM of the Year.

Circles is backed by renowned global investors, including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia), Warburg Pincus, Founders Fund, and EDBI (the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board), with a track record of backing industry challengers.

job.name: Frontend Intern
job.description:
About TrueFoundry Every production AI system whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions needs the same foundational infrastructure.A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.

That infrastructure layer is being built right now. We're TrueFoundry, and we're building it. We're looking for a Frontend Intern to join our Enginerring team.

The Problem We're Solving Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.

The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct-tape together a few API calls and call it production-ready.

You Need a Control Plane That Handles

  • Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
  • Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
  • Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
  • A unified compute layer to run self-hosted models, custom tools, and agents

We've Built Two Products To Solve This AI Gateway is the control plane five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.

AI Deploy is the compute layer of Kubernetes-based platform that abstracts ML workloads as standard software primitives, so everything runs on unified infrastructure.

We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.

Role Overview We are looking for Frontend Engineering Interns who are excited about building developer-focused products and modern web applications. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams to craft intuitive, high-performance user interfaces for AI/ML platforms used by developers and enterprises globally.

This is a hands-on role where you will ship real features to production.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and improve frontend features for TrueFoundry’s core platform
  • Develop responsive, high-quality UI using modern frontend frameworks
  • Collaborate with backend, design, and product teams to ship end-to-end features
  • Optimize performance, usability, and scalability of the frontend
  • Work on dashboards, developer tools, and AI workflow interfaces
  • Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code
  • Participate in code reviews and engineering discussions

Tech Stack

job.name: Software Engineer I - Backend (Kirana Club)
job.description:
About The Team We're a small engineering team, so scope is wide and ownership is real. You'll ship to production in your first week, and every

week after that.

Every engineering role here is back-end-leaning fullstack. Most of your time goes into services, data models and APIs, but you

own your work all the way to the screen — and the screen should look like someone cared. If frontend hasn't been your main

thing, that gap is far smaller than it used to be. What we can't teach is taste: the sense of what a good interface feels like, and

the instinct to notice when something is confusing, slow or ugly before a user has to tell you.

Everyone here writes code with LLMs — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever works, on the paid tier, and we don't count

tokens. Producing code is cheap now, so what we hire for is judgment, verification, specification and taste. One hard rule: you

own every line you ship, whether you typed it or not. "The model wrote it" is not an explanation in code review, in a

postmortem, or in a design discussion.

About The Role This is a backend-leaning fullstack role, and a high-volume learning one. You'll build and ship features end to end — from the

data model through the API to the screen someone actually uses — writing a lot of code and getting a lot of reviews. You'll be

trusted with production early and work on real problems from your first week. The goal for your first year is simple: to become

someone the team can hand an ambiguous problem to.

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship well-scoped features end to end, including the data model, the API, and the interface that consumes it.
  • Deploy to production several times a week, starting with small changes and growing into larger ones.
  • Debug production issues by reading logs, traces and stack traces, and get to the root cause rather than to a workaround.
  • Build the frontend for the features you own — clean, usable, with the loading, empty and error states actually handled

rather than left for later.

  • Write tests that would genuinely catch the bug you're worried about.
  • Participate in code review on both sides: have your work critiqued, and learn to critique others'.
  • Ask questions early and often. Being stuck quietly for a day is the only real mistake here.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 1 year of full-time experience.
  • Strong fundamentals in at least one programming language. We don't mind which.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational data modelling.
  • Comfort building a working, decent-looking interface for what you build. You don't need to have been a frontend engineer,

but you should be able to tell good UI from bad and care about the difference.

  • Evidence that you've built something real and finished it — a project with actual users, a substantial internship

contribution, or an open-source PR that survived review.

Read the full description

Description We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.

We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it — all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in.

You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.

Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.

Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.

Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.

Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.

Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.

Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.

Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.

Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

Building with agentic AI

job.name: Postdoctoral Research Fellowship in Miniature Multiphoton Optics Design
job.description:
Postdoctoral Research Fellowship in Miniature Multiphoton Optics Design

National Center for Biomedical Imaging and Bioengineering (NCBIB)

University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, MI, United States

Employer Description

PI: Thomas D. Wang, MD, PhD, University of Michigan

The Wang Lab at the University of Michigan is seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral research fellow to lead the optical design, ultrafast fiber delivery, and miniaturization of a flexible, fiber-coupled multiphoton microscope for in vivo imaging of neuronal activity in freely behaving animals. This research is supported by the NIH-funded National Center for Biomedical Imaging and Bioengineering (NCBIB/P41). The instrument incorporates a novel remote-focusing optical architecture consisting of two objectives that introduce equal but opposite optical aberrations, enabling large axial displacements of the focal plane while preserving high spatial resolution. Miniature scanning mechanisms based on parametric resonance and thin-film PZT materials provide lateral beam scanning and remote axial focusing to support horizontal (XY), vertical (XZ), and multi-plane imaging. The central engineering challenge is to transform a benchtop remote-focusing optical system into a compact, lightweight, fiber-coupled microscope suitable for head-mounted or implantable imaging. A key component is the delivery of fs excitation pulses through a flexible specialty optical fiber, such as a hollow-core or photonic-bandgap fiber, while preserving sufficient peak power, spectral quality, and polarization stability for efficient multiphoton excitation under the continuous bending and motion experienced during freely behaving animal imaging. The design will integrate custom micro-optics, specialty optical fibers, polarization control, miniature scanners, and fluorescence collection within a target package of <3 g and 1 cm³. The optical system will target a NA of 0.6–0.8 and a FOV of 200 µm, while maintaining efficient multiphoton excitation and fluorescence collection across the axial scanning range. The successful applicant will have primary responsibility for optical modeling, micro-optical design, femtosecond pulse delivery through specialty fiber, mechanical packaging, and system-level optical integration. The fellow will collaborate with the microsystems engineering group on scanner integration and with other P41 personnel on experimental characterization, instrument control, and preclinical imaging.

Key Responsibilities

1. Remote-focusing optical design: Develop and optimize Zemax models for a reduced two-objective remote-focusing architecture using miniature optical components. Evaluate NA, working distance, FOV, residual aberrations, fluorescence collection efficiency, and performance across the axial scan range.

About CultureMonkey

CultureMonkey is an employee engagement platform used by enterprise companies around the world, including the EU. HR teams and leaders run surveys on it, read the results and decide what to fix. We are a small engineering team, so every engineer owns real features and ships them to production.

The problems you'll work on

  • Anonymity on real HR data. Survey answers have to stay anonymous. Nobody should be able to work out who said what, even by combining filters, comparing groups or getting around minimum group sizes. Getting this right takes care with every report, export and API.
  • Ask Cooper, our AI assistant. Ask Cooper is an LLM assistant that answers leaders' questions about their own survey data. You'll improve how it reasons, which tools it can call, how it is scoped for each role, and how we measure whether its answers are right.
  • Security and privacy for global clients. Enterprise customers, including EU clients, check how we handle their data. You'll build features that hold up to their security reviews.

What you'll do

  • Own features from start to finish: design, build, test, ship and support them in production
  • Build LLM features that run in production: RAG, tool calling, agents, MCP servers and evals
  • Design backend systems and REST APIs on PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch and ClickHouse
  • Review other people's code with an eye on correctness, security and privacy
  • Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor every day to move faster, without letting quality slip

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years building and shipping backend software
  • Strong backend skills in any language. Rails is preferred but not required. If you're strong in Django, Node or Go, you can pick up Rails quickly here.
  • Good system design and SQL skills
  • You have used LLM APIs in real work, not only in demos. You know what MCP, evals and RAG are, and when each one helps.
  • You care about security and privacy and catch problems in code review
  • Some frontend skills (React or Next.js) are a plus

Bonus points

  • Side projects or open source work you can show us
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or enterprise customers
  • Experience building agents or agentic workflows

Why join

  • Hard problems with real users: anonymity, AI on customer data, enterprise security
  • Real ownership. Your work reaches customers within days.
  • A team that uses AI tools heavily and wants you to as well

About the role

Ginesys Insights 2.0 is our next-generation, multi-tenant analytics and reporting platform for India's leading

retail brands. It replaces a third-party BI engine for about 500 customers. It has a governed semantic layer,

engineering team.

Delivery and planning

sure the engineering design supports them.

row-level security, column-level security and masking.

Production readiness

includes Cloud Run, Cloud SQL sizing and connection budgets, Secret Manager and IAM.

  • Set up monitoring, metrics and tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident management and rollback runbooks.
  • Set up release management: versioning, the dev-to-main release train, promotion gates and change

control for database migrations.

  • Set up cost governance for cloud and query usage, including usage metering for billing.

Quality

  • Define and enforce quality gates: coverage thresholds and static analysis; end-to-end tests

(Playwright); automated tenant-isolation tests; and metric reconciliation against control totals from

the ERP source.

  • Set code-review standards and guardrails for AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) so

speed doesn't cost correctness or security.

People and stakeholders

  • Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 engineers across backend and frontend, working with UX/design.

HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

About The Role Hiring is one of the most consequential decisions a company makes. 3,000+ enterprises rely on HackerRank to get it right. We are now reinventing how that works for the agentic era. The AI/ML systems that power this platform are not auxiliary features. They are the product.

Open Problems The agentic era is reshaping every layer of the hiring stack. These are some of the core problems you'll be working across, none of them fully solved.

  • Chakra: Building an autonomous AI interviewer that conducts, adapts to, and evaluates technical interviews end to end.
  • Integrity: Detecting fraud and suspicious behavior across multiple signal types. The ways candidates game assessments change frequently, and the models need to keep up.
  • Evaluation: Measuring technical skill in a world where AI writes the code. The old proxies no longer hold and the new ones have not been defined yet.

Your focus will shift across these depending on where the highest-leverage work is at any given time.

What You Will Do

  • Research, Design, and Develop advanced Deep Learning models and novel Neural architectures.
  • Explore architectures beyond Transformers, including State Space Models (SSMs), Liquid Neural Networks (LNNs), and Hybrid approaches.
  • Design and implement Agentic AI systems, Recursive Reasoning Engines, and tool-augmented architectures.
  • Fine-tuning of models using PEFT (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA etc.), and Knowledge Distillation.
  • Optimize model Performance, Inference Efficiency, Latency, and Memory utilization.

job.name: Data Analytics Engineer III
job.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help define and scale analytics across Experity.

This role will own analytical domains and build semantic models, trusted metrics, reusable datasets, and AI-ready data products. The Senior Analytics Engineer will work across analytics, data engineering, architecture, product, and AI teams to translate ambiguous business needs into scalable analytical solutions.

This is not primarily a dashboard development or traditional reporting role. The focus is creating trusted analytical foundations that can be reused across products, teams, applications, and AI experiences.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical execution with analytical judgment. They can independently work through ambiguity, challenge assumptions, make sound modeling decisions, and improve how analytics is delivered.

What You’ll Do

  • Own assigned analytical domains from requirements clarification through implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.
  • Design and maintain semantic models representing Experity’s products, business processes, and core business entities.
  • Define reusable analytical datasets, governed metrics, and centralized business logic.
  • Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable data products rather than one-off analytical solutions.
  • Determine appropriate data grain, facts, dimensions, conformed entities, and relationships.
  • Make informed decisions about whether business logic belongs in the transformation layer, semantic layer, or consuming application.
  • Develop production-quality transformations using SQL, Python, Snowflake, and dbt.
  • Establish automated testing, documentation, monitoring, and data-quality controls for owned models.
  • Design semantic models, metadata, metric definitions, descriptions, and verified query patterns that enable AI tools and natural-language interfaces to reliably interpret analytical data.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering speed, quality, and consistency.
  • Partner directly with U.S.-based analytics, engineering, product, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and identify tradeoffs.
  • Proactively raise unclear requirements, data quality concerns, architectural risks, and design decisions.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and architects to establish reliable and scalable analytical patterns.
  • Lead analytics-engineering onboarding for new products and business domains.
  • Identify duplicated logic, inconsistent metric definitions, architectural gaps, and opportunities for automation or reuse.
  • Create reusable patterns that can be adopted across domains rather than solving the same problem repeatedly.
  • Review analytical designs and code produced by other engineers and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot complex production, performance, and data-quality issues.

What Success Looks Like

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

job.name: Staff Compiler Performance Engineer
job.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Staff Compiler Performance Engineer to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap.

You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams.

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

  • Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmap
  • Lead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collector
  • Make architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategy
  • Lead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul products
  • Mentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validation
  • Represent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilers

What You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)

  • 8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
  • Track record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in production
  • Expert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebases
  • Deep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code size
  • Expert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture level

Nice to Have

  • Recognized contributions to LLVM or another major compiler: code owner, maintainer or author of significant upstream work
  • Deep experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
  • Experience working closely with runtime and GC teams on speculation, deoptimization and barrier design

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Compiler Performance Engineer
job.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Senior Compiler Performance Engineer to own major performance areas of Falcon. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. Your job is to push its generated code further, deciding which optimizations matter, designing them and delivering measurable speedups on real workloads.

You will work in a distributed team of compiler experts, with direct influence on what Falcon optimizes next.

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

  • Own performance of Falcon for a set of workloads or an optimization area end to end: analysis, design, implementation, validation
  • Design and implement new optimizations and improve existing ones in the middle end and back end: inlining heuristics, loop optimizations, vectorization, escape analysis, speculation and deoptimization, GC barrier and runtime call optimization
  • Drive code generation quality on x86\_64 and AArch64, including bringing Falcon to new hardware platforms
  • Investigate complex performance issues reported by customers and turn findings into compiler improvements
  • Review code, mentor engineers on the team and raise the bar for performance methodology
  • Contribute to upstream LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
  • Strong C++ design and coding skills in large codebases
  • Proven track record of delivering compiler optimizations with measurable performance impact
  • Deep knowledge of compiler optimization theory and its practical tradeoffs: compile time, code size, correctness
  • Strong performance analysis skills: profilers, hardware counters, reading and reasoning about generated assembly

Nice to Have

  • Significant experience with LLVM optimization passes or code generation; LLVM commit access is a plus
  • Experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
  • Deep knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
  • Experience with JVM internals: garbage collection, deoptimization, profiling
  • PhD in Computer Science or significant research experience in compilers

job.description:
About Ema Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Ema builds AI agents that act on sensitive enterprise data and systems. You’ll make sure the agents, and the platform they run on, are secure by design. You’ll build security controls for autonomous agents operating across multi-tenant enterprise environments, including cloud, on-prem and air-gapped deployments. You’ll solve zero-trust problems where the code isn’t static logic but non-deterministic models making live API calls against sensitive customer data. Our agents orchestrate 100+ LLMs, call third-party tools through MCP, execute code in sandboxes and drive headless browsers, and each of those is an attack surface you’ll help define.

Role Overview What you’ll own AI and agent security

  • Threat model new AI agent features before launch: direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration through agent outputs, and over-privileged tool use
  • Design guardrails for agentic workflows: least-privilege tool and connector scopes, human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk actions, and output filtering
  • Enforce tenant and data isolation across retrieval (RAG), context stores, and model calls, so no customer’s data leaks into another’s context
  • Secure the AI supply chain: model and provider vetting, third-party MCP servers and connectors, prompt and config versioning
  • Run AI red-team exercises and build automated adversarial tests (prompt injection suites) into CI

Cloud and platform security

  • Security baselines for Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure: RBAC, network policies, workload identity, secrets management, per-tenant network isolation
  • Security in CI/CD: IaC scanning, SAST and dependency scanning, policy-as-code guardrails

What You’ll Contribute To

  • AI-aware detection with our current technology and tooling: logging prompts, tool calls and agent actions, and alerting on anomalous agent behavior
  • Partner with the Security & Compliance Lead on technical controls and evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA and ISO 42001, plus the NIST AI RMF

job.name: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.

–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.

–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Design performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.

–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..

Role: Lead Python Developer

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing and supporting Python-based bots and automation solutions that integrate with multiple enterprise applications, APIs and databases. The role requires strong technical ownership along with the ability to work closely with Business Analysts, business teams, architects, security teams and upstream/downstream application owners.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable owning an automation solution from requirement → technical design → development → integration → testing → deployment → production support .

Key Responsibilities

1. BOT & Automation Development

  • Design and develop scalable automation solutions using Python .
  • Build bots for business-process automation involving multiple enterprise applications.
  • Develop reusable Python frameworks/components rather than relying on standalone scripts.
  • Automate file processing, data transformation, reconciliation, validations and workflow activities.
  • Implement appropriate exception handling, retries, timeouts and recovery mechanisms.
  • Ensure bot processing is idempotent wherever applicable to prevent duplicate business transactions.
  • Build proper audit trails and transaction-level logging.

2. API & System Integration

The candidate should have strong experience integrating Python applications with:

  • REST APIs
  • SOAP/Web Services where required
  • JSON/XML payloads
  • OAuth 2.0/JWT/API-key authentication
  • Upstream and downstream applications
  • Databases
  • File/SFTP-based interfaces
  • Queues/event-driven systems where applicable

The developer should be capable of understanding flows such as:

Business Process → BOT → Upstream API/Application → Processing/Validation → Downstream API/Application → Response/Reconciliation

Should independently troubleshoot issues such as:

  • HTTP 400/401/403/404/429/500/502/504 errors
  • API timeout
  • Rate limiting
  • Authentication/token failures
  • Payload/data mapping errors
  • Partial downstream processing
  • Duplicate transactions
  • Network/SSL issues
  • Retry and reconciliation failures

3. Technical Leadership

  • Act as technical lead for the BOT development team.
  • Review technical designs and code submitted by developers.
  • Establish Python coding standards and reusable frameworks.
  • Conduct code reviews and mentor junior/mid-level developers.
  • Break requirements into technical components and development tasks.
  • Estimate development effort and support sprint/release planning.
  • Identify design and integration risks early.
  • Ensure technical debt is controlled.
  • Drive RCA and permanent corrective actions for production incidents.

This should remain a hands-on role , with the candidate expected to design, code, review and troubleshoot rather than only coordinate the development team.

About The Role At Abnormal AI, we are on a thrilling mission to safeguard the world's largest enterprises against a vast range of relentless email and collaboration application cyber security attacks. Our relentless pursuit involves crafting an exceptional suite of products that empowers customers to seamlessly visualize, expertly control, and fearlessly combat cyber-security threats.

The Multi-Product Platform (MPP) organization owns the product platform that enables scalable product development, helping the business build and launch enterprise-grade products with a consistent customer experience.

This is a chance to build the data backbone that every Abnormal product depends on. As a Software Engineer on MPP, you'll create the standardised data layer that becomes our single source of truth — the one governed path through which any system, agent, or interface can reach data from across every product, from a single record to cross-product aggregates, online or offline, in whatever shape it needs. It's a genuinely hard, high-leverage problem: the layer has to serve the entire platform at high throughput and low latency without ever becoming the bottleneck, while enforcing tenant isolation, authentication, and fine-grained access control so every team inherits strong security and reliability for free. You won't be maintaining someone else's system — you'll be defining the foundation every product is built on, where getting it right compounds across the whole company.

If you're energized by 0→1 platform work, driving cross-team standards, and owning a system end-to-end, this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence

  • Design, build, and iterate on the APIs and services that make up the standardized data access layer.
  • Drive adoption of API-gated data sources, so product teams expose their data once and every consuming surface can reuse it, instead of building one-off integrations.
  • Design and implement standard labeling for data ownership, and build the validation logic that checks incoming requests against it.
  • Own the reliability and stability of the components and features you build.
  • Contribute to the team's architectural decisions, and write technical design documents for the areas you own.

job.name: Senior Consultant - Oracle Fusion Financials
job.description:
Job Description We are seeking a hands-on Principal Oracle Consultant to support the deployments, enhancements, and day-to-day maintenance of our Oracle Cloud applications. In this role, additionally in this role you will bridge the gap between technical teams and business users by writing clear functional specifications, and resolving user queries. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional to gain hands-on experience in full system lifecycle management.

Responsibilities

  • Systems Deployment Support
  • Assist in the planning, configuration, testing, and rollout to new regions and/or acquisitions and involvement with system upgrades.
  • Assist as needed with testing, documenting test results, and log defects during user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Support data migration activities, including data validation and reconciliation.
  • System Enhancements
  • Gather requirements from stakeholders for enhancements (e.g., new reports, customizations, workflow changes).
  • Write functional specifications (MD50, BR100, or similar) that clearly define business rules, logic, and reporting needs for technical developers.
  • Assist in impact analysis to determine how proposed changes affect existing processes.
  • User Query Resolution & Support
  • Serve as the first point of contact for end-user questions related to Oracle functionality (e.g., PO, AP, GL, OM modules).
  • Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes (user error, setup, or data issues), and provide solutions or workarounds.
  • Log and track service requests with Oracle Support when necessary.

Qualifications Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
  • 6+ years of experience with Oracle applications
  • Exposure to Oracle EBS (R12) or Oracle Fusion Cloud is essential.

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Basic understanding of Oracle database concepts (SQL querying is a plus).
  • Ability to write and interpret functional specifications (experience with templates a bonus).
  • Familiarity with at Oracle Financials modules with addition of other areas of experience such as HCM, PPM, Sales advantageous
  • Understanding of system deployment lifecycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication – able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
  • Analytical problem-solving with attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced deployment environment.
  • Collaborative team player who can work with developers, project managers, and business users.

Do you love working with numbers and data?

As a Junior Analyst at Team Everest , you will help organize, clean, and analyze data to support different teams. Your work will ensure data is accurate, structured, and useful for decision-making.

job.description:

We are seeking several highly skilled Data Analyst to join our teams to design, develop, and deliver AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency and decision-making across our business.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams to apply artificial intelligence, generative AI, and machine learning to real-world industrial challenges, helping accelerate innovation, productivity, and operational excellence.

A defining part of the role is technical judgment; choosing the right tool for each problem: classical machine learning, deep learning, GenAI, or pure software development when needed

Job Description Key Responsibilities AI & ML Solution Development & Integration

  • Design, develop, and implement AI solutions, including generative AI, machine learning models, neural networks, and optimization algorithms, to improve business process efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Select the appropriate modelling approach for each problem and articulate the trade-offs behind that choice.
  • Own the machine learning lifecycle: dataset construction, metrics definition, acceptance criteria in accordance with the stakeholders needs, evaluation strategies.
  • Translate business and operational needs into scalable AI-enabled tools, applications, and workflows.
  • Support the deployment and integration of AI/ML models into existing business and technical systems, software environments, and products where applicable, including monitoring for drift, performance degradation, and running cost.

Technical Implementation & Architecture

  • Collaborate with domain experts to identify high-value use cases and define technical requirements for AI solutions.
  • Define and document the solution architecture end to end: from data sources to the integration with the existing enterprise and technical IT landscape.
  • Design cloud-ready and on-premises solutions aligned with company IT, cybersecurity and data-governance standards.
  • Integrate AI/ML capabilities into hardware, software, and business process ecosystems in a way that supports reliability, usability, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to the development of robust, production-ready AI solutions suitable for industrial environments.

Solution Delivery, Partner & Contractor Management

job.name: Vice President, Specialist, Model Validation, Risk Management Group
job.description:
Job Purpose We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled individual to lead the Model Validation function with Risk Management Group. The successful candidate will be responsible for independently validating a diverse range of credit risk models used across both wholesale and retail banking businesses. This role involves assessing model design, data quality, implementation, and ongoing performance to ensure models are fit for purpose, compliant with regulatory requirements, and effectively manage financial risk.

Key Accountabilities and Requirements:

  • Independent Model Validation: Conduct end-to-end independent validation of credit risk models, including but not limited to:
  • Wholesale Banking Models: PD, LGD, EAD models for corporate, commercial real estate, and other institutional exposures; stress testing models; counterparty credit risk models; credit rating models
  • Retail Banking Models: PD, LGD, EAD models for mortgages, auto loans, credit cards, personal loans; application scorecards, behavioral scorecards, collections models.
  • Methodology Review: Critically evaluate model development methodologies, underlying assumptions, conceptual soundness, and quantitative techniques.
  • Data Quality Assessment: Assess the quality, completeness, and appropriateness of data used in model development and ongoing monitoring.
  • Implementation Review: Verify the accurate and robust implementation of models within relevant systems.
  • Performance Monitoring: Review and challenge ongoing model performance monitoring frameworks and results, including backtesting, benchmarking, and sensitivity analysis.
  • Governance and Policy: Establish Governance processes and Model validation Policy in line with local regulatory and group requirements.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Prepare comprehensive validation reports detailing findings, limitations, recommendations, and conclusions. Present findings to model owners, developers, and relevant committees.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure models and validation practices comply with internal policies and external regulatory requirements (e.g., SR 11-7, CECL, IFRS 9, Basel Accords).
  • Challenging Model Development: Proactively engage with model developers to provide constructive challenge and guidance throughout the model lifecycle.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate effectively with model development teams, risk management functions, business lines, internal audit, and regulators.
  • Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the enhancement of validation processes, methodologies, and tools.

Required Experience

Job Description About BNP Paribas India Solutions:

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

About BNP Paribas Group BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

The role provides an opportunity to get involved in activities that help develop and deliver Deloitte’s thought leadership and client briefings in the power and utilities sector (P&U) and renewable energy (RE) industry. A self-motivated individual who is accustomed to working well in a close-knit team would be a good fit. The overall R&I group’s objective is to develop compelling and forward-looking perspectives that allow clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” The perspectives are formed by regular scanning and analysis of shaping trends, industry and company level developments, and regulatory environment. The group plays an integral role in strengthening the firm's strategic positioning in the marketplace and through end-to-end development of high-quality thoughtware.

Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices. job.name: DART Market Risk Reporting- Lead Analyst, Vice President
job.description:
As Vice President, Market Risk Reporting at Citi, you will shape how the organization understands, monitors, and communicates its exposure to credit, market, and operational risk across global portfolios. Working within Citi's independent risk management function, you will analyze complex risk data, build clear regulatory reports, and deliver insights that inform decisions made by senior leaders and regulators. This is an opportunity to directly influence how one of the world's largest banks manages risk and meets regulatory expectations such as FR Y-14.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyze market, credit, and operational risk exposure across Citi's portfolios, identifying trends and emerging risks early.
  • Prepare and present risk reporting packages covering portfolio concentrations, limit exceptions, stress testing results, and loss reserves for internal and regulatory audiences.
  • Deliver regulatory reporting, including FR Y-14 submissions, Credit Bureau Reporting, and other time-sensitive regulatory and audit requests.
  • Design interactive data visualizations and dashboards that translate complex risk data into clear insights for senior management and regulators.
  • Partner with risk and portfolio managers, Finance, and Technology teams to source accurate data and maintain quality and consistency across reports.
  • Develop risk mitigation strategies and policy recommendations in collaboration with stakeholders across multiple business units.
  • Build corrective action plans alongside Internal Audit to address control gaps and strengthen compliance with MCA, BCBS, and EUC standards.
  • Mentor junior analysts, reviewing their work for accuracy and supporting their professional growth.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Background in risk reporting or risk analysis across credit, market, or operational risk portfolios.
  • 8+ relative experience in related roles
  • Knowledge of regulatory reporting frameworks such as FR Y-14, BCBS, and Management Control Assessment standards.
  • Skilled in building data visualizations and reports that translate complex risk data into actionable insights.
  • Strong analytical capability to interpret stress testing results, limit exceptions, and loss reserve data.
  • Capable of collaborating across Risk, Finance, and Technology teams to source, validate, and maintain data quality.
  • Comfortable mentoring junior analysts and reviewing their work for quality and accuracy.
  • Clear, confident communicator able to present risk findings to senior management and regulators.

What We Offer At Citi, you'll work at the center of global risk management, helping to safeguard one of the world's most interconnected banks while growing your expertise alongside experienced risk professionals.

job.name: Workflow Redesign Lead
job.description:
Job Description As Workflow Redesign Lead in the AI Transformation program, you will re-engineer processes for the Delivery & Operations (D&O) or Services organization - mapping current states, designing frictionless AI-enabled workflows, and defining success KPIs. You will own the redesign methodology and opportunity pipeline while collaborating closely with SMEs, engineering, architecture, and business/IT stakeholders.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

  • Lead end-to-end process and workflow redesign initiatives within AI Transformation Program, from discovery and design through to adoption and benefits tracking.
  • Map current-state processes and workflows with business teams, particularly in the Delivery and Operations (D&O) or Services organization, identifying pain points, hand-offs, bottlenecks, rework and automation opportunities.
  • Design target-state processes and workflows, including where AI/data platforms and agent tooling can remove effort, improve quality and speed up decisions.
  • Define workflow KPIs and baselines (e.g. cycle time, quality, cost, throughput), and track and report the outcomes of each redesign.
  • Plan and facilitate SME workshops, interviews and working sessions to capture expert knowledge, challenge assumptions and build consensus on the target state.
  • Identify and prioritize redesign opportunities, build business cases, and align engineering, product, IT and business stakeholders on scope and sequencing.
  • Translate target-state designs into clear requirements for the Chief Architect and engineering team, and drive change management and adoption with process owners.
  • Establish standard methods, templates and playbooks for process redesign, and mentor others in applying them.

Key Skills And Experience You have:

  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree with experience (typically 8+ years) in process reengineering, workflow redesign, business process management or operational excellence.
  • Experience in current-state mapping using BPMN, value stream mapping, or process mining, with the ability to design target-state workflows and translate them into tooling and engineering requirements.
  • Experience working in or with a Delivery and Operations or Services organization, such as care, customer project management or customer engineering teams.
  • Experience defining workflow KPIs, setting baselines and measuring the outcomes of process change.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, manage change and drive adoption across multiple organizations.

Nice to have:

  • Lean, Six Sigma or similar process-improvement certification.
  • Experience with process modelling, process mining or workflow automation tools.
  • Experience redesigning workflows to incorporate AI, automation or agents and change management or adoption experience or certification (e.g. Prosci).

Read the full description

job.name: Food & Beverage Director – Strategy & Performance
job.description:
Organization- India Consultancy Private Limited Summary Position Summary The F&B Director – Strategy & Performance will establish the planning, reporting, analytical and performance-management discipline for regional F&B.

The role will provide accurate and timely insight into portfolio performance, support budget and forecast processes, maintain regional KPIs and tools, coordinate improvement plans and prepare executive-level materials for decision-making.

Regional F&B Strategy and Annual Planning

  • Support the Director of F&B in preparing the annual F&B strategy and operating plan.
  • Translate strategic priorities into measurable initiatives, targets and milestones.
  • Coordinate inputs from Culinary, FOH/Bar, Events, Marketing and hotels.
  • Prepare strategic analysis, business cases and recommendations.
  • Track progress against annual priorities and identify emerging risks and opportunities.

Budgeting, Forecasting and Financial Planning

  • Coordinate the regional F&B budget and forecast process.
  • Establish planning timelines, templates, assumptions and submission requirements.
  • Review hotel submissions for completeness, consistency and commercial logic.
  • Analyse forecast changes, gaps and variances.
  • Partner with Finance to reconcile F&B reporting with official financial results.

KPI, Reporting and Performance Management

  • Define and maintain regional F&B KPIs and reporting standards.
  • Produce weekly flashes, monthly performance packs and quarterly reviews.
  • Lead benchmarking across hotels, outlets and markets.
  • Provide clear explanations of performance drivers and variances.
  • Ensure reports are accurate, timely, concise and decision-oriented.

Portfolio Improvement and Performance Enablement

  • Coordinate structured improvement plans for underperforming hotels or outlets.
  • Support hotels in diagnosing revenue, cost, productivity, control and profitability gaps.
  • Establish baselines, targets and benefits for improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor implementation progress and escalate delays.
  • Evaluate whether interventions are producing measurable results.

P&L, Business Cases and Commercial Analysis

  • Partner with Finance on F&B P&L delivery, business cases, capex and return-on-investment analysis.
  • Analyse revenue, profitability, food cost, beverage cost, labour productivity and outlet performance.
  • Highlight risks to revenue, profitability, cost and productivity.
  • Provide recommendations to improve commercial outcomes.
  • Support strategic projects, openings, conversions and repositioning initiatives with financial analysis.

Systems, Tools and Digital Enablement

  • Partner with IT and systems teams on F&B reporting and operating tools.
  • Improve data availability, accuracy, consistency and usability.
  • Support dashboard, reporting and automation initiatives.
  • Ensure hotel teams understand reporting requirements and tools.
  • Promote practical use of data in operating decisions.

This is a senior commercial strategy role for leaders who can combine the discipline of top-tier consulting with practical business judgment. You will lead multi-disciplinary teams, work directly with senior market executives and franchise partners, and convert analytics into tangible actions that improve transactions, AUV, consumer value and unit economics.

Omnichannel Growth Unit Economics & EBITDA Executive Workshops Team & Capability Building

job.name: Commercial Analyst
job.description:
About The Role This is an early-career commercial strategy and analytics role for candidates who enjoy structured problem solving, working with data and turning analysis into a clear business recommendation. You will work in a consulting-style project environment alongside NRM Strategy, Finance, Consumer Insights and Data & Revenue Science teams, supporting projects from problem definition through executive-ready recommendations.

The role is especially suited to high-potential candidates from leading Indian business schools, consulting/analytics teams, commercial finance or consumer businesses who want broad exposure to Revenue Growth Management (RGM), strategic pricing and growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end NRM engagements by helping define the problem statement, build issue trees, develop hypotheses, identify the analyses required and structure workstreams.
  • Analyze sales, transactions, traffic, average order value, mix, realized price, product and store performance across categories, channels, dayparts, occasions and customer/group-size segments.
  • Conduct core NRM analyses including menu architecture, price ladders, Good-Better-Best tiers, A La Carte / Everyday Value / Disruptive Value performance, KVI strategy, promotional effectiveness, competitor pricing and channel economics.
  • Evaluate cost of sales (COS%), contribution margin, unit economics and product profitability to identify growth opportunities that improve both consumer value and franchisee economics.
  • Clean, validate, reconcile and manipulate large datasets in Excel; use pivot tables, lookups, formulas and scenario analyses to turn raw data into decision-ready outputs.
  • Decode consumer research and survey results to understand value perception, willingness to pay, Key Value Items, occasions, channel preferences and pricing thresholds.
  • Partner with the Data & Revenue Science team on outputs such as elasticity, market basket, tiering and optimization; translate technical results into commercial insights and a clear "so what" for the business.
  • Build client-ready PowerPoint pages, charts and exhibits with answer-first headlines, clear logic and strong visual storytelling.
  • Support stakeholder interviews, market working sessions and workshops; capture inputs, synthesize themes and convert discussion into actions.
  • Own defined analyses or workstreams with strong attention to detail, process discipline, deadlines and output quality.

Qualifications

job.name: Senior Commercial Analyst
job.description:
About The Role The Senior Commercial Analyst is the bridge between analysis and decision-making. You will independently lead major NRM modules, synthesize multiple sources of evidence into a coherent answer, and work directly with market and brand stakeholders to shape practical commercial recommendations.

This role is designed for experienced industry hires and ex-consultants who want to combine consulting-style problem solving with direct ownership of Revenue Growth Management decisions. Strong candidates may come from strategy consulting, RGM/pricing, commercial finance, consumer insights, revenue analytics, category strategy or other growth-oriented roles.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead one or more analytical / strategy modules within global NRM engagements across strategic pricing, value architecture, menu optimization, consumer strategy, channel economics, promotions and unit economics.
  • Structure ambiguous commercial problems into hypotheses, issue trees, analytical workplans and clear decision questions; guide analysts and specialists on the work required to answer them.
  • Synthesize transaction data, consumer research, competitor intelligence, cost and P&L information, market context and revenue science outputs into a single commercial point of view.
  • Develop strategic pricing and revenue recommendations using evidence from realized price, price ladders, elasticity, market basket, willingness-to-pay research, competitive price indices, margin and traffic risk.
  • Shape menu and value architecture across ALC, Everyday Value, Disruptive Value, Good-Better-Best tiers, group sizes, dayparts and channels; identify gaps, cannibalization, trade-up and premiumization opportunities.
  • Quantify opportunity size and business impact, connecting recommendations to transactions, SSSG/SSTG, AUV, revenue, COS%, contribution margin, unit economics and EBITDA through scenario and sensitivity analysis.
  • Lead stakeholder interviews, working sessions and workshops with Marketing, Finance, Operations, Digital, Insights and market leadership; build alignment around the answer and the actions required.
  • Own executive-ready storylines, presentations and recommendation pages, ensuring every analysis connects to a clear "so what", "now what" and financial ambition.
  • Partner closely with the Data & Revenue Science pod to frame model requirements, challenge outputs and ensure analytical results are commercially interpretable and actionable.
  • Coach Commercial Analysts, raise the quality bar on analyses and slides, and build reusable NRM frameworks, playbooks and thought leadership.

Capability Ownership

Senior Commercial Analysts are expected to build distinctive depth in a Primary NRM capability while developing a Secondary capability. Examples include Strategic Pricing, Consumer & Value, Menu / Merchandising, Commercial Finance, Channel / Digital, or Operations / Unit Economics.

job.name: Back End Engineer
job.description:
Primary Skillset: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, ScyllaDB & PostgreSQL, Redis, Microservices, Agentic AI Systems

Years of Work Ex: 1 - 3 yrs

Minimum Qualifications: Bachelors in Computer Science, Engineering or similar

Location: Nariman Point, Mumbai

Timings: 10am - 7pm; Monday to Friday

Work Type: On-Site, 5 days a week

Company Description:

PaisaSmart is the operating brand name for Elixir Equities Pvt. Ltd. (EEPL), a financial services firm with operations in Prop Trading, Stock Broking, Portfolio Management & Mutual Fund distribution, and over 20 years in wealth management under founders who are recognised industry leaders.

Our mission is to build wealth for the next 100m Indians. PaisaSmart is how - a WhatsApp chatbot and an Android/iOS app that make investing simple for people who have never invested.

We ship fast. We work under broker, RA, PMS and MFD licences, so we ship fast without being careless with other people's money - doing both is the actual job.

Our values are humility, curiosity and passion. Socials: YT | Insta | LinkedIn. Try the product: message 8808990978 on WhatsApp.

Application Process:

1. Apply on our site. Screening happens immediately by our AI agent, no waiting immediate pass/fail.
2. One day of in-person interviews at our offices (you select a date & time) with the founder and team.
3. If we like you we make a decision immediately and share an offer.

What You'll Own:

  • The Chatbot and Agentic Backend: Some of the services behind our WhatsApp chatbot and our mobile app. Conversation state, tool calls, LLM integrations and the structured responses users see are yours to build and improve.
  • Your Own Microservices: Two or three services, yours from design to production from the first month. You decide how they are built and you answer for how they run.
  • The Data Layer: Schema and query design across ScyllaDB, PostgreSQL and Redis, including the concurrency problems that appear when several services write the same record.
  • Production: You deploy your services to Kubernetes on AWS, and you read the logs, metrics and traces when they misbehave.

How We Work:

  • Small team, highly collaborative but individual responsibilities. Growth isn't gated on tenure. If you can do the next job, you get it.
  • You work directly with the founder. No layer in between, nobody to hide behind. No office politics, no blame games, direct visibility.
  • High responsibility, high level of freedom, minimal guidance. Find a problem, design a solution, fix it. You own your work end to end, including when something goes wrong at 9pm.
  • If you're right you're right. No hierarchy, no "do it cause the boss said so". Best argument wins, regardless of who made it.
  • Everyone is expected to do 2-3 different tasks. With AI tooling enabling us to learn and do more than ever before come in with one core skillset and learn & apply 1-2 completely new skills with us.

job.name: Network Analyst
job.description:
Company Description Clear InfoSec is a minority and women owned cybersecurity company headquartered in New York City, with a strong global presence. Established in 2017, the organization has built a reputation as a trusted authority in comprehensive information security services across diverse industries. The team specializes in secure software development, secure IT and communications architecture, infrastructure design and implementation, digital transformation, and a wide spectrum of security assessments. Clear InfoSec holds ISO 27001 certification, reflecting adherence to internationally recognized security standards and a rigorous approach to protecting digital assets. The company is committed to proactive, innovative cybersecurity solutions that help clients stay ahead of evolving threats.

Role Description This is a contract, hybrid Network Analyst role based in Mumbai, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. The Network Analyst will monitor, analyze, and maintain network performance across on-premises and cloud environments to ensure availability, reliability, and scalability. Responsibilities include configuring and supporting routers, switches, firewalls, and other network devices, as well as documenting network architecture, changes, and procedures. The role involves diagnosing and resolving network incidents, coordinating with internal teams and vendors, and providing technical support for connectivity, performance, and security issues. The Network Analyst will also assist in implementing network security controls, performing periodic reviews, and recommending improvements aligned with Clear InfoSec’s security standards and client requirements.

Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Network Administration and Network Infrastructure design, configuration, and maintenance.
  • Demonstrated Troubleshooting and Technical Support skills for diagnosing and resolving complex network issues.
  • Solid Network Security capabilities, including implementing security controls, managing firewalls, and supporting secure architectures.
  • Relevant experience with TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, routing and switching protocols, and cloud networking (e.g., AWS, Azure) is beneficial.
  • Working knowledge of network monitoring tools, ticketing systems, and documentation best practices is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNA, Network+, or security-focused credentials (e.g., CompTIA Security+) are an advantage.
  • Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, and adapt to a fast-paced, security-focused environment.

job.name: Verification Applications Engineer
job.description:
Alternate Job Titles

  • Verification Applications Engineer
  • Customer Success Engineer, Verification
  • Technical Applications Engineer, EDA
  • Field Applications Engineer, Simulation and Debug
  • Verification Support Engineer

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You Are

You have spent time in verification environments where the difference between a clean tape-out and a schedule slip often comes down to how fast someone can debug a simulation failure at 2am. You know your way around SystemVerilog testbenches, and you have stared at waveforms long enough to spot the signal toggle that should not be there. You are the person teammates come to when something breaks in a way that does not make sense yet.

Working directly with customers energizes you. You do not just want to hand over a solution, you want to understand the problem first, ask the right questions, and propose something that actually fits their flow. You are comfortable on a call with a design team in another timezone, walking through a debug scenario or explaining why a coverage hole matters.

You learn fast. New methodologies, new tools, new customer designs, you adapt without needing six months of ramp time. At Synopsys, you will work with verification engineers who are solving real problems on real chips, and the solutions you help deliver will directly affect whether those chips make it to production on time.

What You'll Be Doing
