job.name: Browser Automation & Agent Engineer
job.description:
About Birdeye Inc. Birdeye builds AI coworkers for multi-location brands. Jay for marketing, Myna for operations, and Robin for customer experience orchestrate AI agents to win AI visibility, book appointments, and drive consistent CX at every location. They run on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3,000+ integrations. BirdAI consolidates every signal, reasons with industry, brand and location context, and acts autonomously or with a human in the loop.

Birdeye is trusted by the world's largest multi-location brands across healthcare, dental, restaurants, financial services, auto, retail, and property management. G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye.com.

What You’ll Own Agents that log into real third-party sites (Facebook, GBP, CRMs) and take real actions on a customer’s behalf, wherever no official API exists — a backend pipeline through to the approval UI a human clicks before anything goes live.

What You’ll Do

  • Job-dispatch pipeline: dispatch/poll/stall-detection (by activity gaps, not elapsed time) and safe retries
  • 2FA/human-in-the-loop checkpoints: live browser handoff + auto-resume, built conservatively (we’ve shipped and fixed two real bugs here: a runaway auto-resume loop, a stale session retrying a dead login)
  • Credential handling: domain-locked secret injection, secrets never reach the LLM’s own context or logs
  • An independent “judge” layer that verifies what an agent actually did, not what it claims — plus real cost/quality calls across models (cheapest model measured was also the most reliable; a flagship model got lost and cost 10-20x more)
  • REST API design (FastAPI/async Python) usable by both the UI and another agent calling it directly
  • New connectors: task instructions, judge criteria, guardrails (exact-text guarantees, draft-vs-commit gating)
  • The React/TypeScript “Command Center” UI: pending-action feed, job status, 2FA-resume flows
  • Debugging from actual traces/logs, not the agent’s own summary

What You Bring

  • Strong async Python (asyncio, polling/retry, race conditions) + FastAPI
  • Real React/TypeScript experience (async state, not static UI)
  • Hands-on CDP/Playwright/Puppeteer — know the difference between closing a browser and disconnecting a remote debug client
  • Production LLM-agent experience: task/prompt engineering + building verification layers that don’t just trust the agent
  • Security mindset: understands credential custody (not just API keys), ToS risk of automating third-party logins, defaults to the safer design
  • Debugs from primary sources (reads SDK source, greps logs) over guessing

*Nice to have*

  • Experience automating logins at scale (Google/Facebook/Yelp-class sites)
  • SOC2/compliance-adjacent secrets work

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.

job.name: Enterprise AI Transformation Strategist
job.description:
Job Description As Enterprise AI Transformation Strategist, you will be the lead architect for AI/data platforms within Nokia’s transformation program. You are the senior technical anchor for Nokia’s enterprise AI and data platform landscape, including agent tooling and knowledge platforms. You will own how these platforms are integrated, secured and governed, bring deep systems-design experience to how agents and connectors are built, and provide the architectural thinking and thought leadership that guides the program. You’ll own the target architecture and a multi-year roadmap, lead security approvals and cost trade-off discussions, and work closely with the Program Manager, the engineering team and a network of business and IT stakeholders.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

  • Design the target architecture for AI/data platforms – including agent tooling such as Glean, Databricks and other knowledge and data platforms – covering connectors, data integration, permission-aware retrieval, search and assistant experiences, and set the standards for how they are built and operated.
  • Provide the architectural thinking and technical leadership that guides the program and the wider engineering and IT community.
  • Own the target architecture and a multi-year roadmap for AI/data platforms for the program, building on enterprise and cloud platforms.
  • Establish the architecture and standards for integrating, building and maintaining custom connectors, agents and integrations on AI/data platforms, including use of their APIs, agent-building capabilities and MCP, and advise stakeholders on platform and data-heavy use cases while engineering builds.
  • Own security approvals for AI/data platforms and integrations – assessing data access, permissions, privacy and risk together with Security, Legal and compliance partners.
  • Lead cost trade-off discussions, weighing licensing, consumption, model and infrastructure costs against value, quality and risk, and drive clear decisions with stakeholders.
  • Identify technology gaps and establish clear technical priorities, decision frameworks and alignment across engineering, IT, security, data and business stakeholders.
  • Provide thought leadership: represent the AI/data platform architecture in senior technical forums, produce high-quality architecture artifacts, communicate trade-offs clearly and shape future direction inside and outside Nokia.
  • Act as mentor to engineers and architects and evaluate new technologies to set future direction, working across the program and advising across the target workstream.

We are a part of PB Fintech Group, which operates Policybazaar (India's largest online platform for Insurance products\) & *Paisabazaar (India's largest consumer credit marketplace\*)

Paisabazaar is a 7+ yr old brand, which rose to market leadership in a crowded market, through focus on doing what's right for consumers, with a strong bent for execution.

With 50+ partnerships across large banks, large NBFCs and fintech lenders , Paisabazaar offers a wide choice of lending products for consumers on its platform.

While being the market leader, Paisabazaar has also defined the vision for the lending industry by its Industry-first innovations like CoA (Industry first borrower-lender matching algo) and Free Credit Score (offering Consumers lifetime checking and tracking of their credit scores for free) and many more.. with an aim to solve core consumer problems via deep understanding of customer behavior, backed by cutting edge Tech, Product and Analytics capabilities .

As a testimony to the role played by Paisabazaar in the industry, we have been well recognized at several industry platforms with awards like 'Most Innovative Lending Startup’ by India Fintech Forum and ‘Most Promising Brand’ by Economic Times , ‘Excellence in Consumer Lending’ at IAMAI’s India Digital Awards and globally as well with a ‘Outstanding Crisis Finance Innovation 2021 (Asia Pacific) Award’ by Global Finance Magazine and many more.

Watch Paisabazaar's growth story, as covered on Discovery Channel - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AhbWfcKIMjs&t=134s

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y5mATa99XkE

Job Responsibilities

We’re looking to hire someone to help scale Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence efforts at Paisabazaar. You’ll work with the team that develops the models that shall power Paisabazaar’s products focused on Speech, NLP and generative AI. Some of the problems include Automated Speech Recognition(ASR) of Hinglish customer-agent audio conversations and generating critical insights for business, building gen AI chatbots on top of the rich knowledge bases of Paisabazaar.

job.name: Cloud Services Engineer III
job.description:
Job Title: Cloud Service Engineer III

Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid)

Team: Atlassian Administration & Engineering

Experience: 2+ years in Atlassian administration or a related platform engineering role

About the Role

We’re looking for an Atlassian engineer with a few years of experience to join our Atlassian Administration & Engineering team. You’ll work with a team of seven engineers who support a global Atlassian Cloud platform used by about 10,000–12,000 people around the world, across Jira, Confluence, Jira Product Discovery (JPD), and Jira Service Management (JSM).

We recently finished a large migration to Atlassian Cloud, and we’re still bringing separate product instances together into one environment. The migration moved fast and left technical debt behind, so we’re now focused on cleanup: removing legacy customizations and making the platform match Atlassian Cloud best practices. You’ll own parts of that work yourself. That means spotting problems, proposing fixes, and building automation that keeps the platform clean and scalable.

What You’ll Do

  • Platform administration: Take ownership of administration across Jira, Confluence, JPD, and JSM, including permissions, schemes, workflows, custom fields, and space and project configuration.
  • User lifecycle automation: Design and maintain automated onboarding and offboarding, group management, and license management, working with identity providers and SCIM provisioning.
  • Space and project lifecycle: Build repeatable, automated processes to create, standardize, and archive projects and spaces at scale.
  • Reduce legacy customizations: Audit the environment for redundant custom fields, workflows, schemes, and app dependencies. Then propose and carry out plans to remove or consolidate them, using automation wherever possible.
  • Automation engineering: Build and maintain Atlassian Automation rules for routine and bulk administrative work. Where built-in features fall short, design robust API-driven automation.
  • Engineering practices: Treat platform automation as production code. Changes are peer-reviewed, tested, and released through a pipeline, not run ad hoc.
  • AI-assisted engineering: Make AI part of your everyday workflow, from drafting scripts and analyzing configurations to writing documentation, so you deliver more without lowering the quality bar.
  • Service metrics and observability: Capture service metrics through the Atlassian APIs, store them outside the platform, and build dashboards that show how the service is used and how it’s performing.
  • Solution evaluation: Weigh built-in Atlassian features against custom or external solutions, and explain clearly why the chosen option is the best fit.
  • Continuous improvement: Challenge processes that are overly complex, costly, or full of manual toil, and propose simpler, automated alternatives.

Read the full description

job.description:
Summary Position Summary AI Security Consultant, Infrastructure

As an AI Security Senior Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.

Work you'll do

As an AI Security Senior Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead discovery and architecture analysis for managed AI services, self-hosted model stacks, cloud foundations, networks and operational tooling.
  • Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
  • Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
  • Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
  • Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
  • Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
  • Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
  • Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team

Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.

We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.

Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.

The Global Westlaw Engineering organization builds and operates the technology that powers Westlaw, the world's leading legal research platform. Our teams develop innovative products and AI-driven solutions that help legal professionals find trusted answers, uncover insights, and make confident decisions faster. You will work directly with customers to understand complex business and technical problems, design the right AI-powered solution, and help build and deploy that solution into production.

job.name: Senior Solution Architect
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Migration Architect to lead complex Data Centre Exit and DC Consolidation programmes, migrating large-scale enterprise estates to Amazon Web Services (AWS). This is a technically demanding, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of cloud architecture, migration engineering, and programme delivery.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end architectural direction of migration programmes — from initial discovery and dependency mapping through to wave execution, cutover, and post-migration optimisation. You will bring deep expertise in AWS infrastructure, licensing portability (BYOL, BYOS, AWS Licence Manager), network transformation using AWS Transit Gateway and Direct Connect, and the unique complexities that arise when exiting or consolidating physical data centres onto AWS.

This role is suited to an architect who is equally comfortable whiteboarding a target-state AWS Landing Zone architecture with a CTO and sitting with an engineering team to resolve a blast-radius dependency conflict the night before a cutover.

Key Responsibilities Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Design and own the target-state cloud architecture for DC Exit / DC Consolidation programmes on AWS, including compute (EC2, ECS, EKS), storage (EBS, EFS, S3), networking (VPC, Transit Gateway), identity (IAM, AWS SSO), and security (AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, SCPs)
  • Lead application and infrastructure discovery using AWS Application Discovery Service (ADS), Migration Evaluator, and dependency mapping to produce migration-ready groupings and blast radius analysis
  • Define migration patterns (rehost via AWS MGN, replatform to RDS/EKS, refactor to Lambda/containers, retire, replace with SaaS) per workload with clear technical rationale and risk assessment
  • Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), High-Level Designs (HLDs), and Low-Level Designs (LLDs) to programme-grade quality, aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework
  • Govern architectural consistency across migration waves and enforce AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower guardrails throughout the transition

Licensing Portability & Compliance

job.name: Director, Software Development Engineering
job.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction To Team As Director, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Reservations across two of Expedia Group's largest lines of business: Conventional Lodging (hotels) and Vacation Rentals (Vrbo). This platform ensures that the booking is completed across all systems starting from the moment a traveler clicks "book" till the moment a supplier, a hotel property or a vacation rental host, actually confirms that room or home. It is the system of record and execution for every reservation created, retrieved, changed, cancelled, and reconciled across every EG brand and every point of sale, globally.

The scale of these platforms is substantially high since Conventional Lodging alone represents a large majority of Expedia's transaction volume, processing bookings across local inventory, third-party inventory, and GDS supply. Vacation Rentals adds a second, structurally distinct booking model, whole-property rentals with owner/property-manager supply, dynamic quote-and-hold flows, and its own settlement and payout mechanics. Across both businesses, this organization owns dozens of production services spanning booking orchestration, price/availability validation, fulfillment, cancellation, change management, settlement, and event publishing to finance and analytics.

Platform capabilities you will own and continue to raise the bar on:

  • Scalability — supporting booking, retrieve, and post-booking traffic that scales across markets, brands, and business models without re-architecting for every new use case.
  • High-performance — the team is actively driving end-to-end booking latency down, because every additional second at checkout measurably costs conversion and revenue.
  • High throughput — the platform must absorb booking, price-check, and inventory-adjustment traffic at production scale continuously, including peak demand events, without degrading the traveler experience.
  • Resiliency — this is a highly compliant and audited revenue-critical system, designed with redundancy, safe rollout mechanisms, and recovery paths, because a failed booking is a failed sale.

Nice to meet you! We’re the leader in analytics. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence – and questions into answers.

We’re also a debt-free multi-billion-dollar organization on our path to IPO-readiness. If you’re looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career coupled with flexibility and world-class employee experience, you’ll find it here.

About The Job The Industrials team is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test to improve the quality of the next generation application for Planning Management of Our customers. Our team works on the cutting-edge technology stack which processes Big Data to help our customers in making analytical and business decisions. The volume of data, flexible architecture and configurability are the interesting challenges that the Team works upon while delivering features through CI/CD.

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), we are looking for someone who:

  • Creates and maintains high quality of test automation using modern development techniques and provides key data points to support metrics-based decision making.
  • Applies automated tests at every layer of the application stack, both inside and outside of the continuous delivery pipeline.
  • Produces and analyzes metrics that illustrate the quality of applications and develop insight that contribute to quality engineering decisions.
  • Works with team to promptly triage test failures with precision and accuracy, maintaining the health of the build pipeline.
  • Works collaboratively with development, product, operations, and support peers to encourage quality, as a key design element in all work efforts.
  • Engages in code reviews for product, test, and infrastructure code.
  • Protects users from escaped defects, participates in support escalations, and value Customer Experience (CX) above all.
  • Ensures all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.
  • Embraces curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related quantitative field
  • 6-9 years of professional experience in software development or automated testing in Python, or similar languages
  • Experience with integration, regression, and unit testing.
  • Working experience with RDBMS – Oracle, PostgreSQL
  • Experience using Agile development practices
  • Familiarity with various cloud environments and concepts
  • Equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications.

Preferred Qualifications

job.name: QA Engineer
job.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer who take end-to-end ownership of features, demonstrate accountability for deliverables , proactively drive quality improvements, and thrive in a fast-paced cybersecurity environment.

In this role, you will ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of API-based data services and Spark data processing workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of feature testing from requirements through production release.
  • Investigate, debug, and drive resolution of customer-reported issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis and validate fixes for customer and production issues.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test coverage across APIs, backend microservices, Spark jobs, and UI integrations.
  • Validate end-to-end data pipelines for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and performance.
  • Verify Spark job outputs, data transformations, aggregations, and schema integrity.
  • Develop and execute SQL-based data validation across databases and data lakes.
  • Analyze application, Spark, and Kubernetes logs to identify and troubleshoot failures.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and support QA environment deployments.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineers, Product Managers, and developers to define test strategies and quality goals.
  • Track defects, support root cause analysis, and contribute to product documentation.
  • Support hotfix validation and release activities as required.

Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of QA experience, with at least 2 years in test automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Selenium and/or Playwright.
  • Proficiency in Python or Java for automation development.
  • Experience testing REST APIs using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or Requests.
  • Strong SQL skills for data validation and verification.
  • Basic understanding of Big Data concepts and Apache Spark.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI, along with Git.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and Kubernetes fundamentals.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and the ability to independently drive quality outcomes.

Additional Preparation Topics for Shortlisted Candidates

In addition to the responsibilities, qualifications, and technical skills outlined above, shortlisted candidates are expected to have a working understanding of the following topics:

  • Elasticsearch fundamentals
  • Apache Spark concepts and Spark SQL queries
  • REST API testing and automation
  • SQL and data validation techniques
  • Basic Kubernetes troubleshooting and log analysis

job.name: Full Stack Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India JOB OVERVIEW The Legion application is a high-performance, data-driven Java enterprise application that implements sophisticated scheduling and optimization algorithms. It also provides the necessary endpoints for our Web and mobile frontend applications.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES As a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer, you will be a member of the team responsible for the implementation and evolution of this application. You will need to be able to write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality code, and have a deep understanding of the techniques and technologies that are necessary for scalability and performance.

  • Design, build, and ship features end to end across the backend (Java / Spring Boot services, REST APIs, data model) and the web frontend (React / AngularJS).
  • Write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality code that scales to large multi-location customers with complex, highly configurable setups.
  • Own the performance of what you build: diagnose slow queries, memory pressure, and large data imports/exports, and fix them at the root cause.
  • Keep backend and UI behavior consistent — the API contract, validation, and what the user sees must agree.
  • Write unit and integration tests, review peers' code, and hold a high bar on quality and maintainability.
  • Write technical design documents for non-trivial changes and break them into incremental, shippable pieces.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues using logs, metrics, and tracing; take part in on-call and escalation support for your area.
  • Work closely with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements and validate fixes with customers.
  • Mentor engineers on the team and raise the technical bar through reviews and design discussions.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping software products (not consulting or website/portal development).
  • Strong backend experience in Java with Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, and REST API design.
  • Strong frontend experience with React or AngularJS, plus JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, including cross-browser compatibility.
  • Solid relational database skills with MySQL (or similar): schema design, indexing, query tuning, and migrations.
  • Experience with performance and scalability work: profiling, memory and allocation issues, batching, caching, and asynchronous/queue-based processing.
  • Experience handling the complexity of many configurations in a multi-tenant, cloud-based product.
  • Experience with AWS and containerized deployments.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar field.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

job.name: Senior Developer (Oracle EBS)
job.description:
Job Description If you are a Senior Oracle EBS Developer with deep hands-on experience in Oracle E-Business Suite R12 and PL/SQL development, this role offers the opportunity to make a broad impact as a shared technical resource across multiple business-critical applications, supporting Customer Service Delivery, Product Intelligence, and Learning Platform teams at Emerson. You will own complex EBS customizations end-to-end, bridge Oracle database layers to modern web applications, and maintain enterprise systems that drive global operations across Emerson's network.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Oracle EBS R12 customizations across financial modules (AP, AR, GL, INV, Fixed Assets) and service modules (Depot Repair, TeleService, Order Management, WIP, BOM, CRM Foundations).
  • Write robust, well-documented PL/SQL code, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, bulk collect operations, and dynamic SQL, following Emerson coding standards and best practices.
  • Build and maintain Oracle Forms (6i/10g) and Oracle Reports to support business process requirements across multiple teams.
  • Register and manage Concurrent Programs, parameter sets, and request sets within the Concurrent Manager; debug failed concurrent requests and resolve scheduling conflicts.
  • Design and implement Oracle Workflow and AME (Approvals Management Engine) configurations for business process automation.
  • Support and extend EBS module integrations across Depot Repair, TeleService, Order Management, Education Services Administration, and other business-critical applications.
  • Expose EBS data to web applications through Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) and REST APIs, enabling cross-team data sharing across Customer Service, Product Intelligence, and Learning Platform systems.
  • Debug production issues, tune SQL and PL/SQL performance using execution plan analysis and index optimization and continuously improve application scalability.
  • Manage competing priorities across teams as a shared resource, communicating proactively on delivery timelines, dependencies, and risks.
  • Conduct code reviews, participate in agile ceremonies, and contribute to technical design discussions.

Who You Are: You ask the right questions to accurately analyze situations and uncover root causes to difficult problems. You act with a clear sense of ownership and take personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and failures. You partner with others to get work done and create teamwork that allows the organization to achieve shared objectives. You learn quickly when facing new situations and take on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks. You balance multiple demands from different stakeholders without losing focus or quality.

job.name: Senior OpenText Developer/Engineer
job.description:
Senior OpenText Developer/Engineer

Location: Hyderabad (Hybrid) or Pune (Hybrid)

Engagement: Contract

About Ovyo

Ovyo is a B2B services company providing flexible engineering teams and talent solutions to the streaming, media, satellite, and communications industries. With a global presence across multiple locations (UK, India, Portugal, South Africa, Brazil, US, and Eastern Europe), we deliver a mix of long-term client engagements and shorter consulting projects. Our teams build the platforms that shape how the world consumes video and connects, rapidly accelerating both industry experience and career growth.

About the Role

Our client is looking for a Senior OpenText Operations Orchestration (OO) Developer / Automation Engineer to support an enterprise infrastructure automation project.

We are seeking a hands-on specialist with strong experience in OpenText Cloud Service Automation (CSA) and Operations Orchestration (OO), particularly in workflow development, content pack engineering and refactoring existing automation workflows.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, improving and validating orchestration workflows used to automate virtual machine lifecycle operations. Strong API integration experience and a solid understanding of virtualisation platforms are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, refactor and implement OpenText Operations Orchestration (OO) workflows.
  • Engineer, maintain and improve existing OO Content Packs.
  • Review and refactor existing automation flows to improve reliability, maintainability and performance.
  • Develop and integrate workflows using REST APIs and supported integration mechanisms.
  • Implement API authentication, error handling and versioning.
  • Automate virtual machine lifecycle operations, including VM creation, modification, power operations and decommissioning.
  • Develop automation flows for adding disks and network interfaces, creating and deleting snapshots, and modifying VM CPU and memory configurations.
  • Test, validate and troubleshoot orchestration workflows.
  • Investigate and resolve technical issues within existing orchestration environments.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation for each refactored workflow.
  • Provide test results and validation evidence for completed deliverables.

Requirements

job.name: Contract Job for 1 year | Implementation Analyst for software Product | 1 to 3 years+ experience candidates only
job.description:
Selection Process & Instructions

1. Candidates with less than 1 year of relevant experience, including freshers, are requested not to apply. Candidates who have previously applied for this role and were not shortlisted/rejected are also requested not to reapply.

2. This position is open only to candidates currently based in Mumbai .

3. BDO will screen the candidates based on the information submitted through this job posting response (experience, current location, immediate availability, current CTC, expected CTC, etc. would be the key points for filtration). Please note that this is a relatively early-career implementation role, and so the salary expectations cannot go beyond 7 or 8 lakhs per annum .

4. For filtered candidates, there will be a short conversation from BDO's side to validate the data submitted. The candidates will be asked to share their CV in a one-slide PPT format, which will be used by BDO for client submissions.

5. The PPT version of the CVs will be submitted to the client, who will then set up a MS Teams call with multiple candidates together simultaneously, where the candidates will give an introduction of themselves and their work experience. The client will assess the communication skills and smartness of the candidates in this short chat.

6. The client will then revert to BDO, confirming a list of candidates who may be considered for the Product training on their SaaS-based Consent Management solution. This is a free training session where training content will be shared online, and the candidate has to complete the self-paced training at their convenience. There will be an evaluation at the end (minimum 75% to clear the exam). There will be daily Q&A sessions for 1 hour to clarify doubts, if any, on the training material. No payment, salary, or stipend will be provided by BDO or the Client during this training session period. On average, if you spend 3 hours a day, then the training and certification should be completed within 2 weeks.

7. The client will then inform BDO of the list of candidates who have cleared the exam and training and are ready to be onboarded or deployed.

8. Accordingly, BDO will onboard the client-confirmed candidates as BDO employees, but they will be deployed at the client location. There will be a BDO induction in the first week of onboarding.

9. After the first deployment or first assignment gets over, the employee may get deployed on another project of the client.

job.name: AI Engineer – Business
job.description:
About Arira AI

Arira AI implements AI That Saves & Makes Money inside growing businesses.

About the role

As an AI Engineer you work on site at our client companies. You sit with their teams, learn how the work is really done, then use AI tools to build and roll out solutions that make that work faster and better. You are measured by one thing: the value the business gets from AI.

What you will do

1. Work on site at client company offices as the face of the AI programme.
2. Sit with business users, understand how they work today and where time and effort are lost.
3. Ask the right questions to draw out how processes really run, including the exceptions.
4. Document workflows, requirements and decisions clearly so others can build on them.
5. Choose the right language models and AI tools for each problem.
6. Build and configure working solutions yourself, from prompts and agents to quick apps.
7. Roll solutions out, train users and help them adopt new ways of working.
8. Follow up after go-live, fix what does not work and keep improving it.
9. Show the business the value it is getting from AI in terms it cares about.
10. Feed lessons from each deployment back into how we deploy AI.

What you bring

1. 2 to 5 years of professional experience.
2. Hands-on use of different language models and AI tools.
3. Deep functional domain expertise in one business function, such as operations, finance, sales or HR.
4. Real hands-on experience in operations on the ground.
5. A people person: easy to talk to, curious, and good at getting information out of users.
6. Clear, accurate documentation.
7. Able to join quickly. Shorter notice periods are preferred.

Why join

1. AI that actually gets used: your work goes live with real business teams.
2. A free hand with the best tools: full access to our AI assets and the tools the job needs.
3. Learn fast, grow faster: a structured start, then real ownership of live deployments, working closely with leadership.

Details

Full-time, permanent. On site at client company offices. Reports to Head of Implementation. Vacancy reference AIE-B-2026.

Arira AI is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applications from everyone.

job.name: AI Engineer - Tech
job.description:
About Arira AI

Arira AI implements AI That Saves & Makes Money inside growing businesses.

About the role

As an AI Engineer you work on site at our client companies. You sit with their teams, learn how the work is really done, then use AI tools to build and roll out solutions that make that work faster and better. You are measured by one thing: the value the business gets from AI.

What you will do

1. Work on site at client company offices as the face of the AI programme.
2. Sit with business users, understand how they work today and where time and effort are lost.
3. Ask the right questions to draw out how processes really run, including the exceptions.
4. Document workflows, requirements and decisions clearly so others can build on them.
5. Choose the right language models and AI tools for each problem.
6. Build and configure working solutions yourself, from prompts and agents to quick apps.
7. Roll solutions out, train users and help them adopt new ways of working.
8. Follow up after go-live, fix what does not work and keep improving it.
9. Show the business the value it is getting from AI in terms it cares about.
10. Feed lessons from each deployment back into how we deploy AI.

What you bring

1. 2 to 5 years of professional experience.
2. Hands-on use of different language models and AI tools.
3. A working understanding of technology and the software development cycle.
4. Experience as a business user of software, close to real operations.
5. A product mindset, in a product or project manager style of role.
6. A people person: easy to talk to, curious, and good at getting information out of users.
7. Clear, accurate documentation.
8. Able to join quickly. Shorter notice periods are preferred.

Why join

1. AI that actually gets used: your work goes live with real business teams.
2. A free hand with the best tools: full access to our AI assets and the tools the job needs.
3. Learn fast, grow faster: a structured start, then real ownership of live deployments, working closely with leadership.

Details

Full-time, permanent. On site at client company offices. Reports to Head of Implementation. Vacancy reference AIE-T-2026.

Arira AI is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applications from everyone.

job.name: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
About the role

We are building an AI personal assistant that lives in a mobile app and on smart glasses,

helping busy people stay on top of their calls, messages, emails, tasks, meetings and day.

We need a QA Engineer who owns the quality of the whole experience, from the app on

the phone to the hardware on the face.

You will test as a user first and as an engineer second: manual testing from the user's

point of view, real-world testing of the assistant together with the hardware, and

automation so that every app or hardware change is tested without waiting on a person.

  • Location : Ahmedabad, India (on-site)
  • Employment : Full-time
  • Experience : 5+ years in QA, including hardware, IoT or wearable testing

How we want you to think

We are hiring someone who tests GINN the way its founder would: as a demanding daily

user who expects the product to just work, not as someone ticking off test cases. The

founder should be able to hand over quality and trust that nothing ships that the founder

would not be happy to use personally.

  • Own the outcome, not the checklist . Before asking "does it match the spec?", ask "would I trust this with my day?"
  • Judge every release against the promise . GINN is a personal assistant. A feature that works but adds friction, delay or confusion has failed.
  • Live with the product . Carry the app and the hardware through a real workday: commute, meetings, noisy rooms, weak networks, low battery, back-to-back requests.
  • Break it on purpose . Interrupt it mid-sentence, mumble, switch accents or languages, drop the connection mid-request, pair and unpair repeatedly, use it the way no one planned.
  • Notice the small things . Response lag, awkward wording, wrong tone, battery drain, heat, comfort and fit of the hardware. Users feel these before they can name them.
  • Treat trust and privacy as top severity . A personal assistant handles personal data. A wrong action, a leaked detail or an unwanted recording is a release blocker, always.
  • Speak up . Block a release when it is not ready and say why. Flag gaps in the spec. Bring a suggested fix with every bug, not just the report.

What you will do

Your work covers three areas, and the first two feed the third: what you learn by using the

product by hand decides what gets automated.

1. Manual testing from the user's point of view

Test every feature end to end across the mobile app (Android and iOS), the website

and ordering flow, and the AI assistant, the way a first-time user and a daily power

user would.

Explore beyond written test cases: odd inputs, interruptions, slow networks, denied

permissions, notifications arriving mid-task.

Judge the experience, not only the function: speed, clarity, the tone of the assistant's

replies, and whether the user's task was actually completed.

Write bug reports a developer can reproduce in minutes: steps, device, build,

job.name: Engineering Technical Lead
job.description:
Engineering Lead

Payments platform engineering

Hands-on technical lead who owns architecture and system design, ships with the team, and scales systems under real load. This role reports directly to the CTO. Fintech or payments experience is preferred, not required.

The role

You will lead a small engineering group while remaining the strongest technical voice in the room. Day to day is design reviews, production decisions, and code — not status meetings. You set the technical bar, unblock the team, and stay accountable for systems that have to stay up. You report to the CTO and are the CTO’s counterpart on delivery, architecture, and engineering quality.

What you will do

  • Architecture. Design and evolve systems for high throughput and low latency. Own trade-offs on consistency, failure modes, and cost.
  • Hands-on first. Write and review code on the critical path. Diagrams are not a substitute for shipping.
  • System design. Lead design for new products and hard changes to existing ones. Drive data models, APIs, and service boundaries.
  • Team handling. Lead engineers: hiring input, mentoring, code quality, and delivery — without giving up technical depth.
  • Large-scale systems. Capacity, observability, incident response, and postmortems that change the design.
  • AI-native. Use coding agents, evaluation, and automation in the build and run path. Set standards so AI output is reviewed, tested, and owned.
  • Databases. Own schema design, indexing, partitioning, access patterns, and query performance under growth.

Must have

  • Experience. 10–13 years building production software, with recent ownership of systems at meaningful scale.
  • Data structures. Strong data structures and algorithms applied to real systems, not interview trivia.
  • Architecture and system design. Proven ownership of services, data flow, failure handling, and how a system evolves over time.
  • Databases. Relational depth, plus at least one other store, with evidence of designing for volume and correctness.
  • Hands-on first. You still write code and can debug production issues yourself.
  • Team handling. You have led engineers, raised the bar, and shipped through them without becoming a pure manager.
  • AI-native skills. Daily use of coding agents and LLM tooling in design, implementation, testing, and operations, with judgment on where they fail.
  • Large-scale systems. You have operated systems where load, failure, and data growth were real constraints.

Preferred

  • Fintech or payments. UPI, cards, payouts, ledgers, reconciliation, or settlement. Domain knowledge helps; engineering depth matters more.
  • Experience with incident-heavy, money-moving systems where correctness and auditability are non-negotiable.

job.name: Staff Compiler Performance Engineer
job.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Staff Compiler Performance Engineer to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap.

You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams.

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

  • Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmap
  • Lead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collector
  • Make architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategy
  • Lead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul products
  • Mentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validation
  • Represent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilers

What You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)

  • 8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
  • Track record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in production
  • Expert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebases
  • Deep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code size
  • Expert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture level

Nice to Have

  • Recognized contributions to LLVM or another major compiler: code owner, maintainer or author of significant upstream work
  • Deep experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
  • Experience working closely with runtime and GC teams on speculation, deoptimization and barrier design

Read the full description

You will be responsible for managing client accounts and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial records. Your expertise in accounting principles, leadership skills, and client relationship management will contribute to the success of our client accounting services.

Job Description Client Accounting Support:

  • Oversee the day-to-day accounting activities for assigned clients, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, general ledger, and financial reporting
  • Complete and ensure timely and accurate recording of financial transactions, reconciliations, and adjustments
  • Review and approve journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial statements prepared by the accounting team
  • Coordinate and lead month-end and year-end close processes for client accounts
  • Prepare and review financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards
  • Assist in budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities, collaborating with clients and internal stakeholders
  • Analyze financial data, identify trends, variances, and areas for improvement, and provide insights and recommendations to clients and management

Client Communication And Support

  • Serve as the main point of contact for clients, building and maintaining strong relationships based on trust and professionalism
  • Address client inquiries, resolve issues, and provide proactive financial guidance and support
  • Understand clients' business objectives and challenges and provide strategic financial advice and recommendations

Process Improvement And Compliance

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and efficiency within the client accounting function
  • Ensure compliance with accounting principles, regulations, and client-specific requirements
  • Support internal and external audits by providing requested documentation and addressing audit findings

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • No

Work environment

  • Work is conducted in a professional office environment with minimal distractions

Physical demands

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and performing work in front of a computer screen for long periods of time
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at a time

Travel Required

  • Travel may be frequent and unpredictable, depending on client’s needs

job.name: Senior, ML Engineer - 3D Reconstruction
job.description:
About The Company At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business. A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight. Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet The Team: The Pseudo-Labeling team's goal is to create high-quality annotations on sensor data (images, point clouds). The annotations include 2D, 3D bounding boxes, classes, trajectories, lane lines, segmentations, depths, and high-definition map elements. The annotations are then used by different downstream users — for example, perception teams use them to train various models, mapping teams use them to build and maintain HD maps, and simulation teams use them for generating new data. This role owns the hardest problems in the team's lane line and mapping stack and is expected to set technical direction across lane line reconstruction, map creation, and pose accuracy.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the design, implementation, and deployment of offline 3D reconstruction, lane line detection, and automatic mapping/map creation systems that generate high-quality annotations on Cloud Services from logged sensor data (Cameras, Lidars, Radars, GPS/IMU).
  • Lead lane line network reconstruction efforts, rebuilding topologically correct lane line graphs from noisy, partial, or conflicting detections across drives.
  • Design, train, and iterate on lane line detection and creation models, pushing state-of-the-art performance and driving model architecture and training strategy decisions for the team.
  • Develop methods for creating lane line maps in previously unmapped areas, and for detecting and propagating map updates as road geometry changes over time.
  • Own pose correction for sensor data, and lead the diagnosis and mitigation of calibration and sensor errors (extrinsic/intrinsic miscalibration, drift, noise) that degrade reconstruction and mapping quality.
  • Set technical direction and best practices for the team's lane line, mapping, and pose estimation pipelines, and lead architecture decisions with cross-team impact.
  • Serve as technical lead on high-complexity projects, guiding and mentoring other engineers across multiple facets of project execution.
  • Stay ahead of the latest developments in AI and ML for autonomous driving, 3D reconstruction, and automated mapping, and bring emerging techniques into production.
  • Independently develop offline perception and mapping models or algorithms using disciplined software development processes, making recommendations for developing new code or re-using existing code, implementing version co

Our diverse service lines, including Water, Architecture, Building Engineering Services, Field Services, Power, Waste, Industrial, and Transportation reflect our commitment to shaping resilient, sustainable, and forward thinking communities around the world. Across these disciplines, our teams design and deliver solutions that safeguard public health, enhance quality of life, power innovation, and drive responsible growth. Whether advancing clean water, creating healing and learning environments, engineering next generation facilities, or building the infrastructure that moves people and energy, our work is rooted in technical excellence and a shared sense of purpose. Our employee owners collaborate across specialties, combining creativity, precision, and deep expertise to solve the most complex challenges facing our clients and communities.

This role shapes how our data is defined, used, and reused across our Federal Programs and HDR.

We’re looking for a Federal Data Steward to help bring clarity and consistency to how data is defined, shared, and used across all Federal Market Sectors and their embodied service lines within HDR. This is a leadership role, not an IT or compliance position, and it plays a key part in enabling better business decisions, data reuse, and project delivery excellence.

This role is not expected to be the subject matter expert across all Federal business lines. Instead, the Federal Data Steward defines how data practices are established, aligned, and sustained across the HDR Federal practice by coordinating and enabling subject matter experts and technical authorities within each domain. This role is ideal for technical leaders who can shape “how work gets done” and extend that influence on how data supports our business. This role exists to empower our teams to define data once, understand it the same way, and reuse it confidently across projects, teams, and time.

This business leadership role connects operations, business development, contracting, compliance, and project delivery to establish common data standards and accountability across Federal Market Sectors.

Role Description The Senior Linux System Administrator is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru. This role is responsible for managing, configuring, and optimizing Linux servers and related infrastructure to ensure high availability, performance, and security. Day-to-day activities include monitoring systems, performing regular maintenance and upgrades, troubleshooting complex issues, and providing advanced technical support to internal teams. The Senior Linux System Administrator will collaborate with network, security, and development teams to implement best practices, automate routine tasks, and support production and test environments. The role also involves documenting configurations and procedures, contributing to incident and problem management, and participating in on-call rotations as needed.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong skills in System Administration and Linux System Administration, including configuration, optimization, and automation of Linux-based environments.
  • Candidates should possess solid Troubleshooting and Technical Support skills to diagnose, resolve, and prevent infrastructure and application issues.
  • Candidates should possess knowledge of Network Security, including firewalls, access controls, and security best practices for server hardening.
  • Candidates should possess familiarity with scripting languages (such as Bash, Python, or similar) and tools for infrastructure monitoring and configuration management.

job.name: Senior Security Engineer – PKI & Platform Security
job.description:
Senior PKI & HSM Engineer

We're looking for a Senior PKI & HSM Engineer to own our cryptographic infrastructure end-to-end. This is a deeply technical role for someone who lives and breathes certificates, keys, and HSMs — and who can bring automation and DevOps sensibilities to modernize how we operate them.

What You'll Do

  • Manage Public Key Infrastructure across its full lifecycle, including certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, and policy enforcement at enterprise scale
  • Integrate and maintain Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) for secure cryptographic key storage and operations, ensuring high availability and regulatory compliance
  • Administer Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms to automate provisioning and eliminate expiration-related outages
  • Enforce secure key management practices around rotation, storage, auditing, and policy compliance
  • Lead L3-level troubleshooting for PKI, HSM, and CLM issues across cloud, on-prem, and containerized environments
  • Develop automation using Python, Bash, and RESTful APIs to streamline certificate operations, key rotations, and compliance reporting
  • Work across AWS, Azure, and GCP, integrating native key management services (KMS, Key Vault, Cloud KMS) with our PKI ecosystem
  • Partner with application, infrastructure, and security teams to embed cryptographic best practices across the organization

Nice to Have (DevSecOps Exposure)

Beyond the core PKI/HSM work, you'll have opportunities to contribute to our broader security engineering efforts. Familiarity with any of the following is a plus:

  • Designing secure CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions
  • Containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Security platforms like Trend Micro Vision One and container security tooling
  • Observability stacks like ELK, monitoring, and incident response workflows
  • Vulnerability detection and remediation across the SDLC

What We're Looking For

  • Deep, hands-on experience managing enterprise PKI (issuance, revocation, OCSP/CRL, trust hierarchies)
  • Strong working knowledge of HSMs (Thales, Entrust, AWS CloudHSM, or similar) and PKCS#11
  • Experience with Certificate Lifecycle Management platforms (Venafi, AppViewX, Keyfactor, or equivalent)
  • Solid scripting skills in Python and Bash, plus comfort working with RESTful APIs
  • Working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider's key management services
  • L3-level troubleshooting experience across Linux, Windows, and networking
  • A security-first mindset and a track record of automating manual cryptographic operations

Location: Bangalore

Working Mode: WFO (5 days a week)

What we're looking for:

🔹 10+ years in security engineering or implementation, with 4+ years leading delivery / professional services teams

🔹 Experience managing OEM relationships and technical escalations

Why Join Mitigata?

Protecting the businesses that power India's digital economy.

  • Work that matters. Cyber incidents hit real organisations, from hospitals disrupted by ransomware to directors facing liability claims to startups whose funding is put at risk after a breach. Your work helps protect their systems, their finances, and their reputation.
  • A distinctive model. We combine cybersecurity, compliance, and liability insurance in one company, because protection works best when prevention and coverage go together.
  • Room to build. We are building an AI-native platform and one of India's most comprehensive AI-driven Security Operations Centers, with real scope to solve problems from first principles.
  • Growth that follows impact. We are early and growing quickly, so scope often expands faster than headcount. People who learn fast and take ownership see their responsibilities grow with them.
  • Startup pace, institutional foundations. IRDAI-licensed, backed by leading investors, and trusted by 800+ customers, while still moving at the speed of a startup.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Role Overview:

Turing is looking for a Principal Cybersecurity Expert to lead a full-time pod of about 10 cybersecurity experts who label security data and run light investigations for a leading AI lab. You will set how the pod works, settle policy and judgment calls, and be the pod’s main domain voice with the client.

Requirements:

job.name: Applied Scientist (Spatial Intelligence)
job.description:
About the Urban Intelligence Lab

The Urban Intelligence Lab (UIL) is an independent practice within Sidara, a global group of specialist firms in the built environment. Sidara has more than 55,000 people in over 70 countries, and its firms include Dar, Perkins&Will, TYLin, Currie & Brown, Penspen and Wood.

We make design and strategy decisions through science. We use spatial data, AI and computational methods to define the key questions in a project, test the options against clear measures, and show which choices are most likely to work.

We work in cities across Africa, Asia and the Middle East, often where data is hard to access. We show in detail how a city operates, so that design teams can make better decisions. We use sources such as location data from mobile phones, business locations and street-level imagery, and where data is missing, we create it using cameras and other sensors. In other projects, we have used optimisation to decide where millions of native trees are planted and where centres and land uses are located.

Our multidisciplinary team of 15 includes data scientists, computer scientists, urban planners, architects and economists, who trained at MIT, UCL and IIT. AI agents are a core part of how we work, and we expect everyone in the team to use them well.

About the Role

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to solve the most technically demanding problems in our projects, in areas such as optimisation, network analysis and large-scale computation on city data. The problems come from several fields and change from one project to the next, so you should enjoy working out new approaches rather than repeating a standard method.

This is a hands-on role that combines science with engineering. You will take loosely defined urban problems and state them as precise computational problems, review the literature for promising approaches, assess how well they fit, and build working implementations yourself. job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Data Engineer

Building the Data Foundation Behind Every Agent We Deploy

Location: India

The Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer to build the data foundation that IG Labs' agentic systems run on. Every agent we deploy into a client is only as good as the data and structure beneath it, and you are the engineer who builds that foundation: the pipelines, the models and ontologies, and the retrieval layer that feeds the agents the right context. This is backbone engineering, core to everything we deliver, not a service on the side.

You take on the hardest data problems in our client work: the source no one can cleanly extract, the ontology that has to capture how a business really works, the retrieval that has to surface the right context every time. You own the data foundation from a raw, messy starting point to a governed, reliable system in production, and you are accountable for whether the agents built on it can be trusted.

Everything you build, you build to last beyond one client. The pipelines, connectors, and ontology fragments you create become Factory IP that compounds across every engagement, so each project starts ahead of the last. You are a senior engineer in our delivery organization, based in India, working within the POD model alongside the Technical Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and the UI/UX and Technical/Field engineers who build the rest of the system.

Key Responsibilities

Solving the Hardest Data Problems

  • Take on the toughest data problems in our client work: the messy, incomplete, undocumented client data that stands between an idea and a working agent.
  • Design the data models and ontologies the agentic system operates on: entities, relationships, states, and the business rules that govern them.
  • Build the retrieval substrate that agentic systems depend on: chunking, embeddings, indexing, and retrieval pipelines tuned for accuracy.
  • Take an open-ended data problem with no clean source and engineer a reliable, governed path to usable data.
  • Shape genuinely architectural decisions with the Technical Architect, contributing the patterns that become standard.

Data Engineering

  • Build production-grade ingestion, ETL and ELT, and transformation pipelines across batch and streaming.
  • Design warehousing and lakehouse structures, schemas, and ontologies that hold up as engagements grow.
  • Stand up and tune vector stores and retrieval pipelines that feed RAG and agentic workflows.
  • Own data quality, governance, and lineage, the difference between an agent you can trust and one you cannot.
  • Engineer for performance and cost, so the foundation scales with the client without surprises.

Delivering in Client Engagements

job.name: Cyber- DT&P- Infrastructure - AI Security Senior Consultant
job.description:
Summary Position Summary AI Security Consultant, Infrastructure

As an AI Security Senior Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.

Work you'll do

As an AI Security Senior Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead discovery and architecture analysis for managed AI services, self-hosted model stacks, cloud foundations, networks and operational tooling.
  • Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
  • Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
  • Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
  • Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
  • Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
  • Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
  • Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team

Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.

We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.

Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.

The Urban Intelligence Lab (UIL) is an independent practice within Sidara, a global group of specialist firms in the built environment. Sidara has more than 55,000 people in over 70 countries, and its firms include Dar, Perkins&Will, TYLin, Currie & Brown, Penspen and Wood.

We make design and strategy decisions through science. We use spatial data, AI and computational methods to define the key questions in a project, test the options against clear measures, and show which choices are most likely to work.

We work in cities across Africa, Asia and the Middle East, often where data is hard to access. We show in detail how a city operates, so that design teams can make better decisions. We use sources such as location data from mobile phones, business locations and street-level imagery, and where data is missing, we create it using cameras and other sensors. In other projects, we have used optimisation to decide where millions of native trees are planted and where centres and land uses are located.

Our multidisciplinary team of 15 includes data scientists, computer scientists, urban planners, architects and economists, who trained at MIT, UCL and IIT. AI agents are a core part of how we work, and we expect everyone in the team to use them well.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI Engineer to apply AI agents, LLMs and other generative AI to our spatial intelligence work. You will design and build the AI systems that support our design and strategy decisions: agents that run spatial analysis on request, assistants that answer questions from project documents, and other types of model where they suit the problem better.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will choose the right approach for each problem, take it from prototype to a reliable, well-tested tool that our team and clients can trust, and measure how well it works. The aim is for this work to improve real design and strategy decisions for cities.

Experience with spatial data is useful but not essential; strong AI engineering matters more. Projects vary widely, so you should enjoy applying your skills to new questions about cities.

Key Responsibilities

job.name: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
job.description:
Job Description About Team

GDF sits at the core of Walmart's AI & Data organization, building the foundational data platforms that make it possible for every team at Walmart — technical or non-technical — to build with trustworthy, well-governed, discoverable data. Our platforms serve billions of transactions and interactions across 19 countries, powering everything from supply chain intelligence to customer-facing personalization to enterprise AI agents. This particular team is newly formed to solve one of GDF's next big platform bets — which means you'll be shaping charter, operating model, and delivery cadence essentially from a blank page, not inheriting someone else's playbook.

What You'll Do

Lead the engineering team(s) responsible for designing, building, and operating GDF's core data platform capabilities - pipelines, processing frameworks, storage layers, and service APIs that power downstream analytics and AI workloads across Walmart.

Stay hands-on: write and review production code, prototype solutions to hard technical problems, and participate directly in design and code reviews rather than delegating all technical depth to the team.

Own the engineering roadmap, technical execution, and delivery of scalable, high-throughput data services built on languages/frameworks including Java, Python, and Spark.

Guide architecture and system design decisions across distributed data processing systems, batch and streaming pipelines, data lake/lakehouse storage, and enterprise integrations.

Drive the design and evolution of Big Data capabilities - data ingestion, transformation, quality, observability, and governance - at the scale Walmart's platforms require.

Partner with product managers, data scientists, ML engineers, and platform/security teams to deliver reliable, well-governed data capabilities that enable downstream analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases.

Lead pragmatic integration of AI and GenAI capabilities into the data platform - e.g., feature pipelines for ML models, embeddings/vector search for retrieval, LLM-assisted data quality checks, and intelligent pipeline monitoring - wherever they create measurable engineering or business value.

Ensure systems are designed for scalability, reliability, performance, observability, security, and cost efficiency, appropriate for petabyte-scale enterprise data platforms.

Lead engineering execution across the full software development lifecycle - design, coding, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, incident management, and ongoing operational excellence.

Champion DevOps, platform engineering, and automation best practices to improve engineering velocity, reduce toil, and support continuous delivery for a newly formed team building process and standards from scratch.

These systems will be deployed across Indian exchanges (NSE, BSE, MCX) and other APAC exchanges traded by Optiver. You will work at the intersection of trading and technology, shaping the architecture of Optiver’s expansion into systematic strategies.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Your Expertise
