job.name: Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You Are You have spent a decade building systems that need to stay up, not just run, actually stay up, under production load with real users depending on them. You know that observability is not about dashboards that look good in demos, it is about catching the signal before the page goes out at 2am. You think in SLOs and error budgets because you have lived through enough incidents to know that hope is not a strategy.

You are the person who walks into a war room, pulls up three graphs, and knows exactly which service is choking and why. Linux is your native language. You have written enough Bash and Python to automate yourself out of repetitive work, and you know when to reach for Terraform or Ansible to make infrastructure repeatable. Cloud platforms like Azure do not intimidate you because you have built on them, broken things on them, and fixed them under pressure.

EDA workloads are not abstract to you. You have worked with Grid Engine, LSF, or SLURM. You understand what it means when a compute-heavy job grid starts behaving strangely, and you know how to instrument it. Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Grafana, these are not buzzwords, they are tools you have deployed, tuned, and scaled.

At Synopsys, you will build the observability backbone that keeps our Cloud and on-prem production systems visible, reliable, and ready for what comes next.

What You'll Be Doing Design, build, and own the SRE and Observability platform that monitors production systems across on-prem and Azure Cloud environments, giving engineering and operations teams a real-time, holistic view of system health

Partner with product, infrastructure, and application teams to define SLAs, SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and KPIs that actually matter, then instrument systems to track them

Automate deployment and configuration of monitoring tools using Terraform, Ansible, Bash, and Python to eliminate manual toil and reduce configuration drift

Build custom scripts and tooling to extend observability capabilities, including proactive remediation workflows and self-healing automation that catches issues before they become incidents

Lead root cause analysis on production incidents, write detailed postmortems for stakeholders, and drive systemic fixes that prevent recurrence

Mentor junior SREs and Cloud Operations engineers, providing technical guidance on Linux systems, observability tooling, and SRE best practices

About NCR VOYIX NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.

NCR Voyix is seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong C# and .NET expertise to build, modernize, and operate mission-critical payment and commerce platforms. The role involves ownership of complex technical capabilities from design through production support across legacy and modern technology stacks.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support secure, reliable applications using C#, .NET Framework, modern .NET, ASP.NET, ASP.NET Core, and Web APIs.
  • Maintain and modernize legacy applications built with ASP.NET Web Forms and .NET Framework 4.7.2.
  • Lead or contribute to service rewrites, platform modernization, system integrations, and complex data migrations.
  • Build scalable, low-latency, event-driven services using messaging platforms such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or NATS JetStream.
  • Design distributed caching and state-management solutions using Redis or Valkey.
  • Build and operate containerized workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service.
  • Design secure integrations involving Azure Key Vault, HSMs, encryption services, certificates, TLS, and mutual TLS.
  • Apply asynchronous programming, concurrency, parallel processing, and multithreading techniques safely in high-throughput systems.
  • Troubleshoot application, database, networking, performance, and production issues.
  • Improve throughput, latency, reliability, scalability, and resource utilization through profiling, testing, and optimization.
  • Build automation and operational tooling using PowerShell or similar scripting technologies.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions and Git-based source control.
  • Contribute to database design, optimization, migration, and troubleshooting, including MySQL-based systems.
  • Implement observability using structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerts.
  • Use tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Jaeger, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Elastic, or Kibana to monitor applications and investigate production behavior.
  • Write architecture and design documentation, including sequence diagrams, flow diagrams, interface contracts, runbooks, and Architecture Decision Records.
  • Apply sound software design principles including OOP, SOLID, DRY, Clean Architecture, dependency injection, and appropriate design patterns.
  • Develop automated unit, integration, component, contract, and performance tests.

About Us:

Pierag is a global consulting firm with a unique business model that blends domestic proficiency with global expertise to serve clients globally. With a team of highly skilled professionals, we serve prominent clients across the US, India, UK, and Southeast Asia in the field of Accounting Advisory, Business Risk, Technology Risk, Assurance, ESG & Sustainability, Transaction Advisory, Tax and Digital.

We are a distinctive firm specializing in front-end consulting, GCC excellence, and PE/VC portfolio support and advisory.

Fueled by our purpose of 'Inspiring people to do things that Inspire them’ and driven by our values of ‘Excellence, Equity and Empathy’, we empower our team to deliver exceptional results for our clients.

Pierag was founded in February 2021 and was formerly known as Pierian – Assurance and Advisory Services.

We have our offices in Gurugram, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Washington DC, Melbourne, and Singapore.

About the role:

Our Innovation Hub primarily focuses on bringing innovation to service delivery focused business lines and other internal functions. We believe that transformational technologies such as artificial intelligence, robotics, and data analytics have the potential to disrupt our business solutions. Adopting these new-age technologies will help us serve clients better.

As a Principal Developer with AI & Digital, you will have the opportunity at every step to interact with Pierag leadership

The Principal Developer acts as the technical anchor for a cross-functional team focused on experimenting with disruptive opportunities in a variety of business areas – such as Operational Accounting, Technical Accounting, Internal Audit, External audit, financial reporting and ESG space.

Key responsibilities:

  • Prototype Innovation Concepts: Rapidly design, build, and test technical proof of concepts (PoC) for new and emerging technologies utilising industry standard tools.
  • Lead Technical Discovery: Identify promising emerging technologies such as GenAI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, Robotic Process Automation etc., assessing their application to real world challenges in finance domain.
  • Deliver Solution Proposals - Develop and communicate strategically aligned solution proposals – covering options, costs, and recommendations, ensuring adherence to Admiral architecture and Cyber Security standards.
  • Architect Experimental Infrastructure: Maintain a secure development environment for the delivery of prototype/experimental applications.
  • Collaboration with Functional teams: Collaborate with Functional teams to build PoC/PoV applications, supporting detailed design creation and technical solution delivery.
  • Agile Management: Take responsibility for day-to-day agile management activities, coaching, line management of the innovation team members.
  • Plan, estimate and execute systems development work to time, budget and quality targets – working closely with Service Line leaders.

provisioning.

vulnerability hardening, and ensure zero deviation from Cisco security baselines.

  • Lifecycle & RMA Management: Execute automated software image management (SWIM) via

Catalyst Center, lead RMA replacements via SDA workflows, and support night maintenance

windows.

  • Hands-on fabric management (Border, Control Plane, Intermediate, Edge, Subtended node

lan automation & integration).

(Velocity/Jinja2).

  • Automated software upgrades (SWIM) and RMA replacement workflows through Catalyst

Center.

  • Advanced policy sets for Wired/Wireless 802.1X (EAP-TLS, EAP-MSCHAPv2, PEAP, MAB).

  • Cisco FTD / Firepower Management Center (FMC) & Cisco ASA.
  • Stateful Active/Standby & Active/Active failover optimization, connection limits, and timeout

tuning.

troubleshooting.

  • Hardware Platforms: Cisco Catalyst 9000 switches (Cat9300, Cat9400, Cat9500, Cat9600), Cisco ISE

appliances/VMs, and Cisco Firepower 2100/4100/9300 Series.

  • Education: B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA in Electronics, Computer Science, or related field.

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Backend / Agent Orchestration
job.description:
Build the Future Workforce

Wand turns AI into labor. It enables humans and AI agents to operate together as a unified, hybrid workforce, with comprehensive management and oversight. And it’s already operating at scale inside some of the world’s largest organizations.

Wand built the world’s first Agentic Labor Infrastructure enabling governments and global enterprises to create, manage, and scale digital workforces.

Our mission is to integrate agent ecosystems into the core of work and business, unlocking a generational leap in the global economy. We’re building the infrastructure that lets humans and AI agents operate together safely, transparently, and at scale.

Join Wand in leading the Agentic Shift

Wand is building a high-performing global team who take full ownership of what they build. We lead by example, move fast, make data-aware decisions, and continuously push for more- always with a focus on delivering real value to customers.

You would be joining a world-class team that combines deep research expertise and real-world product execution, with experience spanning Deepmind, Google, Amazon, Miro, Elise AI, IBM and Accern.

Position Summary

Every agent on our platform runs because of what this team builds. We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help architect the distributed backend that powers agent orchestration at Wand: workflow execution on Temporal, sandboxed agent code, and the pipelines that keep thousands of agents running without falling over. Zero UI, zero fluff. Just hard distributed systems problems at real scale.

You'll pair directly with our Tech Lead on the India based team and take the architecture to the next level. We need someone who can turn "design v3 of this system" into a real, working plan, then help the team build it.

This isn't just about orchestrating a single agent. It's about orchestrating a workforce of agents working together through processes, and building the layer that makes that possible. Orchestration, task execution and tool calling, and sandboxing are largely independent pieces, so depth in any one of them matters more than breadth across all of them.

job.name: Cybersecurity Manager | Gurugram
job.description:
Company Description Maier+Vidorno Altios (part of the Altios Group) has helped more than 1,500 international companies enter and grow in India over 25+ years. With 240+ professionals in India and the Group's presence across 23 countries and 40 offices, we're looking for a hands-on cybersecurity leader to protect our business globally.

This role combines security operations and compliance leadership – ideal for someone who enjoys both solving real security problems and building strong foundations.

Role Description The Group Cybersecurity Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram. looking for a hands-on cybersecurity leader to protect our global group across India, Europe, the Americas and Asia Pacific.

This role is a mix of security operations and compliance leadership – ideal for someone who enjoys both fixing problems and building strong security foundations.

What you'll do:

  • Run day-to-day security operations – SIEM/SOC, XDR, incident response and threat detection
  • Protect the business from email fraud, phishing and payment fraud (BEC)
  • Lead ISO 27001 and other compliance programmes, audits and client security reviews
  • Secure cloud (Azure/AWS), network, endpoint and ERP environments
  • Set security policies, including for the safe use of AI tools
  • Work with our external SOC partner and global IT teams

What we're looking for:

  • 8–12+ years in cybersecurity, with hands-on and leadership experience
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft security (Defender, Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft 365)
  • Real experience owning ISO 27001 or similar audits
  • Excellent communication skills for working with global teams and senior leaders
  • BE/B.Tech, MCA or MSc in Computer Science/IT or related
  • CISSP, CISM or CEH is a plus

Interested or know someone who'd be a great fit? Send your CV to h.tola@mv-altios.com or message me directly. Referrals are welcome!

job.name: Presales Solutions Architect
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Presales Consultant with 10–12 years of expertise in designing, positioning, and presenting enterprise cybersecurity solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on and consultative experience across Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), and Security Configuration Management (SCM). This role requires close collaboration with sales, delivery, product, and customer teams to translate business and security requirements into scalable, compliant, and commercially viable security solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end cybersecurity presales engagements, including requirement gathering, discovery workshops, solution design, technical presentations, product demonstrations, proof of concepts, and proposal support.
  • Design and position solutions across PAM, IAM, EPM, and SCM aligned to customer security posture, compliance requirements, and business objectives.
  • Prepare high-quality technical proposals, solution architecture documents, bill of materials, statements of work, RFP/RFI responses, compliance matrices, and commercial inputs.
  • Engage with CISOs, CIOs, IT heads, risk teams, compliance teams, and infrastructure stakeholders to understand pain points and map them to relevant cybersecurity solutions.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to build account strategy, qualify opportunities, influence deal progression, and support revenue growth.
  • Work closely with OEMs and technology partners for solution validation, pricing, licensing, sizing, and competitive positioning.
  • Conduct customer workshops and deep-dive sessions on privileged access, identity governance, least privilege, endpoint privilege control, secure configuration, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Support smooth handover from presales to delivery teams, ensuring scope, assumptions, dependencies, and success criteria are clearly documented.
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, regulatory requirements, threat landscape, and emerging technologies relevant to identity, privilege, endpoint, and configuration security.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 10–12 years of overall experience in cybersecurity, information security, solution consulting, presales, or technical architecture roles.
  • PAM/IAM Presales experience mandatory

job.name: Mobile Security Engineer (Android / iOS) - RASP, anti-debugging
job.description:
About the Role : We are looking for a Mobile Security Engineer to join a technology team focused on developing advanced security solutions for mobile applications. The role involves researching security threats, analysing vulnerabilities, developing protective mechanisms and strengthening mobile application security across Android and iOS platforms.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Research and develop security solutions for Android and iOS applications.
  • Analyse mobile applications to identify vulnerabilities, attack methods and security gaps.
  • Perform reverse engineering of mobile applications, malware and security tools.
  • Develop and improve mobile application protection mechanisms, including anti-debugging, anti-tampering, anti-hooking and runtime integrity checks.
  • Study and reproduce real-world mobile security attacks to evaluate existing protection mechanisms.
  • Develop and test security techniques using C/C++, Kotlin, Swift or Objective-C.
  • Work with reverse engineering and dynamic analysis tools to identify potential security weaknesses.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of mobile security SDKs.
  • Understand relevant banking and fintech security regulations and their implications for mobile application security.
  • Participate in technical discussions with enterprise customers and internal engineering teams.
  • Document research findings, security vulnerabilities and defensive solutions.

Experience and Qualification :

  • 5–12 years of experience in application security, mobile security, reverse engineering or penetration testing.
  • Strong understanding of Android and/or iOS application security.
  • Hands-on experience in mobile application reverse engineering.
  • Familiarity with dynamic instrumentation and runtime analysis.
  • Experience with tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, JEB or JADX.
  • Exposure to Frida, GDB, LLDB or similar tools.
  • Experience developing or evaluating RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection) solutions.
  • Ability to analyse compiled code and understand low-level application behaviour.
  • Experience in mobile malware analysis.
  • Knowledge of Android internals or iOS security mechanisms.
  • Experience with native code analysis (C/C++).
  • Understanding of mobile application protection, obfuscation and anti-tampering techniques.
  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD and Linux/Unix environments.

job.name: Technical Authority Expert-IP
job.description:

Also responsible for Trouble Ticket analysis and resolution of trouble tickets raised by Customer / L2 Teams. job.name: Principal Cybersecurity Expert
job.description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Role Overview:

Turing is looking for a Principal Cybersecurity Expert to lead a full-time pod of about 10 cybersecurity experts who label security data and run light investigations for a leading AI lab. You will set how the pod works, settle policy and judgment calls, and be the pod’s main domain voice with the client.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a practitioner who makes clear calls quickly. It is not a research or academic position, and a PhD is not expected.

What does day-to-day look like?

  • Lead 2 to 3 Seniors and 6 to 7 Juniors on cybersecurity labeling and investigation tasks for AI model training and evaluation.
  • Turn client goals into guidelines, rubrics and decision rules the pod applies consistently.
  • Make the final call on ambiguous or policy-sensitive cases and document each decision as reusable guidance.
  • Set the quality bar with Seniors through QC sampling, calibration sessions and feedback to Juniors.
  • Keep investigations scoped by deciding when a case has been looked at enough.
  • Report throughput, quality and recurring issues to the client and internal delivery team, and propose guideline changes.
  • Help onboard and assess new pod members early in the engagement.

Requirements:

  • 8 to 15 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in areas such as security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, application security, penetration testing or vulnerability research.
  • Experience leading or mentoring analysts or engineers, including setting standards and reviewing their work.
  • Working experience with large language models: using them in security workflows, evaluating their outputs, red-teaming them or contributing to AI training data.
  • Offensive and defensive range deep enough to judge others’ analysis across domains.
  • Sound judgment on security policy, responsible disclosure and dual-use content.
  • Clear written English for writing guidelines others follow.
  • Available full-time for 6 to 12 months, with no competing full-time commitments.

Preferred Qualifications:

job.name: Production Monitoring Engineer
job.description:
Role Overview The Monitoring Engineer is a hands‑on technical role responsible for the day‑to‑day administration, configuration, and maintenance of enterprise monitoring platforms, with a primary focus on New Relic.

The role supports the delivery of effective monitoring and observability across FNZ platforms by implementing agreed monitoring standards, maintaining tooling health, and ensuring monitoring configurations remain current and reliable.

This position works closely with Monitoring Architects, Senior Analysts, Production Support, and Engineering teams. Monitoring requirements, strategy, and design direction are driven by Architects and senior operational stakeholders; the Monitoring Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining, and supporting those requirements effectively.

The Monitoring Engineer plays a key role in ensuring monitoring tooling enables timely issue detection, efficient incident investigation, and improved platform reliability.

Team Responsibilities The current climate has no tolerance for slow performance, broken functionality or downtime with a need for constant and clear visibility into the end-to-end performance of our production applications.

Application Monitoring – developing new and innovative solutions to our monitoring requirements.

Stakeholder Communication – ensuring all monitoring solutions are embedded into production BAU and handed over to our operational support teams.

Project management – Manage our monitoring solutions from design, build, test, implementation and handover. Our team follows a Devops model so we will maintain our tooling and build for any upgrades, defects or improvements after go live.

Service Level Management – support the Service Managers in delivering FNZ services within KPIs, SLAs and contractual obligations.

Specific Role Responsibilities Administer and maintain New Relic monitoring components under guidance from Architects and Senior Analysts, including agent configuration, alert policies, dashboards, and integrations.

Ensure New Relic agents are installed, configured correctly, and upgraded in accordance with agreed schedules and standards.

Implement monitoring for new services, applications, or infrastructure following provided requirements and design guidance.

Assist in managing requests for new monitoring deployments or changes, ensuring they are implemented accurately and consistently.

Support the maintenance of alerting rules and thresholds to ensure they are meaningful, reliable, and aligned with operational needs.

Create and maintain dashboards and visualisations to support Production Support and Engineering teams.

Maintain accurate documentation, including setup guides, configuration details, and operational runbooks.

Support vendor support cases and escalations, including collecting evidence and implementing recommended fixes.

Read the full description

job.name: Cyber- DT&P- Infrastructure - AI Security Senior Consultant
job.description:
Summary Position Summary AI Security Consultant, Infrastructure

As an AI Security Senior Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.

Work you'll do

As an AI Security Senior Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead discovery and architecture analysis for managed AI services, self-hosted model stacks, cloud foundations, networks and operational tooling.
  • Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
  • Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
  • Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
  • Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
  • Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
  • Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
  • Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team

Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.

We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.

Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.

Qualifications Required:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Turing is looking for a Principal Cybersecurity Expert to lead a full-time pod of about 10 cybersecurity experts who label security data and run light investigations for a leading AI lab.   • Report throughput, quality and recurring issues to the client and internal delivery team, and propose guideline changes.
  • Help onboard and assess new pod members early in the engagement.

  • 8 to 15 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in areas such as security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, application security, penetration testing or vulnerability research.

  • Working experience with large language models: using them in security workflows, evaluating their outputs, red-teaming them or contributing to AI training data.

job.name: Brand Manager
job.description:
Brand Manager

Tiger Food Ingredients Private Limited · Chennai · On-site · Full-time · 4–7 years (FMCG / Food)

About Us

Tiger Food Ingredients Private Limited is a Chennai-based FMCG company that makes food ingredients across three manufacturing units, with high standards of quality and food safety. We have an established presence in South India across retail stores and online platforms. We are growing fast and building a team that takes pride in quality, discipline and speed.

The Role

You will be the owner of our brands, accountable for how they grow, how they are seen, and how much they earn. You will define where each brand plays and how it wins: positioning, product portfolio, pricing, packaging, launches and communication across offline and online channels. You will turn consumer and market insight into plans that drive sales and market share, and measure every rupee spent. You will work closely with the Marketing Manager, Sales, R&D/NPD, Finance, Operations and our creative team and agencies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Strategy & Positioning

  • Define and maintain a clear positioning, brand promise, target consumer and personality for each brand and product range.
  • Build the annual brand plan for each brand: objectives, volume and value targets, growth drivers, activities, calendar and budget.
  • Maintain brand guidelines (logo, colours, tone, packaging rules) and make sure every touchpoint follows them.
  • Track brand health (awareness, trial, repeat, preference) and adjust the strategy based on results.

2. Consumer & Market Insight

  • Run consumer research: home visits, store visits, surveys, focus groups and taste tests, to understand how people buy and use our products.
  • Track market size, category trends, competitor products, pricing, promotions and launches across South India.
  • Use sales, distribution, e-commerce and retail data to find growth opportunities and gaps.
  • Turn insights into clear actions for product, pack, price, promotion and communication.

3. Portfolio, Pricing & Profitability

  • Own the brand portfolio: which SKUs, pack sizes and price points we sell in each channel and region.
  • With Finance and Sales, recommend pricing, MRP and trade margins that protect profitability while staying competitive.
  • Track brand-wise sales, contribution margin and A&P (advertising and promotion) spend against plan every month.
  • Review slow-moving SKUs and recommend improvements or delisting.

4. New Product Development & Launches

job.name: Firmware Engineer
job.description:
About the role

You will own hardware and firmware for BatteryPool's battery-swapping stations and

energy storage products, from design through production to field support.

You will run several hardware programmes in parallel, lead a small team of early-career

engineers, and stay hands-on in firmware. Station firmware and battery communication

are at the core of the product, and you will be the person who knows them best.

The near-term priorities are keeping deployed stations stable in the field, measured by

swap count and station uptime; automating production; and giving the operations team

the tools to resolve known issues on their own.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Technical ownership

  • Own hardware and firmware end to end across multiple parallel programmes: design,development, build, optimisation and production release.
  • Set the firmware architecture for stations on ESP32 and STM32, including multi-controller communication.
  • Support multiple battery pack protocols in one firmware with automatic battery type detection, and integrate new battery.
  • Own connectivity and field updates: Wi-Fi/MQTT, Bluetooth, RFID, HMI integration and FOTA.
  • Review schematics and board revisions with the hardware team and PCB vendors.
  • Own the test strategy: Fault simulation, HIL rigs, long-duration validation and standard test procedures.

Operations and delivery

  • Plan FOTA rollouts: schedules, staging and rollbacks.
  • Lead post-deployment monitoring, root-cause analysis and escalations for field issues.
  • Automate production firmware deployment, flashing and PDI so production runs faster and smoother.
  • Build troubleshooting documents and tools so the operations team can fix known issues without engineering.
  • Act as the technical expert with clients and battery OEMs.

Technical requirements

  • Expert embedded C; working C++.
  • Production firmware shipped on both ESP32 and STM32.
  • FreeRTOS in depth: task design, synchronisation, timing and memory.
  • Protocols: CAN/CAN-FD, SPI, I2C, UART and RS485/Modbus.
  • Connectivity and updates: Wi-Fi, MQTT, BLE, bootloaders and OTA/FOTA.
  • Hardware: read and review schematics, bring up boards, and understand power and protection circuits.
  • Debugging with an oscilloscope, logic analyser, CAN analyser and JTAG/SWD debugger.
  • Tooling: PlatformIO, ESP-IDF, STM32CubeIDE; Git; Python scripting.
  • Test setups for firmware: HIL rigs, simulators and validation.

Must Have:

  • B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation or a related field.
  • At least one embedded product taken from prototype to production at scale.
  • Has led or mentored engineers.
  • Based in Pune or willing to relocate; willing to travel to stations, the production line and vendor sites.

Good to have:

Support a London-based family office as an Operations Analyst in Mumbai. You will support with maintaining the portfolio management system, invoicing, day-to-day operations and internal reporting. Key Responsibilities

Portfolio management system and tools

  • Keep client, account and position data accurate

Invoicing

Consolidated reporting and decks

Process improvement

  • Document procedures so processes are repeatable
  • Spot manual, error-prone steps and improve them using Excel and Microsoft 365

Essential

  • Unquestionable integrity, which matters above any skill or knowledge in this role
  • Strict confidentiality, as you will handle sensitive client and financial information daily
  • Driven, curious problem-solver who takes ownership
  • Basic understanding of how financial markets work, including equities, bonds and funds
  • Intermediate in Microsoft 365
  • Comfortable with numbers and complexity, with strong attention to detail
  • Fluent English and good communication skills
  • Comfortable working UK hours (1:30 PM to 10:30 PM IST)

job.description:
About the Role

The Risk Engineer will be responsible for conducting technical risk assessments, evaluating loss exposure, and providing risk improvement recommendations for commercial and corporate clients across various industry segments. The role supports underwriting teams by enabling informed risk selection, pricing, portfolio management, and loss prevention initiatives to improve profitability and reduce claims frequency and severity.

Responsibilities

Risk Assessment & Surveys

  • Conduct onsite and virtual risk inspections for commercial and industrial risks.
  • Evaluate fire, engineering, property, liability, marine, infrastructure, and specialty risks.
  • Assess adequacy of fire protection systems, life safety measures, process safety controls, business continuity arrangements, and risk management frameworks.
  • Identify loss exposures associated with manufacturing processes, storage practices, utilities, machinery, hazardous materials, and operational controls.
  • Review compliance with statutory safety regulations and industry best practices.

Underwriting Support

  • Provide technical inputs to underwriters regarding risk acceptability, coverage structure, deductibles, warranties, and pricing considerations.
  • Analyze risk quality and prepare risk grading reports to support underwriting decisions.
  • Participate in pre-underwriting surveys for large corporate accounts and complex risks.
  • Support facultative reinsurance submissions through detailed risk assessment reports.

Risk Improvement & Loss Prevention

  • Develop risk improvement recommendations aimed at reducing claim frequency and loss severity.

  • This is an Internal document.
  • Monitor implementation of risk improvement measures and provide follow-up assessments.
  • Assist clients in strengthening fire protection, occupational safety, asset protection, and operational controls.
  • Conduct loss prevention workshops, client awareness programs, and risk management presentations.

Claims & Loss Analysis

  • Support claims teams in investigation of major losses where required.
  • Conduct root cause analysis of significant incidents and recommend preventive controls.
  • Review historical claims experience and identify emerging risk trends.
  • Prepare technical reports on large loss events and lessons learned.

Portfolio & Risk Analytics

  • Analyze risk inspection data and develop portfolio-level insights.
  • Support catastrophe exposure assessment and accumulation monitoring.
  • Track key risk indicators across property, engineering, marine, and liability portfolios.
  • Contribute to development of risk engineering guidelines and underwriting manuals.

job.name: Online Arbitrage Sourcing Specialist (US Market).
job.description:
Job description

Job title: Online Arbitrage Sourcing Specialist (Amazon US / Walmart US)

Company: Rey Ecom Ops Pvt ltd

Location: Laxmi Nagar, Delhi (On-site)

Employment Type: Full-time

Working hours: IST

Experience: Minimum 1 year of hands-on online arbitrage or product sourcing for Amazon US and/or Walmart US

Salary: Salary + performance incentive on profitable leads

About the role

We are looking for a sourcing specialist who can find profitable products from US retail websites and resell them on Amazon US, Walmart US and other marketplaces. You will own the full lead process: finding products, checking demand and competition, calculating profit, and flagging risks before we buy. Your work directly drives our inventory decisions and profit, so accuracy matters more than volume.

Key responsibilities

  • Source profitable products daily from US retailers (Walmart.com, Target, Kohl's, Walgreens, CVS, Home Depot, Zoro, Best Buy and others) for resale on Amazon US and Walmart US
  • Analyze each lead with Keepa: sales rank history, price stability, number of sellers, Buy Box rotation and whether Amazon sells on the listing
  • Calculate buy cost, FBA/WFS fees, referral fees, prep and inbound shipping, net profit and ROI using SellerAmp SAS or similar tools
  • Estimate monthly sales and recommend a safe buy quantity for each lead
  • Check every lead for risk: gated brands and categories, IP and brand complaints, hazmat, private label, variation and listing-match issues, restricted products
  • Stack savings with coupons, cashback portals (e.g. Rakuten), discounted gift cards and retailer promotions
  • Track retailer sales, clearance events and seasonal trends (Q4, back-to-school, Prime Day) to plan buys ahead
  • Maintain a clear lead sheet with source link, ASIN, cost, sell price, fees, profit, ROI, estimated sales and notes
  • Monitor replenishable winners and rebuy them when prices and margins stay healthy
  • Coordinate with the purchasing team and prep center on orders, shipments and inventory (if assigned)
  • Report weekly on leads found, leads approved, sell-through and actual vs. expected profit

Requirements (must-have)

1+ year of proven online arbitrage or product sourcing experience for Amazon US and/or Walmart US

Strong command of Keepa and SellerAmp SAS (or BuyBotPro / Tactical Arbitrage)

Clear understanding of Amazon FBA fees, referral fees, Buy Box behaviour and sales rank

Knowledge of Amazon and Walmart policies: gating, ungating, IP complaints, restricted and hazmat products, invoice and authenticity requirements

Good spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets or Excel): formulas, filters, lead tracking

Good written English for working with US suppliers, prep centers and managers

Detail-oriented, honest about mistakes, and comfortable working with targets

Good to have

Experience with Walmart Seller Center and Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS)

job.name: AEO & GEO Specialist
job.description:
JOB TITLE: AEO & GEO Specialist (AI Search Optimization)

Company: NetPuppys Technologies Pvt Ltd

Location: Gurugram (JMD Megapolis, Sector 48), work from office

Experience: 2–4 years in SEO or content strategy, including at least 1 year of hands-on work on AI search visibility (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini)

Employment Type: Full-time

PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is a specialist role focused on AI search, not a general SEO or digital marketing position. We're looking for someone who has worked on getting brands mentioned, cited and recommended in AI-generated answers, and who can show examples. If your experience is only traditional SEO (keywords, backlinks, rankings) and you haven't worked on AI search visibility yet, this role isn't the right fit.

ABOUT NETPUPPYS

NetPuppys is an AI-forward digital marketing company headquartered in Gurugram, with offices in Dubai and Frisco, USA. We drive growth for brands in real estate, education, e-commerce, pharma and travel/tech through SEO, performance marketing, social media, content and web development.

ROLE OVERVIEW

More and more buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini or Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode instead of clicking through search results. We're hiring an AEO & GEO Specialist to make sure our clients show up in those answers. You'll track how AI platforms talk about our clients, find the gaps, and fix them through content, structured data, entity building and off-site brand mentions. You'll work closely with our SEO, content and PR teams and help build NetPuppys' AI search offering.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

AI visibility audits and tracking

  • Audit how client brands appear across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode
  • Build prompt sets that match how real customers ask questions in each client's industry, and track them over time
  • Measure brand mentions, citations, share of voice, sentiment and accuracy versus competitors
  • Find which sources AI platforms cite in each category, and where clients are missing
  • Track AI-referral traffic in GA4 and report its impact on leads and conversions

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

  • Structure content so AI systems can extract it easily: question-led headings, short direct answers, FAQs, comparison tables, definitions and summaries
  • Implement and validate structured data (Organization, Product, FAQ, Article, LocalBusiness, Review, HowTo and more)
  • Optimize for featured snippets, People Also Ask and Google AI Overviews
  • Make sure key pages are crawlable and readable by AI crawlers (rendering, page speed, clean HTML)

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

job.name: Product Manager
job.description:
Who we are

Verona is an authenticated matchmaking community designed exclusively for the modern, global Indian. We’re on a mission to foster fulfilling partnerships that last lifetimes. In a country

where dating app disillusionment abounds, Verona makes the matchmaking process delightful—and effective.

Verona was founded by two serial entrepreneurs Mr. Poshak Agrawal and Mr. Rahul Subramaniam, and backed by some of the biggest names in global technology, such as Mr. Michael Novogratz (ex-Fortress Investment Group, CEO of Galaxy Group Investments), Mr. Rishi Jaitly (ex-Twitter CEO for Asia, Middle East, and Africa) and Mr. Yuvraj Singh (co-founder, DMI Finance).

Verona is built on two foundations: security and science. Every member goes through fintech-grade authentication before matchmaking begins, which keeps fraud out and the community trustworthy. Our matching is grounded in the science of compatibility, using AI to connect people based on their core and shared values.

Role Brief

As a Product Manager at Verona, you will be responsible for owning the end-to-end lifecycle of Verona features, from problem definition and system design to post-launch iteration. You will work closely with Engineering and Design teams to translate business requirements into detailed product logic, drive day-to-day execution, and act as the final quality gate to ensure a high-quality, data-driven user experience across the platform.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s/ Master’s from a Tier 1 institute (preferred)
  • 3-6 years of experience in product management or engineering roles
  • Experience in consumer products and analytics
  • Strong communication and attention to detail

Key Responsibilities

1) Feature & Systems Design

  • Translate business and user requirements into detailed product logic, covering user flows, system behavior, and state transitions.
  • Define how features behave across different states (e.g., session persistence, backgrounding, retries, cross-tab interactions).
  • Proactively identify and design for edge cases and failure scenarios (e.g., API failures, latency, empty states) to ensure a seamless user experience.

2) Execution & Delivery Excellence

  • Break down features into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable efficient development.
  • Drive day-to-day execution within the squad, ensuring clarity of scope, priorities, and timelines.
  • Actively unblock Design and Engineering by resolving ambiguities and making timely decisions.

3) Quality Ownership & Release Management

  • Conduct thorough end-to-end User Acceptance Testing (UAT), validating both expected flows and edge cases.
  • Ensure the final build meets defined product standards and delivers a consistent, reliable user experience.
  • Own release readiness, including documentation, communication, and coordination with relevant stakeholders.

4) Data & Analytics

job.name: Business Operations & Strategy Intern
job.description:
About La&Li (Wingit)

La&Li is a luxury multi-brand beauty company bringing the beauty counter to the customer's home. Trained Beauty Advisors visit customers at home, where they can try products from 80+ global brands, including YSL, Lancôme, Givenchy, Kérastase and a curated K-beauty edit, and pay only for what they keep.

We're a founding team preparing for launch, and we're looking for driven interns who want to build from the ground up.

Who You Are

  • You close loops on your own. Once something is assigned to you, it gets done, and nobody has to follow up with you twice. If you're stuck, you say so early.
  • You hold a high bar and notice the details. A wrong number in a sheet, a missed customer note, a typo in an SOP: you catch them, because in luxury the details make the experience.
  • You're fast without being sloppy. You move quickly, prioritise sharply and ship work that holds up. Speed and quality aren't trade-offs for you.
  • You're comfortable with numbers. Excel and Google Sheets are second nature.
  • You communicate clearly with customers, field teams and founders alike.

What You'll Get

As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine, highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive. Our seasoned engineers are central to the success of the World protocol. About The Role We are looking for an AI Agent Security Architect to function as the primary technical authority for Replit’s autonomous and AI agent security blueprint. In this critical role, you will design, implement, and maintain the runtime defense systems, guardrail frameworks, and sandboxing architectures that govern AI agents executing code, invoking tools, and reasoning across our platform. You will be a key technical contributor—leading high-impact AI security initiatives and bridging the gap between non-deterministic AI behavior and rigorous cybersecurity controls for both engineering and executive leadership.

What You'll Do

  • AI Agent Security Strategy & Technical Execution
  • AI Agent Security Blueprint: Define the long-term vision and architectural patterns for securing autonomous agent workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, multi-turn reasoning loops, and multi-agent coordination.
  • Runtime Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Architect and deploy dynamic input/output guardrail systems, semantic firewalls, and real-time intent verification filters to prevent goal hijacking, system prompt leaks, and indirect prompt injections.
  • Agent Execution & Tool Sandboxing: Partner with Infrastructure and AppSec teams to design secure, short-lived, micro-isolated environments (e.g., microVMs, WebAssembly, container sandboxes) where agents can dynamically execute code, run shell commands, and interact with host operating systems safely.
  • Agentic Threat Modeling & Red Teaming: Conduct specialized threat modeling against non-deterministic systems. Lead automated and manual AI red-teaming initiatives to uncover vulnerabilities in RAG context pipelines, vector stores, and tool-calling interfaces.
  • Identity, Delegation & Least Privilege: Architect fine-grained permission models and step-up Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) authorization patterns for agents acting on behalf of users—ensuring agents never exceed the delegated privileges of the end user or misuse API keys.
  • Context & Memory Boundary Security: Design strict data isolation and poisoning prevention controls for vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and long-term conversation memories across multi-tenant workloads.
  • Risk Management & Cross-Functional Enablement
  • Maintain the AI Security Source of Truth: Define, document, and maintain authoritative secure design patterns and SDKs for engineering teams building internal or customer-facing AI agent capabilities.
  • Contribution to Risk Register: Identify, quantify, and document non-deterministic and agentic security risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, MITRE ATLAS), ensuring they are accurately represented in the Cybersecurity Risk Regi

Amber earns a commission from property partners for every student booking made through our platform. Turning a booking into collected revenue involves validating the booking, confirming attribution and move-in, reconciling with the partner, and managing invoicing and collections across the UK, US, Australia, Canada and other markets.

job.name: Virtual SoC Modeling Engineer
job.description:
Company Description

PathinAI designs low-power AI silicon for “physical AI” applications, including robots, drones, vehicles, and industrial machines that sense and act in the real world. The company focuses on transformer-based models running under strict power constraints and builds chips from the workload up, avoiding unnecessary general-purpose features. Its flagship chip, Clean Future CF-1, is a low-power AI accelerator that supports multi-camera perception, sensor fusion, and on-device vision-language models, integrating alongside existing compute boards. Each chip is developed through the PathinAI AI Silicon Platform, which includes workload profiling, virtual silicon simulation, architecture exploration, pre-silicon validation on FPGA, and manufacturing. PathinAI collaborates with robotics, automotive, industrial AI, and semiconductor/OEM teams via solutions such as AI Silicon Assessment, Virtual SoC, Custom AI Accelerator, and Pre-Silicon Validation, with design and IP held in India.

Role Description

The Virtual SoC Modeling Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Noida. This role focuses on creating and refining virtual System-on-Chip (SoC) models to support PathinAI’s AI Silicon Platform, especially the Virtual Silicon and Pre-Silicon Validation stages. Day-to-day work includes developing and maintaining simulation environments, modeling SoC components and subsystems, and running experiments to evaluate candidate architectures under representative AI workloads. The engineer collaborates closely with architecture, R&D, and validation teams to translate workload intelligence into accurate models, analyze performance, power, and functional behavior, and recommend design improvements. Responsibilities also include documenting modeling methodologies, supporting test plan development, and contributing to continuous enhancement of internal tools and workflows.

Qualifications

  • Design controls for agent access, execution, and accountability.
  • Contribute across endpoint, network, identity, and SaaS security, and support incident investigations when needed.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

  • Have independently investigated novel or emerging vulnerabilities and driven enterprise remediation from uncertain initial reports through mitigation and verified closure.
  • Bring technical depth in a relevant security domain and working knowledge across networks, endpoints, and SaaS.
  • Can understand and improve code and safely integrate APIs and security systems.
  • Have solved substantive problems using AI agents and can explain how you evaluated and corrected their work.
  • Think clearly about security tradeoffs, ambiguous evidence, and the changing risks of agentic systems.
  • Collaborate effectively, take ownership, and communicate technical risk to varied audiences.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Security
job.description:
The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our security team - the group responsible for keeping 70+ million creators, and everything they’ve built, safe. Linktree is the front door to a creator’s whole digital presence, which makes it a target: account takeover, abusive content, scraped data, third-party integrations with more access than they should have. This role is about building the systems that make those attacks hard.

This is hands-on engineering, not advisory work. You’ll design and ship authentication and authorisation improvements, secrets handling, abuse and fraud detection, and the internal tooling that lets every other squad build securely by default. You’ll be across TypeScript, Node, React and AWS, and you’ll work with Engineering, Product and Trust & Safety to decide where to harden, where to simplify, and where a control costs more in creator friction than it buys in risk reduction.

It’s a role for someone who thinks in systems and failure modes, who would rather remove a class of vulnerability than patch instances of it, and who can bring other engineers along rather than block them. Every control you ship protects someone’s livelihood - and helps Linktree achieve our mission: to empower anyone to curate and grow their digital universe.

What You’ll Own

  • Design and ship security improvements across the Linktree product: authentication and authorisation, session and token handling, secrets management and third-party access.
  • Build the detection and response capability for the product surface - abuse, account takeover, scraping and fraud - so problems surface before creators report them.
  • Threat model new and existing systems with the squads that own them, and turn the output into prioritised, shipped work.
  • Own the internal tooling and paved paths that make it easy for every other engineer to build securely by default.
  • Triage and remediate vulnerabilities from internal findings, bug bounty and pen tests, and fix the class of problem rather than the instance.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product and Trust & Safety on where to harden and where a control costs more in creator friction than it buys in risk reduction.
  • Bring AI into how you build, and use it to move faster on reviews, migrations and investigation - while staying clear-eyed about what it gets wrong.
  • Raise the security bar around you through review, pairing, documentation and mentoring.

Who We’re Looking For

job.name: Senior Security Engineer, AWS Human Access Security
job.description:
Description AHAS reduces the risk of human and operator access to AWS production systems and customer environments. As the Senior Security Engineer embedded with an AHAS software development team, you own the security design decisions for the operator-access tooling this team builds — tooling that engineers across AWS depend on to request, scope, and audit their access. You define what constitutes the highest-risk operator access, quantify it with data, and partner with teams across AWS to move that access to lower-risk patterns or remove it.

Key job responsibilities

  • Define what counts as high-risk human access to production systems and the data they hold. You identify the access patterns (standing credentials, broad emergency access, unscoped remote sessions, unreviewed privilege elevation) that carry the greatest risk, and you rank them with data rather than opinion.
  • Drive design decisions that lower access risk by default: scoped and time-bound credentials, reviewed privilege elevation, and auditable emergency access, so systems stay secure without depending on operator discipline.
  • Partner with engineering teams across the organization to reduce risky access. You turn your risk model into concrete remediation, negotiate adoption, and measure the reduction over time.
  • Build the measurement and detection capabilities that show where risky access exists and whether it is trending down, and use that data to prioritize the work.
  • Investigate security issues involving human access and turn each one into a durable improvement in the tooling or the risk model, not a one-off fix.
  • Mentor software and security engineers, raise the bar through design and code review, and represent your team's security posture to leadership and partner teams.

A day in the life

Most days come down to one question: who can reach critical production systems, and how do we make that access safer? You dig into the data, find the access patterns that carry the most risk, and decide what to tackle first. Then the part that matters most: you take each finding to the software engineers you work with and build the fix into the tooling, so the identification becomes automatic instead of something you teams have to discover. You'll also win over teams across the company to build tools and mechanisms to remove the risk completeley. Find the problem, then automate it away.

About The Team AWS Human Access Security (AHAS) is a security and engineering team with one mission: make it safe for people to operate the systems that run AWS. Every engineer who touches production is our customer, and we build the tools they use to understand their access and reduce their risk. We pair security engineers with software engineers so good security is built into the product, not bolted on afterward. We care about measurable impact, clear thinking, and shipping fixes that stick. If you want your work to lower real risk across a huge fleet, join us.

Read the full description

job.name: Computer Vision Engineer
job.description:
Title: Computer Vision Engineer

Experience: 1–3 Years

Location: Bengaluru

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech or higher in robotics, electronics, computer science, or a related field.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on computer vision engineer with experience in geometric vision, camera calibration, and 3D perception. The role involves working on multi-camera and LiDAR-based systems, developing 3D perception solutions, and improving measurement accuracy using real-world sensor data.

You will work on production-level computer vision systems, contribute to calibration tools, and solve real-world challenges involving 3D reconstruction, point clouds, and object dimensioning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform intrinsic and extrinsic calibration of multi-camera systems, including RGB, depth, and wide-FOV cameras.
  • Develop and improve 3D perception algorithms for point-cloud processing, dimensioning, tracking, and aggregation.
  • Work with camera geometry, sensor data, and 3D reconstruction techniques to improve measurement accuracy.
  • Use Python, NumPy, OpenCV, and ROS/ROS2 for development and implementation.
  • Analyze real-world accuracy issues, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement production-level fixes.
  • Build calibration tools, automate workflows, and maintain technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams for system testing, deployment, and improvements.

Required Skills

  • Strong programming skills in Python, NumPy, and OpenCV.
  • Understanding of camera geometry, intrinsics, extrinsics, lens distortion, PnP, and coordinate transformations.
  • Hands-on experience with ROS/ROS2 and 3D point clouds (Open3D, PCL, or similar).
  • Familiarity with Linux, Git, and Docker.
  • Knowledge of LiDAR, depth cameras, camera calibration, or SLAM will be an added advantage.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on real-world computer vision and 3D perception applications.
  • Gain hands-on exposure to camera, depth, and LiDAR technologies.
  • Take ownership of production-level engineering projects.
  • Work with a small, collaborative team where your contributions make a direct impact.
  • Get the opportunity to work with real sensor data and physical lab setups.

job.name: Senior Voice Engineer
job.description:
Role: Voice AI Engineer

Experience: 4+ Years

Location: Remote

Role Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - Voice AI to build and scale real-time conversational AI systems for our healthcare interpretation platform . You'll work on voice agents , speech processing , and backend infrastructure to deliver low-latency, reliable, and seamless multilingual conversations.

What You'll Do

  • Build and enhance real-time Voice AI agents integrating Speech-to-Text (STT), LLMs , and Text-to-Speech (TTS).
  • Develop audio streaming pipelines , including voice activity detection, turn detection, interruption handling, and session management.
  • Integrate speech and AI providers such as Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, OpenAI , or similar platforms.
  • Work with real-time communication technologies such as WebSockets , WebRTC , SIP , and telephony integrations .
  • Build scalable backend services, APIs , and event-driven workflows to support voice interactions.
  • Optimise latency, reliability, and performance across the voice pipeline.
  • Collaborate with the ML and product teams to integrate and productionize speech and language models.
  • Contribute to cloud deployments, monitoring, CI/CD, and secure handling of sensitive healthcare data.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience, with hands-on experience building and deploying Voice AI applications.
  • Strong experience integrating STT, LLM, and TTS into conversational voice systems.
  • Experience with real-time audio streaming, WebSockets, WebRTC, or telephony-based systems.
  • Understanding of voice activity detection (VAD), turn detection, barge-in, and latency optimisation.
  • Proficiency in Python , with experience building backend services and APIs.
  • Experience with frameworks or platforms such as LiveKit, Pipecat, Vapi, Twilio, Asterisk, or similar.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Docker, AWS, and production deployment practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to own features end to end.

Good to Have

  • Experience with multilingual speech recognition , translation, and synthesis.
  • Experience with healthcare applications, clinical workflows, or sensitive data environments.
  • Exposure to Go, React, Next.js, Kubernetes, and LLM evaluation.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA, SOC 2, or other data security and compliance standards.

job.name: UiPath Architect
job.description:
Job Description: Lead / Architect – RPA Developer (UiPath)

Experience: 8 Years

Location: Bengaluru

Hiring: Walk-in Drive

Role Type: Hands-on Development / Technical Leadership

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Lead / Architect – RPA Developer with strong hands-on expertise in UiPath automation development, solution design, and production support. The ideal candidate should have experience building and maintaining high-volume production bots, integrating REST APIs, optimizing automation workflows, and reviewing bot designs.

This is a hands-on role requiring daily development and troubleshooting using UiPath Studio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable RPA solutions using UiPath Studio.
  • Build and troubleshoot production-grade bots handling high transaction volumes.
  • Integrate REST APIs into UiPath workflows and replace screen-based automation with API-based solutions wherever feasible.
  • Implement UiPath REFramework, Orchestrator queues, and exception-handling mechanisms.
  • Develop reusable components for API connectivity, retries, logging, monitoring, and alerts.
  • Troubleshoot live production bots, identify root causes, and resolve recurring failures.
  • Review bot designs and provide technical guidance on automation architecture and best practices.
  • Ensure automation solutions are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and performance-optimized.

Mandatory Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in RPA development and UiPath delivery.
  • Strong hands-on experience with UiPath Studio and UiPath Orchestrator.
  • Proven experience delivering and supporting production-level automation projects.
  • Strong knowledge of REFramework, queues, exception handling, and transaction processing.
  • Hands-on experience with REST API integration and API-based automation.
  • Experience developing reusable and modular automation components.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and production support skills.
  • Ability to explain end-to-end RPA projects, including transaction volumes, production issues, and resolutions.

Interview Requirement

Candidates must have UiPath Studio installed (Community Edition or higher) and be prepared for a practical hands-on coding task.

Candidates should be ready to demonstrate a working solution and walk through at least one end-to-end UiPath project, covering:

  • Automation architecture and design
  • Transaction volumes and production scale
  • API integrations and workflow optimization
  • Production failures and troubleshooting approach

  • Strong knowledge of networking, L2/L3 forwarding, and service provider technologies.
  • Experience with Linux/UNIX systems, embedded software debugging, testing, and performance analysis.

job.name: Tech Lead - Backend
job.description:
Tech Lead (IC) – Architecting the Next Billion-User Systems

About Us

We’re Primetrace Technologies - the team behind:

Crafto – 100M+ downloads- https://crafto.app/

Kutumb – 100M+ downloads- https://kutumbapp.com/

We build products used by tens of millions. And we don’t have the luxury of things “just working.” They have to scale, survive, and stay fast — always.

About Role:

This isn’t a “manage the team” role. This is a build, break, scale, and own every damn line of backend logic role.

Our systems run on Node.js and AWS, and your job is to make them bulletproof under traffic.

If you’re the kind of engineer who gets angry when a request takes 500 ms... keep reading.

What You’ll D

  • Architect Node.js systems that scale from zero to millions - resilient, battle-tested, and ready for anything.
  • Tear apart bottlenecks before they become outages.
  • Build a backend that auto-heals, scales without begging, and doesn’t melt at 1M RPM.
  • Own the full lifecycle - from feature idea to scaling in production.
  • Guide engineers, set the technical bar, and call out flawed designs.
  • Think ahead: design for chaos, failovers, and ugly realities before they happen.

You’re Built for This If

  • You’ve watched a system catch fire and brought it back with grit and caffeine.
  • You’ve scaled services under brutal load and lived to tell the story.
  • You know Node.js beyond frameworks - profiling, event loop internals, async churn.
  • You can rip apart AWS quirks (RDS slow queries, ElastiCache meltdowns, S3 limits) in your sleep.
  • You don’t wait for instructions - you see a mess and fix it.

Bonus XP (Things That Impress Us)

  • You’ve taken systems to 100M+ users or 6-digit RPS.
  • You’ve crushed AWS bills without slowing down a single request.
  • You’ve built real-time madness: Kafka, Kinesis, WebSockets.
  • You’ve designed secure-by-default infra: IAM, VPC, KMS.

What’s In It For You

  • Total ownership. Your code decides if we scale or die.
  • Zero politics, zero handholding. Just outcomes.
  • Massive visibility. If you’re good, everyone will know it.
  • Work with a team that’s already shipped to 100M+ people - and is doing it again.
  • If you’ve fought fires in production, debugged chaos at 3 AM, and still wanted more - you’re our kind of engineer.

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

About the Role

We’re looking for experienced, hands-on software engineers to help evaluate and improve AI coding models .

Rather than primarily building production applications, you’ll work with coding agents across real-world repositories and assess the quality of their work. You’ll review generated code and agent behavior, determine whether solutions are technically correct, identify failure modes, and create the evaluation signals and feedback used to improve model performance.

Think of the coding agent as another engineer whose work you’re reviewing: Can it understand the task? Did it choose the right approach? Is the resulting code correct, robust, and maintainable? Can you explain precisely where it succeeded or failed?

What You’ll Do:

  • Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions across real-world software repositories
  • Review agent behavior, tool usage, and code changes for correctness and quality

  • Build and maintain pipelines and infrastructure supporting data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows
  • Synthesize findings from data work into clear write-ups, updates, and recommendations for the team

job.name: Programmeur FPGA (Senior)
job.description:
Description Du Poste Dans le cadre du développement de calculateurs critiques destinés au secteur aéronautique, nous recherchons une personne spécialisée en développement, vérification et validation FPGA, capable d’évoluer dans un environnement soumis aux exigences de la norme DO-254.

La mission porte à la fois sur le développement et l’implémentation d’architectures FPGA en VHDL et/ou Verilog, ainsi que sur leur vérification et leur validation. Elle comprend notamment la mise en œuvre d’environnements de test UVM, l’exécution de campagnes de tests, l’analyse des résultats et des écarts, ainsi que la production des éléments de preuve et de traçabilité nécessaires dans un contexte DO-254.

Responsabilités

  • Développer et implémenter des architectures FPGA en VHDL et/ou Verilog, en cohérence avec le cycle de vie DO-254 et les processus de justification et de traçabilité du projet.
  • Renforcer et produire les éléments de vérification et validation FPGA compatibles avec les exigences DO-254.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes hardware, software et systèmes afin d’assurer l’intégration des solutions FPGA.
  • Élaborer et exécuter les plans de tests et les campagnes de vérification fonctionnelle et structurelle conformément aux exigences DO-254.
  • Mettre en place et maintenir les environnements et infrastructures nécessaires aux campagnes de tests.
  • Implémenter, maintenir et faire évoluer les environnements de test basés sur la méthodologie UVM.
  • Définir et faire évoluer les séquences, agents, monitors, scoreboards et modèles de coverage selon les besoins du projet.
  • Garantir la maintenabilité et la reproductibilité des tests à travers le versioning, les scripts et la gestion des paramètres.
  • Utiliser de manière avancée les outils de simulation Questasim et/ou ModelSim ainsi que Aldec Active-HDL pour les activités de simulation ou d’émulation selon les besoins.
  • Déboguer les comportements observés, analyser les logs et les formes d’ondes et identifier les causes racines provenant du testbench, du RTL ou de l’environnement.
  • Analyser les résultats des campagnes de tests, traiter les anomalies et assurer la revalidation après correction.
  • Mettre en œuvre, collecter et analyser les métriques de qualité, notamment le code coverage.
  • Contribuer à l’atteinte des objectifs de couverture définis et produire des justifications structurées en cas d’écarts.
  • Réaliser des vérifications sur carte, participer au débogage matériel et exploiter les métriques de validation associées selon la stratégie du projet.
  • Utiliser Git pour la gestion du code source, notamment les branches, merges, pull requests, tags et baselines selon les processus établis.
  • Respecter les règles de gestion de configuration et de traçabilité définies dans le cadre du projet.
  • Rédiger et contribuer aux documents de conception et de validation FPGA, aux rapports de tests, aux synthèses de résultats ainsi qu’aux éléments de preuve et supports de traçabilité.
  • Préparer et part

job.name: GCP - Computer System Validation Specialist (12 month limited-term)
job.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Looking for a new challenge with real impact, ensuring technology meets the highest quality and compliance standards in a regulated environment? As a Computer System Validation (CSV) Specialist , you will play a key role in validating GCP-regulated systems, partnering with IT, Quality, and business teams to deliver compliant, reliable solutions. You'll lead validation activities from planning through execution, influence system quality and integrity, and help drive continuous compliance with industry regulations and best practices.

About the Role:

  • Execute validation activities for computerized systems and software in compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and applicable regulatory requirements
  • Develop and maintain validation documentation, including validation plans, test scripts, traceability matrices, summary reports, and release documentation
  • Partner with IT, Quality Assurance, business stakeholders, and external vendors to define validation strategies and ensure successful project delivery
  • Coordinate and oversee validation testing activities, ensuring requirements are appropriately tested and documented
  • Manage defects, deviations, and incidents identified during testing, including triage, resolution tracking, and closure documentation
  • Facilitate review, approval, execution, and post-execution management of validation and qualification documentation
  • Train and support project teams on validation procedures, tools, documentation standards, and best practices
  • Provide ongoing guidance on change management for validated systems and stay current with evolving regulatory requirements and industry standards

What we're looking for:

  • Qualifications

+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Software Development, or a related field with 3-5 years of relevant experience , or equivalent combination of education and experience

+ Experience validating GCP-regulated computerized systems and software, ideally within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other highly regulated industries

job.name: Ingénieur(e) R&D

Découvre une opportunité qui mérite ton attention

Chez Tornatech, notre mission est de sauver des vies. En tant qu'entreprise québécoise qui a conquis le monde avec nos contrôleurs de pompes anti-incendie, nous sommes passés de locaux à internationaux en établissant des usines de production en Belgique et à Dubaï.

Tu aimes concevoir de nouvelles fonctionnalités, développer des logiciels et comprendre les interactions entre les systèmes logiciels et matériels? Tu maîtrises plusieurs langages de programmation, appliques les bonnes pratiques du développement orienté objet et privilégies une démarche structurée pour concevoir, tester et améliorer des solutions?

Joins-toi à l'équipe de développement de Tornatech à titre d'ingénieur(e) R&D. Relevant du chef de service Développement, tu prendras part à la conception de nouvelles fonctionnalités matérielles et logicielles, réaliseras des mandats de développement, d'analyse et de validation, et pourras mettre des idées à l'épreuve au moyen de preuves de concept. Le travail se fait en étroite collaboration avec les autres membres de la R&D, les équipes de l'entreprise et, selon les mandats, des spécialistes externes. Tu partageras tes constats et construiras les solutions avec les personnes concernées.

Responsabilités principales

Tu veilleras à ce que les solutions matérielles et logicielles demeurent efficaces pour l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits. Cette responsabilité se concrétisera par la conception de nouvelles fonctionnalités, l'analyse des besoins et des problèmes, des recommandations techniques et la réalisation des mandats qui te seront confiés. La conception détaillée des circuits électroniques, le routage des cartes et les fichiers de fabrication relèvent de spécialistes externes.
