job.name: Principal Software Engineer - Environments Engineering (Commercial & Investment Bank)
job.description:
Archer is collaborating with J.P. Morgan to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role. Job Description If you are looking for a game-changing career, working for one of the world's leading financial institutions, you've come to the right place.

As a Principal Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Commercial and Investment Bank Digital Channels and Connectivity team, you will own the technical strategy and delivery of the firm's next-generation test environment platform — enabling every developer across a 10,000-engineer organization to spin up an isolated, composable, production-representative virtual environment per pull request, run integration tests independently and simultaneously, and merge with confidence without contention on shared environments. You will solve the fundamental constraint that limits flow of code to production: environment bottlenecks. Your approach will be composable — reusing most unchanged components while instantiating only the services under test, with intelligent dependency resolution, traffic isolation, and automatic teardown. You will design and build the MVP hands-on, then shift to hardening, socializing, and driving adoption at scale across multiple organizations. You will partner as a peer to engineering delivery leadership and collaborate closely with performance engineering, SRE, and quality engineering to ensure the platform meets the demands of a large, hybrid (cloud and on-premises) service estate.

job.name: TSS Hardware Engineering Internship (Summer 2027)
job.description:
Position Summary

Two Sigma is a leading quantitative investment management and trading firm. The company applies a scientific approach to investing, combining cutting-edge technology, artificial intelligence, data science, and quantitative research with rigorous human inquiry to capitalize on market opportunities and deliver alpha for investors.

Our team of engineers, quantitative researchers and data scientists looks beyond the traditional to test hypotheses and develop creative solutions to some of the world’s most complex economic problems.

Two Sigma Securities brings a scientific approach to systematic trading and risk management to make markets more efficient. Our team trades equites, options and futures, leveraging our high performance trading system to execute over 850 million shares per day. Two Sigma Securities is entering an exciting growth phase. We value the insights of our colleagues and encourage them to innovate and shape their own work agenda. New joiners use our proprietary platform to work on diverse projects. From building next generation trading technologies and researching novel AI and machine learning techniques to enhancing our strategies and deploying automation, our team is pushing the frontier in systematic trading

Technology drives our business — it's our main advantage — and software engineers play a pivotal role.

Software engineers at Two Sigma focus on analysis, experimentation, design, and elegant implementation. They build the scalable tools the organization needs to explore data's possibilities and act on our findings – to mine the past and attempt to predict the future.

As a Two Sigma engineer, you'll champion the rigorous, collaborative, scientific approach that allows us to meet business needs. You'll join a forward-looking, future-reaching organization to build software that will scale with the company.

We attract engineers with a true passion for data. We seek individuals who want to build for today and invent for tomorrow. We value curiosity and insight, balanced with pragmatism and practicality. We recognize both the small steps, as well as the broad vision.

We are seeking a diverse set of software engineering interns to join our team. With a group that includes a Unix Lifetime Achievement winner, Putnam medalists, ACM Programming competition finalists, and International Mathematics Olympiad medalists, you'll be in the company of ambitious high achievers with common goals and a love of learning.

The summer internship program lasts 10 weeks and takes place at our Soho-based New York City office. You will partner with an assigned mentor and work on a single project during the course of your time here, which culminates in a final presentation.

job.name: Remote Senior Software Developer
job.description:
About Us:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Ideal Background:

This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree.

Project Overview:

As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

  • Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go.
  • Evaluate and refine AI-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance AI-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks.

  • Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them.
  • Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task.

Emphasis will be on waveform design and digital signal processing for digital communications.

Other responsibilities will include high-level design, detailed design, simulation, implementation, testing and documentation.

Experience with leading collaborative software design/development/test teams is expected.

Experience with digital signal processing (DSP), embedded C++/C and MATLAB is expected.

Experience working with Agile Scrum, and DevOps-based software development is desired. Experience in engineering requirements analysis, development, and testing is desired.

  • Lead and contribute to the execution of the assigned portion of the entire product development cycle in an Agile Scrum framework.

  • Stay up to date with the latest advancements in DSP technology and apply new techniques and methodologies.

  • Contribute to the strategic direction of DSP solutions and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Ability to Obtain US Security Clearance

job.description:

About The Role We are hiring an Autonomy Platform Engineer to build and evolve the foundational software that runs our autonomy stack across robot and compute platforms. The Autonomy Platform team works across embedded Linux, compute and sensor enablement, robotics middleware, process orchestration, data capture and replay, system observability, and performance.

  • Lead complex debugging across application, middleware, OS, driver, networking, timing, and hardware boundaries.

We’re Excited About You Because…

  • Strong production C++ and Python experience.
  • Experience with embedded Linux, robotics, autonomous vehicles, or complex mechatronic systems.
  • Solid understanding of several of these areas: operating systems, concurrency, networking, middleware, drivers, GPU acceleration, storage, or real-time performance.
  • Experience debugging complex problems across multiple software and hardware layers.
  • Experience with profiling, tracing, observability, automated testing, and CI.
  • Familiarity with Bazel, Git, and modern software-development practices.
  • ROS/ROS2 or comparable robotics middleware experience is preferred.

No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Surfscan group includes a team of engineers, technology development, apps engineers and product marketing focused on technology that enables wafer, IC and equipment manufacturers to develop, qualify and monitor their process tools. Defects and process non-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. The flagship Surfscan products include the SPx platforms for wafer surface quality and wafer defect inspection tools and systems for inspection of polished wafers, epi wafers and engineered substrates during the wafer fabrication process.

Overview Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. The Data Processing Unit (DPU) team within Azure Hardware Systems and Infrastructure (AHSI) builds custom silicon that accelerates data processing across Microsoft's Azure datacenters. About Us:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.   • Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task.

job.description:
Sr. Optical Transceiver Validation Engineer

Location: San Jose, CA

Work Mode: Primarily onsite, with reasonable flexibility

About the company

A global leader in optical communications and one of the largest players in the industry, serving some of the world’s leading technology companies

Position Overview

We are seeking a Sr. Optical Transceiver System Engineer specializing in switch-side optical transceiver validation, performance optimization, and system-level troubleshooting.

In this role, you will develop and execute comprehensive test plans for optical modules deployed on data center switches, ensuring product performance, interoperability, compliance, and reliability. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with mainstream data center switch platforms, familiarity with network operating systems such as SONiC, ONIE, or EOS, and strong Python scripting skills for test automation and data analysis.

You will collaborate closely with firmware, test, design, and system engineering teams to identify and resolve technical issues, while working directly with customer engineering teams to communicate qualification results, present technical findings, and support customer deployments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute comprehensive switch-side optical transceiver qualification test plans covering functional, performance, interoperability, and reliability validation.
  • Configure, validate, and debug optical modules on mainstream data center switch platforms, such as NVIDIA, Arista, and Celestica, running SONiC, EOS, ONIE, or similar network operating systems.
  • Develop and maintain Python scripts to automate test execution, data logging, and test result analysis.
  • Verify optical module compliance with CMIS, SFF-8636, and other relevant industry standards, including diagnostics, state machines, and memory maps.
  • Analyze test results, prepare detailed qualification reports, and collaborate with firmware, test, design, and system engineering teams to resolve technical issues.
  • Reproduce and troubleshoot customer-reported optical module issues in the laboratory, driving root cause analysis and resolution.
  • Present qualification results, technical findings, and reports directly to customers, leading technical discussions with customer engineering teams.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure optical transceiver products meet performance, compliance, and interoperability requirements for customer deployments.

It is a large, mission-critical, near-real-time system written predominantly in Java and Kotlin, and also includes C++ components. JRE is deployed everywhere from handheld devices and small-form-factor drones to strategic bombers, guided-missile destroyers, and global command-and-control centers.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on the software development team, you'll work closely with other developers, as well as with testers and test engineers on the test team. Through test automation, you'll play an essential role in enabling rapid, agentically-developed, high-quality releases of JRE to meet the current and future mission needs of the warfighter.

Your impact will extend beyond the code you write yourself. You'll lead projects and build up the test engineering skills of the people you work with.

Job Duties

  • Expand JRE's unit, integration, service, GUI, and end-to-end test automation.
  • Engineer and maintain a comprehensive automated performance test suite covering load, stress, and endurance testing; support our IT team with capacity planning for the hardware environment it requires.
  • Design, develop, and maintain advanced simulators for IP and serial tactical data link terminals, radios, navigation systems, and sensors.
  • Contribute to the definition and ongoing verification of minimum system requirements for JRE's full range of deployment platforms.
  • Refactor JRE code for testability, introducing API, RPC, and messaging seams to enable additional white- and gray-box testing.
  • Mentor developers, testers, and less-experienced test engineers in test automation best practices as we expand automated coverage across the codebase.
  • Optimize the performance and quality of our test automation suites.
  • Quarantine, troubleshoot, and fix nondeterministic tests.

Qualifications Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree and nine (9) years’ experience; additional four (4) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree.

Required Clearance

job.name: Quantitative Developer
job.description:
Node.js + Python Developer | Ahmedabad | Full Time - 2+ Years Experience

About the Role

Miracles Fintech is an NSE/BSE/MCX/SEBI-registered, technology-first proprietary trading and quantitative research firm building scalable, low-latency systematic trading systems with colocation infrastructure across Indian equity, derivatives, and commodity markets. The gap between a research idea and a live, production-grade strategy is where this role lives.

We're looking for a Quantitative Developer who understands market microstructure — order books, spreads, liquidity, price discovery, and execution dynamics — and can translate that understanding into fast, correct, well-engineered code in Python and Node.js. You'll sit between research and infrastructure: converting signals and strategies from research notebooks into production systems, building the data and execution plumbing around them, and using modern AI-assisted development workflows (Claude Code) to move fast without cutting corners. This role suits engineers who think like traders and build like engineers.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy Implementation & Market Microstructure Engineering

  • Research-to-production: Translate quant research (signals, strategies, backtests) from Python research code into robust, production-ready systems in Python and Node.js.

• Microstructure-aware engineering: Build order execution, order book handling, and market-data processing logic that correctly accounts for spreads, slippage, order flow, tick size, and expiry/rollover effects across NSE, BSE, and MCX.

• Execution logic: Implement and refine order placement, smart order routing, and execution algorithms that minimize market impact and latency for intraday/short-term strategies.

• Derivatives handling: Build systems that correctly handle futures/options data — strikes, expiries, ATM shifts, implied volatility — for both research and live trading.

Systems & Data Engineering

• Real-time data pipelines: Build and maintain data pipelines for tick-level, OHLC, and order-book data, ensuring correctness (no look-ahead bias, no data leakage) across research and production environments.

• Backend services: Design and build backend services and APIs in Node.js and Python that connect strategy logic, risk checks, and monitoring dashboards.

• Live monitoring: Build tooling to compare live vs. backtested performance and flag degradation from regime change, signal decay, or execution issues.

AI-Accelerated Development

• Claude Code workflows: Use Claude Code and structured prompting (CLAUDE.md/spec-driven development) as a core part of the development workflow — for rapid prototyping, refactoring, test generation, and documentation, while maintaining full understanding and ownership of the resulting code.

job.name: AI/ML Engineer
job.description:
Company Description

PathinAI designs low-power AI silicon for “physical AI” applications across robots, drones, vehicles, and industrial machines that sense and act in the real world. The company focuses on transformer-based models running under tight power budgets, architecting chips from the workload up instead of relying on general-purpose hardware. Its flagship accelerator, Clean Future CF-1, supports multi-camera perception, sensor fusion, and on-device vision-language models, integrating alongside existing compute boards. Every chip is developed through the PathinAI AI Silicon Platform, combining workload profiling, virtual silicon simulation, architecture exploration, pre-silicon FPGA validation, and phased manufacturing. PathinAI collaborates with robotics, automotive, industrial AI, and semiconductor/OEM teams through tailored solutions and is designed and built in India, with IP and design files held locally.

Role Description

As an AI/ML Engineer at PATH IN AI, you will design, implement, and optimize machine learning models that run efficiently on low-power AI silicon for physical AI applications. You will work closely with chip architects and software engineers to translate workload requirements into deployable algorithms, focusing on perception, sensor fusion, and transformer-based models. Daily responsibilities include developing and training models, conducting experiments, evaluating performance using statistical techniques, and refining algorithms for power, latency, and accuracy constraints. You will contribute to pre-silicon validation by building and testing workloads on FPGA and virtual silicon environments, and support integration with robotics, automotive, and industrial partners. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Noida.

Qualifications

  • Strong foundation in Computer Science and Algorithms, with experience designing and analyzing efficient solutions for real-world AI workloads.
  • Hands-on expertise in Neural Networks and Pattern Recognition, including deep learning architectures for vision, sensor fusion, or sequence modeling.
  • Proficiency in Statistics and applied data analysis to evaluate model performance, reliability, and robustness under edge deployment constraints.
  • Experience with AI/ML engineering tools and frameworks (e.g., Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX), and familiarity with model optimization and quantization for edge devices.
  • Background in embedded or edge AI systems, GPU/accelerator programming, or hardware-aware ML (e.g., FPGA, custom accelerators) is highly beneficial.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, communicate technical concepts clearly, and work on-site in Noida on complex, iterative hardware-software projects.

job.name: Program Associate
job.description:
Program Manager & Program Associate

Central Team · New Delhi · Full-time

Experience:

Program Associate: 1-3 years in Economics, public policy, or any related fields from top university.

Program Manager - 3- 5 years, with masters preferred.

Base: New Delhi (travel to project states)

Reports to: Senior Programme Managers, Atithi Foundation

About Atithi Foundation

Atithi Foundation is a not-for-profit organisation working to transform India's tourism sector into a key engine of economic growth. We partner with government bodies, industry leaders, knowledge institutions and community stakeholders to design evidence-based policies and strategies to create livelihoods, safeguard heritage, and strengthen India's position on the global tourism stage.

Our vision: To make India a $490 billion tourism economy by 2035, with inclusive growth, preserving heritage, and showcasing the nation's culture and natural beauty to the world.

Tourism as an Economic Engine

Tourism generated over $200 billion for India in 2023 — 5.5% of GDP — and supports nearly 40 million jobs (8% of national employment). 54% of the tourism workforce comprises women, making it one of India's most inclusive growth sectors.

India's Untapped Global Potential

Despite extraordinary geography and heritage, India attracted only 10 million foreign visitors in 2023 — against China's 66 million (2019), Thailand's 40 million, and Vietnam's 18 million. Closing even half that gap is a multi-billion dollar opportunity.

Key Challenges We Are Solving

  • Inadequate tourism infrastructure: Most high-potential destinations lack the accommodation, connectivity, and on-site facilities needed to convert visitors into multi-night stays
  • PPP gap: Tourism assets remain underinvested because transaction structures, risk allocation, and bankable project formats are not yet in place at scale
  • Fragmented governance: Infrastructure development, land, environment, and culture sit across multiple departments — a single coordination failure stops a project
  • Narrow brand and distribution: India's top six destinations absorb the bulk of tourism spend; 90% of the country's potential goes unmonetised

The Role

This is an early-career role for someone who wants to do real work on a hard problem.

We are not looking for a particular background in a specific space. We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious, takes ownership instinctively, and is energised by the idea of working on something that matters. Someone who wants to learn fast, roll up their sleeves, and be in the room where decisions get made, not wait to be invited.

This person will work across Atithi's programmes - supporting destination strategy, government engagement, research, investor outreach, and programme management, and grow into whatever they are best at. The role is deliberately broad at the start. What it becomes depends on you.

job.description:
Job Description

Position Title : DevOps Lead

Location: Kandivali, Mumbai

Job Objective:

Lead enterprise DevOps practice across all engineering teams — spanning CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, release engineering, DevSecOps and developer enablement. Define the standards, tooling and self-service platforms that improve delivery speed, quality and security, and cascade measurable delivery-performance improvements across the engineering pods.

Primary Responsibilities:

DevOps Strategy & Engineering Standards

  • Define the DevOps roadmap, engineering standards and best practices across all engineering teams.
  • Improve developer productivity and flow through automation, tooling and standardised workflows.
  • Establish and track DORA metrics — deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate and mean time to restore — to drive continuous improvement.
  • Champion a shift-left culture across development teams.

CI/CD & Release Engineering

  • Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines across Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
  • Standardise build, test, packaging, deployment and rollback processes across all products.
  • Implement progressive delivery patterns including blue-green and canary deployments.
  • Govern release management, versioning and build-artefact management.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Standardise Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Azure Bicep.
  • Automate environment provisioning, configuration management and drift detection.
  • Build reusable modules and templates to accelerate and standardise environment setup.

DevSecOps

  • Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning and secret management into pipelines (e.g. SonarQube).
  • Embed security gates and policy-as-code across the delivery lifecycle, prioritising zero data egress within the Azure tenant.
  • Support ISO, GxP and cybersecurity compliance within CI/CD workflows.

Containers & Developer Platform

  • Manage Docker and Kubernetes (AKS) platforms for build and runtime environments.
  • Build reusable pipeline templates and self-service engineering platforms.
  • Enable developer self-service for environments, deployments and observability.

People & Collaboration

  • Partner with Cloud & Platform, Product Engineering, QA and Information Security teams.
  • Mentor engineers and evangelise DevOps practices across the organisation.
  • Participate in incident, problem and change management for the delivery toolchain.

Technical Skills:

Azure DevOps · GitHub Actions · Jenkins · Terraform · Azure Bicep · Docker · Kubernetes (AKS) · YAML · PowerShell, Python, Bash · DevSecOps tooling (SAST/DAST, dependency & secret scanning) · Azure Boards / Jira · DORA metrics.

Educational & Experience Requirements:

Education: Engineering Graduate.

Experience: 7+ years in DevOps, CI/CD and release engineering, with a track record of standardising delivery practices across multiple engineering teams.

At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)

At AMINA, we are building practical AI and automation solutions for a regulated banking environment — production systems, not demos.

We are looking for a Senior AI / Full Stack Engineer to help design, build, integrate, and operate AI-enabled applications and agentic workflows. This role combines AI engineering, full-stack software development, API integration, DevOps, and Azure cloud delivery.

You will work as part of a dedicated AI squad focused on process automation and AI adoption across the bank. You will collaborate closely with process engineers, business stakeholders, and technology teams to turn well-understood business problems into reliable AI-powered solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role: you build, test, deploy, monitor, and improve what you create.

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. We are hiring a UI Product Manager to own the customer-facing experience of the Bright app - onboarding, credit building, offers, money movement, and the AI money assistant - and the metrics those surfaces drive.

job.name: Senior Bioinformatics Scientist
job.description:
Company Description AL Fahad Global Enterprises is a diversified organization focused on innovation and technology-driven solutions in the life sciences sector. The company is expanding its capabilities in genomics, data science, and advanced analytics to support research, healthcare, and related industries. Team members collaborate across disciplines to translate complex biological data into actionable insights. AL Fahad Global Enterprises values ethical practices, continuous learning, and inclusive work environments that support professional growth. The organization offers opportunities to contribute to impactful projects while working with modern tools and methodologies.
Role Description The Senior Bioinformatics Scientist will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of analytical pipelines for high-throughput sequencing and other omics data, working on-site in Pune City in a full-time capacity. Responsibilities include performing complex data analysis, developing statistical models, and interpreting genomic and molecular data to support research and product development. The role involves collaborating with experimental scientists to design studies, define data requirements, and validate results, as well as documenting workflows and presenting findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. The scientist will evaluate and integrate new bioinformatics tools, maintain reproducible code and data standards, and contribute to publications, reports, and internal knowledge sharing. Mentoring team members and helping define best practices for data quality, security, and compliance will also be part of the day-to-day work.
Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong expertise in Data Analysis and Statistics, including experience with large biological datasets and quantitative modeling.
  • Candidates should possess hands-on skills in DNA Sequencing and Sequencing technologies, with experience handling NGS data and related workflows.
  • Candidates should possess solid Research skills, including study design, hypothesis testing, and clear documentation of methods and results.
  • Candidates should possess proficiency in bioinformatics programming and tools (e.g., Python, R, Bash, common NGS pipelines, and version control systems).
  • Candidates should possess familiarity with genomics, molecular biology, and common databases (e.g., NCBI, Ensembl, GEO) and reference genomes.
  • Advanced degree (PhD or MSc) in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Statistics, Genomics, or a related field, with several years of relevant experience.
  • Strong communication skills, ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, and capacity to explain complex analyses to varied audiences.
  • Experience in an on-site laboratory or research environment and knowledge of data governance, privacy, and ethical considerations in genomics is beneficial.

job.name: Data 360 Architect
job.description:
Role: Data 360 Architect

Location: Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Delhi, Noida, Bhubaneswar, Coimbatore.

Duration of contract : 6 Months

Years of Experience 7 – 10 Years

Hybrid for 3 days a week

Role Overview

The Data 360 Architect is responsible for defining and governing the end-to-end architecture for Salesforce Data 360, formerly Data Cloud. The role translates business, data, analytics, personalization, and AI requirements into secure and scalable designs that connect enterprise data sources, harmonize customer and business data, establish trusted profiles, and activate data across Salesforce applications, Agentforce, analytics, and external platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Strategy

Define the target-state Data 360 architecture, phased implementation roadmap, data-domain boundaries, data spaces, environment strategy, and non-functional requirements.

Assess the enterprise data landscape and select appropriate ingestion, federation, zero-copy, batch, streaming, API, change data capture, and event-driven patterns.

Create solution architecture documents, logical and physical data-flow designs, integration specifications, security models, and architecture decision records.

Lead architecture and design reviews, ensuring alignment with Salesforce standards, enterprise architecture, data strategy, and measurable business outcomes.

Data Modeling, Harmonization & Identity

Design source-to-target mappings from Data Lake Objects (DLOs) to Data Model Objects (DMOs) using the Customer 360 data model and governed custom extensions.

Define transformation, normalization, data-quality, survivorship, lineage, metadata-management, and reconciliation approaches.

Design identity-resolution match and reconciliation rules to establish trusted unified profiles while preserving traceability to source records.

Architect calculated insights, related attributes, segments, and reusable data products for operational and analytical use cases.

Integration, Activation & AI Enablement

Architect connectivity with Salesforce clouds, MuleSoft, APIs, data warehouses, lakehouses, marketing platforms, analytics products, and enterprise applications.

Define activation patterns for Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce, Tableau, Agentforce, and approved external destinations.

Design structured and unstructured grounding patterns for AI agents, including chunking, indexing, embeddings, vector or hybrid search, and access controls where applicable.

Balance freshness, latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, data movement, and consumption cost across use cases.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

14+ years of enterprise technology experience, including substantial Salesforce architecture and data-platform delivery responsibility.

Read the full description

Job Title: Software Engineer - Full Stack (Python & Golang)

Company: QAD

Location: Pune (Pimpri-Chinchwad)

Shift timing: 9 to 5 or 10 to 6

Company Description

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through an intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and technology into a single System of Action. Founded in 1979 and headquartered in Miami, Florida, the company serves manufacturers across more than 100 countries in industries including automotive, consumer products, food and beverage, high technology, industrial equipment, and life sciences.

The platform is built on three core pillars: Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive ERP (the intelligent backbone of manufacturing operations), and ChampionAI (Agentic AI purpose-built for manufacturing). Together, these enable manufacturers to achieve measurable productivity, resilience, and growth — in as little as 90 days.

Job Description

ChampionAI is QAD | Redzone's agentic platform, purpose-built for manufacturing and used across all business units. As a junior-level Engineer, you will join the core platform team to build new platform capabilities, help Applied AI teams ship Champion agents correctly, and directly build Champion agents for business-unit use cases.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and ship features across the Champion platform repositories using trunk-based development with PR-gated merges.
  • Improve developer experience through tooling, scaffolding, internal documentation, and onboarding paths for Applied AI engineers.
  • Maintain and evolve the MCP tool server and agent infrastructure that business unit teams depend on.
  • Identify and address friction points that slow down Champion development or deployment.
  • Support BU Applied AI engineers in building, deploying, and operating Champions correctly.
  • Review agent implementations for prompt quality, scope enforcement, auth configuration, and deployment setup.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guides and skill documentation.
  • Pair with BU engineers on first K8S manifest creation, database registration, and LaunchDarkly prompt rollout.
  • Design and build Champion agents for BU use-cases when the platform team is directly engaged.
  • Write and iterate on system prompts, tool bindings, and context injection for production agents.

Qualifications

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of hands-on software development experience, specialising in Python, Golang and AI-driven systems.
  • Proficiency in Python (async, FastAPI, Pydantic, pytest, pytest-asyncio, DeepEval), Docker, PostgreSQL, and Git.
  • Good understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol, and multi-agent architectures.

About Company

Actnable AI builds research AI for market research and consumer insights teams: AI grounded in each client's own data, checked by researchers, and never pooled across clients. We are looking for our first senior technology leader to own our technology, shape our products with the CEO, and grow into Co-founder & CTO.

We were founded in 2023 and are based in Nairobi, Kenya, with partners in India, the USA and South Africa. We are lean and fully remote. We serve research agencies, research firms and corporate insights teams in Africa, the US and beyond.

Why join now

  • Real clients and revenue, including a leading global research firm for which we built a large digital-twin platform
  • Three product lines: Actnable One (subscription platform with AI surveys by voice and WhatsApp, field operations, Qual AI, open-ends coding, translations and chat with data), The Engine (White Label Solution grounded on client data) and The Lab (bespoke research AI)
  • Public relaunch in January 2027 and a funding round planned for 2027

What you will own

  • Technology strategy and one shared architecture across our products, including retrieval over client data, digital twins and evaluation
  • Technical ownership of our engineering partner in India: scope, code review, releases and quality
  • Delivery oversight for our key international clients
  • An evaluation harness that proves our outputs are grounded and accurate
  • Security, IP ownership and the roadmap to SOC 2 or ISO 27001, with our data-protection advisers
  • Technical due diligence with investors and enterprise clients, and our first in-house engineering hires

What you bring

  • Multi-tenant SaaS on AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Experience leading an external or offshore engineering team
  • Still hands-on: you read code and can prototype
  • Clear communication with CEOs, researchers, clients and investors

Strong plus: market research or analytics tech; multilingual, voice or African-language AI; WhatsApp or voice-bot channels; a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 programme; startup or founder experience.

How it works

  • About 20 hours a week to start, with set overlap hours with Nairobi and US Eastern time; full-time when our next funding round closes
  • Monthly USD retainer, and eventually, upon successful completion of six months, equity options when you move to full-time as Co-founder & CTO

job.name: Product Security Engineer
job.description:
About Rocketlane Rocketlane is a B2B SaaS platform for client onboarding and project delivery, and we're building Nitro, our AI-native product layer. We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to own product and infrastructure security for the company.

What you'll own

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor security role covering the full range of product security work, not just one slice of it.

Offensive security and vulnerability discovery

  • Run internal penetration tests across our web app, APIs, mobile app, and cloud infrastructure, and triage findings from external pentest vendors
  • Actively hunt for vulnerabilities in new features, including in AI/LLM-powered surfaces (prompt injection paths, unsafe code execution in agent tooling, unauthenticated internal endpoints)
  • Have found and driven the fix for real vulnerabilities before. We need someone who thinks like an attacker, not just someone who runs a scanner and files a ticket

Cloud and infrastructure security

  • Review and harden our AWS setup: WAF rules, ALB/CloudFront TLS policies and cipher suites, container isolation, IAM and secrets hygiene
  • Investigate and close out Dependabot and other CI/CD security alerts across dozens of repos, and work with engineering teams to get fixes prioritized and shipped
  • Build and maintain internal security tooling

Compliance and customer trust

  • Help with our compliance audit cycles end to end: evidence collection, control testing, and coordinating with auditors. This typically takes up 5% of the work.
  • Respond to customer security questionnaires and InfoSec review requests, working with sales and customer success to turn these around quickly and accurately
  • Keep our security documentation and posture current as the product and infrastructure evolve

Cross-team coordination

  • Work directly with engineering, platform, and ops teams to get security fixes prioritized and shipped, not just logged
  • Report critical findings up to leadership with clear, actionable writeups (source, sink, impact, fix)

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years in a hands-on security role covering penetration testing and vulnerability research, ideally across web, API, mobile, and cloud
  • Real, demonstrable experience finding and helping fix serious vulnerabilities (RCE, auth bypass, injection classes), not just running automated scans
  • Solid working knowledge of AWS security: WAF, ALB/CloudFront, IAM, container security on ECS or similar
  • Comfort integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning) and driving remediation with engineering teams
  • Experience with, or strong interest in, securing LLM/AI-powered applications: unsafe code execution, prompt injection, agent tool-call boundaries
  • Strong written communication. You'll be writing up findings for engineers and explaining risk to non-technical stakeholders in the same week

Nice to have

job.name: C++ Developer (Low-Latency / Trading Systems) : Senior Executive | Assistant Manager | Manager (3-10 Years)
job.description:
Location: Andheri, Mumbai (On-site)

About the role

We're hiring C++ engineers to build microsecond-sensitive software for a leading financial market infrastructure institution. You'll write low-latency code for market connectivity, market data handling, pre-trade risk checks and execution routing, and you'll stay hands-on with the code as you grow.

What you'll do

  • Write clean, fast systems code in modern C++ (C++17/20) for market data normalization, risk engines and execution routers
  • Apply low-latency techniques such as custom memory pools, placement new and object pools, with no heap allocation on critical paths
  • Build IPC channels using shared memory and lock-free ring buffers or queues
  • Implement multi-threaded designs using atomics and CPU thread affinity to maximize cache performance
  • Use template metaprogramming to build compile-time, zero-overhead abstractions
  • Implement exchange protocols (FIX, ITCH, OUCH, SBE), order lifecycles and matching-engine communication
  • Design MySQL schemas, transaction logs and lookup queries for reference data and audit trails
  • Build custom data structures such as indexing and binary parsing logic, and use bitwise packing
  • Run profiling and benchmarking (Valgrind, gprof, Google Benchmark, Linux perf) to catch latency and memory regressions
  • Do rigorous code reviews and enforce static analysis standards
  • Assistant Manager and Manager: mentor developers, break down tasks and track sprint delivery. Manager only: directly supervise a pod of 3-4 developers

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT or a quantitative engineering discipline
  • Strong production experience in systems-level C++ and the STL, including RAII, pointers and manual memory management
  • Solid concurrency skills: thread-safe code, lock-free logic, avoiding deadlocks, races and contention
  • Understanding of hardware behavior: CPU cache hierarchy (L1/L2/L3), memory-mapped files, branch prediction
  • Strong data structures and algorithms, plus MySQL design and indexing skills
  • Experience with template-driven, compile-time design
  • Experience on Linux

Experience by level

  • Senior Executive: 3-6 years in systems-level C++, with experience as a feature owner or mentor
  • Assistant Manager: 6-8 years, with a track record of mentoring juniors or owning features
  • Manager: 8-10 years, with at least 2 years as a team lead

Good to have

Exposure to high-frequency trading infrastructure, proprietary trading, market data handlers, exchange gateways, asset management systems or core fintech infrastructure.

Why join us

You'll work on high-throughput, mission-critical trading infrastructure where microseconds matter, with real ownership and a clear growth path from engineering excellence into technical leadership.

job.name: Technical Lead, Low-Latency C++ | Trading Systems | Mumbai
job.description:
We're building trading infrastructure where microseconds matter, and we're looking for a systems engineer ready to take on their first formal leadership step while staying hands-on with the code.

What you'll do

  • Write and maintain low-latency C++17/20 for market data normalization, pre-trade risk checks and execution routing
  • Keep the hot path free of heap allocation, using object pools, ring buffers and placement new
  • Build sub-microsecond IPC with Linux shared memory and lock-free queues
  • Design deterministic multi-threaded systems with atomics and CPU affinity
  • Implement exchange protocols (FIX, ITCH, OUCH, SBE) and order lifecycle logic
  • Own modules end to end, review code and mentor junior engineers
  • Profile and benchmark (Valgrind, perf, Google Benchmark) to catch latency regressions early.

What you bring

  • 3–6 years of production C++ in heavy systems programming
  • Strong grasp of multi-threading, lock-free design, CPU caches, mmap and branch prediction
  • Solid data structures and algorithms, plus MySQL schema and indexing skills
  • Template metaprogramming and zero-cost abstraction experience
  • Experience mentoring juniors or owning features
  • Bachelor's in CS, IT, Computer Engineering or a quantitative discipline.

Big plus: exposure to HFT, prop trading, market data handlers or exchange gateways.

If this sounds like you or know someone who'd be a fit? Write to Rukmini@careerxperts.com

Job Title: Cloud Operations / Azure Engineer

Location: Bangalore

Experience: Min. 3 Years

Preferred: Immediate Joiners

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Operations / Azure Engineer to manage, monitor, and

support cloud infrastructure and services. The role involves end-to-end responsibility for

deployment, operations, security, backup, DR, and performance optimization of cloud

environments.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Deployment & Management

  • Deploy, configure, and manage cloud infrastructure (VMs, storage, networking,

databases).

  • Manage cloud-native tools and services including containers, orchestration, and

monitoring tools.

  • Ensure high availability (>99.95%) and performance of cloud services.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Single Sign-On (SSO).
  • Ensure encryption of data and compliance with MeitY guidelines.
  • Perform patching, vulnerability assessment, and security hardening.
  • Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) and maintain audit logs.

Monitoring & Reporting

  • Monitor cloud services, network, VPN, bandwidth, and system performance.
  • Provide weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on performance and utilization.
  • Ensure resource utilization does not exceed defined thresholds (e.g., 70%).

Backup & Disaster Recovery (DR)

  • Manage online backups of VM and critical data.
  • Ensure backup retention as per policy (e.g., 90 days).
  • Perform DR drills (failover/failback) every 6 months.
  • Ensure RTO/RPO compliance and zero data loss.

Migration & Portability

  • Handle migration of applications and data between cloud and on-premises

environments.

  • Ensure zero downtime and seamless transition during porting.
  • Plan and execute cloud migration strategies.

Scalability & Performance

  • Enable auto-scaling and resource scaling (compute/storage).
  • Ensure scaling requests are completed within defined SLAs (e.g., 30 minutes).
  • Optimize system performance and minimize latency.

Documentation & Training

  • Prepare SOPs, technical documentation, and architecture documents.
  • Provide training and knowledge transfer (minimum 120 hours if required).

Required Skills

  • Strong experience in Microsoft Azure (preferred)
  • Knowledge of Cloud Infrastructure, Networking, Virtualization

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Requirements

job.description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

Job Description

About the role

Western Digital runs process control systems that automate and coordinate equipment and process flow in its factories. This team develops and manages those systems for all Western Digital factories. They are low-latency, high-availability applications. A delay or defect can stop a production line, so correctness and reliability matter as much as features.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with ownership of control system software. You will own application components or services end to end, from design to production operation. You will write and debug code every day, make design decisions that have to hold up for years across many factories, and guide the engineers around you.

What you will do

  • Own control system components end to end. Take accountability for the correctness, latency, availability, and maintainability of the components you own, across all the factories that run them.
  • Design for the long term. Choose architectures, data models, and technologies with the long term in mind: backward compatibility, upgradeability across sites, scalability, and the maintenance burden you leave the team. Record decisions and trade-offs in design documents, and revisit them as needs change.
  • Build low-latency applications. Write production-quality, concurrent, high-performance code. Measure and tune latency and throughput, and design for predictable behavior under load and failure.
  • Design messaging and integrations. Choose and implement messaging patterns between control applications, equipment interfaces, and other factory systems. Handle ordering, delivery guarantees, retries, and recovery.
  • Manage data. Choose the right data store for each workload (relational, NoSQL, or time-series). Design schemas, indexes, and transactions, and tune performance using your knowledge of database internals. Plan data retention, migration, and consistency.
  • Test rigorously. Define unit, integration, and failure-injection testing for your components. Set the quality bar for what is safe to release into a running factory.
  • Deploy safely. Own build, packaging, and deployment pipelines. Roll out and roll back changes across factories with minimal or zero downtime, following chan

As a Sr Kernel Engineer you will help build the kernel stack and BSP for various SoCs with custom hardware accelerators to be deployed in a range of Amazon devices. You will develop software for industry standard and custom hardware IP to accelerate applications in machine learning, computer vision and robotics.

In This Role You Will

  • Optimize OS and kernel solutions to achieve excellent performance for supported features.
  • Contribute throughout product development stages including HVT, EVT, DVT, and PVT phases.
  • Engage with diverse cross-functional teams to ensure seamless feature integration and alignment across hardware, firmware, and software components.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 10+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
  • 10+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
  • Hands-on experience with ARM v8/v9 architecture profiles, including understanding of instruction sets, memory models, and security features.
  • Demonstrated ability to debug complex system-level issues on embedded devices, including hardware-software integration challenges.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Master's degree in computer science or equivalent
  • Hands-on experience with embedded Linux Yocto distribution for custom BSP development.
  • Strong knowledge of thermal management, power optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Proven experience with high-speed interfaces including USB, eMMC, NAND, and PCIe.
  • Proficiency with low-speed interfaces such as Pinmux, GPIO, SPI, I2C, UART, and PWM.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced SharePoint QA Engineer with 4–6 years of experience in software testing, particularly in Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments. The candidate should have strong experience in functional, integration, regression, and UI testing of SharePoint applications and solutions.

The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding business requirements, preparing test scenarios, identifying defects, and ensuring the quality and reliability of SharePoint-based applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform functional, integration, regression, and system testing of SharePoint applications.
  • Test SharePoint Online.
  • Validate SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, content types, workflows, permissions, and customizations.
  • Test SPFx web parts, extensions, and custom SharePoint solutions.
  • Validate integrations between SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 services, including Teams, Power Automate, and Microsoft Graph.
  • Prepare and maintain test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and test execution reports.
  • Identify, document, track, and verify defects using Azure DevOps or similar defect-tracking tools.
  • Perform cross-browser, UI, usability, and compatibility testing.
  • Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and functional teams to understand requirements and resolve issues.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and release validation.
  • Ensure quality standards are maintained across development and production releases.

Required Skills

  • 4–6 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365.
  • Good understanding of SharePoint architecture, lists, libraries, site collections, permissions, and content management.
  • Experience testing custom SharePoint solutions and SPFx components.
  • Knowledge of Power Automate workflows and SharePoint integrations.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps for test management and bug tracking.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and defect management processes.
  • Experience in writing test cases, test scenarios, and test execution reports.
  • Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Good to Have

job.name: Software Engineer- l2, L3 forwarding, C/C ++, IOS XR 4 to 8 years
job.description:
Meet the team Join Cisco’s Service Provider Networking team, where software and forwarding hardware work together to move traffic across some of the world’s largest networks. The team builds high-performance IOS XR forwarding capabilities, giving you the opportunity to solve real networking challenges and contribute to technology used by service providers globally. As a Software engineer, you will design, implement, test, and troubleshoot defined forwarding features, working closely with senior engineers and partner teams across software and hardware.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain production C/C++ software for IOS XR L2/L3 forwarding.
  • Implement or enhance features in areas such as packet classification, route and label handling, ACLs, QoS, mirroring, OAM, tunnels, and slow path processing.
  • Work with service provider technologies such as EVPN, VPLS, MPLS, Segment Routing, SRv6, IPv4, and IPv6, based on team priorities.
  • Translate feature requirements into code, tests, and technical documentation.
  • Investigate defects using logs, traces, packet captures, core files, and test results; implement fixes and verify them.
  • Develop unit, integration, and regression tests, and use Python or other scripting to automate development and validation tasks.
  • Collaborate with protocol, IOS XR platform, hardware/NPU, and system test teams through feature integration and defect resolution.
  • Use approved AI tools regularly to assist with code exploration, implementation, test creation, debugging, and documentation; review and validate AI-generated output.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Suggested 4–7 years of relevant software development experience and a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong programming skills in C or C++, with experience contributing to production software.
  • Scripting experience, preferably Perl, Python.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, packet forwarding, and L2/L3 concepts.
  • Familiarity with Linux/UNIX development, debugging, testing, source control, and code review.
  • Practical use of AI tools in engineering work, with the ability to evaluate and verify their output.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system.
  • Exposure to EVPN, VPLS, MPLS, Segment Routing, SRv6, QoS, ACLs, BFD, GRE, or related technologies.
  • Familiarity with NPU/ASIC-based forwarding, hardware SDKs, performance analysis, or embedded system debugging.
  • Experience with tools such as GDB, Valgrind, packet analyzers, or traffic generators.

Success in the role Success means delivering well-tested forwarding features and fixes, meeting agreed quality and performance targets, resolving defects effectively, and taking increasing ownership of a defined feature area.

Why Cisco?

job.name: Full Stack Engineer
job.description:
Company Description

LowerPlane helps startups and growing companies become audit-ready without the overhead of traditional compliance programs, streamlining processes for SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, and AI governance. The platform simplifies compliance operations through automation, guided workflows, and centralized evidence management tailored for SaaS teams. LowerPlane replaces fragmented spreadsheets and consulting-heavy approaches with a faster, more operational model for handling security reviews and vendor questionnaires. Teams use LowerPlane to generate customizable policies, automate security questionnaire responses, track controls and readiness, and prepare for audits with structured workflows. The company’s mission is to lower the barrier to enterprise-grade trust so organizations can move through audits faster, build customer confidence earlier, and scale securely.

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site Full Stack Engineer role based in Chennai. The Full Stack Engineer will design, develop, and maintain web applications that power LowerPlane’s compliance and automation platform, working across both front-end and back-end components. Day-to-day responsibilities include implementing user interfaces, building secure APIs and services, optimizing performance, and ensuring high reliability and scalability. The role involves collaborating closely with product, design, and compliance teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, as well as writing clean, testable code and participating in code reviews. The engineer will help improve existing features, contribute to technical architecture decisions, and support ongoing deployments and production monitoring.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong Full-Stack Development and Software Development skills, with experience designing and implementing end-to-end web solutions.
  • Candidates should possess solid Back-End Web Development skills, including building APIs, integrating databases, and handling security and performance considerations.
  • Candidates should possess Front-End Development skills, including proficiency in modern JavaScript frameworks and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) for responsive, accessible interfaces.
  • Candidates should possess experience working with web application architectures, version control (e.g., Git), and continuous integration and deployment practices.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, and take ownership of features from design through deployment.
  • Experience with SaaS platforms, security, or compliance-related products is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and relational or NoSQL databases is an advantage.

job.name: Industrial Trainee - Business Consulting Risk - AMI - CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Kolkata
job.description:
Requisition id- 1764593

The opportunity : Industrial Trainee-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Kolkata

AMI : The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.

CNS - Risk - Process & Controls : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

Your Key Responsibilities Technical Excellence

Automatisation et outillage

4. Prior paid human data experience supporting AI training — annotation, labeling, RLHF, AI response evaluation, model evaluation, or rubric-based grading — is a plus.

5. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

6. Ability to communicate complex findings clearly in written English, providing specific, actionable feedback (B2 level or above).

7. No formal degree required—practical, demonstrable testing experience takes precedence.

Job Title: Capital Market Analyst Intern

Location: Remote

Organization: PipRaisers

Stipend: Up to ₹20,000 per month

Duration: 2 Months

Opportunities: Letter of Recommendation (LOR) & Pre-Placement Offer (PPO)

About PipRaisers

PipRaisers is a high-performance trading research firm focused on macro-driven markets, cross-asset analysis, and global trading strategies. With an edge in economic forecasting, sentiment research, and live market intelligence, we help traders and institutions align with major global moves across forex, commodities, and digital assets.

Role Overview

As a Capital Market Analyst Intern at PipRaisers, you'll work closely with our strategy and research team to interpret macroeconomic signals, analyze intermarket dynamics, and identify tradeable global trends. From daily market updates to institutional-style research notes, you’ll develop the mindset and skills of a global strategist.

Key Responsibilities

1. Track macroeconomic events, central bank moves, and geopolitical developments (FOMC, ECB, CPI, GDP, NFP)

2. Analyse inter-asset relationships—USD vs. Gold, Oil, Crypto, and Risk-on/Risk-off sentiment shifts

3. Contribute to daily/weekly market outlooks, strategy notes, and trading calendars

4. Perform sentiment tracking using heatmaps, positioning data, and risk metrics

5. Research major FX pairs, commodity contracts, and crypto pairs from a macro perspective

6. Assist in backtesting macro-based trade ideas using historical data

7. Build concise, data-rich presentation decks and visual summaries for team briefings and client insights

Who Should Apply?

1. Students or graduates in Finance, Economics, International Business, or MBA (Finance)

2. Passion for global macroeconomics, central bank policy, and cross-asset trading

3. Strong grasp of economic data, market narratives, and trend interpretation

4. Experience with TradingView, economic calendars, Investing.com, or Bloomberg tools

5. Skill in transforming complex data into simplified actionable analysis

6. Knowledge of FX, commodities, and crypto instruments is highly preferred

What You’ll Gain

1. Real-world exposure to macroeconomic-driven global markets and research workflows

2. Learn to craft institutional-style research reports and market updates

3. Monthly stipend up to ₹20,000 based on your deliverables and performance

4. Letter of Recommendation and internship certification on successful completion

5. Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity for high-potential interns

6. 1-on-1 mentorship from macro strategists, traders, and portfolio analysts

Start Date: Immediate preferred

About the company:

India's first social distribution AI fintech platform for the underserved aspirational middle-class- delivering Secured & Unsecured loans, Insurance, and Investment products across 5,000+ small cities of India (referred as India-2). Founded in 2019, WeRize is at an annualized-run-rate of $60 Mn (Gross revenues) and $32Mn (Net) and $7Mn+ of net profits before taxes (3x Y-o-Y growth) with ROE > 20%. We are projecting ~2x growth in topline and ~3x growth in profits over the next 12 months.

WeRize operates as a “category creator” three-sided marketplace connecting 17,000+ trained local freelancers with India-2 customers and partner financial institutions, all powered by a full-stack AI operating layer that creates a “flywheel of trust” with self-reinforcing network effects.

  • Distributor trust: Freelancers are empowered through AI-led tools that help them act in the long-term best interests of their customers.
  • Customer trust: End customers rely on WeRize’s assisted distributor, data-driven recommendations across both asset and liability products
  • Manufacturer trust: Financial Institutions rely on WeRize’s data, risk management and distribution intelligence to reach small city customers that they can’t serve on their own.

Key highlights: What do we do

1. Large, underpenetrated market opportunity: India’s 300Mn+ aspirational middle-class captures ~30% of GDP, yet remains financially underserved across credit, insurance, and investments. Pure-digital models lack the required trust, while physical branches are economically unviable.
2. Differentiated, asset-light social distribution: WeRize leverages 17,000+ financially literate freelancers across 5,000+ small cities. This branchless, zero-sales-team model delivers high-trust human touchpoints, superb unit economics, and strong freelancer retention through a broad product suite.
3. Proprietary AI driven tech stack: Trained on 20Bn+ data points across 4Mn+ households, WeRize’s AI powers end-to-end operations. For distribution, it optimizes lead gen, selling, and engagement—turning freelancers into professional advisors. For manufacturing, it sharpens risk management, underwriting, and product structuring for high-margin expansion.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

Role Overview:

The Product & Research Analyst serves as the strategic bridge connecting our clients, product team, and marketing group. In this client-facing role, you will interact directly with customers to gather primary market intelligence, analyze user engagement, and identify performance gaps. About Zamp:

At Zamp, we’re building AI agents that empower people to move at the speed of thought. Our vision is a world where AI handles the routine, so humans can focus on strategy and innovation. We are building a platform where all operational work runs autonomously. We partner with Fortune 500s, leading global banks and companies to streamline complex Finance and Operations processes.

Founded in 2022 by Amit Jain—an IIT Delhi and Stanford graduate with over 20 years of industry leadership, including roles as Managing Director at Sequoia Capital and Head of Asia Pacific at Uber—Zamp is backed by a stellar $22M seed round. Customer Implementation: Help take customers from kickoff to successful delivery and ongoing value. Delivery Excellence: Help the team deliver better and faster by building the in-house tools, processes, and best practices that make great execution repeatable. job.name: Instrument Software Test and Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
Overview

About Us

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Santa Rosa, in the heart of California’s wine country, is Keysight’s corporate headquarters and home to many product development R&D labs. The Digital and Photonics R&D team in Santa Rosa develops and produces the world’s highest performance oscilloscopes. You will work closely with a diverse, multi-functional team of engineers, scientists, and researchers around the globe to meet the communications electronics measurement challenges of today and tomorrow. Giving customers insight into developing digital communication and Internet infrastructure signals and devices is our focus.

Role summary

As a Software QA Engineer on the Digital and Photonics R&D team in Santa Rosa, you will test the software that controls our sampling oscilloscopes, captures waveform data, and performs the measurements and analysis used to characterize high-speed digital signals. You will help make sure the measurements our customers rely on are correct and repeatable, with support from senior engineers.

Responsibilities

You will join the R&D team for a high-performance sampling oscilloscope and test the software that controls the instrument, acquires waveforms, and computes the measurement results engineers use to characterize high-speed digital signals. You will work with support from senior engineers and take on more ownership as you grow.

Test design and execution

  • Turn feature requirements into test cases covering functional, measurement-accuracy, regression, and installation testing, and help prioritize them by customer risk.
  • Test the software on real instruments and signal sources: set up the signal and acquisition, run the measurement, and check that the result looks physically reasonable (for example eye diagram, jitter, amplitude, and timing results on NRZ and PAM4 signals).
  • Compare measurement results with reference signals, golden data, or reference instruments, and report differences you find.

Test automation

  • Write and maintain automated tests, test harnesses, and instrument-control scripts.
  • Help identify gaps in automated coverage and close them, starting with the highest-risk areas.
  • Work with developers to add unit, regression, and functional tests as features are developed.

Read the full description
