job.name: Wireless Validation Engineer
job.description:
Source One is a consulting services company and we’re currently looking for the following individual to work as a consultant to an innovative autonomous mobility company in Foster City, CA.

Title: Wireless Validation Engineer

Work Environment: On-site / In-person

Compensation: $73.16 per hour plus benefits

Contract Duration: 12 months with possible extension

Overview: Our client is seeking a highly skilled and creative Wireless Validation Engineer to validate the performance, reliability, and regulatory compliance of wireless connectivity and vehicle networking systems. In this role, you will design, develop, document, and execute comprehensive unit-level and system-level validation test plans for critical hardware and connected vehicle technologies. Your primary focus will include 4G LTE, 5G NR (NSA/SA), Wi-Fi 6/6E, GNSS, and high-speed Automotive Ethernet.

You will work closely with internal system architects, engineering teams, chipset vendors, and external module suppliers to characterize RF performance, troubleshoot complex connectivity issues, and ensure systems meet stringent performance, reliability, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in wireless system validation, modem technologies, RF performance testing, and automated test development, along with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Wireless Protocol and System Validation

  • Develop, document, and execute comprehensive unit-level and system-level validation test plans for 4G LTE, 5G NR (NSA/SA), Wi-Fi 6/6E, GNSS, and Automotive Ethernet.
  • Evaluate end-to-end system performance, protocol compliance, RF characteristics, Quality of Service (QoS), and network throughput.
  • Collaborate with system architects, chipset vendors, and module suppliers to investigate and resolve protocol-level failures.
  • Execute validation testing across PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, and NAS protocol layers.
  • Perform IMS, VoLTE, and VoNR testing, including call-flow analysis and defect triage.

2. Automated Test Infrastructure Development

  • Develop and maintain automated wireless validation frameworks using Python, SCPI commands, and specialized APIs.
  • Configure and operate wireless network simulation platforms, including Keysight and Rohde & Schwarz equipment.
  • Create repeatable test scenarios to simulate real-world wireless network and channel conditions.
  • Develop automated regression testing solutions and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test environments.
  • Improve test efficiency, reliability, and coverage through automation.

3. Failure Analysis and Root-Cause Investigation

  • Conduct Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to identify, evaluate, and address system anomalies.
  • Collect, analyze, and interpret PHY, MAC, and higher-layer protocol logs.
  • Utilize diagnostic tools such as Qualcomm QXDM, QCAT, ShannonDM, and Wireshark to troubleshoot connectivity issues.

We're a venture-backed hardtech company in Redwood City, building power conversion technology for data centers, EVs, and energy systems. Several products are already moving into production.

You'll define what "validated" means for a given program, plan and run the dynamometer, high-voltage, reliability, thermal, and vibration campaigns that prove it, and drive anomalies to root cause using Tau's existing test capability.

You'll also be one of Tau's technical faces to the outside world. When a customer or Tier 1 partner needs someone onsite to run dynamometer testing on their floor, troubleshoot alongside their engineering team, and represent Tau's product credibly under their scrutiny, that's you.

job.name: Avionics Systems & Verification Engineer
job.description:
Description

Role Summary

We are seeking an Avionics Systems & Verification Engineer to lead the integration and DO-178C verification of our Cockpit Display Systems (CDS), VMS and Communication, Navigation, and Surveillance (CNS) suites. You will be responsible for authoring rigorous verification test plans, developing requirement-based test cases, and executing end-to-end integration testing across Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and flight deck simulation environments to ensure full airworthiness compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Avionics Integration (Cockpit & CNS): Lead the functional and interface integration of Primary Flight Displays (PFD), Multi-Function Displays (MFD), Crew Alerting Systems (CAS), and CNS radios/transponders (VHF, SATCOM, GNSS/IRS, ADS-B, TCAS, Weather Radar).
  • Test Plan & Test Case Authoring: Write comprehensive Software/System Verification Plans (SVP) and detailed, requirement-based test cases covering normal operations, human-machine interface (HMI) logic, and degraded/failure modes.
  • DO-178C Verification Execution: Execute formal verification procedures across desktop simulators, Avionics Integration Benches (AIB), and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) rigs in strict accordance with DO-178C (DAL A/B/C) and ARP4754A/B standards.
  • Bus & Protocol Validation: Verify data bus communications and Interface Control Documents (ICDs) across protocols such as ARINC 429, ARINC 661 (Cockpit Display Systems), ARINC 825 (CAN), and AFDX / ARINC 664.
  • Traceability & Certification Audits: Maintain bidirectional traceability from system/software requirements to test cases, test results, and structural coverage reports (MC/DC) using tools like IBM DOORS, Jama, or Polarion. Support internal reviews and regulatory Stage of Involvement (SOI #1–#4) audits.

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Avionics Domain Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of Cockpit Display Systems (symbology, alerting, graphics generation) and CNS architectures (navigation aids, surveillance transponders, radio management).
  • DO-178C & Aerospace Standards: Hands-on experience executing verification lifecycles under DO-178C and ARP4754A/B, including familiarity with ARINC 661 or DO-254 interfaces.
  • Testing & Automation Tools: Proven ability to author test plans/procedures and automate test scripts using Python, C/C++, or specialized avionics test environments (e.g., dSPACE, National Instruments VeriStand, Vector CANoe).
  • Data Bus Debugging: Practical experience analyzing and troubleshooting avionics data buses (ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet/AFDX, CAN) using bus analyzers.

Preferred Qualifications

Company Description

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.

Who You’ll Work With

The EOS Routing PI team is responsible for developing routing protocols like BGP, OSPF and ISIS and Data Center and SP technologies like MPLS, Segment Routing and EVPN. A unique feature of the Arista routing team is that the routing software is common across Campus, Data Center and Service Provider routing features. This is a global team that spreads multiple geographies working on cutting edge features that get deployed in the largest Cloud titan, Service Provider, Enterprise and Campus networks.

What You’ll Do

Arista provides an open Engineering-driven culture which fosters innovation and enables engineers to Learn, Lead and Thrive. Our adoption of modern software tools, methodologies and processes and emphasis on automation enables our engineers to focus their energies on the truly complex problems and be among the most productive in the industry. Arista's products are purpose built with the scale, performance and quality required to operate in some of the most demanding environments - this provides engineers the platform and rigour to learn and gain experience in building complex, scalable software systems.

Qualifications

Basic qualifications

1. Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering

Preferred qualifications

1. Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment

This is a high-impact Product Architect role within the Oracle Practice. You are the functional lead responsible for transforming supply chain challenges into working digital realities.   • SCM Digital Roadmap/Blueprinting: Mapping legacy supply chain processes to Oracle Modern Best Practices.

II. Domain Expertise

  • Procurement & Sourcing: Deep expertise in Sourcing, Purchasing, and the Supplier Portal for collaborative procurement.

  • End-to-End Flows: Comprehensive knowledge of Source-to-Pay (S2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycles.

III. Candidate Profile

  • Experience: 10+ years in Oracle SCM (EBS/Cloud), with at least 3 full-lifecycle Oracle Cloud SCM implementations.

job.name: Senior Manufacturing Cost Analyst
job.description:
Your role

CPC Pumps is looking for a talented professional to join our team to fill an existing vacancy in the role of Senior Manufacturing Cost Analyst. The Senior Manufacturing Cost Analyst performs financial and operational analysis from Sales through Operating Gross Profit, focusing on product and manufacturing costs, COGS, gross margin and manufacturing performance. The role independently calculates, analyzes, investigates and reports findings, and recommends improvement opportunities. Working with the Business Controller, Finance team and operational functions, the position provides fact-based insights that support cost, productivity and profitability improvements.

Your day-to-day

Sales, Cost & Profitability Analysis

  • Analyze Sales, COGS, Gross Profit and Gross Margin against budget, forecast and prior year, including price, volume and mix impacts
  • Analyze profitability by customer, product, product line and order/project
  • Prepare monthly Gross Profit analysis, investigate significant deviations, and highlight margin erosion, cost overruns, risks and recommendations
  • Prepare supporting cost analysis for new products, manufacturing changes, orders and projects.

Manufacturing Cost & Performance Analysis

  • Analyze material, labour and manufacturing overhead costs, including actual cost development, BOMs, routings and other costing drivers
  • Analyze utilization, productivity, efficiency, capacity and absorption, and explain their impact on COGS and Gross Profit
  • Analyze material, labour overhead, production, utilization and absorption variances against budget, forecast and historical results
  • Investigate underlying drivers with Operations, Engineering and Supply Chain, including shop-floor review when needed, and communicate findings and recommendations
  • Analyze inventory and WIP cost development, unusual balances and manufacturing orders, and monitor significant orders/projects for cost overruns and margin deterioration
  • Provide cost analysis supporting inventory valuation, physical inventory and related activities
  • Support the Business Controller with manufacturing rate calculations by gathering and validating inputs, structuring models, and preparing supporting analysis and scenarios.

Reporting, Planning & Business Support

job.name: Lead AI Engineer, Conversational & Agentic AI
job.description:
Job Description What is the Opportunity? RBC is hiring Lead AI Engineers to build the conversational and agentic AI that serves our clients and employees. You'll design LLM agents that plan, call tools, and work securely with core banking systems, then own them in production: evaluation, observability, guardrails, and iteration. The role combines hands-on engineering with data science rigour and technical leadership in a regulated environment. If you've shipped LLM or agent systems to production and kept them running after launch, we want to talk to you.

What will you do? We're growing RBC's conversational and agentic AI capabilities, which include virtual assistants, voice interfaces, and LLM-based agents that complete multi-step tasks for clients and employees. As a Lead AI Engineer, you'll set technical directions, build production systems, and make sure they are measurable, secure, and compliant. You'll write code, lead design reviews, and mentor engineers and data scientists.

  • Agentic systems
  • Design and build LLM agents that plan, reason, and act through tool and function calling across core banking, CRM, and knowledge-base APIs.
  • Architect single-agent and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, including state management, memory, retries, and human-in-the-loop handoffs.
  • Build and integrate tools and services through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and secure internal APIs.
  • Conversational AI
  • Build and improve intent recognition, entity extraction, and dialogue orchestration for chat and voice channels.
  • Design RAG pipelines: chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, and grounding, using vector databases.
  • Implement guardrails, fallback handling, and escalation to human agents.
  • Data science and evaluation
  • Build offline and online evaluation frameworks, including A/B testing, significance testing, and metric design for both conversations and agent trajectories (task success, tool-call accuracy, step efficiency, cost).
  • Observability and LLMOps
  • Own end-to-end observability: distributed tracing of every pipeline stage (guardrails, LLM calls, tool calls, cache, downstream APIs), structured logging with PII redaction, metrics, and alerting.
  • Track quality, latency (p95/p99), error rates, containment, escalation, and guardrail outcomes in production. Use traces to debug regressions and feed evaluation datasets.
  • Stack: OpenTelemetry, Traceloop/OpenLLMetry, Langfuse, MLflow, Arize Phoenix, promptfoo, and Dynatrace.
  • Governance, risk and compliance
  • Make sure solutions meet RBC's privacy, security, and responsible AI standards, as well as OSFI and other regulatory requirements.
  • Work with Risk, Legal, and Compliance to validate model and agent behaviour, including red-teaming, bias mitigation, and auditability of agent actions.

job.name: Senior Machine Learning Expert
job.description:
Senior Machine Learning Expert (AI Training) About The Role What if your deep expertise in machine learning could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems learn to reason, plan, and make decisions? We're looking for Senior Machine Learning Experts to author high-fidelity reasoning traces — the structured, step-by-step thinking patterns that teach large language models how to tackle complex, real-world problems reliably.

This isn't annotation work. This is senior-level intellectual contribution to the frontier of AI development. You'll be working alongside world-class AI research teams, bringing your architectural instincts and problem-solving depth to some of the most impactful training data being produced today.

Fully remote. Flexible hours. Contract-based with room to grow.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Author complex, high-fidelity reasoning traces that document how an LLM should plan, use tools, and make decisions step by step
  • Decompose sophisticated technical tasks into clear, logical, well-structured decision paths
  • Design data strategies that reflect real-world problem-solving across advanced ML scenarios
  • Review and mentor the quality of structured traces to ensure rigorous planning and tool-use documentation
  • Contribute directly to training pipelines for frontier AI models used by leading research labs

Who You Are

  • Deeply experienced in machine learning, AI research, or a closely related technical field
  • A natural systems thinker — you can break down complex problems into clean, logical, documented steps
  • Familiar with LLM architectures, evaluation methodologies, and training pipelines
  • Precise and structured in your written communication — you explain your reasoning, not just your conclusions
  • Comfortable working independently and asynchronously in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or AI training data workflows
  • Top-tier Kaggle competition results (Grandmaster or Master level) — a strong signal of model performance intuition and feature engineering depth
  • Hands-on experience with RLHF, chain-of-thought prompting, or tool-augmented LLM evaluation
  • Background in AI safety, alignment research, or reasoning benchmarks

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI projects alongside world-leading research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — structure your hours around your life, not the other way around
  • Freelance autonomy with the intellectual depth of genuinely meaningful, senior-level work
  • Rare opportunity to influence how the next generation of AI systems actually think and reason
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

job.name: Risk Strategist
job.description:
*🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!* Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

*💻 Role* Risk Strategists at Whatnot combine data analysis, hands-on investigation, and technical problem-solving to protect our marketplace. You’ll dig into how fraud works, translate those insights into durable defenses, and help shape our risk strategy and Product and Engineering roadmap. This role requires both attention to detail and the ability to turn individual findings into broader action.

  • Investigate fraud at its source. Examine suspicious accounts, transactions, and connected activity to understand fraudsters’ modus operandi, the methods, behavioral patterns, coordination tactics, and product or process gaps they exploit.
  • Build durable defenses. Translate investigative findings into repeatable detection signals, rules, controls, and product improvements that address underlying vulnerabilities rather than individual incidents.
  • Shape strategy and priorities. Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations to define strategic direction, prioritize opportunities, and develop a roadmap that balances immediate threats with long-term protection.
  • Drive cross-functional execution. Turn complex findings into clear recommendations, build alignment on tradeoffs, and carry initiatives from problem definition through implementation and iteration.
  • Stay hands-on and technical. Use SQL, scripting, automation, and AI-assisted development tools to investigate problems and prototype solutions. Where appropriate, contribute lightweight tools and small, well-scoped application features in partnership with Engineering.
  • Measure and improve outcomes. Monitor emerging fraud trends and defense performance, balancing fraud prevention with false positives, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
  • Embed protection into new experiences. Evaluate abuse risks in new products, markets, and customer journeys, and help design safeguards before and after launch.

job.name: Economist, Entertainment Economics
job.description:
Description The charter of the Entertainment Economics team includes working on high-impact projects that require economics expertise and a cross-business perspective. Our team supports Amazon’s diverse entertainment businesses – especially Prime Video, Amazon Music, Amazon MGM Studios, and Gaming (Luna) – through complex causal measurements (observational and experimental) and structural modeling. Some of our team’s areas of science expertise include marketing science, long-term value measurement, and experimentation. As a central economics team not embedded in any particular business, we strive to provide objective analyses that take a customer-obsessed, pan-Amazon perspective.

This role partners with the Prime Science team to evaluate and improve the way Amazon allocates Prime subscription revenue across its benefit teams, including entertainment businesses. Prime is Amazon's premiere membership program, with over 200mm members world-wide, bringing in billions in Prime subscription revenue annually. Prime is at the center of many major company decisions that impact Amazon's customers. These decisions span a variety of industries, each reflecting the diversity of Prime benefits: fast and free shipping, entertainment & digital content, reading, healthcare, and grocery. Each of these Prime benefits is supported by a different organization, and each relies on Prime subscription revenue to make critical investment decisions. Our team partners with Prime Science to ensure that these allocations are credible, actionable, and incentive compatible for every benefit.

To support this work, this role will create science models, validate them, and productionize them. In addition to stellar economics expertise, this role requires systems thinking (anticipating how complex interconnected models will respond to changes in data or modeling), strategic thinking (supporting decisions that affect 200 million+ customers and set Amazon’s direction for years to come), and scientifically novel thinking (using AI and the latest science advancements to achieve move).

The ideal candidate is expert in causal inference with experience working in large, complex structural modeling environments. They are a creative problem-solver, able to identify new approaches that solve multiple problems at once while minimizing churn. They think big, not limiting themselves to what’s been done before, while tactfully accounting for the costs of major changes. They can add structure to incredibly ambiguous business contexts, making defensible assumptions and delivering measurements that drive impactful business decisions. They have effective communication and the skill to translate data-driven findings into actionable insights for senior leaders. Finally, they are empathetic and constructive. Our healthy team culture is supportive and fast-paced, and we prioritize learning, growth, and helping each other to continuously raise the bar.

Impact and Career Growth

job.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE As a Data Scientist on the Digital Experience Insights team, you'll lead high-impact analytics initiatives, turning complex data, platform, and time-series data into rigorous predictive models, causal inferences, and strategic product metrics. job.name: Senior and Staff Data Scientist - Credit and Lending ML
job.description:
About a week before Hurricane Sandy made landfall, the two leading forecast models flatly disagreed: the American one carried the storm safely out into the Atlantic, the European one turned it hard left into New Jersey. The European model wasn't running a better simulation, it was running an ensemble. Hundreds of thousands of people were evacuated on the strength of the spread in forecast distribution, days before any single forecast could have justified moving them, and on October 29th, 2012, Sandy came ashore almost exactly where the models had put it.

At Mercury, we're building the future of financial infrastructure for startups and growing businesses. We're extending credit to those businesses, and we're doing it with proprietary access to some of the best data for understanding a borrower's business, from bank transactions to financial reporting to payroll. We're looking for a Senior/Staff Data Scientists to turn that record into a lending decision, partnering closely with Credit, Product, and Engineering.

In this role, you'll build and own the inference layer behind our small business lending program; you'll ship it into production with the monitoring and documentation that make it trustworthy; and you'll help Credit and Product decide what we should be lending in the first place.

Here Are Some Things You'll Do On The Job:

  • Build and own the models behind our lending program - transaction classification, recurring inflow/outflow detection, annual revenue estimation, forecasting with seasonality, anomaly detection, and more
  • Turn messy data streams - bank transactions, storefront sales, and more - into a defensible view of a business's health
  • Deploy models into a production environment with observability, monitoring, and tests
  • Partner with Credit on underwriting policy: what data is asked for, when follow-up information is worth the friction, and how to quantify uncertainty
  • Partner with Product on the shape of the product: from principal sizes and pricing to repayment terms
  • Assess where predictive modeling actually moves the underwriting program
  • Set the technical bar for ML in Credit

You Should:

For Staff:

  • Have 7+ years building ML models
  • Implemented models that shaped automated decisions with money on the line
  • Write production-grade Python
  • Have depth beyond classification models; for example: time series and forecasting, anomaly detection, and NLP models
  • Be proficient with deep learning, transformers, and LLMs
  • Be strong in SQL and at home in a data warehouse
  • Be able to explain a model to a credit officer, a model validator, a PM, and an engineer
  • Be able to set modeling standards for your data-science colleagues
  • Have a quantitative degree, or the equivalent built some other way

For Senior:

Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role As a Staff Data Scientist at SentiLink, you will build our core products: models that identify fraudsters and also advance our growing suite of products in financial risk. As an experienced researcher you will be relied upon to be technically capable and the definitive owner of your respective domain. You will often work on projects with high visibility and impact that require deep domain understanding, critical thinking and strong technical abilities. You will work with teams across the company to research new types of fraud, develop new products, and provide analysis to drive sales and marketing. This is a full-stack data science role, involving model development, analysis, and writing production code. You should be interested in having end-to-end ownership and a fast-moving environment where deep domain understanding drives development and unusual insights drive our competitive advantage rather than optimization of new machine learning methodologies.

We Have Open Roles On Multiple Teams Including

job.name: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
Joins us at PharmEasy:

Launched in 2015, PharmEasy is a consumer healthcare “super app.” Started with the sole purpose of making healthcare accessible C affordable to all, PharmEasy today is India's leading C most trusted onlinehealthcare aggregator in the country.

We provide on-demand, home-delivered access to a wide range of prescription pharmaceuticals,

diagnostic test services, OTC pharmaceuticals, C other consumer healthcare products, thereby serving your healthcare needs. Through our services, we ensure access to the best and most genuine health products, with the highest savings in the shortest time. Today, we deliver medicines in 1000+ cities in India, covering 19000+ pin codes. We offer diagnostic test services across Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Gandhi Nagar, Surat, Vadodara, Lucknow, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Jaipur.

About the role

You'll work across three businesses: PharmEasy (consumer pharmacy), Ascent (B2B pharma

distribution), and Thyrocare (diagnostics). This is a hands-on role. You'll build and deploy ML

models yourself and own the problem areas they serve, from deciding what to build to the

results in production. We care about shipped work with measurable impact, not papers or

leaderboard rankings.

Problems you'll work on

Search and Recommendations, Personalization, risk modelling, Agentic AI applications,

Forecasting, supply chain and inventory optimization, pricing and margin optimization,

operations planning and routing. We'll match problems to your strengths.

What you'll do

● Build and deploy ML models end to end: data preparation, feature engineering, training,

evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

● Own a problem area, from deciding what's worth building to the business metrics it

moves.

● Write production-quality code and work with engineering on serving, latency, and scale.

● Track drift, retrain, and keep improving models after launch.

● Build LLM-based agentic systems where they beat simpler approaches.

● Work directly with business heads across three companies to shape what gets built.

What success looks like

Within your first 6 months, you'll have shipped at least one model that measurably moves a core

business metric.

What you need

● 4+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML models.

● Strong classical ML: regression, tree-based models, time-series forecasting, feature

engineering, validation.

● Models you've taken to production yourself, using Python, SQL, and standard MLOps

tooling, with impact you can quantify.

● Hands-on experience with LLM/agentic systems beyond demos.

● Nice to have: Optimization or simulation, search and recommendation systems, A/B

testing or causal inference, and experience in e-commerce, pharma, diagnostics, or

supply chain.

Location: Bangalore

job.name: Source Control Management for Git Hub
job.description:
Experience: 0-3 Yrs

Skills

  • Git: Help colleagues with branching, merging, resolving conflicts, etc.
  • GitHub: Org & repo maintenance and administration.
  • GitHub Actions: Runner group & runner management, writing and maintenance of GitHub Actions workflows.
  • Jenkins: Configuration and maintenance of nodes, jobs and pipelines.
  • Artifactory: Management of generated artifacts, including administration of Conan remotes.
  • CMake: Writing & maintenance of modern, target-based C/C++ build scripts, toolchain files, and CMakePresets for multi-platform CI builds.
  • Compilation & Linkage: Working knowledge of compiler/linker behavior (GCC, Clang, MSVC), static vs. dynamic linking, ABI compatibility, and cross-compilation toolchains.
  • Conan 2.0: Writing & maintenance of Conan recipes, profiles, and remotes; managing binary compatibility and dependency resolution.
  • Test frameworks: GoogleTest, CTest with CMake.
  • Static analysis & sanitizers: cppcheck, ASan/UBSan/TSan.
  • Code coverage: gcov/lcov, CI pipelines and reporting.
  • Scripting languages: Batch scripting, PowerShell, Bash, Python, Groovy.
  • Markup languages: Markdown, YAML.
  • Containerization: Writing, maintenance and optimization of Docker images.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source Control Management:
  • Administer and maintain GitHub organizations and repositories (access control, repo structure, etc.).
  • Enforce branch/PR rules and review practices.
  • Disseminate knowledge and debug issues of colleagues.

CI/CT

  • Design, build, and maintain GitHub Actions workflows for automated build, test, and deployment.
  • Manage and optimize Jenkins pipelines and jobs for various projects.
  • Maintain and optimize CMake build configurations across platforms/architectures, including toolchain files, presets, and build caching.
  • Write and maintain Conan recipes, manage remotes and package promotion workflows on Artifactory, and resolve dependency/binary compatibility issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve build/link failures related to compiler/linker configuration, ABI mismatches, or toolchain differences.
  • Integrate and maintain GoogleTest/CTest suites, static analysis (cppcheck), sanitizers (ASan/UBSan/TSan), and code coverage (gcov/lcov) in CI pipelines, with reporting.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot build, test, and deployment failures.

Automation, Tooling & Documentation

  • Develop scripts and automation to improve developer productivity and reduce manual effort.
  • Create and maintain scripts for first-day onboarding of new users and machines.
  • Maintain configuration files, secrets, and credentials in a secure manner.
  • Write and update documentation of new and existing CI/CT work packages.

job.description:
Chez Extia Canada , on fait du conseil autrement : performance, transparence et humain avant tout.

Présents en Europe et au Canada, certifiés Great Place To Work® , on accompagne nos consultants sur des mandats à forte valeur ajoutée, dans des environnements exigeants.

D'abord qui ?

On cherche un Administrateur Systèmes Senior , avec une solide expérience dans l'administration, la maintenance, la sécurisation et l'évolution d'infrastructures informatiques, principalement dans des environnements Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Intune et Azure .

Le contexte : participer à la gestion et à l'évolution d'infrastructures systèmes d'entreprise, en intervenant sur l'administration des serveurs, les environnements virtualisés VMware et Hyper-V , la gestion des identités et des accès, ainsi que l'automatisation des tâches d'exploitation.

On recherche un profil avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience, alternance incluse , autonome techniquement, capable de résoudre des incidents complexes et d'évoluer dans un environnement international et anglophone.

Quelqu'un qui :

  • possède une solide expérience en administration systèmes Windows Server
  • maîtrise Active Directory , la gestion des utilisateurs, des groupes et des stratégies de sécurité (GPO)
  • possède une bonne expérience sur Microsoft 365 (Office 365) et Intune
  • connaît les environnements Microsoft Azure et les infrastructures hybrides
  • maîtrise les solutions de virtualisation VMware et/ou Hyper-V
  • possède une expérience dans la gestion, la maintenance et la sécurisation des serveurs
  • connaît les outils d'ordonnancement et d'automatisation des traitements
  • sait développer et maintenir des scripts pour automatiser les tâches d'administration
  • est capable de diagnostiquer et de résoudre des incidents systèmes complexes
  • comprend les enjeux de performance, de disponibilité et de sécurité des infrastructures
  • est capable d'évoluer dans un environnement professionnel en anglais courant

Ensuite quoi ?

Mission principale

Administrer, maintenir, sécuriser et faire évoluer les infrastructures systèmes afin de garantir leur disponibilité, leur performance et leur sécurité.

Participer aux projets de modernisation des environnements informatiques, notamment autour des technologies Microsoft, Azure, VMware et Hyper-V , tout en contribuant à l'automatisation et à l'amélioration continue des processus d'exploitation.

job.name: Utilization and Capacity Analyst
job.description:
About Us

ZenaTech (Nasdaq: ZENA | FSE: 49Q) is a technology company specializing in AI drones, Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS), enterprise SaaS, and quantum computing solutions for mission-critical business applications. Since 2017, the company has leveraged its software development expertise and expanded its drone design and manufacturing capabilities through ZenaDrone to innovate and enhance customer inspection, monitoring, safety, security, compliance, and surveying processes. ZenaTech serves over 100 enterprise software customers in law enforcement, government, and industrial sectors, with drones used in agriculture, defense, and logistics industries. The company has offices in North America, Europe, Australia, and the UAE.

Job Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Utilization and Capacity Analyst to develop and implement strategies that align organizational resources with current and future business demands while supporting operational efficiency, productivity, and workforce optimization. The successful candidate will leverage data-driven insights to identify capacity risks, improve resource allocation, and support informed decision-making across the organization.

This is a full-time, in-person role out of our office located in Toronto, ON.

Key Responsibilities

  • Track and analyze the utilization of company resources across various departments and business units.
  • Partner with project managers and business leaders to support resource planning, prioritization, and allocation decisions.
  • Assess resource availability against current and projected business demands, identifying capacity gaps, constraints, and inefficiencies.
  • Identify underutilized or overcommitted resources and recommend practical solutions to optimize workforce arrangement
  • Document methodologies, KPIs, and reporting standards to ensure utilization is consistently defined, measured, and communicated across the organization.
  • Develop forecasting models, dashboards, and regular reporting to provide insights into capacity trends, resource requirements, and business performance.

job.name: Integrated Insights Manager
job.description:
Summary Location: Toronto

This role is based in Toronto, Canada. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

The Integrated Insights Manager is a country level role within the Integrated Insights pillar of Execution Excellence (EE). It transforms data into actionable insights to support Commercial and Value & Access (V&A) decision-making for assigned Therapeutic Areas.

The role bridges strategy with execution by translating priorities into clear insight and analytics questions, and by orchestrating delivery through the Data, Analytics & Platforms (DAP) pillar and external research partners. It leads execution of insight plans — including market research, performance analysis and forecast input preparation, within the guardrails defined by EE.

About The Role Key responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary Integrated Insights partner for assigned Therapeutic Areas (TA) and/or Value & Access (V&A), consolidating analytics and insight needs
  • Translate business strategies into clear insights, analytics questions, and research priorities.
  • Lead market research planning and execution, including patient journey mapping, segmentation, and competitive intelligence.
  • Integrate internal KPIs and external data sources to generate holistic insights on market, customer, and brand performance.
  • Support forecasting by developing market assumptions and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment.
  • Generate insights to support Value & Access strategies, including payer research and access-related data analysis.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across market, customer, and performance dimensions.
  • Deliver impactful reports and presentations, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Partner with data and analytics teams to ensure data quality, integrity, and continuous improvement.

Essential Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Business, Economics, Market Research, or related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in integrated insights, market research, business analytics, or commercial strategy in healthcare/pharma.
  • Strong expertise across analytics, primary and secondary market research, competitive intelligence, and forecasting.
  • Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with commercial, finance, and access teams.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Proficiency in data tools and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Alteryx).
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills to influence senior stakeholders.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced degree in Business, Life Sciences, Economics, or related field.
  • Experience leveraging digital innovation and advanced analytics to drive business outcomes.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Experience: 5–7 Years

Location: Bengaluru

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join our Windows Platform Engineering team, responsible for developing and maintaining enterprise-grade Windows client applications in the network security and connectivity domain.

The role involves Windows application development, system-level integrations, networking, troubleshooting, and building reliable and high-performance software components.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain Windows desktop applications and background components using C# and .NET.
  • Develop and maintain Windows services, system utilities, and platform-level components.
  • Work with Windows APIs, Registry, process and service management, and inter-process communication (IPC).
  • Develop and troubleshoot Windows networking and connectivity features.
  • Investigate issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, routing, network interfaces, and VPN connectivity.
  • Analyse application logs, crash dumps, Windows event logs, and network traces to identify root causes.
  • Develop unit, integration, and automated tests; contribute to reusable test automation frameworks.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and CI/CD integration.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in C# and .NET development.
  • Good understanding of object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, design patterns, and multithreading.
  • Experience with Windows application development, preferably WPF.
  • Knowledge of Windows internals, including processes, services, Registry, Windows APIs, and IPC.
  • Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, and network interfaces.
  • Experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and automated testing.
  • Familiarity with Git and PowerShell scripting.

Good to Have

  • Experience in VPN, SASE, endpoint security, or network security client development.
  • Knowledge of IPsec, TLS/SSL, DTLS, Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), or Windows RAS.
  • Experience with Named Pipes, RPC, or gRPC.
  • Familiarity with test framework , Gherkin, Reqnroll, NUnit, or similar testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to MDM solutions
  • Knowledge of C++, Rust, or Python.

Experience

  • 5–7 years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Ability to independently own features from design and implementation through testing and delivery.

L’entreprise a son siège social à Dollard-des-Ormeaux, au Québec, et est une filiale à part entière de Brother International Corporation (BIC), basée aux États-Unis. BIC est elle-même une filiale de Brother Industries Limited (BIL), fondée en 1908 à Nagoya, au Japon, et présente dans plus de 30 pays à travers le monde.

Pourquoi travailler chez Brother ? Chez Brother Canada, nous sommes bien plus qu’une équipe : nous formons une communauté guidée par les moteurs de notre culture : la responsabilité, l’authenticité, l’excellence et l’audace. Nous favorisons la collaboration, la croissance et l’équilibre entre la vie professionnelle et la vie personnelle en proposant à notre personnel des horaires flexibles, des possibilités de travail hybride, des subventions de santé, des rabais, ainsi que des programmes de formation, de perfectionnement et de reconnaissance. Présents à Montréal depuis 1960, nous valorisons l’amélioration continue et encourageons le dépassement de soi, tout en assurant votre stabilité et en offrant une expérience client exceptionnelle.

Aperçu du rôle Relevant du directeur de l’analyste des données et des connaissances, l’analyste de données contribue à faciliter et à accélérer la prise de décisions fondées sur des données et la science. Mettant à profit les résultats d’analyses rigoureuses, la personne qui occupe ce poste fournit des renseignements fiables, pertinents et à jour qui orientent les activités commerciales et les initiatives stratégiques de l’entreprise, ainsi que les tactiques de mise en marché. De plus, elle veille à répondre aux exigences des clients à l’interne et à assurer l’excellence opérationnelle. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les autres membres de l’équipe d’analyse, l’analyste de données crée et tient à jour des outils et des processus qui facilitent la manipulation et la transformation des données sur plusieurs plateformes. Il ou elle participe à l’automatisation des processus et à l’intégration des principes de la science des données en vue d’améliorer les processus de prise de décision. Il ou elle s’informe des exigences commerciales auprès de diverses parties prenantes pour ensuite les traduire en exigences techniques, réaliser des projets de développement et en tester les fonctionnalités. En outre, l’analyste de données répond aux demandes ad hoc, met en œuvre des procédures opérationnelles normalisées liées aux données et gère les attentes des parties prenantes tout au long du processus. The Business Intelligence & Metrics Analyst is responsible for developing, governing, and operationalizing enterprise metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), objectives and key results (OKRs), dashboards, and executive reporting across Risk, Security, IT, Compliance, and Shared Services functions. Taskimpetus Inc.

Information Tehnology

job.name: Staff Data Scientist (growth-stage startup)
job.description:
About Us Jerry.ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with the car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.

About The Team The Data Science & Analytics team is the strategic and analytical horsepower behind our relentless growth in a highly competitive market and despite headwinds. They’re primarily ex-BCG, McKinsey, and Bain consultants. Every product vertical or critical initiative has a Data Science & Analytics team member embedded — they own data analysis, insights & strategy, and drive our teams towards our next goal: reach 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

In 2026, We Launched 5 New Products — Home Insurance, Property Tax, Motorcycle Insurance, Car Repair Shop Bids, And Roadside Assistance. We’re Adding 1-2 Data Science And Analytics Team Members To Drive Impact In One Of These Key Areas

  • Growth — paid and organic marketing, market expansion, supply and distribution partnerships
  • Product — building 0-1 products, scaling existing products

Note: Our priority is finding the right people, we are flexible on job leveling/title.

About The Role You'll be embedded in a product team or a business unit that sits across products, and own the following:

  • Strategy: Define what business questions we should answer. Develop a hypothesis and next steps, prioritize, and create solutions with cross-functional partners.
  • Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
  • Build: Scope, validate and pursue new levers to accelerate our business. This could be building new products, testing new growth channels, launching new partnerships, or finding new ways to apply AI/automation.
  • Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

Why you will (or won't) like working here

  • No corporate fluff: We’re a team of insatiable learners and overachievers who care deeply about solving interesting problems and making a real impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or layers of approvals.
  • No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
  • Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

Who You Are

Read the full description

job.description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: 2 days in-office. This job posting is for an existing, currently vacant position People Analytics Partner Why this job’s a big deal The People Analytics Partner transforms employee and workforce data into clear, actionable insights that support better business and people decisions. This role partners with HR Business Partners, business leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable reporting, meaningful analysis, and data-driven recommendations.

In This Role, You Will

  • Work with HR leaders and stakeholders to translate business and talent needs into clear analytics requirements and metrics definitions.
  • Monitor key workforce metrics (headcount, attrition, engagement, hiring velocity, performance, etc.) to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for workforce optimization.
  • Conduct deep-dive analysis on people data to provide actionable recommendations for retention, employee satisfaction, and talent acquisition efficiency.
  • Support the refinement and prioritization of HR analytics projects and reporting requests to ensure alignment with People strategy and business objectives.
  • Develop and maintain intuitive People Analytics dashboards, reports, and self-service solutions using Workday and modern analytics tools.
  • Automate reporting workflows and leverage scalable technologies, including GenAI, to optimize analytics processes.
  • Communicate analytical findings through clear, compelling data stories and presentations for key stakeholders.
  • Lead ad-hoc analytics initiatives, including survey analysis, attrition research, and workforce planning support.
  • Act as a bridge between People Operations and HR Business Partners to ensure a shared understanding of workforce data and systems.
  • Ensure that people data practices, reporting, and analytics comply with data privacy laws, regulatory standards, and internal confidentiality requirements.
  • Document standard operating procedures (SOPs) and data dictionary guidelines for People Analytics to ensure consistency and scalability.
  • Rapidly learn Priceline's organizational structure, HR technology stack (Workday, ATS, LMS, etc.), and industry best practices in People Analytics.

Who You Are

job.name: Quantitative Trader
job.description:
Company Description Quantizer Research, founded in 2019, is focused on becoming India’s leading quantitative trading and high-frequency trading (HFT) firm. The company builds ultra-low latency trading platforms and tools for real-time trade support, market access, and advanced trading simulations. Quantizer emphasizes scale, technology, algorithms, speed, and mathematical rigor to identify profitable opportunities and maintain technical excellence. Its state-of-the-art HFT infrastructure includes an arbitrage trading platform, an ultra-low latency C++ API for automated trading, and an advanced options trading platform optimized for performance and features. Team members collaborate closely to refine mathematical and performance metrics and continuously improve the firm’s trading edge.

Role Description The Quantitative Trader role at Quantizer Research is a full-time, on-site position based in Dwarka. The person in this role will design, implement, and optimize quantitative trading strategies across multiple asset classes, focusing on high-frequency and low-latency environments. Daily responsibilities include analyzing market microstructure data, backtesting strategies, monitoring live trading performance, and making data-driven adjustments to improve profitability and reduce risk. The role involves close collaboration with developers and researchers to refine algorithms, enhance execution quality, and leverage in-house tools and platforms. The Quantitative Trader is expected to document models and assumptions clearly, maintain robust risk controls, and stay current with market trends, regulatory changes, and technological developments.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess skills in Trading and Trading Strategies for designing, executing, and optimizing systematic approaches.
  • Candidates should possess skills in Market Making to manage order books, provide liquidity, and respond to changing market conditions.
  • Candidates should possess skills in Quantitative Investing to build data-driven models and evaluate opportunities across instruments and time horizons.
  • Candidates should possess skills in Quantitative Analytics to perform statistical analysis, model validation, and performance measurement.
  • Strong proficiency in programming (e.g., C++, Python) and experience working with market data, backtesting frameworks, and execution systems.
  • Solid foundation in mathematics, statistics, or related quantitative disciplines; a degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance) is preferred.
  • Familiarity with HFT concepts, latency optimization, and risk management practices in electronic trading environments.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative setting, communicate complex ideas clearly, and make decisions based on empirical evidence.

job.name: AI/ML Engineer – Medical Imaging & Healthcare Technology
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

AI/ML Engineer – Medical Imaging & Healthcare Technology

Company: ONE Simulation
Location: Greater Noida / Noida
Department: Research & Development – AI/ML
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 0–2 Years
Eligibility: Freshers, candidates with 0–2 years of experience, and final-year B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / MCA students.

About ONE Simulation

ONE Simulation is a healthcare technology company focused on transforming medical education through simulation-based learning, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Extended Reality (XR), and advanced medical imaging technologies.

We develop innovative healthcare simulators and digital learning platforms across CT, MRI, Ultrasound, maternal and child healthcare, and minimally invasive procedures.

We are looking for enthusiastic AI/ML Engineers who are passionate about applying Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Computer Vision to medical imaging and healthcare technologies.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI/ML Model Development

  • Develop and implement machine learning and deep learning models.
  • Work on medical image classification, segmentation, detection, and analysis.
  • Explore AI applications in CT, MRI, Ultrasound, and X-ray imaging, C- ARM
  • Train, test, and optimize AI models using medical imaging datasets.

2. Medical Image Processing

  • Work with DICOM images and medical imaging formats.
  • Develop image processing algorithms for CT, MRI, and Ultrasound.
  • Explore image segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and anatomical structure identification.

3. Computer Vision & Deep Learning

  • Work with CNN, U-Net, YOLO, Vision Transformers, and other deep learning architectures.
  • Develop computer vision algorithms for object detection and real-time tracking.
  • Explore AI-based needle tracking and anatomical landmark detection.

4. AI Integration with Healthcare Simulators

  • Integrate AI/ML models with medical simulation platforms.
  • Develop intelligent feedback and performance assessment systems.
  • Explore AI-based evaluation of procedural skills.

5. Research & Innovation

  • Research emerging AI technologies in medical imaging.
  • Experiment with open-source AI frameworks and pretrained models.
  • Develop proof-of-concept projects and functional prototypes.

Required Technical Skills

  • Good knowledge of Python.
  • Basic understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
  • Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Knowledge of OpenCV, NumPy and Pandas.
  • Understanding of Computer Vision fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitHub.

Preferred Skills

job.description:
About Faire Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About This Role We are looking for a Strategy & Analytics Senior Lead to drive mission critical product and business decisions. This role owns the strategic direction for a cross-functional pod with a broad mandate, identifying and answering critical questions such as: What should our next 6-month strategy look like? What is the biggest lever to move our north star metric? What roadmap items should we prioritize to maximize impact? How can we learn from our launches and experiments to make the next iteration better? How and why are our most critical metrics moving?

The S&A team at Faire is unlike any other analytics team. We are leaders in our space — owning the metrics, analytical roadmap, prioritization, and strategic decisions end-to-end. We have a unique combination of skills including strategic thinking, problem solving, execution, and technical acumen that enable us to tackle the most ambiguous problems and influence key leaders on high stakes business decisions. We are true thought partners to many functions including Product, Sales, Operations, Marketing, and Finance.

This is an ideal role for someone who wants to work as a high-impact individual contributor in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and data-driven environment. This is a high-visibility role where you'll regularly present strategic insights and recommendations to Faire's leadership team, and your work will directly drive positive impact for Faire and our customers.

Open roles Skills We have multiple openings across this team, and use a general interview process. As a candidate, you’ll have a chance to meet hiring managers and teammates across several pillars throughout the process. By the final stage, you’ll be routed to the most relevant role(s) based on business priorities in addition to your skillsets and interests. We make sure you have plenty of time to meet your manager and potential teammates at the end of the process. More on the four pillars of our business below:

job.description:
At AMCL, a Turner & Townsend Company, you’ll join a global team of thought leaders committed to making a difference to infrastructure and society. If you bring your talent, enthusiasm, and creativity, we’ll help you realize your potential, providing the opportunity to learn, develop and work on our exciting projects happening around the world.

For 75 years Turner & Townsend has been helping to deliver transformational programs across the real estate, infrastructure, and natural resources sectors, making a difference in people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors. With 22,000 experts across more than 60 countries, Turner & Townsend is an independent professional services company specializing in program management, project management, cost management and consulting across the real estate, infrastructure, and natural resources sectors.

In 2017, AMCL joined forces with Turner & Townsend. AMCL is recognized as the world’s leading specialist infrastructure, asset management and asset information consultancy. We have built a global reputation for leadership in asset management thinking and on-the-ground delivery. AMCL was founded in 1997 and has worked with over 400 infrastructure organizations globally, across the energy, transportation, and utility sectors. Our teams thrive on the opportunities to share learning and good practice with our clients enabling them to realize true value from the work we deliver. With headquarters in the UK and branches around the globe, including New York City, AMCL has one of the largest teams of dedicated Infrastructure asset management consultants in the world.

www.amcl.com

job.name: DevOps Engineer
job.description:
About the Company

Opella is a global consumer healthcare company, focused on over-the-counter (OTC) medicines and self-care products. Opella is currently the third-largest player globally in the OTC and vitamins & supplements market and operates in over 100 countries . The company has a workforce of around 11,000 employees and a strong portfolio of more than 100 well-known brands , including Allegra, Dulcolax, and Doliprane.

About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a key role in building and maintaining Opella’s cloud and automation foundations. This position requires strong hands-on expertise in Azure, Terraform, and GitHub, ensuring secure, scalable, and automated cloud infrastructure. You will contribute to defining governance models, ways of working, and technical implementation standards that will shape Opella’s cloud and DevOps landscape. Experience with observability or monitoring tools such as New Relic or Splunk is considered a plus.

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure‑as‑Code using Terraform, including reusable modules, environment provisioning, and state management.
  • Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines through GitHub Actions, automating infrastructure deployments, testing, compliance, and platform configuration.
  • Establish and uphold GitHub governance, including repository standards, branch protection, code scanning integration, and secrets management.
  • Define and promote DevOps ways of working, contributing to cloud governance frameworks, automation strategies, and platform engineering standards.
  • Collaborate with application, architecture, and operations teams to integrate Azure services, harmonize cloud patterns, and improve developer productivity.
  • Support modernization and migration initiatives, leveraging automation and IaC for deployment, configuration, and environment lifecycle management.
  • Participate in architectural and design discussions, providing expert guidance on cloud infrastructure, automation patterns, and DevOps best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to enhance tooling, efficiency, operational reliability, and cloud maturity.

(Nice to have) Observability-related responsibilities

  • Support the migration from Splunk to New Relic when required.
  • Assist teams in implementing logging, metrics, APM instrumentation, or dashboards in New Relic.
  • Contribute to observability governance and standardization efforts.

job.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

  • Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
  • What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
  • It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS\*

  • Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
  • Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
  • Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
  • And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
  • Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.
  • Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Data Analyst to help us turn data into useful insights and make better business decisions while contributing to the continued development of our data infrastructure. In this role, you’ll independently partner with stakeholders across the organization to explore data, improve reporting, answer business questions, define meaningful metrics, and develop practical, reusable solutions. You’ll also help test, validate, and execute new data models, processes, and tools as we build a more scalable data foundation. job.name: Data Analyst- REMOTE
job.description:
About Our Client:

The organization operates within the defense and aerospace sector, focusing on complex NATO SATCOM terminal acquisition, deployment, logistics, sustainment, and lifecycle support programs. It addresses challenges related to the management and analysis of extensive technical and operational data across program lifecycles, supporting informed decision-making to improve readiness and sustainment outcomes for critical communication systems.

  • Design and maintain executive dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and automated reporting solutions.
  • Conduct predictive analytics, trend forecasting, anomaly detection, and risk assessments.
  • Support configuration management activities through data validation and traceability.
  • Analyze training effectiveness, certification rates, readiness metrics, and training performance data.
  • Support cybersecurity and quality assurance initiatives through compliance reporting and audit analytics.
  • Present findings and recommendations to diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders.

job.name: Data Integration & Analytics Analyst - Level 3
job.description:
Standard Job Description Role Overview Lockheed Martin Space is seeking a Data Integration & Analytics Analyst – Level 3 to support the Reentry Operations Center. You will use data analysis and automation to improve manufacturing visibility, production readiness, and operational performance. Working with engineering and operations teams, you will turn manufacturing data into actionable insights for factory execution and production decisions.

Key Duties / Responsibilities

  • Partner with engineering, manufacturing, and operations teams on production readiness.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reporting tools, and operational tracking systems.
  • Analyze manufacturing and production data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop integrations among SAP, machine data sources, and shop floor systems.
  • Support production ramp activities through data automation and process monitoring.
  • Apply statistical process control (SPC) and manufacturing performance analysis techniques.
  • Work with factory operations teams to improve execution and operational visibility.
  • Streamline reporting workflows and improve data access for decision-makers.

About Lockheed Martin Space Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you. Basic Qualifications To be considered, candidates must meet all requirements listed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related technical field.
  • Experience working with data pipelines, databases, or analytical tools in an operational or business environment.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, R, or similar tools to manipulate and analyze data.
  • Understanding of statistical methods, data analysis, metrics-based performance evaluation, and statistical process control (SPC).
  • Experience creating data visualizations, dashboards, or reporting solutions.
  • Ability to communicate data insights and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.

job.name: Principal Data Analyst
job.description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

  • Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
  • Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
  • Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

  • Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
  • Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

  • Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
  • Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
  • Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
  • Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
  • Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
  • Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics, or, a Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
  • At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language
  • At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
  • At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

job.name: Senior Data Analyst
job.description:
About Us At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Make it Right. Play to Win. Win as One

About The Role As a Senior Data Analyst, you will design, build, and own the analytics that ShipStation Global’s business teams use to make decisions. This role sits between the data platform built by data engineering and the business and is responsible for performing data discovery, defining and governing metrics, and analysis activities to identify specific information required to support client decisions and then present these results in a meaningful and intuitive format, using a variety of BI tools and techniques.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, genuinely curious about how the business operates, and comfortable working through ambiguity — able to sit down with a stakeholder, ask the questions that surface the real decision behind the request, define the problem, and then engineer a durable solution. Equally important is the judgment to push back when what was asked for is not what is actually needed, and the communication skills to explain why.

This position is hybrid (3 days per week in office) and is located in Austin or Dallas, Texas. job.name: Senior Data Analyst
job.description:
Our Company Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. Position Summary As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in analyzing complex healthcare datasets to drive strategic insights, improve operational efficiency, and deliver data-driven solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional business partners and technology teams to turn raw data into meaningful metrics, interactive dashboards, and strategic recommendations. This position offers the opportunity to solve challenging problems using modern analytical tools and data infrastructure in a dynamic environment.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute\* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Perform complex conceptual analyses and data mining across large enterprise datasets to extract actionable business insights
  • Design, build, and maintain automated reporting dashboards and visualization solutions for key stakeholders
  • Collaborate with business leaders, product teams, and technical teams to define metrics, reporting requirements, and data specifications
  • Conduct data validation, profiling, and quality checks to ensure data integrity and accuracy across all outputs
  • Write and optimize complex SQL queries and analytical scripts to aggregate and process multi-source data efficiently
  • Translate quantitative insights into strategic recommendations and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or quantitative analytics roles
  • 3+ years of experience writing complex SQL queries for data extraction, manipulation, and performance optimization
  • 2+ years of experience creating interactive dashboards and business reports using BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)
  • 2+ years of experience working with enterprise relational databases or cloud data warehouses
  • Demonstrated experience conducting data profiling, data validation, and root cause analysis
