job.name: Flutter Developer
job.description:
Company Description CargoClave is an AI-native Global Trade Management platform built to simplify, automate, and connect every stage of international trade. The company replaces fragmented tools and manual paperwork with a single intelligent platform for importers, exporters, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and fleet operators. CargoClave provides document intelligence, shipment visibility, freight and fleet management, compliance automation, and AI agents that enable autonomous workflows across the supply chain. Backed by decades of logistics expertise and modern enterprise software experience, the team focuses on building solutions that are AI-first rather than retrofitted onto legacy systems. CargoClave is headquartered in Delhi, India and builds products for global customers.
Role Description This is a full-time, hybrid Flutter Developer role based in Delhi, India, with flexibility for partial work from home. The Flutter Developer will design, build, and maintain cross-platform mobile applications that integrate with CargoClave’s AI-powered trade management platform. Day-to-day responsibilities include writing clean and efficient Dart code, implementing responsive UI/UX, integrating RESTful APIs and back-end services, and ensuring application performance, reliability, and security. The role involves collaborating with product managers, designers, and back-end engineers to translate requirements into scalable features, as well as participating in code reviews, testing, debugging, and continuous improvement of the mobile stack. The Flutter Developer will also contribute to technical documentation and help optimize development workflows and best practices.
Qualifications

  • Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
  • Proficiency in Software Development and Programming, with hands-on experience in Dart and mobile application development using Flutter.
  • Experience with Back-End Web Development and integration of RESTful APIs or microservices into mobile applications.
  • Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and their practical application in production code.
  • Experience building and deploying Flutter apps for Android and iOS, including state management (e.g., Provider, Bloc, Riverpod) and modular architecture.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and collaborative development workflows.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and basic understanding of security best practices for mobile and web applications.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid environment, communicate clearly with cross-functional teams, and take ownership of features from concept to release.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in logistics, supply chain, or B2B SaaS products is a plus.

job.name: Network & Infrastructure Security Analyst
job.description:
Network & Infrastructure Security Analyst (AI Training) About The Role Your hands-on security experience is more valuable than you might think — not just in the SOC, but in shaping the next generation of AI. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models. We're looking for experienced infrastructure and network security practitioners to help us do that by analyzing real-world security scenarios, classifying incidents, and evaluating how threats and controls interact in production environments.

This is a unique opportunity to apply deep technical expertise in a high-impact, flexible contract role — and directly influence how AI understands enterprise security.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Analyze network, endpoint, and email security scenarios drawn from modern enterprise environments
  • Review firewall, EDR, and infrastructure security cases to determine root causes and failure points
  • Classify incidents, misconfigurations, and control failures based on real operational data
  • Create, label, and validate security datasets used to train and evaluate AI systems
  • Translate complex security issues into clear, structured explanations of root cause and business impact

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in network security, infrastructure security, or endpoint security
  • Familiar with enterprise security tooling — firewalls, EDR platforms, email security, IAM, SIEMs, and more
  • Strong grasp of how real organizations deploy, operate, and fail to enforce security controls
  • Able to clearly articulate what went wrong, why it matters, and what should have happened instead
  • Self-directed and comfortable working asynchronously on task-based assignments

Nice to Have

  • Experience with incident response, threat hunting, or security operations
  • Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or vulnerability management
  • Familiarity with AI systems, data labeling, or security research
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CEH, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent

Why Join Us

  • Work on frontier AI projects alongside top research labs and security teams
  • Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work at your own pace
  • Freelance autonomy with the backing of a globally collaborative team
  • Contribute to meaningful work that makes AI safer and more security-aware
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension based on performance

job.name: Offensive Security Analyst (Structured / Non-Exploit)
job.description:
About The Role What if your offensive security expertise could directly shape how AI understands and reasons about real-world cyber threats? We're looking for experienced security professionals to analyze adversarial attack paths, model threat behavior, and help train the frontier AI systems that will define how the world thinks about cybersecurity.

This role is not about writing exploits — it's about the strategic, analytical layer that makes offensive security genuinely hard: understanding how attacks unfold, where defenses break down, and how risk cascades through modern environments. Your knowledge becomes the ground truth that makes AI smarter about security.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Analyze realistic attack paths, kill chains, and adversary strategies across modern infrastructure
  • Classify weaknesses, misconfigurations, and defensive gaps with clear, structured reasoning
  • Review red-team-style scenarios and intrusion narratives for accuracy, completeness, and impact
  • Generate, label, and validate adversarial reasoning data used to train and evaluate AI systems
  • Articulate how attacks unfold, what they impact, and what tradeoffs defenders face
  • Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

  • 2+ years in pentesting, red team operations, or a blue-team role with deep, hands-on attack knowledge
  • You understand how real attacks unfold in production environments — not just theory
  • You can clearly explain attack chains, lateral movement, and business impact to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Naturally analytical and detail-oriented — you think in systems and see where things break
  • Strong written communicator who can document complex scenarios with precision and clarity
  • No prior AI experience required

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, or STRIDE
  • Experience with cloud environments, Active Directory attacks, or modern application security
  • Background in threat intelligence, purple team exercises, or security architecture review
  • Certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GPEN, or similar — helpful but not required

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside leading AI research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
  • Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work
  • Apply your offensive security expertise in a uniquely high-impact, non-destructive context
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

job.name: Identity & Access Management (IAM) Analyst
job.description:
Identity & Access Management (IAM) Analyst (AI Training) About The Role Identity is at the core of most modern security failures — and the AI systems of tomorrow need to understand exactly how and why. We're looking for experienced IAM professionals to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models on real-world identity and access control scenarios.

Your expertise will directly shape how AI reasons about privilege escalation, zero-trust design, and enterprise access risk. This is a unique opportunity to apply your security knowledge to one of the most consequential technology challenges of our time.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Analyze realistic IAM, SSO, and access control scenarios to identify weaknesses and misconfigurations
  • Classify permission issues, privilege escalation paths, and identity-related failures
  • Review zero-trust models and access design decisions, providing structured expert feedback
  • Generate and validate realistic identity security data used to train and evaluate AI systems
  • Help AI understand how identity failures occur and how attackers exploit them in practice

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with IAM, SSO, or enterprise identity platforms
  • Solid understanding of RBAC, least-privilege principles, and access review processes

  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently on asynchronous, task-based assignments

Nice to Have

  • Experience with platforms such as Okta, Azure AD, AWS IAM, or SailPoint
  • Familiarity with frameworks like NIST, SOC 2, or Zero Trust Architecture
  • Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or identity-focused threat modeling
  • Prior involvement in AI, data labeling, or security research projects

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI systems with leading AI research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — set your own schedule and hours
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with a global expert community
  • Make a meaningful impact on how AI understands and reasons about enterprise security
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

job.description:
Meet The Team Team: Mass-Scale Infrastructure Group (MIG) – Platform Forwarding

You will join the MIG Platform Forwarding team, the engine room behind the world’s most robust service provider networks. We build the high-performance data plane software that powers IOS-XR platforms, using innovative Silicon One (SiOne) Network Processing Units (NPUs).

Our team operates at the intersection of hardware and software, defining how packets traverse the internet's backbone. We are transitioning into a new era of embedded development, using modern AI-assisted methodologies to deliver features faster and with higher quality.

Your Impact As a Software Engineer, you will focus on the hands-on design, coding, and optimization of our forwarding software. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality code for complex L2 /L3 forwarding featurfeatures,uring they extract maximum performance from our NPUs. You will act as a key technical contributor, using modern software practices and AI-driven workflows to streamline development and debugging.

Responsibilities Feature Design & Implementation : Be responsible for the design and development of specific forwarding features within the IOS-XR platform. Write high-performance, production-grade code for QOS, Mirroring, Slowpath, OAM, Layer 2 (EVPN, VPLS) and Layer 3 (SRv6, Segment Routing, MPLS) technologies.

NPU Data Plane Programming: Implement data plane logic to optimize packet processing. Translate network protocol requirements into efficient NPU microcode and SDK interactions.

Debugging & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate and resolve complex software defects found during internal testing or customer deployments. Analyze logs, core dumps, and packet traces to distinguish between NPU behavior and software logic issues.

Performance Optimization: Profile and tune code to minimize latency and enhance throughput, ensuring the software meets strict service provider performance metrics.

Modern Development Practices: Actively use AI/LLM-based tools for code generation, unit test creation, and static analysis to improve individual efficiency and code quality.

Requirements Embedded Development: Strong proficiency in C/C++ for high-performance embedded systems. Proficiency in Python for scripting and test automation.

NPU Familiarity:NPU-based data plane architectures (e.g., Broadcom DNX, Silicon One, or ezChip). Understanding of pipelining, table management, and packet processing flows.

Forwarding Protocols (L2/L3): Strong understanding and implementation experience in Qos, Mirroring, OAM , Layer 2 (EVPN, VPLS) or Layer 3 routing (SRv6, Segment Routing, MPLS, IPv4/v6). Implementation experience with TE-Tunnels, GRE tunnels, BFD, BGP Flowspec, ACLs, or Slowpath forwarding mechanisms.

Network Knowledge & Debugging Service Provider Context: Understanding of router deployments in Service Provider networks (Core, Peering).

job.name: Senior AWS Cloud Security Engineer (Part-Time Contract, Fintech)
job.description:
Scalable Path is looking for a part-time Senior AWS Cloud Security Engineer to join the team. This is a remote, part-time (20 hours/week) position.

Own the security of a fintech platform from day one. A well-backed New York startup is building a loan origination and automated underwriting platform from scratch, and they need a senior AWS security engineer to design and guard its control surface.

This is a part-time contract: about 20 hours a week for the first three months while accounts, identity, keys, and CI gates are set up, then a few hours a week after that.

Why this role is interesting

  • Greenfield: you design the AWS organization, IAM, and key management from the start, instead of cleaning up someone else’s setup
  • You work directly with the technical co-founder, with no layers in between
  • The team is AI-first: AI writes most of the code and infrastructure, and you’re the independent reviewer who decides what’s safe to ship
  • A part-time schedule that can work alongside other commitments
  • A long-term engagement of 12+ months

What you’ll own

  • AWS Organization design: account structure, guardrails, SSO, and a pipeline-only path to production
  • IAM for a remote contractor team: least privilege per person, short-lived credentials, secrets in vaults, and 2FA everywhere
  • Tenancy and encryption: per-tenant KMS keys and an audit trail of who did what
  • Security gates in CI: policy checks on CDK changes, dependency and secret scanning, and sign-off on infrastructure changes
  • Reviewing AI-generated infrastructure and security-relevant code, including CDK in TypeScript, auth, and data access
  • Securing the AI features: prompt injection, kill switches, and logging
  • Keeping evidence along the way, so a future SOC 2 audit can start from a running system

What we’re looking for

  • Senior cloud or platform security experience with deep AWS: Organizations, IAM, KMS, SSO, VPC, and CloudTrail
  • You’ve designed multi-account AWS setups, not just worked inside one
  • Infrastructure as code experience, ideally CDK in TypeScript
  • Practical knowledge of SOC 2-style controls: reviewed pipelines, access reviews, and audit logging
  • Comfortable reviewing code and infrastructure you didn’t write, including AI-generated changes

Nice to have

  • Fintech, lending, or regulated-data experience
  • Multi-tenant SaaS security
  • Securing LLM-powered features
  • GitHub Actions hardening or Temporal Cloud

Details

  • Part-time contract: about 20 hours a week for 3 months, then a few hours a week
  • Remote, with a few hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time
  • 12+ months, likely ongoing

Position Description

CGI is seeking a Senior Cloud Systems Architect to lead the implementation of established cloud strategies, architecture standards and target-state roadmaps. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer and Enterprise Architecture function, you will translate approved architecture principles into secure, scalable and resilient cloud solutions.

This senior, hands-on role combines architecture delivery, technical leadership and mentorship. You will collaborate with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, application development, operations and vendor teams to modernize workloads, strengthen cloud capabilities and support sustainable technology delivery

  • Lead the implementation of cloud strategies, target-state architectures, standards, governance guardrails and roadmaps, contributing improvements based on delivery experience.

  • Lead complex workload migration and modernization initiatives, aligning implementation approaches with business requirements, architecture direction and operational readiness.
  • Integrate security, risk, compliance, cost management and DevSecOps controls into cloud services, delivery pipelines and operational practices.
  • Improve service reliability through monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, resiliency, recovery and sustainable support models.
  • Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to clarify requirements, evaluate solution options, communicate trade-offs and maintain alignment throughout implementation.
  • Develop and deliver architecture presentations, recommendations and decision materials for executives, governance forums, project teams and vendors.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship and escalation support to architects, engineers and delivery teams, resolving complex design and implementation challenges.
  • Maintain solution designs, implementation guidance, support models and operational documentation to enable consistent delivery and long-term ownership.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

job.name: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Job Description At Icertis, we’re transforming how enterprises manage contracts by applying AI to make them more intelligent, actionable, and impactful across the business.

With the acquisition of Dioptra, we are accelerating this vision by integrating advanced AI agents that fundamentally change how contracts are reviewed, analyzed, and understood. Together, Icertis and Dioptra are delivering an AI-first contracting experience used by some of the world’s largest and most complex enterprises.

Responsibilities On this team, you’ll:

  • Report directly with Dioptra’s founders as part of a small, highly focused product and engineering group
  • Build and evolve front-end experiences that bring powerful AI capabilities to life for end users
  • Design intuitive, high-quality interfaces used by global enterprises such as Microsoft, Johnson & Johnson, and Mercedes-Benz
  • Have meaningful ownership and influence over the user experience and product direction
  • Join the enterprise legal technology market at a pivotal moment, with the opportunity to shape how AI is applied at scale

Qualifications Contracts are still processed by hand, even though the work touching them — ERP, CLM, email, Slack/Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel, procurement systems — spans a dozen disconnected tools. Most of the effort in contracting isn't judgment or drafting; it's gluing those systems together.

Dioptra is building Contract OS : an agentic platform that does that gluing for you. Agents draft, negotiate, and review pre-signature; extract, monitor, and operationalize post-signature; and execute workflows across every system a contract touches — turning contracts from documents people process into live objects agents operate. We work deep inside the enterprise contracting stack (Icertis, SAP, SharePoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams), which means real technical depth, real enterprise customers, and a market that's actively shifting toward AI-native tooling in real time.

We're a small, technical team that ships fast and holds a high bar. This is a founding-level seat with direct access to the founders and real ownership from day one.

What You'll Own You'll be our first Site Reliability Engineer and own production across five areas.

job.name: AI Cybersecurity Engineering Lead, Director
job.description:
About This Role The Aladdin Platform Engineering – Engineering Services team builds the platforms, pipelines, and developer tooling that thousands of engineers across BlackRock use every day to design, build, and ship software. Security is engineered into that path rather than inspected at the end of it: the same teams that own build systems, artifact repositories, and deployment pipelines also own the guardrails, evidence, and automated controls that make secure delivery the default.

You will lead the cybersecurity engineering function inside this group, working alongside platform engineering, product management, risk, and the firm’s information security organization to protect a large, cloud-native, AI-enabled, highly regulated financial services firm.

Your role and impact As Director for Cybersecurity Engineering, you’ll set the technical strategy for how security is built into software delivery and cloud infrastructure at scale. Software supply chain integrity is your first principle: every artifact the firm ships should carry verifiable provenance, and every release should be attested — signed, traceable to its source and build environment, and admissible as evidence without anyone assembling it after the fact. You’ll lead BlackRock toward that future state, moving the organization from periodic inspection of what was built to continuous, cryptographic proof of how it was built, with trust decisions made against attestations rather than assumptions.

You’ll treat DevSecOps as the operating principle that makes this achievable — policy as code, automated enforcement in continuous integration and delivery pipelines, and time-boxed exceptions with audit-ready evidence generated automatically. You’ll extend that same provenance and trust model to AI-assisted development and agentic workflows, where model-generated code, prompt injection, and non-human identities create new classes of exposure and demand policy-driven defense in depth.

Your Responsibilities No matter your role at BlackRock, you’ll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, stay curious and adaptable as the business evolves, and take end-to-end ownership of outcomes that matter to clients. job.name: Senior Java Developer (AI React Legacy Modernization)
job.description:
REMOTE OPTION IS AVAILABLE

NO FRESHER WILL BE PREFERRED

We are looking for Senior Java Developer (AI React Legacy Modernization) as a Full Time for our IT Company.

Location- Remote

Experience- 5+ years

Budget- As per company standard

Notice Period- Immediate Joiner

Java (Java EE / Spring Boot), React (TypeScript), Relational Databases, Legacy System Modernization, AI Coding Tools, LLM API Integration, End-to-End Feature Ownership, Engineering Mentorship.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our product engineering team. You will work on the products that help our customers run and use their real estate:

Projects, maintenance, and sustainability: capital projects and bidding, preventive and reactive maintenance, and energy & sustainability.

Space and workplace: space management, occupancy, reservations, and visitor management.

The role

These products sit on a mature Java and Oracle platform that customers rely on every day. We are now moving that platform onto a modern React front end and clean APIs, one workflow at a time.

You deliver features on your own within a team. You take a story or a less well-defined task, break it into steps, build it in Java and React, and get it to production without close oversight. You keep the features you ship running, including on-call support for your team's systems. Senior engineers on the team set the technical direction for larger initiatives. You make that direction real, and you start to shape it.

This is not a greenfield role. Most of the system is legacy Java EE with a JSF/ADF front end, and you will spend real time in it alongside the new React work. If you want to learn how a large, revenue-earning system gets modernized, this is a good place to do it.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver features independently

Take features from a documented spec to production in Java and React, with steady progress and no close oversight.

Break large requests into subtasks. Estimate stories and help shape sprint plans.

Spot blockers early and act before they slow the team down.

Build on both sides of the stack

Build React and TypeScript screens on Holocron, Tango's shared design system, as legacy Oracle ADF/JSF screens are replaced.

Build and extend the Java services and APIs (Spring Boot and Java EE) behind those screens, and fix defects in the legacy code.

Think before you code. Talk through design ideas with the team in a whiteboard session or a short RFC.

Own quality and operations for your work

Write tests and meet the team's quality bar with less help from senior engineers over time.

Give useful code reviews with specific, actionable feedback.

Provide on-call and operational support for the systems your team owns. Apply basic security practice: permissions, input validation, and common vulnerabilities.

Work across functions

State your assumptions, clarify tasks up front, and flag problems with requirements.

job.name: Lead Data Engineer – Lakehouse & Analytics Platform
job.description:
What you’ll do

  • Stand up AWS foundations for the UK and Ireland in Terraform: accounts, S3, Glue Iceberg catalog, and Lake Formation permissions.
  • Build change-data-capture pipelines from microservice databases with AWS DMS, landing directly into the lakehouse.
  • Load external sources including PostHog product analytics and public property datasets such as Price Paid, EPC, BER, and PPR.
  • Model bronze, silver, and gold layers in dbt, including incremental marts, SCD2 history, and tests.
  • Mask and minimise personal data, and enforce row- and column-level access for internal and agency users.
  • Deliver the first internal KPI dashboards and the first embedded, tenant-isolated agency dashboard.
  • Set up orchestration, data quality alerting, CI/CD, and Iceberg table maintenance.
  • Agree KPI definitions with product and business teams, pushing back where needed.
  • Set engineering standards, then help hire and mentor the data team as it grows.

Tech environment

The target stack is set, but you will have a real say in final choices.

LayerTechnology

Ingestion

AWS DMS (full load + CDC), scheduled batch loaders, PostHog batch exports

Storage

Amazon S3 + Apache Iceberg, AWS Glue catalog

Governance

AWS Lake Formation, IAM, two AWS regions (London, Ireland)

Transformation

dbt Core on Amazon Athena

Orchestration

Dagster or Amazon MWAA (Airflow)

BI

Amazon Quick Sight with embedded dashboards and tag-based row-level security

Engineering

Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD, Python, SQL

What you’ll bring

  • Around 6–9 years in data engineering, with at least 2–3 years building modern lakehouse or dbt platforms hands-on.
  • Production AWS data experience: S3, DMS, Glue, Lake Formation, and IAM—ideally across more than one region or account.
  • Production experience with Apache Iceberg (or Delta/Hudi): table design, partitioning, compaction, and snapshot expiry.
  • Deep dbt experience: incremental models, snapshots, tests, and keeping a growing project tidy.
  • Excellent SQL and solid Python.
  • Terraform (or similar) and CI/CD for data projects.
  • Hands-on experience with an orchestrator such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect.
  • Experience building change-data-capture pipelines from operational databases such as Postgres or MySQL.
  • Practical GDPR knowledge: personal data masking, data residency, and least-privilege access.
  • Confidence working with stakeholders and turning business questions into clear KPI definitions.
  • A track record of building something from zero, not only maintaining it.

What you bring

  • At least 8 years of relevant experience.
  • Hands-on MDM development experience and practical experience reading and extracting data from MDM tables.
  • Strong SQL coding and database-querying skills.
  • SAP MDM experience and a good understanding of SAP tables and fields.
  • Practical ETL or ELT, Databricks and Python or PySpark experience.
  • Experience in data quality, data validation and reconciliation across different sources.
  • Ability to translate data-quality requirements into technical SQL or Python logic.
  • Experience testing data-quality rules, investigating defects and troubleshooting discrepancies.
  • Degree-level education.

Nice to have

The ICB Risk Modelling team develops statistical and machine learning models to reduce fraud and credit risk within ICB. The team also engages with external vendors and supports the onboarding of vendor models, working through Model Governance to obtain the appropriate approvals for different uses. The team conducts model surveillance and provides insights to support regulatory requirements.

As an AI/ML Associate in the ICB Risk Modelling team, you will analyse business problems, develop and manage in-house machine learning models, and support the onboarding and management of vendor models to mitigate fraud and credit risk within ICB. You will work closely with product owners, risk officers, data engineers and software engineers, and collaborate with external vendors where needed, to ensure models are developed and managed in line with the firm's standards and perform effectively.

We are looking for someone with a strong foundation in statistics, machine learning and data analysis, who can understand and support the strategic objectives of large, complex organisations and work effectively within their data landscapes.

job.name: GFCC Detect/Report Specialist - IV (Transaction Monitoring)
job.description:
Job Description The GFCC Alert Triage position is part of the firm's India AML Alert Triage team within AML Investigations. The Triage team dispositions alerts consistent with the Global AML Standards, provides an initial assessment of potential Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing as well as other nefarious activity and recommends alerts for escalation and further review or closure as false positives

Responsibilities

  • Collect and document data, including: alerting activity, account information, transactional data, KYC information, politically exposed person (PEP) status, adverse media as well as counterparty and any other required information to assist in the investigation
  • Review and analyze underlying data gathered opposite Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Terrorist Financing (TF), Human Trafficking and other red flags to assess whether the alert should be recommended for escalation or to be closed with no further action
  • Fully document all alerts, including supporting data, analysis as well as escalation or close recommendation rationale within the case management system in a timely manner and consistent with the firm's quality standards
  • Build relationships with AML Investigations units and effectively communicate and transfer information for case investigations
  • Collaborate with India and US colleagues to share processing and AML knowledge to enhance AML Investigation process flows
  • Process work items in the order of priority and aligned with SLA priorities. Escalate issues in a timely manner and demonstrate courage and integrity by doing the right thing all the time.
  • In conjunction with manager and consistent with overall department objectives, establish and execute on annual development goals. You would participate in special projects, quality improvement initiatives and other similar exercises

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Qualified graduate with 2 to 6 years' of relevant experience in Global Financial Crime Compliance
  • Familiarity with the firm's internal systems and processes or similar processes at other institutions, and proficiency in MS Office (Outlook/Word/Excel/PowerPoint)
  • You are a self-starter, capable of working under minimum supervision, able to multi-task and meet deadlines in high-pressure environment
  • You are a result-oriented team player with strong problem solving ability.
  • You have exceptional research and analytical skills with the ability to analyze large amounts of data, decipher higher risk attributes (transactional, geographical, product, customer type, etc.) and develop well-reasoned recommendations and strong documentation skills to clearly articulate alert disposition
  • You are adaptable to change and demonstrate strong interpersonal and verbal/written communication skills.
  • You adhere to and standards, controls and policy.

Read the full description

Job Description- Manager Strategy and Operations

Work Location: Hyderabad

We are looking for a high-impact Manager Strategy & Operations to work closely with the Founders Office and leadership team. This role will drive strategic initiatives, solve critical business problems, and ensure execution across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced B2C startup environment.

job.name: Project Coordinator - Home Care
job.description:
Position Summary:

The Project Coordinator - Home Care Program will be responsible for the end-to-end management, monitoring, growth, and quality assurance of Sparsh's home-based palliative care services. The role will ensure effective implementation of projects, achievement of program goals, optimal utilization of resources, and expansion of services to reach more patients in need.

The position requires a professional who can combine project management, operations, stakeholder engagement, team coordination, data-driven decision-making, and strategic growth planning.

Key Responsibilities:

Program Management & Operations

  • Lead the planning, implementation, and day-to-day operations of home care services.
  • Coordinate with doctors, nurses, counsellors, volunteers, and support staff to ensure seamless patient care.
  • Monitor service delivery, patient coverage, and operational efficiency across all home-care units.
  • Ensure adherence to clinical protocols, organizational policies, and quality standards.
  • Manage patient intake, referrals, service allocation, and continuity of care.

Monitoring, Evaluation & Reporting

  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) including patient enrolment, home visits, symptom management outcomes, caregiver support, and patient satisfaction.
  • Maintain project dashboards, MIS reports, and data tracking systems which is there in the system.
  • Analyze program performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reports for management and donor partners.
  • Support impact assessment and documentation of patient stories, case studies, and outcomes.

Donor Funded & Subsidised Project Management

job.name: Manager AI Governance
job.description:
We are seeking an AI Governance & Control Architecture professional to establish, implement, and mature the organization's AI governance framework, ensuring the responsible, secure, compliant, and ethical use of Artificial Intelligence across the enterprise. The role will be responsible for defining AI governance policies, standards, risk management processes, and control frameworks aligned with business objectives and emerging regulatory requirements. Candidates should have hands-on experience in AI governance framework design and deployment, AI risk assessments, model governance, regulatory compliance, privacy-by-design, security controls, and lifecycle management of AI/GenAI solutions.

The ideal candidate will work closely with business, technology, data science, security, risk, legal, and privacy teams to embed governance controls throughout the AI lifecycle, including model development, deployment, monitoring, explainability, bias management, data governance, and third-party AI risk management. Experience in implementing governance frameworks aligned with ISO 42001, NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), Responsible AI principles, and AI control assurance programs is highly desirable. For L3-G8, the role includes leading enterprise AI governance initiatives, defining control architectures, conducting AI governance assessments, and driving organization-wide adoption of responsible AI practices.

Preferred Certifications: ISO 42001 Lead Implementer (Mandatory/Highly Preferred), ISO 42001 Lead Auditor, Certified AI Governance Professional (AIGP), CDPSE, CISM, CISSP, or equivalent certifications.

Experience: L3 (6-10+ years) in AI Governance, Risk & Compliance, Security Architecture, Data Governance, Privacy, or AI/ML Governance programs

Job Description Assume a critical role in defining the future of a globally recognized firm and have a direct and significant effect in a realm tailored for top achievers in site reliability.

As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you hold a leadership role in your team, demonstrate strong knowledge across multiple technical domains, and advise others on the technical and business issues facing them. Take lead and conduct resiliency design reviews, break up complex problems into digestible work for other engineers, act as a technical lead for medium to large-sized products, and provide advice and mentoring to other engineers.

Job Responsibilities

  • Consistently models and champions site reliability culture and practices, documents and shares knowledge within your organization via internal forums and communities of practice
  • Lead the design, development and delivery of the automation platform for the Global ESX Infrastructure SRE team's VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF 5.x / VCF 9) estate, covering vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, vSAN and NSX, as development lead engineer and SME
  • Own the automation codebase and engineering standards across the full SDLC, including requirements, design reviews, Git branching, peer code review, automated testing, static analysis, secure coding, CI/CD, versioning, release notes and controlled promotion from lab to production
  • Develop secure, high-quality, maintainable Python code (pyVmomi, vSphere Automation SDK, SDDC Manager / VCF and NSX REST APIs), and review and debug code written by others
  • Build reusable frameworks, Infrastructure as Code and self-service workflows (VCF / Aria Automation and Orchestrator, Terraform, Ansible) that automate provisioning, patching through vLCM / SDDC Manager, configuration drift remediation, resource optimization, compliance, health checks and reporting
  • Design safe automation based on VMware virtualization (HA/DRS, vMotion, vSAN, maintenance mode, vLCM), with pre/post validation, idempotency, automated testing, rollback and runbooks, and make sure every change follows ITIL change management with traceability and audit evidence
  • Build observability and self-healing patterns into automation and platform tooling by correlating vCenter events, VCF Operations, VCF Operations for Logs and out-of-band (iLO/iDRAC) telemetry, and work with stakeholders to define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets
  • Serve as SME, main point of contact and escalation point during major incidents, use enterprise-authorized AI and analysis of past incidents to speed up triage and RCA, and drive problem management to closure through preventive automation
  • Mentor engineers on software engineering and SDLC practices, work with SRE, platform engineering and application teams to prioritize the automation backlog, lead performance testing and evaluation of new tools, and promote reuse-first adoption of AI-assisted reliability workflows with appropriate

job.name: Applied Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning- Markets Operations - Vice President
job.description:
Job Description As an Applied AI & ML Lead in the Market Operations team, you will drive the design and delivery of AI agents and ML solutions that enhance and transform Market Operations. You will lead a team of scientists and engineers, partner with business stakeholders and technology leaders, and ensure the successful implementation and scaling of AI-driven tools. You will identify opportunities, set technical direction, and deliver measurable impact by automating and augmenting complex operational workflows with reliable, auditable agents.

Job Responsibilities

  • Agent Development and Delivery

+ Lead the end-to-end design, development, and delivery of LLM-based agents and advanced ML models for Market Operations.
+ Design and own the agent harness: orchestration loop, tool and API interfaces, context and memory management, multi-agent coordination, human-in-the-loop escalation, and guardrails.

  • Evals and Prompt Improvement

+ Build and run the evaluation program for agents: task-level benchmarks built from real operational cases, regression gates in CI, and online monitoring tied to business outcomes.
+ Lead systematic prompt and program improvement using automated optimization techniques (e.g., GEPA, DSPy, AutoPrompt), driven by execution traces and failure analysis.

  • Scalable AI/ML Architecture & Deployment

+ Partner with AI Engineering to design scalable agent and model serving on cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, Bedrock/SageMaker), with orchestration, model gateway routing, versioned prompt/model registries, sandboxed tool execution, and rollouts gated by eval regressions.
+ Define and enforce SLOs for task success, latency, and cost per task, using distributed tracing, caching, and tiered model routing to meet them.

  • Team Management & Mentorship following Agile Practices

+ Lead and mentor a team of AI/ML data scientists, guiding iterative experimentation and tracking progress to deliver measurable outcomes in an agile manner.

  • Drive Model Methodology Documentation

+ Champion documentation of methodologies, results, and best practices for knowledge sharing

  • Execution Excellence and Stakeholder Engagement

+ Align design and delivery across partner teams to maintain execution velocity, and drive clarity on prerequisites for AI/ML development.

We're looking for Lean 4 Proof Engineers to translate advanced mathematical arguments into machine-verifiable formalizations — working at the absolute frontier of what proof assistants can express, capture, and automate.

  • Translate informal mathematical proofs into Lean 4 (and related proof systems) with an emphasis on clarity, correctness, and structure

  • Construct formalizations that test and extend the limits of existing proof assistants, especially where automation breaks down
  • Investigate why automated provers fail — complexity barriers, missing lemmas, insufficient libraries — and articulate those failure modes clearly
  • Develop highly readable, reproducible proof scripts aligned with mathematical best practices and Lean idioms
  • Collaborate with AI researchers to design and refine strategies for improving formal verification pipelines
  • Create Lean proofs that reveal deeper patterns or generalizations implicit in the original mathematics

Who You Are

  • Hold a Master's degree or higher in Mathematics, Logic, Theoretical Computer Science, or a closely related field

  • Have hands-on experience with Lean (Lean 3 or Lean 4), Coq, Isabelle/HOL, Agda, or a comparable formal proof system — Lean 4 strongly preferred
  • Genuinely excited about formal verification, proof assistants, and the future of mechanized mathematics
  • Able to translate dense, informal mathematical arguments into clean, structured, machine-checkable proofs
  • Self-directed and comfortable working independently in an asynchronous remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with type theory, the Curry-Howard correspondence, and proof automation tools

The ideal candidate should have deep hands-on experience with Python, SQL, PySpark, Apache Spark and AWS data services, along with the ability to troubleshoot complex workloads and improve pipeline performance, reliability and cost efficiency.

The role requires a technically strong individual contributor who can work independently with clients and engineering teams, provide technical guidance, and deliver reliable data foundations for analytics and AI-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using AWS services.
  • Build reusable data engineering components using Python, SQL and PySpark.
  • Optimise complex SQL queries, Spark jobs and distributed data processing workloads.
  • Analyse Spark execution plans, data skew, shuffle operations, memory utilisation and resource consumption.
  • Improve partitioning, file sizing, compression, caching and join strategies.
  • Tune AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, Amazon Athena and other AWS processing services.
  • Implement automated testing, data validation, monitoring, exception handling and recovery mechanisms.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive solutions.
  • Establish performance benchmarks and measure improvements in runtime, throughput and cloud costs.
  • Apply data modelling, metadata management, security and governance best practices.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks and engineering standards.
  • Mentor engineers and collaborate with clients, platform teams and business stakeholders.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in AWS data engineering: S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena and Lambda.
  • Advanced SQL with strong query optimisation and troubleshooting skills.
  • Proficiency in Python and PySpark.
  • Strong knowledge of Apache Spark and distributed data processing.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow or equivalent orchestration tools.
  • Understanding of data lakes, lakehouse architectures, data warehouses and dimensional modelling.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing and production support.
  • Practical experience in performance optimisation of large-scale data pipelines.

Good to Have

  • Apache Kafka and/or Amazon Kinesis.
  • Amazon Bedrock, LLMs, embeddings and vector databases.
  • Excel/CSV ingestion, template-driven processing and schema evolution.
  • Experience with columnar formats such as Parquet and Iceberg.

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication, comprehension and articulation skills.
  • Ability to work independently as a technical consultant and individual contributor.
  • Strong stakeholder management, persuasion and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to guide, mentor and inspire engineering teams.
  • Strong ownership, analytical thinking and client-facing capabilities.

job.name: Data Architect
job.description:
Role Description: The Data Architect will design and evolve the enterprise data architecture behind our financial crime and risk AI applications, making sure data systems are scalable, reliable and aligned with business, regulatory and AI requirements. This is a hands-on role: you will own model and platform design, build and tune at scale, and use AI tools to deliver faster.

You will design a canonical enterprise data model shared by many applications, define data standards, and work with engineering and product teams to build robust lakehouse and relational pipelines that handle billion-row tables and tens of millions of new records a day. You will choose the right mix of relational, lakehouse, graph, search and vector stores, and keep them consistent. You will set and enforce data governance practices in regulated, multi-tenant environments, optimise data flows for analytics, machine learning and AI agents, and troubleshoot data issues across environments. You will also evaluate new tools and technologies, record architecture decisions, contribute to best practices, and support strategic data initiatives that improve our products and customer outcomes.

Qualification

  • 8-10 years in data engineering or data architecture, including 3+ years designing data models for enterprise-scale production systems.
  • Strong data architecture and data modeling skills: dimensional, normalised and Data Vault patterns, grain definition, key strategy, and canonical models shared across applications.
  • Expertise in managing history and change: SCD Type 2, bitemporal modeling, data versioning and fingerprinting (including CDC), and idempotent loads.
  • Hands-on data warehousing, lakehouse and ETL/ELT experience with Apache Spark (PySpark), Apache Iceberg, PostgreSQL and Kafka, supporting analytics and AI workloads.
  • Performance optimisation at scale: partitioning, skew mitigation, join optimisation, file sizing, query plan analysis and index tuning.
  • Working knowledge of graph (Neo4j, NebulaGraph or Apache AGE), search (OpenSearch) and vector (pgvector) stores, and when to use each.
  • Data governance skills covering data quality, lineage, metadata, data policies, security and compliance in regulated environments.
  • Experience designing cloud-agnostic data solutions (AWS, GCP or Azure) with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Advanced SQL and Python, with DataOps practices (Git, CI/CD).
  • AI-assisted engineering: daily use of AI coding agents, prompt and context engineering, agentic workflows with human oversight, and designing AI-ready data (embeddings, knowledge graphs, retrieval).
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, communicate complex data concepts clearly, and work in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Java Full Stack Developer (React AI Legacy Modernization)
job.description:
REMOTE OPTION IS AVAILABLE

NO FRESHER WILL BE PREFERRED

We are looking for Senior Java Full Stack Developer (React AI Legacy Modernization) as a Full Time for our IT Company.

Location- Remote

Experience- 5+ years

Budget- As per company standard

Notice Period- Immediate Joiner

Java (Java EE / Spring Boot), React (TypeScript), Relational Databases, Legacy System Modernization, AI Coding Tools, LLM API Integration, End-to-End Feature Ownership, Engineering Mentorship.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our product engineering team. You will work on the products that help our customers run and use their real estate:

  • Projects, maintenance, and sustainability: capital projects and bidding, preventive and reactive maintenance, and energy & sustainability.
  • Space and workplace: space management, occupancy, reservations, and visitor management.

The role

These products sit on a mature Java and Oracle platform that customers rely on every day. We are now moving that platform onto a modern React front end and clean APIs, one workflow at a time.

You deliver features on your own within a team. You take a story or a less well-defined task, break it into steps, build it in Java and React, and get it to production without close oversight. You keep the features you ship running, including on-call support for your team's systems. Senior engineers on the team set the technical direction for larger initiatives. You make that direction real, and you start to shape it.

This is not a greenfield role. Most of the system is legacy Java EE with a JSF/ADF front end, and you will spend real time in it alongside the new React work. If you want to learn how a large, revenue-earning system gets modernized, this is a good place to do it.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver features independently

  • Take features from a documented spec to production in Java and React, with steady progress and no close oversight.
  • Break large requests into subtasks. Estimate stories and help shape sprint plans.
  • Spot blockers early and act before they slow the team down.

Build on both sides of the stack

  • Build React and TypeScript screens on Holocron, Tango's shared design system, as legacy Oracle ADF/JSF screens are replaced.
  • Build and extend the Java services and APIs (Spring Boot and Java EE) behind those screens, and fix defects in the legacy code.
  • Think before you code. Talk through design ideas with the team in a whiteboard session or a short RFC.

Own quality and operations for your work

  • Write tests and meet the team's quality bar with less help from senior engineers over time.
  • Give useful code reviews with specific, actionable feedback.

job.name: Data Engineer, Databricks
job.description:
Every day, millions of shipments move around the world on data that nobody is looking at in real time. Orders, ASNs, invoices, and tracking events flow between 3PLs, forwarders, brands, and retailers through EDI and APIs, then get flattened into a status that tells you something went wrong only after it already has.

SwiftB2B exists to change that. We are an AI operating system for global supply chains. One platform where 3PLs, freight forwarders, brands, retailers, and manufacturers can see every item, shipment, and exception as it happens. The platform does not stop at flagging a delay. It works out what the delay costs, weighs the options, and starts the fix.

We built it on 15 years of SwiftAnt’s work in supply chain and EDI technology, and on a team that has spent careers in logistics, retail, and enterprise software. We know what a late container does to a retailer’s shelf, and we know what the data underneath it looks like.

That data is where you come in. The intelligence in SwiftB2B is only as good as the pipelines feeding it. We are a Databricks partner and we are building our data platform on the lakehouse. We want engineers who understand the full breadth of Databricks, from ingestion and Delta tables through Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and Mosaic AI, and who can see how all of it applies to shipment data, customer profitability, emissions reporting, and the rest of the problems logistics companies live with.

What you will do

You will design, build, and run the data pipelines and models that power the visibility and decision-making in SwiftB2B. In practice that means:

  • Ingesting and transforming data from logistics and enterprise systems (EDI feeds, TMS/WMS exports, ERPs, carrier APIs) into analytics-ready lakehouse tables on Databricks.
  • Building and tuning ETL and ELT workflows, and modeling data for analytics, warehousing, and the AI features in the product.
  • Owning data quality end to end: validation, lineage, monitoring, and fixing production issues when they happen.
  • Working with product, engineering, and operations to turn messy supply-chain data into features customers use.
  • Improving the platform as it grows, so it keeps up with more customers, more data, and more automation.

What we are looking for

job.description:
Job Description At Icertis, we’re transforming how enterprises manage contracts by applying AI to make them more intelligent, actionable, and impactful across the business.

With the acquisition of Dioptra, we are accelerating this vision by integrating advanced AI agents that fundamentally change how contracts are reviewed, analyzed, and understood. Together, Icertis and Dioptra are delivering an AI-first contracting experience used by some of the world’s largest and most complex enterprises.

Responsibilities On this team, you’ll:

  • Report directly with Dioptra’s founders as part of a small, highly focused product and engineering group
  • Build and evolve front-end experiences that bring powerful AI capabilities to life for end users
  • Design intuitive, high-quality interfaces used by global enterprises such as Microsoft, Johnson & Johnson, and Mercedes-Benz
  • Have meaningful ownership and influence over the user experience and product direction
  • Join the enterprise legal technology market at a pivotal moment, with the opportunity to shape how AI is applied at scale

Qualifications Contracts are still processed by hand, even though the work touching them — ERP, CLM, email, Slack/Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel, procurement systems — spans a dozen disconnected tools. Most of the effort in contracting isn't judgment or drafting; it's gluing those systems together.

Dioptra is building Contract OS : an agentic platform that does that gluing for you. Agents draft, negotiate, and review pre-signature; extract, monitor, and operationalize post-signature; and execute workflows across every system a contract touches — turning contracts from documents people process into live objects agents operate. We work deep inside the enterprise contracting stack (Icertis, SAP, SharePoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams), which means real technical depth, real enterprise customers, and a market that's actively shifting toward AI-native tooling in real time.

We're a small, technical team that ships fast and holds a high bar. This is a founding-level seat with direct access to the founders and real ownership from day one.

Company Description Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s around 33,000 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Job Description Designation: Demand Planner

Location: Nerul, Navi Mumbai

Department: Supply Chain Management (SCM)

Reporting To: SCM Head / S&OP Lead

Position Purpose The Demand Planner is responsible for developing and maintaining accurate demand forecasts by integrating historical sales data, market intelligence, sales inputs, and business trends. The role acts as a key link between Sales, Marketing, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, and Finance to support the S&OP process, ensure high forecast reliability, optimize inventory levels, and proactively manage slow-moving and obsolete inventories.

Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Implementation & MRP Stabilization are Key Project to drive Process Automation.

Key Responsibilities Demand Planning & Forecasting

  • Generate, maintain, and continuously improve rolling demand forecasts at SKU, product family, and regional levels.
  • Analyze historical sales data, market trends, seasonality, and business intelligence to develop demand plans.
  • Incorporate Sales, Marketing, Key Account, and Channel inputs into the forecasting process.
  • Segment SKUs based on demand patterns and forecast ability.
  • Identify demand risks, opportunities, and forecast assumptions.
  • Support new product launch forecasting and phase-out planning.
  • Communicate forecast updates and demand changes to Supply Planning, Manufacturing, and Procurement teams.
  • Monitor forecast performance and drive continuous forecast improvement initiatives.
  • Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Implementation & MRP Stabilization are Key Project to drive Process Automation.

S&OP Process Support

  • Lead the demand review process as part of the monthly S&OP cycle.
  • Facilitate consensus demand planning with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Challenge assumptions and reconcile differences between statistical forecasts and commercial inputs.
  • Provide demand scenarios and sensitivity analysis to support management decision-making.

Inventory Management

job.name: Health Policy & Management
job.description:
Health Policy & Management - AI Data Trainer

  • Location: Remote

About The Job At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models.

We are seeking Masters in Public Health (MPH) graduates to help train AI models to provide accurate, evidence-based health information and policy analysis. You will challenge Large Language Models on their understanding of population health, biostatistics, and global health equity—ensuring that the models prioritize scientific consensus and ethical health guidelines. Work on high-impact projects while earning $35+/hour, fully remote, with flexible weekly hours.

Organization : Alignerr Position : Health Policy & Management - AI Data Trainer Type : Hourly Contract Compensation : $35–$55 /hour Location : Remote Commitment : 10–40 hours/week

What You’ll Do

  • Develop Complex Problems: Design advanced public health scenarios involving disease outbreak simulations, health equity assessments, and statistical interpretation of clinical trials.
  • Author Ground-Truth Solutions: Create rigorous, step-by-step responses that synthesize peer-reviewed research, epidemiological data, and current public health guidelines (e.g., CDC, WHO standards).
  • Technical Auditing: Evaluate AI-generated health advice and policy recommendations for accuracy, bias, and adherence to ethical standards. You will identify "misinformation" or logical gaps in the AI's health reasoning.
  • Refine Reasoning: Provide structured feedback to help the model distinguish between correlation and causation in health data and improve its ability to communicate risks to diverse populations.

Requirements

  • Advanced Degree: Masters in Public Health (MPH), Master of Science in Public Health (MSPH), or a closely related graduate degree.
  • Domain Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge in at least two core pillars: Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Environmental Health, or Health Policy.
  • Analytical Writing: The ability to translate complex health data into clear, actionable, and culturally sensitive written information.
  • Attention to Detail: High level of precision when checking statistical significance, data citations, and the logic of health interventions.
  • No AI experience required

Preferred

  • Prior experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
  • Experience with data analysis software such as R, SAS, or Stata.
  • Prior experience in health communication, clinical research coordination, or public health monitoring

Why Join Us

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Direct engagement with industry-leading LLMs.
  • Contractor advantages: high agency, agility, and international reach.
  • More opportunities for contracting renewals.

Application Process (Takes 15-20 min)

  • Submit your resume
  • Complete a short screening
  • Project matching and onboarding

job.name: SAP ABAP with Inventory Management, HANA, BW knowledge
job.description:
SAP ABAP with Inventory Management, HANA, BW knowledge

Experience: 5–8 years

Location: Remote

Type: Contract / Fulltime

An ABAPer with knowledge of BW, HANA, and Inventory Functional processes. S/he should know what the processes are, what each thing means, and understand concepts such as inventory movements.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong understanding of SAP Supply Chain processes, including Demand Planning, MRP, PP/DS, Inventory, Warehousing, and Transportation.
  • Ability to read and analyze ABAP code, extract business logic, and document findings clearly in Excel.
  • Strong BW and HANA experience, including BW/4HANA, InfoObjects, DSOs/aDSOs, transformations, routines, and process chains.
  • Strong knowledge of BW extraction methods, including 2LIS extractors, LO Cockpit, custom extractors, delta queues, ODQ, and ODP.
  • Ability to interpret BW technical tables, including PSA/DSO structures and SID/master-data tables, to uncover business logic embedded in ABAP.
  • Experience with HANA calculation and analytical views, SQLScript, and reverse-engineering HANA models.
  • Strong S/4HANA CDS experience, including standard and custom wrapper CDS views and CDC/delta enablement, to support TE's move toward PS4.
  • Ability to collaborate with Databricks developers and engineers to rebuild SAP transaction logic using Spark SQL, PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, and Unity Catalog.
  • Understanding of data modeling and medallion architecture.
  • Ability to create source-to-target mappings and perform row-count, value, and KPI reconciliations to validate that Databricks outputs match SAP, BW, and HANA.
  • Strong learning mindset with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes every day.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities:

  • Report to the manager on daily work and remain available during EST business hours until 2:00 PM.
  • Analyze T-Code ABAP programs and BW/HANA code, documenting columns, business logic, and supporting SAP/HANA data in Excel.
  • Communicate findings clearly with business stakeholders and SAP functional experts.
  • Attend standups consistently and provide regular status updates.
  • Learn quickly and apply new knowledge to support the success of TE programs and projects.
  • Work with developers, engineers, and SMEs to identify gaps and recommend improvements.
  • Execute priorities set by the reporting manager and deliver outcomes within days.
  • Use AI tools effectively to shorten delivery cycles.

Product Manager – Growth

Own consumer product growth from acquisition to retention through product-led experiences, experimentation, and

YES MADAM is a fast-growing consumer beauty and wellness platform focused on convenience, quality, and

and onboarding to discovery, conversion, checkout, and repeat usage.

Why Join YES MADAM

job.name: Business Administration (MBA) - AI Content Specialist
job.description:
About The Role What if your MBA — your hard-won expertise in corporate finance, market strategy, and business operations — could directly shape how AI advises executives and drives decisions for millions of businesses around the world?

We're looking for MBA-qualified professionals to work with Alignerr, partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. You'll stress-test AI reasoning on the toughest business problems, author gold-standard solutions, and ensure these models are truly ready to function as sophisticated partners for executive decision-making.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI experience needed — just deep business expertise and a sharp analytical mind.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Design Complex Business Challenges — Craft advanced business cases and quantitative problems spanning DCF valuation, market entry strategy, operations bottlenecks, cap table modeling, and more
  • Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Produce rigorous, step-by-step responses complete with financial statements, strategic frameworks (4Ps, 5Cs, Porter's Five Forces), and executive-level rationales that serve as the "golden standard" for AI training
  • Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated business plans, financial forecasts, and case study analyses for logical consistency, mathematical accuracy, and professional-grade quality
  • Sharpen AI Reasoning — Identify and document logical flaws in AI reasoning — such as ignoring sunk costs, miscalculating WACC, or failing to account for macroeconomic variables — and provide structured, actionable feedback

Who You Are

  • Holder of a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited institution
  • Strong foundational knowledge across at least two core business disciplines: Finance, Marketing, Operations, or Strategic Management
  • Skilled at synthesizing complex data into clear, executive-style analysis and recommendations
  • Precise and methodical — you catch errors in financial formulas, data interpretation, and business logic
  • Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on your own schedule
  • No prior AI or data annotation experience required

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy
  • Background in data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
  • Proficiency in data-driven tools such as Excel financial modeling, Tableau, or SQL
  • Experience producing board-level or C-suite communications and deliverables

Why Join Us

job.name: Principal Architect, Frontier AI Offense & Defense Security
job.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

LSI (Lean SuperIntelligence) is a security AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity LLMs. LSI-Offense-1 finds, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to attacks. The two train against each other inside LSI Cyber World Models, realistic instrumented enterprise environments where every outcome is verified, and they run on-prem or air-gapped inside the enterprise that owns them.

LSI is founded by the team behind India's first sovereign LLM and AI labs at Alexa, Uber AI and Salesforce Research, with elite security researchers, and is backed by Accel, Fusion Fund, SVQ, Inventus Capital and Dreamit Ventures, plus angels who led AI and security at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne and Zscaler.

About the Role

You will architect LSI's agentic security system: a team of AI agents that attack, defend and harden a customer's estate continuously. Offense agents probe like an attacker, defense agents detect, investigate and respond like the best responder, and remediation agents turn findings into fixes. You own how they reason, act, hand off to each other and stay under human control.

You are fluent on both sides: you have run adversary simulations and led investigations, and you have built agents that do both. You will turn that into system architecture, training signal and evaluations, working with ML researchers, offense and defense engineers and design partners.

What you'll do

  • Architect the multi-agent system: offense, defense and remediation agents, the orchestrator that routes work between them, and the shared context that carries a finding from attack path to detection to fix.
  • Design the harness and actuators agents use across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, code and CI/CD, and SIEM/XDR/SOAR, with every action scoped, traceable and replayable.
  • Build the security context graph that unifies endpoint, identity, cloud, app and agent signals with threat intel, past incidents and policy.
  • Own routing between LSI's specialised cyber models and frontier models, trading accuracy, latency and cost per task.
  • Define agent identity, least privilege, autonomy levels, human sign-off for high-impact actions, audit trails and rollback.
  • Own one evaluation scorecard across find, exploit, detect, investigate, triage and fix, and lead staff engineers and design-partner pilots.

What you bring

JOB DESCRIPTION

AI Engineering

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows.

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development.

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis’s product-platform strategy.

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities.

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives.

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations.

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration.

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns.

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability.

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance.

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools.

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes.

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience.

job.description:
Build the next generation of AI-powered engineering solutions as a Senior AI Engineer at FE fundinfo, where you will have the opportunity to shape enterprise AI platforms and transform how engineering teams innovate and deliver.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced, hands-on engineer to take ownership of AI platform development, work with cutting-edge technologies, and bring AI-driven solutions from concept to production. You will play a key role in driving engineering productivity, developing scalable AI capabilities, and influencing how AI is integrated into enterprise applications. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and turning emerging AI technologies into practical business solutions, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

FE fundinfo is a leading financial data provider, connecting the investment industry across the UK, Europe, and Asia-Pacific through an integrated platform. Our skilled team empowers clients with data-driven insights, making the industry Navigate Complexity with Confidence!

At FE fundinfo, you will be part of a collaborative, globally connected engineering community that values innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

Your key responsibilities as a Senior AI Engineer will include:

  • Own and deliver AI platform capabilities end-to-end, from solution design through to production operations.
  • Build and maintain reusable AI services, integrations, developer tools, and platform automation.
  • Use AI coding agents and development tools to accelerate engineering delivery, testing, and problem-solving.
  • Integrate and operationalise AI technologies within enterprise applications and platforms.
  • Implement automated deployments, monitoring, reliability, and security controls for AI-powered systems.

You will need the following experience and skills to join us as a Senior AI Engineer:

  • You will bring 8-10 years of software engineering experience, including at least 4 years in AI-related engineering or AI-enabled development.
  • You must have 5+ years of hands-on experience with Python or C#/.NET, alongside strong knowledge of software design, OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.
  • You will have at least 3 years of Microsoft Azure experience, including Azure DevOps, CI/CD, cloud deployments, and production troubleshooting.
  • You should have hands-on experience with AI-first development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent, with practical examples of how you have improved engineering productivity.

job.name: Senior LLM/RAG Engineer (Legacy Modernization)
job.description:
The LLM/RAG Engineer will play a pivotal role in a high-profile modernization project, transitioning a legacy RPG/IBM i-based Dealer Management System (DMS) into a modern, cloud-native Java architecture.

In this Proof of Concept (POC) phase, you will specialize in CodeRAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation for code) and Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) techniques. Your primary objective is to automate the parsing, transformation, and migration of legacy business logic into modern microservices. You will work at the intersection of Generative AI and legacy system modernization, ensuring that automated code generation remains accurate, performant, and aligned with architectural specifications.

Responsibilities

  • Code Transformation & Analysis: Utilize AST techniques to parse legacy RPG code and transform it into structured formats suitable for automated migration.
  • RAG Implementation: Design and maintain RAG pipelines using AWS Bedrock and Vector Databases to provide LLMs with high-fidelity context from legacy documentation and code analysis.
  • Data Preprocessing: Clean, structure, and enrich metadata from legacy systems, potentially involving the creation of knowledge graphs or embeddings to improve LLM accuracy.
  • Iterative Validation: Perform rigorous validation and correction of AI-generated code assets to ensure they meet modern Java standards and functional parity with the legacy system.
  • Legacy Integration: Collaborate with specialized code analysis tools (such as PKS eXplain) to extract business logic and code flows from IBM i environments.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Work closely with cross-functional teams in India and Germany, documenting complex business logic and ensuring tight feedback loops during the POC.
  • Quality Assurance: Adhere to strict architectural specifications and collaborate on testing strategies to validate the migrated solution.

Requirements

  • Total Work Experience: Minimum of 4–8 years of experience in software engineering, with a significant focus on AI/ML or Backend development.
  • AI & LLM Expertise: Proven experience working with advanced LLMs (e.g., Claude 3.5/3.7/4) and building RAG pipelines.
  • Technical Proficiency: \* Languages: Strong proficiency in Python.

+ Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock.
+ Databases: Experience with Vector Databases such as Milvus or Pinecone.

  • Code Transformation Skills: Deep understanding of Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) and experience in parsing or transforming code programmatically.
  • Modernization Knowledge: Familiarity with code migration processes, microservices architecture, and cloud-native design patterns.
  • Tools & Version Control: Expert-level knowledge of Git for managing generated code and collaborative development.
