job.name: Azure AD B2C Technical Lead
job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) Lead to own the architecture, implementation, modernisation, and operational excellence of Bose's customer identity platform.

The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on expertise in Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID , strong Azure cloud architecture knowledge, and experience designing secure, scalable authentication and authorisation solutions for consumer-facing digital platforms.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong identity architecture expertise, cloud platform knowledge, and the ability to lead complex technical initiatives.

Roles & Responsibilities

1. Customer Identity Architecture: Lead the design, implementation, and modernisation of Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID solutions across customer-facing applications.
2. Authentication & Authorisation: Design secure sign-up, sign-in, MFA, passwordless authentication, SSO, account recovery, and identity federation experiences.
3. Azure Platform Architecture: Provide technical leadership across Azure services, cloud integrations, security, scalability, performance, and platform reliability.
4. Custom Policies & User Journeys: Develop Azure AD B2C custom policies using Identity Experience Framework (IEF), claims transformations, technical profiles, and orchestration workflows.
5. Application & API Integration: Integrate customer identity with web applications, mobile apps, APIs, microservices, e-commerce platforms, CRM, and customer support systems.
6. Identity Security: Implement OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, RBAC/ABAC, token security, least-privilege access, and Zero Trust principles.
7. Automation & DevOps: Implement CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, automated configuration management, policy deployment, and environment promotion.
8. Cloud Cost Optimisation: Apply FinOps principles to improve Azure resource utilisation, cost efficiency, and cloud governance.
9. Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Establish identity monitoring, logging, alerting, incident management, and root-cause analysis using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and enterprise observability tools.
10. Technical Leadership: Lead architecture reviews, define engineering standards, resolve complex production issues, and mentor developers and platform engineers.
11. Platform Modernisation: Drive identity migration strategies, reusable architecture patterns, scalability improvements, and long-term platform roadmaps.
12. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, Cloud, Security, Privacy, E-commerce, and Support teams to deliver reliable identity solutions.

job.description:
About the Company

My client is the inference platform behind some of the best-known AI products on the market. They're past $1B ARR, about 200 people, and founded by engineers who built some of the most widely used AI infrastructure in the industry. Their customers see up to 15× faster speed and 4× lower latency than closed models.

About the Role

They're hiring the first 3–5 senior engineers for a new Field Engineering team. That group will lead a much bigger team within about six months.

What the job really is

  • Guide fine-tuning strategy (SFT, DPO, RFT) and get them from "exploring open models" to "running at scale"

Required Skills

  • Have shipped code into someone else's production system (FDE, solutions architect, applied AI, sales engineer, or a client-facing engineer)

Pay range and compensation package

job.name: Staff Full Stack Engineer, Product
job.description:
Role: Senior / Staff Software Engineer (Full-Stack, Product-Focused)

Industry: Hospitality

Salary: $150K–$240K + meaningful equity

Full-time, Permanent Role

What They Do: Our client is a Series A startup, building the modern operating system for the hospitality industry: a two-sided marketplace + automated accounts payable + bill-pay platform. They are already live with dozens of groups and thousands of suppliers, digitizing millions in paper invoices every month and moving real dollars through the platform.

The role: They are looking for a product-minded, full-stack engineer who will own major product surface area end-to-end (especially the marketplace hotels use to buy supplies) and bring professional rigor as they scale from 1-to-N. You’ll work directly with the founders and a small, high-ownership team.

You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Creating custom, AI-assisted experiences and integrations for marketplace and inventory management that make buying feel less like filling in forms
  • Owning the data model underneath it all: how orders, suppliers, buyers and catalogs fit together
  • Professionalizing the product and codebase for high-volume data while still moving extremely fast

About You

  • 8+ years shipping production systems as a senior or staff-level full-stack engineer
  • Deep, current Ruby on Rails expertise (monolith, Postgres, Sidekiq, etc.); React on the front end is welcome
  • Strong product instincts with a front-end lean and the backend depth to model data well
  • Comfort owning a feature from idea to production in a small team
  • A plus: experience in marketplaces, commerce, hospitality or payments

Compensation & Perks

  • $175K–$250K base + meaningful Series A equity (real upside)
  • 75% paid medical, dental, vision for you + dependents
  • 401(k)
  • Quarterly team offsites (they fly everyone in and put the team up at partner hotels)
  • Remote-first, minimal meetings, high-trust culture

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack with Rust
job.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are looking for a Fullstack Sr. Software Engineer who is energized by building a new agent first CRM platform from 0 to 1. You will have a high degree of ownership over the entire stack: from crafting responsive, component-driven interfaces in React to architecting robust, scalable backend logic in Rust. We need a builder who enjoys the challenge of creating a clean, scalable application from the ground up.

What You'll Do

  • You will be part of a small group of engineers building an AI-first CRM platform
  • End-to-End Development: Take full ownership of features by writing clean, maintainable code across the entire stack
  • Frontend Excellence: Translate UI/UX designs into high-performance user interfaces using React
  • Backend Logic: Build efficient and accurate server-side logic and APIs powered by Rust running in our platform environment
  • Platform Integrations: Build highly scalable integrations to common applications that integrate with CRM

Requirements

  • We need good team players
  • 7+ years of fullstack development experience
  • Proficiency with Rust and server side languages
  • Experience with SQL
  • Applicants must have the unrestricted right to work in the United States. Veeva will not provide sponsorship at this time

Interviewing with Veeva We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

+ A conversation with the hiring manager
+ A technical/coding skills exercise
+ A final panel interview with team members and senior leaders

  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
job.description:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

You will be working closely with Product & Design, Solutions Engineering, Data Science, Infrastructure and the Data Platform teams to build new products and enhance our existing suite of products.

This is a remote, US-based role.

job.name: Fullstack Software Engineer, ADK
job.description:
About Pelico Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About The Role Companies have multiple founding moments and Pelico is going through a new one.

You would be one of the founding engineers of our new agentic platform, building alongside a small, super talented, high-bar team. This is a hands-on seat from day one: you write the code that manufacturers and their own AI teams build on, close to real customers and real factory data.

You benefit from company assets (data, events dependency graphs, simulation engine, next best action algorithms) and the reach that comes from Pelico running the operational data of multiple leading manufacturers.

What You'll Do

  • Ship agent capabilities end to end. Build real features from the tool/MCP and orchestration backend through to the React console, live for users - not demos.
  • Harden the runtime. Durable execution, retries, scheduling, and human-in-the-loop approvals on agent actions that carry real consequences.
  • Make agents trustworthy. Grow the eval harness (scenario evals, LLM-as-judge) so we catch regressions in agent behavior before they ship.
  • Build a console people believe. Real-time streaming of agent events, tool calls, and approvals - clear, fast, and reliable enough that a controller trusts it.
  • Set a craft bar. Write specs others build against, keep the frontend/backend contract honest, and leave reusable patterns the team adopts.

About You We care about how good you are and how far you can go, and we calibrate to the experience you bring. This seat is built for exceptional people - whether you are just out of a top program or already have a few years of serious building behind you.

Read the full description

job.name: Lead Java Developer
job.description:
About The Role WebBee Global is looking for an experienced Java Architect / Lead Java Backend Developer to drive the design, architecture, and development of scalable SaaS integration platforms. The role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on coding expertise, and the ability to design high-performance backend systems supporting complex e-commerce workflows.

The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems, microservices, API integrations, cloud technologies, and enterprise application architecture. The candidate will be responsible for technical decisions, architecture improvements, mentoring engineering teams, and delivering reliable production-grade solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and design scalable backend architecture for SaaS-based integration platforms.
  • Lead technical design discussions and provide architectural direction.
  • Develop and review high-quality backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Design microservices, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and integration solutions.
  • Build systems capable of handling high-volume transactions and complex business workflows.
  • Review existing architecture and recommend improvements for scalability, performance, and reliability.
  • Design solutions for e-commerce integrations involving orders, inventory, fulfilment, tracking, and product data.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root-cause analysis.
  • Establish engineering best practices for coding standards, security, testing, and deployment.
  • Mentor senior and junior developers through technical guidance and code reviews.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and business teams to deliver reliable solutions.
  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to engineering processes.

Requirements Required Skills

  • 12–15 years of experience in Java backend development.
  • Strong expertise in Java 8+ and advanced Java concepts.
  • Extensive experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Hibernate.
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience designing and developing enterprise-grade REST APIs.
  • Strong knowledge of database design, MySQL, SQL optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Excellent understanding of object-oriented design principles and design patterns.
  • Experience with multi threading, concurrency, caching, and asynchronous processing.
  • Strong debugging, system analysis, and production troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience with Git, Maven/Gradle, JUnit, Mockito, and CI/CD practices.
  • Understanding of application security, API security, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working with Linux-based production environments.

job.name: Senior Java Developer
job.description:
Backend Development - Design, develop and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot. - Build reliable

and scalable REST APIs. - Develop integration workflows involving orders, inventory, fulfilment, tracking and product

data. - Write clean, reusable and maintainable code. - Implement validations, exception handling, retry mechanisms

and failure recovery. - Optimise existing modules for performance, reliability and scalability. - Participate in

architecture and technical design discussions. - Refactor legacy code where required without affecting existing

customers.

API and Integration Development - Integrate with external platforms using REST and SOAP APIs. - Work with API

authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0, API keys and access tokens. - Handle pagination, rate limits, retries and

API failures. - Design and consume webhooks. - Analyse API requests, responses and error messages. - Develop data

mapping and transformation logic between different platforms. - Ensure integrations are idempotent and do not create

duplicate transactions. - Maintain compatibility with third-party API changes and version upgrades.

Production Troubleshooting - Investigate production incidents using application logs, database records and monitoring

tools. - Identify root causes instead of applying temporary fixes. - Analyse performance issues, memory problems,

connection pool exhaustion and slow database queries. - Troubleshoot intermittent API, webhook, scheduler and

queue-related failures. - Provide technical findings to support, QA and operations teams. - Implement permanent

corrective and preventive actions. - Participate in critical incident resolution when required.

Database Development - Design and maintain MySQL database structures. - Write and optimise SQL queries. - Create

appropriate indexes and analyse execution plans. - Handle large-volume data processing efficiently. - Identify

duplicate, inconsistent or incomplete records. - Work safely with production data and database migrations. -

Understand transactions, locking, isolation levels and concurrency.

Code Quality and Reviews - Review code written by other developers. - Identify defects, security issues, performance

risks and maintainability concerns. - Enforce coding standards and engineering best practices. - Write unit and

integration tests. - Ensure adequate test coverage for critical workflows. - Participate in pull-request reviews and

release validation. - Mentor junior and mid-level developers.

Performance and Scalability - Design systems that can process high-volume orders and API transactions. - Improve

scheduler, batch and queue-processing efficiency. - Identify memory, CPU, thread and database bottlenecks. - Design

asynchronous processing where appropriate. - Ensure that services fail safely and recover correctly. - Support

horizontal and vertical scaling decisions.

job.name: Software Engineer — AI Code Ranking
job.description:
About The Role What if your years of software engineering experience could directly shape how AI writes code for millions of developers? We're looking for Software Engineers in New York to evaluate, rank, and refine AI-generated code — helping the next generation of coding assistants produce solutions that are correct, efficient, idiomatic, and production-ready.

Your deep understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and real-world engineering trade-offs is exactly what AI models need to get better. This isn't about writing boilerplate — it's about applying expert judgment to push the boundaries of what AI can do with code.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for experienced developers who want meaningful, high-impact work on their own schedule.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Review and rank AI-generated code solutions across multiple programming languages and problem domains
  • Evaluate code for correctness, efficiency, readability, maintainability, and adherence to best practices
  • Identify bugs, anti-patterns, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI-generated outputs
  • Write detailed, structured feedback explaining why one solution is better than another
  • Refine and improve AI-generated code to meet production-level engineering standards
  • Provide preference rankings that help AI models learn what "good code" actually looks like
  • Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

  • Software engineer with 3+ years of professional development experience
  • Proficient in one or more major programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C++, Go, Rust)
  • Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity
  • Deep understanding of software design principles, clean code practices, and engineering trade-offs
  • Experienced with code review — you know how to assess quality and articulate why something works or doesn't
  • Clear, concise written communicator who can explain technical decisions effectively
  • Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision

Nice to Have

  • Experience across multiple languages, frameworks, or tech stacks
  • Background in systems design, distributed systems, or backend architecture
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)
  • Prior experience with code evaluation, technical mentoring, or open-source contribution
  • Knowledge of security best practices and performance optimization
  • Experience in competitive programming or technical interviewing

job.name: Technical Consultant, Enterprise, Oracle Cloud
job.description:
About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About The Role Technical Consultants are on the frontlines working to establish partnerships with Ramp customers, and act as a liaison between customers and our internal technical teams. You'll be partnering with Customer Activation & Account Management teams to identify, prioritize and build financial solutions for new and existing customers so that Ramp continues to scale with their needs.

You will act as the technical and financial subject matter expert for our customers and design solutions that address the customer's needs through Ramp and partner integrations. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams' roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value.

You will define the customer's financial & technical success criteria from onboarding through activation and expansion. You will represent Product, Design, and Engineering externally and will operate with deep conviction and understanding of Ramp's technical capabilities. The role requires technical skills necessary to understand and educate on robust accounting features and integrate them across all the touchpoints and surface area of a customer.

This role is specifically focused on Enterprise customers running Oracle Fusion Cloud, supporting large, complex organizations with multi-entity environments, advanced ERP integrations, and highly customized financial workflows.

Introduction A career at Anderon provides the rare opportunity to help define a new industry. We’re a wafer foundry that’s commercializing semiconductor manufacturing for quantum chips. You’ll partner with innovative clients and leading researchers to develop the technology needed to build the coming quantum economy.

  • Please note: Anderon uses IBM's recruitment platform for candidate applications and hiring workflows. While this role is with Anderon, all applications will be submitted and processed through IBM's careers system.

Your Role And Responsibilities The Foundry Enablement team develops design solutions and automation that help translate semiconductor manufacturing capabilities into usable resources for chip-design teams. As a Foundry Enablement Automation Intern, you will contribute to engineering work in one or more areas, including kerf, macro design, design services, assembly, and mask tapeout.

You will work alongside semiconductor and enablement engineers to understand physical-design and manufacturing challenges, contribute to engineering designs, and develop Python-based automation that improves the efficiency, consistency, and quality of Foundry Enablement workflows. Depending on the assignment, you may analyze technical data, automate engineering calculations or design activities, generate and validate design content, or apply AI-assisted methods to support engineering problem-solving.

This role provides hands-on experience at the intersection of semiconductor engineering, physical design, Python automation, and applied AI. Prior AI experience is not required. The ideal candidate has a foundation in hardware, semiconductor processes, or chip design and can independently develop and test Python scripts.

Preferred Education Bachelor's Degree

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, or a related hardware or physical-science field.
  • Foundational knowledge acquired through coursework, research, or projects in areas such as electronic devices, circuits, semiconductor processes, chip design, solid-state physics, microelectronics, or physical design.
  • Ability to independently develop, test, debug, and document Python scripts used for engineering analysis, data processing, design support, or workflow automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze physical or technical problems, translate requirements into a structured approach, and validate results against engineering expectations.
  • Strong curiosity, learning agility, communication skills, and ability to collaborate across multiple engineering disciplines.

job.name: Software Engineer
job.description:
Department: Tech - Software Engineering

Location: Gurugram, India

Description The Interfaces to Aurora Aurora is the global market leader in energy market analytics and software. We built that position on fundamentals models of energy markets and the intellectual rigour behind them. Investors, lenders, developers and governments use our forecasts to decide which wind farms, solar farms and batteries get built and financed, so the data has to be trusted and bankable. None of that matters unless people can get at it.

Our Product Engineering team owns the interfaces to Aurora: UI, APIs, SDKs, CLIs and newer interaction models such as MCP servers, which let AI agents work with our data directly. Our job is to make Aurora's capabilities usable for customers and our own analysts, whatever the touchpoint, and everyone in the team works across those surfaces.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join one of our squads in our growing Gurugram engineering hub.

What Makes It Interesting Energy sits where physics, economics and maths meet. A power price emerges from weather, grid constraints, fuel costs, policy and the behaviour of every asset on the system, and our models simulate all of it. Our modellers build those models, but our engineers engage just as deeply with the domain. You can't design a good interface to something you don't understand, so you'll learn how markets, assets and policy fit together, and for most of the team that's a big part of the appeal. You don't need an energy background to apply: we'll support you to build that knowledge.

The harder engineering problem is that there is no single energy market. Our regional teams cover markets around the world, and a market rule in Texas, a capacity mechanism in Germany and a grid in Australia all have to be handled by the same software. Designing something that respects those differences without dissolving into special cases is where much of the interesting work sits.

Key Responsibilities We're organised into long-lived squads, each owning part of the product end to end, with an embedded product representative who can make backlog decisions. Squads stay stable so they build real depth in their area.

We are serious about continuous delivery and push to production many times a day in small changes, backed by automated tests and CI. We already tick most of the DORA capabilities (the practices research has found predict good software delivery outcomes), and we treat that as a starting point. Our ambition is to be among the best engineering teams at building and delivering software. You'll own what you build from design through to running it in production.

job.name: Software Engineer, Robotics Data
job.description:
About The Role Frontier AI is going physical, and the labs building it are bottlenecked on one thing: high-quality data from the real world. We pair operational scale with the specialized engineering that physical-world data demands.

As a Software Engineer on Robotics, you'll sit between our data systems and our customers' infrastructure. Every frontier lab wants something different: container format, schema, fields, and quality requirements. You'll build infrastructure general enough that a new customer becomes a quick configuration, and you'll work directly with customer engineering teams on bespoke requests, feeding what you learn into scalable platform architecture decisions. An example might be modifying the segmentation model derived from a customer request for stricter filtering on hands being in frame and building this into a configurable pipeline feature.

Prior robotics experience is not required. This is a backend and data engineering role at its core, developing pipelines, formats, and storage methods. If you've built high-volume data infrastructure anywhere and want depth in robotics data, working directly with the engineers and researchers at the labs and robotics companies building physical AI, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the reusable infrastructure behind robotics data deliveries: the processing, packaging, and delivery systems
  • Format and transform datasets to per-client specification: MCAP and other container formats, custom schemas, field mappings, metadata, and versioning
  • Work directly with customer engineering teams to scope and build bespoke schemas, custom fields, and one-off transforms where requirements are custom
  • Build and operate the pipelines that move data from our systems into customer storage reliably at petabyte scale
  • Partner with operations and product to turn evolving requirements into shipped data deliveries, and prototype quickly when a new data type or customer arrives
  • Build automated validation techniques

What We're Looking For

  • Strong backend and data engineering fundamentals in a modern language (Python, Go, Rust) and comfort operating production systems on AWS and GCP
  • Experience building and owning high-volume data pipelines, not just contributing to them
  • Experience with large binary formats, streaming ingestion, distributed batch processing, and object storage economics
  • Customer-facing instincts: you can lead a technical conversation, ask the right questions, and push back when a request is unreasonable
  • Comfort working through ambiguity and shipping iteratively with a product team, where requirements evolve with the customers and data types

Nice to Have

job.name: Embedded Software Engineer, Validation
job.description:
About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You And The Role We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to build the automated validation systems that ensure the reliability of the embedded platform powering autonomous aircraft operating in safety-critical environments.

This role sits within the Embedded Platform team, which develops the foundational middleware and infrastructure used throughout the flight software stack. Our systems provide critical capabilities including interprocess communication (IPC), logging and observability, communication bridges, over-the-air (OTA) software updates, and live telemetry between aircraft and cloud services.

As an Embedded Software Validation Engineer, you will design and build the simulation and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) infrastructure used to validate these platform services. Working closely with software engineers across the Flight Software organization, you will develop comprehensive automated test scenarios that verify functionality, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance before software reaches an aircraft.

This is a software engineering role focused on building scalable validation infrastructure, not manual testing.

What You'll Do

job.name: Product Engineer - Onboarding Automation
job.description:
About Stuut Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order-to-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank.

Over 150 companies, spanning the mid-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date.

Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai.

The Role

We're hiring our first Product Engineer dedicated to customer onboarding. Your job is to make bringing a new customer live on Stuut faster and smoother, and to build the tools our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team uses on every implementation.

Every new customer brings its own ERP, data, email templates, and collections process. You'll work alongside our FDEs, find the steps that can be automated, and ship the tools that make each onboarding faster than the last: a smarter intake form and the APIs behind it, and agents that turn a customer's existing collateral into a configured account.

This work also lays the foundation for channel partners to implement Stuut for their own clients.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first quarter, you've shipped an onboarding automation used on live customers. Within 12 months, customers go live meaningfully faster, your tooling is a core part of every implementation, and it's robust enough for channel partners to use.

What You'll Do

  • Build the intake-to-configuration path: Turn our intake form into a full product, with the APIs behind it so customer inputs configure an account end to end.
  • Ship agents for onboarding: Build LLM-powered tools that turn customer collateral (email templates, collection playbooks, process docs) into working Stuut configuration.
  • Make customer data easy: Make ERP data, flat-file, and schema mapping fast and reliable, whether that means building or integrating the right tool.
  • Improve the onboarding toolkit: Continuously improve the tools and automation our FDEs use on every implementation.
  • Find the bottleneck, ship the simple fix: Work with FDEs and customers, measure where time goes, and ship the smallest thing that moves it before building the big thing.
  • Build for partners: Design onboarding tooling that channel partners can use too.
  • Build with agents: Use coding agents daily to ship quickly, while owning the testing and debugging of what they produce.

You Might Be a Fit If You…

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise GenAI
job.description:
At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. About The Team Scale's Applied Intelligence Systems team builds the enterprise agent platform (SGP). It is the foundation that lets enterprises build, run, govern and trust AI agents in production, on any major cloud and inside customer environments. Our work spans how agents are built and orchestrated, how they run securely, how they remember and reason over enterprise data, how they're evaluated and observed, and the infrastructure that keeps all of it reliable. Models and frameworks change every week. We build the layer that runs and governs them.

Sample projects

  • Building agents. The SDK, harness and deploy pipeline that take an agent from commit to a signed, versioned agent in a customer's environment, plus multi-agent orchestration where parent agents delegate to children, pause and resume.
  • Running agents safely. Isolated sandboxes, identity that proves who an agent acts for, and a gateway that checks permissions and audits every tool call, with credentials agents never hold.
  • Reliability at scale. Kubernetes fleets, upgrades and disaster recovery across AWS, Azure and GCP, and proving the platform can absorb 10x agent workload.
  • Tooling for every deployment. A fleet control plane, a trusted image registry, and the CI/CD and release gates that carry every change to customers.
  • Observability. Shared instrumentation and fleet-wide health views, with sensitive data redacted before it's stored.

What You'll Do

  • Own and set the technical direction for large areas of the platform, from design through production, on-call and iteration.
  • Write the designs that cross team boundaries, and lead the reviews that raise the bar around you.

Job Description: Building trusted markets — powered by our people At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

We're building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we've earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Location Overview: Cboe HQ is located in the historic Old Post Office district, it’s a landmark that blends classic architecture with modern amenities. The building features expansive spaces with high ceilings and large windows, offering an abundance of natural light and panoramic views of the city skyline and the Chicago River.

With its prime location in the heart of downtown, the OPO Building provides easy access to major transportation hubs, including Union Station and multiple CTA lines, making it convenient for commuters. The building is home to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, a fitness center, and collaborative workspaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic work environment in one of Chicago's most iconic areas.

Role Overview Cboe Clear U.S. (CCUS) is a regulated clearinghouse. We clear the event contracts and prediction markets listed on Cboe's exchanges, and we are building toward tokenized collateral, 24x7 operation, and the infrastructure that carries traditional finance onto DeFi rails.

CCUS Software Engineering is a high trust environment. Failure leads to inquiry rather than blame. Working across team boundaries is expected rather than tolerated. We solve the problem, then we write the code. Design documents and architecture decision records come first. The engineers we value most close their feedback loop. They write tests, and they instrument what they ship so it fails fast, explains itself in production, leaves an audit trail and rolls back cleanly.

The Software Engineer builds and runs the services that clear trades. You would own features inside a design your team sets, write the tests and observability that ship with them, and carry the on-call that comes from owning your own code. Java is our stack choice, but we hire polyglots. The engineers who do well here grow into shaping the design rather than working inside it.

We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We turn shopper activity on our marketplace into a clear picture of who each buyer is and what they're looking for, then recommend the next move to the salesperson working that lead. Thousands of dealerships rely on it every day.

You'll work in the Java and Spring Boot services behind all of this: enriching each lead as it arrives, consuming high-volume event streams, and serving the APIs that power the dashboards dealers work in. It's a small team, so you'll take real ownership early. You'll partner closely with product, design, and other backend and frontend engineers to move projects from technical design through implementation and launch, and you'll see the result in dealer adoption and close rates.

job.name: Senior Backend Engineer
job.description:
Who We Are At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

This role is a part of Bluehost's innovation team, the group building the AI-native backbone of our platform while the rest of the business scales around us. You'll design async, production-grade backend systems that treat AI as a first-class citizen: multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and provider-agnostic LLM integration, all woven into products millions of small businesses depend on. We want a true go-getter who can take an idea from whiteboard to production without waiting to be told how.

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

  • Design and scale async REST/WebSocket APIs in Python (FastAPI or similar), using dependency injection, type hints, and clean, vertical-slice architecture
  • Implement multi-agent workflows (sequential, concurrent, and handoff patterns) to route work among specialized LLM agents
  • Integrate multiple LLM providers behind a provider-agnostic layer, enabling A/B testing and cost-aware routing rather than hard-coding a single vendor
  • Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines against vector stores such as pgvector, Chroma, or a managed vector search service
  • Design schemas and evolve data models (SQLAlchemy/SQLModel-style ORM plus migrations) that support both traditional application logic and AI-driven features
  • Instrument services with structured logs, distributed tracing, and cost/latency metrics, holding a real bar for p95 response time under production load
  • Maintain end-to-end CI/CD ownership, lint, type-check, test, package, and deploy, so releases are boring and safe
  • Champion AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated code gets reviewed, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer data may enter a prompt
  • Move ideas from concept to production fast, with real ownership over architecture and outcomes, not just tickets

Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Ledger
job.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

What You’ll Do Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature.

You Have

  • 4+ years of backend software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable systems (e.g., microservices, APIs).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience debugging complex issues in distributed systems.
  • Experience in managing projects, planning and executing work across different workstreams.
  • Strong collaboration skills, ability to work across teams and organizations, mentoring and guiding junior engineers.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
  • Experience in financial infrastructure, ledgers, accounting, or another domain where accuracy is non-negotiable is highly desirable. Experience building a ledger or double-entry system at another company is a strong plus.
  • Experience with large-scale data or analytical systems (OLAP, event-driven pipelines, or similar) is a plus but not a requirement.

Your Tech Career Is Still Within Reach? Rebuild Momentum With a Placement Process

Even if you’ve been rejected, laid off, or out of the field for years, your tech career is still within reach. SynergisticIT helps you rebuild your confidence and sharpen your skills through hands‑on real‑world projects. You’ll also receive interview coaching and resume optimization that highlight your strengths. Also get marketed directly to Fortune 500 companies, giving you access to opportunities that most job seekers never see. Your career isn’t over — it’s waiting for the right opportunity. Synergisticit helps you reach it faster.

A career gap doesn’t disqualify you — outdated skills do. But the job market can still feel brutal: you apply daily, watch automated rejections roll in, and wonder why your experience isn’t translating into interviews. The truth is that hiring has shifted. Employers want candidates who match current stacks , show recent hands-on proof , and interview strongly. If you’ve been out for 3–6+ months, that gap can become an extra filter—unless you deliberately rebuild momentum.

We’re actively engaging candidates for full-time opportunities aligned to client needs: software programming, Java full stack development, Java/Python roles, DevOps engineering, and data roles spanning analytics, engineering, science, and ML/AI. Our primary focus remains Java/Full Stack/DevOps and Data/Engineering/Analytics/ML.

SynergisticIT since 2010 has helped candidates land full-time roles at major organizations (examples often listed include Google, Apple, PayPal, Visa, Western Union, Wells Fargo, Intel, JPMC, Citi, Bank of America, Wayfair , and others), with offers in the $95k–$154k range depending on role and stack.

Why laid-off candidates often struggle (even with experience)

After a layoff, two things happen:

1. Your skills may be solid, but your keywords and tools may be slightly behind the market.
2. Your interview performance may drop because stress makes you second-guess.

Also, employers increasingly expect hybrid capability: not just “I coded,” but “I can build + deploy + collaborate + document + explain.” That’s especially true for Java full stack, DevOps, data engineering, and ML/AI.

What roles are commonly in demand right now

Laid-off candidates often do best targeting roles that map to consistent enterprise demand. The main lanes include:

  • Entry-level to mid-level software engineering roles (especially backend/full stack)
  • Java full stack roles (enterprise stability)
  • Java/Python developer roles (flexibility across teams)
  • DevOps/Cloud roles (automation, pipelines, reliability)
  • Data roles (analytics → engineering → ML/AI)

why placement support matters

  • rebuild a job-ready portfolio fast
  • adjust your resume and LinkedIn for ATS
  • practice interviews under real conditions

job.name: Senior Salesforce Developer
job.description:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart : trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

Want to get a better feel for what it's like to work at Docebo? Check out our Life page on our LinkedIn to get a glimpse into our culture, people, and the experiences that make Docebo a great place to grow your career.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

🚀 The Adventure Ahead

Our Salesforce org is the system of record for how Docebo sells, renews and serves customers. It carries CPQ, document generation, e-signature, provisioning and billing integrations, and a growing set of AI-driven workflows. The team that runs it is small, senior, and split between Canada and Italy. We've spent this year putting real structure behind it: a formal development lifecycle, a definition of ready for every ticket, a security standard for integrations, and a hardening program that is cleaning up years of accumulated access.

We're adding a senior developer to carry that forward. You'll build on the platform every week, but you'll also be one of the people the rest of the team turns to when a design needs a second opinion, a connected app needs scrutiny, or a request needs someone to say "not like that, and here's why."

⚡ The Day-to-Day

Who we are

About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team Brand Studio team works on a variety of brand-centric projects for Stripe, from our brand standards to campaigns, events, IRL experiences, packaging, digital products, and even printed publications. The brand designers on this team are multidisciplinary in nature, able to design robust visual systems, art direction, and craft surfaces that focus on brand and product storytelling.

Collaborating with other teams at Stripe, as well as external partners, we raise the quality and consistency of experiences with the Stripe brand IRL, virtually, and everywhere in between. We craft the creative vision and strategy for different types of projects and audiences, and amplify them across various mediums, channels, objects to environments, and digital and physical experiences.

About Stripe Creative Lab Stripe Creative Lab aims to create breakthrough, culturally resonant, and exquisitely crafted projects that reveal Stripe’s magic in surprising ways. We dedicate ourselves to meticulously crafting the work to ensure the highest possible creative quality. The work is experimental, often starts with ambiguous briefs and requires finding a way where others might deem it impossible. We are making it up as we go, and that’s the way we love to work.

What you’ll do

You’ll be joining a highly creative team working across digital experiences, interactive projects, physical installations, experimental technology, and whatever else an idea might require. The work often begins without an obvious technical solution and sometimes without knowing exactly what form the final project should take.

As a Design Engineer, you’ll work closely with designers, art directors, and producers to figure out what’s possible, prototype ideas quickly, and turn ambitious creative concepts into working experiences. You’ll bring deep technical expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, alongside the curiosity and technical range to work confidently beyond it.

A significant amount of our work lives on the internet, so you should be comfortable independently building and shipping highly crafted digital experiences. Other projects may involve hardware, physical computing, unusual displays, installations, or technical systems we haven’t encountered before. You won’t be expected to be an expert in everything, but you should be excited to learn, experiment, and know when to bring in specialists.

job.name: Demand Planner
job.description:
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s around 33,000 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Job Description

Designation: Demand Planner

Location: Nerul, Navi Mumbai

Department: Supply Chain Management (SCM)

Reporting To: SCM Head / S&OP Lead

Position Purpose

The Demand Planner is responsible for developing and maintaining accurate demand forecasts by integrating historical sales data, market intelligence, sales inputs, and business trends. The role acts as a key link between Sales, Marketing, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, and Finance to support the S&OP process, ensure high forecast reliability, optimize inventory levels, and proactively manage slow-moving and obsolete inventories.

Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Implementation & MRP Stabilization are Key Project to drive Process Automation.

Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning & Forecasting

  • Generate, maintain, and continuously improve rolling demand forecasts at SKU, product family, and regional levels.
  • Analyze historical sales data, market trends, seasonality, and business intelligence to develop demand plans.
  • Incorporate Sales, Marketing, Key Account, and Channel inputs into the forecasting process.
  • Segment SKUs based on demand patterns and forecast ability.
  • Identify demand risks, opportunities, and forecast assumptions.
  • Support new product launch forecasting and phase-out planning.
  • Communicate forecast updates and demand changes to Supply Planning, Manufacturing, and Procurement teams.
  • Monitor forecast performance and drive continuous forecast improvement initiatives.
  • Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Implementation & MRP Stabilization are Key Project to drive Process Automation.

S&OP Process Support

  • Lead the demand review process as part of the monthly S&OP cycle.
  • Facilitate consensus demand planning with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Challenge assumptions and reconcile differences between statistical forecasts and commercial inputs.
  • Provide demand scenarios and sensitivity analysis to support management decision-making.

Inventory Management

Maintain accurate investigation and ticket documentation, follow SOC procedures and SLAs, and collaborate effectively with global security teams in a 24x7 shift-based environment.

job.name: Information Technology System Administrator
job.description:
Company Description Amity University is a leading non-profit private university in India, recognized for its hi-tech campuses and strong focus on developing both academic excellence and leadership skills. With over two decades of academic achievement, Amity has earned the highest ‘A+’ Grade Accreditation from the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC). The university has a global presence with campuses across India, as well as in Dubai, London, Singapore, New York, California, China, and Romania, offering career-focused undergraduate and postgraduate programs in diverse disciplines. Amity is committed to combining practice-based learning and research with quality teaching, creating an environment that supports professional growth and personal values. Its strong industry orientation and successful alumni network worldwide reflect a culture of dedication, sincerity, and high performance.
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Information Technology System Administrator role based at Amity University in Bengaluru. The System Administrator will manage and maintain servers, operating systems, and core IT infrastructure to ensure high availability, performance, and security. Daily responsibilities include monitoring systems and networks, performing backups and updates, managing user accounts and access permissions, and resolving hardware and software issues. The role involves providing technical support to faculty, staff, and students, troubleshooting incidents, and coordinating with vendors or external support teams when needed. The System Administrator will also contribute to IT policy implementation, documentation of procedures, and continuous improvement of campus-wide technology services.
Qualifications

  • Strong System Administration skills, including server management, operating system configuration, and user account administration.
  • Proficiency in Network Administration, covering LAN/WAN management, network security, and monitoring of network performance.
  • Experience in Technical Support, with the ability to assist end users, resolve IT incidents, and provide clear guidance on technology usage.
  • Advanced Troubleshooting capabilities to diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues efficiently.
  • Solid foundation in Information Technology principles, including IT security, backup and recovery, and infrastructure best practices.
  • Relevant academic qualification such as a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with common enterprise tools and platforms (e.g., Windows and Linux servers, virtualization, email and collaboration systems).
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a university environment, manage priorities, and maintain clear documentation.
  • Professional certifications (such as CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft, Cisco, or similar) are an advantage.

job.name: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
job.description:
Hiring for BRAHMA AI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Brahma AI Services India Ltd, formerly Prime Focus Technologies, builds AI-led media asset management, localisation, rights, metadata and distribution products for global media and entertainment customers.

Job Description

About the role We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build and scale modern web applications and backend services. You’ll own features across the UI, services, data and deployment, working with ReactJS and Java or Golang.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and deliver full-stack features using ReactJS and Java or Golang.
  • Build scalable backend services, REST APIs and microservices.
  • Develop reusable, high-performance React interfaces and reliable frontend-backend integrations.
  • Design API contracts, authentication, authorization and data flows.
  • Work with databases, caching, messaging and asynchronous processing.
  • Test, deploy and support production features using Docker, CI/CD and cloud platforms.
  • Diagnose issues across the application stack and contribute to technical design and engineering standards.
  • Support video or media workflows where needed, and mentor teammates.

Requirements

  • 6–8 years of hands-on software engineering experience.
  • Strong production experience with ReactJS and Java or Golang; either backend language qualifies.
  • Strong JavaScript or TypeScript skills.
  • Experience with REST APIs, microservices, databases and distributed systems.
  • Ability to design, build and deliver full-stack features.
  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and a cloud platform such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

What we offer

  • Full-time role based in Bengaluru, with a hybrid work arrangement.
  • Opportunity to own features end to end and work across frontend, backend and cloud.
  • Exposure to scalable applications and, where relevant, video/media workflows.

job.name: AI Generalist
job.description:
There's no job description for this role. That's the point.

We are Softway, A people-first AI transformation firm, we hire for mindset over résumé: hunger, curiosity and ownership. If you'd rather have a neatly defined role, this isn't it.We're a small team at Softway looking for an AI Generalist, full-time and in office in Bengaluru.

One week you might be shaping a product, the next untangling an internal problem, researching something nobody here has tried yet, building a process from scratch, or figuring out something completely new. You'll work closely with every team across Softway, and how much leverage you create is up to you. Your background doesn't matter: technology, product, HR, finance, sales, GTM, marketing, product marketing, anything. What matters is that you're a curious problem solver who has already used AI to get real things done, and you understand technology well enough to build something meaningful with it. You don't need to be an engineer.

And we don't hire through interviews. If you're genuinely keen, come to our in-person hiring event at our Bengaluru office on December 5. Pick up a real problem nobody has solved yet, build something that works with AI, and present it to us. If it clicks, you might even spend a few days working with us before you join.

Apply here 👉: https://www.softway.com/lovexai/builders-day

Application architecture

Exigences linguistiques : Anglais

À propos de Destination Canada

Le tourisme est au cœur des communautés vivant aux quatre coins du pays. À Destination Canada, nous souhaitons que l'industrie du tourisme soit source de prospérité et de bien-être pour le Canada dans son ensemble et enrichisse la vie des invités. Notre mission est d'influencer l'offre et de stimuler la demande dans l'intérêt des résidents, des communautés et des visiteurs, le tout grâce à de la recherche d'avant-garde, à un alignement sur les secteurs public et privé et à un marketing du Canada réalisé au pays et à l'étranger. Nous cherchons des esprits inventifs ayant une curiosité intellectuelle et un profond désir de faire croître l'industrie canadienne du tourisme, en renforçant la vitalité socioculturelle, environnementale et économique qu'apporte le tourisme au Canada.

À propos du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'une agente financière générale ou d'un agent financier général qui se démarque par sa minutie et son grand sens de l'organisation pour soutenir notre équipe des Finances.

Sous la responsabilité de la directrice de la planification et de l'analyse financières, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les unités opérationnelles assignées et leur fournirez des conseils et du soutien pour les aider à prendre des décisions financières éclairées. Vous aurez notamment à coordonner les budgets, à faire le suivi des dépenses, à préparer des prévisions, à surveiller les dépenses liées aux projets et les contrats, et à fournir des indications sur les politiques et les processus financiers de Destination Canada.

Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec la directrice pour appuyer la planification, l'analyse et la production de rapports financiers, contribuant ainsi à l'élaboration et à l'amélioration des processus budgétaires, des contrôles internes et des politiques financières.

De plus, vous aurez l'occasion de contribuer à des initiatives et à des projets spéciaux qui soutiennent l'équipe des Finances et l'organisme dans son ensemble.

job.name: Cost Engineer
job.description:
Job Details

12 months contract- possibility of extension

Hybrid- Surrey BC

  • 1-2 days per week surrey office
  • Q2 next year – work out of Delta office 3 days per week

Rate:80-90/hr

JOB DESCRIPTION

We're looking for an experienced Cost Controller to join an owner-side project controls team supporting large projects.

In this new role, you'll keep project cost information accurate and current, and provide the analysis leaders need to forecast, report and make decisions. You'll monitor budgets, actuals, commitments, accruals, forecasts and contingency to show where costs stand today and where they're headed. You'll work closely with Project Managers and the Project Controls Lead. You'll also need to turn detailed numbers into clear, simple updates.

What you'll do

Maintain the approved project control budget and the project work breakdown structure (WBS), in line with project governance requirements.

Run the monthly cost cycle by updating actuals, commitments and accruals against the approved budget.

Coordinate monthly forecast updates with Project Managers and project teams, and maintain detailed estimate-to-complete (ETC) and estimate-at-completion (EAC) forecasts.

Analyze cost variances, trends and emerging cost pressures, and write clear variance explanations.

Keep contract, purchase order and commitment records current, and add approved changes.

Support monthly accruals and reconcile project cost data with corporate finance.

Track contingency drawdowns and remaining balances.

Prepare the monthly cost report and escalate material cost issues early.

Key deliverables

Monthly project cost report

Cost forecast (ETC and EAC)

Budget-to-forecast variance analysis

Monthly cost variance explanation

Actuals and commitments reconciliation

Commitment register / PO report

Monthly accrual support

Contingency drawdown report

Cost trend analysis

Cash flow forecast, where applicable

What success looks like

ETC and EAC forecasts are reliable and trusted.

Monthly reconciliations with finance are clean.

Commitment and contingency records are accurate.

Variance explanations are clear and on time.

Cost pressures are raised early enough for leadership to act.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

5+ years in a similar role (project controls or project finance), with hands-on cost control on large capital projects

Forecasting: monthly forecast updates, ETC and EAC

Budget control: maintaining the approved control budget and tracking actuals, commitments and accruals against it

Variance and trend analysis, with written variance explanations

Commitment management: contracts, POs, the commitment register and approved changes

Reconciliation: monthly accruals and matching project cost data to corporate finance

Contingency tracking, cost reporting and escalating cost pressures

Strong with numbers and a clear communicator. You can explain cost information simply to project and controls leadership.

job.name: Product Manager Business Bulk Fulfilment, Amazon Business Operations - Analytics and Tech
job.description:
Description Amazon Business customers buy at a scale most retail systems were never built for: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking an entire floor. Today those orders often arrive as dozens of separate boxes over many days, and we are rebuilding how Amazon fulfills them.

You will own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment at Amazon Business. The goal is simple to state and hard to build: a customer places one large order, picks one date, and receives it once, in the form factor that fits their dock and their crew. Getting there means changing how Amazon sources, consolidates, packs and ships large orders, working shoulder to shoulder with the engineering teams that own fulfillment planning and fulfillment center operations. This is a builder role with a funded roadmap and direct exposure to senior leaders across Amazon Business, supply chain and operations.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.

Write the documents that get the work funded and built: PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and annual and three year planning inputs.

Act as the requirements owner with partner engineering teams in fulfillment planning and fulfillment center technology, not a ticket filer. Negotiate scope, sequence and dependencies directly with their product and engineering leaders.

Define how Amazon consolidates a large order into as few deliveries as possible, including palletized delivery and customer selected delivery dates.

Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.

Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.

Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.

Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.

A day in the life

You will spend your day between customers and builders. Mornings often start in the data, checking how last week's large orders actually shipped and where they fragmented. From there it is working sessions with fulfillment planning and fulfillment center engineering teams on requirements, a review with operations leaders on the manual work still left in the flow, and time with Amazon Business sales and customer teams on what large buyers are asking for. You will write often, and you will present what you write to directors and above.

Read the full description

Modis is seeking a Business Analyst for a Contract job with a client in USA (Remote). The ideal candidate will support the design, configuration, enhancement, testing, and optimization of Oracle Incentive Compensation Cloud solutions while partnering with business and technical teams to deliver scalable sales compensation programs.

Rate Range: $58/hour to $60/hour ; The rate may be negotiable based on experience, education, geographic location, and other factors.

Business Analyst Job Responsibilities Include

  • Configure and maintain Oracle Incentive Compensation Cloud solutions to support sales compensation programs and business objectives.
  • Design, build, and configure Incentive Compensation Plans, Plan Components, Performance Measures, Rate Tables, and compensation-related workflows.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical solution designs within Oracle Incentive Compensation Cloud.
  • Configure and support Classification Rules, Assignment Rules, Credit Rules, Incentive Formulae, Flexfields, Web Services, and Compensation setups.
  • Manage Import Management processes related to users, transactions, compensation rules, goals, and incentive-related data.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, sales operations teams, and IT teams to develop effective compensation solutions and process improvements.
  • Support enhancements, upgrades, and new feature implementations to meet evolving business requirements.
  • Create, modify, and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and analytics solutions utilizing OTBI and Data Models.
  • Conduct system testing activities including configuration validation, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production support.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Six to eight years of experience supporting Oracle Incentive Compensation, Oracle Fusion Applications, or Oracle Cloud compensation solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Incentive Compensation Cloud configuration and administration.
  • Deep understanding of Classification Rules, Assignment Rules, Credit Rules, Performance Measures, Incentive Plans, Rate Tables, and Compensation Frameworks.
  • Experience configuring Flexfields, Web Services, and Oracle Incentive Compensation Cloud setups.
  • Strong knowledge of Import Management processes for transactions, users, goals, and compensation-related data.
  • Experience analyzing business requirements and translating them into Oracle Cloud compensation solutions.
  • Experience creating and enhancing reports, dashboards, and analytics using Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) and Data Models.

Preferred Qualifications
