job.name: Software Engineer, iOS
job.description:
About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About The Role As an iOS Engineer at Ramp, you’ll enhance our successful and rapidly growing mobile app. You will improve the core platform that thousands of businesses rely on while also building the future of automated finance by integrating AI and intelligent agents into the mobile experience. This is a chance to grow your skills on a proven product and define the next generation of fintech.

Check out our Engineering Blog for more on our tech stack, mission, and values!

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and launch new products to Ramp’s iOS app.
  • Help establish engineering processes, tools, and systems that allow us to scale the code base and productivity.
  • Conduct code reviews and set engineering standards.
  • Work with Product and Design to identify key features that will make the app successful.
  • Work alongside Product and other cross-functional teams to understand customer feedback and continuously improve our product.

What You Need

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in mobile development.
  • Proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI for iOS development.
  • Experience launching at least one mobile app and/or several features that reached a large number of users.
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced environment, continuously grow, and master your craft.
  • Strong understanding of mobile design patterns and best practices.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with web apps (React, TypeScript).
  • Experience with backend technologies (Python, Flask, SQL, OpenAPI).
  • Experience with our mobile stack in addition to Swift and SwiftUI: Swift Concurrency, The Composable Architecture, Bazel, OpenAPI & Buildkite
  • Experience managing apps with App Store Connect

Benefits Available To All Full-time Ramp Employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO
  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering
  • Health and wellness stipend
  • Budget for intra-office travel
  • Weekly coffee stipend

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend
job.description:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role As a Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack you will be responsible for the development and maintenance of our web application and platform that is used for Fraud analysis. You will be working closely with Product & Design, Solutions Engineering, Data Science, Infrastructure and the Data Platform teams to build new products and enhance our existing suite of products. This role is primarily focused on frontend development (approximately 60–70%), with the remainder involving collaboration across the stack.

This is a remote, US-based role.

Technologies React, Golang, Python, PostgreSQL (RDS), Docker, AWS technologies (Lambda, Cognito and other standard technologies)

job.description:
Always verify and apply to jobs on the official Federal Reserve Board career site or through verified Federal Reserve Board social media channels.

Minimum Education Enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program at an accredited university and returning to continue studies after the internship.

Minimum Experience 0

Summary The Federal Reserve Board (Board) provides students opportunities for career success. The Board’s Internship program is designed to provide valuable work experience for undergraduate and graduate students considering careers including, but not limited to, economics, finance and accounting, information systems, and data analysis. The Board believes that by combining academic endeavors with project-related work experience, qualified and capable college students can gain the practical knowledge need in a competitive global job market. Internships are paid positions with salaries commensurate with credit hours; internships may be in-person, remote or hybrid, depending on the needs of the team. Employment in the Board’s internship program is granted to U.S. citizens. Applicants must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program at an accredited university and returning to continue studies after the internship. Interns receive a syllabus or research project plan outlining their projects and goals for the internship. Interns are assigned a supervisor or mentor to guide them through their internship, and regular check-in meetings with their manager to manage performance expectations and assist with learning goals. Interns have access to a wide range of training programs and events for professional development purposes.

About The Division And Section/Team The Application Design and Development (ADD) section in the division of Research and Statistics (R&S) is an enthusiastic team of UX designers and software engineers that design, develop and support solutions that enable the economic research, analysis, and policy work of the Federal Reserve Board.

About The Role ADD is looking for an intern to work with our team of SharePoint Developers, UX Designers, and Product Managers to help develop simple and complex applications that support collaborative document management and communications practices.

As an intern, you'll develop SharePoint Online solutions using both out-of-the-box tools and custom coding in front-end and back-end programming languages and frameworks including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React JS, SPFx, Handlebars, PowerShell, Bootstrap, and Fluent UI. You'll have the opportunity to leverage modern AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code to accelerate development and generate reusable SharePoint components and solutions.

Job Type Regular

Work Location: Remote - TX - Dallas

Overview 2020 Companies is looking for a Full-Stack Developer Lead: a builder who can also lead. You will design and ship the applications our field teams, clients, and internal teams use, from the database to the screen, on Microsoft Azure.

Most of your week goes to writing code: new applications, APIs, and AI-powered features. The rest goes to leading our development team and the contractors and overseas developers we bring in for specific projects, reviewing their work and setting the standards they build to. You will work directly with the VP of Technology on what gets built and in what order, and you will own what you ship after it goes live.

What We Offer

  • A hands-on role building applications used every day by more than 5,000 field representatives across 60+ client programs
  • A small, technical team where what you build ships and gets used
  • Real work with AI: building features on large language models, not just talking about them
  • Room to grow as the team and its work expand

What's in It for You?

  • Competitive salary
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Generous paid time off
  • Hybrid or fully remote flexibility
  • Ongoing professional development

Job Description Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Stack Development: Design, build, and ship web applications and APIs on Microsoft Azure, from the database to the user interface
  • Prototype to Production: Turn working prototypes into production applications with automated tests, monitoring, security, and a release plan
  • AI-Powered Features: Build features on large language models, such as document intake, search, and assistants, within our AI governance standards
  • Integrations & Data: Connect applications to Salesforce, Workday, and Microsoft 365 through their APIs. Design data models and services that reporting and other teams can rely on
  • Technical Leadership: Run day-to-day development: plan the work, break it into tasks, review code, and clear blockers. Mentor developers and review contractor and overseas work before it ships

job.name: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (JavaScript)
job.description:
Kensho is S&P Global’s hub for AI innovation and transformation. With expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and data discovery, we develop and deploy novel solutions to innovate and drive progress at S&P Global and its customers worldwide. Kensho's solutions and research focus on business and financial generative AI applications, agents, data retrieval APIs, data extraction, and much more.

At Kensho, we hire talented people and give them the autonomy and support needed to build amazing technology and products. We collaborate using our teammates' diverse perspectives to solve hard problems. Our communication with one another is open, honest, and efficient. We dedicate time and resources to explore new ideas, but always rooted in engineering best practices. As a result, we can innovate rapidly to produce technology that is scalable, robust, and useful.

Kensho’s Applications group develops the web apps and APIs that deliver Kensho’s AI capabilities to our customers. Our teams are small, product-focused, and intent on shipping high-quality code that best leverages our efforts. We’re collegial, humble, and inquisitive, and we delight in learning from teammates with backgrounds, skills, and interests different from our own.

Our App Experiences team focuses on breathing life into novel ML capabilities, translating them into valuable and intuitive end-user experiences. We collaborate closely with our Product and Design teams to understand user needs, looking for creative applications and delivery mechanisms of our technology. We demo early and often, and we keep a tight iteration loop. We sweat the details when it comes to UX.

You'll have significant autonomy over technical and architectural choices, and be responsible for managing short- and long-term trade-offs. The ideal candidate loves product and views technology as a means, not an end, and is excited to collaborate across all aspects of the software development lifecycle.

Kensho states that the anticipated base salary range for the position is 150k–225k. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual incentive bonus and equity plans. At Kensho, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

What You’ll Do

  • Build full-stack and SPA TypeScript applications ranging from experiments to flagship products
  • Collaborate on product decisions and communicate technical constraints and considerations
  • Own and collaborate on technology/architecture decisions and conventions
  • Teach and learn from the team and the broader organization via mentorship, code review, knowledge sharing, etc.
  • Self-sufficiently manage project priorities, estimates, and deliverables

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Full-Stack (Arsenal 2)
job.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the full technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system (ArsenalOS) that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.

MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.

This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. job.description:
Company Description By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.

Why join Harvard Medical School? Harvard Medical School's mission is to nurture a diverse, inclusive community dedicated to alleviating suffering and improving health and well-being for all through excellence in teaching and learning, discovery and scholarship, and service and leadership.

You’ll be at the heart of biomedical discovery, education, and innovation, working alongside world-renowned faculty and a community dedicated to improving human health. This is more than a job - it’s an opportunity to shape the future of medicine.

Join our team of researchers, engineers, and designers to shape a future in which humans and AI collaborate to solve the most challenging biological and medical problems!

About The Department Of Biomedical Informatics The HIDIVE Lab in the Department of Biomedical Informatics at Harvard Medical School conducts research at the interface of human and artificial intelligence. We create methods and tools that enable humans and machines alike to interact with and generate insights from biomedical data, combining state-of-the-art biomedical informatics, data visualization, and AI/ML techniques across the full spectrum of biomedical data. An overview of recent publications of the lab can be found on Google Scholar.

We value diverse viewpoints, creative thinking, and bold initiative in a highly collaborative and interdisciplinary work environment. The HIDIVE Lab has an international reputation for creating high impact data visualization tools and we are driven to solve the most challenging design and engineering problems where biomedical data, humans, and AI meet. We would love to have you on our team!

Job Description We are seeking a Software Developer with 1-3 years of professional software development experience who wants real ownership of production software and meaningful exposure to biomedical research. Under the guidance of senior developers, you will help integrate a natural-language conversational AI system for exploring biomedical metadata and visualizations into biomedical data portals, including developing APIs and packages to move visualizations in and out of these systems. You will work with researchers, designers, and engineers to build tools that allow scientists to efficiently query, visualize, and understand complex biological data through natural language and direct interaction with visualizations.

This role offers an opportunity to develop software at the intersection of AI, scientific discovery, and interactive data visualization - contributing to widely used biomedical data resources and community tools.

job.name: Co-tech founder
job.description:
**Technical Co-Founder / CTO – Pocket Coach

Location: Remote / Orlando, Florida preferred

Company Stage: Early-stage, pre-seed startup

Compensation: Initially equity-based, with the intention of establishing a salary following successful fundraising.

About Pocket Coach

Pocket Coach is an emerging human movement intelligence company developing technology that can analyze, interpret and improve human movement through computer vision, artificial intelligence and biomechanics.

Our initial application is basketball, where users can upload videos and receive personalized technical analysis, movement corrections and interactive 3D demonstrations.

Our long-term vision extends beyond basketball into athletics, fitness, physical rehabilitation and human performance.

We have an initial working prototype and are seeking a technical co-founder to help transform the product into a scalable, scientifically grounded technology platform with proprietary intellectual property.

Responsibilities

\* Take ownership of the company’s technical architecture and development.

\* Develop advanced computer vision and human motion tracking capabilities.

\* Build proprietary movement recognition and analysis systems.

\* Integrate biomechanics, machine learning and human pose estimation.

\* Develop technology capable of identifying complex movement sequences, timing, coordination and mechanical inefficiencies.

\* Build automated data collection, annotation, model training and validation systems.

\* Integrate accurate 3D movement visualization and personalized corrective animations.

\* Establish testing systems to measure and continuously improve technological accuracy.

\* Develop scalable infrastructure and protect proprietary technology.

\* Participate in investor meetings, fundraising and strategic company decisions.

\* Eventually recruit and lead the company’s engineering team.

Ideal Candidate

\* Strong background in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence or machine learning.

\* Experience with Python, PyTorch, OpenCV, computer vision or similar technologies.

\* Understanding of neural networks, pose estimation and video analysis.

\* Interest in biomechanics, human movement and sports technology.

\* Ability to independently build, test and deploy complex software.

\* Entrepreneurial mindset with a desire to build something from the ground up.

\* Highly motivated, resourceful and comfortable working in an early-stage startup environment.

Experience with 3D modeling, motion capture, animation, physics engines or human movement research is a significant advantage.

Recent graduates and exceptionally talented self-taught engineers are encouraged to apply. Demonstrated technical ability matters more than years of professional experience.

The Opportunity

Your Job As a Forward Deployed Engineer on the Koch Capabilities Finance team, you will work directly with finance teams to identify opportunities, build AI-enabled solutions, and deliver measurable business value.

This newly created role will accelerate how finance uses AI, automation, data, and software to improve decision-making, financial stewardship, and operational effectiveness. This role is not open to sponsorship or a Visa transfer now or in the future. Our Team Koch Capabilities Finance is global team that sits at the intersection of finance, technology, transformation, and strategy. We modernize how finance work gets done, improve decision quality, strengthen financial stewardship, scale enterprise capabilities, and create capacity for higher-value business partnership.

Our work spans planning, accounting, reporting, controls, enterprise finance applications, data, AI enablement, process transformation, and capability development. We start with meaningful business problems and combine finance expertise, technology, and new ways of working to create value across Koch.

What You Will Do

  • Work alongside finance teams to understand their decisions, data, controls, exceptions, and desired business outcomes.
  • Identify root causes and determine how AI, automation, analytics, data, or software can improve end-to-end workflows.
  • Design, code, integrate, test, and deploy working solutions using real workflows and data while balancing speed, security, reliability, and maintainability.

job.name: Senior Frontend Developer - React/Node.js
job.description:
Build engaging digital experiences. Create modern web applications. Bring great user experiences to life.

The Role

We are looking for a talented Senior Frontend Developer with 6+ years of professional software development experience to join Capco's Technology & Engineering practice in Toronto.

In this role, you will focus primarily on designing, developing and enhancing modern web applications using React, Node.js and JavaScript. You will play an important role in building responsive, reliable and maintainable user interfaces while collaborating with backend developers and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver high-quality technology solutions.

While your primary expertise will be in frontend development, we are also looking for someone with a basic understanding of Java backend development and Spring Boot. You don't need to be a backend expert, but you should be comfortable understanding how frontend applications interact with backend services and supporting integration activities when required.

This is an opportunity to strengthen your frontend engineering expertise, collaborate with experienced technology professionals and contribute to meaningful digital development initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Develop modern frontend applications: Design, build, maintain and enhance interactive web applications, focusing on functionality, usability, performance and maintainability.
  • Deliver high-quality user experiences: Develop reusable interface components, implement application features and ensure consistent, responsive behaviour across supported devices and browsers.
  • Support frontend and backend integration: Collaborate with backend developers to connect user interfaces with application services, troubleshoot integration issues and ensure reliable data exchange.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with developers, testers and other stakeholders to understand requirements, resolve technical challenges and deliver software enhancements.
  • Contribute to engineering excellence: Write clean, maintainable code, participate in code reviews, troubleshoot defects and identify opportunities to improve application quality and development practices.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on frontend application development.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities, with the ability to analyse application issues and implement practical, maintainable solutions.
  • A solid understanding of software development principles, coding standards and the importance of delivering reliable, high-quality applications.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering colleagues and explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A proactive approach to learning, adapting to new technologies and taking ownership of assigned development activities.

  • Programmer les nouveaux modules (AXXO Formation, AXXO Terrain, AXXO Connect).
  • Intégrer l'IA dans l'application.
  • Assurer la maintenance et l'évolution de l'app mobile, du Web et de l'infrastructure AWS.
  • Prendre les décisions techniques avec l'équipe.

Qualifications

  • Full stack pour vrai : de l'interface à la base de données, du serveur à l'app mobile.
  • AWS, c'est ta maison : notre plateforme y roule déjà.
  • Intégration de l'IA dans une vraie app : API d'IA (Claude, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock), lecture automatique de documents (OCR), assistant intelligent.
  • Apps déjà publiées sur l'App Store et Google Play.
  • Mobile multiplateforme (React Native, Flutter ou l'équivalent) et Web moderne (React, TypeScript ou l'équivalent).
  • API solides et intégrations avec d'autres logiciels.
  • Bases de données conçues pour grossir sans casser.
  • La sécurité, c'est un réflexe : authentification, chiffrement, Loi 25.
  • Tu penses au chantier : mode hors ligne, notifications, PDF, codes QR, app rapide sur n'importe quel cellulaire.
  • Tu livres : tu fixes des échéances et tu les respectes.
  • Tu reprends du code existant sans vouloir tout recommencer.
  • Tu utilises l'IA pour coder plus vite.
  • Tu parles français et tu aimes la simplicité extrême.

Scolarité : baccalauréat en génie logiciel, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente démontrée.

Lieu : on cherche quelqu'un basé au Québec. AXXO est située en Mauricie et dans les Laurentides. Le travail se fait surtout à distance, mais tu dois être disponible pour te déplacer au besoin.

Ce qu'on t'offre

  • Une vraie participation dans l'entreprise (des actions), gagnée au fil de tes livrables.
  • Un produit déjà en marché, pas une idée sur une serviette de table.
  • Une équipe qui connaît son industrie à fond.
  • Le contrôle technique du produit : tu deviens le cerveau tech d'AXXO.

Pour postuler : envoie nous tes apps publiées, ton GitHub ou tes projets, et deux lignes sur pourquoi AXXO t'allume, à info@axxo.ca.

job.description:
À propos de Cozey

Chez Cozey, notre mission est de rendre l’aménagement de la maison simple, agréable et rempli de possibilités. Nous créons des meubles élégants et bien pensés qui s’adaptent aux modes de vie en constante évolution, alliant innovation, rapport qualité-prix et service à la clientèle exceptionnel. En tant que marque en forte croissance et principalement en ligne, notre succès repose sur une équipe passionnée par la redéfinition de l’expérience d’achat de meubles.

Pourquoi joindre l’équipe d’ingénierie chez Cozey

Chez *Cozey Engineering* , nous ne faisons pas que développer des logiciels — nous bâtissons la colonne vertébrale d’une opération de commerce électronique moderne, efficace et entièrement axée sur le client. De la commande à la livraison, chaque étape repose sur nos propres systèmes internes qui assurent rapidité, précision et expérience fluide. Notre équipe est responsable de tout : de l’infrastructure opérationnelle et des systèmes de gestion d’entrepôt aux services backend qui propulsent notre site web et notre logistique.

La mission du poste de *Développeur·euse logiciel sénior* chez Cozey

En tant que *Développeur·euse logiciel sénior , relevant du Gestionnaire, Ingénierie logicielle (WMS)* , votre mission est de concevoir et de bâtir les systèmes qui alimentent le parcours post-achat afin d’offrir une expérience client fluide et sans friction. Vous créerez des solutions internes évolutives qui remplacent les outils tiers, assurant rapidité, précision et innovation à chaque étape. En prenant en charge les projets du concept jusqu’au déploiement, vous contribuerez à redéfinir la façon dont nos clients reçoivent leurs meubles en toute simplicité.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités pour notre produit phare — le Cozey Operating System (COS)
  • Créer des outils et plateformes internes pour remplacer les solutions tierces — nous aimons bâtir nos propres systèmes de A à Z
  • Concevoir et déployer des agents IA pour automatiser et simplifier les flux de gestion d’entrepôt
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes des opérations et du produit pour identifier les irritants et lancer rapidement des solutions à fort impact
  • Gérer vos projets de bout en bout — de la conception et l’architecture à la mise en œuvre et au déploiement

Nous aimerions vous rencontrer si vous avez

  • Une solide expérience avec des langages fortement typés, orientés objet ou similaires à TypeScript
  • De l’expérience dans la conception, le développement et l’évolution d’API REST robustes
  • Une forte culture de tests — vous accordez de l’importance aux tests unitaires et de bout en bout
  • Un souci marqué pour la qualité du code, les revues de code et la documentation
  • Une passion pour résoudre des problèmes concrets avec des solutions évolutives et maintenables
  • Une expérience avec AWS (Serverless, SQS, SNS, etc.) est un atout

job.name: AI Generalist
job.description:
There's no job description for this role. That's the point.

We are Softway, A people-first AI transformation firm, so we hire for mindset over résumé: hunger, curiosity, humility and ownership. If you'd rather have a neatly defined role, this isn't it.We're a small team at Softway looking for an AI Generalist, full-time and in office in Bengaluru.

One week you might be shaping a product, the next untangling an internal problem, researching something nobody here has tried yet, building a process from scratch, or figuring out something completely new. You'll work closely with every team across Softway, and how much leverage you create is up to you. Your background doesn't matter: technology, product, HR, finance, sales, GTM, marketing, product marketing, anything. What matters is that you're a curious problem solver who has already used AI to get real things done, and you understand technology well enough to build something meaningful with it. You don't need to be an engineer.

And we don't hire through interviews. If you're genuinely keen, come to our in-person hiring event at our Bengaluru office on December 5. Pick up a real problem nobody has solved yet, build something that works with AI, and present it to us. If it clicks, you might even spend a few days working with us before you join.

Apply 👉 https://www.softway.com/lovexai/builders-day

As a Database Administrator, the role involves ensuring the stability, performance, and reliability of enterprise database environments. A typical day includes managing database configurations, monitoring system health, and optimizing performance to support seamless application operations. Perform performance tuning, including dynamic SQL tuning and access path analysis.

Manage database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning, ensuring business continuity.

Handle DB2 and application problem determination and resolution in production environments.

Design and maintain logical and physical database structures.

Execute regular database maintenance activities such as REORG and RUNSTATS.

Work with DB2 utilities and monitoring tools (e.g., DB2 Administration tools, Omegamon).

Support and manage IBM Db2 Analytics Accelerator for z/OS (IDAA).

Manage and administer Db2 Data Sharing environments in z/OS Sysplex environments

Manage and monitor job scheduling using ITWS (IBM Tivoli Workload Scheduler).

Develop and maintain automation scripts using REXX, CLIST, and JCL.

Design and develop reports/tools to improve operational efficiency.

Ensure high availability of systems supporting large-scale online transaction and batch workloads in 24x7 production environments.

Participate in release management, database upgrades, and environment stability initiatives.

job.name: Lead Software Engineer - Medical OS
job.description:
Mission Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose The Medical OS team builds the software behind every Neko visit, from check-in through the scan to the doctor's conversation with the member. We are building it AI-first: an intelligent clinical platform that prepares personalised briefings, drafts documentation, and handles routine coordination, so clinicians spend their time where they matter most, on clinical judgment and with members. Underneath it all sits a longitudinal health record that gets richer with every scan, the foundation for care that's personal, proactive, and consistent as Neko scales (Member-first, always).

What You'll Deliver In The First 6-12 Months

  • Ship AI-native clinical workflows end-to-end across the stack: personalised pre-briefs, drafted debriefs, and intelligent assessment tools, always with the clinician as the decision-maker (Chase 10X, Not 10%).
  • Build the clinician-in-the-loop flywheel: clinician expertise teaches the system, the system gives clinicians more time with members, and every scan makes care more personal (Tech-enabled, human-centred).
  • Make direct contact with clinicians and members your working pattern: spend time in clinics, understand the work first-hand, and turn what you learn into shipped product (Impact, not activity).

Description Application deadline: Nov 30, 2026

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility or higher.

A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end-to-end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment, combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. They create reusable architectures, patterns, and engineering mechanisms that scale the entire FDE practice. This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active US Government Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility (or higher).

  • Lead technical delivery across customer engagements. Own the technical strategy and execution for complex, multi-workstream customer AI programs. Make architecture decisions that span multiple services and organizational boundaries. Align technical approach with the customer's long-term technology strategy. Requires up to 25% travel.
  • Architect and build production AI systems at scale: multi-agent orchestration, enterprise retrieval systems, and decision intelligence platforms for the most complex engagements. Drive clarity where neither the business problem nor the technology approach is fully defined. Build production systems that handle enterprise-scale traffic and reliability requirements.

A day in the life

A Senior FDE spends the day leading technical delivery inside the customer's environment: setting the architecture direction across workstreams, building alongside customer engineers on the hardest production AI problems, reviewing designs and code, and mentoring FDEs into independent contributors.

job.name: AI/ML Intern - Media
job.description:
We’re building PersonaMatrix.ai , a character and story intelligence platform for studios and streaming services. We’re looking for an intern to help editors find specific moments across films, series and microdramas.

Imagine an editor searching for “a quiet goodbye.” The scene they want shows a character waving from a departing train. One project you could take on is testing whether adding visual cues to transcript search brings that scene to the top of the results.

What you’ll work on

  • Use video frames, dialogue transcripts and speaker information to link characters and story events to timestamps.
  • Experiment with text and video embeddings to improve how search results are ranked.
  • Build a small set of labelled test clips. Measure how often the right scene comes first and how long each search takes.
  • Investigate missed matches with an engineer and help bring a tested improvement into PersonaMatrix Studio.

Who should apply

If you’ve built an ML project in Python and can explain how you tested it, we’d like to hear from you. Coursework, research and personal projects all count. You should be comfortable with Git and an ML library such as PyTorch or scikit-learn. Experience with OpenCV, Hugging Face Transformers or vector search is a plus.

Hiring for Lapmaster Wolters — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Lapmaster Wolters is a global leader in high-precision machine tools and surface processing systems, with a heritage of over 200 years. Its machines lap, polish and fine-grind surfaces for manufacturers in more than 20 industries. The company has 600+ employees, 40,000+ m² of production space and revenue above €250 million.

Lapmaster Wolters is now expanding into advanced semiconductor packaging, one of the fastest-growing segments in chips, driven by chiplet architectures, heterogeneous integration and next-generation compute. The Bengaluru software team builds the software behind this new equipment line.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer II in Software Engineering – Semiconductor Equipment, you'll write the software that drives high-precision semiconductor machines. You'll work where software meets hardware, building control interfaces, operator GUIs and automated system controls that meet semiconductor-industry standards. The role is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru.

What you'll do

  • Design, develop, test and integrate software for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
  • Build C#/C++ DLL interfaces that let customers control the equipment programmatically.
  • Build operator interfaces for the equipment in C# (WinForms/WPF) and C++.
  • Implement hardware control modules over serial interfaces and TCP/IP.
  • Develop and maintain automated system controls for equipment operations.
  • Run system testing, debugging and performance optimisation.
  • Support customers and field teams after deployment, debugging issues on live equipment.

What you bring

  • 3–6 years of professional software development in C# / .NET.
  • Hands-on C# and C++, with strong OOP, design patterns, data structures and algorithms.
  • GUI development with C# .NET (WinForms and WPF).
  • Has built software that talks to hardware (instruments, machines, PLCs or embedded devices) over serial or TCP/IP.
  • Solid multithreading and concurrent programming.
  • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis on complex systems.
  • Familiarity with PLC programming concepts and industrial automation.
  • Version control with GitHub or Azure DevOps.
  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field, and clear written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of SEMI software standards (SECS/GEM, GEM300) and equipment cybersecurity.
  • Experience in regulated or high-precision domains such as semiconductor, healthcare/medical devices or aerospace.

Job Requisition ID # 26WD100856

Position Overview We are seeking an ERP Integration Specialist to join the ERP Connect team, with a primary focus on becoming a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for ERP integrations and supporting the growing number of Autodesk applications and customers using ERP Connect.

The role will develop deep knowledge of ERP Connect and supported ERP systems, acting as a technical bridge between Engineering, Product, Support, QA, customer-facing teams, and external ERP platforms. This is a technical SME and integration support role rather than a primarily software-development role - the strongest candidates will demonstrate excellent API troubleshooting skills, strong Postman expertise, an ability to understand complex integrations, and the communication skills required to work effectively across technical and customer-facing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate and troubleshoot ERP integrations using Postman, logs, observability tooling, and ERP-specific knowledge
  • Work with REST APIs, JSON payloads, authentication, data mappings, and API error responses to reproduce issues, validate integration behaviour, and identify where problems originate
  • Act as a technical bridge between Engineering, Product, Support, QA, customer-facing teams, and external ERP platforms

  • Identify recurring issues and improve ERP Connect documentation and support processes
  • Capture solutions and knowledge gained through investigations in Postman, documentation, troubleshooting guides, and support processes so known issues can increasingly be resolved without specialist Engineering involvement
  • Develop into a deep ERP Connect and ERP integration SME over time

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in API/integration support, technical support, or a related technical role
  • Strong hands-on Postman experience, used as a day-to-day investigation and integration tool
  • REST API, HTTP and JSON expertise
  • API and integration troubleshooting experience
  • ERP or enterprise-system integration experience
  • Technical investigation and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with customer/application onboarding
  • Production support and observability experience
  • Technical documentation and knowledge management skills
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has worked directly with customers or support teams to diagnose API/integration issues, rather than coming from a predominantly software-development background
  • Treats software engineering knowledge as beneficial, but not the focus of the role
  • Shows evidence of using Postman as a day-to-day investigation and integration tool, rather than simply listing Postman as a testing skill

job.name: Senior Backend Engineer
job.description:
Hiring for BRAHMA AI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

BRAHMA AI builds an enterprise AI content platform for media, entertainment and brand content teams. Its BRAHMA AI Core (BAIC) platform grew out of the CLEAR media asset management system and helps organisations ingest, manage, search and localise large libraries of video and media, while BRAHMA AI Studio adds generative AI for content creation. The engineering team in Bengaluru is modernising the core platform and adding AI capabilities across it, and this hire strengthens that work.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend) at BRAHMA AI in Bengaluru, you'll design and build the services behind the BAIC platform: microservices in Go, Python and .NET, the data stores and search that power media workflows, and the React micro-frontends on top of them. This is a full-time, on-site role working directly with BRAHMA AI.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain scalable backend microservices for the BAIC platform in Go, Python and .NET.
  • Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL and MongoDB for media metadata, workflows and assets.
  • Build search over large media libraries with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
  • Build and improve React micro-frontends that sit on top of your services.
  • Deploy to AWS and Azure and keep CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps fast and reliable.
  • Pay down technical debt, modernise legacy platform services, review code and contribute to architecture and documentation.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Strong production backend development in at least one of Go, Python or .NET (C#/ASP.NET). Strength in one is enough; willingness to work across the others is expected.
  • Hands-on React experience, ideally with microservices and micro-frontend architectures.
  • Working knowledge of PostgreSQL/SQL and MongoDB, and of a search engine such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
  • Has deployed and run services on AWS or Azure, with CI/CD in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience building an enterprise SaaS or media-tech product, in an agile team.

Nice to have

  • Experience with media asset management, OTT, video or content platforms.
  • Exposure to integrating AI/ML models into product workflows.
  • Experience modernising legacy services into cloud-native microservices.

job.name: Software Engineering Manager
job.description:
Location: Bangalore, India (hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 from home) · Reports to: Head of Platform Engineering · Team: one Engineering and QA team, 3–6 direct reports

OVERVIEW:

APEXX is an independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform. Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: a cquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation. Our routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost. We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by Finch Capital and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds. We're looking for a Engineering Manager in Bangalore to help build and run the core of that platform.

This role covers everything in orchestration - payment flows, routing, connectors, tokenisation, webhooks and reconciliation - and how we run the platform: reliability, on-call, CI/CD and shared engineering practices. We build it, we run it, and done means released, not dev-complete.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

Hands-on engineering

  • Write and review production code in Java and Spring Boot for a large part of your week, taking work that keeps you off the team's critical path.
  • Guide design across payment flows, routing and cascading, acquirer, APM and BNPL connectors, tokenisation, webhooks and reconciliation, working with your senior engineers on technical design docs.
  • Set the team's engineering standards, including how we use AI coding tools safely.

Delivery and operations

  • Own your team's delivery end to end: planning, estimation, release readiness and follow-through until work is released and stable.
  • Run your team's on-call rota, lead incidents, and make sure blameless RCAs lead to changes that ship.
  • Define and track SLOs and service dashboards for your team's services.
  • Own your team's part of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls: code review before release, change control, patching timelines and secure-coding practice.

People and team

  • Lead, coach and grow a team of engineers and QA: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, honest feedback, performance reviews and career conversations.
  • Hire for the team: run interview loops, calibrate interviewers and onboard new joiners.
  • Build a team where ownership is easy: clear responsibilities, documented decisions and time for improvement work.

Across the business

  • Work with Product, Business Analysis, Solutions, Support and InfoSec to turn merchant and partner needs into plans your team can commit to.
  • Work with the technical teams at our acquirer and APM partners on certifications, changes and outages.
  • Work closely with engineering colleagues in the UK, Portugal and India.

ABOUT YOU:

job.name: Software Engineer
job.description:
About Opal Security

At Opal, we’re building modern identity governance for the AI era—intelligent access management that empowers enterprises to move fast while staying secure. Our mission is to bring clarity, control, and confidence to complex enterprise environments, helping teams govern access without slowing down innovation.

About The Role

Identity is having a moment. Every company is deploying agents, spinning up service accounts, and realizing their IAM stack can't keep up. We're building AI-native security that scales with this chaos and companies like Databricks and Figma are betting on us to get it right.

You will build customer solutions across the entire stack. You'll talk directly to security and eng teams at Fortune 500s and startups alike, understand their messy reality, and architect systems that actually solve their problems. You'll own the problem , not just the solution, which means you get to be creative, challenge assumptions, and build things that don't exist yet.

This is a team of people who genuinely like each other and want to work together. We value thoughtful engineering over speed-running tickets. You'll collaborate with people who have wildly different expertise, debate tradeoffs, and ship work you're proud of.

Please note: We've built a team that works exceptionally well together and has fun doing so. We're looking to bring on new teammates who will both add to and grow with what we're building 🙂

Your Responsibilities

  • Own critical product areas from concept to production: design and build features across our full stack, make architectural decisions, work directly with customers to validate solutions, and ensure your systems scale as we grow.
  • Multiply the team's impact: write code that other engineers build on top of, establish patterns that improve our velocity, share knowledge that levels up the team, and help shape how we build at Opal.

Our Ideal Candidate Loves To

  • Build end-to-end: you can take a customer problem, design the solution, and ship it across frontend and backend.
  • Think creatively: you're not a code monkey or a bot following specs. You question requirements, propose better approaches, and care about the "why" behind what you're building.
  • Thrive in undefined spaces: you get energized by ambiguous problems where there's no playbook. You'd rather figure out what to build than be handed a detailed spec.
  • Talk to customers: you want to understand who you're building for, what they need, and how Opal enables their growth and success
  • Explore a passion or curiosity in IAM / security

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive Salary
  • Early employee equity
  • Top-tier Medical, Vision, & Dental coverage
  • Company and team bonding trips throughout the year fully covered by Opal Security
  • Daily lunch & coffee allowance
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 11 company holidays
  • One Medical Membership
  • 401k plan
  • Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits

This role is based in San Francisco. Remote optional

Backed by leading VCs and prominent founders, they're growing rapidly.

As a Founding Full-Stack Engineer, you'll be the architect of this decision intelligence, owning the algorithms, architecture, and underlying infrastructure. What You Bring

job.name: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
job.description:
Description A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end-to-end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. They create reusable architectures, patterns, and engineering mechanisms that scale the entire FDE practice.

Key job responsibilities

  • Embed within customer engineering teams. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable AI-enabled production systems. Requires 30 – 50% travel.
  • Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — orchestration layers for multi-agent systems, retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, decision intelligence. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, APIs, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, observability, cost, and security.
  • Own production. Take systems from design through production rollout and operationalization. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, data pipelines, and application services. Put in place monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and the operational mechanisms (testing, CI/CD, rollback, resiliency) that keep AI systems healthy at scale.
  • Accelerate customer transformation. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption across customer workflows. Codify reusable patterns, accelerators, and reference architectures that benefit future customers and feed back into AWS.
  • Raise the bar. Mentor engineers. Contribute to AWS engineering best practices for AI and forward deployment. Push reusable components and learnings back into AWS products and services.

job.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
About Us Conversion is the agentic marketing automation platform for modern enterprises such as Plaid, ClickHouse, Webflow, and Productboard. Our platform lets growth teams run their entire go-to-market motion in one place, from acquisition through retention, with AI agents doing the work that legacy tools like Marketo, HubSpot, and Pardot can't.

We've raised $28M+ from Abstract Ventures, True Ventures, and HOF Capital. The team is based in San Francisco and includes engineers, designers, and operators from Airbnb, Palantir, Pinterest, IMC, Shopify, LinkedIn, and Microsoft.

About The Role Hey there! James here 👋, co-founder at Conversion. Just wanted to share my thoughts on the perfect candidate we're looking for to be one our Founding Forward Deployed Engineers.

So what exactly is a Forward Deployed Engineer? At Conversion, they turn enterprise customer needs into working AI deployments. A $100k+ deal does not survive on a nice pitch or a self-serve onboarding flow. It survives if the customer sees value in the pilot. Forward Deployed Engineers partner with Deployment Strategists to build, integrate, and deploy the technology that makes that value real.

  • Technical sales enablement: Partnering with Deployment Strategists and the sales team to scope technical requirements, build proof-of-concepts, and demonstrate how Conversion can solve enterprise customers’ specific challenges.
  • Customer integration and deployment: Building the integrations, data pipelines, and custom functionality needed to connect a customer’s existing marketing infrastructure to Conversion and get them successfully into production.
  • Building for customer success: Working directly with customer teams and Deployment Strategists to translate marketing goals into deployed product features, AI workflows, and technical solutions that deliver measurable results.
  • Shaping product: Working closely with engineering and product to turn lessons from customer deployments into reusable capabilities, helping ensure that what we build for one customer makes Conversion better for many.

This role is in-person 5 days/week in San Francisco .

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have software engineering experience, and prefer staying close to customers while also shipping product
  • Thrive cross-functionally, working alongside engineering, growth, and product
  • Enjoy fast paced and dynamic environments

You Might Be a Great Fit If You

  • Love helping customers, and gain fulfillment from seeing customers thrive and succeed with the products we build

job.name: Founding Developer Relations
job.description:
Weave (YC W25) is building the definitive platform for understanding and improving how engineering teams work. We believe the way engineering output is measured today is fundamentally broken and that modern AI can give teams a far more accurate and actionable view of productivity, impact and collaboration.

Trusted by 200+ customers such as Robinhood, Rho, PostHog and Browserbase, we've delivered consistent double-digit month-over-month revenue growth since May and are looking to accelerate our growth.

As Weave's Founding Developer Advocate, you'll be Weave's voice with the engineers who actually use it. Part engineer, part writer, part community builder. You'll own the open-source Weave Router, the content and demos that teach engineers how to measure AI-era engineering, and the community of developers who make Weave the default in their orgs.

We've raised a $13.5 million Series A and are backed by Standard Capital, YCombinator, Moonfire and Burst Capital.

This is a rare opportunity to join at the ground floor and shape how millions of engineers and leaders understand engineering work.

What We're Building

Weave is rethinking engineering output from first principles.

We Use AI To

  • Understand how engineers actually work (not just what they ship)
  • Surface meaningful insights about productivity, quality, collaboration and impact
  • Help teams improve outcomes without vanity metrics or surveillance

Our goal is not to optimize for "more output," but for better engineering.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll Work Directly With

  • Andrew (CTO) – previously a founding engineer at Causal, MIT alum. Andrew has been in your shoes and is deeply committed to providing the mentorship, ownership and growth he had as an early engineer.
  • Adam (CEO) – leads sales and customer discovery. Adam is a former sales executive at multiple high-growth startups and deeply embedded with customers and scaled multiple sales teams from $0-30M in ARR.

This is a small, intense, highly collaborative team. You will have real ownership from day one.

The Role

This isn’t a traditional developer relations role. The closest thing we can describe it as is a mashup of software engineer, technical writer, video producer, and open-source maintainer.

You own the conversation with the engineers: the tech leads, staff engineers and engineering managers who install Weave and decide whether Weave is a tool they trust or a dashboard their boss bought. Engineers everywhere are asking the same question: "am I actually better with AI, and how would I know?" The person who answers it credibly, with working code and real data, in public, will earn the trust of every engineer we want as a customer. We want that person to be you.

Responsibilities

job.name: Lead Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Job Title – Lead Network Engineer

The Purpose of This Role As a Lead Network Engineer in the NTT team will be responsible for network operations of the network landscape for Fidelity Investments globally.

The Value You Deliver To be a successful candidate, you will need to have a strong understanding of network infrastructure and network hardware. You will also need to be able to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network devices including WAPs, firewalls, routers, switches, and controllers. A deep knowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols is highly desired.

The Skills That Are Key To This Role Technical / Behavioral

  • Experience with TCP/IP, including knowledge of common-service applications.
  • Routed/Routing Protocols: BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VRF, VPNs
  • Strong understanding of network infrastructure and network hardware.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to the network environment
  • Escalating issues as needed
  • Experience with HPE, Cisco routing and switching.
  • Network Engineering and Troubleshooting skills
  • Application Traffic Analysis
  • Switched Protocols: PVST, RPVST, MST, VXLAN
  • WLAN/LAN/WAN engineering and implementation.
  • Experience with ITIL and Project Management.
  • Ability to work in a team environment.
  • Experience with 802.1x configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with 802.1x switch configuration and tuning for Cisco and HP switch platforms.
  • Communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience with Multi-vendor Supplicant configurations.
  • Documentation of complex technologies and topologies based on based practices

The Skills that are Good to Have for this role

  • Experience with Wireshark packet captures
  • Experience with Amazon AWS
  • Microsoft Azure/O365
  • Experience with ExpressRoute configuration and setup (Azure private, Azure public, Microsoft peering)
  • Good to have Scripting skills such as Python, Ansible (not a must)

How Your Work Impacts The Organization You will be responsible for providing Network incident management and resolution work solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks

The Expertise We’re Looking For

  • 7-9 years of IT experience
  • Graduate

Company Overview Fidelity Investments is one of the world's largest providers of financial services. Headquartered in Boston, US, Fidelity's goal is to make financial expertise broadly accessible and effective in helping people live the lives they want. Privately held for nearly 70 years, Fidelity employs 45,000 associates who are focused on the long-term success of our customers. FMR (Fidelity Management & Research) India is the Global Inhouse Center of Fidelity Investments. Headquartered at Bangalore, where operations commenced in 2003, FMR India has another fully functional unit at Chennai. To know more visit: FMR India Location: Chennai

Shift timings : 9:00 am - 5:00pm

job.name: Security Consultant-Identity & Access Management Services
job.description:
Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities As a Security Consultant specializing in Identity & Access Management (IAM) services, you help organizations understand and manage the entire identity lifecycle within their enterprise. You utilize commercially available IAM tools to provide Single Sign-On (SSO) and manage user identities effectively.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Implement Identity Solutions: Utilize IAM tools such as ISIM/ISAM, Cloud Identity/Okta/Sailpoint/MS Entra to create a secure and streamlined identity management system for the organization.
  • Develop Automation Scripts: Create scripts to automate the provisioning and migration of identities across Cloud, OT, IOT, and enterprise IT.
  • Manage Directory Services: Apply proficiency in directory services like TDI and AD to support effective identity management.
  • Support Identity Lifecycle: Provide expertise to manage the entire identity lifecycle within the enterprise, ensuring secure and efficient identity management.
  • Apply Security Protocols: Utilize hands-on experience with SAML, OAuth, and scripting to ensure secure identity management practices.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Exposure to Identity & Access Management Tools: Utilized commercially available IAM tools such as ISIM/ISAM, Cloud Identity/Okta/Sailpoint/MS Entra to provide Single Sign-On (SSO) and manage user identities effectively.
  • Scripting Experience: Developed scripts to automate the provisioning and migration of identities across Cloud, OT, IOT, and enterprise IT using languages such as SAML and OAuth.
  • Directory Services Knowledge: Applied proficiency in directory services like TDI and AD to support effective identity management.
  • Identity Lifecycle Management: Managed the entire identity lifecycle within an enterprise, ensuring secure and efficient identity management practices.
  • Security Protocol Implementation: Utilized hands-on experience with security protocols such as SAML, OAuth, and scripting to ensure secure identity management practices.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

job.name: Specialist, CSIRT
job.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

As a Security Operations Specialist on the Security Operations team, you'll defend Coinbase and its customers against some of the most sophisticated attackers in the world. This team - spanning CDRE, Insider Threat, Blockops and Threat Intelligence - protects billions of dollars in digital assets while scaling security coverage for the next billion crypto users. You'll own frontline incident response, build detection and automation capabilities, and partner across the organization to keep Coinbase safe as it launches new Web3 products globally.

What you'll do:

  • Own second-line triage and response for security alerts, leading incident management through resolution and driving post-incident improvements
  • Build and maintain runbooks for repeatable response patterns, then define and implement automation to eliminate manual toil
  • Partner with teams across Security Operations to develop monitoring strategies informed by attacker investigation findings
  • Drive Security monitoring and incident response for emerging Web3 product launches
  • Strengthen team capabilities by mentoring peers, sharing knowledge, and participating in 24/7 rotational coverage across time zones

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 3+ years of hands-on security operations experience including incident response, alert triage, and network/host forensics across cloud, SaaS, and container environments
  • Demonstrated ability to identify detection gaps and build coverage across diverse log sources (cloud platforms, SaaS applications, container orchestration, M&A integrations)
  • Proficiency scripting automation workflows that reduce manual investigation and response time (Python, Bash, or equivalent)
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS) sufficient to analyze host and network-level artifacts
  • Experience working with SIEM platforms and threat intelligence tooling at scale, including tuning alerts and improving signal-to-noise ratios
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Position ID: P77687

The opportunity : Consultant-CHS-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Digital Risk - Gurgaon

CHS :

CHS consists of Consumer Products and Healthcare sectors.

Consumer products largely entail, Retail and Agri business. Companies in this sector meet the demands of consumers all around the world, every day; providing everything from agricultural crops to food, clothes, durables and retail experiences. We help clients to capture new sources of profitable growth, rethinking how and where they bring value to consumers, today and into the future. Incumbents need to shift their focus from protecting what they have to creating what they need to become.

The Health Sciences & Wellness architecture brings together a worldwide network of professionals to build data-centric approaches to customer engagement and improved outcomes. To retain relevancy in today’s digitally focused, data-infused ecosystem, all participants in the sector must rethink their business practices, including capital strategy, partnering and the creation of patient-centric operating models.

CNS - Risk - Digital Risk :

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :

Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.

Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities.   • Drive the architecture and delivery of critical modernization bets, including YARN to Kubernetes migrations, native vectorization (Gluten/Velox), and Airflow and Data Catalog modernization
  • Lead the implementation of a multi-region and multi-cloud data strategy for high availability, disaster recovery, and Azure Blob Storage compliance
  • Reduce operational burden and maintenance overhead (KTLO) from over 40% to under 10% by shifting fixes into the platform instead of relying on runbooks
  • Foster a culture of operational excellence and mentor engineers at various stages in their careers, up to Staff+

SaaS Applications, working in partnership with Product Management, Architecture and the Cloud Operations teams. job.name: Senior Technical Architect II - Wireline Autonomous Voice Core Network
job.description:
Req Id: 431483

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

Summary We are seeking a Senior Technical Architect to lead the evolution of Voice Core networks towards Autonomous Network (AN). This role will define the architectural vision, roadmap and technology strategy to transform traditional voice core operations into AI-driven, intent-based, self- optimizing and self-healing network systems.

The successful candidate will work across network technology, operations and cloud platforms, data and AI team to establish the future-state architecture and drive adoption of autonomous capabilities across voice core domain.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the autonomous network architecture strategy for voice core domain.
  • Define the long-term vision, target-state architecture and multi-year technology roadmap.
  • Develop domain-specific AN maturity models, capability frameworks, closed-loop automation and transformation plans.
  • Identify the opportunities to leverage AI, GenAI and Agentic AI, analytics and automation technologies to improve operational efficiency
  • Architect and lead implementation of lifecycle management, self-healing, and proactive remediation.

Architectural Leadership

  • Define the target-state architecture for Autonomous Networking, covering closed-loop automation, service assurance, predictive analytics, and intent-driven orchestration.
  • Design end-to-end autonomous network architecture covering:

+ Network observability
+ Telemetry and data collection
+ Intent-based networking
+ AI/ML-driven assurance
+ Self-healing and self-optimization capabilities

  • Define the integration architecture between the voice core platform applications and cloud infrastructure.
  • Define architectural strategy for Unified communication as a service including On‑demand network customization for enterprise and wholesale customers to enable monetization through exposure of network capabilities and intent-based service catalogs.

Technical Governance

This is a delivery role combining project and workstream management, resource coordination, financial management, Agile delivery, waterfall governance, dependency management and program reporting across multiple Cloud Engineering teams.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Stream Leads, Project Managers, Cloud Engineering leaders and supporting teams to drive coordinated delivery against the program's milestones and business outcomes.

  • Contribute to engineering excellence: Participate in technical discussions, identify opportunities to improve application performance and development practices, and support the delivery of maintainable software solutions.

What We're Looking For

  • A solid understanding of software development principles, coding standards and the importance of producing reliable, high-quality applications.
