job.name: Product Engineer - Ads Bidding
job.description:
About Faire Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About This Role Faire's Ads team builds the systems that decide which ads brands show, at what price, and how their budgets are spent. We own the bidding side of the Ads business: auction and bidding logic, budget pacing, spend accuracy, and the infrastructure that keeps all of it fast, correct, and trustworthy.

As an infrastructure engineer on the team, you'll own systems end-to-end: design them, ship them, run them in production, and measure whether they made bidding better for advertisers and retailers. You'll partner with Product, Data Science, ML, and the product engineers who build on top of our platform to shape what we build, not just how it gets built.

This is an ideal role for engineers who enjoy hard systems problems, want to see their work show up directly in revenue and advertiser outcomes, and bring genuine excitement about AI. You'll go deep on how ads bidding works in a wholesale marketplace, where the advertisers are independent brands and the buyers are the retailers who stock them.

What You'll Do

  • Infrastructure ownership: Design, build, and operate the services behind bidding, auction, and budget pacing, from problem to launch and through on-call.
  • Reliability and performance: Build systems that stay low-latency, high-throughput, and correct under failure. Spend accuracy affects advertiser money directly, so you'll treat correctness as a product requirement.
  • Data and feedback loops: Build and maintain the streaming and batch pipelines that feed bidding with fresh, trustworthy signals such as impressions, clicks, conversions, and spend, and contribute to the technical strategy that lets them scale.
  • AI fluency: Use AI tooling as a core part of how you deliver impact, from prototyping and coding to debugging, reviewing, and exploring ideas faster.
  • Observability and experimentation: Instrument what you ship with monitoring, alerting, and SLOs, and partner with Data Science and ML to run experiments and evaluate how changes to bidding systems affect advertiser outcomes.

Qualifications Must-haves

AI Engineer

Who We are

Polar Asset Management Partners is a global multi-strategy asset manager founded in 1991 and headquartered in Toronto. Our teams in Canada, the US, and the UK manage strategies across equities, credit, commodities, rates, and specialized niche markets, with a shared focus on generating strong risk-adjusted returns.

About the Role

The AI Team at Polar is seeking a high-performing AI Engineer to join the team. This team builds and runs the shared foundation that every AI application at the firm depends on: the connectivity, runtime, quality and release infrastructure that lets portfolio management, operations and technology teams ship agentic AI quickly and safely.

What you’ll do

  • Own the AI platform end-to-end, from evaluating vendors and making build-versus-buy calls to deploying scalable, production-grade infrastructure across the firm, grounded in agentic AI best practices
  • Build and operate the full platform surface: the agent framework and developer tooling, MCP servers and gateways, the plugin and skill marketplace, and the authentication and entitlements layer that governs access. Provide the reliability, documentation and support that portfolio management, operations and technology teams depend on
  • Build tracing and evaluation tools so every agent can be tested, monitored and released with confidence
  • Act as a forward deployed engineer, working directly with portfolio management, operations and technology teams to integrate the agent platform into their workflows

What you need

  • 1-3 years' experience developing agentic AI applications, harnesses, MCP servers and workflows, ideally as developer-facing platforms or internal tooling used by other teams
  • Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and GraphRAG pipelines
  • Experience with observability and evaluation tooling such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or Langfuse, plus exposure to identity and entitlements or to software supply chain and package management

What We Offer

  • We invest in you. We develop talent from within through mentorship, training, and hands-on learning. job.description:
Role & responsibilities

We're hiring senior Workday Payroll functional consultants to serve as subject matter experts for a global enterprise client with US Workday Payroll live and planning to roll out third-party payroll across 30+ countries over the next year. As a functional consultant, you'll work with HR, Finance, and IT stakeholders to ensure payroll runs accurately and remains compliant.

  • Configuration: Design, configure, and maintain Workday Payroll, including earnings and deduction codes, pay groups, pay schedules, period schedules, run categories, tax setup, and calculation rules
  • Implementation: Lead requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, prototyping, and deployment for payroll initiatives, new countries, and Workday feature releases
  • Global payroll integrations: Design and test integrations between Workday and CloudPay (PECI/PICOF, Global Payroll Connect), benefits providers, and other pay-input sources. This includes data mapping, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Testing and quality: Build test scenarios and scripts, lead parallel payroll testing, audit results, and fix defects before go-lives and Workday's twice-yearly releases
  • US payroll compliance: Keep configurations compliant with federal, state, and local tax rules, wage garnishments, year-end processing (W-2), and statutory reporting
  • Production support: Serve as the Tier 2/3 escalation point for live US payroll issues, find root causes, and put long-term fixes in place
  • Solution design: Take an AI-first approach to solution design, and contribute design input for custom applications (Workday Extend or external apps) that support payroll operations
  • Stakeholder management: Translate complex business requirements into scalable configurations, and communicate clearly with payroll, HR, Finance, and technical teams
  • Documentation: Maintain configuration workbooks and SOPs, and run knowledge-transfer sessions for payroll administrators

Preferred candidate profile

Must have:

  • 4–6 years of hands-on Workday Payroll functional experience
  • At least 2 full-lifecycle Workday Payroll implementations , plus post-production support experience
  • Deep knowledge of Workday Payroll architecture: run categories, period schedules, payroll accounting and costing, and calculation rules
  • Strong US Payroll experience: multi-state tax, garnishments, year-end and W-2 processing
  • Hands-on experience with payroll integrations: PECI/PICOF and EIB for loads and adjustments, plus testing integrations with outside systems
  • Working knowledge of related modules (HCM, Absence Management, Time Tracking, Benefits) and how they affect payroll
  • Custom reporting with Report Writer and calculated fields

Some careers open more doors than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

Business Descriptor

Our Chief Operating Officer team delivers strategic execution for Corporate and Institutional Banking across the globe. Through transformative data and digital solutions, customer servicing, and non-financial risk expertise, this team is where problems are solved, and careers are made.

Corporate and Institutional Banking Chief Operating Officer focuses on these key priorities:

  • Protecting the Bank, our customers and stakeholders by enhancing our operational resilience, strengthening our control environment, and improving risk management.
  • Driving operational excellence and efficiency by optimising our processes and delivering the transition to net zero in our own operations.
  • Enabling business growth and exceptional service by enabling our businesses to focus on our competitive advantage and deliver transformation and digitisation across the Bank.

Role Purpose

Credit and Capital Management under Corporate and Institutional Banking are in the process of implementing a new, modern and consistent end-to-end operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first-line credit management office, the Business Credit Office.

The Business Credit Office function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors, including the Credit Analysis Unit, Credit Analysts and Relationship Managers, in the management of first-line credit risk responsibilities. These responsibilities include structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendations, client credit monitoring tasks, and credit terms and documentation negotiation with Wholesale Credit and Market Risk and clients. The Business Credit Office will act as a single handoff from a Relationship Manager to the Business Credit Office for all Credit and Lending tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client-facing and customer-service-oriented.

The Business Credit Office Manager provides credit management support to Relationship Managers and Coverage, and facilitates client review and renewal activities. The role is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial analysis and credit analysis on behalf of the Relationship Managers, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end Credit and Lending process.

job.description:
Hiring for J K Shah Classes — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

J K Shah Classes is one of India's best-known commerce coaching institutes. Since 1983 it has prepared over half a million students for CA, CS, CMA, ACCA and Commerce, through 120+ branches and a growing online platform. It is now part of the listed Veranda Learning group and is expanding its centres and online business across India. The finance, people and admissions teams based in Mumbai are growing to support that expansion.

About the Role

You'll be the planning engine of the finance team: budgets, forecasts, monthly MIS and branch economics for a growing network of coaching centres and an online business. The role suits a qualified CA who wants to move from audit or accounting into business finance.

What you'll do

  • Track branch and centre P&L and unit economics: enrolments, fee realisation, faculty and rent cost
  • Prepare management and parent-group reporting packs
  • Build financial models for new centres, pricing and online growth decisions
  • Partner with business heads to set and track targets

What you bring

  • Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA)
  • Has prepared budgets, forecasts or variance analysis for a business, not only statutory accounts
  • Has built a P&L or unit-economics view at business-unit, branch or product level
  • Strong Excel financial modelling
  • Clear written and verbal communication with non-finance stakeholders

job.name: Compliance Manager
job.description:
Job Title: Internal Audit & Risk Advisory

Job Overview

Looking for CA/CMA Semi-Qualified professionals with 1–3 years of relevant experience to join its Internal Audit & Risk Advisory team in Delhi NCR.

The selected candidate will be responsible for executing internal audit assignments, conducting process walkthroughs, evaluating internal controls, preparing Risk Control Matrices, performing control testing and supporting Internal Financial Controls assignments.

The role will also involve identifying process gaps and control deficiencies, preparing audit observations, assisting with SOP development and supporting process improvement assignments across multiple industries.

Candidates with previous exposure to Internal Audit, Risk Advisory, Assurance, Internal Financial Controls or process audits will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Audit Execution

  • Execute internal audit assignments across different business functions and industries.
  • Understand business processes and perform audit procedures according to assigned scope.
  • Review process documentation and supporting records.
  • Perform transaction testing and control testing during internal audit assignments.
  • Identify exceptions, process deviations and control weaknesses.
  • Maintain appropriate audit working papers and supporting documentation.
  • Support completion of assigned audits within defined timelines.

Process Walkthroughs & Control Evaluation

  • Conduct process walkthroughs with client process owners.
  • Understand existing business processes, workflows and control points.
  • Document process flows and key control activities.
  • Evaluate the design and implementation of internal controls.
  • Identify missing, ineffective or inadequately designed controls.
  • Assess process risks and existing risk-mitigation mechanisms.

Risk Control Matrix (RCM)

  • Assist in preparation and updating of Risk Control Matrices.
  • Identify process risks and map corresponding controls.
  • Document control objectives, control activities and testing procedures.
  • Perform control design and operating effectiveness testing.
  • Record testing results and control exceptions.
  • Support remediation tracking for identified deficiencies.

Internal Financial Controls (IFC)

  • Perform Internal Financial Controls testing and documentation.
  • Review financial and operational processes relevant to IFC assignments.
  • Test key controls based on approved testing plans.
  • Document control testing results and supporting evidence.
  • Identify IFC deficiencies and control gaps.
  • Assist in preparing findings and recommendations arising from IFC reviews.

Risk Advisory

job.description:
Job Description The Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Functional Analyst is a key member of the Finance Operations team supporting the Horizon Global ERP platform. This role provides Level 2 functional production support, investigates complex finance-system issues, and delivers controlled configuration changes across Oracle Fusion Financials. Working closely with Finance stakeholders, Global ERP teams, technical teams, and managed service providers, the analyst helps maintain a stable, compliant, and scalable global solution while improving the user experience and supporting evolving business needs

Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 functional support for Oracle Fusion Financials, with primary focus on General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Subledger Accounting, intercompany processing, and related finance processes.
  • Investigate incidents and accounting or transaction exceptions, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate timely corrective actions with internal teams and managed service providers.
  • Monitor, run, and troubleshoot scheduled processes, interfaces, data loads, and integrations that support Finance operations.
  • Support month-end and year-end close activities, including issue triage and resolution of critical processing exceptions.
  • Gather and analyze business requirements, complete fit-gap assessments, and translate approved needs into clear functional specifications and solution designs.
  • Configure Oracle Fusion Financials and deliver controlled system changes in accordance with the global template, governance standards, security requirements, and change-management processes.
  • Assess cross-functional and downstream impacts of proposed changes, including impacts to integrations, reporting, controls, and regional processes.
  • Develop test scenarios and scripts; execute functional, regression, and integration testing; support user acceptance testing; and manage defects through resolution.
  • Support release and deployment activities, including Oracle quarterly update impact assessments, readiness testing, and post-release validation.
  • Partner with development, integration, reporting, security, quality assurance, and testing teams to deliver reliable solutions on schedule.
  • Create and maintain functional designs, configuration records, process documentation, support procedures, and knowledge articles.
  • Provide user guidance, knowledge transfer, and recommendations that improve business processes, system adoption, and operational performance.

Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience

Program Management Senior Specialist is the glue that keeps all the elements of an owned marketing channel campaign (i.e. email) project together. + Kick off and strategically manage campaign development with offshore production team, provide guidance and answers to production team during the production process, manage production timelines.
+ Prepare work orders for the production team and create project estimations for the PMM, managing the approval process for these estimates.

+ Conduct thorough quality assurance (QA) reviews on all deliverables against client specifications before releasing to the PMM
+ Communicate production progress to PMM, facilitate approval of simulations, proofs and prototypes, ensure any changes are implemented after prototype and proof review.
+ Flag issues that arise during the production process and proactively seek solutions.

job.description:
Position Summary The Content Manager serves as the sector-wide credit subject matter expert within the Energy and Industrials Credit pod and owns expert research content coverage requiring credit-specific judgment across the sector. The role identifies the companies, themes and investor questions that warrant coverage; defines and validates the Network Member profiles needed; designs differentiated interview agendas; leads human-moderated one-to-one interviews; and develops recurring programs for execution by Associates. The primary output of this research is the transcript: a written record of each human-moderated interview, published on GLG's Library, our access-controlled research platform, for use by institutional investors.

The role requires an investor mindset and deep credit expertise across E&I Credit , with sufficient knowledge of its major sub-sectors, companies and value chains to evaluate business quality, capital structures, cash-flow durability, downside risk and credit catalysts.

Key Responsibilities Coverage ownership and research agenda

  • Set and maintain the sector-wide credit research agenda for E&I , including priority issuers, sub-sectors, capital-structure themes, catalysts, investor debates and underserved information needs.
  • Identify emerging themes, inflection points and content gaps early, connecting macro and sector developments to issuer-level credit implications.
  • Translate earnings calls, financing and rating developments, conferences, market events, client demand and usage signals into timely interviews and recurring credit content programs.

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. job.name: Growth Hacker
job.description:
Growth Hacker - PM

$110k – $120k • 0.0% – 0.3%

Why Zime

  • Zime is Behavioral AI for Sales Execution. It turns a CRO's strategy and top reps' judgment into the next move in every live deal, then verifies the move was made.
  • 20+ revenue teams deploy Zime. SaaStr Startup of the Year 2026. SOC 2 Type II.
  • Crossed $1M ARR, with 0 churn and 200% NRR. Confirm before posting.
  • Tier-1 investors, a stellar team, and HQ in central Palo Alto.
  • You report to the founder-CEO and work with him closely, AI-native, in the most AI-first market.

Your one target More traffic and more SQLs.

What you'll do

  • Run a steady stream of growth experiments: lead magnets, marketing loops and new channels.
  • Own local Bay Area events, from roundtables to follow-up.
  • Research the market, work out user intent, bring ideas, and ship them.
  • Build your own data and pivots, and write a hypothesis and a learning for every test.
  • Work with engineering when an experiment needs an integration or build.
  • Occasionally join the CEO in customer meetings to hear buyers directly.

You'll thrive if you

  • Think numbers first: you build the pivots, find the story, then act.
  • Are AI-native but not AI-dependent. You do the research, analysis with your judgment first and then use Claude to jam.
  • Have a strategic bent: you think, then do, and you don't brute-force.
  • Work like a PM: you understand the customer, deliver, and measure.
  • Have 1–2 years in growth, marketing, product or similar.
  • Are hungry, self-motivated, and eager to sweat, learn and grow.

This isn't for you if

  • You leave loops open.
  • You need to be chased.
  • You lack ownership and accountability.

Details

  • Comp: $120K fixed + meaningful equity. Your comp grows as Zime and you grow.
  • Trial: We start with a paid 30-day trial. On day one we agree the targets (experiments run, SQLs sourced), and at day 30 we decide together whether to continue full-time.
  • You'll talk with the CEO directly.

The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Tax - In this role, you will be required to prepare, review, and file D. E. Shaw’s hedge investment funds’ income tax returns and issue annual tax information (Sch. K-1s) to investors. You will review tax information to be included in various regulatory filings (tax audits, state tax returns, etc.) and interact with D. E. Headquartered in Munich with about 1,700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure.

About the Role

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code.

What you'll do

  • Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
  • Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
  • Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
  • Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
  • Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
  • Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
  • Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

This is a build-then-run role. 2. Change & Release Reliability

job.name: Software Engineer, Systems and Infrastructure
job.description:
Software Engineer, Systems & InfrastructureOur mission is to create high-quality training data and evaluations so Meta's AI models become and stay state-of-the-art. Our center of gravity is the hardest part of that problem: software that runs on real devices, under real power and timing constraints. Today's models are genuinely weak there, and it's one of the few gaps you cannot scrape your way out of — it takes real devices, real firmware, real bring-up, and a working loop around all of it.That's the center of gravity, not the boundary. This work pulls on infrastructure, distributed systems, developer tooling, OS and kernel, and platform engineering, and the teams here draw on the full range of those capabilities across a broad variety of tracks.About This OpportunityMost infrastructure improves one product. This improves what a model can do, which compounds everywhere that model is used — including back into Meta's own product work. The loop closes on us.Meta is unusually well positioned: very few places have the devices, the people who understand them deeply, and the infrastructure muscle to connect the two. That combination is rare, and it's ours to use. We also intend to be the kind of team that other teams want to build with, so expect to work well outside your own reporting line.

Software Engineer, Systems and Infrastructure Responsibilities:

  • Two things, and they're inseparable: building the software that makes high-quality data possible, and shaping the data itself
  • On the infrastructure side: reliable and reproducible execution environments, deterministic harnesses, virtual and physical device infrastructure, and the pipelines that carry results back into training. This is real systems engineering — isolation, determinism, scale, and at times the awkward problem of running a coding agent against hardware behavior without letting it discover that the hardware isn't real
  • On the data side: defining what a genuinely hard problem looks like, proving a solution is correct rather than accidentally passing, and closing off the ways a model can pass for the wrong reasons
  • Identify and build shared tooling and automation that reduces per-task authoring cost over time, with measurable improvements in team efficiency
  • In general:
  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance system components including distributed services, storage layers, runtime environments, or platform infrastructure
  • Own end-to-end technical design for systems projects, evaluating architectural trade-offs and driving decisions that balance performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to define requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions
  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to organization-wide engineering programs
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt, drive codebase migrations to completion, and improve developer tooling and automation to accelerate team velocity

In this role, you will augment NVIDIA's internal software/firmware and quality teams with a dedicated CSP-facing focus. You will drive work streams with CSP engineering teams to build shared understanding of reliability software/firmware architecture, methodology, incorporate their fleet telemetry and failure data into NVIDIA's improvement priorities, and validate that reliability improvements measured in the lab translate to real customer environments. Your cross-CSP visibility enables you to distinguish systemic architectural gaps from environmental or configuration-specific issues that no single customer engagement could identify alone.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Drive reliability work streams with CSP engineering teams — ensuring shared understanding of MTBI measurement methodology, failure classification, and health monitoring architecture

job.description:
About Etched Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference . Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary You'll be one of Etched's first Site Reliability Engineers, building the command-and-control layer for our fleet of frontier inference systems: the alerting, automated recovery and fleet data that keep clusters serving, and the routing that gets each problem to the right expert. Our Supercomputing and Infrastructure teams build the fleet management, rollout and telemetry backbone; but you'll decide which signals define a healthy system, set how we alert and respond, and build agentic hardware health workflows on top of it.

Your job is to design and run a scalable system. Fleet SREs own detection, first response and handoff; domain SREs embedded in each team own the deep product fixes. Over time, most problems should be caught by an alert that measures what users experience, which is then triaged by agents, and sent to an engineer as needed, with the logs, dashboards and recent changes already attached.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define what a healthy inference system looks like. In collaboration with software teams building out management and telemetry systems, identify the signals that most clearly show an unhealthy site, rack, node or chip, keep refining them as the fleet changes, and decide which actions (drain, cordon, restart, reroute, roll back) run on their own and which page a person.
  • Set a common alerting standard. Define SLOs with each team (latency such as time to first token, error rate, availability), alert on user-facing symptoms, and verify that the metrics behind each alert measure what the alert assumes.
  • Cut alert noise. Suppress expected alerts during deploys and maintenance automatically, correlate related alerts into one incident, and retire pages nobody acts on.
  • Automate recovery. Turn runbooks into agentic hardware health recovery: service restarts, node drain and traffic shift, spare swaps. Build it with guardrails (scoped permissions, rate limits, blast-radius checks, an audit trail)..
  • Route every event to the right engineer. Classify events by domain, page the right domain SRE with context attached, and dispatch on-site technicians for physical work such as tray swaps, reseats and leak response.
  • Shape the fleet data. Work with Supercomputing and Infrastructure, who build the telemetry pipeline, so it captures the key signals. Set the tracing standard (OpenTelemetry) so every service can be followed end to end, and report uptime and reliability trends that drive engineering and capacity decisions.
  • Run operationally excellent incident

job.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER (HIGH PERFORMANCE COMPUTING) SpaceX HPC is a shared compute platform used across the company — vehicle and structures simulation, machine learning, AI inference, and more. We support every program at SpaceX to design and operate the worlds most advanced rockets and satellites. This role exists to put a real Site Reliability Engineer operating model on these capabilities and accelerating the world class engineering at SpaceX: toil reduction, automation, observability, and a sustainable incident process.

We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who wants to own everything from Linux machines and our Infrastructure as Code, storage, and user facing applications – the whole ecosystem as a product, not as a ticket queue. You do not need a prior HPC title. You do need production instincts — you have operated real infrastructure, you write code to delete toil, and you care about whether users can actually get work done, not just whether nodes ping. You’ll work alongside HPC systems engineers who design and commission clusters to help make them more reliable and provide world class services for world class engineers.

Aerospace experience is not required. We value engineers who treat teammates with fairness and respect, who are self-critical, and who will take ownership of hard production problems.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation; practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems

Role Summary The Staff Site Reliability Engineer applies software engineering and systems engineering practices to improve the reliability, resilience, scalability, and operational health of production services. Even with more than 8,500 people, 130 U.S. locations, and a global reach, we promise to know you and help you.

CLA is dedicated to building a culture that invites different beliefs and perspectives to the table, so we can truly know and help our clients, communities, and each other.

About The Role CLA is seeking to hire a Site Reliability Engineer to join our growing technology team. This position will design, implement, and support reliable, scalable, and secure production systems. The Site Reliability Engineer will combine software engineering principles, operational expertise, and automation practices to improve system availability, performance, and resilience.

This role will partner closely with development, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to reduce operational risk, accelerate software delivery, and ensure the stability of business-critical services.

As a Site Reliability Engineer, You Will

  • Design, implement, and maintain reliability engineering practices that improve the stability, scalability, performance, and security of production environments.

job.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER (STARSHIELD) At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy the Starshield constellation. Starshield is the world’s largest US government satellite constellation and is tasked with providing immediate access to critical intelligence and national security data for the US government anywhere on the globe. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – receivers that allow users to connect within minutes, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starshield's global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help us further our ambitious goals.

As an engineer focused on Starshield's software and GPU infrastructure, you will design, operate and scale the infrastructure which supports critical national security missions. These positions cover a variety of areas ranging from Site Reliability Engineering, Developer Operations, and GPU platforms. You will develop automation to deploy and manage on-premise compute resources, create highly scalable and maintainable software products, and directly collaborate with engineering across the board.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and provide support for GPU as a service for external customers on bare metal hardware and virtualized platforms
  • Design, validate, and productize solutions for AI clusters (100k+ GPU scale)
  • Develop automation to deploy and manage on-premise Kubernetes\AI clusters, and operating systems
  • Deploy and manage core infrastructure such as databases, monitoring and distributed storage
  • Closely collaborate with AI engineers to create highly scalable, operable, and maintainable products
  • Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services -- from inception and design, through deployment, operation and refinement
  • Monitoring and alerting supporting systems to have high availability

Job Description Who are we looking for? We are looking for a Technical Application Support Specialist to provide advanced Tier 2 support to our external customers for issues affecting our SaaS applications and services.

This is an external, customer-facing role. You will be the technical expert our customers speak with directly, spending much of your day on calls, video meetings, and email, working through their issues in real time. If you enjoy live conversations and are a structured problem solver who can troubleshoot across the full application stack, this role is for you.

Working with Development, QA, Product, Operations, Security, and other technical teams, you will resolve issues within Tier 2 where appropriate or provide well-documented escalations that enable efficient action.

The role can be based in our offices in Waterloo, or Toronto or Ottawa.

Hybrid work Model : Be part of the dynamic culture! Our workplace thrives on a hybrid model, combining in-office collaboration and flexibility. Join us in the office three days a week to contribute, connect, and excel in our vibrant environment.

Working with an energetic and high-performing team, this position offers a variety of work and will see you involved in:

  • Own Tier 2 customer incidents from acceptance through resolution, validated workaround, or technical escalation.
  • Work directly with external customers by phone, video, and email to gather technical and business context, ask targeted questions, guide troubleshooting, and translate technical findings into clear, practical language.
  • Assess incident scope, severity, business impact, and priority, and coordinate the response through established support processes, including during high-impact production incidents.
  • Use logs, browser developer tools, HAR files, network traces, SQL queries, monitoring platforms, and other diagnostic tools to isolate failures and distinguish product defects from configuration, data, infrastructure, integration, permissions, browser, or customer-specific issues.
  • Develop targeted SQL queries, scripts, or lightweight diagnostic utilities to support investigation, and apply and validate approved configuration or data corrections within established production change and security controls.
  • Determine whether an issue can be resolved within Tier 2 or needs escalation, and prepare high-quality escalations with reproduction steps, logs, environment details, business impact, findings, and troubleshooting already completed.
  • Give customers and internal stakeholders clear, timely, professional updates on findings, next steps, workarounds, and realistic expectations.
  • Create troubleshooting guides and knowledge articles, identify recurring issues, and mentor Tier 1 team members to improve technical capability and escalation quality.

multiple initiatives forward.

architectures. You must be comfortable operating in many different tech stacks, quickly learning

modernization needs.

over time.

job.description:
L'opportunité Nous recherchons un(e) développeur(euse) de logiciels sénior pour se joindre à notre équipe Industry Engineering à Montréal et devenir la première personne dédiée à l'intégration OpenUSD de Unity. L'USD (Universal Scene Description) s'impose peu à peu comme la norme pour échanger des données 3D dans les secteurs de la fabrication, de la robotique et de la simulation. Vous serez responsable de la couche qui permet à Unity de lire, d'écrire et de convertir en aller-retour des stages USD, y compris la synchronisation en direct entre Unity et des outils de simulation externes.

Ce rôle vous offre une réelle autonomie. Vous façonnerez l'architecture et l'API de l'intégration, vous la maintiendrez fiable à long terme et vous collaborerez étroitement avec nos équipes de gestion des actifs numériques et de conversion de données 3D. Voyez la liste ci-dessous comme un point de départ, et non comme les limites du poste. Si vous aimez créer un produit où le C++ natif et le C# se rencontrent, joignez-vous à nous.

Ce que vous allez faire

  • Assumer la responsabilité d'une couche d'intégration C# au-dessus des bibliothèques natives OpenUSD, y compris l'interopérabilité native, la surface d'API et les builds multiplateformes (Windows, macOS, Linux), et la faire évoluer
  • Concevoir l'importation, l'exportation et la conversion aller-retour de stages USD dans l'éditeur Unity et à l'exécution, en couvrant les arcs de composition, les variantes, les payloads et la physique
  • Développer la synchronisation de scène en direct entre Unity et des outils de simulation externes basés sur USD
  • Rendre l'importation USD rapide et fiable sur des scènes industrielles volumineuses, tirées de cas réels
  • Corriger les bogues et ajouter des fonctionnalités, en gardant à l'esprit le coût de maintenance à long terme et la qualité de la documentation
  • Décomposer des problèmes complexes qui touchent plusieurs composants et équipes, puis travailler avec les responsables concernés pour les résoudre
  • Collaborer avec les équipes produit, partenaires et relations clients afin de transformer de vrais flux de travail USD industriels en fonctionnalités

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Solide expérience professionnelle en C# et en C++, y compris en interopérabilité native (P/Invoke ou équivalent)
  • Expérience concrète d'OpenUSD : stages, layers, composition et schémas
  • Bonnes bases en 3D : graphes de scène, transformations, maillages et matériaux
  • Expérience de la livraison et de la maintenance de bibliothèques natives sur plusieurs plateformes
  • Expérience éprouvée de la prise en charge d'une bibliothèque ou d'une base de code de bout en bout, de la conception à la maintenance à long terme
  • Enthousiasme pour l'utilisation d'outils d'IA dans votre propre travail de développement

Vous avez peut-être également

job.description:
New Value Solutions, a national IT consulting firm, is seeking an experienced Software Developer with strong hands-on expertise in C#, .NET, Microsoft Azure, and microservices development for a potential long-term engagement.

The successful candidate will contribute to the development, enhancement, testing, and deployment of enterprise applications and services within a Microsoft Azure environment. The role requires practical software development experience, including contract-first development practices, established design patterns, and event-driven microservices.

Work is expected to be primarily remote, although onsite attendance in Ottawa may be required depending on assignment requirements.

job.description:
Relevant du Directeur du développement, le ou la titulaire du poste participera à la conception, au développement et à l’intégration de solutions de vision numérique exploitant l’intelligence artificielle pour une vaste gamme de systèmes d’automatisation industrielle.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Concevoir, développer et intégrer des solutions exploitant l'intelligence artificielle afin d'améliorer les performances, la robustesse et la flexibilité des systèmes de vision.

  • Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique liée aux projets.
  • Planifier et organiser son travail afin de respecter les échéanciers, les budgets et les objectifs de performance des projets.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de robotique, d'automatisation et de développement logiciel afin de livrer des solutions robustes, performantes et innovantes.

Qualifications

  • BAC en génie informatique, génie logiciel, génie de la production automatisée ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Connaissance d’une ou plusieurs librairies de traitement d’images et de nuages de points (OpenCV, PCL, Halcon, etc).
  • Expérience pertinente en vision 2D et 3D.
  • Expérience pertinente en intelligence artificielle.
  • Excellente maîtrise du langage de programmation C#.
  • Expérience en conception et développement d’applications logicielles
  • Familiarité avec les pratiques de développement logiciel : gestion du code source, revue de code, tests unitaires et débogage.
  • Excellente maîtrise du français.
  • Bonne maîtrise de l’anglais car la nature du poste exige de communiquer fréquemment avec des clients aux États-Unis
  • Aptitude à communiquer efficacement avec l’équipe dans le cadre de projets complexes

ATOUTS

  • Maîtrise des langages de programmation C/C++ et Python.
  • Détenir un permis de conduire valide.
  • Détenir un passeport valide.

job.name: Technical Application Support Specialist
job.description:
Job Description Who are we looking for? We are looking for a Technical Application Support Specialist to provide advanced Tier 2 support to our external customers for issues affecting our SaaS applications and services.

This is an external, customer-facing role. You will be the technical expert our customers speak with directly, spending much of your day on calls, video meetings, and email, working through their issues in real time. If you enjoy live conversations and are a structured problem solver who can troubleshoot across the full application stack, this role is for you.

Working with Development, QA, Product, Operations, Security, and other technical teams, you will resolve issues within Tier 2 where appropriate or provide well-documented escalations that enable efficient action.

The role can be based in our offices in Waterloo, or Toronto or Ottawa.

Hybrid work Model : Be part of the dynamic culture! Our workplace thrives on a hybrid model, combining in-office collaboration and flexibility. Join us in the office three days a week to contribute, connect, and excel in our vibrant environment.

Working with an energetic and high-performing team, this position offers a variety of work and will see you involved in:

  • Own Tier 2 customer incidents from acceptance through resolution, validated workaround, or technical escalation.
  • Work directly with external customers by phone, video, and email to gather technical and business context, ask targeted questions, guide troubleshooting, and translate technical findings into clear, practical language.
  • Assess incident scope, severity, business impact, and priority, and coordinate the response through established support processes, including during high-impact production incidents.
  • Use logs, browser developer tools, HAR files, network traces, SQL queries, monitoring platforms, and other diagnostic tools to isolate failures and distinguish product defects from configuration, data, infrastructure, integration, permissions, browser, or customer-specific issues.
  • Develop targeted SQL queries, scripts, or lightweight diagnostic utilities to support investigation, and apply and validate approved configuration or data corrections within established production change and security controls.
  • Determine whether an issue can be resolved within Tier 2 or needs escalation, and prepare high-quality escalations with reproduction steps, logs, environment details, business impact, findings, and troubleshooting already completed.
  • Give customers and internal stakeholders clear, timely, professional updates on findings, next steps, workarounds, and realistic expectations.
  • Create troubleshooting guides and knowledge articles, identify recurring issues, and mentor Tier 1 team members to improve technical capability and escalation quality.

What You’ll Bring

Insight Global is looking for a C#/.NET Front Office Developer to support a Rates Trading desk by building and enhancing strategic applications focused on risk, P&L, reporting, and valuation. job.name: Développeur(euse) C# / C# Developer
job.description:
Description générale du poste:

Le rôle du Développeur(euse) C# est de développer, modifier et maintenir des programmes complexes qui produisent différents produits interreliés. Par exemple, des dessins d’atelier, des configurations de connaissements, des détails de fabrication, etc. Le Développeur(euse) C# fait aussi l’analyse de programmes pour en vérifier la viabilité et développer de nouveaux programmes ou des programmes alternatifs. De plus, il offre du soutien aux utilisateurs pour identifier leurs besoins et participe aux propositions de modifications techniques (PMT).

Tâches spécifiques:

  • Valider les besoins de projets en révisant les objectifs, les données entrées et les résultats attendus, conjointement avec l’analyste, le superviseur et le client.
  • Convertir l’information du flux de travail en langage de programmation.
  • Exécution de tests pour analyser l’opération de programmes, suivi de modification des séquences et/ou du code.
  • Préparation d’outils de référence pour les utilisateurs, particulièrement sous forme d’instructions opérationnelles. Présentation d’un plan du processus et des procédés requis, ainsi qu’une estimation du nombre d’heures requis pour la complétion du projet.
  • Maintenir les registres et révisions de documents en lien avec le développement de programmes.
  • Analyser les applications en place pour faciliter les efforts d’intégration. Prendre en charge la résolution de problèmes dans le système et ses applications. Agir en tant qu’expert en la matière au sujet des plans d’intégration et d’implantation.
  • Définir les échéances de développement de produits.
  • Fournir de la formation aux utilisateurs, au besoin.
  • Identifier les défauts le plus tôt possible en faisant des inspections du code, le tout dans le but de prévenir les défauts futurs.
  • Participation au révisions de concepts – amélioration du code.
  • Travaillez en collaboration avec les autres membres de l'équipe pour les aider dans leurs tâches de développement.
  • Création d’applications pour permettre aux utilisateurs d’accéder à l’information contenue dans les bases de données, et de la modifier.
  • Modifier les applications pour rendre les applications le plus faciles à utiliser possible.
  • Obtenir l’information nécessaire au codage et à la complétion d’applications et de projets, au besoin.

Éducation : Diplôme en informatique ou en mathématique, ainsi qu’une connaissance des langages de programmation.

Expérience : 3+ années d’expérience en programmation. 1 à 2 années d’expérience dans un domaine de fabrication, un atout.

Logiciels/Langages/Programmation :

Requis : C#; SQL Server; XML, Visual Studio, SSRS

Atout : Solidworks, Python

job.name: Software Developer (.NETCore and React)

Location: Ontario, Canada

Description Veriforce is the fastest-growing SaaS-technology and services company in the global supply chain risk management market. We help industry-leading companies create and maintain operating cultures and work environments that optimize safety, promote sustainability, and foster collaboration across a broad spectrum of internal and external stakeholders. What separates Veriforce from the rest is our people. We hire growth-minded individuals that team well and continuously look for new, better ways of solving business challenges. If this sounds compelling, keep reading.

The Role You’ll Play Veriforce is seeking an experienced full stack developer to help design and develop applications for our SaaS platform. You will join a growing team of talented front-end, back-end, and DevOps engineers, to expand the software-as-a-service offerings.

What that means day-to-day: • Participate as a key member of a small, collaborative full-stack engineering team.

Camera Vision Software Engineer

*Job Description* Responsible for developing and implementing computer vision algorithms to solve specific problems using image and video processing, feature extraction, object detection and tracking, and semantic segmentation. Leverages techniques such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), deep learning, and traditional computer vision algorithms to develop robust and accurate solutions. The role involves developing and refining algorithms using platforms like TensorFlow or OpenCV, writing and maintaining production-quality code, performing ablation studies, and documenting technical processes. Collaboration with cross-functional teams ensures system integration and troubleshooting, while regular evaluation and improvement of models maintain high accuracy and efficiency within engineering projects.

· Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Lyft is looking for software engineers from a scope of disciplines. job.name: PhD Researcher, HCI & Visualization Research
job.description:
Job Requisition ID # 26WD101057

Position Overview Graduate internships will explore new areas of technology and help Autodesk (as well as the academic community) understand how emerging technologies can be leveraged to improve creation and design processes. Within the Future AI Experiences and HCI & Visualization research groups, you and your mentor(s) will arrive at a mutually agreed upon research project in the area of human-computer interaction or data visualization. Over the course of the internship, you will drive that project forward with guidance from your mentor(s), including implementation, experimental validation, data analysis, etc. Specific areas of interest for research projects include: Human-AI Collaboration, Agentic Co-Creation, User Interfaces for Generative AI or Machine Learning Systems, Information Visualization, Software Learning, Future of Work, Generative Design Tools, Interactive Fabrication, Augmented Reality, and Virtual Reality.

Based in Canada or USA.

Responsibilities

  • Support the research and design efforts by developing software prototypes and explore concepts
  • Conduct literature reviews
  • Gather requirements and issues to explore and design
  • Develop algorithms
  • Build prototypes to test and explore concepts
  • Conduct experiments to test research ideas and hypotheses
  • Measure human performance and cognition limitations related to interaction with technology
  • Conduct usability studies, ethnographic studies, heuristic evaluations, task analyses, structured interviews and surveys
  • Evaluate research findings and prototypes to make recommendations for impacting business and products.
  • Explore new prototyping frameworks and technologies
  • Author a full research paper
  • Produce an accompanying research video
  • Present the results of your research externally and internally

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science or related field, with a specialization in Human-Computer Interaction, and at least one academic term to complete post internship
  • Demonstrated expertise in the area of interactive technologies, with peer-reviewed publications on the topic in international venues
  • Strong communication skills and teamwork experience
  • Very strong technical skills in building software prototypes

Preferred Qualifications

job.name: Consultant senior - Modernisation des applications | Sr. Consultant - Application Modernization, AWS Professional Services
job.description:
Description L'équipe AWS Professional Services (ProServe) recherche un Consultant en livraison – Modernisation d'applications expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe chez AWS. Dans ce rôle, vous collaborerez étroitement avec les clients pour concevoir, développer, mettre en œuvre et moderniser des applications afin de tirer pleinement parti du cloud AWS, notamment via les techniques de modernisation accélérées par l'IA générative (GenAI). Vous serez un acteur clé de la réussite des clients dans leur adoption du cloud, en apportant votre expertise technique et les bonnes pratiques à chaque étape du cycle de vie des projets.

En tant que Consultant en livraison – Modernisation d'applications, vous mettrez votre expertise au service de la conception d'architectures complexes, évolutives et sécurisées, taillées sur mesure pour chaque client. Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec les parties prenantes pour recueillir les besoins, évaluer les applications existantes et proposer des stratégies de migration efficaces vers AWS. Conseiller de confiance de nos clients, vous les guiderez sur les tendances du secteur, les technologies émergentes et les solutions innovantes, et piloterez la mise en œuvre des projets en garantissant le respect des bonnes pratiques, l'optimisation des performances et la maîtrise des risques tout au long du projet.

L'organisation AWS Professional Services est une équipe mondiale d'experts qui aide les clients à concrétiser leurs objectifs métiers grâce au cloud AWS. Nous collaborons avec les équipes clientes et le réseau de partenaires AWS (APN) pour mener des initiatives cloud en entreprise. Notre équipe propose une gamme de prestations qui aide les clients à atteindre des résultats concrets dans leur adoption du cloud en entreprise. Nous apportons également des conseils ciblés via nos pôles d'expertise mondiaux, couvrant un large éventail de solutions, de technologies et de secteurs d'activité.

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant – Application Modernization, to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, develop, implement and re-engineer applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud, including GenAI-accelerated modernization techniques. You'll be a key leader in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

job.description:
About The Company At IBM Software, we turn complex client challenges into technology that helps businesses and society move forward. Our teams build AI-powered, cloud-native products and work across industries to support organizations as they adapt, innovate, and grow. A culture of curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning gives IBMers opportunities to develop their skills and contribute to work with global reach. In this role, you will contribute to a data streaming platform where information moves in near real time, helping companies respond quickly, build smarter services, and create more dynamic customer experiences.

About The Role As a Senior Software Engineer II, you will take ownership of critical backend systems that support a cloud-based data streaming platform. You will help design, build, and operate a highly available, scalable metadata store that serves as a source of truth for services across the platform. Its low-latency read and write APIs, together with real-time data streaming, underpin customer-facing and internal capabilities.

You will work on foundational distributed systems challenges, including availability, consistency, sharding, and scaling across regions and cloud environments. The broader goal is to provide a dependable, self-service metadata platform that can replace isolated, team-specific data stores. You will independently move projects from problem discovery through design, delivery, and operation, partnering with colleagues who value thoughtful debate, direct feedback, and shared ownership. This position is based in Canada and requires authorization to work in Canada without sponsorship.

Qualifications

  • At least six years of industry experience designing, building, and operating large-scale backend services in production.
  • Strong programming and algorithmic skills, with proficiency in Go or a comparable programming language.
  • Demonstrated understanding of concurrency, correctness, and techniques for identifying and preventing race conditions.
  • Practical experience with distributed data stores such as DynamoDB, Cosmos DB, Spanner, Cassandra, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience developing or operating services in at least one major cloud environment: AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
  • Knowledge of observability and operational excellence, including service-level objectives, on-call practices, incident response, and postmortems.
  • Strong ownership, self-directed execution, and the ability to deliver effectively in a fast-paced platform team.
  • Commitment to sound engineering practices, including testing, code review, documentation, and clear written and verbal communication.
  • Preferred: familiarity with Kubernetes operators and controller patterns.
  • Preferred: experience with event streaming concepts or platforms, including Kafka, event ordering, idempotency, and at-least-once or exactly-once delivery.

job.name: Senior / Lead Software Engineer - Agentic Red Teaming (AI Harness, Offensive Tooling)
job.description:
Senior / Lead Software Engineer - Agentic Red Teaming (AI Harness, Offensive Tooling)

  • Company: AI Security Startup
  • Location: Bay Area, Hybrid 3 days a week
  • Level: Senior or Lead
  • Salary: Up to $300,000 base + equity (depending on level & experience)

Build the attacker that breaks AI agents before real attackers do.

The role

Version one of the attack engine is live and doing well with customers. You'll build version two and make it fully autonomous: planning, tool use, safe execution at scale, and knowing whether an attack actually worked. You'd be the first engineer on a new team of two or three leading this.

  • Build the second version of the attack engine from the architecture up
  • Own the design, not a ticket queue. You decide how it works
  • Turn what the research team discovers into reliable production software
  • Test it against a wide range of agent archetypes, the way real attackers will meet them

Who we're looking for

You're probably right for this if you're one of these:

  • An engineer who built an attack or red team agent, at a company or in the open: something that plans, runs and checks attacks on its own
  • A builder of the attack engine at an offensive security or AI pentesting vendor. You write the scanner, the exploit automation or the orchestration
  • A contributor or maintainer of an open-source LLM or agent red teaming tool
  • A software engineer who built an agent harness or runtime (coding agents, orchestration, tool-use frameworks) and wants to point it at security
  • A red team tooling engineer (C2, implants, fuzzers, exploit frameworks) who writes production-grade code

Whichever you are, you have:

  • Senior level engineer, writing production code every day (Python or Go)
  • Built something that runs agents or automates attacks, and you can show it
  • Worked on systems that had to be fast and survive real load
  • Built with AI daily

Why this one is different

Every enterprise is shipping AI agents. Almost none know how those agents can be attacked, and the tools built to test systems were designed for networks and web apps, not for agents that reason, use tools and act on their own.

This company secures AI agents for Fortune 500 enterprises and frontier AI labs. Revenue grew more than tenfold last year, and a major round closed this year, backed by top-tier venture firms and strategic investors from financial services and enterprise software.

job.description:
Company Description Veza is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents. For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry.

Job Summary In our firmware role, you will help develop firmware for our chips, designed to run large AI models efficiently. You’ll work across the stack—from low-level drivers, hardware interfaces, and system initialization code to integration with runtime libraries and model-execution frameworks. Your work will focus on making the hardware operate reliably and at peak performance, enabling high-throughput inference and training workloads. You’ll collaborate with hardware, architecture, and software teams to bring up new silicon, validate features, and support real-world AI applications. We are looking for Spring '27, and Summer '27 interns.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • Progress towards a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Proficiency in C/C++ or Rust
  • Strong fundamentals in data structures and algorithms
  • Strong understanding of low-level software engineering
  • Strong understanding of hardware/software co-design
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Strong Candidates May Also Have (Nice To Have Qualifications)

  • Experience with Linux internals, kernel development, or driver debugging
  • Experience with hardware diagnostics or interpreting hardware logs
  • Exposure to server virtualization or CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with Rust or embedded development

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification.

Program details

  • 12-week paid internship
  • Generous housing support for those relocating
  • Daily lunch and dinner in our office
  • Based at our office in San Jose, CA
  • Direct mentorship from industry leaders and world-class engineers
  • Opportunity to work on one of the most important problems of our time

For any questions, contact internships@etched.com

How We’re Different Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

Job Description:

"REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

MANAGERIAL & COLLABORATION SKILLS

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend
job.description:
Location: Ottawa or Toronto, On-Site

Reports to: Head of Software

Type: Full-Time

The Role The people using our software are in the field, under pressure, with little time and no patience for a confusing interface. This is mission-critical front end work for Canadian defence, not business analytics or dashboards. Every screen has to be clear, fast and trustworthy when it counts. In this role, you build the UI that lets them get their job done. You take the front end from the operator's workflow to the TypeScript and React that ships it. You work directly with the people who use the product and the engineers behind it, and you set the bar for what "usable" means on our team.

What You'll Do

  • Build real-time interfaces on a 3D map, with live tracks, video and alerts that stay responsive as data streams in.
  • Start from the user's job: learn the workflow, the environment, the pain points, and the failure modes before you build.
  • Build controls that work with gloved touch on tablets, keyboard on desktops and, for some controls, a game controller.
  • Own the interaction and visual design of what you build
  • Ensure the UI reflects system state, so users always know what is happening, including when data is bad or conditions are degraded.
  • Get feedback from operators and engineers early, and iterate on what you learn from real use.
  • Hold and raise the front end bar through code review, our design system, testing and written design decisions.

What You Bring

  • Senior front-end judgment, shown in the work you have shipped rather than a year count.
  • Strong TypeScript and React, with production experience building complex interfaces.
  • Experience building usable UI for mission-critical or high-stakes use, where mistakes have real cost.
  • High user empathy: you think about who is using the screen, where, and what they need before you think about how it looks.
  • Practical problem solving: you can take an ambiguous user need and get to a simple, working solution.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical people.

Nice to Have

  • Real-time or telemetry visualization for field systems.
  • Tactical or field-device context, including ATAK/TAK.
  • Direct work with end users, including usability testing.
  • Experience building and supporting defence and security systems.
  • Offline-first or low-bandwidth UI, accessibility, or design system experience.

No defence background required. We've hired people who didn't tick every box. If this is the work you want to do, please apply anyway.

job.name: Lead Android Platform Engineer - Canada - FTE
job.description:
About Very (Remote – Canada)

Very is a fully distributed technology firm led by expert problem-solvers who create efficient, scalable solutions that move commercial, industrial, and consumer products from pilot to production in record time.

We believe that real innovation happens in the grind — working shoulder to shoulder with clients who are building the future. Our team thrives on that energy. When we’re not helping clients deliver business-critical outcomes, we’re refining our craft and celebrating what it means to do hard things well.

We’ve built a collaborative, tight-knit culture that thrives in both remote and in-person settings. We’ve won numerous workplace awards over the years, including Great Place to Work certification and recognition from Parity.org as a Best Company for Women to Advance.

Our clients include well-known brands like Vizio, Peloton, Clear, iHeart Radio, and Fellowes — all determined to leverage connected devices and AI to drive meaningful impact. Our job is simple: help them win.

As an Lead Android Platform Engineer, you'll lead a team of 3 to 5 Android engineers embedded in a client's engineering organization through Very's staff augmentation model. The team builds system-level apps for an AOSP-based Android TV product, including a custom launcher, settings, setup and other platform-integrated apps that live inside the AOSP source tree rather than on an app store. This is not mobile app development: you'll work on the Android operating system itself, from AOSP builds and system apps down to the layer that talks to the TV hardware. About 80% of the codebase is Kotlin, alongside a React Native home experience and a JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for ads integration.

This is a full-time, long-term role that balances technical leadership with people management. You'll lead and grow your team, own their delivery, and stay deep enough in the stack to chase a problem from the app layer down through the framework to the hardware. You'll work in the client's codebase, tools and processes, partner day to day with their engineering and product leaders, and stay part of the Very team. At Very, a manager is accountable for both what the team ships and how the team works.

This is not an easy role. You'll work under real deadlines with a client who expects you and your team to be available, proactive and delivering from day one. If you like doing hard things well, you'll fit right in.

Meta is seeking a Partner Engineer for the Wearables platform. As a member of the Wearables team, you'll help 3rd-party developers create integrations with our Wearables platforms, including Meta's smart glasses. job.name: Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
job.description:
*🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!* Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

*💻 Role* We Are Looking For Intellectually Curious, Highly Motivated Individuals To Join Us For a 12-16 Week Hybrid Internship During Summer 2027. Our Interns Work In Cross-functional Multidisciplinary Teams Enabling You To Directly Impact The Direction Of Our Platform. Your Code And Ideas Will Contribute To Solving Some Of The Most Complex Technical Challenges We Face Today And Define Future Engineering Initiatives. Some Sample Projects You Might Work On Are

  • Building new features for users in our live-streams
  • Implementing growth tactics and strategies to scale our buyer and seller flows
  • Building systems at scale that help us deliver a high trust marketplace experience

By the end of your internship, you will have contributed to one of the fastest growing marketplaces ever while gaining core industry skills of project ideation, management and collaboration.

We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in-person time for planning, problem-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our New York City or San Francisco or hubs during the internship. *👋 You* People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it.

As our next Engineering Intern you should have some industry software engineering experience, plus

  • Pursuing a degree in computer science or other related major graduating in Dec 2027 or by Summer 2028
  • Problem solver and out-of-the-box thinker
  • Willing to take risks and build product and systems for 1M+ users
  • Ability to pick up on new technologies quickly

*🎁 Benefits*

  • Monthly allowance to dogfood the app

job.name: iOS Engineer, Flights Search
job.description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: 2 days in-office

iOS Engineer, Flights Search Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal As demand for seamless travel booking and flight discovery continues to reach record levels, we are focused on delivering a faster, highly responsive, and intuitive flights and shopping experience to make {big deal} moments happen for our customers. Our development environment is optimistic, collaborative, fast-moving, tight-knit, and rolls up its sleeves. Join our open, dynamic, no-red-tape web and platform engineering team—including designers, product managers, and backend engineers—who believe in hiring people who love what they do.

In This Role You Will Get To

job.name: Software Development Engineer
job.description:
Description Amazon Web Services (AWS) is building a central pipeline of Software Development Engineer (SDE) talent for anticipated roles in 2026. This requisition supports hiring across all AWS SDE positions, from fungible SDE roles to specialized engineering positions in areas including:

  • Embedded Systems
  • Game Development
  • Compiler Engineering
  • Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning
  • Healthcare AI
  • Infrastructure Services
  • Firmware Development
  • Cloud Computing
  • Distributed Systems
  • Security Engineering
  • Video Processing and Streaming
  • Content Delivery Network (CDN)

When you apply to this position, your profile will be considered for current and future SDE openings across AWS, including teams such as Twitch, AWS Elemental, and AWS CloudFront.

Key job responsibilities

As An AWS Software Development Engineer, You Will

  • Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code
  • Implement complex software solutions that meet business requirements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews to provide technical guidance
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process enhancement
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a strong engineering culture

A day in the life

On a typical day as an AWS SDE, you might:

  • Start your morning with a team stand-up to align on priorities and address any blockers
  • Collaborate with product managers to refine requirements for upcoming features
  • Write code and develop solutions for complex technical challenges
  • Review pull requests from team members, providing constructive feedback
  • Participate in design discussions for new services or features
  • Debug and troubleshoot production issues as they arise
  • Attend learning sessions to stay current with AWS technologies
  • Document your work and contribute to technical specifications
  • Engage with customers or internal stakeholders to better understand their needs

About The Team Our central SDE sourcing team specializes exclusively in the SDE job family across AWS. This team of experts understands the nuances of various SDE roles throughout the organization and serves as your dedicated resource throughout the hiring process. Here's what you can expect:

  • An SDE sourcer will contact you for an initial screening call to understand your background, skills, and interests
  • They will share specific details about what you need to succeed in the interview process
  • As the right roles become available, your sourcer will stay in touch and connect you with appropriate teams
  • Throughout the process, the central team will provide guidance and preparation support

Basic Qualifications
