job.name: Mobile Engineer 5 ( Android) (Enterprise Platforms Technology )
job.description:
Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. As a Mobile Engineer, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across the enterprise. At Capital One, the iOS and Android platforms are recognized as an opportunity to reach our customers in unique, personal and engaging ways. Nothing is off-limits as we explore exciting ways to take advantage of the full ecosystem of mobile devices, including Watch, TV, and whatever future developments Apple or Google creates. Our engineers are provided with top-of-the-line MacBook Pros, multiple high-end monitors and the necessary tooling to develop the best possible products with the least amount of friction. We operate in small, productive Agile teams and use the best industry tools to collaborate cross-functionally. Enterprise Platforms Technology (EPTech) comprises many of Capital One’s most important enterprise platforms. We play an essential role in establishing practices for building technology solutions across the company, while also delivering capabilities that exemplify those practices. What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with software engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver high-performing, quality features for 100M+ customers that are engaging, purposeful and powerful in their simplicity
  • Partner with product leaders to influence multi-quarter engineering roadmaps (e.g., new capability builds, performance optimization, platform modernization) ensuring alignment with broader business goals
  • Architect, build, and maintain core components and shared libraries that act as a force multiplier for multiple teams within your product area
  • Contribute to standards for cross-platform consistency, scalability, and accessibility across mobile experiences
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in critical areas like mobile performance, networking, or platform-specific UI frameworks, influencing standards across teams
  • Partner with infrastructure and backend teams to define and improve mobile CI/CD, observability, and reliability engineering practices, standardizing release practices
  • Define strategies for leveraging agentic AI tools across multiple teams, including specialized agents, skills and tools built on open standards (e.g., Model Context Protocol), to standardize workflows
  • Mentor and guide senior engineers in building AI-native workflows, shaping the next generation of technical leaders proficient in agentic coding
  • Apply mastery of the modern mobile ecosystem (including deep platform-specific capabilities and advanced UI patterns) to make complex, high-leverage, hands-on technical contributions that solve the most challenging problems within your product area

job.name: AEM Technical Architect / Lead
job.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Technical Architect / Lead to lead the architecture, design, development, and delivery of scalable enterprise AEM solutions. This is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining solution architecture, guiding the AEM development team, reviewing designs and code, and ensuring high-quality releases.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in AEM as a Cloud Service, Java, Apache Sling, OSGi, HTL/Sightly, Adobe Cloud Manager, REST APIs, Dispatcher, enterprise integrations, and modern AEM development practices. Experience integrating AEM applications with Esri map services is highly desirable. This is a hands-on Architect/Lead role, not a purely advisory architecture position. The individual is expected to design solutions, contribute production-quality code, troubleshoot complex issues, review implementations, mentor developers, and own the technical quality of AEM releases.

Key Responsibilities

· Architect and implement scalable, secure, maintainable AEM as a Cloud Service solutions.

· Serve as the technical architect and lead for the AEM development team.

· Define solution architecture, technical standards, reusable patterns, and development best practices.

· Lead technical design reviews, architecture reviews, pull request reviews, and code reviews.

· Provide technical direction and mentorship to AEM developers.

· Ensure solutions meet enterprise architecture, security, performance, accessibility, and maintainability requirements.

· Design and develop reusable AEM components, templates, services, Sling Models, Sling Servlets, and Experience Fragments.

· Develop solutions using Java, Sling, OSGi, HTL/Sightly, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, and JSON.

· Develop and support AEM Adaptive Forms.

· Implement and maintain AEM integrations with backend systems and enterprise services.

· Design and support integrations with Esri map services and APIs.

· Support multilingual and localized websites, including translation of AEM Sites content and Experience Fragments.

· Implement frontend solutions that are reusable, responsive, performant, and maintainable.

· Drive Adobe Cloud Manager CI/CD pipelines, builds, quality gates, deployments, and environment management.

· Troubleshoot Cloud Manager build and deployment issues.

· Configure and optimize AEM Dispatcher, caching rules, filters, redirects, and related web-tier configurations.

· Support performance optimization, caching strategies, and production troubleshooting.

· Use modern AI-assisted development tools such as Anthropic Claude and AWS Kiro to accelerate development, code analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, testing, and developer productivity.

· Establish appropriate engineering practices for reviewing and validating AI-generated code before production implementation.

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
job.description:
Company Information PACCAR is a Fortune 500 company established in 1905 and is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture, and support of high-quality light-, medium- and heavy-duty trucks. PACCAR is best known for its truck brands: Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF.

The PACCAR Silicon Valley Innovation Center, located in Sunnyvale, California, focuses on advancing emerging technologies for all of PACCAR’s businesses. Our office is spacious and modern, with a private work café, high ceilings, and several truck bays.

If you are passionate about transportation and technology—including autonomy, advanced driving assistance systems (ADAS), electrification, and connectivity—PACCAR is the place for you. Let’s get started!

Requisition Summary We are a tight knit team of engineers that value collaboration and results. We are looking for an ambitious, enthusiastic, and self-directed Senior Software Engineer to complement our unique skillsets. If you have a proven track record of excellence, come join us!

Your main responsibility will be to write, maintain, and deploy code for our vehicle-technologies such as telematics, sensor data, and system architectures. This will include both hands-on technical work as well as the guidance and supervision of external resources. To make this happen, you need to be a utility player who understands version control, defect management, documentation, and software best practices for production code deployment. You’ll write software for both the truck and in the cloud, so you need to understand partitioning, offloading, and edge computing.

This is a unique role with great visibility within PACCAR. If you are the right candidate, it would position you well to become a thought-leader for modern software practices within PACCAR. Because we are an innovation center, we are able to move quickly and try a lot of different approaches. In addition, we’ve built strong relationships with PACCAR groups around the world, which provides nice opportunities for collaboration and learning.

This position is located in Sunnyvale, CA Job Responsibilities

Read the full description

job.name: Software Developer II - Android Apps
job.description:
Overview Join Esri’s Field Apps team and help build the next generation of Android apps that empower people everywhere to make smarter decisions in the world around them. From frontline workers collecting real-time data to teams managing critical field operations, your work will directly support impactful missions across the globe.

As a Software Developer II, you’ll collaborate with a passionate, cross-functional team to design intuitive, high-performance mobile apps built with the latest Android technologies. You’ll tackle complex challenges like offline data sync, GPS integration, and seamless mapping experiences—all while delivering clean, scalable code that brings powerful field workflows to life.

Help us push the boundaries of what Android can do and create tools that truly make a difference!

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Redlands, CA area for this position.

Responsibilities

  • Build the latest Android apps from architecture to design (ICS and up)
  • Join forces with other developers and designers throughout the development process
  • Understand user requirements—these apps have to meet real world scenarios
  • Develop software for use in field mapping, data collection, sensor networks, street navigation, and more
  • Solve complex problems with design, development, and user experience
  • Be an Android advocate within the company and at conferences; help us grow Android development capability throughout Esri

Requirements

  • 2+ years of commercial software development experience
  • Be an Android enthusiast and a game changer
  • You are anxious to learn but you’ve got these things covered:

+ Kotlin programming
+ Developing on the Android platform
+ Object oriented design skills
+ Data structures and algorithms
+ Mobile development issues related to performance optimization and caching

  • Develop strong skills and best practices on the team through participation in design and code reviews

+ Good communication skills
+ Be a team player who can also fly solo
+ The ability to thrive in an environment that changes often

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related field
  • Did we mention, you gotta love Android?

Recommended Qualifications

  • Submitted Android apps to Google Play/Amazon Appstore/other Android marketplaces
  • Prior experience building spatial/mapping applications or software components
  • Experience with security and/or native hardware components (GPS, camera, and more)
  • Experience with one or more of the following technologies: GIS, RESTful web services, Git
  • Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related field

We are committed to innovation and excellence, building reliable and impactful healthcare solutions that make a meaningful difference in the lives of our customers. Our collaborative and inclusive culture fosters continuous learning and growth, empowering employees to contribute their best work in a supportive environment.

About The Role We are seeking an Associate Android Developer to join our newly formed mobile engineering team in San Diego, CA. In this role, you will develop high-quality Android application features for Resmed’s mobile products used by customers worldwide. You will work closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and fellow mobile developers to transform ideas into reliable and scalable Android experiences. This position is ideal for individuals early in their careers who are eager to grow their Android development expertise through structured onboarding, mentorship, and hands-on ownership of their work.

job.name: Senior Engineer, Software
job.description:
Company Overview Brother is a leading provider of home and office equipment, sewing and crafting products, and industrial solutions. With a legacy spanning over 115 years, our brand is renowned for producing award-winning printers, sewing machines, P-touch labelers, and more. Brother International Corporation (BIC) was established in 1954, marking over 70 years of operations in the United States. Our Americas headquarters is located in Bridgewater, New Jersey. BIC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Brother Industries Limited (BIL), which was founded in 1908 in Nagoya, Japan, and operates in more than 30 countries worldwide. Brother’s Americas presence includes subsidiaries in Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, and Peru.

Why Work at Brother? Brother USA has consistently been recognized as a best place to work, reflecting our commitment to fostering a workplace culture aligned with our core values of being inclusive, collaborative, customer-centric, and socially responsible. We value work-life balance and flexibility, and as a result have introduced policies such as our hybrid office schedule, casual dress code, and flexible Fridays, which allow us to wrap up meetings for dedicated focus time or to start our weekends sooner, year-round. Our commitment to employee growth and development is demonstrated through our offering of facilitated courses and certificate programs and our investment in resources that enable self-paced learning.

job.name: Mobile Software Development Engineer II - Android
job.description:
Job Description Join a fast-paced team of engineers creating cutting edge software products for the Joint Operations and medical communities (Air Force, Army, and Navy). You will work alongside BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems (SMS) and US Air Force developers and engineers to provide technologies that increase the capabilities of our nation’s military. Our team’s goal is to create user driven applications that optimize human-machine performance in the next generation of Air Force systems.

We accomplish this by exploiting state of the art hardware and software practices while maintaining a tight feedback loop with both Special Warfare and the Defense Health Agency medical personnel we support. Our unique customers give you the phenomenal opportunity to work directly with users to develop capabilities and solutions that simplify and enhance their ability to accomplish their missions, as well as save lives. job.name: Senior AI-Native Product Engineer, Mobile
job.description:
About The Team The Mercury Mobile team builds Zillow Instant Messaging (ZIM) — the conversation layer where millions of movers participate in a multiplayer, integrated experience to find their next home. We own the messaging experience on both iOS and Android, from the real-time messaging core through the rich, interactive content inside every conversation. Our larger organization is responsible for turning interest in a home into a completed tour, a durable relationship with an agent, and a successful move. Right now we are rebuilding what a messaging product can be when an AI assistant is a participant in the conversation rather than a feature bolted onto it.

About The Role As a Senior Software Development Engineer on Mercury Mobile, you will define how AI shows up inside ZIM on mobile — and you will do it on both platforms. This is deliberately a cross-platform role: you will work in Swift and Kotlin, and the architectural decisions you make will land on iOS and Android together rather than diverging. The problems are the interesting ones in mobile client engineering today: streaming AI responses into a live conversation without janking the UI, rendering multi-modal and richly structured content that exceeds what a message bubble was ever designed to hold, and building it all to work on a spotty connection in a driveway. You will have real ownership of the architecture, and a team that expects you to use it.

You Will Get To

  • Design and ship the mobile client architecture for AI in conversations — streaming responses, topic-based conversation structures, and multi-modal content rendering across iOS and Android
  • Own cross-platform architectural decisions for the ZIM messaging core, keeping Swift and Kotlin implementations converged rather than letting them drift
  • Build real-time, resilient messaging experiences that hold up on unreliable mobile networks, with observability and SLOs you define
  • Partner directly with the AI, Web, and Backend teams shaping Zillow's conversational AI roadmap, and represent mobile in those decisions
  • Use AI coding agents as a genuine part of your workflow — and help set the standards for how the team does it well
  • Raise the bar on testing and delivery velocity through unit, snapshot, and UI automation, and shared tooling other teams adopt
  • Mentor engineers across both platforms and grow the team's cross-platform depth

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

job.name: Jr. Staff Android Engineer
job.description:
*The Mission:* We are building the next generation of connected digital cockpits, bridging high-performance vehicle hardware with intuitive, cloud-connected experiences.

In this role, you will initially tackle critical platform security and connectivity challenges: establishing hardware-backed trust with Qualcomm silicon, securing backend communication channels, and tuning network routing inside a virtualized Android environment.

At the same time, we don’t believe in rigid silos. While your initial focus will be anchoring these core platform and security foundations, you will be part of an adaptable engineering team. As the platform matures, you will have plenty of room to flex across the broader Android stack—collaborating on core system services, framework features, and user-facing capabilities across the digital cockpit.

*What You Will Work On:* Initial Platform & Security Focus:

  • Hardware-Backed Trust & mTLS: Connect Android’s Keystore / KeyMint layer with Qualcomm TrustZone hardware to safely manage certificates, keys, and token lifecycles for secure mutual TLS (mTLS) communication with the backend.
  • Network & Multi-APN Routing: Configure Android networking pipelines, cellular APN policies, and DNS whitelisting to cleanly route private telematics, cloud APIs, and consumer traffic through their intended channels.
  • Hypervisor Network Integration: Work with virtual network interfaces (virtio-net, bridging) spanning the host hypervisor and the guest Android OS to ensure reliable, high-throughput data transport.
  • Platform Hardening & SELinux: Write and refine SELinux policies (sepolicy) and define clean Binder IPC boundaries to keep platform services secure, stable, and compliant.
  • Identity & Secure Transport: Support user profile isolation (IAM), secure storage for JWTs and session tokens, and reliable telemetry messaging using protocols like MQTT over TLS.

Looking Ahead (Generalist & Platform Evolution):

  • Build, extend, and maintain Android framework services and system applications that power core cockpit experiences.
  • Collaborate across teams on modern Android development—from IPC and background services to application logic and developer tooling.
  • Help shape architecture, code quality, and engineering standards as our software footprint continues to grow.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Containers
job.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As a Senior Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will design and ship the features, services, and build systems behind Chainguard Containers, working in a small sub-team of two to four engineers that owns one project end to end.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will build that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

This is a product role. You will work directly with Product Managers and customers, make the trade-off calls on the features you own, and ship them.

What The Team Owns

  • Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).
  • The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.
  • Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.
  • Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

What You'll Do

job.name: Senior Systems Software Engineer - NV Cloud Functions
job.description:
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA Cloud Functions (NVCF) is an open-source platform that links workloads to GPUs. It lets teams deploy, manage, and serve GPU-accelerated, containerized applications across regions and clusters worldwide. The platform routes inference, streaming, and batch jobs across decentralized GPU clusters. This allows endpoints to scale repeatably, whether hosted on-prem or in the cloud.

We are seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team. You will focus on improving the performance, reliability, and scaling behavior of a system that routes AI workloads onto distributed GPU fleets. You will work on a polyglot platform that is now fully open source, with both control plane and edge deployments. The work suits someone with deep experience in systems performance, distributed systems, and Kubernetes-based runtimes. We are looking for engineers who want to learn and grow. Expect to be challenged in an environment with rapidly shifting priorities, where insight, focus, and execution are key.

What You Will Be Doing

  • You'll be working in a distributed team that explores innovative ways to make GPU- and DPU-accelerated applications easier to develop, deploy, and monitor on the latest and greatest NVIDIA hardware.
  • Design and ship services in Java, Go, and Rust, building in the open on a public repository where your commits, design proposals, and reviews are transparent to the community.
  • Work on automating and optimizing build, test, integration, and release processes for cloud native.
  • Partner with engineering teams across NVIDIA so the platform integrates with adjacent NVIDIA technologies, including the KAI Scheduler, NVIDIA NIM, Grove, and Dynamo.
  • Help steward an open-source project. You will triage community issues and pull requests and write docs contributors can build on.

What We Need To See

Meet the Team

Isovalent, now part of Cisco, is the company founded by the creators of Cilium and eBPF. Cisco Secure Workload is Cisco's flagship product for workload protection and micro-segmentation, and part of Cisco's Hybrid Mesh Firewall solution. Together, Isovalent and Secure Workload are building the next generation of products for securing workloads and AI infrastructure.

Our team turns security intent into enforcement.   • Collecting and processing telemetry at scale from diverse data sources.

  • Implementing high-performance API endpoints with minimal latency for large data volumes.

Nutanix, a leader in enterprise cloud, is looking for an outstanding Software Developer to join our Software Defined Security product team, Nutanix Flow.

You will work on software-defined networking and security solutions that govern environments independent of physical infrastructure, providing granular control and visibility for enterprise applications.

About The Team The Nutanix Flow team is a high-impact group focused on delivering advanced networking, security services, and compliance insights for the enterprise. We value big thinkers who are unafraid to take on seemingly impossible challenges and are interested in learning how to build a business along the way. Our team culture is built on collaboration and the open exploration of ideas to deliver granular control for enterprise applications

Flow Team’s Tech Stack

Development is in a Linux based environment. The backend software is written in Python and Golang. Tools like git, open source libraries etc are used for regular product and test infrastructure development. We work on problems covering aspects of Software defined Networking, Networking security, Offloading AI workloads and enterprise scale.

Nutanix Vancouver

Nutanix is expanding its engineering presence in Vancouver as part of a long-term commitment to building strong infrastructure and platform teams. This hub brings together engineers working on distributed systems, storage, compute, networking, and platform services. For engineers joining early, this is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful systems while influencing how the team develops. Learn more about Nutanix Vancouver: https://careers.nutanix.com/en/nutanix-vancouver/

Your Role

  • Develop a world-class network security product that is distributed, resilient, and highly performant at large-scale deployments within enterprise customers.
  • Adapt best engineering practices, including the creation of clear functional specs, design documents, and test plans, while ensuring code hygiene and thorough testing.
  • Collaborate with a geo-distributed team and deliver projects with high quality and predictability under minimal supervision.
  • Work on improving existing systems to provide improved functionality, performance and reliability for our customers.
  • Work alongside development, test, documentation, and product management teams to deliver high-quality products in a fast-paced environment.

job.name: Volunteer Web Developer
job.description:
Time commitment — 8-10 hours per week

EmpowHERto is looking for a volunteer Web Developer to help finish our new website. You’ll work with our web designer to turn approved designs into working pages, set up a public events calendar, and make it easy for our team to update photos, copy, and event listings after launch.

Our website helps girls and families in Toronto and South Florida find programs in tech, mentorship, and wellness, register for events, and learn how to get involved.

What you’ll do

  • Build remaining pages and reusable templates from approved designs using our existing website platform.
  • Set up a public events calendar where visitors can find events by location and follow registration links. Configure it so staff can manage listings through the website editor.
  • Configure and test navigation, forms, and links for program registration, volunteering, and donations.
  • Test pages on desktop and mobile, check keyboard navigation and form labels, and fix layout or functionality issues.
  • Set up editing access and show staff how to update pages, photos, and calendar entries.
  • Help troubleshoot technical issues during launch and document how the site and calendar are set up.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience building or maintaining websites using a content management system or website builder.
  • Ability to turn design mockups into responsive, accessible pages.
  • Experience setting up forms, calendars, or third-party integrations.
  • Familiarity with HTML and CSS and the ability to troubleshoot independently.
  • Clear communication and the ability to explain technical updates to teammates who manage website content.

How to apply

Share a short introduction, your availability for 10 hours per week, and links to one or two websites you’ve worked on. Tell us which platforms you used and what you built or maintained.

job.name: Product Designer – UI/UX | Figma | React
job.description:
Build better healthcare software for patients and professionals

Script Assist is looking for a Product Designer to help shape the UX and UI of a growing suite of healthcare SaaS products.

We build technology used across the healthcare journey — from patient-facing digital experiences and mobile-responsive journeys to B2B SaaS platforms used by clinics, pharmacies and operational teams .

Our technology supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month across multiple healthcare organisations and brands.

We’re looking for a Product Designer who combines strong UX thinking, excellent UI design, deep Figma capability and practical React/HTML/CSS experience .

This isn’t simply a role for making existing screens look better.

You’ll work on user journeys, interaction design, information architecture, complex workflows, design systems and production UI , helping us make sophisticated healthcare software clearer, simpler and more intuitive.

What you’ll design

You’ll work across both consumer-facing products and professional B2B SaaS applications .

That includes:

  • patient journeys;
  • responsive web and mobile experiences;
  • clinic software;
  • pharmacy software;
  • dashboards;
  • forms;
  • tables;
  • administrative workflows;
  • configuration interfaces;
  • information-dense applications;
  • customer-specific branded experiences.

You’ll need to think differently about a patient completing a simple journey on a phone and a professional user working inside complex software all day.

What you’ll do

As a Product Designer, you’ll:

  • design end-to-end user journeys and user flows;
  • improve UX across existing software products;
  • simplify complex workflows;
  • create wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity UI in Figma;
  • design intuitive web application and mobile-responsive experiences;
  • work on information architecture and interaction design;
  • build and evolve reusable Figma components and design systems;
  • create scalable UI patterns, components, variants and design tokens;
  • design dashboards, forms, tables and information-dense SaaS interfaces;
  • collaborate directly with Product and Engineering;
  • work within existing React applications;
  • use HTML/CSS and React knowledge to support or implement front-end design changes;
  • review implemented features and maintain a high standard of UI quality;
  • help create and maintain customer-specific themes and white-labelled experiences.

International product experience

Our software is designed primarily for UK and international users.

We’re therefore specifically looking for Product Designers whose professional experience has predominantly involved designing software for international customers or end users outside India .

That could mean working:

  • for an international software company;
  • for an Indian SaaS company serving international markets;
  • on international B2B SaaS products;

job.name: Domain Solution Architect – Drug Development
job.description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!

Job Summary The Domain Solution Architect – Drug Development designs and supports technology solutions across the pharmaceutical R&D lifecycle. This role ensures that digital solutions align with business needs, architectural standards, and regulatory requirements to enable efficient, compliant, and data‑driven drug development.

Working closely with R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, and IT stakeholders, you will translate scientific and operational needs into scalable solution architectures spanning non‑clinical research, clinical development, regulatory submission support, and R&D platforms (e.g. Veeva Vault, LIMS).

  • Collaborate across global, cross‑functional teams and vendors

Required Experience & Skills

  • Strong understanding of drug development processes and supporting systems
  • Proven delivery experience in regulated environments
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g. TOGAF)
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, influencing, and consulting skills
  • Comfortable working in complex, evolving, and highly regulated contexts

Preferred Requirements

  • Managing resources.
  • Creativity and visioning.
  • Emerging Technology Monitoring.
  • Consulting.
  • IT Governance.
  • IT Enterprise & Business Architecture.
  • IT Solution Architecture.
  • IT Technical Strategy & Planning.
  • Performance Management.
  • Influencing and persuading.

Why Sandoz? Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.

À propos de Zilia

Zilia est une compagnie de technologie médicale basée à Québec qui vise à révolutionner la prise en charge de maladies oculaires et systémiques grâce à la mesure non-invasive de biomarqueurs dans l'œil.

Au fil des dernières années, Zilia a développé une plateforme technologique révolutionnaire combinant imagerie, spectroscopie et intelligence artificielle. Celle-ci tire parti des propriétés optiques de l'œil et de ses liens uniques avec le système vasculaire et le cerveau pour fournir des informations précieuses sur la santé oculaire et générale. Aujourd'hui, Zilia commercialise sa technologie en milieu clinique au Canada et dans le secteur de la recherche à l’échelle internationale. L'entreprise poursuit son ambition de rendre sa plateforme accessible dans différents secteurs de la santé, afin de transformer le diagnostic et la prise en charge des maladies oculaires et systémiques et d’améliorer la qualité de vie des patients.

Le savais-tu?

  • 415 millions de personnes dans le monde souffrent de diabète et 1 diabétique sur 3 sera affecté par la rétinopathie diabétique à un point dans sa vie.
  • La prévalence mondiale du glaucome chez les adultes âgés entre 40 et 80 ans est estimée à 3.5%.
  • Près de 9% de la population en Amérique du Nord vit avec une forme de dégénérescence maculaire liée à l'âge.

Responsabilités

  • Concevoir et développer l’interface tactile embarquée du Zilia Ocular, qui pilote en temps réel le matériel d’imagerie (caméra, moteurs, éclairage), ainsi que les interfaces de notre plateforme Cloud.
  • Développer des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, de l’interface jusqu’aux services backend et API qui les supportent.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec nos équipes de design et de terrain pour transformer les besoins des clients en expériences utilisateur simples et efficaces.
  • Faire évoluer l’architecture frontend et veiller à la qualité du code (revues de code, tests automatisés, performance).
  • Contribuer à la documentation logicielle requise dans le contexte d’un dispositif médical réglementé.

Pourquoi choisir Zilia

  • C’est ta chance de participer à un projet porteur qui vise à révolutionner le domaine de la santé.
  • Tu feras partie des décisions cruciales liées à la planification et au développement de la plateforme.
  • Tu bénéficieras d’opportunités de croissance professionnelle.
  • Tu travailleras au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire qui valorise le développement des connaissances et des compétences.
  • Tu travailleras dans un environnement innovant et stimulant.
  • Tu pourras t’impliquer dans différents comités internes, notamment en cybersécurité, en amélioration des processus et en intelligence artificielle, afin de mettre à profit ton expertise et de contribuer activement à l’évolution de l’entreprise.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend
job.description:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role As a Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack you will be responsible for the development and maintenance of our web application and platform that is used for Fraud analysis. You will be working closely with Product & Design, Solutions Engineering, Data Science, Infrastructure and the Data Platform teams to build new products and enhance our existing suite of products. This role is primarily focused on frontend development (approximately 60–70%), with the remainder involving collaboration across the stack.

This is a remote, US-based role.

Technologies React, Golang, Python, PostgreSQL (RDS), Docker, AWS technologies (Lambda, Cognito and other standard technologies)

job.name: Design Engineer Intern 2027 - Design and Build AI-Native Interfaces
job.description:
Introduction The Apps@Research team builds the tools that IBM Researchers need to accelerate their work. Whether it's compute, agents, models, data or support; we work closely with our research teams to build what they need. We are an AI-native team and looking for a design engineer intern who can collaborate with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to deliver new experiences from sketch to software.

Your Role And Responsibilities

  • Design and ship UI work for production applications, from first sketch to merged code.
  • Extend our component library and the Storybook that documents it, so patterns stay reusable and other people can find them.
  • Prototype in code. Put something clickable in front of researchers in days, not weeks, and let what you learn change the design.
  • Work alongside AI coding agents as a normal part of the job, and improve how the team runs them.
  • Carry IBM Research's voice into the interface — its tone, restraint, and vocabulary — while bringing your own aesthetic judgment to the work.

Preferred Education Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • A portfolio of design work. Show craft: typography, layout, color, motion, interaction states. Include at least one thing you designed and built and put in front of real users. Live links beat static files.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and component frameworks. You can take a design from Figma to a working component without waiting for someone else.
  • Exposure to design systems in practice. Component variants, design tokens, and writing a component's documentation so a stranger uses it correctly. Building or running a Storybook counts; so does any comparable component workbench.
  • Hands-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or v0 past one-off prompting and into repeatable setups. Two specific practices we care about: loop engineering (designing a process that keeps an agent working toward a stated goal and checks its own output, rather than typing every prompt yourself) and agent swarms (splitting a job across several agents running in parallel, each with a narrow scope). These practices are new and still changing. A few honest attempts and an opinion about what broke will carry you further here than a polished method.
  • Enough back-end familiarity to feed a front end — Python, Go, or Node.js. You can read an API response and shape the data an interface needs.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Security
job.description:
The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our security team - the group responsible for keeping 70+ million creators, and everything they’ve built, safe. Linktree is the front door to a creator’s whole digital presence, which makes it a target: account takeover, abusive content, scraped data, third-party integrations with more access than they should have. This role is about building the systems that make those attacks hard.

This is hands-on engineering, not advisory work. You’ll design and ship authentication and authorisation improvements, secrets handling, abuse and fraud detection, and the internal tooling that lets every other squad build securely by default. You’ll be across TypeScript, Node, React and AWS, and you’ll work with Engineering, Product and Trust & Safety to decide where to harden, where to simplify, and where a control costs more in creator friction than it buys in risk reduction.

It’s a role for someone who thinks in systems and failure modes, who would rather remove a class of vulnerability than patch instances of it, and who can bring other engineers along rather than block them. Every control you ship protects someone’s livelihood - and helps Linktree achieve our mission: to empower anyone to curate and grow their digital universe.

What You’ll Own

  • Design and ship security improvements across the Linktree product: authentication and authorisation, session and token handling, secrets management and third-party access.
  • Build the detection and response capability for the product surface - abuse, account takeover, scraping and fraud - so problems surface before creators report them.
  • Threat model new and existing systems with the squads that own them, and turn the output into prioritised, shipped work.
  • Own the internal tooling and paved paths that make it easy for every other engineer to build securely by default.
  • Triage and remediate vulnerabilities from internal findings, bug bounty and pen tests, and fix the class of problem rather than the instance.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product and Trust & Safety on where to harden and where a control costs more in creator friction than it buys in risk reduction.
  • Bring AI into how you build, and use it to move faster on reviews, migrations and investigation - while staying clear-eyed about what it gets wrong.
  • Raise the security bar around you through review, pairing, documentation and mentoring.

Who We’re Looking For

SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

You will be working closely with Product & Design, Solutions Engineering, Data Science, Infrastructure and the Data Platform teams to build new products and enhance our existing suite of products. This role is primarily focused on frontend development (approximately 60–70%), with the remainder involving collaboration across the stack.

This is a remote, US-based role.

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to craft beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to building exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

The Opportunity

As a Data Engineer, you’ll join our data engineering and BI team and work closely with business analysts to understand requirements and translate them into reliable data pipelines, data models and curated datasets that power reporting. You’ll also interact directly with business users and support their ad-hoc requests from time to time.

What you’ll Do

  • Build and maintain ELT/ETL pipelines on Databricks and SQL Server using SQL, PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/Jobs and Unity Catalog.
  • Develop dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, facts, dimensions, SCDs) and curated datasets for reporting.
  • Monitor data quality, SLAs and failures, and resolve pipeline issues.
  • Clarify requirements with business and analytics teams, flag gaps early, and turn them into reliable datasets and key metrics.
  • Write unit and integration tests, and build pipelines that are easy to test.
  • Contribute to query and pipeline performance tuning.
  • Use Git, code reviews and documentation to keep work clear, and share what you learn with the team through demos.
  • Occasionally support important pipelines outside normal hours, when business needs require.

What you need to succeed

  • 2-7 years in business intelligence, data warehousing and data analysis, with hands-on Databricks development and SQL as the core skill.
  • Solid SQL skills: complex joins, CTEs, window functions and reading execution plans.
  • Working knowledge of data warehousing: dimensional modelling, SCD types, incremental/CDC loads and medallion (Bronze-Silver-Gold) architecture.
  • Python/PySpark for transformation, validation and automation.
  • Familiarity with Delta Lake (MERGE, time travel), Git, and Azure or AWS data services.
  • Curiosity, attention to detail, and clear communication with technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • Good to have: Databricks performance tuning (OPTIMIZE, Z-ORDER, liquid clustering, Photon, cluster sizing), Unity Catalog governance, Power BI (DAX, semantic models), SSAS or SSIS.

SciPlay is a leading developer and publisher of digital games on mobile and web platforms, providing highly entertaining free-to-play games that millions of people play every day for their authenticity, engagement and fun.

Position Summary We're hiring an Associate Product Manager (Economy focused) to be the economic brain behind our games. You will specialize in tuning the economy (what things cost, what they give, and how fast players progress) and you will share LiveOps, monitoring and monetization with the teams that run them day to day. If you like modeling incentives and then watching real players prove you right or wrong, this is the job.

This role is part of SciPlay’s Project Rising Program. Project Rising is an immersive onboarding program designed to quickly build your understanding of social/mobile gaming at SciPlay. Through hands-on learning, you’ll explore our history, market, and game development approach, covering core areas like monetization, product, and analytics. Topics include impact funnels, game loops, LiveOps, KPI monitoring, economy strategies, and more. You’ll learn from SciPlay’s leaders, complete projects to apply your knowledge, and present insights on our games. By the program's end, you’ll be equipped to make a real impact within our team and on our players.

We’re looking for people with high aptitude in critical thinking, sense of urgency, teamwork and drive while making cool games for a living! Ready to rise-up with us?

The economist's mindset

  • Thinks in incentives: what a change makes players do, not only what it costs or earns.
  • Reads an economy as flows: sources, sinks, inflation, and the marginal effect of each tweak.
  • Understands the tension between short-term revenue and long-term economy health, and can explain which one a decision favors.
  • Leans on data, models and experiments over intuition, and writes the reasoning down.

Role Overview

Collabera is seeking an Application Support Engineer to join a major pension fund in downtown Toronto.

This role is focused on providing hands-on technical application support across lower environments (DEV/QA/UAT) for approximately 5-6 integrated applications supporting Capital Markets trading and post-trade activities.

The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining environment stability, performing daily health checks, troubleshooting application failures, conducting root-cause analysis, and implementing minor code or configuration fixes. Applications are primarily developed in Python and Java , and the environment leverages AWS, including EKS and CloudWatch.

This is a highly technical, hands-on L4/L5-level support role requiring someone who can independently investigate and resolve issues rather than simply monitor applications and escalate problems.

The individual will work closely with Development, DevOps, Infrastructure, and other application teams to resolve integration issues, support upstream/downstream dependencies, and ensure applications are functioning correctly ahead of a targeted January 30 production go-live.

This is NOT a traditional QA or 24/7 production support role. The primary focus is application troubleshooting, debugging, and lower-environment support. Functional and integration testing will be secondary responsibilities when environments are stable.

Must-Haves

1. Application / Development Support: Strong hands-on experience supporting complex backend applications, preferably in DEV/QA/UAT environments. Must be capable of independently troubleshooting, debugging, performing root-cause analysis, and implementing minor application or configuration fixes.
2. Python / Java & Technical Debugging: Experience working with Python and/or Java applications, including scripting, code-level debugging, analyzing application logs, and investigating job or service failures.
3. SQL, APIs & Integration Troubleshooting: Strong working knowledge of SQL and Experience with API testing and debugging.
4. AWS / Cloud Environment Support: Experience working with AWS/cloud-based applications, including CloudWatch or similar monitoring tools. Understanding of EKS, application services, scheduled/batch jobs, environment health checks, and CI/CD deployment processes.
5. Capital Markets / Post-Trade Knowledge: Previous Capital Markets experience or training is mandatory. Must understand the trade lifecycle, front-to-back processing, and post-trade workflows. Experience supporting trading, investment, or post-trade applications is strongly preferred.

job.name: MCP/AI Developer
job.description:
Job Requisition ID # 26WD99785

Position Overview

Autodesk's Visualization Solutions power high-performance 2D and 3D visualization experiences across our product portfolio. Our new team in Canada is bringing agentic AI to that experience — expanding our Viewer MCP (Model Context Protocol) from a basic capability layer into a production-grade agentic platform that lets users interact with their models in natural language.

As an MCP/AI Developer you will build end-to-end features of that platform: MCP tools, agentic workflows, and the services behind them. You'll work hands-on across a modern, cloud-enabled web stack, integrating LLMs and models through APIs to deliver capabilities our users rely on. This is a strong software-engineering role with a clear runway to grow deep ML expertise as the team — and the org's AI competency — matures.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain clean, well-tested code for MCP tools, agentic features, and their supporting services (front-end and back-end), to team standards.
  • Integrate LLMs and models via APIs/SDKs to deliver agentic workflows, with attention to correctness, latency, and cost.
  • Help build the guardrails of agentic workflows — human-in-the-loop steps, traceability, and clear error handling.
  • Contribute to automated tests, evaluation harnesses for AI behavior, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling.
  • Debug and troubleshoot across the stack (agent/tool logic, APIs, web UI), collaborating with senior engineers and QA.
  • Work with Product and UX to translate requirements into technical tasks; surface risks and blockers early and seek mentorship.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's in Computer Science / Computer Engineering, or a Bachelor's with 3+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience building software in at least one mainstream language (TypeScript/JavaScript preferred for our stack).
  • Familiarity with modern web development (HTML/CSS/JS) and a framework such as React.
  • Sound understanding of testing, debugging, and code review; experience with Git and collaborative workflows (PRs, branches).
  • Exposure to building with LLMs or AI APIs — e.g. prompting, calling model/agent APIs, or simple agentic/RAG features (course, side-project, or work experience all count).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, eagerness to learn ML/AI deeply, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Experience with Agile practices; strong written and spoken English.

Beneficial Qualifications

  • Node.js back-end development and RESTful APIs.
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent frameworks, or tool-calling patterns.
  • Cloud and CI/CD basics (AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions) and observability tooling.
  • Foundational ML knowledge (embeddings, vector search/RAG, model evaluation).
  • Exposure to 2D/3D rendering, visualization, or graphics concepts (WebGL/WebGPU).

The Ideal Candidate

Read the full description

job.name: Data Scientist
job.description:
Numeris is Canada’s most trusted and authoritative source for broadcast measurement and consumer behaviour data. As well, the industry leading intelligence provider to broadcasters, advertisers, and agencies. We have been recognized for over 75 years as providing the gold standard in audience intelligence.

We have great people who do exceptional work. We take pride in building an environment of continuous learning and career advancement opportunities. Our teams are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to creating quality experiences. We love what we do, enjoy each other’s company, and support initiatives to give back to our communities. We are looking for people to help us shape the future of Numeris, and have a lot of fun along the way.

Numeris is seeking a Data Scientist who will be responsible for designing, developing, validating, and monitoring advanced analytics, statistical models, machine learning solutions, and data products that enhance our products, operations, and decision-making. Working with internal and external data sources and methodologies, the Data Scientist will translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You Will Do

  • Conduct advanced data analytics, modelling, fusion/integration, and machine learning initiatives
  • Develop and enhance algorithms that can be deployed for sample design, weighting/calibration procedures, and improvements in production.
  • Contribute to the application and review of data mining, data integration and hybrid methodologies.
  • Review statistical and machine learning models developed internally or by external business partners, applying established research, statistical and data science standards and escalating issues as appropriate.
  • Support cross-functional teams by providing analytics, presenting findings, and informing team decisions.
  • Maintain current knowledge of statistical methods, machine learning and AI-assisted analytics.

What You Have

  • Undergraduate or Graduate degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics or related quantitative fields.
  • An accredited statistician or Advanced Data Science certification preferred

Required Skills

  • Up to 3 years of experience in a similar role/field
  • Strong expertise in applied statistics, including sampling, statistical inference, regression, imputation, model evaluation and forecasting, supported by experience in advanced analytics, data integration and machine learning.
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, or equivalent, and familiarity with reproducible analytical practices including Git, modular development, testing and documentation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

job.name: Power System Controls Engineer – Data Centers
job.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

At Jacobs, we bring engineering expertise, fresh thinking, and collaboration to complex energy challenges. Join us in developing power systems that support the next generation of data centers and advanced facilities while advancing reliability and resilience.

Your impact

Jacobs’ Energy & Power business is seeking a Power System Controls Engineer to support conceptual planning, design, modeling, integration, and validation of Data Center controls ecosystem including battery energy storage systems (BESS), UPS, and other controllable equipment with a particular focus on AI and hyperscale facilities.

You’ll help clients setup technical and functional specifications, define how BESS operates alongside utility supplies and onsite generation to comply with large load interconnection, performance and other applicable technical requirements.

Working with Jacobs’ regional and global teams, data-center owners, equipment manufacturers, utilities, and EPC contractors, you’ll support projects from feasibility and conceptual design through procurement, detailed engineering, commissioning, and operational performance assessment.

Your responsibilities will include

  • Define and establish overall AI data center plant control hierarchy and support establishing functional/performance specifications, acceptance criteria for load swings, faults, trips etc.;
  • Work closely with state-of-the-art controls and inverter manufacturers to stay on top of all latest and greatest technologies;
  • Develop integrated power system models on RMS and EMT platforms;
  • Perform a range of power system studies from BESS optimal sizing to transients;
  • Support project commissioning through SIL/HIL testing, FAT/SAT, capacity and efficiency testing, integrated systems testing, and utility witness testing. This will be part of larger team of experts and only focused on controls system.
  • Support team work and project delivery. Deliver clear reports and client presentations, manage assigned scope, schedule, budget, and risks, and contribute to proposals and knowledge sharing across Jacobs. #epjobs #naepjobs

Here's what you'll need

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline, with a strong foundation in power systems, circuit theory, power electronics, and controls.

job.name: Growth Product Manager, HTS Media
job.description:
About The Role As a Growth Product Manager, HTS Media, you will own the roadmap for growing advertiser demand across brands: more qualified pipeline, faster campaign launches and higher advertiser spend within Hopper's ecosystem, working closely with engineering leadership, the sales team, Ad Operations and Account Management. This is a builder role: you will start by owning the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, using AI-assisted systems to create demand and make every seller faster, then grow into owning the platform roadmap, including the campaign buying interfaces, in partnership with engineering leadership. In your first year, you'll be judged on the pipeline your systems create, how much faster campaigns go from signed to live, and growth in spend per advertiser.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Own the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, with goals and success metrics tied to a revenue target
  • Build AI-powered systems that generate demand, from account research and signal-based targeting to personalized outreach and follow-up, and measure the pipeline and meetings they produce
  • Grow into owning the platform roadmap for the campaign buying interfaces with engineering leadership: write the specs and decide what gets built, and in what order
  • Work with Ad Operations to remove friction between a signed campaign and a live one
  • Put insights into the buying interface, such as forecasts, benchmarks and media plan recommendations
  • Use SQL on booking, search and campaign data to size opportunities, find advertiser results and decide what to build next
  • Run demand experiments across channels such as LinkedIn, email and events, and track results in internal dashboards
  • Support HTS Media positioning and reusable sales materials (deck templates, one-pagers and case studies), and the HTS Media website and offers site

An ideal candidate has

job.name: Senior Quantum Applied Research Scientist, Physics Modeling
job.description:
At NVIDIA, we're solving the world's most exciting problems with our unique approach to accelerated computing. We're looking for a passionate scientist at the intersection of quantum device physics and advanced physics simulation and modeling. This role will path-find the future of high-fidelity, real-time models for fault-tolerant quantum hardware.

At NVIDIA, we want to help accelerate the entire quantum ecosystem. As a Sr. Quantum Applied Research Scientist, you will help design and build high-fidelity models grounded in device physics, calibration experiments, decoding, and system performance. You will develop physics-informed data generation pipelines, advanced physics models, and advanced noise models. Your research will translate qubit physics into performant, accelerated modeling systems for fault-tolerant quantum computing for both offline and real-time use. You will collaborate with teams across Product, Engineering, and Applied Research to push the frontier of Accelerated Quantum Supercomputers! Do you love developing new technology, enjoy working with people and teams around the world, and operating at the speed of light? If yes, we would love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

  • Research and develop advanced physics-based models and scalable simulation frameworks.
  • Build physics-informed synthetic data generation pipelines that leverage quantum device models, noise channels, and Hamiltonian characterization to produce high-quality datasets.
  • Develop detailed noise models of quantum hardware that capture device physics, decoherence, and drift behavior, enabling accurate performance prediction and parameter inference without full experimental overhead.
  • Develop GPU-accelerated implementations to ensure the full simulation and modeling pipeline scales.
  • Communicate research findings and collaborate with academic and industry partners to advance the field, while championing rapid innovation, technical depth, and creative problem solving.

What We Need To See

  • Masters Degree in Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field (Ph.D. strongly preferred); or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of combined experience and high impact in quantum systems, physics-based modeling, simulation, or related research areas.
  • Hands-on expertise in developing high-fidelity models of physical systems, including numerical simulation and model validation.
  • Strong background in quantum device physics and information science, including noise models, error mechanisms, and fault-tolerant quantum systems across one or more qubit modalities.
  • Broad understanding of quantum control, such as pulse-level hardware interfaces and classical feedback through software abstractions.
  • Experience with scalable computing or accelerated systems for simulation, numerical methods, or modeling workflows.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
job.description:
Reports to: Director of Software

Type: Full-Time

Location: Ottawa or Toronto

Location AuraNet is Dominion Dynamics' mesh networking platform for autonomous assets working in contested and disconnected environments. It has to move data securely and in real time over links that aren't conventional wired networks, where bandwidth is scarce, connections drop, and the cloud may not be reachable at all. Keeping that working is the job.

You'll design and build the backend systems behind AuraNet in Python and Rust, across distributed systems, networking and security. You'll own an area of AuraNet or a project built on it, and move to where the work matters most as priorities shift. We're a small team building sovereign Canadian capability for the people who use it in the field. We value engineers who make good decisions quickly, ship quality work, and set the bar for the engineers who join after them.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build backend services in Python and Rust for data ingestion, processing and real-time distribution across AuraNet.
  • Build and tune networking for low-latency, end-to-end encrypted communication over mesh, intermittent and non-cloud links.
  • Bring a security-first approach to the platform, including authentication, PKI and encrypted transport, and add depth to the team's security work.
  • Package and deploy services in containers that run reliably on edge hardware with limited connectivity.
  • Integrate backend systems with autonomous platforms, flight stacks and simulation environments as the work requires.
  • Shape platform architecture and engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews and mentoring.
  • Move across AuraNet and related projects as priorities change, picking up whatever needs to ship next.

What You Bring

  • Senior or Staff-level experience designing and shipping distributed systems in production.
  • Strong backend engineering in Python and/or Rust, and willingness to work in both.
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, UDP, and publish/subscribe architectures.
  • Working knowledge of security concepts, including end-to-end encryption, PKI, authentication and authorization.
  • Hands-on experience with containers and deploying services outside a standard cloud environment.
  • Sound judgment, and you move fast without cutting corners on quality.
  • Low ego and a get-it-done attitude. You're comfortable owning your work and changing focus when the team needs it.
  • Eligibility for Canadian security clearance.

Nice to Have

job.name: Principal, Senior, Distinguished Engineer, AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services, AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services
job.description:
Description We are hiring Principal, Senior, and Distinguished Engineers to join AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services.

AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services is redefining how the world stores, serves, and reasons over data in the age of AI. Our vision is to make every byte of enterprise data instantly durable, infinitely scalable, and intelligent by default — so that organizations of any size can turn their data into insight and action. We pair decades of hard-won operational experience with relentless curiosity to build the foundational services the rest of the cloud is built on: object storage (Amazon S3), block storage (Amazon EBS), archival storage (Amazon S3 Glacier), analytics and database engines (Amazon Redshift, EMR, SageMaker), and the ultra-high-performance caching layers that make generative AI and analytics fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale. We're hiring Principal and Senior Principal Engineers across the org to own technical direction for some of our hardest problems: building a new cache product purpose-built for GenAI and analytics — delivering ultra-low-latency, ultra-high-throughput access to S3 data at exponential scale; setting architecture for S3 storage at the exabyte tier; and driving the engineering direction of SageMaker, Redshift, EMR, and AWS Database Services. These are deep, high-ownership systems roles — some remote-eligible, others anchored to hubs like Seattle, Irvine, and Berlin — for engineers who have led org-wide technical strategy and want to see it run in production. If you want to build systems that operate at planet scale — where durability, availability, latency, and failure-mode ownership are first-class concerns measured in eleven nines — this is the team.

What You'll Do

This is a rare chance to own and ship the foundational services the rest of the cloud is built on — not features on top of a platform, but the storage, data, and caching layers that everything else depends on, operating at a scale no one else in the industry touches. You'll architect systems that store and serve exabytes of the world's most critical data, where a single design decision ripples across hundreds of millions of customers and millions of applications.

The problems here are unlike anywhere else. How do you deliver eleven nines of durability while adding net-new capabilities to a service that already stores hundreds of trillions of objects? How do you build a new cache product that serves S3 data at ultra-low latency and ultra-high throughput for GenAI and analytics workloads growing exponentially? How do you evolve block, object, and archival storage — and the analytics and database engines on top of them — without ever compromising the durability, availability, and latency guarantees customers have bet their businesses on? These are deep systems challenges solved in production, at a scale where the usual playbooks break down. You help write the new ones.

Overview JOB DESCRIPTION The Jefferies Equity Research Data Strategy Team is a global team embedded within the Equity Research department, responsible for shaping and executing the department's data and AI strategy. On the data side, the team helps incorporate fundamental and alternative datasets into Analyst research reports, combining analysts’ domain expertise with our team’s technical skills to produce thoughtful, defensible, and actionable analysis of real-world behavior at scale. On the AI side, our team is responsible for building internal generative AI tooling along with evaluating third-party AI models and tools to enhance our analysts’ work. We help integrate AI capabilities into analysts’ daily workflows and ensure that first- and third-party datasets are fully AI-accessible to them. Statistics, data engineering, data science, and AI are cornerstones of our work.

As a Data Scientist at Jefferies, your focus will be to support the Research Analysts and the Data Strategy Team’s broader platform. The candidate will use technical and financial skills to implement ideas and requests from the Research Analysts, while also building and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders, working in collaboration with the rest of the Global Data Strategy Team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Query, transform, analyze, and combine large datasets in support of solving problems and implementing research ideas across sectors and data categories, occasionally developing statistical models to predict outcomes
  • Enhance our platform through the creation and maintenance of tools, AI agents, MCP servers, and processes that streamline, scale, and standardize our ability to evaluate, clean, analyze, and disseminate data
  • Contribute to the data centralization process, ensuring all first- and third-party data assets are AI-accessible and meet quality, lineage, and governance standards
  • Present highly technical methods to non-technical stakeholders and translate open-ended questions into data-driven insights
  • Maintain and build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including research teams, third-party data vendors, management, and possibly buy-side clients

  • STEM degree with preference for Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, and related disciplines

job.name: Senior Product Engineer, Full Stack
job.description:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin.
