job.name: Software Developer for Quantum-Centric Supercomputing
job.description:
Introduction At IBM Research, we push the boundaries of what’s possible in computing: advancing AI, hybrid cloud, high‑performance computing, and quantum computing. Our teams explore the fundamental challenges that will define the next era of computational science.

As part of IBM Quantum you will join a multidisciplinary group working at the intersection of state‑of‑the‑art HPC systems and emerging quantum processors. Our culture values curiosity, creativity, and scientific rigor, offering unique opportunities to develop the software that will support the future of compute while growing professionally within a team that defines cutting-edge technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities We are seeking a software developer to build integration software enabling hybrid HPC–Quantum workflows, resource management systems, and interfaces that orchestrate workloads across classical and quantum compute backends. In this role you will:

  • Design, develop, and implement components of workflow orchestration software and libraries for hybrid HPC–Quantum systems.
  • Develop and maintain resource management, scheduling, and workload coordination APIs across distributed systems.
  • Define, implement, and evolve robust interfaces between HPC job schedulers (e.g., Slurm, LSF) and quantum runtimes.
  • Develop tools in Python, Rust, and C to support interoperability, data movement, workflow resilience, and runtime monitoring.
  • Collaborate with system architects, HPC engineers, and quantum software teams, as well as external researchers, to align workflows with system capabilities and performance goals.
  • Participate in open-source development workflows including documentation, testing, design reviews, and release processes.
  • Contribute to internal engineering practices such as CI/CD, performance instrumentation, and interface design.

Preferred Education Doctorate Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with modern software engineering practices
  • Strong proficiency in at least one systems programming language (e.g., C, C++, Rust)
  • Collaborative mindset, able to serve as a bridge between various research organizations, clients, and vendors
  • Proven ability to understand user requirements, implement and release software accordingly, and manage post-release maintenance including feature enhancements and bug fixes

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Hands-on experience with HPC software (e.g., OpenMP, MPI, GPU) and resource managers (e.g., Slurm, PBS, Grid Engine)
  • Experience with quantum computing frontends and related ecosystems (e.g., Qiskit, OpenQASM, CUDA-Q)

job.name: Graduate Software Engineer (DV Commodities)
job.description:
About Us :

Founded more than 15 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America and in Europe. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser.

DV Commodities is a division within DV Group that specializes in trading commodities markets, including crude oil, refined products, natural gas, power, emissions, metals, softs, and agriculture. DV Commodities' risk management, world-class technology, and talented traders have enabled it to become one of the world's largest liquidity providers and risk allocators in the energy and commodities spaces. DV Commodities currently has over 35 desks, with traders and staff located in London, New York, Chicago, Houston, and Dubai.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and improve a variety of proprietary trading tools to support the trading desks across the business
  • Collaborate with other developers, tech leaders, traders, and researchers to outline the technical needs for each trading application
  • Work with technology and business stakeholders in iterative fashion to deliver platform functionality
  • Architect greenfield solutions to address business needs, and work with equal confidence in established codebases: quickly building context in unfamiliar systems, extending them safely, and improving them as you go
  • Use AI to accelerate development while taking full ownership of your code: apply engineering judgment across the entire lifecycle, from design and edge case handling through deployment and production support

Requirements:

  • Expected to graduate with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field by Summer 2027
  • Experience programming in either C++ and/or Python in Linux environments, ideally on quantitative or latency-sensitive problems
  • Accelerate development with AI tools while fully owning your code from verification through edge case handling
  • Excellent listening, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
  • Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work onsite at our New York office 5 days a week

job.name: Software Engineer, GPU Fleet
job.description:
Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998. Tower has built its business on a high-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25+ year track record of innovation and a reputation for discovering unique market opportunities.

Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.

Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.

At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best.

At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.

Summary:

Our GPU fleet is one of the fastest-growing and most critical parts of the firm's infrastructure, and this role is about the software that keeps it healthy, observable, and efficient.

In this role you will build and own the tooling behind day-to-day GPU operations: management, monitoring, metrics collection, maintenance, and network configuration. When something misbehaves anywhere between an application and the kernel, you will help track it down.

The work varies day to day by design. One day you might be shipping a new feature for our fleet automation, the next digging into a stubborn driver issue, the next mining job statistics to find where the fleet could be doing more with what it has.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain the tooling that automates GPU fleet operations: management, monitoring, metrics collection, maintenance, and network configuration.
  • Troubleshoot software and hardware issues across the fleet, from application and network problems down to the operating system and kernel.
  • Work with engineering teams across the firm to tune workloads and processes so they use GPUs more efficiently.
  • Analyze GPU job statistics to surface trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

job.name: Databricks Data Engineer

Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities AuthMind is a pioneering Identity SecOps provider that arms identity and cybersecurity teams with end-to-end, real-time identity security posture management and threat detection. AuthMind is designed to secure identity and access in any cloud (e.g., AWS, Azure), as well as on-premises or data centres.

AuthMind discovers and monitors any identity that enterprise employees use to connect to any asset, anywhere, anytime. The AuthMind Identity SecOps Platform enables SecOps to address the most dangerous enablers of identity-based attacks: blind spots, identity infrastructure security gaps, and misconfigurations caused by human error. It allows security orgs to become enablers for engineering and business teams to move faster as they adopt new cloud and SaaS tooling.

The product is heavily driven by data analytics as well as AI/ML. The core idea is to analyse events & logs from enterprise systems & networks to enable the use cases we are trying to solve in the area of identity & access security.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Development Engineer with 3 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic and fast-paced engineering team. The ideal candidate is technically adept, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and has a proven track record of building and scaling backend services. You will play a critical role in designing and delivering high-performance, secure systems for solving some of the most challenging problems in identity security while mentoring others and driving engineering excellence.

job.name: Senior System Software Engineer - Datacenter Power Management
job.description:
NVIDIA is redefining accelerated computing and powering the next era of artificial intelligence. Our data-center platforms bring together GPUs, CPUs, networking, systems, and software to solve some of the world’s most exciting computing problems. We are looking for a Senior System Software Engineer to join NVIDIA’s Datacenter Performance and Power Management Software team. You will be responsible for architecting production software for datacenter power management controllers. Your work will also cover cluster- level dynamic provisioning and power-management control system technologies for next-generation data-centers.

You will work at the intersection of hardware architecture, embedded firmware, device drivers, operating systems, and AI workloads. Your responsibilities will span the entire product lifecycle—from initial architectural design and pre-silicon validation through silicon bring-up, productization, and deployment in extensive data-center infrastructures. This is an outstanding chance to influence how next-generation NVIDIA GPUs provide top-tier performance, energy efficiency, and reliability.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Architect, build, implement, and debug data center power and performance-management software, with particular emphasis on end-to-end power management at racks and data halls.
  • Develop real-time controllers, policies, and mechanisms that dynamically optimize performance, power, thermals, and energy efficiency under demanding data-center workloads.
  • Drive features across the full product lifecycle: requirements, architecture, implementation, pre-silicon validation, silicon bring-up, productization, and production support.
  • Collaborate with GPU architects and hardware designers to define hardware-software interfaces and influence the power-management capabilities of next-generation processors.
  • Analyze complex interactions among workloads, clocks, voltages, power limits, thermals, telemetry, and system-level policies.
  • Lead the investigation and resolution of complex power, performance, stability, and reliability issues spanning firmware, drivers, hardware, and platform software.
  • Develop validation strategies and automation for functional correctness, transition latency, performance-per-watt, and robustness across operating conditions.
  • Build clear architecture, interface, and compose specifications for new power-management features.
  • Partner with geographically distributed architecture, ASIC, firmware, driver, validation, platform, and data-center systems teams.

What We Need To See

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
job.description:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role As a Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack you will be responsible for the development and maintenance of our web application and platform that is used for Fraud analysis. You will be working closely with Product & Design, Solutions Engineering, Data Science, Infrastructure and the Data Platform teams to build new products and enhance our existing suite of products.

This is a remote, US-based role.

Overview Help build the high-performance networking infrastructure powering Microsoft's next generation of AI accelerators.

As a Software Engineer II and/or Senior Software Engineer - AI Accelerator Networking on the Maia networking team, you'll develop the software that enables thousands of AI accelerators to communicate efficiently and reliably. You'll work at the intersection of high-performance networking, distributed systems, and custom silicon, tackling challenging problems in RDMA, data movement, and large-scale AI infrastructure.

You'll work across the networking stack, from low-level hardware interfaces and RDMA data paths to enabling communication across large clusters of accelerators. Working closely with silicon architects, firmware engineers, and distributed runtime teams, you'll help shape networking capabilities for current and future generations of Maia.

This is an opportunity to solve complex systems problems, influence hardware and software architecture, and help push the boundaries of what's possible with large-scale AI systems.

At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.

  • Build high-performance networking software in C++ and Linux, including RDMA-based communication, connection management, and efficient data movement across AI accelerators.
  • Design and evolve networking capabilities that enable distributed AI workloads to scale efficiently across devices, nodes, and clusters.
  • Solve complex systems problems involving performance, concurrency, and reliability across hardware and software boundaries, using profiling, benchmarking, and hands-on experimentation.

job.name: Software QA Lead
job.description:
Hiring for Cotecna Inspection — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About Company

Cotecna is a global provider of testing, inspection and certification services. Its digital products support customer portals, field inspection, laboratories, compliance records, certificates, document workflows and operational teams across high-stakes global supply chains. The company is strengthening the quality-engineering foundations behind these applications.

Job Roles & Responsibilities

  • Own the automation strategy while remaining hands-on with framework design, test development, debugging and execution across Cotecna’s digital products.
  • Build and evolve maintainable automation frameworks for web and API journeys; framework choice is flexible when the architecture and ownership evidence are strong.
  • Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish reliable quality gates, reporting, triage and release-readiness criteria.
  • Lead and mentor QA engineers, define standards and review practices, and improve coverage, speed, maintainability and production quality.
  • Partner with product, engineering and business stakeholders on risk-based testing, defect prevention, go/no-go decisions and post-release improvement.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Six to ten years of QA or quality-engineering experience, including at least five years of recent hands-on automation and continued coding or framework work.
  • Demonstrable ownership of an automation framework built from scratch or substantially architected; scripting only inside somebody else’s framework is insufficient.
  • Hands-on web automation using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or an equivalent, plus API automation using Rest Assured, Postman, Karate or an equivalent.
  • Personal ownership of integrating automated suites into Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or a comparable delivery pipeline.
  • Evidence of leading or owning QA for a team, including mentoring, standards and release or production-readiness decisions; quantified team size is preferred.
  • Mobile automation, performance or security-aware testing, cloud or containers, and regulated or document-heavy systems are useful differentiators.

Hiring Process

1. Internal HM Review
2. Flexiple Interview

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in test planning, test case design, functional testing, regression testing, API testing, automation frameworks, and defect management.   • Perform API testing using Postman, Rest Assured, or similar tools.

  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), production deployments, and post-release validation.

Are you passionate about building AI agents that reason, plan, route work, and run reliably in production—not just prototypes? Do you want to shape how an enterprise builds, operates, and governs digital workers at scale? Join our AgentOps Engineering team and help build the core platform capabilities that power agent crews running across the business.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on building . You’ll ship the write-path features that let agents take real actions, design the orchestration and routing patterns that direct work to the right agent, and engineer enhancements to the platform itself—working inside it, not just on top of it. Through this, you’ll help teams across Pearson put dependable AI agents to work, and help people realize the lives they imagine through learning.

As a key member of the AgentOps Engineering team and Pearson, you will be expected to embody, and role model our leadership dimensions:

  • Deliver Results: You set a high-quality bar, get the details right, and own outcomes that matter to learners and stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

  • Build write-path features
  • Ship the features that let agents take real, governed actions—wrapping enterprise APIs, validators, and data sources so agents can write, not just read.
  • Design safe write semantics: idempotency, confirmation and human-in-the-loop gates, structured outputs, and audit-ready action logging.
  • Design multi-agent orchestration
  • Build multi-agent and digital-worker orchestration patterns that let specialized agents delegate, collaborate, and complete multi-step goals.
  • Build stateful, cyclic workflows using modern agent orchestration frameworks—enabling reflection, recovery, and adaptive execution beyond linear chains.
  • Engineer agent routing
  • Build the routing layer that directs requests to the right agent or crew—intent classification, capability-based dispatch, fallback, and escalation paths.
  • Create reusable components for retries, degraded modes, and human handoff; tune agent roles, goals, and prompts using fixtures and golden sets.
  • Enhance the platform

job.name: Engineering Manager, Reliability Engineering Flywheel - EDA Infrastructure
job.description:
NVIDIA’s EDA Infrastructure organization builds and operates the systems that support chip development. We are looking for an engineering manager to lead the team responsible for operational processes and platforms across incident management, maintenance, on-call, issue management, and customer-serving readiness.

You will own the roadmap and delivery, from defining how teams work to building the tools they use. You will partner with infrastructure and service owners to improve reliability, reduce manual work, and ensure services are ready to support customers. Your team will use automation, AI, and lessons from operational events to drive improvements.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead a team and own the roadmap for operational processes and platforms, from requirements and delivery through adoption and results.
  • Set technical direction, prioritize work, and guide execution across engineering and operational disciplines.
  • Partner with infrastructure, product, and security teams to establish consistent practices for incident response, maintenance, on-call, issue management, and customer-serving readiness.
  • Hire and develop engineers and technical leads, building a team with clear ownership and accountability.
  • Align priorities across teams, communicate progress and risks, and provide technical leadership during major incidents.

What We Need To See

  • BS degree or equivalent experience with 10+ overall years of software engineering or related experience, including 5+ years of engineering leadership managing teams or complex technical programs.
  • Knowledge of operational processes and supporting platforms, including roadmap, delivery, adoption, and improvement.
  • Strong technical judgment in software architecture, platform integration, and engineering tradeoffs.
  • Clear communication with engineers, cross-functional partners, and executive stakeholders.
  • A record of developing engineers, growing teams, and delivering results under pressure.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Established readiness standards covering service ownership, support coverage, and reliability objectives.
  • Built, integrated, and scaled platforms pertaining the incident, maintenance, customer experience management, along with on-call and production readiness
  • Applied AI or LLMs to improve triage, knowledge retrieval, incident analysis, or automation.
  • Supported EDA, large-scale compute, or hybrid infrastructure with complex dependencies and demanding availability requirements.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous?

job.name: Robotics Systems Engineer III , Tech Deployment
job.description:
Description Are you passionate about building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers some of the world's most impactful technology? Do you thrive when diagnosing complex system issues, turning manual processes into automated solutions, and driving projects from concept to completion? As a Systems Administrator Engineer III at Amazon, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for designing, operating, and improving the systems and services that keep our operations running smoothly. You will work across multiple technology domains, including operating systems, networking, hardware, and software, to solve challenging problems and deliver reliable, high-performing infrastructure. This role blends hands-on engineering with project leadership, giving you the opportunity to plan and execute technical initiatives, mentor fellow engineers, and shape the technical direction of your team while collaborating with partners across the organization.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of systems and services within your team's scope, ensuring they are highly available, performant, secure, and maintainable.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple technology areas, determining both short-term mitigations and long-term solutions while minimizing customer impact.
  • Plan and manage technical projects end to end, including scoping work, defining milestones, tracking deliverables, and coordinating across teams to keep initiatives on schedule.
  • Develop and maintain automation that simplifies operational workloads, scales infrastructure, and reduces points of failure across managed systems.
  • Drive the creation and review of standard operating procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation while communicating project status, trade-offs, and risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing system health dashboards and triaging alerts before joining a project stand-up to check progress against milestones. After lunch, you could be leading an implementation review with your team, then coordinating with partner teams on dependencies for an upcoming deployment. Later in the afternoon, you shift to root-cause analysis on a performance anomaly, documenting findings and updating your project tracker before wrapping up.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • Maternity and Parental Leave Options
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k) Plan

Read the full description

job.description:
The CIO’s Post Sales organization builds and operates many of the technology platforms that enable the end-to-end customer lifecycle, spanning Revenue Operations, Technical Support, Customer Success, and Professional Services.

As a Senior Product Manager within the Post Sales organization, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for the Technical Services platforms and tools. These platforms and tools are used by customer facing developers and engineers , and they directly affect how effectively these teams solve highly complex technical problems every day. Initiatives could include work around a Customer Health Application, utilizing agentic capabilities to minimize manual tasks, optimizing integration options and more.

You will partner with Technical Services and Engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize investments, solve hard problems creatively by delivering scalable solutions that improve end customer experiences, drive operational efficiency, and support scaling business growth.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Austin, Seattle, Palo Alto and New York for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities Domain Expertise

  • Proven experience modernizing Technical Support platforms including developer tooling, including but not limited to knowledge sharing, workforce planning, workflow automation and optimization for technical support engineers
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end support user journey, including case creation and management, omni-channel case routing, prioritization, system integrations, and AI-driven proactive customer engagement
  • Expertise in customer and support agent journeys, support processes, and operational workflows, with a track record of large-scale digital transformations and delivering custom solutions that address complex business challenges creatively
  • Extensive knowledge of integration patterns across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, external support portals, developer tooling and analytics platforms to deliver seamless customer and agent experiences
  • Broad understanding of the post-sales milestones spanning Professional Services, Technical Support, and Solution Architects with the ability to design solutions that optimize this end user experience
  • Expertise in building and scaling out of the box technology solutions for Technical Support, and Professional Services organizations

Product Strategy & Vision

job.name: Director, Software Development, Builder Operations, Amazon SW Builder Experience
job.description:
Description Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), started in 2022, is working to make Amazon the best place to build software. Every day, hundreds of thousands of Amazon software builders rely on us for the tools they build with, and for the technology, training, and community behind them. We are at an inflection point as builders shift from performing every step of software development to supervising agents that perform the steps. We own the experience that makes this transition work, empowering builders to apply their knowledge and expertise to invent more for customers.

The Role

We are seeking a Director of Software Development to lead Builder Operations (“Builder Ops”), the organization that builds the technology, tools, and services Amazon teams use to practice DevOps for all of Amazon (AWS, Retail, Devices, and beyond): incident management, change management in production, and the feedback loops that turn operational learnings into better software. This team is leading the charge to bring agentic operations to Amazon, and this leader will define how humans and agents run production together. Few engineering roles anywhere combine this scope, this scale, and this moment.

Builder Ops has built one of the largest incident-management and DevOps platforms in the industry, with the majority of that work now resolved faster, and safely, using AI. The strategic priority this leader owns is the shift to agentic operations: defining how humans and agents operate together at Amazon's safety bar, at dramatically higher speed, while maintaining the reliability builders and customers depend on. This is an established organization that owns tools and services used by virtually every builder at Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Builder Ops, connecting it to builder impact: code quality, reliability, security, developer productivity, and the shift to agent-supervised development.
  • Own Amazon's incident management, change management, and operational-safety capabilities across all regions.
  • Drive agentic operations, defining how AI agents and human operators collaborate at Amazon's safety bar at machine-speed.
  • Lead and grow a multi-team engineering organization: develop leaders, attract Principal Engineers, and build the leadership bench.
  • Drive product quality and operational excellence end to end while accelerating innovation velocity.
  • Partner across ASBX and Amazon to align execution with strategy and orchestrate shared solutions.
  • Influence strategy and technical direction at the most senior levels of the company through clear written narrative and data; briefs at CEO-level reviews.

Basic Qualifications

job.name: Principal Engineer & Senior Principal Engineer, AWS Infrastructure Services
job.description:
Description We are hiring Principal Engineers and Senior Principal Engineers to join AWS Network Services.

We meet our customers at the scale of quadrillions of transactions per second across every layer of connected applications. Our millions of customers, from single-developer startups to the largest companies in the world, rely on us to present their business to the world — seamlessly, without limits. We make use of innovative virtualization technology to make connectivity magical.

We don't build on top of the cloud. We build what the cloud is built on.

What You'll Do You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, protocols, hardware, and security, and every system we ship goes straight into production, powering the world’s most demanding workloads. Nothing we build sits on a shelf.

You won't be tuning knobs on an existing system. You'll be deciding what the system is. As a Principal or Senior Principal Engineer, you'll set the technical direction for the systems that make AWS possible where microseconds matter and billions of dollars of customer workloads depend on your decisions.

Here, great products start with Engineering. Principal Engineers work in close partnership with Product Management. You’ll propose new products born from deep technical insight and help shape and sharpen ideas. The roadmap grows with its Principal Engineers, so the systems you invent become the products customers rely on.

Key job responsibilities

Among The Areas We’re Hiring For Today

  • Compute Connectivity: Deliver scale, security, and simplicity. Enable customers to focus on their applications and maximize their compute efficiency, while the connectivity underneath just works.
  • Real-Time Media: Real-Time Media: Build the infrastructure for sub-second, bidirectional video and audio delivery at global scale, spanning interactive live streaming, AI-integrated experiences, real-time AI voice agents, and physical AI
  • Security & Threat Defense: Ensure that connectivity brings only good to our customers' businesses. Innovate across traffic classification, adversarial defense, and application protection so that trust in AWS is never in question.
  • Moving the Bytes that Move the World: AWS connectivity solutions power the largest companies in the world and provide critical support to governments. Other AWS services rely on our solutions too and even small features can support headline-driving events.
  • VPC Core — Cross-Plane Networking Architecture: Turn customer and AWS-service intent into working network state across the planes that record it, deliver it, and enforce it in hardware. Own the contracts and scale models between those planes so a change that’s right in one never breaks another and keep VPC scaling as fast as the services built on it.

Read the full description

job.description:
Description AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Are you passionate about driving change and transforming how organizations deliver customer resilience at scale? The Customer Outcomes and Resilience Engineering (CORE) organization is seeking a results-oriented Technical Program Manager to create and drive projects and programs that support a unified real-time incident response and complex escalation recovery function into a single AI-first operating model. You will help deliver work in support of the transformation of a 300+ person organization from reactive to proactive—resolving customer issues, preventing recurrence, and shipping production AI capabilities at scale.

As a Technical Program Manager in CORE, you will lead projects aligned to our regional leaders, helping to own and define how the organization scales customer resilience and onboarding across regions. Working with Generative AI and Agentic AI technology initiatives, you will partner with business leaders to understand their requirements across critical incidents and escalations, and collaborate with builder teams to create scalable long-term mechanisms that turn every incident into an input that improves the system. Your work will keep the flywheel between front-line resolution and upstream service improvement compounding quarter over quarter, delivering the Unified Operations set of services that delight our customers.

job.name: Sr Software Development Engineer - Amazon MSK, Managed Streaming for Kafka
job.description:
Description Come build the future of data streaming with the Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (MSK) team!

We are seeking builders for our Amazon MSK service, a fully managed service that makes it easy for customers to build and run applications that use Apache Kafka to process streaming data. We are looking for engineers who are enthusiastic about data streaming, and are as passionate about contributing to open source as they are about solving real customers' business needs, at AWS scale.

As a member of the Amazon MSK team, you will be making contributions to the entire core data plane stack that make up the MSK service, the core Kafka platform, and stand-alone tools that make it easier for Kafka community to operate Kafka better. Upstream compatibility is a core tenet of MSK. Your code changes to the Kafka platform will be released back to open source. As a member of an AWS service that builds on top of a popular open source technology, this is a unique opportunity to work on a team that straddles both worlds – open source and Amazon-internal software. You will design and build new features, make performance improvements, identify and investigate new technologies, prototype solutions, build scalable services, and test and review changes, to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

The ideal candidate has experience designing large-scale systems supporting millions of transactions per second, enjoys solving complex software problems, and possesses analytical, design and problem-solving skills. Ideally you have an in-depth understanding of streaming data technologies like Amazon Kinesis or Apache Kafka, and experience with open-source data processing frameworks like Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or Apache Storm. Your responsibilities will include collaborating with other engineers to build a large scale AWS service, and work with senior leaders to define your team's roadmap, including identifying design and code changes needed in the underlying open source platforms.

Learn more about Amazon MSK: - AWS re:Invent 2018: Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (Amazon MSK) Launch

  • AWS re:Invent 2020: How Goldman Sachs uses an Amazon MSK backbone for Transaction Banking Platform
  • AWS re:Invent 2020: How New Relic is migrating its Apache Kafka cluster to Amazon MSK
  • AWS re:Invent 2021: How Coinbase uses Amazon MSK as an event store for applications
  • MSK Tiered Storage: Optimize cost and improve Kafka scalability
  • AWS re:Invent 2023: How Rivian builds real-time analytics from electric vehicles

Utility Computing (UC)

job.name: Data Engineer
job.description:
Hiring for PULS Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About PULS Group

PULS Group is a global leader in DIN rail power supplies, Field Power Supplies, and industrial power technology. The India team is scaling local capability for manufacturing, analytics, supply-chain visibility, and cross-functional business support while staying connected to PULS global operating standards. The role is based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

Job Roles & Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines from SAP S/4HANA into Snowflake, ensuring clean, consistent, business-ready data for the global controlling and analytics team.
  • Model, transform, and optimize data in Snowflake using strong SQL, structured layers, semantic models, and performance-aware data-engineering practices.
  • Partner with business controllers and global stakeholders to convert requirements into MVPs, functional testing, UAT, rollout, and ongoing enhancements across 2–3 month project cycles.
  • Support Power BI as the reporting and visualization front-end, including datasets, dashboards, calculations, and validation of outputs against source systems.
  • Work through Jira/ticket-based delivery while communicating clearly with teams across India, Germany, Czech Republic, China, and external partners.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 3–5 years of data engineering, analytics engineering, or BI engineering experience; no freshers/newcomers for this role.
  • Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is the top priority, including data modeling, transformations, warehouse concepts, and performance optimization.
  • Advanced SQL and practical ETL/ELT or data-pipeline experience, ideally around business, finance, controlling, operations, or manufacturing data.
  • SAP S/4HANA exposure is a strong advantage but trainable; candidates with strong Snowflake/data-engineering fundamentals should still be considered if SAP depth is emerging.
  • Power BI experience is helpful for front-end visualization, but should not outweigh Snowflake/data-engineering strength.
  • Computer Science or Information Systems background preferred; Snowflake Cortex, AI/ML on Snowflake, or chatbot-over-business-data exposure is a bonus signal.

Role Impact

This role will help PULS replace and localize data-engineering capability that previously sat in Munich. The hire will turn SAP and business data into trusted Snowflake data products and Power BI outputs, enabling controllers and global business teams to make faster, more confident decisions.

What We Offer

  • Work with a global industrial technology leader building India capabilities across analytics, manufacturing, sourcing, and operations.
  • Collaborate with international stakeholders on practical, business-critical data products rather than isolated dashboard work.
  • Gain exposure to emerging Snowflake AI/Cortex use cases, including chatbot-style interaction with SAP/business data.

job.name: Process Automation & Workflow Design Lead
job.description:
Why this role matters

Own the common method for identifying, redesigning, instrumenting and scaling AI-enabled workflows, and the capability system required to embed them. The role connects domain expertise, market users, Champions, product teams and specialist talent so adoption is designed from prototype and the work changes, not simply the technology.

Reports to: VP, AI Adoption & Scale

Location / scope: Above-market, International; across domains, solutions and market workflows

People leadership: Approximately 6-9 AI-native specialists / flexible bench

Role type: Workflow design, experience design, automation and capability change

Key accountabilities

Own the workflow transformation method

  • Define the end-to-end method: baseline, pain points, prioritization, future-state design, automation opportunity, embedding and evidence.
  • Create facilitation guides, standards, templates, quality criteria and practitioner certification.
  • Ensure methods are practical across markets and can be applied with limited central dependence.

Lead experience design and co-creation

  • Translate user, market and domain insight into clear experience briefs.
  • Co-design with representative users from prototype onward and test usability, behavioural friction, hand-offs and local fit.
  • Bring workflow, service design and automation expertise into product and domain discussions.

Build instrumentation and evidence

  • Define baselines, success measures and instrumentation before scale.
  • Work with product, data and technical teams to build adoption, behaviour and outcome events into solutions.
  • Create before-and-after evidence and package validated redesigns for reuse.

Build capability and behaviour change

  • Define role-based capabilities and observable behaviors required for new workflows.
  • Develop curriculum architecture, facilitator certification, playbooks and applied learning experiences.
  • Ensure learning is connected to priority workflows and reinforced in the operating rhythm.

Manage the specialist bench and reusable library

  • Deploy specialist capacity against priority domains, products and markets with explicit outcomes and hand-offs.
  • Curate workflow patterns, reusable assets and validated case studies.
  • Continuously improve quality standards based on evidence and practitioner feedback.

What success looks like

  • Priority workflows have clear baselines, future states, ownership, instrumentation and embedded use.
  • Friction, steps and unnecessary hand-offs are reduced.
  • Priority products have agreed behavioural and outcome events before scale.
  • Markets and domains can apply the method with limited central dependence.
  • Validated workflow patterns and assets are reused across products and markets.

job.description:
US Mortgage Loan Originations Underwriting

Job Summary This role focuses on managing and optimizing loan origination processes in a night shift work from office model while applying strong expertise in MS Excel to analyze data track pipeline metrics and improve operational efficiency across pre underwriting and underwriting activities in order to deliver accurate and timely credit decisions for a global financial services environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage end to end loan origination workflows to ensure accurate intake data validation and timely progression of applications across all internal checkpoints in a structured and compliant manner.
  • Analyze large volumes of loan application data in MS Excel to identify patterns detect anomalies and generate insights that support higher quality credit evaluation and operational decision making.
  • Develop detailed Excel based trackers and dashboards that provide transparent visibility into pipeline status turnaround times and key performance indicators for loan originations.
  • Coordinate closely with credit operations risk and quality review teams to resolve application discrepancies and ensure that each case is processed with complete and reliable information.
  • Document and refine standard operating procedures for loan origination stages so that each task owner has clear guidance on inputs outputs and quality expectations.
  • Collaborate with technology and process excellence teams to suggest automation or template improvements grounded in recurring trends observed through Excel reports and operational metrics.
  • Review pre underwriting documentation for completeness basic eligibility criteria and data consistency so that underwriters can focus on higher value risk analysis rather than preliminary checks.
  • Support underwriting teams by preparing concise Excel summaries of applicant income obligations and collateral information that enable quick and informed credit assessments.
  • Monitor night shift process performance and promptly escalate capacity constraints or systemic issues that might impact service level commitments to business partners.
  • Provide coaching and process clarification to team members with less experience in Excel so that overall team productivity and data accuracy are improved over time.
  • Ensure strict adherence to regulatory guidelines and internal risk controls throughout the loan origination journey to protect customers and the organization from avoidable exposure.
  • Coordinate handoffs between day and night shift stakeholders by maintaining clear Excel based logs that capture pending actions critical risks and priority applications.
  • Prepare periodic management reports that summarize volumes approval ratios and exception trends so that business leaders can adjust policies and resource planning appropriately.

job.name: Principal Engineer - Groundwater Modelling
job.description:
Job Description The SWM Consulting (GCC) team is seeking an experienced professional to join our growing groundwater team within the SWM Consulting Team (UK Water). You will have 8+ years of professional experience on hydrogeology, groundwater modelling and/or knowledge of UK water sector. You will be expected to work with the wider UK team on developing conceptual groundwater models, interpretation of hydrogeological and geological data, support the GCC team, assist on bids/tenders and taking ownership of other catchment studies for the UK. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career and work with industry leading hydrogeologists and groundwater modellers with an excellent support network and mentorship from the UK team and an opportunity to develop the GCC team.

Responsibilities

  • The candidate should have more than 8yrs of demonstrable working experience on MODFLOW and hydrogeology
  • Excellent communication and to effectively liaise with the UK team as well as internal and external Clients
  • Developing groundwater models, managing and interpretation of hydrogeological data
  • Skills on using automation tools for pre and post processing of large datasets (familiarity with 'Python, VBA, R' is desirable)
  • Preparing detailed modeling reports, extraction of information from groundwater models, producing interactive reports/mapping and other GIS based outputs
  • Works collaboratively within the team and proactively supports junior staff in developing their technical knowledge and understanding of tasks/projects assigned
  • Welcomes more responsibility and has an ability to proactively manage professional development, seeking support from more senior staff where required
  • Proactively contributes to the culture of safety, health and well-being of self and of individuals and the team; recognises the impact of what we do on the safety of others
  • Communicates openly and keeps people informed, actively supporting a knowledge sharing and learning environment across WSP.

Qualifications

  • Masters Degree in Water Resources Engineering or equivalent.
  • Prior experience of flood risk management based projects, ideally with exposure to standards, specifications and software tools used in the UK Water Industry. A Minimum of 6+ years of relevant industry experience is desirable.
  • Working towards professional accreditation with CIWEM or with an ability to get chartered within 1-year (Desirable)
  • Strong working knowledge of on UK groundwater modelling, hydrogeology and geomorphology.

+ Groundwater Modelling
+ Abstraction Studies
+ Low Flows Hydrology
+ Surface Water Management
+ GIS based desk-studies
+ Detailed Project/Modelling Reporting
+ Project Management/Understanding of Project Financials

job.name: Salesforce Developer
job.description:
Hiring for PULS Group — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of DIN-rail power supplies for industrial automation, with plants in Germany, the Czech Republic, China and Chennai. Its global IT team, spread across the same four countries, runs Salesforce as a core business platform connected to sales, service and SAP S/4HANA. PULS is hiring a hands-on developer in Chennai to build and extend that platform for business units worldwide.

Job Roles & Responsibilities

  • Build and enhance Salesforce solutions in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and Flow for global PULS business units.
  • Deliver Salesforce change requests on time and within budget: requirements analysis, technical design, build, testing, documentation and deployment.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA through SAP CPI, using REST/SOAP APIs and Platform Events.
  • Support releases, data migrations and cross-system projects with solution architects, administrators and integration developers.
  • Resolve incidents and problems raised by business stakeholders across countries.
  • Follow the team's development standards, code reviews, Git workflows and CI/CD deployments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development, writing Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and Flow.
  • Has built Sales Cloud features end to end, including configuration, security, data models, validation rules and automation.
  • Has designed and shipped at least one integration between Salesforce and an external system using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events or middleware.
  • Has deployed through Git-based version control and a CI/CD pipeline with Salesforce DX or similar deployment tools.
  • Has turned business-user requirements into maintainable solutions and troubleshot complex production issues.
  • Communicates clearly in English with stakeholders in several countries.
  • A plus: Platform Developer I/II certification, full-cycle implementations, SAP integration, Service Cloud, manufacturing or electronics industry experience, and work with implementation partners.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of a global Salesforce platform that is central to PULS's business.
  • A place in an international IT team across Germany, the Czech Republic, China and India.
  • Full-time, on-site role at PULS's Chennai office.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Senior Backend Engineer

Please note: This position requires the successful candidate to reside in the Edmonton area.

Build the Systems Behind a Global Real-Time Intelligence Platform

Our client is a rapidly growing Canadian technology company that helps organizations identify, understand, and respond to emerging events around the world in real time.

Their platform continuously processes massive volumes of global information, transforming raw data into actionable intelligence used by some of the world's leading organizations. Combining advanced data processing, cloud-native technologies, and AI-driven capabilities, they deliver critical insights that help customers make informed decisions when time matters most.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll play a key role in building the services, APIs, and data systems that power this platform. This is an opportunity to work on challenging engineering problems involving large-scale data ingestion, distributed processing, real-time intelligence, and modern AI technologies.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Develop APIs and platform services that enable customers to access and interact with real-time intelligence data.
  • Build and enhance data pipeline components responsible for ingesting, processing, enriching, and delivering large volumes of information from global sources.
  • Design solutions that improve platform performance, reliability, scalability, and observability.
  • Integrate new internal and external data sources into the platform.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to deliver new capabilities.
  • Contribute to technical architecture decisions and help shape the evolution of the platform.
  • Build internal tools that support operational, product, and data teams.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions while promoting engineering best practices.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of backend software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Experience designing and building REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Experience building scalable backend applications in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services such as ECS, SQS, S3, CloudWatch, or similar cloud technologies.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
  • Experience working with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
  • Strong understanding of system design, backend architecture, and software engineering best practices.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred

job.name: Développeur·euse sénior de logiciels I
job.description:
Fondée en 2004, nous sommes une entreprise technologique pionnière qui propose des jeux et du divertissement pour adultes de calibre mondial sur certaines des plateformes les plus sûres et les plus populaires qui existent actuellement en ligne. Soutenue par une équipe internationale d’innovateurs dynamiques et collaboratifs, sa mission consiste à permettre aux utilisateurs de vivre des expériences sûres et de renforcer ses communautés en célébrant la diversité, l’inclusion et l’expression – tout en maintenant des protocoles solides et dignes de confiance.

Nous offrons le meilleur des deux mondes! Les talents locaux peuvent s'épanouir dans notre bureau axé sur la collaboration avec la flexibilité d’un environnement de travail hybride, tandis que nos collègues à distance jouent un rôle essentiel au sein de notre culture dynamique. Nous disposons de bureaux à Montréal (Québec), Austin (Texas) et Nicosie (Chypre).

  • Un certain nombre de postes nécessitent une présence au bureau à temps plein\*

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur·euse sénior, pratique et opérationnel(le), avec une solide expertise en React ainsi que de fortes compétences en Java et Spring Boot. Vous dirigerez les décisions de conception frontend et serez responsable des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, de l'expérience visible par les utilisateurs dans le navigateur jusqu'aux API, services et modifications de base de données qui la soutiennent.

Ce que vous ferez :

  • Concevoir, développer, tester et maintenir des applications monopages (SPA) React ainsi que les services Java et Spring Boot qui les alimentent.
  • Diriger les décisions de conception frontend concernant la structure des composants, la gestion de l'état, l'intégration des API, l'accessibilité et la performance. Créer des composants réutilisables qui assurent une expérience utilisateur cohérente d'une fonctionnalité à l'autre.
  • Concevoir et faire évoluer les API, les services backend et les schémas SQL pour répondre aux besoins de l'entreprise à mesure que le trafic et les volumes de données augmentent.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Produit, Frontend, QA, DevOps et les autres responsables techniques pour clarifier les exigences, évaluer les options de conception et identifier les risques techniques avant la mise en œuvre.
  • Diriger les revues de code en React et en Java. Accompagner les ingénieurs juniors et intermédiaires grâce à des retours concrets, du pair programming et des discussions de conception.
  • Diriger les investigations en production à travers les couches navigateur, API, services et base de données. Identifier les causes profondes, mettre en œuvre des correctifs et en vérifier les résultats.
  • Améliorer les tests automatisés, les pipelines CI/CD et les normes d'ingénierie. Documenter les décisions de conception et partager vos connaissances à travers des présentations techniques et du mentorat.
  • Agir comme point de contact technique pour l'équipe, orienter les décisions d'architecture à traver

job.name: Staff Software Engineer, Orders Platform
job.description:
About Owner Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Role Overview Owner is the leading all-in-one platform for independent restaurants. Orders Platform is the system that takes, tracks, and settles every order a restaurant handles with the upmost reliability (even through internet outages).

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to help own and evolve the core of that platform as we scale to more and more restaurants. You'll work on problems that look very different from a traditional backend role: event-sourced data storage, data reconciliation, cost-effective observability, code distribution across thousands of devices via Kotlin Multiplatform, and restaurant workflows that must behave correctly even when part of the system disappears halfway through an operation.

Read the full description

job.name: Delivery Consultant - Application Modernization, AWS Professional Services
job.description:
Description he Amazon Web Services Professional Services team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant – Application Modernization, to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, develop, implement and re-engineer applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud, including GenAI-accelerated modernization techniques. You'll be a key leader in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

As a Delivery Consultant - Application Modernization, you will be proficient in leading the architecture of complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current applications, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities

Designing and implementation of complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs

Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery

Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies

Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies

Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

Helping customers modernize legacy applications using proven patterns such as strangler fig and anti-corruption layers

Decomposing monoliths into microservices and serverless architectures (Lambda, ECS/EKS, Fargate, Step Functions, EventBridge)

Modernizing legacy stacks (e.g., .NET Framework → .NET Core, Java EE → Spring Boot, mainframe/COBOL transformation)

Database modernization using RDS, Aurora, DMS, and schema conversion tooling

Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development and infrastructure teams

A day in the life

A WordPress Web Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining websites using the
WordPress content management system. A successful WordPress Web Developer should have a good
understanding of HTML and PHP and have experience working with WordPress. They should have
experience building responsive websites and knowledge of web development best practices and standards.
They should be able to work independently and be able to multitask and meet deadlines. They should be
well-organized and able to communicate effectively with clients and other team members. Additionally, they
should be able to troubleshoot and debug issues quickly and efficiently.

3. Customizing existing WordPress themes and plugins to match the design and functional
requirements of clients.
4. Building and maintaining custom WordPress-based solutions, such as e-commerce sites,
membership sites, and custom post types.

Should have knowledge about the SEO for pages
10. Continuously learning new technologies, frameworks and tools

From GlossGenius to Reception, its products work 24/7 on busywork like booking, marketing, client management, finances, staff and inventory management, and more.

Genius AI technology has saved businesses 106M in admin hours, earned them $2.0B in additional revenue, and facilitated more than 624M client touch points.

We're hiring across two paths: product engineers who work at the intersection of AI capabilities and customer problems, shipping the features that put agentic tools directly in front of the businesses we serve; and platform engineers who build the scalable, reliable infrastructure that makes those AI products possible in the first place. About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About The Role As a member of the AI Gateway Team, you will be responsible for developing and enhancing our AI Gateway platform, which provides a unified API for accessing hundreds of AI models from multiple providers. You will collaborate with a remote and distributed team of engineers to build reliable, low-latency systems that handle rate limiting, intelligent failovers, and seamless integrations, enabling developers to ship AI-powered applications without managing provider-specific complexities. This role focuses on ensuring production-ready reliability for AI workloads, including automatic fallbacks during outages and consistent performance across providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more.

What You'll Do

  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code, conducting thorough testing to ensure low-latency responses and stability for high-volume AI inference requests.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, AI researchers, and infrastructure engineers, to integrate new AI providers and models while addressing scalability and performance challenges.
  • Engage with the open-source community, contribute to AI SDK and related projects, and align with Vercel's ethos of fostering developer tools.
  • Gather user feedback and analytics to drive innovations in AI Gateway, such as enhanced billing unification, provider-agnostic authentication, and analytics for usage insights.

What You Need

  • 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and experience with backend development, APIs, and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience with AI/ML integrations, API gateways, distributed systems, or handling high-throughput services (e.g., rate limiting, caching, failovers)
  • Experience contributing to or participating in open source projects
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment

Benefits & Compensation:

job.name: Software Engineer, Developer Platform
job.description:
Who We Are

At Pave, we're building the industry’s leading compensation platform, combining the world's largest real-time compensation dataset with deep expertise in AI and machine learning. Our platform is perfecting the art and science of pay to give 9,000+ companies unparalleled confidence in every compensation decision.

Top tier companies like OpenAI, McDonald’s, Instacart, Atlassian, Affirm, Ericsson, Synopsys, Stripe, Databricks, and Waymo use Pave, transforming every pay decision into a competitive advantage. $190+ billion in total compensation spend is managed in our workflows, and 80% of Forbes AI 50 use Pave to benchmark compensation.

The future of pay is real-time & predictive, and we’re making it happen right now. We’ve raised $175M in funding from leading investors like Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Insight Partners, Atomico, Venture Partners, and Craft Ventures.

The Developer Platform Team @ Pave

The Developer Platform team owns the foundation that powers Pave - from the infrastructure that keeps our product reliable and scalable to the development systems that help our product, data, and engineering teams move fast with confidence. As coding agents take on more meaningful work alongside engineers, we’re extending that same platform to help both humans and agents build, verify, ship, operate, and improve software reliably in production.

What You'll Do

  • Agentic engineering: Build shared infrastructure for agent environments, repository context, event-driven workflows, verification, runtimes, automated merge flows, and measurement.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer - Connect
job.description:
The Basics

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Connect team, you will own how Tanium data reaches the rest of our customers' tools. Connect is the module that moves endpoint data and events out of Tanium and into external systems such as SIEMs (security information and event management tools like Splunk), data warehouses, ticketing systems, cloud storage, and email. Customers run thousands of these exports on schedules, and a failed or slow export means their security team is working with stale data.

You'll design and build the services behind Connect, shape its technical direction, and mentor engineers on the team. This role is a strong fit for someone on a path to Staff Engineer.

This position follows the Company's hybrid schedule, which currently requires employees to work in the office a minimum of three days per week at our Durham, NC or Emeryville, CA location. Candidates must be US-based.

What you'll do

  • Design and build scalable, reliable backend services in Node.js and Golang that collect, transform, and deliver large volumes of endpoint data to external destinations
  • Design and evolve the APIs Connect exposes and consumes, with clear contracts, versioning, and backward compatibility
  • Build and maintain integrations (connectors) to third-party platforms, handling their different authentication methods, rate limits, payload formats, and failure behavior
  • Own delivery guarantees: retries, backoff, deduplication, and back-pressure (slowing intake when a destination can't keep up), so data is not lost or duplicated
  • Build event-driven workflows using NATS (an open-source messaging system where services publish and subscribe to events) and Temporal (an open-source engine that runs multi-step jobs durably, so they resume where they left off after a crash)
  • Lead technical design for new Connect capabilities, driving decisions across teams and writing design docs others can build from
  • Improve observability (metrics, logs, tracing, alerting) so we find export problems before customers do
  • Write unit tests for your code and partner with the QA and automation team on integration and end-to-end coverage, building services that are easy to test

job.name: Senior Software Development Engineer, Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS)
job.description:
Description Can a compliance platform onboard each new team through configuration, and still keep every team's data, permissions, and workflows separate? How do you let an artificial intelligence (AI) agent scan regulatory change or test a control, and still show an auditor every source and approval behind its output? What does it take to keep a platform that compliance teams depend on secure, available, and fast to change?

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE) to join the Engineering team within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS). Our team builds the Signal Suite, the platform RCS uses to track regulatory change, assess risks and controls, run assurance testing, and manage issues to closure. Payments regulatory compliance is our core domain. RCS's north star is that compliance is never the step that delays a financial product launch, a response to regulatory change, or a market expansion. We are turning the Signal Suite from a compliance repository into the system where compliance work runs end to end. Automation takes on the volume, so experts focus on regulatory interpretation and risk judgment.

You design and build that next stage across 3 areas: the multi-tenant platform, the generative AI (GenAI) layer and its AI agents, and the engineering foundation. The platform moves to a configuration-driven design that keeps each tenant's data and access separate in every layer. The AI agents you build run steps of the compliance lifecycle, and compliance experts supervise and approve their work. The engineering foundation covers reliability, security, and release practices. Every output faces internal audit and regulatory examination, so traceability is part of the product.

As a Senior SDE, you own each problem from definition to production. You shape the requirements with product managers and Compliance Officers, write the design, build and test the services, and operate them. You make and document the trade-offs between tenant isolation, cost, latency, and delivery speed. You mentor engineers and influence technical direction across teams you do not manage. Our services run on Amazon Web Services (AWS), including AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB. Your partners also include data engineers and business intelligence engineers across RCS.

The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement and proves an idea with a working prototype before scaling it.

Key job responsibilities
