job.name: Sr AI Architect/Engineer
job.description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!

Overview Researches, designs, develops, and operates secure, production AI platform capabilities by translating business objectives and departmental requirements into deployed AI solutions. Work typically includes assessing lines of business’ automation needs, building the data connectivity, security, and cost-management infrastructure that lets AI work safely against company data, and engineering the model hosting, orchestration, and monitoring systems that deliver measurable application value.

Responsibilities Why this role exists TNS is moving from AI governance and foundations into execution. The platform building blocks are in place or underway — Microsoft 365, Copilot, Entra ID, SharePoint, and Anthropic's Claude models via AWS Bedrock. What we don't yet have is a dedicated person who can both build and operate the secure, production-grade AI platform that lets AI work safely against our data and embed with our lines of business to turn that capability into measurable value. This role does both. You'll be the technical engine and the on-the-ground partner who makes AI a productive, trusted tool across the enterprise — and who multiplies that impact by enabling others to build, not just building yourself.

What You'll Do Your time will span two connected halves.

Build and operate the AI platform Model platform and private hosting. Own our Claude deployment on AWS Bedrock end to end — model access and versioning, region and data-residency decisions, provisioned throughput vs. on-demand, and the private, VPC-isolated hosting posture that keeps our data inside our boundary and out of third-party training. Evaluate and manage additional models where they fit, and maintain a routing layer so applications aren't hard-wired to a single model or provider.

Harness and orchestration management. Build and maintain the application harness that sits between our users and the models: prompt and context management, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, guardrails and content filtering, caching, and fallback behavior. Own the evaluation harness too — regression suites, quality benchmarks, and the release process that lets us upgrade models without breaking what's in production.

Data connectivity. Design and build secure, governed connections between AI systems and TNS data — Microsoft 365 and Graph, SharePoint, databases, data warehouses, APIs, and line-of-business systems. Own the retrieval architecture, indexing and freshness strategy, and the permission-trimming that ensures every user sees only what they're entitled to see, with no leakage across boundaries.

Read the full description

job.name: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
job.description:
Description A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end-to-end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. They create reusable architectures, patterns, and engineering mechanisms that scale the entire FDE practice.

Key job responsibilities

  • Embed within customer engineering teams. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable AI-enabled production systems. Requires 30 – 50% travel.
  • Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — orchestration layers for multi-agent systems, retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, decision intelligence. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, APIs, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, observability, cost, and security.
  • Own production. Take systems from design through production rollout and operationalization. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, data pipelines, and application services. Put in place monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and the operational mechanisms (testing, CI/CD, rollback, resiliency) that keep AI systems healthy at scale.
  • Accelerate customer transformation. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption across customer workflows. Codify reusable patterns, accelerators, and reference architectures that benefit future customers and feed back into AWS.
  • Raise the bar. Mentor engineers. Contribute to AWS engineering best practices for AI and forward deployment. Push reusable components and learnings back into AWS products and services.

About The Team ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend
job.description:
SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. We were also the first company to go live with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role As a Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack you will be responsible for the development and maintenance of our web application and platform that is used for Fraud analysis. You will be working closely with Product & Design, Solutions Engineering, Data Science, Infrastructure and the Data Platform teams to build new products and enhance our existing suite of products. This role is primarily focused on frontend development (approximately 60–70%), with the remainder involving collaboration across the stack.

This is a remote, US-based role.

Technologies React, Golang, Python, PostgreSQL (RDS), Docker, AWS technologies (Lambda, Cognito and other standard technologies)

job.description:
Description AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Are you inspired to work with a team than launches products with direct and massive impact on Amazon’s customers? Are you excited to join one of the newest and most exciting AWS services?

Amazon Connect is a highly disruptive cloud-based contact center that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. Amazon Connect is the result of the ten years of development that went into building the tools Amazon uses to provide its award winning customer service at massive scale and launching it as a publicly available AWS service. With Amazon Connect, you can create your own cloud-based contact center and be taking calls in minutes. Amazon Connect leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence and the large ecosystem of AWS services such as Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and Amazon Kinesis to provide a truly frustration free, easy-to-use, extensible, and natural customer experience. With this technology, we are transforming an industry and the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them. See our section in Andy Jassy 2020 re:Invent keynote

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems. We are looking for a passionate and talented Front End Engineer to join us to innovate on this new service that addresses customer needs to build modern contact centers in the cloud. The position represents a rare opportunity to be a part of a fast-growing business soon after launch, and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will be playing a crucial role in developing the next generation contact center, and get the opportunity to design and deliver scaleable, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

job.name: Research Scientist / AI Software Engineer, LLM/Agent Platform - TikTok - Content Ecology AI Innovation & Platform - TikTok Content Ecology
job.description:
Responsibilities The TikTok Content Ecology team builds the core algorithm systems for content understanding and ecosystem governance on TikTok. Drawing on platform-scale video content and interaction signals, we apply multimodal large models, natural language processing, computer vision, and recommendation systems to build a content foundation platform supporting search, local services, product infrastructure, PGC, and UGC across TikTok's global business.

Our work spans three areas:
1. Unified content understanding. We use multimodal large models for fine-grained semantic parsing of video, building a cross-category, multilingual labeling and event knowledge system that provides reliable foundations for search, recommendation, and safety.
2. Platform-level content governance. We develop high-precision recognition and review models that handle billions of pieces of content daily, addressing low-quality and non-compliant material and supporting compliance requirements for goods and content in areas such as local services.
3. Business growth and user experience. Through trending discovery, inspiration recommendations, and intelligent customer service, we serve creators and users worldwide, improving distribution efficiency, the precision of creative recommendations, and the speed of customer service response.

We work on understanding hundreds of languages and processing multimodal data at hundred-billion scale, in a global business that keeps growing. You will apply NLP, multimodal, and large model technology at real-world scale, seeing your work reach hundreds of millions of users.

The Content Ecology Algorithm Team drives TikTok’s AI innovations in LLMs, NLP, Computer Vision (CV), multimodal learning, and recommendation algorithms. We develop cutting-edge AI capabilities that power multiple business lines.

We are seeking exceptional, experienced Research Scientists / Architects in the areas of LLM / Agent Platform. This is a unique role for innovators who are passionate about building the "bones" (scalable infrastructure) of next-generation AI and Agent. You will design and implement novel LLM/Agent frameworks with self-improving capabilities and architect the robust, high-performance infrastructure that brings these LLMs and agents to life at a global scale. This is an opportunity to shape the future of AI at one of the world's most dynamic technology companies.

job.name: Software Development Engineer, AI/ML, AWS Neuron, Model Inference
job.description:
Description The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds AWS Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium.

The AWS Neuron SDK, developed by the Annapurna Labs team at AWS, is the backbone for accelerating deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon's Inferentia and Trainium ML accelerators. This comprehensive toolkit includes an ML compiler, runtime, and application framework that seamlessly integrates with popular ML frameworks like PyTorch and JAX enabling unparalleled ML inference and training performance.

The High-Performance Inference Systems & Acceleration team is at the forefront of running a wide range of models and supporting novel architecture alongside maximizing their performance for AWS's custom ML accelerators. Working across the stack from PyTorch till the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, innovate new methods and create high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers - from frameworks and kernels and collaborate with compiler to runtime and collectives. We not only optimize current performance but also contribute to future architecture designs, working closely with customers to enable their models and ensure optimal performance. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology

You will architect and implement business critical features, and mentor a brilliant team of experienced engineers. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators. The team collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

job.name: Software Engineer - Applied AI
job.description:
Company Overview Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

*Operating Principles* Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  • Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.
  • Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.
  • Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.
  • Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

*AI-First by Default* We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.
  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.
  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.
  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Read the full description

Agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, and privacy and security are design baselines, not review gates. Agentic coding tools are how you move fast. What you add is what they are worst at: system design, security, and hard debugging. You own features end to end.

Salary Range Is $170,000 - 195,000

job.name: Software Engineer, AI Test & Evaluation
job.description:
Providius is looking for a Software Engineer, AI Test & Evaluation to help build the automated testing and evaluation systems behind our software products, with a particular focus on AI and machine learning functionality.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys writing code, experimenting with emerging technologies, building automation, and investigating complex technical problems.

*Position Overview* Our products increasingly incorporate AI and machine learning, including LLM-based assistants and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations that connect AI clients to our systems.

Testing these systems presents a different set of engineering challenges than testing traditional software. Outputs can vary between runs, quality is often measured across a distribution of results rather than a simple pass or fail, and changes to models or prompts can introduce regressions without changes to application code.

You will help build the evaluation frameworks, automated tests, datasets, and tooling that allow us to measure these behaviours and release AI-enabled software with confidence.

AI is also changing how software itself is developed. Our engineers use AI-assisted development tools daily, increasing the pace at which code is written and changed. You will help build the automated coverage and feedback loops that allow engineering to maintain that pace without sacrificing reliability.

While AI testing is a significant focus of this position, you will also contribute to conventional software test automation across our products, including API, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.

This is an individual-contributor role within engineering. You will spend most of your time writing code, building test infrastructure, investigating results, and working directly with software and ML engineers.

*Duties And Responsibilities* AI and ML Quality

  • Build and maintain evaluation suites for LLM and ML-based product features
  • Develop representative datasets, golden datasets, scoring rubrics, and automated evaluation methods
  • Test non-deterministic systems using repeated evaluations, appropriate metrics, and quality thresholds
  • Implement regression testing for prompts, models, retrieval systems, and AI-enabled workflows
  • Evaluate model outputs for correctness, consistency, relevance, and reliability
  • Test AI integrations, including MCP servers, tool calling, schemas, authentication, authorization, and error handling
  • Help evaluate model changes and fine-tuned models against existing baselines
  • Test data quality and the pipelines supporting AI and ML functionality
  • Integrate automated evaluations into CI/CD pipelines and release validation workflows
  • Investigate unexpected AI behaviour and incorporate discovered failure cases into evaluation datasets
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve test coverage and automation while validating the quality of generated tests

job.name: Member of Technical Staff - Post-Training (Reinforcement Learning & Generalization)
job.description:
Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Key Overview As a Member of Technical Staff in Post-Training, you will train our large language models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning and develop methods that help them generalize beyond the distribution they were trained on. You will design the training recipes, environments, and evaluations that tell us whether a model has truly learned a skill or has only fitted its training tasks, and turn what works into the recipes behind our production models. You will work closely with the post-training data infrastructure, evaluation, and pre-training teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, run, and analyse large-scale RL post-training experiments (e.g., RLHF, RL from verifiable rewards).
  • Research and develop methods that improve out-of-distribution generalization, such as reward design, environment and task diversity, curricula, and regularization.
  • Build held-out evaluations that measure generalization to unseen tasks, domains, and formats, and that catch reward hacking and benchmark overfitting.
  • Diagnose training dynamics and failure modes, including instability, reward over-optimization, and capability regressions.
  • Turn successful research into robust, reproducible training recipes for production models.

Qualifications

  • Strong research and software engineering skills, with hands-on experience training LLMs.
  • Experience applying reinforcement learning to LLMs (e.g., PPO, GRPO, RLHF, RLVR), ideally at scale.
  • Track record of work on generalization, robustness, or distribution shift, through publications or shipped models.
  • Rigorous experimental practice: clean ablations, careful controls, and sound conclusions from noisy results.
  • Experience with distributed training (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, FSDP, Megatron) is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Deep understanding of data quality principles and best practices: demonstrates willingness to dive deep into data while possessing strong intuition for assessing the quality of datasets and anticipating how different data characteristics will impact model training outcomes.

Read the full description

job.name: Senior and Staff Data Scientist - Credit and Lending ML
job.description:
About a week before Hurricane Sandy made landfall, the two leading forecast models flatly disagreed: the American one carried the storm safely out into the Atlantic, the European one turned it hard left into New Jersey. The European model wasn't running a better simulation, it was running an ensemble. Hundreds of thousands of people were evacuated on the strength of the spread in forecast distribution, days before any single forecast could have justified moving them, and on October 29th, 2012, Sandy came ashore almost exactly where the models had put it.

At Mercury, we're building the future of financial infrastructure for startups and growing businesses. We're extending credit to those businesses, and we're doing it with proprietary access to some of the best data for understanding a borrower's business, from bank transactions to financial reporting to payroll. We're looking for a Senior/Staff Data Scientists to turn that record into a lending decision, partnering closely with Credit, Product, and Engineering.

In this role, you'll build and own the inference layer behind our small business lending program; you'll ship it into production with the monitoring and documentation that make it trustworthy; and you'll help Credit and Product decide what we should be lending in the first place.

Here Are Some Things You'll Do On The Job:

  • Build and own the models behind our lending program - transaction classification, recurring inflow/outflow detection, annual revenue estimation, forecasting with seasonality, anomaly detection, and more
  • Turn messy data streams - bank transactions, storefront sales, and more - into a defensible view of a business's health
  • Deploy models into a production environment with observability, monitoring, and tests
  • Partner with Credit on underwriting policy: what data is asked for, when follow-up information is worth the friction, and how to quantify uncertainty
  • Partner with Product on the shape of the product: from principal sizes and pricing to repayment terms
  • Assess where predictive modeling actually moves the underwriting program
  • Set the technical bar for ML in Credit

You Should:

For Staff:

  • Have 7+ years building ML models
  • Implemented models that shaped automated decisions with money on the line
  • Write production-grade Python
  • Have depth beyond classification models; for example: time series and forecasting, anomaly detection, and NLP models
  • Be proficient with deep learning, transformers, and LLMs
  • Be strong in SQL and at home in a data warehouse
  • Be able to explain a model to a credit officer, a model validator, a PM, and an engineer
  • Be able to set modeling standards for your data-science colleagues
  • Have a quantitative degree, or the equivalent built some other way

For Senior:

The Role You will develop the autonomy that flies the platform. Dominion Dynamics is building a sovereign Autonomous Collaborative Platform (ACP) for RCAF and NORAD missions. Our autonomy and C2 layer, AuraNet, is a Canadian alternative to closed foreign stacks, purpose-built for the Arctic operating environment and near-peer threat, and our digital proving ground, AuraSim, lets us design, train, and validate autonomous tactical behaviour before it ever reaches a test platform.

Working directly with mission systems, tactics, simulation, and test stakeholders, you'll turn operational intent into executable behaviour using a hybrid approach: behaviour trees for structured, auditable, doctrine-anchored tactics, and learned policies (RL/IL) where adaptive, high-dimensional decision-making wins. You'll then prove that behaviour in simulation and help roll it out onto test platforms.

This is a build-and-deploy role, not a research-only role. You'll own autonomy end-to-end — from a tactician's whiteboard to a policy running on a test aircraft. The behaviours you build won't sit in a paper; they'll fly.

What You'll Do

  • Elicit and codify tactical behaviour. Work with pilots, tacticians, and capability stakeholders to translate combat employment into clear, testable autonomy requirements.
  • Design hybrid autonomy. Architect and implement behaviour trees for structured tactical logic and integrate learned policies where they outperform, deciding deliberately where each belongs and how they hand off. Map behaviours against our PA/MA/CA autonomy taxonomy and Capability Register.
  • Develop teaming behaviour. Build multi-agent coordination, target engagement, and survivability across cooperating platforms.
  • Build in simulation. Stand up and instrument scenarios in AuraSim to develop, train, and stress behaviours against representative threat and mission sets across our operating environment.
  • Train and validate learned policies. Work within our RL training pipeline — reward shaping, curriculum design, and large-scale rollouts — and validate policy behaviour against doctrine and mission requirements.
  • Verify and validate. Test behaviours through the full V&V lifecycle, including safety and constraint enforcement.
  • Deploy and test on hardware. Take behaviours from sim to test platforms: integration with the runtime autonomy stack, HIL/SIL testing, flight-test support, and closing the loop on observed vs. simulated performance.
  • Analyse mission data. Use mission logs and performance data to diagnose failures and refine behaviour models.
  • Collaborate across the team. Work across simulation, sensors/perception, hardware, and flight test to integrate autonomy end-to-end.

job.name: Principal AI Engineer - Context - Agents and Context
job.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role: The Context Engine team builds the knowledge layer that AI agents use to work with enterprise data in Elasticsearch. We extract knowledge from any data sources into a structured AI Index, serve it to agents through public APIs, MCP tools and framework integrations, and close the loop with agent traces so that what the engine knows improves from real usage. Any agent can use it: Elastic’s own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.

As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of engineering, data science, and product. You will write production code, design evaluation and telemetry that product decisions can rest on, and set the technical bar for how the team iterates on agentic behaviour. You will work alongside data scientists, backend engineers, product, and UX, and your work will show up directly in what customers build on top of Elastic.

The codebase is TypeScript and we build it in the open, so you'll be shipping code, designs and discussions in public alongside the rest of the Elastic Stack.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Own the production improvement loop for Context Engine: understand how extraction automations, retrieval tools and memory behave, based on offline evaluations and customer conversations and telemetry. You help find the failure modes, fix them, and prove the fix.
  • Define how we iterate on agents and skills safely: versioning and rollout of prompts, skills and automations, regression coverage, staged and shadow evaluation, and the guardrails that let us change behaviour without breaking customers.
  • Design the telemetry we need to make data-informed engineering decisions: what to capture from agent traces, tool calls and knowledge retrieval, how it lands in Elasticsearch, and how it feeds evaluation, dashboards and the feedback loop.
  • Partner with the data science team on evaluation strategy: golden datasets, evaluators to gate on quality, latency and cost.
  • Raise the bar across the team: review designs and PRs, mentor engineers in eval-driven development, and write the technical proposals that shape the roadmap.

job.name: Member of Technical Staff, Training Performance Engineer
job.description:
Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview As a Performance Engineer in the Pre-Training team you will be responsible for optimizing the performance of our advanced language models and systems. Their primary focus is on improving key model training metrics, such as training throughput, ensuring high accelerator utilization.

The team combines expertise in software engineering, machine learning, and low-level kernel design and development to design robust systems and enhance model performance. You will work on identifying and removing performance bottlenecks, develop cutting-edge training and profiling tools to help Cohere's mission of providing efficient and reliable language understanding and generation capabilities and drive innovation in the field of natural language processing.

Note: We have offices in London, Toronto, New York and San Francisco, but we’re also remote-friendly! This team operates primarily between ET to CET time zones, so we’re seeking candidates in locations that align with these hours for effective collaboration. Key Responsibilities

  • Design and write high-performant and scalable software for training.
  • Understand architectural modifications and design choices and their effects on training throughput and quality.
  • Write low-level CUDA, triton kernels to squeeze every last bit of performance from our accelerators.
  • Research, implement, and experiment with ideas on our supercompute and data infrastructure.
  • Learn from and work with the best researchers in the field.

Qualifications

  • Extremely strong software engineering skills.
  • Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks such as JAX, Pytorch and XLA/MLIR.
  • Experience writing kernels for GPUs using CUDA, triton, etc
  • Experience using large-scale distributed training strategies.
  • Familiarity with autoregressive sequence models, such as Transformers.

Bonus : paper at top-tier venues (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AIStats, MLSys, JMLR, AAAI, Nature, COLING, ACL, EMNLP).

job.name: Applied Scientist II, Performance Algorithms
job.description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world's leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet - from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world's brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges - from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you're driven to solve meaningful challenges, we'd love to meet you.

The Trade Desk is a global technology company with a mission to create a better, more open internet for everyone through principled, intelligent advertising. Handling over 1 trillion queries per day, our platform operates at an unprecedented scale. We have also built something even stronger and more valuable: an award-winning culture based on trust, ownership, empathy, and collaboration. We value the unique experiences and perspectives that each person brings to The Trade Desk, and we are committed to fostering inclusive spaces where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Do you have a passion for solving hard problems at scale? Are you eager to join a dynamic, globally-connected team where your contributions will make a meaningful difference in building a better media ecosystem? Come and see why Fortune magazine consistently ranks The Trade Desk among the best small-medium-sized workplaces globally.

About The Role Our team is responsible for developing algorithms that run in our real time bidding platform with the ultimate goal of helping thousands of customers run effective advertising campaigns. Many of our problems involve getting deep learning algorithms to train and inference at scale. Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

We're building a cutting-edge AI team, and this role is for an engineer who wants to apply AI to real problems in energy. SentiLink helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Made-to-mission software for defense.

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next-gen aerospace sector building an end-to-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems (“UAS”), aviation-related physical artificial intelligence (“AI”) solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors.

Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. What You Need:

  • 8+ years of experience related to position minimum
  • M.S., PhD, or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, with strong applied machine learning depth (exceptional BS candidates also considered).
  • Hands-on experience building, fine-tuning, and/or integrating vision-language or VLA models.

About Arcade Arcade is building the world's first AI physical product creation platform, where imagination becomes reality. Our platform lets anyone design, purchase, and sell custom, manufacturable products using natural language and generative AI. We believe everyone should have the power to create physical goods as easily as they post online, and we're building the infrastructure to make that real.

We've raised $42M from a world-class group of investors, including Reid Hoffman, Forerunner Ventures (Kirsten Green), Canaan Partners (Laura Chau), Adverb Ventures (April Underwood), Factorial Funds (Sol Bier), Offline Ventures (Brit Morin), Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher), Inspired Capital (Alexa von Tobel), and Torch Capital (Jonathan Keidan). Arcade is headquartered in San Francisco's Presidio and led by serial entrepreneur Mariam Naficy (Minted, Eve), and a founding team with deep experience in generative AI, design systems, and supply chain. We're pioneering a new category at the intersection of AI, personal expression, and on-demand manufacturing, and we're building fast.

Overview of Role

We're looking for a Staff Applied AI Engineer to architect the ML systems at the core of Arcade's product. This is a senior, high-leverage individual-contributor role for someone who thinks in systems — not just models. You'll own the architecture that lets our generative AI scale: the pipelines, the evaluation infrastructure, and the production systems that turn diffusion models and LLMs into reliable, high-quality output at volume.

You'll be the person who sees where the leverage is — the system-level changes that move our ML operations and output quality forward by a step function rather than a percentage point — and who brings state-of-the-art, industry best-practice rigor to how we train, deploy, evaluate, and improve models. You'll set the technical direction for applied AI at Arcade and raise the bar for everyone building alongside you.

job.name: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Accelerated Apache Spark
job.description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join the GPU accelerated Apache Spark team.

Apache Spark is the most popular data processing engine in data centers for running massive scale workloads for ETL, SQL, and ML/DL model training and inference pipelines, spanning many domains and use cases. NVIDIA GPUs offer a promising avenue for significantly speeding up and/or lowering the cost of running very large Apache Spark applications. You will work with the open source community to accelerate Apache Spark with GPUs. You will apply the latest ML/AI methods to empower enterprises to migrate Spark workloads onto GPUs at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design and implement machine learning solutions for performance prediction and optimization of GPU accelerated enterprise Apache Spark workloads.
  • Develop advanced algorithms and adaptive systems to continuously improve the performance of Apache Spark workloads on GPUs.
  • Develop AI-based agents and tools to assist with fixing system issues and application optimization.
  • Collaborate with key partners and customers on the deployment of complex machine learning solutions in various environments.
  • Maintain deep domain expertise by knowing the latest published advances in ML systems and algorithms.
  • Provide technical mentorship and leadership in data science and machine learning to a team of engineers.

What We Need To See

  • BS, MS, or PhD or equivalent experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science or a closely related field.
  • 12+ years of professional experience in designing, implementing, and productionizing high-quality ML/DL solutions.
  • 3+ experience as technical lead in ML model development.
  • Proven hands-on experience (2+ years) with large-scale data processing platforms, such as Apache Spark.
  • Proven ability to employ modern tooling and sound techniques for all aspects of crafting, deploying, and maintaining machine learning models.
  • Excellent programming skills in Python and Python data science related libraries like numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, scipy, pytorch, and tensorflow.
  • Deep experience with sophisticated ML methodologies, including LLM/GenAI, reinforcement learning, and adaptive, on-line ML systems.
  • Strong expertise in feature engineering, feature importance assessment, and developing boosted tree model solutions (e.g., XGBoost).

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Understanding of the internal workings and architecture related to Apache Spark.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA GPUs and CUDA.
  • Experience coding in Scala, Java, and/or C++.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most experienced and dedicated people in the world working for us. If you are passionate about what you do, creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

job.name: MongoDB Developer
job.description:
Iris Software is hiring a MongoDB Developer for multinational investment banking and financial services corporations. Our client is a world-leading financial services company that provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial services and products.

Hiring: MongoDB Developer

Locations: Toronto/Halifax (Canada) OR Raleigh, NC (USA)

Multiple Years—Long-Term Opportunity

About the role The Client Lifecycle Management (CLM) technology team is hiring a contract MongoDB developer to design, build, and optimize the data layer of an enterprise platform that onboards and maintains client and relationship data across business lines. The platform is real-time and event-driven, processes high volumes of concurrent requests, and uses Redis for caching, session state, and fast-access data. The contractor will work alongside the Node.js and integration engineering team to keep data stores performant, consistent, and secure.

Responsibilities

  • Design MongoDB schemas, indexes, and aggregation pipelines that support high volume client and relationship data.
  • Implement full CRUD data access across MongoDB and relational stores, with attention to data integrity, consistency, and transaction handling.
  • Design and implement Redis caching strategies, including key design, eviction policies, TTLs, and cache invalidation tied to event-driven updates.
  • Build and maintain event-driven data flows, including consuming and publishing events that update data stores and caches.
  • Develop and maintain data loads and ETL pipelines in Node.js or Python, including batch and incremental loads, transformation, and validation.
  • Tune query performance and capacity for concurrent workloads, using profiling, index analysis, and load testing.
  • Implement data security controls, including encryption at rest and in transit, access controls, and handling of sensitive client data.
  • Write unit and integration tests, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, data migration scripts, and observability (metrics, logging, and alerting).
  • Document data models, caching patterns, ETL processes, and operational runbooks.

Required qualifications

  • Expert-level MongoDB experience, including schema design, indexing, aggregation framework, and performance tuning in production.
  • Hands-on experience with Redis, including data structures, caching patterns, pub/sub or streams, and TTL and eviction management.
  • Experience working in an event-driven environment, with at least one messaging or streaming platform such as Kafka, Solace, or similar.
  • Proficiency in Node.js or Python for writing data loads and ETL pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of Node.js and TypeScript for building data access layers and services.
  • Experience with relational SQL databases and comfort with full CRUD operations across both NoSQL and SQL stores.

Iris's direct client, one of the Top 5 Bank in Canada, is looking to hire a Data Solution Architect (Banking) a long-term opportunity at Toronto, ON (Hybrid).

Our client is a Canadian multinational financial services company and the largest bank in Canada by market capitalization. The bank serves over 17 million clients and has more than 89,000 employees worldwide. Bank is serving individual consumers, small and middle market businesses and large corporations with a full range of banking, investing, asset management and other financial and risk-management products and services.

Position: Data Solution Architect

Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid 2-3 days/week)

Duration: Long Term (12+ Months)

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Data Solution Architect with strong expertise in AWS cloud-native data architecture, enterprise data modeling, and DataOps platforms, along with working knowledge of Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio .

The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and reusable data solutions, enabling seamless data ingestion, transformation, governance, discovery, and consumption across multiple business use cases. The role requires a combination of hands-on technical expertise, architectural leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to translate business requirements into enterprise-grade data solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end data architectures and solutions leveraging AWS cloud-native services.
  • Define and evolve the architecture of the enterprise DataOps platform to support multiple business use cases.
  • Leverage Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio to enable unified data discovery, engineering, analytics, and AI/ML workflows.
  • Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with enterprise data architecture standards.
  • Architect scalable data ingestion, transformation, processing, storage, and consumption frameworks.
  • Establish reusable architectural patterns, frameworks, and design standards to accelerate use case onboarding.
  • Drive DataOps best practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated data quality checks, monitoring, and observability.
  • Ensure data governance, lineage, metadata management, security, and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data engineers, data modelers, and platform engineering teams.
  • Provide technical leadership, conduct architecture reviews, and proactively resolve technical challenges.
  • 10+ years of overall IT experience , including 4+ years in data architecture or data solution architecture roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise data solutions on AWS.
  • Working knowledge of Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio , including:
  • Domains, projects, and project configurations.
  • SageMaker Lakehouse and SageMaker Catalog.
  • Data discovery, cataloging, sharing, and access governance.
  • Integration

job.name: Senior Databricks Engineer, Internal Data & Analytics (Contract)
job.description:
About the Company

Our client is a PE-backed technology services firm with a growing Data & AI consulting practice. They build modern data platforms for enterprise clients, and they run their own business on the same standards: Azure Databricks, infrastructure as code and automated deployments.

Internally, leadership, finance and the firm's investors already depend on a well-built Databricks environment for day-to-day decisions. The next step is giving that platform a dedicated owner.

The Role

This is a hands-on Databricks engineer to take ownership of the company's internal data and analytics platform. You'll keep the existing reporting running smoothly, ship the features already on the backlog and lead new builds directly with finance and sales stakeholders. It suits someone who works out what needs building, proposes the design and gets it to production without waiting for direction. The engagement is a roughly 12-month contract, with permanent options for the right person. The team is remote-first, with a preference for Toronto.

What You Will Do

  • Own and support the live reporting already in production, fixing issues quickly and keeping executive dashboards accurate
  • Finish a self-serve sales reporting portal on Databricks Apps, including row-level access controls and front-end improvements
  • Work through a backlog of quote-to-cash enhancements covering quoting, contracts, delivery, invoicing and collections data
  • Lead the design and build of a commissions calculation engine, working with the business to clarify plan rules and edge cases
  • Bring CRM, PSA, finance and HR system data into a single trusted source for customers, projects, contracts and revenue

What You Bring

  • Several years of hands-on production experience with Databricks, including Unity Catalog, Asset Bundles and Terraform-based deployments
  • Strong Python and SQL, with solid Git, testing and CI/CD habits from feature branch through to production
  • Daily use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, with concrete examples of how they have changed the way you build
  • Comfort working with finance and sales teams to agree on definitions and reconcile messy data across business systems
  • Experience with commissions, utilization, invoicing or project profitability data, Databricks Apps or Genie, and Databricks certifications are all strong pluses

Why This Role

You'll have real ownership of a mature platform that the company's leadership uses every day, with a clear backlog and direct access to the people who rely on it. The team builds with serious engineering discipline and uses AI-assisted development as standard practice. This is a strong fit for an engineer who wants to own outcomes rather than tickets.

job.name: Solution Engineer, Data & AI
job.description:
About the Company

This is a private equity-backed professional services firm with a growing data and AI practice that delivers projects for clients across North America. The company also runs its own business on a mature Azure Databricks platform. Deployments are fully automated, governance is in place, and finance and sales reporting is already live in production.

The Role

This is a senior, hands-on engineer who will own the company's internal data platform. Executive and investor reporting runs on it. You'll keep what's in production running smoothly and take over an active roadmap. That roadmap covers sales performance, billing and project profitability, and a new commissions engine built from scratch. It suits someone who brings an architecture proposal, gets agreement on it, and then builds it without waiting to be told.

What You Will Do

  • Run and improve production Databricks pipelines and models that feed C-suite and investor reporting on revenue, utilization and margin
  • Finish the self-serve sales performance portal, including the app front end, row-level access and query performance
  • Work through the backlog of improvements to the opportunity-to-invoice-to-collections workflow, from design through testing and release
  • Lead the design and delivery of a commissions calculation engine, working with Finance and Sales to settle plan rules and edge cases
  • Turn prototypes the business builds itself into supported production apps, and help build a semantic layer that makes AI-assisted analysis more reliable

What You Bring

  • 4+ years in data or software engineering, including deep production experience on Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta, lakehouse design)
  • Strong Python and SQL, with good habits around Git, code review and automated testing
  • Experience deploying through CI/CD and infrastructure as code, ideally Databricks Asset Bundles and Terraform
  • A record of modelling messy business-system data from CRM, ERP, finance or PSA tools into numbers leadership trusts
  • Regular use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, plus the judgment to review and test what they produce

Why This Role

The platform is already well built, so the job is to extend it, not to fix basic problems. The work comes straight from the CEO's priorities, and leadership uses what you ship. You'll be the go-to person for internal data. Over time there's room to move into client-facing data and AI delivery work as well.

job.name: Data Engineer

job.name: Équipe L'Oréal - Ingénieur base de données et développement GCP
job.description:
QUI NOUS SOMMES

Cosmo5 est une agence de performance digitale qui stimule la croissance des entreprises grâce à des stratégies basées sur les données dans plus de 18 pays, avec un réseau mondial de 29 bureaux. Depuis 2001, nos 1,200+ talents soutiennent des centaines d'entreprises locales et internationales pour développer et/ou sécuriser une position de leader sur leurs marchés.

Parmi les 400+ clients de Cosmo5, nous comptons des entreprises leaders telles que L’Oréal, Ardene, Warner Bros, Dassault, Ecko Unltd, LVMH.

INTRODUCTION

Cosmo5 recherche un·e spécialiste des bases de données et de l’ingénierie de données pour concevoir, bâtir et maintenir l’architecture de données qui soutient son équipe interne dédiée au client L’Oréal, à Montréal.

Vous recueillerez les besoins des utilisateurs, concevrez des modèles et des pipelines de données dans Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Dataform) et contribuerez au développement de OneApp, une application web interne. Vous travaillerez en français et en anglais selon vos interlocuteurs et expliquerez les enjeux techniques à des publics non techniques.

RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

La majorité de votre temps sera consacrée à la conception, à l’administration et à l’analyse des bases de données.

Analyse des besoins

  • Recueillir et documenter les besoins des spécialistes médias et des gestionnaires de compte en matière de données, de suivi de la performance et de production de rapports.

Ingénierie de données

  • Concevoir l’architecture des bases et des entrepôts de données dans BigQuery pour les projets de l’équipe.
  • Construire, modifier, tester et mettre en production les modèles de données et les pipelines ELT/ETL dans Dataform, relié à un dépôt GitHub.
  • Intégrer les données provenant de plateformes et d’API marketing (Adverity, Amazon, Google) et traiter les données non standardisées stockées dans Google Cloud Storage à l’aide de Cloud Functions et de Cloud Run.
  • Appliquer et faire évoluer les normes de gestion des données, notamment la nomenclature, la qualité, la documentation et le cycle de vie des tables.
  • Rédiger des scripts et mettre en place des automatisations, notamment des requêtes SQL planifiées, des procédures stockées et des alertes budgétaires.
  • Développer des tests d’assurance qualité (assertions Dataform) pour les pipelines nouveaux et existants.

Intelligence d’affaires

  • Interroger les bases de données pour réaliser des analyses ponctuelles et exploratoires à la demande de l’équipe ou du client.
  • Présenter les résultats dans des tableaux de bord Looker Studio pour permettre à l’équipe et au client d’en tirer rapidement des conclusions.

job.name: Principal, Senior, Distinguished Engineer, AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services, AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services
job.description:
Description We are hiring Principal, Senior, and Distinguished Engineers to join AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services.

AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services is redefining how the world stores, serves, and reasons over data in the age of AI. Our vision is to make every byte of enterprise data instantly durable, infinitely scalable, and intelligent by default — so that organizations of any size can turn their data into insight and action. We pair decades of hard-won operational experience with relentless curiosity to build the foundational services the rest of the cloud is built on: object storage (Amazon S3), block storage (Amazon EBS), archival storage (Amazon S3 Glacier), analytics and database engines (Amazon Redshift, EMR, SageMaker), and the ultra-high-performance caching layers that make generative AI and analytics fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale. We're hiring Principal and Senior Principal Engineers across the org to own technical direction for some of our hardest problems: building a new cache product purpose-built for GenAI and analytics — delivering ultra-low-latency, ultra-high-throughput access to S3 data at exponential scale; setting architecture for S3 storage at the exabyte tier; and driving the engineering direction of SageMaker, Redshift, EMR, and AWS Database Services. These are deep, high-ownership systems roles — some remote-eligible, others anchored to hubs like Seattle, Irvine, and Berlin — for engineers who have led org-wide technical strategy and want to see it run in production. If you want to build systems that operate at planet scale — where durability, availability, latency, and failure-mode ownership are first-class concerns measured in eleven nines — this is the team.

What You'll Do

This is a rare chance to own and ship the foundational services the rest of the cloud is built on — not features on top of a platform, but the storage, data, and caching layers that everything else depends on, operating at a scale no one else in the industry touches. You'll architect systems that store and serve exabytes of the world's most critical data, where a single design decision ripples across hundreds of millions of customers and millions of applications.

The problems here are unlike anywhere else. How do you deliver eleven nines of durability while adding net-new capabilities to a service that already stores hundreds of trillions of objects? How do you build a new cache product that serves S3 data at ultra-low latency and ultra-high throughput for GenAI and analytics workloads growing exponentially? How do you evolve block, object, and archival storage — and the analytics and database engines on top of them — without ever compromising the durability, availability, and latency guarantees customers have bet their businesses on? These are deep systems challenges solved in production, at a scale where the usual playbooks break down. You help write the new ones.

Read the full description

job.name: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Canada Protected B
job.description:
Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description Role Overview: As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer supporting our Canada Protected B regulated cloud environment, you will provide senior technical leadership for the reliability, availability, scalability, security, and performance of critical cloud infrastructure and services.

In addition to personally solving complex production problems, you will provide technical leadership across systems, services, and engineering teams. You will take ownership of ambiguous, multi-system reliability problems, influence technical architecture and operational standards, lead significant engineering and automation initiatives, and help other engineers solve difficult problems.

The Staff Site Reliability Engineer is an individual-contributor technical leadership role. Success is measured not only by the problems you personally solve, but by your ability to improve the reliability and operability of the broader environment, influence technical direction, reduce systemic operational risk, and increase the effectiveness of other engineers and partner teams.

Canada Protected B Eligibility Due to Government of Canada regulatory requirements, this position requires the successful completion of a Government of Canada Reliability Status screening as a condition of employment. The screening process requires 5 years of verifiable background history. This includes identity verification, education verification, a criminal record check, and a credit check. Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain Reliability Status, which generally requires Canadian citizenship or Canadian permanent resident status. Employment is contingent upon successful completion and maintenance of the required screening.

Work Schedule This position is part of a shift-based Site Reliability Engineering operation supporting the Canada Protected B regulated environment. The initial operating model provides continuous 24x5 coverage through fixed day, swing, and overnight shifts, Monday through Friday.

Each shift includes eight hours of scheduled work and a one-hour unpaid meal period. Adjacent shifts overlap by one hour to support structured warm handovers and continuity of active incident response.

  • Intervenir en cas d’incidents liés à la plateforme dans le cadre d’un système de rotation des gardes, diriger l’analyse des causes profondes et mettre en place des solutions durables.
  • Créer et mettre à jour des manuels d’exploitation, des guides d’utilisation, de la documentation sur les API et du matériel d’intégration.
  • Mettre en place des journaux, des métriques, des traces, des tableaux de bord et des alertes, et appliquer les pratiques d’ingénierie de la fiabilité des sites (SRE) afin d’atteindre les objectifs de disponibilité et de rendement de la plateforme.
  • Mettre en œuvre les pratiques de développement et d’exploitation sécu

job.name: Cloud Engineer
job.description:
Job Description What is the opportunity? Join our dynamic and innovative Hybrid Infrastructure Services Team, where cutting-edge technology meets a passion for driving organizational change. We operate critical shared platforms including Kafka, Elasticsearch, and Redis supporting a large number of internal application teams.

We're not looking for someone who just knows Kubernetes, Kafka, Elasticsearch, and Redis. We're looking for a Senior Engineer who treats AI-assisted engineering as a core skill — someone who uses tools like Copilot and Claude Code as a default way of working, and who can go further: designing and deploying task-specific agents that handle on-call triage, onboarding validation, upgrade pre-checks, and capacity forecasting at scale. You'll help shape how our team delivers meaningfully more value faster automation, smarter self-service, quicker incident response without the tradeoffs of understanding the systems less deeply.

What will you do? Engineering:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable, resilient hybrid Cloud services that align with organizational goals.
  • Use AI-assisted coding (Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent) as your default way of writing and reviewing infrastructure code, scripts, and documentation — holding it to the same review bar as any other change, just produced faster.
  • Design, build, and operate task-specific agents that reduce manual toil — for example, on-call triage agents that correlate metrics and past incidents, onboarding agents that validate requests against policy, or capacity-forecasting agents that flag drift weeks ahead.
  • Define guardrails for agentic workflows: what an agent can act on autonomously versus what requires human sign-off, with full audit trails for every automated action.
  • Conduct performance analysis and optimization of services to ensure efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
  • Identify and implement best practices for resource utilization and scalability across diverse infrastructure landscapes.

Security and Compliance:

  • Implement and maintain security measures to safeguard on-premise and public Cloud environments and data.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements across deployment models, including explainability and auditability of any AI- or agent-driven action on production infrastructure.

Monitoring and Troubleshooting:

  • Set up monitoring and alerting for proactive issue identification across on-premise and public Cloud environments.
  • Respond to incidents promptly, using AI-assisted correlation to speed up diagnosis — while owning the judgment calls (root cause, failover decisions, customer communication) that stay firmly human.

What do you need to succeed? Must-have:

job.name: Systems Operations Specialist
job.description:
The Role

We’re looking for a Systems Operations Specialist to join our Canadian Equities team in Toronto, reporting to the Manager of Systems Operations. In this role, you’ll help keep our trading platforms stable, reliable, and ready to support clients in a fast-moving market environment.

This is a unique opportunity to combine systems operations, market operations, and client support. You’ll fit right in if you’re technically curious, comfortable communicating with clients and internal teams, and energized by solving problems that have a real impact on the Canadian capital markets.

What You’ll Do

  • Monitor and support production systems to maintain the reliability, availability, and performance of our Canadian equities platforms.
  • Configure, maintain, and enhance Linux and AWS-based infrastructure, including supporting the team’s continued migration to AWS.
  • Troubleshoot incidents and real-time application issues, working closely with developers and other technology teams to resolve problems.
  • Support clients and internal stakeholders by responding to technical and operational questions clearly and effectively.
  • Build and improve automation, operational workflows, documentation, and runbooks to reduce manual work and strengthen platform support.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 4 years of experience supporting production systems, cloud infrastructure, or systems operations.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and Linux administration, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux and the Linux command line.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and client service skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative and regulated environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting real-time, highly available, or business-critical applications.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, observability, CI/CD, networking, security, and tools such as Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, or GitLab.
  • An interest in capital markets, trading technology, or financial services.

This position will be located in Toronto and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.

Come as You Are Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

job.description:
Job Description You will be working on a 100% remote schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement. Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings. At Fidelity, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.

Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.

How You’ll Make An Impact As a Software Developer, Agentic AI Platform, at Fidelity Investments Canada, you will support the implementation, deployment and ongoing operation of components used in Agentic AI solutions across AWS and Snowflake.

Working with senior team members and partner teams, you will help move approved Agentic AI use cases from prototype into controlled production environments. The role focuses on practical Python automation, cloud deployment, data integration, monitoring and production support rather than AI model development or research.

Agentic AI Implementation & Integration

  • Support the implementation and integration of approved Agentic AI solutions within enterprise applications.
  • Configure and maintain Python-based automation scripts and integration components used by Agentic AI workflows.
  • Connect Agentic AI solutions with approved enterprise systems, services and data sources.
  • Support retrieval workflows using enterprise documents and structured data stored or processed through platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Assist with data integration workflows involving Snowflake, Informatica Cloud and approved enterprise data sources.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues involving model services, tools, data sources and data pipelines.
  • Follow established engineering standards for version control, logging, exception handling, testing and documentation.

Deployment, Operations & Production Support

job.description:

job.name: Azure Devops Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Platform Engineering & Infrastructure Management

Design, build, maintain, and optimize scalable, secure, and highly available enterprise platforms.

Manage cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Implement infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, and related tools.

Support platform upgrades, migrations, patching, and lifecycle management.

Ensure platform availability, resilience, capacity planning, and disaster recovery readiness.

DevOps & Automation

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab.

Automate infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, and operational processes.

Develop reusable automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.

Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps practices.

Drive continuous improvements in deployment efficiency and operational reliability.

Cloud & Container Platform Management

Manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.

Support orchestration platforms such as AKS, EKS, or OpenShift.

Configure and maintain cloud networking, storage, compute, and security services.

Optimize cloud resource utilization, performance, and infrastructure costs.

Support microservices architectures and cloud native application platforms.

Monitoring, Reliability & Production Support

Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, or Azure Monitor.

Perform proactive platform health checks and performance optimization.

Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, application hosting, and deployment issues.

Lead root cause analysis (RCA), incident resolution, and preventive actions.

Support production environments and participate in on call support rotations.

Establish operational procedures, runbooks, and platform documentation.

Security & Compliance

Implement platform security controls, identity and access management, and encryption standards.

Ensure infrastructure compliance with enterprise security policies and regulatory requirements.

Integrate security scanning and vulnerability management into CI/CD pipelines.

Support audit requirements, patch management, and remediation activities.

Implement secure configuration and secrets management practices.
