job.name: Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Solutions Engineer – Cloud & AI Infrastructure What You'll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives and sales teams to understand customer priorities, identify opportunities, and shape technical strategies.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners across data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure.
  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, architecture discussions, demonstrations, and presentations.
  • Translate customer business and technical requirements into scalable, differentiated Cisco solutions.
  • Develop end-to-end architectures leveraging Cisco's portfolio and relevant technology ecosystems.
  • Contribute technical insights to account planning, opportunity development, cross-sell, up-sell, and competitive strategies.
  • Stay current on emerging trends across data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure and translate insights into customer opportunities.
  • Collaborate with portfolio teams, technical specialists, partners, and sales stakeholders to drive customer outcomes.
  • Support customer workshops, partner engagements, enablement sessions, and industry events.
  • Travel as required for customer, partner, and Cisco engagements across India and internationally.

Who You'll Work With You will be part of a global Cloud and AI Architecture organization, partnering with Account Executives, portfolio sellers, partners, and customers.

The primary focus will be India , with opportunities to support broader APJC engagements and collaborate with global teams.

Who You Are You are a customer-focused technical sales professional with strong architecture expertise and a passion for data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure .

You can engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders, simplify complex technology concepts, and translate customer challenges into business value. You thrive in a collaborative, matrixed environment and are comfortable influencing across teams to deliver customer outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of technical presales, solutions engineering, or relevant hands-on infrastructure experience data center networking, compute, storage and how compute, storage, and network integrate.
  • Deep knowledge and practical experience with the relevant switching and routing protocols and technologies (e.g.,Spanning Tree, OSPF, ISIS, BGP, VXLAN, EVPN, Multicast, QoS, Network Segmentation, etc).
  • Solid understanding of data center networking design fundamentals across traditional 3-tier architecture, VXLAN EVPN, Software Defined Network and Data Center Interconnect.
  • Solid understanding of network security in data center including design and implementation of multi-tenancy, N-S/E-W firewall and microsegmentation.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to deliver engaging demos, Proof-of-Concept, workshops to both technical and non-technical audiences on infrastructure and modernization topics.

job.name: Consultant - Information Security
job.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview The Security consultant is responsible for enabling secure business growth by ensuring that security is embedded into technology solutions, cloud platforms, applications, infrastructure, and business initiatives from design through implementation. The team partners closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Cloud, Risk, Compliance, and Global Information Security teams to promote security-by-design principles and reduce cybersecurity risk across the organization. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and perform first level security architecture reviews for applications, infrastructure, cloud deployments, and technology initiatives.
  • Ensure security review activities are completed within established timelines.
  • Track security findings, risks, exceptions, and remediation activities resulting from architecture reviews, Penetration testing, Vulnerability management.
  • Facilitate the documentation and approval process for security exceptions and risk acceptances.

Required Knowledge And Experiences

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Relevant security certifications (Security+, ISO 27001, CISSP Associate, or equivalent) are desirable.

  • Understanding of Security Architecture and Secure-by-Design principles.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals, including identity and access management, network security, data protection, vulnerability management, and application security.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including Security, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Business stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews, and security compliance initiatives.

job.name: Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Solutions Engineer – Cloud & AI Infrastructure What You'll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives and sales teams to understand customer priorities, identify opportunities, and shape technical strategies.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners across data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure.
  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, architecture discussions, demonstrations, and presentations.
  • Translate customer business and technical requirements into scalable, differentiated Cisco solutions.
  • Develop end-to-end architectures leveraging Cisco's portfolio and relevant technology ecosystems.
  • Contribute technical insights to account planning, opportunity development, cross-sell, up-sell, and competitive strategies.
  • Stay current on emerging trends across data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure and translate insights into customer opportunities.
  • Collaborate with portfolio teams, technical specialists, partners, and sales stakeholders to drive customer outcomes.
  • Support customer workshops, partner engagements, enablement sessions, and industry events.
  • Travel as required for customer, partner, and Cisco engagements across India and internationally.

Who You'll Work With You will be part of a global Cloud and AI Architecture organization, partnering with Account Executives, portfolio sellers, partners, and customers.

The primary focus will be India , with opportunities to support broader APJC engagements and collaborate with global teams.

Who You Are You are a customer-focused technical sales professional with strong architecture expertise and a passion for data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure .

You can engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders, simplify complex technology concepts, and translate customer challenges into business value. You thrive in a collaborative, matrixed environment and are comfortable influencing across teams to deliver customer outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of technical presales, solutions engineering, or relevant hands-on infrastructure experience data center networking, compute, storage and how compute, storage, and network integrate.
  • Deep knowledge and practical experience with the relevant switching and routing protocols and technologies (e.g.,Spanning Tree, OSPF, ISIS, BGP, VXLAN, EVPN, Multicast, QoS, Network Segmentation, etc).
  • Solid understanding of data center networking design fundamentals across traditional 3-tier architecture, VXLAN EVPN, Software Defined Network and Data Center Interconnect.
  • Solid understanding of network security in data center including design and implementation of multi-tenancy, N-S/E-W firewall and microsegmentation.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to deliver engaging demos, Proof-of-Concept, workshops to both technical and non-technical audiences on infrastructure and modernization topics.

job.name: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
job.description:
Description Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.

Key job responsibilities

You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.

You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.

Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

job.name: Sr Specialist - Business Support
job.description:
GCL: D3

Introduction To Role Are you ready to take ownership of critically important services that keep our business moving and help speed life-changing medicines to patients? Can you translate complex incident insights into lasting improvements that protect high-impact operations?

As Service Manager for our Business Support portfolio, you will lead incident, problem, change, and critical issue management throughout the entire process. end. You will coordinate across technology teams, service partners, and business collaborators to restore services quickly, reduce recurring issues, and implement well-governed changes that minimize disruption. Your work will turn operational data into clear priorities and measurable improvements that strengthen resilience across the enterprise.

You will thrive at the center of fast-paced operations—making timely decisions, bringing the right teams together, and communicating clearly with senior leaders. If you enjoy owning outcomes, influencing without authority, and building trusted relationships across technical and business communities, this role puts you in a position to make a visible, enterprise-wide impact.

Accountabilities

  • Incident Leadership: Own high-priority incidents from triage to restoration, set clear priorities, mobilize resolvers at pace, and ensure timely recovery while safeguarding user experience and business continuity.
  • Problem Management: Drive root cause analysis for recurring or material issues, implement corrective and preventive actions, and track known errors to reduce repeat failures and avoidable risk.
  • Change Governance: Coordinate impact and risk assessments, readiness activities, approvals, scheduling, and validation to deliver changes with strong control and minimal disruption.
  • Critical issue Ownership: Handle partner concerns end to end, remove blockers, clarify accountabilities, and ensure actions remain on track to closure with appropriate governance.
  • Collaborator Communications: Deliver accurate, audience-appropriate updates on impact, workarounds, risks, recovery progress, and next steps to operational teams, business leaders, and partners.
  • Operational Controls and Records: Ensure incidents are correctly logged, categorized, prioritized, assigned, updated, resolved, and closed with complete, auditable records aligned to service levels and controls.
  • Trend and Exception Analytics: Analyze incident trends, repeat failures, aged tickets, reopen rates, and SLA exceptions to identify risks early and convert insights into actionable improvements.
  • Service Performance Reporting: Prepare and present service performance reports and insights for operational reviews and leadership forums, highlighting decisions, risks, and required interventions.
  • ServiceNow Reporting and Automation: Create and maintain basic ServiceNow reports and dashboards; identify and implement workflow automations, routing rules, notifications, and process enhancements.
  • Team

Job Description Join Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and play a vital role in the expansion and adoption of innovative cloud technologies. We are developing scalable public cloud services across Compute, Storage, Networking, Governance, Database, and Load Balancing. The Database Operations team is responsible for operating and improving highly available Oracle Database services on Exadata in OCI. If you are a skilled database engineer with a passion for solving complex challenges in high-availability, large-scale cloud environments, we are looking for you to help build and operate next-generation enterprise-class cloud services.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

security controls.

job.name: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (DNS, NTP, LDAP, Linux)
job.description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.

Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description We are seeking a highly experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to implement and support our current and future DNS architecture in private/public cloud. You will be directly responsible for ensuring the scalability, resilience, automation, and performance optimization of our DNS environment by leveraging Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Ansible, and Terraform, or Pulumi.

This is a deeply technical role requiring expert-level understanding of DNS, NTP, LDAP and extensive working knowledge on Linux Operating systems. You will also collaborate with platform and SRE teams to maintain secure, performant, and multi-tenant-isolated services that serve high-throughput, mission-critical applications.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and support large scale DNS Architecture that stretches private & public cloud across multiple regions.
  • Implement and support Infoblox DDI solutions (DNS, IPAM, DHCP), Cloudflare DNS management, Google & AWS DNS services.
  • Implement and support highly reliable NTP and LDAP services on Linux instances.
  • Implement Infrastructure as code leveraging CI/CD automation, Ansible, Terraform/Pulumi, Python and Bash for automated provisioning of DNS services.
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure updates, patches, and rollbacks.
  • Automate monitoring, alerting, and self-healing with GitOps and observability tools (Prometheus, Loki, Grafana).
  • Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and scalable operations.
  • Troubleshoot and analyze performance across hypervisors, storage, and networking.
  • Support on-call rotation, incident response, and root cause analysis.

Qualifications

Modern Workplace Engineering delivers and operates enterprise workplace technologies that enable secure and reliable access across managed devices.   • Own the mobile-platform service lifecycle, delivering engineering backlog items and Level 3 troubleshooting while supporting controlled environments, incident and problem management, knowledge transfer and reliable day-to-day operations.

Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

job.description:
Description Investigation Excellence (IE)

At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step and a day to look forward to new challenges. And today is that day for you. It's your day to be part of something great. A day to make your ideas come to life and your day to join a company that redefines itself every day. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon.

investigation Excellence Overview

Investigation Excellence (IE) is the deep-dive team within ATS Central Operations, owning root-cause investigation across Amazon's European Transportation Surface Transportation network. IE dives deep into every DEA miss — tracing VRIDs from origin to destination, separating true root cause from recovery, and ensuring each disruption is attributed to the right controllable owner. Rather than accepting metrics at face value, the team operates at the lowest level of detail, audits the data themselves, and stays connected to the specifics. IE plays a critical role in giving the network an honest, accurate picture of performance — which is what allows the right teams to fix the right problems and keep Amazon serving customers on time.

Purview of a Program Manager

As a program manager within Investigation Excellence, your role centers on diving deep into transportation execution data to uncover the true drivers behind DEA misses, and on inventing and simplifying the way we investigate — turning manual, repetitive deep dives into scalable, automated solutions (e.g. Kiro, Quick investigation tooling). You will own root-cause classification and attribution logic, drive accuracy and standardization so investigations can be consistently applied across teams, and monitor performance metrics to drive continuous improvement. You hold a high bar for quality and data integrity, look for ways to eliminate effort rather than add it, and foster cross-functional collaboration. Above all, you provide leadership and direction that keeps IE operating as a high-performance, self-sufficient investigation team — focused on efficiency, accuracy, and simplification.

Key job responsibilities

  • On-going generation and creation of reporting.
  • Analyzing data to outline any reasons for under/over performance and take actions to improve performance.
  • Support the delivery of productivity targets for all KPI's
  • Ensure accurate recording and reporting of metrics.
  • Work closely with leadership to identify “hot spots” and take appropriate actions to minimize any impacts.
  • Communicate and interact effectively with operations and support functions to provide internal customers with information/data needs in a timely manner.
  • Evaluate and implement opportunities for improving workflow processes and automation of processes. (Using Excel VBA or in any other tool)
  • Raise awareness to any areas for development or recognition.

job.name: Core Infrastructure Engineer 2
job.description:
Job Description Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under guidance. Applies basic scalability requirements, conducts performance/load testing, and configures resiliency features (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) to handle network variability. Builds telemetry, alerts, and runbook-driven procedures; delivers scoped features and fault-injection tests; and helps implement basic data replication and synchronization. Assists with on-call rotations, uses automation/IaC scripts to troubleshoot, and follows change, security, and compliance procedures (encryption, access controls, remediation plans) while escalating complex issues to senior engineers.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: –Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers.

–Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers.

–Implement scalability requirements for assigned components.

–Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Execute performance and load testing, with guidance.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: –Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs.

–Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: –Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures.

–Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance.

–Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: –Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implement test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance.

–Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: –Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision.

–Follow protocols to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

–Run basic automation scripts and tooling to troubleshoot operational issues.

Job Description AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid – 3 days a week in office)

About Us Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending.

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed.

We're investing heavily in AI — building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production. In total 6-8 years of experience.

Technical Skills

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code.
  • Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code.

  • Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation.
  • Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e.g., MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day.

Leadership & Ownership

  • Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences.
  • At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams.

Mindset & Collaboration

  • Growth mindset — curious, always learning, and open to feedback.
  • Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster.

Nice to Have

Location : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)

Position overview

We are looking for an Architect to set the technical direction of our core backend and AI platform. You will define how we build, orchestrate and scale agentic AI systems on top of highly available, fault-tolerant distributed infrastructure, and make AI-first engineering the default way our teams work.

You will own the platform architecture end to end: from target-state design and architecture RFCs through to reference implementations, evaluation strategy, rollout and production reliability at scale. You stay hands-on, building critical-path components and prototypes yourself.

Our stack is built on Golang and AWS. Language is not a barrier: we care about deep computer science fundamentals, sound architectural judgement, data-driven decisions, and a track record of designing backend platforms that others build on.

Core responsibilities

Agent platform architecture: Define the reference architecture for autonomous agents and multi-agent systems: execution loops, tool-calling (function calling) interfaces, structured outputs, agent-to-agent and agent-to-system protocols (including MCP), and integration with enterprise backends.

Distributed systems design: Architect event-driven backends for asynchronous agent state, long-running and durable workflows (Temporal), context management, and memory/retrieval layers (vector and graph stores, hybrid search). Set the consistency, idempotency and failure-isolation models teams build against.

job.name: Principal Software Engineer, Backend
job.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo. Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo As a Principal Software Engineer, Backend for the Platform & Cloud Services team, you will be a technical cornerstone, helping fulfil Skylo's mission of making satellite connectivity available to all. This is a senior, hands-on Individual Contributor role for an architect-level engineer who is driven by technical excellence and has a passion for mentoring others. You will be a technical authority, responsible for driving the architecture, design, and implementation of our most critical product features and services. This is a technical leadership role, requiring both hands-on expertise and management skills

Your influence will extend across multiple functional groups, ensuring that our backend platform is scalable, resilient, and built to the highest standards. You will lead by example, setting the bar for engineering quality and guiding teams through complex technical challenges, elevating the skills of the entire team.

How You Will Contribute

job.description:
Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities As an Azure Cloud Full Stack Application Developer, you will work in a modern cloud-native environment, building solutions around Azure Native services, microservices-based modular designs, and API-driven microservices. You will collaborate with teams to deliver scalable and resilient backend microservices and rich UI applications using SPA or microfrontends.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Develop Scalable Microservices: Design and develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, bounded context of the business domain, and expose functionality via API and event interfaces.
  • Build Rich UI Applications: Develop rich UI applications using ReactJS or Angular, with a focus on Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends.
  • Implement Event-Driven Architectures: Develop event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and Azure Integration services like Azure Logic apps, Services Bus, Event Grid, and APIM.
  • Manage Azure Services: Run and manage services on Azure, including PaaS, content delivery networks, routing services, databases, and storage.
  • Implement DevSecOps Practices: Use Azure DevOps, GitHub, and Azure CI to implement continuous integration and delivery, and develop infrastructure as code using Terraform and ARM Templates.

Preferred Education Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

job.name: Senior Software Engineer (Mobility)
job.description:
Hiring for BRAHMA AI — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

BRAHMA AI builds an enterprise AI content platform for media, entertainment and brand content teams. Its BRAHMA AI Core (BAIC) platform grew out of the CLEAR media asset management system and helps organisations ingest, manage, search and localise large libraries of video and media, while BRAHMA AI Studio adds generative AI for content creation. The engineering team in Bengaluru is modernising the core platform and adding AI capabilities across it, and this hire strengthens that work.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Mobility) at BRAHMA AI in Bengaluru, you'll build services and APIs for the BAIC platform in Go, Python and .NET, including the APIs that mobile and client apps rely on, along with React micro-frontends. This is a full-time, on-site role working directly with BRAHMA AI.

What you'll do

  • Design and build backend services and APIs for the BAIC platform in Go, Python and .NET, including APIs consumed by mobile and client apps.
  • Keep those APIs fast, versioned and reliable for clients on varied networks and devices.
  • Build React micro-frontends on top of the services you deliver.
  • Model data in PostgreSQL and MongoDB and build search with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
  • Deploy on AWS and Azure with CI/CD in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Review code, contribute to architecture and documentation, and help modernise the platform.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Strong production backend development in at least one of Go, Python or .NET (C#/ASP.NET). Strength in one is enough; willingness to work across the others is expected.
  • Hands-on React experience, ideally with microservices and micro-frontend architectures.
  • Working knowledge of PostgreSQL/SQL and MongoDB, and of a search engine such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
  • Has deployed and run services on AWS or Azure, with CI/CD in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience building an enterprise SaaS or media-tech product, in an agile team.
  • Has built backends or APIs that serve mobile apps, or worked on a mobility product, at production scale.

Nice to have

job.name: Senior Product Manager
job.description:
We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.

You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end-to-end.

You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.

Strategic ownership

  • Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
  • Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
  • Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
  • Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities

Execution leadership

  • Lead cross-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
  • Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
  • Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
  • Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with platform PMs

  • Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
  • Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success

Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following AI-native products or features that users love

  • Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
  • Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
  • Cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas
  • Experiences that balance power with usability.

job.name: Lead, Tech (JSH Analytics)
job.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.

We are looking for an exceptional developer to join our Jsh Analytics team in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Gurugram. Jsh is the firm’s analytics engine, optimizer, portfolio and risk-management system for all its discretionary strategies, and its functionality is consumed firm-wide through real-time data, historical end-of-day data, intraday time-series views, and Excel plug-ins. The Jsh Analytics team focuses on the analytics at the heart of Jsh: adding and changing analytical computations, building instrument-specific analytics, modeling new instruments, and improving pricing, valuation, risk, portfolio, and optimization logic across strategies such as options, energy, macro, and convertible arbitrage. The team also builds reusable analytics and tooling that work across strategies and instruments and drives strategic and infrastructural improvements to the engine. The team primarily works with C++ and Python tech stack.

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: As a member of the team, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing complex financial analytics, tailored to different business groups, that process large volumes of data focusing on correctness, scalability, reusability, performance, efficiency, and fault tolerance. You will add and enhance instrument-specific analytics, pricing, valuation, and risk computations, partnering closely with quants, portfolio managers, and traders, and complex designs and code that meet the requirements of multiple stakeholders. In this role, you will need to understand the complexities of multi-threaded and multi-process (fork-safe), performance-critical systems that cater to ever-changing business needs and balance long-term, big-picture goals against the short-term implications of design decisions. Additionally, you will uphold robust engineering practices, including sound high-level and low-level design, rigorous code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, and architectural disentanglement. You will further be responsible for coaching, guiding, mentoring, and managing junior engineers working across different efforts.

job.name: Data Science / Python / Consultant Specialist
job.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specalist

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

This role develops Python services that use AI to automate document-processing workflows. You’ll integrate with Azure OpenAI through the approved Group AI Platform while meeting enterprise access, security and data-handling requirements. The work includes extracting and validating structured information from PDFs including trade confirmations. Success looks like reliable end-to-end workflows - from ingestion and OCR through to structured outputs that are validated and usable. You’ll build services that handle uncertainty well rather than treating AI responses as automatically correct. You’ll partner across product, data, cloud, security and business teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain Python APIs and services for AI-powered document processing
  • Integrate with Azure OpenAI through the approved Group AI Platform including authentication request handling error handling and usage monitoring
  • Develop PDF ingestion and OCR workflows then convert model responses into validated structured data
  • Design prompts and schemas for reliable extraction then evaluate output quality across real documents
  • Implement handling for uncertainty missing fields and conflicting values to avoid brittle downstream processing
  • Establish human-review paths so AI output does not become authoritative when validation or confidence is insufficient
  • Apply privacy security auditability and data-retention requirements across prompts outputs and logs
  • Write automated tests troubleshoot production issues and contribute to deployment and operational support

What we're looking for

Job Description Why This Role? Why Now?

Customer experience is transforming through AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change — we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionizing how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology. As the technical and product expert for our AI-powered Resolution Platform, the AI Services Consultant role is integral to delivering quick time to value while guiding our customers through their configuration and optimization.

As an AI Services Consultant at Zendesk, your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. You will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex configurations with agility and precision. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure seamless integration and optimization of AI solutions, driving transformative business outcomes.

  • Change Management & Training: Facilitate change management processes and deliver consultative sessions to ensure smooth adoption and integration of AI solutions within customer organizations.

As a Applied Machine Learning Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and deploying state‑of‑the‑art machine learning models that solve complex real‑world problems. You will work closely with cross‑functional teams to transform business requirements into scalable ML solutions, leveraging advanced techniques such as reinforcement learning, deep neural networks, and probabilistic modeling. Your role will involve end‑to‑end model lifecycle management—from data preprocessing and feature engineering to model training, evaluation, and continuous improvement in production environments. You will also contribute to research initiatives, staying ahead of emerging trends in AI to bring innovative approaches to product and operational challenges.

  • Design and implement scalable machine learning pipelines that meet stringent performance and latency requirements
  • Develop and fine‑tune reinforcement learning agents for dynamic decision‑making tasks in real‑time systems
  • Conduct rigorous experimentation, including A/B testing and statistical validation, to ensure model robustness and fairness
  • Collaborate with data engineers to architect high‑quality data ingestion and preprocessing workflows
  • Deploy models using containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and managed cloud services for production readiness
  • Monitor model performance in production, performing drift detection and automated retraining strategies
  • Document model specifications, development processes, and evaluation metrics for reproducibility and knowledge sharing
  • Mentor and coach junior data scientists and ML engineers to elevate team skill levels
  • Stay current with academic research and industry best practices, integrating novel algorithms into production solutions

job.name: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Location: Hyderabad or Bangalore

Mandatory Educational Background: Graduation or Post Graduation with Mathematics & Statistics background.

The role

The Senior Data Scientist will design, build, and deploy data science solutions for nxzen's critical national infrastructure clients (primarily energy and utilities such as water, gas, and electricity, expanding in the mid-term to rail and highways sectors) in the UK, Australia, and internationally, applying predictive analytics and statistical modelling, optimisation and simulation to real operational problems, and leveraging machine learning and AI as tools where they add value.

Based in nxzen’s Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad or Bangalore, you will report to the Director of AI and Analytics and work as part of a growing Data Science team delivering production-grade analytical and predictive solutions for critical national infrastructure operators. This is a hands-on technical delivery role with a team leadership and coaching element. You will write production code, build predictive models, run simulations, and work directly with client data, while leading and mentoring small teams of data professionals alongside you.

The role spans the full data science lifecycle: from problem framing and use case discovery, through exploratory data analysis and feature engineering, to model development, validation, and production deployment. Your core discipline is predictive analytics and statistical modelling, optimisation and simulation. You will apply machine learning techniques (regression, classification, clustering, time-series forecasting, deep learning) and generative AI (LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows) where they are the right tool for the problem. You will work closely with data engineers, analytics leads, and domain consultants to ensure solutions are robust, explainable, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

You will contribute to nxzen’s IP and solution development, and support pre-sales by building proof-of-value prototypes, technical demonstrations, and contributing to proposals and commercial presentations under the direction of the Director of AI and Analytics and the Head of the Data & AI practice. Success in this role requires strong applied data science skills, comfort with messy real-world data, the ability to communicate technical results to non-technical stakeholders, and a genuine interest in energy and infrastructure as an application domain.

Key responsibilities

The Senior Data Scientist will design and deliver data science solutions across nxzen’s critical national infrastructure client portfolio, combining analytical depth with practical delivery focus. You will work on client engagements from discovery through to production, collaborating with onshore/offshore consultants, data engineers, and client technical teams.

Read the full description

job.description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv. We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title Sr. Data Scientist

Senior Data Scientist - Fraud Detection & VAS Services As a Senior Data Scientist in our Fraud Detection & VAS (Value-Added Services) team, you will design, deploy, and monitor enterprise-scale AI/ML solutions that strengthen fraud prevention and risk intelligence across Fiserv's payment ecosystem. You will own the full ML lifecycle, from problem formulation and data exploration to production deployment and continuous improvement, working with product, engineering, and risk teams to deliver measurable business impact.

What You Will Do

  • Design and develop ML models for fraud detection, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and transaction intelligence, using advanced techniques (GNNs, ensembles, deep learning, Generative AI)
  • Build feature engineering pipelines and rigorously validate models using cross-validation, unseen test sets, and business metrics
  • Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines on AWS SageMaker with CI/CD, model versioning, governance, and automated retraining to handle data drift and emerging fraud tactics
  • Optimize models for production (sub-100ms inference, cost efficiency, scale to millions of transactions) and deploy with monitoring, alerting, and SLA compliance
  • Maintain runbooks, track model health and data drift, and communicate risks and improvements to stakeholders
  • Prototype Generative AI, Agentic AI, and RAG solutions, and evaluate emerging technologies (LLMs, vector databases) for fraud use cases
  • Partner with AI/Backend Engineers, DevOps, Product, and Risk teams; lead design reviews and mentor junior team members
  • Ensure solutions meet Fiserv standards for security, explainability, and responsible AI, including bias audits, data privacy, and audit-ready compliance documentation

job.name: Senior AI & Data Science Engineer
job.description:
Designation : Senior AI & Data Science Engineer

Required Experience: 5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

Job Description:

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership -

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows -

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

job.description:
Who we are

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over twenty million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings.

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives.

About the Team and the Work

The BI Engineering team owns the acquisition, storage, modelling and provisioning of data that powers reporting, billing, product decisions and, increasingly, operational features consumed by systems outside BI. Our Redshift-centred warehouse handles hundreds of millions of events a day across a wide suite of products, and the roadmap for the next 18-24 months is the longest and most ambitious it has ever been. We are leveraging AI Workflows and agents across the team for ETL monitoring, query optimisation, code generation, documentation, and performance monitoring.

You'll join at a point where the team is moving beyond "keep the pipeline running" into four parallel streams of work:

  • Redshift Optimisation: Optimising cluster and table configurations, including distribution, sort keys, and compression, to improve query performance. Analysing long-running queries and applying query-level optimisations, while leveraging data aggregation and retention strategies to improve performance, reduce storage, and manage data growth effectively.
  • Data Aggregation & Retention: Designing and building roll-up layers that preserve analytical value while enabling safe deletion of raw-level data. This includes schema design, backfills, data reconciliation, and ensuring backward compatibility for existing reports and consumers.
  • Data provision: Enabling teams to access data by creating curated, fit-for-purpose datasets and APIs for product, operations, and integrator-facing systems. These externally consumed solutions require high availability and strong data reliability.
  • Infrastructure and Performance. Strengthening pipeline monitoring through automated setup and built-in notifications, while proactively identifying query optimisation opportunities and cost-efficiency improvements. Defining solutions to manage data limitations and retention, with data volume remaining a key constraint shaping the overall roadmap.

What will you be doing at Yoti?

job.description:
Job Title Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst

Overview

We are seeking motivated SOC Analysts to join our team. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in detecting, analyzing, and responding to cybersecurity threats while also contributing to research, automation, and advanced security initiatives.

This role blends operational monitoring and product innovation making it ideal for candidates who want to grow into well-rounded cybersecurity professionals—not just alert responders. Candidates must be eager to learn, adaptable to rotating shifts (including night shifts), and passionate about making an impact in cybersecurity defense.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor, analyze, and respond to security alerts, incidents, and potential threats within a 24/7 SOC environment.
  • Perform initial triage, investigation, and escalation of security events, ensuring timely and accurate threat response.
  • Develop and improve automation scripts, tools, and playbooks (primarily in Python) to enhance SOC efficiency and reduce manual workload.
  • Participate in threat research: analyzing emerging attack vectors, malware, and vulnerabilities to strengthen detection strategies.
  • Contribute to security projects—experimenting with new technologies and working on proof-of-concept.
  • Collaborate with senior analysts, threat hunters, and incident response on complex investigations.
  • Maintain documentation of incidents, findings, and process improvements.
  • Continuously upgrade skills through research, and certifications.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
  • Previous experience with SIEM, EDR solutions and log analysis.
  • Strong foundation in networking, operating systems, and security fundamentals (TCP/IP, logs, firewalls, SIEM, IDS/IPS).
  • Hands-on coding/scripting skills – preferably in Python (PowerShell, Bash, or other scripting languages are a plus).
  • Analytical and troubleshooting ability under pressure.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong willingness to work in rotational shifts (morning/afternoon/evening).

Preferred Skills

  • Certifications: CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CEH, or equivalent. are a plus
  • Exposure to malware analysis, threat intelligence,
  • Experience in creating custom detection rules or scripts (YARA, Sigma, Snort, etc.). are plus
  • Previous internship or hands-on project experience in a SOC, cybersecurity lab, or capture-the-flag (CTF) competitions.

Shift Details

  • 5 Day work week, 9hour shift
  • Rotating shifts (Morning/Evening/Night)
  • Must be comfortable with night shifts and flexible to work weekends/holidays as part of the rotation.

job.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Java and Apache Spark Developer to build, enhance and support scalable data-processing solutions on modern enterprise data platforms. The role requires strong Java engineering, distributed data-processing expertise and practical experience with either Snowflake or Databricks. The engineer will work across design, development, testing, optimisation, deployment and production support in an Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test and maintain high-volume batch and near-real-time data-processing applications using Java, Apache Spark and Spark SQL.
  • Build resilient, reusable and maintainable data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, enrichment and distribution across enterprise systems.
  • Develop Java-based services, utilities and integration components that support data workflows and downstream consumers.
  • Implement data solutions on Snowflake and/or Databricks, including transformations, curated datasets and consumption-ready data structures.
  • Optimise Spark jobs through appropriate partitioning, caching, broadcast strategies, join selection, shuffle reduction, resource tuning and data-skew handling.
  • Write complex SQL for transformation, validation, reconciliation and performance-sensitive workloads.
  • Partner with architects, business analysts, product owners and engineering teams to translate requirements into practical technical designs.
  • Implement data-quality controls, logging, monitoring, ing, lineage and operational support features.
  • Create unit, integration, regression and performance tests; support defect resolution, release validation and production deployment.
  • Contribute to code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, technical documentation, runbooks and engineering standards.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across application code, Spark execution, SQL workloads, data pipelines and platform integrations.

Mandatory Skills and Experience

  • 5-7 years of relevant experience in data engineering, backend development or large-scale data-processing applications.
  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Java, including object-oriented design, collections, exception handling, multithreading and performance-conscious coding.
  • Strong practical experience with Apache Spark using Java, Spark SQL and DataFrame/Dataset APIs.
  • Hands-on experience designing and tuning distributed data-processing jobs for scalability, reliability and efficient resource utilisation.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern data platform: Snowflake or Databricks.
  • Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, query optimisation and data validation.
  • Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines and working with structured and semi-structured data.
  • Experience with Git-based development, code reviews, build tools and CI/CD practices.

We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. We deploy, integrate, and operate the Kubernetes-based platform and shared services used to provision, monitor, and operate NVIDIA’s global network across data centers, colocation facilities, and cloud environments. The team owns the architecture and lifecycle of this platform, including cluster provisioning and upgrades, GitOps delivery, observability, capacity, and service enablement. We build software and automation to standardize how network platforms and services are deployed, scaled, and managed across environments.

We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer to own the lifecycle and automation of the Kubernetes platform supporting GNI network systems. You will also provide production support for network services running on the platform, partnering with their engineering owners when issues or changes cross the platform boundary. You will take complex problems from design through production and remain accountable for the outcome. You will bring deep Kubernetes expertise and help establish consistent engineering practices across the US and Bangalore teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership and production responsibility.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and operate the Kubernetes platform that powers GNI network automation, telemetry, and operations across data center, colocation, and cloud environments.
  • Own the lifecycle management for GNI Kubernetes environments, including cluster onboarding, upgrades, capacity, availability, and recovery.
  • Develop production-quality software and automation for cluster provisioning, validation, upgrades, remediation, and safe multi-cluster delivery through GitOps.
  • Provide production support for network services hosted on the platform, working with Network Automation and service teams that retain ownership of application architecture, code, and features.
  • Diagnose complex Kubernetes platform and hosted-service failures involving control-plane health, cluster networking, storage, scheduling, workload placement, and multi-cluster dependencies. Drive issues from initial signal through verified resolution.
  • Define production-readiness and observability standards for the platform and hosted network services, including health signals, capacity, alerts, runbooks, and recovery.
  • Participate in CFR’s production on-call rotation, including scheduled after-hours and weekend coverage. Lead incident response and recovery, then drive corrective actions to completion.

What We Need To See

Role Summary We are looking for an L2 Database Engineer to join our 24/7 Operations Centre. You will be the second line of support for production databases running on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL across AWS and on-premises environments. You will own database monitoring, alert triage, read-only investigation, and incident response using approved runbooks, and escalate to the L3 Database Infrastructure team with clear diagnostics for remediation and deeper engineering work. PostgreSQL and MySQL Operations

job.name: Python Developer
job.description:
We are looking for a seasoned Software Engineer with 4–6 years of hands-on experience in core Python programming, Linux systems, and computer networking. In this hybrid role, you will own critical backend and network-layer software modules, write high-reliability Python code, and lead deep-dive debugging efforts to solve complex software and protocol-level issues. Experience in the telecom domain or AI/ML integration is a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and write clean, high-performance, production-grade software in Python.

  • Lead root-cause analysis, memory/CPU profiling, and low-level debugging across application logic, network stacks, and Linux OS internals.

Required Qualifications

  • Computer Networking Fundamentals: Sound, practical knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, routing, switching, sockets, and network security protocols (TLS/SSL).
  • Linux Internals: Deep fluency in Linux environments, including process/thread management, IPC, virtual memory, file systems, and CLI system diagnostics.
  • Engineering Practices: Strong proficiency with Git, modular software design, and debugging multi-process/distributed applications.

Preferred Qualifications (Added Advantage)

  • Telecom Domain Knowledge: Prior experience with telecom protocols, signaling, packet core, VoIP/SIP, 4G/5G architecture, or carrier-grade network applications.
  • AI / ML Experience: Hands-on experience integrating AI APIs, LLMs, or Python ML/data libraries (e.g., PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy, Hugging Face) into production software.

MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Field Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended R&D organization. Field Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB.

Such transformations are very time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Field Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB’s R&D teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Forward Deployed AI Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernization projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.

Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.

Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.

Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).

Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.

Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.

job.name: Confluent Kafka Developer (CCDAK)
job.description:
Confluent Kafka Developer (CCDAK) · India (Remote) – Pune preferred · Blue Polaris Inc.

Location

India (Remote) – Pune preferred; candidates elsewhere in India welcome

About Blue Polaris

At Blue Polaris, we are redefining how businesses make decisions. As a global leader in decision automation, AI, and business architecture, we partner with Fortune 500 companies to design intelligent, transparent systems using Decision Model and Notation (DMN) and our proprietary Decisions First™ approach.

We don't just solve problems — we model how organizations think, decide, and act. By combining AI, analytics, business architecture, and human expertise, we help enterprises improve outcomes at scale.

Position Overview

We are looking for a CCDAK-certified Apache Kafka developer to design and build a Kafka proof of concept (POC) and turn it into a working event-streaming solution.

This is a hands-on build role. You will own the technical side from architecture to a running solution, prove its value, and document it so the wider team can build on it.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Build

  • Work with our team to define the POC scope, use cases, and success criteria.
  • Design the event-streaming architecture: topics, partitioning, replication, retention, and schemas.
  • Build producers and consumers in Java or Python, with Kafka Streams or ksqlDB processing where needed.
  • Set up Kafka Connect connectors to move data between Kafka and source and target systems.
  • Manage schemas and schema evolution with Schema Registry (Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema).
  • Set up and run the environment on Confluent Cloud or Confluent Platform.

Test, Tune and Hand Over

  • Test for reliability, delivery guarantees, and performance, and tune throughput and latency.
  • Set up monitoring and handle errors, retries, and dead-letter topics.
  • Document the architecture, code, and runbooks.
  • Present POC results and recommendations to the team and stakeholders.
  • Walk teammates through the solution so they can support and extend it.

Requirements

  • Current Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka (CCDAK) certification.
  • Hands-on experience building Kafka solutions that went to production or a client POC.
  • Strong knowledge of Kafka core concepts: brokers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, offsets, delivery semantics.
  • Professional experience writing Kafka producers and consumers in Java or Python (Scala or Go also welcome).
  • Experience with Kafka Connect and Schema Registry.
  • Based in India, able to overlap 3–4 hours with US Eastern business hours for meetings.
  • Professional English, spoken and written.

Key Skills
