job.name: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

job.name: Associate Analyst- II Kolkata
job.description:
Job Description: An Associate Analyst II works with our clients (banks and non-bank financial institutions) to provide advice and counsel in order to help them fight financial crime and mitigate financial crime risks. The purpose of this role is to detect and investigate unusual financial activity by performing detailed monitoring of account activity and ensuring compliance with regulatory policies, operational policies, and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures In short, you are on the front-line of making decisions as to how to keep our clients compliant with applicable law and regulations.

As an Associate Analyst II, you research and analyze various sources of data and provide written summaries of recommendations and conclusions as it relates to the identification of suspicious or unusual financial activity and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.

You will need to exercise discretion and judgment in the work and must be able to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Evaluate and monitor transactional activity to assess potential suspicious activity.
  • Verify the identity of clients to understand the nature and purpose of their relationship with the financial institution for the purposes of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.
  • Interpret and implement client-operating policies regarding financial data.
  • Identify data anomalies and red flags for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and escalate for second level review.
  • Submit written work product for review by AMLRS and client-led quality control teams, make the requested adjustments as necessary, and apply the feedback going forward.
  • Adhere to all designated timeframes and procedure to ensure on time and accurate completion of work.
  • Complete advanced tasks, such as providing peer support and training.
  • Conduct quality reviews, as needed.
  • Meet production and quality standards for completing assignments.
  • Work and contribute in a team-oriented and collaborative environment.
  • Adhere to and comply with all applicable, federal and state laws, regulations and guidance, including those related to Anti-Money Laundering, as well as adhering to company policies and procedures and client requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 1 year of relevant AML/BSA, Fraud, or Compliance experience.
  • Strong oral communication skills and ability to produce narrative and written summaries clearly synthesizing recommendations and conclusions.
  • Strong analytical, problem solving and organizational skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel & Microsoft Word, with ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Ability to multi-task, work independently and as part of a team, establishing cooperative and collaborative working relationships.

job.name: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer

Job Description Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

job.name: Senior QA Automation Engineer – Playwright & TypeScript
job.description:
Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India | Currently Remote, Future Hybrid | Full-time | 3–5 Years' Experience

Own and improve the automation framework behind a growing UK healthcare technology platform.

Script Assist develops sophisticated SaaS software connecting clinics, pharmacies and patients across the UK.

Our platform supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with interconnected workflows covering consultations, prescribing, repeat requests, medicine availability, dispensing and fulfilment.

This creates substantial engineering complexity.

Our applications must work reliably across multiple organisations, different configurations, user roles, permissions and connected services. A seemingly small application change can introduce unexpected behaviour somewhere else in the platform.

As we continue developing the product, dependable automated testing is essential to maintaining quality and supporting confident software releases.

We're looking for a genuinely hands-on Senior QA Automation Engineer to help shape how we test this technology.

You will take meaningful technical ownership of our Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript automation framework , improving its architecture, reliability, maintainability and integration with our engineering workflows.

This is not simply a role for someone who can write automated test scripts. We need an engineer who understands why automation becomes unreliable, how to structure it properly and how to improve its effectiveness across a growing software platform.

Why this role is technically interesting

  • Framework ownership. You'll influence how our Playwright test automation is structured, maintained and extended, rather than simply following an existing pattern.
  • Complex multi-tenant SaaS. You'll help automate workflows across multiple clinics, pharmacies, applications, organisational configurations and user roles.
  • Challenging reliability problems. You'll tackle flaky tests, asynchronous workflows, test-data contamination, unreliable selectors, permissions and difficult-to-reproduce failures.
  • Impact across engineering. Your work will help developers identify regressions earlier, improve CI/CD feedback and give the team better evidence when making release decisions.
  • Technical leadership without losing the coding. You'll review automation code, help other engineers improve and contribute directly to the framework and important test scenarios.
  • Real-world healthcare operations. You'll work on technology supporting significant volumes of complex, interconnected healthcare activity.

What you'll own and deliver

  • Playwright framework architecture: Design, extend, refactor and maintain a robust end-to-end test automation framework using Playwright with TypeScript or JavaScript.

job.name: Internship
job.description:
About The Role You would work on Mangrove — real parts of it, with real consequences — in the same room as the people building it. You take something from a question to working software, and then watch somebody use it.

Mangrove is a Tauri application: Rust underneath, with a React and TypeScript front end. You would write both ends of it.

We take one intern at a time. That is deliberate: teaching somebody properly takes attention, and attention does not divide well.

Why we do this

Companies are hiring fewer junior developers, and AI is doing the work they used to learn on. We still believe a trade has to pass from one generation to the next, one person teaching another.

It is also the point of the company. Our motto is that through learning we flourish, and a company that means it should be willing to spend money on somebody who is still learning.

What you'll do

  • Take one meaningful piece of work from a question to something people use, over three to six months.
  • Sit in on the decisions — what we build, what we decline to build, and why.
  • Say when something we are doing makes no sense. You will often be the only one who can see it, because you are the only one who has not got used to it yet.

What we're looking for

  • A habit of making things, whatever their size and however rough.
  • Curiosity about why things work, not only how.
  • Willingness to be taught, and willingness to argue.
  • Three to six months you can spend in Mumbai, in person.

Compensation & Benefits ₹20,000 a month, paid monthly. What we quote is what reaches you.

Time off works the same for you as for everybody here: every paid day earns two points, ten points buys a paid day off, and you take one without telling us why. Over three months that comes to about thirteen days. If you need a day before you have earned it, take it anyway.

We would rather publish all of this than make you ask for it. You should be able to tell whether a role is worth your time before you spend any of it writing to us.

How to apply

Email us three things: a phone number, the days and times you are free for a ten minute call, and a few sentences on what you want to learn on the job.

We read applications in the order they arrive and keep calling until we have found the person, so we will write to everybody once the place is filled.

job.name: Palo Alto Firewall Engineer, Level 2
job.description:
Hiring for Zurich Insurance — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

Zurich Insurance Group is one of the world's largest multi-line insurers, serving customers in more than 200 countries and territories. In 2026 Zurich opened its Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad as a zero-legacy, AI-first technology hub. Its Security Platform Services team is building an in-house network security engineering capability there, taking over firewall operations for Zurich's global estate.

About the Role

As a Level 2 Palo Alto Firewall Engineer you're the technical escalation point for Zurich's global firewall service. You resolve complex incidents, deliver higher-risk changes and upgrades through Panorama, and turn repeat operational work into automated, API-first workflows. You also mentor Level 1 engineers in Hyderabad.

This is a hybrid role from Hyderabad. Candidates who can join immediately or within 15 days are preferred.

What you'll do

  • Engineer, administer and improve Palo Alto firewall platforms and Panorama across a complex global estate
  • Own advanced diagnosis of firewall, routing, NAT, App-ID, DNS, VPN and connectivity issues, including during major incidents
  • Assess and deliver non-standard and higher-risk changes with design review, testing and rollback plans
  • Lead root-cause analysis for recurring or high-impact incidents and put fixes in place
  • Plan and carry out PAN-OS upgrades, patching and lifecycle work
  • Drive rule recertification, policy optimisation, object clean-up and vulnerability remediation
  • Automate repeat tasks with Python, PAN-OS APIs, Ansible or Terraform, with proper governance
  • Mentor Level 1 engineers and build runbooks and engineering standards

What you bring

  • 4–5 years in network security engineering, with hands-on Palo Alto Networks firewalls in an enterprise environment
  • Hands-on Panorama administration; Strata Cloud Manager exposure is a plus
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, NAT, App-ID, security policy, DNS, and site-to-site and remote-access VPN
  • You have troubleshot complex issues using logs, packet captures and traffic analysis
  • You have delivered production changes and PAN-OS upgrades under ITIL change and problem management
  • Practical scripting or automation with Python, REST APIs, Ansible or Terraform

Nice to have

  • PCNSE, CCNP Security or a similar certification
  • Azure or AWS network security and hybrid connectivity; Prisma Access
  • Infrastructure-as-Code and Git-based workflows
  • Using AI tools for policy analysis, drift detection and troubleshooting

At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.

Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.

Who You Are You are a Senior Software Development Engineer L4 who brings strong reporting and data experience to design, build, and optimize scalable systems that power analytics, business intelligence, and reporting capabilities for clients. You work as a senior technical contributor, helping shape architecture, engineering standards, and delivery practices across the team. You use sound judgment, deep technical expertise, and a data-driven mindset to build secure, reliable, high-performance solutions that support business outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Design resilient, secure distributed systems at scale from initial concept through implementation.
  • Lead technical decisions that raise the engineering bar for scalability, resiliency, security, and overall engineering excellence.
  • Discover, review, and influence evolving designs, architecture, and standards for building and delivering services and solutions.
  • Investigate, design, and implement innovative technologies that expand infrastructure capabilities through robust, scalable solutions.
  • Develop and execute designs for complex systems using strong engineering analysis, testing, and optimization.
  • Create, gather, and use metrics to manage server fleets and complex computing systems, driving automation, performance improvements, and operational efficiency.
  • Own detailed design, analysis, testing, and optimization to ensure solutions are reliable, maintainable, and high performing.
  • Mentor and onboard new team members to support effective ramp-up and ongoing team success.
  • Collaborate with engineers, internal services across Inovalon, and external customers to understand requirements and maintain a tight, data-driven feedback loop.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical issues outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, and respond within defined SLAs.

job.name: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React, Python, AI)
job.description:
Hiring for ClearRoute — via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

About the Company

ClearRoute is a global platform engineering consultancy, headquartered in London with engineering hubs in Pune and Bengaluru. It helps large enterprises bring digital products to market faster, cheaper and more safely, across cloud platforms, quality engineering and developer experience, and it puts AI at the centre of how software gets delivered. ClearRoute is growing its India engineering team for enterprise client engagements and is hiring two senior full-stack engineers who can build AI-enabled applications end to end.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer you'll build, deploy and optimise scalable, high-performance web applications that handle large volumes of data and integrate AI-driven components. You'll work closely with backend engineers, cloud specialists and AI teams to ship intelligent, production-ready applications at scale. This is a full-time role, hybrid from Pune or Bengaluru.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain scalable front-end applications in React and modern TypeScript/JavaScript, backed by Python services
  • Build front ends that stay fast and responsive under high data throughput
  • Integrate applications with AI-powered services: LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, LLM workflows and agentic AI systems
  • Build automation and orchestration services, particularly on Microsoft Azure
  • Deploy applications to the cloud (Azure preferred, AWS welcome) using Docker and cloud-native pipelines
  • Support CI/CD and make deployments reliable and repeatable
  • Improve front-end performance and observability, using measurements to guide decisions

What you bring

  • 6–8 years of software engineering experience, with recent years as a senior full-stack engineer
  • Expert, hands-on React (modern patterns, hooks, state management, performance optimisation) and Python in production
  • Has integrated LLM APIs, RAG or agentic workflows into a real application, not just used AI coding assistants
  • Has deployed applications to a cloud platform, ideally Microsoft Azure
  • Has integrated front ends with APIs, microservices and distributed systems
  • Has worked on applications that handle large datasets or high traffic
  • Familiar with Docker and container-based deployment
  • Strong understanding of front-end performance, observability and optimisation

Nice to have

  • Hands-on Azure automation and orchestration services
  • CI/CD pipeline ownership
  • Consulting or client-facing delivery experience
  • A proactive, ownership-driven way of working rather than ticket-led delivery

*Join Envalior - Imagine The Future!* Are you passionate about cybersecurity and eager to help protect a global organization against evolving threats? At Envalior, we are shaping the future of high-performance materials through innovation, reliability, and operational excellence. For our Pune, India site, we are looking for a Vulnerability Manager to join our Cyber- & Information Security Office and bring vulnerability management expertise in-house.

*IMAGINE THE FUTURE AT ENVALIOR* At Envalior, the future is not only imagined — it is pioneered. We foster an environment where every voice is heard and ideas are valued. Empowerment drives our teams to take initiative, explore new solutions, and continuously improve operations. Join us and become part of a team where safety, performance, and continuous improvement come together to deliver cybersecurity excellence.

  • Analyse and prioritize vulnerabilities based on parameters such as VPR score, exploitability and asset criticality, and recommend remediations in line with industry standards such as CISA and CVE

  • Share reports and insights with stakeholders across the organization

job.description:
About Northern Trust As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. About The Role We are looking for a Senior Data Resiliency Engineer to own the design, implementation, and assurance of our data protection and recovery capabilities across our hybrid cloud estate.

This is a high-trust, high-accountability role. Our backup infrastructure is not just an operational concern — it is a regulatory obligation, a cyber defense layer, and a core component of our operational resilience framework. You will be the subject matter expert who ensures our ability to recover is proven, not assumed, and that our posture satisfies the expectations of regulators including the FCA, PRA, and the requirements of DORA.

You will work in close partnership with Information Security, Technology Risk, Business Continuity, and SRE teams, and will interface directly with audit and regulatory processes.

What You’ll Do Backup & Recovery Engineering

  • Architect, implement, and operate backup and restore solutions across on-premises data centers and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), covering the full range of financial services workloads — core banking systems, trading platforms, payment processing, databases, and unstructured data.
  • Define, own, and continuously validate RTO and RPO targets in alignment with Important Business Service (IBS) mapping and impact tolerances as required under the PRA/FCA operational resilience framework.
  • Own backup policy governance — retention schedules, legal hold processes, data classification alignment, and lifecycle rules — ensuring consistency with data management and records retention obligations under GDPR and FCA COBS/SYSC requirements.
  • Lead a structured restore testing programs including full DR failover, Business Service recovery exercises, clean-room scenario based recovery simulations, and immutable backup integrity validation — with evidence packages suitable for regulatory review.
  • Own backup failure investigation and resolution end-to-end, conducting blameless post-incident reviews and feeding findings into the firm’s risk event process.

Cyber Recovery & Resilience

job.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel.

This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today.

We are looking for a motivated engineer to drive the transformation of performance verification workflows through AI and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy solutions that accelerate verification cycles, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort across hardware performance verification project lifecycles. You will be at the forefront of redefining how performance verification is done at scale — replacing repetitive manual analysis with intelligent, self-improving automation that helps engineers focus on what matters most.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Automate verification workflows by building AI/ML-based tools that generate, triage, and analyse performance test cases and results
  • Develop intelligent agents that can identify performance regressions, root-cause failures, and recommend corrective actions
  • Integrate LLM-based assistants into existing verification infrastructure to enable natural-language querying of results, specs, and coverage data
  • Design data pipelines to collect, curate, and label verification data for model training and continuous improvement
  • Collaborate with verification engineers to understand pain points, define automation priorities, and validate AI-driven solutions against real-world workflows
  • Establish metrics and dashboards to measure automation impact (cycle time reduction, coverage improvement, engineer productivity)

job.name: Lead, Tech (JSH Analytics)
job.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.

We are looking for an exceptional developer to join our Jsh Analytics team in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Gurugram. Jsh is the firm’s analytics engine, optimizer, portfolio and risk-management system for all its discretionary strategies, and its functionality is consumed firm-wide through real-time data, historical end-of-day data, intraday time-series views, and Excel plug-ins. The Jsh Analytics team focuses on the analytics at the heart of Jsh: adding and changing analytical computations, building instrument-specific analytics, modeling new instruments, and improving pricing, valuation, risk, portfolio, and optimization logic across strategies such as options, energy, macro, and convertible arbitrage. The team also builds reusable analytics and tooling that work across strategies and instruments and drives strategic and infrastructural improvements to the engine. The team primarily works with C++ and Python tech stack.

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: As a member of the team, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing complex financial analytics, tailored to different business groups, that process large volumes of data focusing on correctness, scalability, reusability, performance, efficiency, and fault tolerance. You will add and enhance instrument-specific analytics, pricing, valuation, and risk computations, partnering closely with quants, portfolio managers, and traders, and complex designs and code that meet the requirements of multiple stakeholders. In this role, you will need to understand the complexities of multi-threaded and multi-process (fork-safe), performance-critical systems that cater to ever-changing business needs and balance long-term, big-picture goals against the short-term implications of design decisions. Additionally, you will uphold robust engineering practices, including sound high-level and low-level design, rigorous code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, and architectural disentanglement. You will further be responsible for coaching, guiding, mentoring, and managing junior engineers working across different efforts.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. NVIDIA pioneers innovative tech in computer graphics, gaming, and AI, seeking Sr System SW Engineers in Pune, India.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Drive comprehensive power, performance, and Perf/Watt measurements on SoC and system platforms, with a strong emphasis on Windows on ARM (WoA) devices.
  • Characterize system behavior across different states, idle, active, and low-power states, especifically optimizing Hours of Battery Life (HOBL) scenarios (e.g., Productivity, Web Browsing, Conferencing, Video Streaming, Modern Standby).
  • Analyze power telemetry, firmware traces, and OS metrics to identify and mitigate bottlenecks, driving flawless performance.
  • Design, build, and scale automated power measurement infrastructure, integrating Data Acquisition systems (DAQs), telemetry parsers, and ETL pipelines from the ground up.

What We Need To See

  • 5+ Years of experiene with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field.

  • Proven experience with power tools on Windows/Linux platforms, such as WPA, HWInfo, ETL, Xperf, and PowerCfg.
  • ISolid understanding of SoC architecture, including CPU, memory, I/O subsystems, and firmware (BIOS/UEFI/EC).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash for test automation and data parsing.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex execution metrics (latency, throughput, utilization) and balance power vs. performance trade-offs.

Title: Network Administrator - L3

Experience: 6+ years

Location: Delhi

Skills Required: L2 support, Cisco Routers & Switches, troubleshooting, configuration

Notice Period: Immediate joiner or up to 1 Month.

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech (CS/IT/ECE) or M.Sc. (IT/CS) / MCA from a recognised university

We at Coforge are seeking a “Network Administrator – L3" with expertise in enterprise LAN, Data Centre Networks, Routing & Switching, Firewalls, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SDA). The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, troubleshooting, and optimising network infrastructure to ensure high availability, security, and performance of mission-critical environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, configure, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN, WAN, and Data Center Networks to ensure maximum uptime and performance.
  • Manage and support Cisco Catalyst, Cisco Nexus, core switches, distribution switches, routers, wireless controllers, and network appliances.
  • Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, STP, VTP, EtherChannel, Inter-VLAN Routing, HSRP, VRRP, and Layer 2/Layer 3 network services.
  • Implement, configure, and optimize dynamic routing protocols including OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, and Static Routing.
  • Administer and support Software Defined Networking (SDN), Software Defined Access (SDA), and Cisco DNA Center (DNAC) environments.
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco Firepower, Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Firewalls, Access Control Lists (ACLs), IPSec VPNs, SSL VPNs, and Network Segmentation policies.
  • Manage and support Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC), Enterprise WLAN Infrastructure, Wireless Security, RF Optimization, and Wireless Troubleshooting.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for network performance, connectivity, latency, routing, switching, firewall, and security-related incidents.
  • Administer Data Center Networking technologies including Cisco Nexus, VXLAN, EVPN, High Availability Architectures, Redundancy Protocols, and Spine-Leaf Network Design.
  • Monitor network infrastructure using tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, Zabbix, SNMP, Syslog, NetFlow, and Network Analytics Platforms.
  • Perform network capacity planning, bandwidth optimization, performance tuning, and infrastructure health checks.
  • Execute firmware upgrades, software updates, patch management, and lifecycle management of network devices.
  • Configure and maintain network redundancy, failover mechanisms, and disaster recovery solutions.

job.name: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

job.name: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

About The Function Flights is MakeMyTrip’s flagship business, serving millions of travellers across domestic and international routes. Within it, Flights Supply is the engine behind every fare a customer sees, books and gets serviced on. It covers connectivity with airlines, GDS, NDC and aggregators, and the content, pricing and servicing capabilities built on top.

As the business scales, the supply stack must be more reliable, more accurate and less dependent on manual effort. We are building supply systems that detect problems before customers do, keep content and pricing in parity with the source, and use AI to automate work that has traditionally been manual.

The Flights Supply team combines deep distribution knowledge, data-driven decision making and strong engineering partnerships. Product managers, analysts, engineers, designers and business teams work together to make every booking dependable and every servicing journey efficient .

About The Role We are looking for a Assistant Manager, Product Management to own a workstream within Flights Supply, such as supply-side conversion, content and pricing accuracy, or airline and ancillary integrations. This role requires strong product thinking, a quick grasp of technical systems, execution excellence and a passion for solving problems with data and AI.

You will take features and projects from problem definition to launch, working closely with engineering, airline and distribution partners, finance, customer support and the funnel product team. You will shape the direction of your workstream and be accountable for its results

What will you be doing

+ Own the roadmap and delivery for a defined area of the funnel, and shape its direction and priorities in line with the overall funnel strategy.
+ Identify friction and drop-offs in the booking journey through data, customer feedback and competitor benchmarking, and turn them into well-scoped product opportunities.
+ Write clear PRDs and detailed user stories, and groom them in depth with tech so edge cases are covered before development, not after go-live.
+ Work with design to craft simple, high-converting experiences across app, web and mobile web.
+ Define hypotheses and success metrics, run A/B experiments, and read the results with rigour before drawing conclusions.
+ Track funnel metrics such as search-to-book conversion, step-wise drop-offs by channel, platform and region, page performance and revenue per booking. Build dashboards and keep them current.
+ Use AI tools to speed up analysis, research and routine work, and contribute ideas for AI-led booking and discovery experiences.
+ Support launches of new features and experiences across the funnel, working with business, marketing and supply teams.
+ Run execution from concept to launch and post-launch optimisation, and flag risks and delays early.

Role Purpose The Cash & Liquidity Management Specialist partners closely with the Global Process Owner (GPO) to provide subject matter expertise across cash forecasting, liquidity management, banking operations, financial controls, and cash reporting. The role is responsible for driving the standardisation, governance, optimisation, and continuous improvement of global Cash & Liquidity Management (CLM) processes, ensuring effective management of cash, liquidity, and related financial risks across the organisation.

The role combines expertise in Treasury, Financial Control, and Controllership, working closely with Treasury, Controllers, the Centre of Excellence (CoE), Managed Service Providers, and business stakeholders to improve cash visibility, forecast accuracy, liquidity planning, bank account governance, reconciliations, and cash-related reporting.

The role holder will leverage accounting knowledge, cash management expertise, data analytics, and technology-enabled solutions to strengthen controls, improve decision-making, and enhance the effectiveness of the CLM operating model. They will lead and support initiatives that improve forecasting methodologies, optimise liquidity management, automate manual processes, and establish robust governance and performance frameworks.

Acting as a trusted advisor to the GPO and key stakeholders, the role will identify control gaps, operational risks, and improvement opportunities, delivering sustainable solutions that balance global standardisation with business and regulatory requirements. The role will also represent and deputise for the GPO as required, providing leadership on CLM governance, transformation initiatives, and process improvement activities across the global finance community.

Main Accountabilities Cash Forecasting & Liquidity Management

  • Lead the development, governance, and continuous improvement of short-term and long-term cash forecasting processes and methodologies.
  • Drive improvements in cash visibility, forecast accuracy, liquidity planning, and cash performance reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to optimise cash utilisation and support effective liquidity management across the organisation.
  • Develop meaningful cash and liquidity insights to support Treasury and Finance decision-making.

We are looking for a highly skilled Nokia Corteca Technical Specialist to support the deployment, operational readiness, troubleshooting, and incident resolution of Nokia's Corteca platform for Bharti Airtel.

The individual will be responsible for understanding the end-to-end Corteca architecture, identifying probable fault domains, performing advanced technical diagnostics, and guiding troubleshooting activities to accelerate root cause analysis and service restoration.

· Develop an in-depth understanding of Nokia Corteca architecture, implementation, service workflows, and deployment topology.

· Support deployment-related technical activities and operational troubleshooting.

· Perform advanced application troubleshooting, debugging, and log analysis.

· Analyse packet captures and network traffic flows to identify potential points of failure.

· Diagnose issues across cloud-native applications, microservices, container orchestration, messaging brokers, databases, and supporting infrastructure.

· Identify whether reported issues originate within the Corteca platform or from external interfacing systems.

· Guide technical teams in troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

· Correlate logs, metrics, events, and application behaviour across multiple monitoring and diagnostic tools.

· Coordinate with Nokia TAC/TEC, R&D, Bharti Airtel teams, and third-party technology specialists for issue resolution.

· Facilitate faster fault isolation, service restoration, and technical closure of critical incidents.

· Provide technical updates and recommendations to relevant stakeholders during incident resolution.

3. Technical Skills & CompetenciesA. Core Technical Expertise

Nokia Corteca Platform

· Understanding of Nokia Fixed Networks Corteca architecture and implementation.

· Knowledge of end-to-end service workflows and deployment architecture.

· Application-level troubleshooting and debugging.

job.name: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

job.name: Senior Software Engineer (.NET), Pricepoint
job.description:
Vendavo powers the shift to digital business for the world's most demanding B2B companies, unlocking value, growing margin and accelerating revenue. Companies in chemicals, distribution, high-tech and manufacturing use Vendavo to build customer insight and pricing strategies that maximize margin and improve sales effectiveness.

Vendavo Pricepoint is our price management product, built on C#/.NET and SQL Server. It lets large enterprises set, govern and update prices at scale, with pricing logic, workflows and integrations to ERP and other Vendavo products.

THE OPPORTUNITY

  • Design, build and test features end to end in C#/.NET and SQL Server: backend, database, integration tests, and customer-specific extensions.
  • Own one or more product components and their quality; mentor other engineers and take an active part in code reviews.
  • Analyze requirements with Product Management and the lead engineer, estimate the work, and explain the trade-offs.
  • Tune performance in application code and in T-SQL: query plans, deadlocks, timeouts, large data volumes.
  • Write unit and integration tests (xUnit, tSQLt), and help the team move UI regression from Selenium to Playwright.
  • Take part in platform upgrades and modernization: .NET runtime and library upgrades, SQL Server upgrades, deployment on AWS and Kubernetes, and observability.
  • Investigate customer escalations to root cause with Support and our cloud operations team, and fix security findings from pen tests and scans.
  • Support the release cycle (three major releases a year, regular patches and urgent fixes for critical customer issues), including fixes for the previous major version and cherry-picks into release branches.

The Skills

  • 5+ years of professional software development in C#/.NET.
  • Strong knowledge of modern .NET (8 or later; we run .NET 10) and ASP.NET (MVC and Web API).
  • Strong SQL Server and T-SQL skills: stored procedures, functions, indexing, reading execution plans, query tuning, locking and deadlocks, large data volumes, schema changes in a live product.
  • Hands-on unit and integration testing (e.g. xUnit, Moq) and database unit tests (e.g. tSQLt).
  • Git, pull-request workflows, CI/CD (Azure DevOps) and Agile delivery (Scrum).
  • Experience troubleshooting production systems and finding root causes.
  • Experience with IIS-hosted applications and Windows services.
  • Clear written and spoken English (B2+).

AI skills

  • Hands-on use of AI coding agents (we use Claude Code) for coding, refactoring, tests and code review.
  • Good judgment on where AI output needs verification; owns every line they merge, whoever wrote it.
  • Uses and extends the team's shared AI skills and repo conventions (CLAUDE.md).
  • Uses AI to speed up test work: writing unit and Playwright tests, and fixing issues found by AI-assisted test triage.
  • Follows review, security and data-confidentiality standards for AI-generated code, in line with Vendavo's AI policies.

Tool & System Integration

Agentic Workflows & Automation

  • Design end-to-end agentic workflows that automate complex, multi-step business processes

  • Implement event-driven agent triggers integrated with enterprise systems and data streams

Slack Platform & Agent Accessibility

job.name: Senior Solutions Automation Engineer
job.description:
Description Hungry, Humble, Honest, with a Heart.

The Opportunity

Nutanix Validated Designs (NVDs) certify Nutanix Solutions cross-product interoperability at scale. Solutions Automation Engineers build the software behind that certification: the programmatic environment builds and validation workflows that Solutions Architects and Quality Engineering rely on.

We are changing how that work gets done. Standing up infrastructure is already a solved problem for us, because our Python infrastructure-as-code tooling builds the same environment the same way every time. Judgment is the harder part, and it covers reading a validated design, catching the contradictions buried in it, and justifying every design decision before anything gets built. That is the work we are handing to agents.

In this role you will write the deterministic Python that has to be correct on every run, and you will build the agentic workflows around it: the prompts, the skills, the guardrails, and the evaluations that decide when an agent can act on its own and when control belongs to a pipeline or to a person.

You will work on hard problems at scale, with the freedom to deliver, alongside engineers who care about getting it right.

Your Role

  • Design, build, and maintain Python software that deploys, configures, and validates Nutanix private and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Build agentic workflows around that software, including prompt engineering, agent skill and tool development, and the evaluation harnesses that show a workflow works before we rely on it.
  • Decide what belongs in deterministic code and what belongs to an agent, and be able to defend that decision. Most of what you deliver should be deterministic and repeatable, with agents used where the problem involves ambiguity, synthesis, or design judgment.
  • Use agentic coding tools in your daily work, and help raise the team's practice as the tooling changes.
  • Build and operate cloud native, automated pipelines, covering containerized workloads, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, so that builds and validations run without manual intervention.
  • Automate validation as part of building the feature, and catch regressions before a release reaches a customer.
  • Analyze failures, determine root cause, and drive fixes to closure.
  • Demo your work to Solutions Architects, product teams, and customers, and write documentation that other people can actually use.
  • Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues.

What You'll Bring

Read the full description

Qualifications

  • Experience with Data Modeling and designing structures optimized for analytics, reporting, and storage efficiency.
  • Proficiency in Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes, including developing, scheduling, and monitoring ETL workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Data Warehousing concepts and implementation on modern cloud platforms.
  • Applied Data Analytics skills, with the ability to translate business questions into data solutions and actionable insights.
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (e.g., Python, Scala).
  • Experience with modern data platforms and tools (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Spark, cloud services such as AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of data governance, data security, and best practices for data quality and observability.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional environment and mentor junior data engineers.

Working closely with Business Process Owners, Oracle ERP teams, Blueprint organizations, and vendor teams, you will drive demand management, project planning, prioritization, delivery governance, stakeholder communication, and execution oversight. job.description:
Job Description We are looking for a creative developer who can support the development of interactive dashboards, digital tools, data visualisations and AI-enabled workflows, while also helping teams build the capability to create and use these solutions independently. The role is not intended to become a bottleneck for every dashboard, slide or digital output. Instead, it should act as an enablement function that develops reusable tools, templates, agents, training materials and workflows that help project teams work faster, smarter and more consistently.

Responsibilities

  • Lead knowledge-sharing sessions to demonstrate practical use cases, lessons learned, reusable methods and examples of good practice.
  • Develop interactive slides, offline HTML dashboards, online web dashboards and lightweight digital tools.
  • Produce Tableau dashboards/workbooks and Power BI dashboards as formal deliverables when required.
  • Create charts, KPI cards, heatmaps, maps, scenario tools and visual analytics.
  • Convert Excel, CSV, APIs and technical models into user-facing interfaces.
  • Build dashboards for engineering, sustainability, infrastructure, climate, energy and operations use cases.
  • Create reusable dashboard templates, prompt libraries, coding structures and visual assets that other team members can adapt.
  • Develop AI agents and semi-automated workflows to support analysis, reporting, dashboard creation, slide generation and data visualisation.
  • Train and support project teams on the use of AI tools, dashboard templates, data visualisation approaches and prompt engineering.
  • Enable teams to independently produce high-quality digital outputs by providing guidance, examples, templates and practical coaching.
  • Use AI coding tools to prototype quickly, improve design quality and iterate based on feedback.

Qualifications

  • Strong frontend skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern dashboard UI approaches.
  • Experience with Tailwind, Chart.js, React-style interfaces or similar frameworks.
  • Practical experience developing engineering solutions dashboards or technical analytics tools.
  • Ability to develop Tableau dashboards/workbooks, Power BI dashboards and Stata-based analytics outputs.
  • Experience creating reusable templates, workflows, agents or automation tools that enable others to work more efficiently.
  • Strong prompt engineering capability, with the ability to structure clear, effective AI prompts to accelerate coding, dashboard development, design iteration, data visualisation and content refinement.
  • Strong UI/UX design capability, with the ability to create intuitive, visually polished interfaces through effective layout, typography, visual hierarchy, colour systems, iconography and user flow.
  • Ability to train, guide and upskill non-technical teams in the use of AI-enabled tools and digital workflows.

job.description:
Overview :

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

Job Summary: This role will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi and will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

We collaborate closely with public- and private-sector partners to translate big questions into deep insights that improve programs, refine strategies, and enhance understanding using data science and analytics. job.name: Lead II - Telco Engineering :: Domain SME
job.description:
Role Description Must-Have Skills

  • Deep expertise in Telecom Core Network architecture including 2G/3G/4G/5G, EPC, 5GC (AMF, SMF, UPF, NRF), and IMS.
  • Strong knowledge of network protocols and interfaces such as Diameter, SS7, SIP, GTP, and RADIUS.
  • Hands-on experience with CDRs/xDRs, PM (Performance Management) Counters, FM (Fault Management) Alarms, and Signaling Traces.
  • Experience working with OSS/BSS systems, network probes, and telecom vendor platforms
  • Strong understanding of telecom network KPIs including throughput, latency, call drop rate, handover success rate, and service availability.
  • Experience supporting network operations, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and capacity planning activities.

Data Engineering

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data extraction, transformation, analysis, and automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake including data warehousing, schema design, performance tuning, and query optimization.
  • Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines using Databricks.
  • Working knowledge of PySpark for large-scale data processing.
  • Understanding of data modeling, data quality, and data governance principles.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines for telecom network datasets.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Exposure to Machine Learning use cases such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, and network optimization.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of telecom data privacy, security, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Experience working in data analytics and reporting environments supporting telecom operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Core Network architecture, protocols, and network data sources.
  • Partner with Network Engineering, OSS/BSS, and NOC teams to translate telecom domain knowledge into data engineering requirements.
  • Analyze call flows, signaling traces, network KPIs, and operational metrics to support business and operational analytics.
  • Perform network performance troubleshooting and root-cause analysis using PM counters, FM alarms, CDRs/xDRs, and signaling data.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, Snowflake, and Databricks.
  • Support ingestion, transformation, and exposure of network data for reporting and analytics platforms.
  • Document network data models, schemas, business rules, and data lineage.
  • Ensure compliance with telecom security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve network visibility, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.

Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”

Job Description The SAS Macro Developer (Manager) will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-level SAS macros, with a primary focus on automating and standardizing TLF (Tables, Listings, and Figures) generation workflows . While the core expertise will drive TLF efficiencies , the incumbent will also support broader SDTM and ADaM processes . The incumbent will serve as a subject matter expert in automation and play a critical role in ensuring clinical data programming meets global regulatory standards.

In this role, a typical day might include the following:

  • Architect, develop, and deploy complex, dynamic, and reusable SAS macros to optimize SDTM, ADaM, and TLF generation processes.
  • Build automated tools and utilities for data transformation, variable derivation, and quality control (QC) checks to improve delivery timelines.
  • Ensure all macro development and validation activities rigorously follow the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and comply with 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP guidelines.
  • Perform robust testing of macros. Author and maintain comprehensive validation documentation including User Requirement Specifications (URS), test plans, test scripts, and traceability matrices.
  • Partner with statistical programmers, biostatisticians to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance, code review, and training to the broader Biometrics team to promote the adoption of new macros and programming best practices.
  • Provide hands-on programming support during peak regulatory submission periods and troubleshoot complex macro-related issues.

The experience we are looking for

Slate’s “Digital Assistant'' uses machine learning and AI to execute multi-dimensional analysis across internal and external data sources. This includes public data such as weather, labor, and traffic with the dark data locked in silos and non-integrated systems within their own and sub-contractor organizations. Want to join us on this incredible journey?

Slate India is a fully owned subsidiary of Slate Inc, aiming to be the Technology hub in the AEC space, from 3D digital twins, building design to logistics to collaboration tools. job.description:
Req ID: 399309

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Lead Engineer to join our team in Delhi, Delhi (IN-DL), India (IN).

Job Title :

Confluent Kafka Platform Engineer / Administrator

Experience :

6–7 years of overall experience, with strong hands-on experience in Apache Kafka / Confluent Platform administration, Kafka Connect, and Kubernetes/EKS-based deployments.

Role Summary :

We are looking for a strong Confluent Kafka Platform Engineer to support and administer an enterprise Kafka ecosystem hosted on AWS EKS/Kubernetes.

The role will be responsible for Kafka platform operations, Kafka Connect support, production troubleshooting, security, monitoring, performance, upgrades, and coordination with application and infrastructure teams.

The candidate should be comfortable working in a 24x7 production support / managed services environment with L2/L3 responsibilities and should be flexible to support rotational shifts, on-call coverage, weekend support and critical production incidents as required.

Key Responsibilities :

Confluent Kafka Platform Administration

Monitor and manage Kafka cluster health, brokers, topics, partitions and replication.

Create/modify topics and manage retention, partitions and replication configurations.

Monitor consumer groups, offsets and consumer lag.

Troubleshoot under-replicated partitions, broker failures, connectivity and performance issues.

Perform capacity and performance analysis for Kafka clusters.

Support cluster scaling, configuration changes and platform maintenance.

Support Kafka upgrades, patching and version compatibility activities.

Participate in RCA for production Kafka incidents.

Kafka Connect

Administer and support Kafka Connect clusters and connectors.

Monitor connector/task status and troubleshoot failed or stuck connectors.

Perform connector restart/recovery and approved configuration changes.

Troubleshoot source/target connectivity, serialization and data-processing issues.

Support file/SFTP/database/API-based connector integrations.

Understand connector offsets, error handling, retry/DLQ patterns and task distribution.

Security & Access Management

Manage Kafka ACLs and access permissions.

Support service accounts, API keys and credential rotation.

Support SSL/TLS certificates and authentication-related issues.

Troubleshoot authorization, authentication and certificate failures.

Coordinate with security/network teams for access and connectivity issues.

Schema & Confluent Components

Support Schema Registry and schema-related issues.

Good understanding of Avro, JSON Schema and Protobuf.

Knowledge of Confluent Control Center and platform monitoring.

job.name: Senior Platform Engineer
job.description:
We are looking to engage an experienced Senior Platform Engineer to design and build this shared platform capability.

This is a hands-on engineering role combining cloud platform engineering, workflow orchestration, automation and Python developer enablement. It is not a traditional infrastructure administration role and is not a pure application-development role. The successful candidate will work across Amazon Web Services, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service, Kubernetes, Argo Workflows, infrastructure automation, platform security, observability and delivery pipelines.

The role will also create reusable Python libraries, workflow abstractions, examples and documentation that enable actuarial and other adopter teams to build their own governed workflows. The Platform Engineer will provide enablement, technical review and assurance rather than developing all adopter business logic.

The initial delivery model is expected to include two cross-functional Platform Engineers. Each engineer should be capable of contributing across the end-to-end platform lifecycle, reducing key-person dependency and ensuring the platform remains supportable after initial delivery.

Role Responsibilities

Platform Engineering

  • Design and implement the platform on Amazon Web Services, using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service and standard Kubernetes interfaces.
  • Create cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, storage and security configuration through version-controlled Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
  • Implement Argo Workflows and related platform services for multi-step, parallel, recoverable and traceable workflow execution.
  • Configure workload classes, queues, priorities, quotas, compute pools, autoscaling and cost controls for analytical and batch workloads.
  • Integrate approved container registries, secrets management, object storage, monitoring, logging and enterprise service-management capabilities.
  • Build for high availability, controlled upgrades, disaster recovery, operational support and future portability.

Developer Enablement

  • Develop supported Python libraries, software development kits and abstractions that simplify workflow creation and hide unnecessary Kubernetes complexity.
  • Create representative workflow examples, templates and reference implementations for adopter teams.
  • Define clear workload contracts covering inputs, outputs, parameters, resource requirements, status, failure handling and retained artefacts.
  • Provide guidance and technical review to actuarial and other teams building workloads on the platform.
  • Produce concise developer documentation, onboarding material and troubleshooting guidance.

Delivery Automation

  • Create supported Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines for building, testing, scanning, signing and promoting container images and workflow assets.

job.name: Senior Staff Engineer
job.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission - Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.

What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.

Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.

Read the full description
