job.name: Technical Co-Founder / Founding Partner -Pipeleap
job.description:
Company Description Pipeleap is a sales productivity and sales stack optimization platform designed to help revenue teams spend less time on administrative tasks and more time selling. The product connects to the CRM, prospecting, enrichment, engagement, inbox, and calendar tools that teams already use, unifying data and handling the operational work across these systems. Pipeleap keeps the CRM as the central source of truth while ensuring that sales representatives remain in control by approving changes. The platform is built for teams that want to get more value from their existing sales stack without adding unnecessary complexity.

Role Description The Technical Co-Founder / Founding Partner will lead the end-to-end technical vision, architecture, and implementation of Pipeleap’s platform. This full-time, on-site role in the Greater Hyderabad Area involves hands-on backend and frontend development, system design, and integration with major CRM and sales tools. The person in this role will collaborate closely with the business co-founders to translate customer needs into product features, define the technical roadmap, and make build-versus-buy decisions. Daily responsibilities include writing production-quality code, reviewing contributions from early team members, managing infrastructure and security, and establishing engineering best practices. The role also includes recruiting and mentoring the initial engineering team, owning technical documentation, and contributing to fundraising and customer conversations where technical insight is needed.

Qualifications

  • Strong backend engineering skills with experience in building scalable, secure SaaS platforms (e.g., Node.js, Python, Java, or similar).
  • Proficiency in modern frontend frameworks and building responsive, user-centric interfaces (e.g., React, Vue, or similar).
  • Experience integrating with CRMs and sales tools via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines; familiarity with data synchronization and reconciliation.
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and CI/CD practices (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, containerization, monitoring).
  • Background in data modeling, database design, and performance optimization for high-volume transactional or analytics workloads.
  • Demonstrated ability to own technical strategy, make architectural decisions, and balance speed with reliability in an early-stage startup.
  • Comfort working closely with customers and non-technical stakeholders, with clear communication and product-thinking skills.
  • Previous startup, founder, or early-stage experience, and a strong interest in sales tech or revenue operations is highly beneficial.
  • Education: no degree or certification required-proven skills and shipped work are mandatory.

Compensation: co-founder equity stake (vesting over 4 years) + salary once funded.

job.name: SDE II, Amazon Business Operations
job.description:
Description Are you excited about building software that operates at massive scale and directly impacts millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II for Amazon Business Operations, you will design, build, and deliver features that solve unique B2B supply chain tech problems while raising the bar on code quality and operational excellence. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from defining requirements and designing systems to deploying and operating production services. This is an opportunity to grow your technical skills, mentor fellow engineers, and contribute to software that matters. If you are a collaborative, curious engineer who thrives on turning ambiguous problems into clean, maintainable solutions, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and implement software solutions across major portions of your team's systems, balancing functional and non-functional requirements such as scalability, performance, and security.
  • Deliver working features spanning the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, system design, coding, testing, deployment, and operational support.
  • Actively participate in code reviews, providing meaningful and constructive feedback to teammates, and coach others on producing high-quality, maintainable code.
  • Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, continuously improving system reliability and your team's operational processes.
  • Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to understand business needs and ensure your solutions deliver the right customer value.

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics from a recent launch, then jump into a design discussion with teammates to map out a new feature. After lunch you write and test code, pausing to review a pull request from a colleague and share feedback. You wrap up by triaging an operational alert, identifying the root cause, and documenting a fix. Throughout it all, you balance new feature work with operational improvements and mentoring newer engineers on your team.

About The Team AB Operations is the logistics partner for Amazon Business and owns the delivery experience for commercial customers. Our organization covers supply chain management, product management, data engineering, applied science, QA, and business intelligence, and we are now adding a dedicated software development team to take on new problems that will unlock a new tier of fulfillment for enterprise customers. The engineering work spans backend services, ML model deployment, driver-facing UX changes, and API integrations with 3P carriers. You will report to the AB Ops tech leadership and work alongside an established org that has a presence in 11 countries.

By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.

Job Description: Role Overview We are seeking an Atlassian Platform Specialist to join our Global Competency Center in Chennai and become a key technical resource supporting our global Atlassian environment.

This is a hands-on role responsible for the administration, development and continuous improvement of Jira and the wider Atlassian platform. The role will support teams across the organization through effective workflow design, service management, automation, integrations, forms, reporting and custom solutions.

Working closely with the global platform owner, the Atlassian Platform Specialist will take ownership of day-to-day platform administration and technical delivery while helping us develop scalable, well-governed solutions.

We are looking for someone who can go beyond simply configuring Jira. The successful candidate will be comfortable understanding a business problem, investigating the requirement and recommending how Jira, Jira Service Management, automation or integration capabilities can best be used to solve it.

  • Administer and maintain Jira Cloud, Jira Service Management and associated Atlassian capabilities.
  • Configure and manage projects, workflows, issue types, screens, custom fields, schemes, permissions, notifications and platform settings.
  • Manage Jira Service Management request types, queues, SLAs, portals and service configurations.
  • Support platform access, roles, groups and permission structures.
  • Troubleshoot complex platform and configuration issues.
  • Monitor the Jira environment and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve configuration.
  • Support the adoption and implementation of new Atlassian functionality.

Workflow & Solution Design

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business requirements, challenges and processes.
  • Translate requirements into effective, scalable Jira solutions.
  • Design workflows, forms, data structures and automation supporting operational and service-management processes.
  • Determine whether requirements are best addressed through native Jira functionality, automation, APIs, integrations or custom solutions.

  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), production deployments, and post-release validation.

We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

As Bluehost scales, reliability and good data both depend on strong platform engineering. You'll lead the team that keeps our infrastructure resilient and our data trustworthy — from cloud architecture and containerized hosting to backup/disaster recovery, observability, and the pipelines that turn raw data into insight for product and growth teams across a fast-growing SMB SaaS platform.

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a small team while staying hands-on as a software engineer yourself.

As a manager

  • Lead and develop a team of ~4 engineers spanning data engineering, devops, cloud infrastructure, hosting solutions, and observability — hiring, mentoring, and owning performance and career development.

  • Drive on-call and incident-response practices so pipeline, cloud, and hosting issues are caught before they hit customers or a dashboard.

As an engineer

  • Write and review code for data pipelines, devops tooling, cloud configuration (infrastructure-as-code), observability instrumentation, and backup/recovery solutions.

Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high-stakes, judgement-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor.

At the core is Accrete’s Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization’s tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high-stakes decisions — not just answer questions about them.

From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement.

job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a talented MERN Stack Developer to architect and implement the backend infrastructure and APIs for a mobile multiplayer game. The focus will be on building real-time battling systems, matchmaking logic, and leaderboard functionality. You will be responsible for designing, coding, and optimizing APIs that ensure smooth player-versus-player (PvP) experiences, persistent progression tracking, and global ranking systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs for multiplayer gameplay.
  • Build real-time matchmaking and battle synchronization APIs using Node.js, Express, and Socket.io/WebSockets.
  • Design and implement leaderboard APIs (global, regional, seasonal, friend-based).
  • Manage player data persistence in MongoDB, including:
  • Player profiles, teams, rosters
  • Match history and battle outcomes
  • Ranking and progression data
  • Ensure low-latency communication between clients and server during battles.
  • Create secure authentication and authorization APIs (JWT/OAuth2).
  • Implement reward APIs tied to battle outcomes and leaderboard positions.
  • Develop admin APIs for monitoring, analytics, and game balancing.
  • Write detailed API documentation for mobile team integration.
  • Monitor, scale, and optimize backend systems for high concurrent player loads.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Proven experience with Socket.io/WebSockets for real-time communication.
  • Experience in designing scalable RESTful/GraphQL APIs.
  • Understanding of game mechanics and multiplayer server architecture.
  • Proficiency in MongoDB schema design and performance optimization.
  • Strong grasp of security practices (rate limiting, API throttling, data validation, encryption).
  • Familiarity with load balancing and cloud deployment (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Elo/MMR ranking algorithms or custom matchmaking logic.
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and Docker/Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of reward systems, battle pass integrations, and seasonal events.
  • Prior work on real-time multiplayer mobile games.

Here’s a comprehensive list of APIs the developer would be expected to build for such a game

1. Authentication & Player Profile APIs

2. Matchmaking APIs

3. Battle APIs

4. Leaderboard APIs

5. Ranking & Progression APIs

6. Rewards & Economy APIs

About Knowva Systems

Knowva Systems builds a school management platform used by schools and campuses to run their day-to-day work: admissions, students and attendance, fees and payments, exams and report cards, timetables, staff and payroll, transport and communication. The platform has two parts:

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Quality SME / Solution Architect to lead Data Quality strategy, requirements translation, solution design, and delivery for enterprise client engagements.

The ideal candidate will work directly with client stakeholders/client proxies, understand complex business and data requirements, translate them into actionable Data Quality rules, and guide a small team of Data Quality Engineers to deliver the solution.

Define and own the overall Data Quality and testing strategy across different data pipeline layers.

Support platform architecture and configuration, including users, roles, workspaces, connections, notifications and related administration.

Ensure appropriate separation between active Data Quality testing, data cataloguing and upstream data governance.

Maintain high standards of documentation, rule inventories, exception handling and delivery processes.

Required Technical Skills

SQL – Must Have

Strong/advanced SQL skills with experience in enterprise databases.

Complex joins, CTEs and window functions.

Query optimisation and performance tuning.

Experience working with large-scale datasets.

Exposure to one or more of the following is preferred:

Snowflake

Databricks / Databricks SQL

Other enterprise-scale SQL environments

job.name: Senior Staff AI Application Engineer
job.description:
Job Description Summary We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who has shipped production applications, and who has owned software that other engineering teams depended on — a framework, SDK, shared library or internal developer platform — living with an abstraction decision long enough to have had to correct it while consumers depended on it. Establishing engineering standards through automation rather than documentation should be instinctive.

You will be the senior technical owner of GE HealthCare's internal AI engineering platform: the shared libraries, standardised interfaces, code generation tools and automated verification our data scientists and engineers use to take AI solutions into production. It exists to deliver four outcomes for the company:

  • reduce time from working prototype to production from months to days;
  • allow data scientists to ship production-grade AI without expertise in cloud infrastructure, deployment, application security or front-end development;
  • make security, compliance and consistency automatically enforced properties of every solution, rather than outcomes dependent on scarce expert review;
  • allow underlying technologies to be replaced — model provider, agent framework, user interface approach — without rewriting the solutions built on them.

Your accountability is the platform's architecture and public interfaces, the automated verification that enforces our engineering standards, and the versioning and migration approach that keeps it dependable as it evolves beneath a growing number of applications. The role also includes building AI applications end to end yourself — front end, back end and agents — where that is the fastest way to prove a platform capability or unblock a priority use case; the emphasis at this level sits firmly on the platform, with application work serving it rather than competing with it. This is a hands-on senior engineering role with substantial architectural responsibility and organisational influence — not a management position, and not a research position.

Job Description GE HealthCare's Chief Data and Analytics Office is delivering a portfolio of strategic AI programmes across Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing and Operational Excellence.

job.name: Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
Born in India, Built for the World

Amagi is an Emmy®-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication.

Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers:

9,000+ channels across 300+ content distributors

500,000+ hours of content processed

26 billion+ monetized ad impressions

We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore https://www.amagi.com/social-impact.

Role Overview

We are seeking an impact-driven Machine Learning / AI Engineer to bridge the gap between complex business challenges and scalable AI solutions. In this role, you will own the entire ML lifecycle—from problem framing and custom model training to rigorous evaluation and deployment. Rather than just implementing off-the-shelf tools, you will design intelligent systems that solve real-world problems, making key architectural decisions alongside a multidisciplinary team.

Working closely with Product Managers and stakeholders, you will act as the technical translator to ensure our AI initiatives drive core product objectives. You will tackle complex, high-impact challenges—such as building real-time video intelligence pipelines to extract semantic meaning from live broadcasts, designing predictive fan engagement models for our Fanpulse initiative, and architecting intelligent systems that automate dynamic, personalized media workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Problem Framing & Strategy: Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to translate ambiguous business problems into concrete, solvable machine learning and AI formulations.

Frontier AI Research & Experimentation: Continuously explore, experiment with, and benchmark the latest frontier models, emerging architectures, and AI techniques. Develop rigorous evaluations to identify where new capabilities deliver measurable improvements, and turn promising breakthroughs into practical, production-ready solutions for our business.

Data Collection & Processing: Design and implement robust data pipelines. Identify, gather, clean, and preprocess the datasets required to train and evaluate high-performing models.

Model Training & Fine-Tuning: Build custom ML/AI solutions from the ground up. Train, fine-tune, and optimize traditional ML algorithms, deep neural networks, and open-source foundation models to solve domain-specific problems.

job.name: Senior Engineer - AI
job.description:
Who Are We? Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

About The Team Postman sits at the center of how the world's APIs get built, tested, and consumed. That's an insane dataset. If you've been deep in the agent tooling ecosystem — building with sandboxes, remote execution environments, code generation pipelines — and you've been thinking about what all of this looks like when it's backed by real-world API intelligence at massive scale, this is the role.

We're building Agent Mode and the next generation of AI-powered capabilities at Postman. We just released Postman v12, but in the AI world, every day is day zero. Check out the latest demo.

This doesn’t mean bolting a chat window onto an existing product. It's rethinking what an API platform becomes in an AI-native, API-first world — where agents don't just assist developers, they become developers. Postman has a unique position to make that real, and we need people who already intuitively understand why.

The Opportunity You live in this space. You're not reading about agents from the sidelines — you're building with them, breaking them, and forming opinions about why certain architectures work and others don't. You can talk about the tradeoffs between different sandboxing approaches, how workspace and execution environments shape agent capabilities, and what the actual bottlenecks are in shipping reliable AI features. Your opinions are evidence-backed because you've done the work, either in production or for exploration.

You've used AI to 10x yourself. Not theoretically. You have multiple concrete examples — side projects, open source contributions, internal tools, workflow automations — where you used AI tooling to operate at a fundamentally different level of output. If you haven't been experimenting with [almost] every new model, framework, and dev tool that drops, this probably isn't the right fit.

job.name: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
job.description:
About the Role: GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work — embedded with business unit teams, proving ideas through PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies — Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI — and this role brings that model to GSK.

This senior engineer role embeds directly with business unit teams — product owners, engineering leads, and the wider BU — to understand the problem and execute. Most prototyping work is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine coding, freeing the FDE to focus on framing, judgement, and validation. The role works directly inside the customer’s business and emerges with working software and a defensible value hypothesis — not slideware. The FDE does not carry use cases through to long-term operations — clean handoff to the Sr. Solutions Engineer is part of the role.

Why This Role Exists: Enterprise AI’s impact depends on engineers who can close the gap between what AI can do and what the business needs — fast, embedded, and without requiring the business to specify everything upfront. The FDE is that engineer.

  • Proves AI ideas fast — shipping working prototypes at days-to-weeks cadence before significant investment is committed.
  • Works directly inside the business — not at arm’s length — building the trust and domain understanding that separate useful AI from academic AI.
  • Builds the organisation’s reusable AI engineering assets — every engagement distilled into patterns, agents, and reference architectures the whole team benefits from.

Key Responsibilities: PoC / PoV / MVP Delivery:

  • Take ownership of high-priority BU use cases from problem framing through to a working prototype, at days-to-weeks cadence, and form a defensible view on whether each should progress.
  • Ship first production versions directly for use cases where the path is clear — before the Sr. Solutions Engineer takes them forward to scale.

AI-Native Engineering:

  • Operate AI agent workflows (planning, coding, testing, review, documentation) for autonomous prototype delivery — selecting the right level of automation for each engagement.
  • Use AI coding assistants as the default mode of building; provide judgement, course-correction, and validation.

Customer Embedding & Handoff:

  • Embed with BU teams — attend standups, understand the domain, prototype against real data and real workflows.
  • Package proven use cases cleanly for the Sr. Solutions Engineer — working code, architecture rationale, open risks, and scaling concerns.
